        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        background: #fff;
      }
      .proj-editor-wrapper .ql-container {
        flex: 1;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }

      .ql-editor::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 4px;
      }
      .ql-editor::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: #cbd5e1;
        border-radius: 4px;
      }

      body.mode-split .project-section {
        order: 10;
        background: #fff;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        box-shadow: 0 -4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
        z-index: 15;
        padding-bottom: 20px;
      }

      }

      body.mode-split .sheet {

      }

      .proj-toggle-icon {

        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        border-radius: 4px;

      .proj-toggle-icon:hover {

      .project-scroll {

          padding 0.28s ease;

      .project-section.collapsed .project-scroll {
        max-height: 0;
        opacity: 0;
        padding-top: 0;
        padding-bottom: 0;
        margin: 0;
      }

      /**
 * Section: Fullscreen Writing Mode & Input Refinements
 * Responsibilities: Rules for distraction-free fullscreen editing, pin label wrapping,
 * and auto-growing textareas.
 */
      body.editing-active .sheet,
      body.editing-active .overlay {
        position: fixed !important;
        top: 0 !important;
        left: 0 !important;
        right: 0 !important;
        bottom: 0 !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        height: var(--visual-viewport-height, 100dvh) !important;
        background: #ffffff !important;
        z-index: 10000 !important;
        border-radius: 0 !important;
        transform: none !important;
        backdrop-filter: none !important;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
      }
      body.editing-active .sheet .sh-body,
      body.editing-active #sheetBody {
        padding: 0 !important;
        flex: 1 1 auto !important;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
        min-height: 0 !important;
        height: 100% !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
      }
      body.editing-active .editor-container,
      body.editing-active .proj-editor-wrapper {
        flex: 1 1 auto !important;
        min-height: 0 !important;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        border: none !important;
        border-radius: 0 !important;
      }
      .rt-shell,
      body.editing-active .rt-shell {
        flex: 1 1 auto !important;
        min-height: 0 !important;
        height: 100% !important;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        position: relative !important;
      }

      body.editing-active header,
      body.editing-active .timeline-strip,
      body.editing-active .project-section,
      body.editing-active .master-btn,
      body.editing-active .add-fab,
      body.editing-active .cal-grid,
      body.editing-active .nav-group {
        display: none !important;
      }

      body.editing-active .sheet .sh-body {
        padding: 0 !important;
        flex: 1 !important;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
      }

      body.editing-active .editor-container {
        border: none !important;
        border-radius: 0 !important;
      }

      .pin-chip {
        font-size: 0.6rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        padding: 2px 4px;
        border-radius: 3px;
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        color: var(--primary);

        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;

        line-height: 1.3;
        border-left: 2px solid var(--primary);
        display: block;
      }

      .inp-flat {
        border: 1px solid #eee;
        background: var(--bg-body);
        padding: 8px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        flex: 1;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        resize: none;
        overflow: hidden;
        field-sizing: content;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
        word-wrap: break-word;
      }

      .proj-desc-inp {
        width: 100%;
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        border-bottom: 1px dashed transparent;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        margin-top: 4px;
        padding: 2px 0;
        font-family: inherit;
        transition: 0.2s;
        resize: none;
        overflow: hidden;
        field-sizing: content;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
        word-wrap: break-word;
      }

      /**
 * Section: Viewport Coordinator & Mobile Accessibility
 * Responsibilities: Dynamic viewport geometry, mobile virtual keyboard stability,
 * safe-area insets, focus rings, touch targets, and reduced-motion preferences.
 */
      :root {
        --visual-viewport-height: 100dvh;
        --visual-viewport-offset-top: 0px;
        --safe-area-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
        --safe-area-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
      }

      html,
      body {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        overscroll-behavior: none;
      }

      body {
        height: var(--visual-viewport-height, 100dvh);
        min-height: 0;
      }

      button,
      input,
      textarea {
        font: inherit;
      }

      button,
      [role="button"] {
        touch-action: manipulation;
      }

      :focus-visible {
        outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 75%, white);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }

      input:focus-visible,
      textarea:focus-visible,
      .ql-editor:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--primary);
        outline-offset: -2px;
      }

      header {
        min-height: calc(54px + var(--safe-area-top));
        height: auto;
        padding-top: var(--safe-area-top);
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      main {
        min-height: 0;
      }

      .view-toggle {
        width: auto;
        min-width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
        padding: 0 9px;
        display: inline-flex;
        gap: 6px;
      }

      .view-toggle::after {
        content: attr(data-mode-label);
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .nav-btn {
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
      }

      .add-fab,
      .master-btn {
        width: 52px;
        height: 52px;
      }

      .f-chip {
        min-height: 36px;
        border: 0;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .cp-dot {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
        flex: 0 0 30px;
      }

      .color-picker {
        overflow-x: auto;
        scrollbar-width: none;
      }

      .color-picker::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
      }

      body:not(.mode-split) .overlay,
      .master-panel,
      .project-panel {
        top: var(--visual-viewport-offset-top, 0px);
        bottom: auto;
        height: var(--visual-viewport-height, 100dvh);
        max-height: var(--visual-viewport-height, 100dvh);
      }

      .sheet {
        max-height: 100%;
      }

      body.mode-split {
        height: var(--visual-viewport-height, 100dvh);
        min-height: 0;
      }

      .sh-body,
      .mp-content,
      #projectBody,
      .ql-editor {
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      }

      .editor-container,
      .proj-editor-wrapper,
      .ql-container.ql-snow {
        min-height: 0;
      }

      .editor-actions {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        padding: 12px 15px calc(12px + var(--safe-area-bottom));
        background: #fff;
        border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
        z-index: 50;
        display: flex;
        gap: 10px;
        box-shadow: 0 -4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
      }

      #sheetBody.editor-active,
      #masterContent.editor-active,
      #projectBody.editor-active {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
        flex: 1 !important;
        min-height: 0 !important;
        height: auto !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
      }

      #projectBody.editor-active .proj-editor-wrapper {
        flex: 1;
        height: auto;
        min-height: 0;
      }

      #projectBody.editor-active .ql-container,
      #masterContent.editor-active .ql-container,
      #sheetBody.editor-active .ql-container {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #projectBody.editor-active .ql-editor,
      #masterContent.editor-active .ql-editor,
      #sheetBody.editor-active .ql-editor {
        height: 100%;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }

      body.editing-active .overlay {
        top: var(--visual-viewport-offset-top, 0px) !important;
        bottom: auto !important;
        height: var(--visual-viewport-height, 100dvh) !important;
      }

      body.editing-active .sheet {
        position: absolute !important;
        inset: 0 !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        height: 100% !important;
        max-height: 100% !important;
      }

      body.keyboard-open .sheet,
      body.keyboard-open .master-panel,
      body.keyboard-open .project-panel,
      body.keyboard-open .project-scroll,
      body.keyboard-open .clock-widget {
        animation: none !important;
        transition: none !important;
      }

      body.keyboard-open .overlay {
        backdrop-filter: none;
      }

      body.keyboard-open .sheet {
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      body.keyboard-open .master-btn,
      body.keyboard-open .master-panel > .add-fab,
      body.keyboard-open .project-panel > .add-fab,
      body.keyboard-open .project-section {
        visibility: hidden !important;
        pointer-events: none !important;
      }

      #fabBtn {
        bottom: calc(16px + var(--safe-area-bottom));
      }

      .save-status {
        position: fixed;
        top: calc(
          var(--visual-viewport-offset-top, 0px) + var(--safe-area-top) + 10px
        );
        right: 12px;
        z-index: 12000;
        padding: 7px 11px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.92);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(8px);
        pointer-events: none;
        transition:
          opacity 0.18s ease,
          transform 0.18s ease;
      }

      .save-status.visible {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }

      .sr-only {
        position: absolute !important;
        width: 1px !important;
        height: 1px !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        margin: -1px !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important;
        white-space: nowrap !important;
        border: 0 !important;
      }

      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        /* iOS auto-zoom lock: form fields only. .ql-editor must stay out so
           the document zoom (font-size: calc(16px * var(--doc-zoom))) works
           on phones too. */
        input,
        textarea {
          font-size: 16px !important;
        }

        .ql-toolbar.ql-snow {
          min-height: 46px;
          flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
          overflow-x: auto;
          overflow-y: hidden;
          scrollbar-width: none;
        }

        .ql-toolbar.ql-snow::-webkit-scrollbar {
          display: none;
        }

        .ql-toolbar.ql-snow .ql-formats {
          display: inline-flex;
          flex: 0 0 auto;
          margin-right: 4px;
        }
      }

      @media (max-width: 380px) {
        .view-toggle::after {
          display: none;
        }
      }

      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        *,
        *::before,
        *::after {
          scroll-behavior: auto !important;
          animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
          animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
          transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        }
      }

      /**
 * Section: Extended Sheet Layout & Modular Controls
 * Responsibilities: Fullscreen sheet expansion, compact project strip headers,
 * editor toolbar layering, and action buttons.
 */

      /* Fullscreen Daily Sheet Mode */
      body.sheet-fullscreen .overlay {
        top: var(--visual-viewport-offset-top, 0px) !important;
        bottom: auto !important;
        height: var(--visual-viewport-height, 100dvh) !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        background: #fff !important;
        backdrop-filter: none !important;
      }
      body.sheet-fullscreen .sheet {
        position: fixed !important;
        inset: 0 !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        height: var(--visual-viewport-height, 100dvh) !important;
        max-height: none !important;
        border-radius: 0 !important;
        transform: none !important;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
      }
      body.sheet-fullscreen .sheet .sh-body {
        flex: 1 1 auto !important;
        min-height: 0 !important;
        overflow-y: auto !important;
      }
      body.sheet-fullscreen header,
      body.sheet-fullscreen .timeline-strip,
      body.sheet-fullscreen .master-btn {
        display: none !important;
      }
      .btn-full.is-on {
        background: var(--primary-soft) !important;
        color: var(--primary) !important;
        border-radius: 8px;
      }

      /* Compact Project Strip Header */
      .project-section {
        padding: 6px 10px 8px !important;
        gap: 2px !important;
      }
      .project-section .section-title {
        font-size: 0.7rem !important;
        padding: 2px 4px !important;
        min-height: 28px;
      }
      .project-section .section-title button {
        padding: 2px 6px !important;
        font-size: 0.7rem !important;
      }
      .project-scroll {
        padding: 6px 4px 8px 4px !important;
        max-height: 124px !important;
        gap: 10px !important;
      }
      .proj-3d-card {
        height: 92px !important;
        min-width: 132px !important;
        padding: 10px !important;
      }
      .project-section.collapsed {
        padding-bottom: 2px !important;
      }

      /* Editor Toolbar Stacking and Positioning */
      .ql-toolbar.ql-snow {
        position: sticky !important;
        top: 0 !important;
        z-index: 900 !important;
        background: var(--bg-body) !important;
        overflow: visible !important;
      }
      .editor-container,
      .proj-editor-wrapper,
      .ql-container.ql-snow,
      .sh-body.editor-active,
      #masterContent.editor-active,
      #projectBody.editor-active {
        overflow: visible;
      }
      .ql-container.ql-snow {
        z-index: 1 !important;
      }
      .ql-snow .ql-picker {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 950 !important;
      }
      .ql-snow .ql-picker.ql-expanded {
        z-index: 1000 !important;
      }
      .ql-snow .ql-picker-options {
        z-index: 1001 !important;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18);
        border-radius: 8px;
        max-height: 46vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }
      .ql-snow .ql-picker.ql-expanded .ql-picker-options {
        position: absolute !important;
        top: 100% !important;
        margin-top: 2px;
      }
      .ql-snow .ql-tooltip {
        z-index: 1002 !important;
      }
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        /* Scrollable toolbar with visible dropdown overflow */
        .ql-toolbar.ql-snow {
          flex-wrap: wrap !important;
          overflow-x: visible !important;
          row-gap: 2px;
        }
        .ql-snow .ql-picker-options {
          max-height: 38vh;
        }
      }

      /* Compact Action Buttons for Master Cards */
      #masterResults button:not(.f-chip):not(.tab):not(.add-fab) {
        padding: 4px 8px !important;
        font-size: 0.62rem !important;
        line-height: 1.1 !important;
        min-height: 26px !important;
        border-radius: 6px !important;
      }
      #masterResults button svg {
        width: 12px !important;
        height: 12px !important;
      }
      #masterResults .acc-timer {
        font-size: 0.55rem !important;
        padding: 2px 6px !important;
      }
      #masterResults .meta-row {
        font-size: 0.5rem !important;
      }

      /* Shared Control Bar and Action Buttons */
      .pk-bar {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        padding: 8px 14px;
        background: #fff;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 30;
      }
      .pk-btn {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 4px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--text-main);
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        padding: 5px 9px;
        border-radius: 7px;
        cursor: pointer;
        min-height: 28px;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .pk-btn:hover {
        background: #f8fafc;
      }
      .pk-btn.is-on {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        border-color: var(--primary);
        color: var(--primary);
      }
      .pk-btn.pk-pin.is-on {
        background: #fffbeb;
        border-color: #f59e0b;
        color: #b45309;
      }
      .pk-btn.pk-del {
        background: #fee2e2;
        border-color: #fecaca;
        color: var(--danger);
      }
      .pk-icon {
        width: 28px;
        height: 28px;
        padding: 0;
        display: inline-grid;
        place-items: center;
        border-radius: 7px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        cursor: pointer;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .pk-icon.pk-del {
        background: #fee2e2;
        border-color: #fecaca;
        color: var(--danger);
        font-weight: 800;
      }
      .pk-icon:active {
        transform: scale(0.94);
      }

      /* Split All-Projects Panel Grid Layout */
      .pl-panel {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        background: var(--bg-body);
        z-index: 2400;
        display: none;
        flex-direction: column;
      }
      .pl-panel.active {
        display: flex;
      }
      .pl-head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 12px 15px;
        background: #fff;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      .pl-title {
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .pl-split {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }
      .pl-split.has-preview {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }
      @media (min-width: 760px) {
        .pl-split.has-preview {
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
        }
      }
      .pl-list {
        overflow-y: auto;
        padding: 12px;
        min-height: 0;
      }
      .pl-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));
        gap: 10px;
        align-content: start;
      }
      .pl-grid.pk-list-mode {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }
      .pl-card {
        position: relative;
        background: #fff;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 14px;
        padding: 12px 12px 34px;
        cursor: pointer;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
        min-height: 96px;
      }
      .pl-card.is-pinned {
        border-color: #f59e0b;
        background: #fffdf5;
      }
      .pl-card-title {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-main);
        line-height: 1.3;
        /* Multi-row project cards grid */
        white-space: normal;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        word-break: break-word;
      }
      .pl-card-meta {
        margin-top: 6px;
        font-size: 0.6rem;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .pl-card-actions {
        position: absolute;
        right: 8px;
        bottom: 8px;
        display: flex;
        gap: 5px;
      }
      .pl-card-actions .pk-icon {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
        font-size: 0.8rem;
      }
      .pl-preview {
        display: none;
        border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
        background: #fff;
        overflow-y: auto;
        padding: 14px;
        min-height: 0;
      }
      @media (min-width: 760px) {
        .pl-split.has-preview .pl-preview {
          display: block;
        }
      }
      .pl-empty {
        text-align: center;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        padding: 40px 16px;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
      }

      /**
 * Section: Project Panel Animations & Responsive Breakpoints
 * Responsibilities: Smooth collapse transitions, project workspace header,
 * unified action icons, and responsive layouts.
 */

      /* Collapsible Project Strip Transitions */
      .project-section {
        transition:
          padding 0.28s ease,
          gap 0.28s ease;
      }
      .project-section.collapsed {
        padding: 4px 10px !important;
        gap: 0 !important;
      }
      .project-section.collapsed .project-scroll {
        max-height: 0 !important;
        min-height: 0 !important;
        opacity: 0 !important;
        padding-top: 0 !important;
        padding-bottom: 0 !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
        border: 0 !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        pointer-events: none;
        visibility: hidden;
      }
      .project-section.collapsed .section-title {
        min-height: 24px !important;
      }
      .project-section .section-title {
        user-select: none;
        border-radius: 8px;
      }
      .project-section .section-title:hover {
        background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03);
      }
      .proj-toggle-icon {
        transition: transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
      }

      /* Project Strip Card Layout */
      .proj-3d-card {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        justify-content: flex-start;
        background: linear-gradient(150deg, #ffffff 0%, #f4f7fb 100%) !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.22) !important;
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04),
          0 6px 16px -8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18) !important;
        transition:
          transform 0.18s ease,
          box-shadow 0.18s ease;
      }
      .proj-3d-card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow:
          0 2px 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05),
          0 12px 24px -10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.28) !important;
      }
      .proj-3d-card .p-card-title {
        font-size: 0.85rem !important;
        line-height: 1.3;

        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 10px 10px 8px 12px;
        background: linear-gradient(
          180deg,
          var(--doc-tint, #fff) 0%,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) 100%
        );
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.18);
      }
      .doc-card-title {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        line-height: 1.35;
        color: var(--text-main);
        display: -webkit-box;
        -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
        -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
        overflow: hidden;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }
      .doc-card-tools {
        display: flex;
        gap: 4px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      /* Collapsed preview with internal scroll */
      .doc-card-body {
        padding: 10px 12px !important;
        max-height: 170px;
        overflow-y: auto !important;
        overflow-x: hidden !important;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
        scrollbar-width: thin;
        font-size: 0.82rem !important;
        line-height: 1.55 !important;
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .doc-card-body::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 5px;
      }
      .doc-card-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: #cbd5e1;
        border-radius: 4px;
      }
      .doc-card.is-expanded .doc-card-body {
        max-height: none;
        overflow-y: visible !important;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card-body {
        max-height: 300px;
      }
      .doc-card.is-expanded .doc-expand svg {
        transform: rotate(180deg);
      }

      /* Authored HTML containment */
      .doc-card-body > *:first-child {
        margin-top: 0 !important;
      }
      .doc-card-body h1,
      .doc-card-body h2,
      .doc-card-body h3,
      .doc-card-body h4 {
        font-size: 0.95rem !important;
        line-height: 1.3 !important;
        margin: 6px 0 4px !important;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }
      .doc-card-body p,
      .doc-card-body li,
      .doc-card-body blockquote,
      .doc-card-body span,
      .doc-card-body div {
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        word-break: break-word;
        max-width: 100%;
      }
      .doc-card-body img,
      .doc-card-body video,
      .doc-card-body iframe,
      .doc-card-body svg {
        max-width: 100% !important;
        height: auto !important;
        border-radius: 8px;
        display: block;
      }
      .doc-card-body pre,
      .doc-card-body code {
        white-space: pre-wrap !important;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        max-width: 100%;
        font-size: 0.74rem !important;
      }
      .doc-card-body pre {
        padding: 8px !important;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: #f1f5f9 !important;
      }
      .doc-card-body table {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 100%;
        overflow-x: auto;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
      }
      .doc-card-body td,
      .doc-card-body th {
        padding: 3px 6px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .doc-card-body blockquote {
        margin: 6px 0 !important;
        padding-left: 10px !important;
        border-left: 3px solid var(--primary);
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }

      .doc-card-foot {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 6px 8px 6px 12px;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.16);
        background: #fcfdff;
        font-size: 0.6rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .doc-foot-right {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
      }
      .doc-stamp {
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .doc-pin-tag {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 4px;
        color: #b45309;
      }
      .doc-pin-tag svg {
        width: 10px;
        height: 10px;
      }
      .doc-expand {
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 0;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .doc-expand:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        border-color: var(--primary);
        color: var(--primary);
      }
      .doc-expand svg {
        width: 13px;
        height: 13px;
        transition: transform 0.2s ease;
      }

      /* Master Planner metadata badges */
      .doc-card .meta-row {
        border: none !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
      }

      .doc-empty {
        text-align: center;
        padding: 56px 20px;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .doc-empty-ico {
        font-size: 2.4rem;
        opacity: 0.45;
      }
      .doc-empty-title {
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-main);
        margin-top: 8px;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
      }
      .doc-empty-sub {
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        margin-top: 2px;
      }

      /* Responsive Grid Layouts */
      @media (max-width: 430px) {
        .doc-controls,
        .proj-controls,
        .mp-controls {
          padding: 9px 12px !important;
        }
        .doc-scroll {
          padding-left: 12px;
          padding-right: 12px;
        }
        .doc-grid {
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important;
        }
        .doc-card-body {
          max-height: 150px;
        }
        .doc-controls .pk-btn span,
        .proj-controls .pk-btn span {
          display: none;
        }
      }
      @media (min-width: 1000px) {
        .doc-card-body {
          max-height: 200px;
        }
      }
      @media (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape) {
        .doc-card-body {
          max-height: 120px;
        }
      }

      /**
 * Section: Sticky-Note Document Visuals & Theming
 * Responsibilities: 3D sticky note card styles, folded corner decorations,
 * pin tape indicators, and per-card color palettes.
 */

      /* Smooth momentum scrolling */
      html {
        scroll-behavior: smooth;
      }
      .doc-card-body,
      .sh-body,
      .mp-content,
      #masterResults,
      #projectBody,
      .pl-list,
      .pl-preview,
      .doc-scroll,
      .project-scroll {
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        scroll-behavior: smooth;
        scrollbar-width: thin;
        scrollbar-color: #cbd5e1 transparent;
        will-change: scroll-position;
      }
      .doc-card-body::-webkit-scrollbar,
      .sh-body::-webkit-scrollbar,
      .mp-content::-webkit-scrollbar,
      #projectBody::-webkit-scrollbar,
      .pl-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 6px;
        height: 6px;
      }
      .doc-card-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
      .sh-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
      .mp-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
      #projectBody::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
      .pl-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: #cbd5e1;
        border-radius: 999px;
      }
      .doc-card-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
        background: #94a3b8;
      }
      .doc-card-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: transparent;
      }

      /* Rounded card base */
      .doc-card {
        border-radius: 18px !important;
        background: var(--doc-tint, #fff) !important;
        position: relative;
        isolation: isolate;
      }
      .doc-card-head,
      .doc-card-foot,
      .doc-card-body {
        background: transparent !important;
      }
      .doc-card-head {
        border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.07) !important;
      }
      .doc-card-foot {
        border-radius: 0 0 18px 18px;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.07) !important;
        color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--doc-ink, #334155) 72%, transparent);
      }
      .doc-card-title {
        color: var(--doc-ink, var(--text-main));
      }
      .doc-tape {
        display: none;
      }

      /* Grid Mode: 3D Sticky Note Cards */
      .doc-grid:not(.is-list) {
        gap: 18px 14px;
        padding-top: 8px;
      }
      .doc-grid:not(.is-list) .doc-card {
        border: none !important;
        border-radius: 16px !important;
        /* Layered elevation and ambient lighting */
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
          0 4px 6px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1),
          0 14px 22px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.35),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important;
        transform: translateZ(0);
        transform-origin: 50% 100%;
        transition:
          transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
          box-shadow 0.22s ease;
      }

      .doc-grid:not(.is-list) .doc-card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.012);
        box-shadow:
          0 2px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
          0 10px 16px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16),
          0 28px 42px -18px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.42),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) !important;
        z-index: 2;
      }
      /* Folded corner decorative styling */
      .doc-grid:not(.is-list) .doc-card::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 26px;
        height: 26px;
        border-radius: 16px 0 16px 0;
        background: linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) 0%,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1) 55%,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16) 100%
        );
        box-shadow: -1px -1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1);
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 3;
      }
      /* Adhesive tape indicator on pinned cards */
      .doc-grid:not(.is-list) .doc-card.is-pinned .doc-tape {
        display: block;
        position: absolute;
        top: -7px;
        left: 50%;
        width: 62px;
        height: 15px;
        transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-1.6deg);
        background: linear-gradient(
          180deg,
          rgba(253, 230, 138, 0.92),
          rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.72)
        );
        border-radius: 3px;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2);
        z-index: 4;
      }
      .doc-grid:not(.is-list) .doc-card.is-pinned {
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
          0 4px 6px -2px rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.16),
          0 16px 26px -12px rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.42),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important;
      }
      .doc-grid:not(.is-list) .doc-card-head {
        padding-bottom: 6px;
        border-bottom-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06) !important;
      }
      .doc-grid:not(.is-list) .doc-card-body {
        max-height: 158px;
      }

      /* List Mode: Compact Document Rows */
      .doc-grid.is-list {
        gap: 8px;
        padding-top: 4px;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 5px minmax(0, 1fr);
        grid-template-areas:
          "accent head"
          "accent palette"
          "accent body"
          "accent foot";
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3) !important;
        border-radius: 14px !important;
        background: #fff !important;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05) !important;
        transform: none !important;
        transition:
          background 0.15s ease,
          border-color 0.15s ease,
          box-shadow 0.15s ease;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card::before {
        content: "";
        grid-area: accent;
        background: var(--doc-tint, #e2e8f0);
        border-right: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
        box-shadow: inset -1px 0 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
      }
      /* Constrained row width */
      .pinned-header .doc-grid:not(.is-list) {
        justify-content: start;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card::after {
        display: none; /* Reset folded corner decoration */
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card:hover {
        background: #f8fafc !important;
        border-color: var(--primary) !important;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.22) !important;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card-head {
        grid-area: head;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 9px 10px 6px 12px;
        border-bottom: none !important;
        border-radius: 0;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-palette {
        grid-area: palette;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card-body {
        grid-area: body;
        max-height: 96px; /* Compact single-line preview text */
        padding: 0 12px 8px 12px !important;
        font-size: 0.78rem !important;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card.is-expanded .doc-card-body {
        max-height: none;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card-body h1,
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card-body h2,
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card-body h3 {
        font-size: 0.82rem !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card-title {
        -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
        font-size: 0.88rem;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card-foot {
        grid-area: foot;
        padding: 6px 10px 7px 12px;
        border-radius: 0;
        background: transparent !important;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-tape {
        display: none !important;
      }

      /* Per-Card Color Palette Popover */
      .doc-colour {
        position: relative;
      }
      .doc-colour-dot {
        width: 14px;
        height: 14px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--doc-tint, #fff);
        border: 1.5px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.28);
        box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14);
        display: block;
      }
      .doc-palette {
        display: none;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
        gap: 6px;
        padding: 9px 12px;
        margin: 0 10px 8px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
        border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
        border-radius: 12px;
        backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      }
      .doc-card.palette-open .doc-palette {
        display: grid;
        animation: docPaletteIn 0.18s ease;
      }
      @keyframes docPaletteIn {
        from {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(-4px);
        }
        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: none;
        }
      }
      .doc-sw {
        aspect-ratio: 1;
        width: 100%;
        min-width: 20px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--sw);
        border: 1.5px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2);
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 0;
        transition:
          transform 0.14s ease,
          box-shadow 0.14s ease;
      }
      .doc-sw:hover {
        transform: scale(1.18);
      }
      .doc-sw.is-on {
        border-color: var(--text-main);
        box-shadow:
          0 0 0 2px #fff,
          0 0 0 4px var(--text-main);
      }

      /* Unified rounded corner styling */
      .doc-search-inp, .pk-btn, .pk-icon, .doc-expand {
        border-radius: 999px !important;
      }
      .doc-search-inp {
        border-radius: 999px !important;
      }
      .doc-empty,
      .pinned-header {
        border-radius: 18px !important;
      }
      .doc-card-body pre,
      .doc-card-body img,
      .doc-card-body video,
      .doc-card-body iframe {
        border-radius: 12px !important;
      }

      /* Single-Row Editor Toolbar */
      .ql-toolbar.ql-snow {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
        align-items: center;
        overflow-x: auto !important;
        overflow-y: visible !important;
        white-space: nowrap;
        padding: 6px 8px !important;
        gap: 2px;
        min-height: 44px;
        scrollbar-width: none;
        -ms-overflow-style: none;
        scroll-behavior: smooth;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
        overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
        background: #fff !important;
      }
      .ql-toolbar.ql-snow::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
      }
      .ql-toolbar.ql-snow .ql-formats {
        display: inline-flex !important;
        align-items: center;
        flex: 0 0 auto !important;
        margin: 0 6px 0 0 !important;
        padding-right: 6px;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      .ql-toolbar.ql-snow .ql-formats:last-child {
        border-right: none;
        padding-right: 0;
      }
      .ql-toolbar.ql-snow button {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        border-radius: 7px;
      }
      .ql-toolbar.ql-snow button:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .ql-snow .ql-picker {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      /* Toolbar horizontal no-wrap */
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .ql-toolbar.ql-snow {
          flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
          overflow-x: auto !important;
        }
      }

      /* Responsive Toolbar Styling */
      @media (max-width: 430px) {
        .doc-grid:not(.is-list) {
          gap: 16px 12px;
        }
        .doc-palette {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
          gap: 5px;
          padding: 8px 10px;
        }
        .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card-body {
          max-height: 76px;
        }
      }
      @media (hover: none) {
        .doc-grid:not(.is-list) .doc-card:hover {
          transform: translateZ(0);
        }
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        html,
        .doc-card-body,
        .ql-toolbar.ql-snow {
          scroll-behavior: auto !important;
        }
        .doc-grid:not(.is-list) .doc-card,
        .doc-grid:not(.is-list) .doc-card:hover {
          transform: none !important;
        }
      }

      /**
 * Section: 3D Elevation Tokens & Toolbar Stacking
 * Responsibilities: Elevation tokens, 3D list row cards, neomorphic project buttons,
 * and dropdown portal layering.
 */

      /* Elevation Tokens */
      :root {
        --lift-rest:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
          0 4px 6px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1),
          0 14px 22px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.32),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
        --lift-hover:
          0 2px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
          0 10px 16px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16),
          0 28px 42px -18px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
        --lift-amber:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
          0 4px 6px -2px rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.16),
          0 16px 26px -12px rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.4),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
      }

      /* 3D List Row Elevation */
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card {
        border: none !important;
        border-radius: 16px !important;
        background: var(--doc-tint, #fff) !important;
        box-shadow: var(--lift-rest) !important;
        transform: translateZ(0);
        transition:
          transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
          box-shadow 0.2s ease !important;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card:hover {
        background: var(--doc-tint, #fff) !important;
        transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.006);
        box-shadow: var(--lift-hover) !important;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card.is-pinned {
        box-shadow: var(--lift-amber) !important;
      }
      /* Rounded accent rail */
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card::before {
        border-right: none;
        box-shadow: inset -1px 0 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--doc-ink, #64748b) 26%, transparent);
      }
      /* Folded corner accent */
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card::after {
        display: block !important;
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        border-radius: 16px 0 16px 0;
        background: linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72) 0%,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.09) 55%,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15) 100%
        );
        box-shadow: -1px -1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.09);
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 3;
      }
      .doc-grid.is-list .doc-card-body {
        color: var(--doc-ink, var(--text-main));
        opacity: 0.86;
      }

      /* All Projects 3D List Styling */
      .pl-grid,
      .pl-grid.pk-list-mode {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important;
        gap: 10px !important;
      }
      .pl-card {
        border: none !important;
        border-radius: 16px !important;
        background: linear-gradient(150deg, #ffffff 0%, #f6f8fc 100%) !important;
        box-shadow: var(--lift-rest) !important;
        padding: 13px 84px 13px 16px !important;
        min-height: 0 !important;
        transform: translateZ(0);
        transition:
          transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
          box-shadow 0.2s ease !important;
      }
      .pl-card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.006);
        box-shadow: var(--lift-hover) !important;
        border: none !important;
      }
      .pl-card::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        border-radius: 16px 0 16px 0;
        background: linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) 0%,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08) 55%,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14) 100%
        );
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .pl-card.is-pinned {
        background: linear-gradient(150deg, #fffdf5 0%, #fff7e6 100%) !important;
        box-shadow: var(--lift-amber) !important;
      }
      .pl-card.is-pinned .pl-card-title::before {
        content: "";
        display: inline-block;
        width: 6px;
        height: 6px;
        border-radius: 50%;

      /**
 * Section: Calendar Viewport Fit & Pin Overflow
 * Responsibilities: Equal-row 6x7 calendar layout, scrollable pin cells,
 * multi-line pin text wrapping, and overflow count badges.
 */

      /* Viewport-Fitted Calendar Grid */
      main {
        min-height: 0; /* Grid flex-shrink layout */
      }
      .cal-grid {
        grid-template-rows: auto repeat(var(--cal-rows, 6), minmax(0, 1fr));
        grid-auto-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) !important;
        height: 100% !important;
        min-height: 0;
        overflow: hidden !important; /* Fixed calendar viewport */
        align-content: stretch !important;
      }
      .day {
        min-height: 0;
        min-width: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        gap: 2px !important;
        padding: 3px !important;
        border-radius: 6px;
        transition:
          background 0.15s ease,
          box-shadow 0.15s ease;
      }
      .day.is-blank {
        background: var(--bg-body);
        cursor: default;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .day-top {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        gap: 4px;
      }
      .date-num {
        margin-left: 0 !important;
        width: 19px;
        height: 19px;
        font-size: 0.66rem;
      }

      /* Scrollable Day Cell Pin List */
      .day-pins {
        flex: 1 1 auto;
        min-height: 0;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 2px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overflow-x: hidden;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
        scrollbar-width: none;
        scroll-behavior: smooth;
      }
      .day-pins::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 0;
        display: none;
      }
      .pin-chip {
        /* Two-line text wrapping for pins */
        white-space: normal !important;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: unset;
        display: -webkit-box;
        -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
        -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        word-break: break-word;
        line-height: 1.25;
        font-size: 0.58rem;
        padding: 2px 4px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        cursor: grab;
        user-select: none;
        -webkit-user-drag: element;
        transition:
          transform 0.14s ease,
          box-shadow 0.14s ease,
          opacity 0.14s ease;
      }
      .pin-chip:active {
        cursor: grabbing;
      }
      .pin-chip:hover {
        transform: translateX(1px);
        box-shadow: 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.28);
      }
      .pin-chip.is-dragging {
        opacity: 0.45;
        transform: scale(0.96) rotate(-1.5deg);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45);
      }
      /* Drag-and-drop drop target highlight */
      .day.drop-target {
        background: var(--primary-soft) !important;
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--primary);
      }

      /* Overflow badge for excessive day pins */
      .day.has-overflow {
        position: relative;
      }
      .day.has-overflow .day-pins {
        -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(
          180deg,
          #000 0%,
          #000 78%,
          transparent 100%
        );
        mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0%, #000 78%, transparent 100%);
      }
      .day.has-overflow .day-pins:hover,
      .day.has-overflow .day-pins:focus-within {
        -webkit-mask-image: none;
        mask-image: none;
      }
      .day.has-overflow::after {
        content: var(--more, "+");
        position: absolute;
        right: 3px;
        bottom: 2px;
        font-size: 0.5rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        line-height: 1;
        padding: 2px 5px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: var(--primary);
        color: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.3);

        box-shadow:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04),
          0 2px 4px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
        cursor: pointer;
        white-space: nowrap;
        transition:
          transform 0.14s ease,
          box-shadow 0.14s ease,
          background 0.14s ease,
          color 0.14s ease;
      }
      .mf-chip svg {
        width: 11px;
        height: 11px;
      }
      .mf-chip:hover {
        transform: translateY(-1.5px);
        box-shadow:
          0 2px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05),
          0 7px 12px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.3),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
      }
      .mf-chip:active {
        transform: translateY(0);
        box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2);
      }
      .mf-chip.is-on {
        color: #fff;
        border-color: transparent;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4f46e5 0%, #4338ca 100%);
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
          0 4px 10px -3px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.6),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32);
      }
      .mf-chip.is-on svg {
        color: #fff;
      }
      .mf-chip.mf-pin.is-on {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fbbf24 0%, #f59e0b 100%);
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
          0 4px 10px -3px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
      }

      /* Color Swatch Filter Buttons */
      .mf-sw {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--sw);
        border: 1.5px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18);
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 0;
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
        transition:
          transform 0.14s ease,
          box-shadow 0.14s ease;
      }
      .mf-sw:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.1);
      }
      .mf-sw.is-on {
        border-color: var(--text-main);
        box-shadow:
          0 0 0 2px #fff,
          0 0 0 4px var(--primary),
          0 3px 8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.25);
      }
      .mf-date {
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        padding: 6px 9px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.36);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f3f5f9 100%);
        box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
        color: var(--text-main);
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .mf-date:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .mf-dash {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }

      /* Smooth Document Scrolling */
      .mp-content {
        scroll-padding-top: 70px;
        padding-bottom: 0 !important;
      }
      #masterResults {
        padding-top: 4px;
      }
      /* Sticky Section Group Headers */
      .mp-section .group-label {
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 12;
        background: linear-gradient(
          180deg,
          var(--bg-body) 0%,
          var(--bg-body) 70%,
          rgba(241, 245, 249, 0) 100%
        );
        backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
        padding-top: 8px !important;
      }
      .mp-section.pinned-header .group-label {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fffdf3 0%, rgba(255, 253, 243, 0) 100%);
      }
      /* Custom Scrollbar for Panel */
      .mp-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 8px;
      }
      .mp-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: #cbd5e1;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 2px solid var(--bg-body);
      }
      .mp-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
        background: #94a3b8;
      }

      /* Responsive Grid Layouts */
      @media (max-width: 720px) {
        .mp-head {
          flex-wrap: wrap;
          padding: 7px 12px !important;
          gap: 8px;
        }
        .mp-seg {
          order: 3;
          width: 100%;
          flex: 1 0 100%;
        }
        .mp-seg-btn {
          flex: 1;
          justify-content: center;
          padding: 6px 8px;
        }
        .mf-widget {
          padding: 0 12px;
          top: 52px;
        }
        .mf-row {
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 5px;
        }
        .mf-label {
          flex: none;
          padding-top: 0;
        }
        .mf-widget-inner {
          max-height: 62vh;
          overflow-y: auto;
          overscroll-behavior: contain;
        }
      }
      @media (max-width: 380px) {
        .mp-title {
          display: none; /* Compact Logo Display */
        }
      }
      @media (min-width: 900px) {
        .mf-widget {
          padding: 0 24px;
        }
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .mp-seg-glide,
        .mf-widget,
        .mf-chip {
          transition: none !important;
        }
      }

      /**
 * Section: Pagination Controls, Standalone Code Blocks & Focus Rings
 * Responsibilities: Master Planner "Show more" batch pager, standalone code block typography,
 * and accessible focus-visible rings.
 */

      /* Batch Pagination Pager Button */
      .mp-more {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 320px;
        margin: 18px auto 8px;
        padding: 11px 18px;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--primary);
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f3f5f9 100%);
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.36);
        border-radius: 999px;
        cursor: pointer;
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04),
          0 3px 8px -3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.24),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
        transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
      }
      .mp-more:hover {
        transform: translateY(-1.5px);
        box-shadow:
          0 2px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
          0 9px 16px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.32),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
      }
      .mp-more:active {
        transform: none;
        box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2);
      }

      /* Standalone Monospace Code Block Styling */
      .ql-editor pre.ql-syntax,
      .ql-editor pre {
        background: #0f172a !important;
        color: #e2e8f0 !important;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 12px 14px !important;
        overflow-x: auto;
        font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        line-height: 1.55;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }
      .doc-card-body pre.ql-syntax,
      .doc-card-body pre {
        background: #0f172a !important;
        color: #e2e8f0 !important;
      }
      .ql-editor code,
      .doc-card-body code {
        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.18);
        padding: 1px 5px;
        border-radius: 5px;
        font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
      }
      .ql-editor pre code,
      .doc-card-body pre code {
        background: none;
        padding: 0;
      }

      /* Accessible Focus Visible Indicators */
      .mf-chip:focus-visible,
      .mf-trigger:focus-visible,
      .mp-seg-btn:focus-visible,
      .pk-btn:focus-visible,
      .pk-icon:focus-visible,
      .doc-expand:focus-visible,
      .mp-more:focus-visible,
      .doc-sw:focus-visible,
      .mf-sw:focus-visible,
      .pin-chip:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--primary);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }

      /**
 * Section: Rich Document Engine & Toolbar Architecture
 * Responsibilities: Core rich document editing surface, single-row ribbon toolbar container,
 * action buttons, dropdowns, and table selectors.
 */

      /* Toolbar Shell: Single scrollable horizontal row */
      .rt-bar {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        flex-wrap: nowrap;
        gap: 4px;
        padding: 6px 8px;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f7f9fc 100%);
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        overflow-x: auto;
        overflow-y: visible;
        scrollbar-width: none;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
        overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 1200;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        min-height: 44px;
      }
      .rt-bar::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
      }
      /* Unclipped Popover Containers */
      .rt-bar:has(.rt-pop-wrap.open) {
        overflow: visible;
        z-index: 2000;
      }
      .rt-grp {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 2px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        padding-right: 6px;
        margin-right: 2px;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      .rt-grp:last-child {
        border-right: none;
      }

      /* Toolbar Action Buttons */
      .rt-b {
        display: inline-grid;
        place-items: center;
        min-width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
        padding: 0 6px;
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: transparent;
        color: var(--text-main);
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1;
        cursor: pointer;
        white-space: nowrap;
        transition:
          background 0.14s ease,
          color 0.14s ease,
          box-shadow 0.14s ease;
      }
      .rt-b svg {
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
      }
      .rt-b:hover {
        background: #eef2f7;
      }
      .rt-b:active {
        box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16);
      }
      .rt-b.on {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        color: var(--primary);
        border-color: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.28);
      }
      .rt-b.dim {
        opacity: 0.38;
      }
      .rt-b sup,
      .rt-b sub {
        font-size: 0.6em;
      }

      /* Toolbar Dropdown Menus */
      .rt-sel {
        height: 30px;
        max-width: 130px;
        padding: 0 22px 0 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: #fff
          url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='10' height='10' viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path d='M6 9l6 6 6-6' fill='none' stroke='%2364748b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/></svg>")
          no-repeat right 7px center;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.74rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
        -webkit-appearance: none;
        appearance: none;
      }
      .rt-sel:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .rt-block {
        min-width: 108px;
      }
      .rt-font {
        min-width: 96px;
      }
      .rt-size {
        min-width: 62px;
      }
      .rt-lh {
        min-width: 68px;
      }

      /* Color Swatches and Palette Picker */
      .rt-pop-wrap {
        position: relative;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .rt-colbtn {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 1px;
        min-width: 32px;
        padding: 3px 5px 2px;
      }
      .rt-colgl {
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 900;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .rt-hlgl {
        background: linear-gradient(transparent 58%, #fde68a 58%);
        padding: 0 1px;
      }
      .rt-colbar {
        display: block;
        width: 18px;
        height: 4px;
        border-radius: 2px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2);
      }
      .rt-pop {
        display: none;
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(100% + 6px);
        left: 0;
        z-index: 2200;
        padding: 10px;
        background: #fff;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 14px;
        box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45);
      }
      .rt-pop-wrap.open .rt-pop {
        display: block;
        animation: rtPop 0.14s ease;
      }
      @keyframes rtPop {
        from {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(-5px);
        }
        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: none;
        }
      }
      .rt-pop-h {
        font-size: 0.6rem;
        font-weight: 900;
        letter-spacing: 0.09em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        margin-bottom: 8px;
      }
      .rt-swgrid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
        gap: 4px;
      }
      .rt-sw {
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        border-radius: 5px;
        background: var(--c);
        border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18);
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 0;
        transition: transform 0.12s ease;
      }
      .rt-sw:hover {
        transform: scale(1.18);
        box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.28);
      }
      .rt-pop-f {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        margin-top: 10px;
        padding-top: 9px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      .rt-custom {
        width: 34px;
        height: 26px;
        padding: 0;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: none;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .rt-clear {
        flex: 1;
        height: 26px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #fff;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .rt-clear:hover {
        background: #fee2e2;
        border-color: #fecaca;
        color: var(--danger);
      }

      /* Table Dimension Grid Selector */
      .rt-pop-tbl {
        left: auto;
        right: 0;
      }
      .rt-tgrid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 22px);
        gap: 3px;
        padding: 4px;
        touch-action: none !important;
        user-select: none !important;
        -webkit-user-select: none !important;
      }
      .rt-tcell {
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        padding: 0;
        border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
        border-radius: 4px;
        background: #ffffff;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: background 0.1s ease, border-color 0.1s ease;
      }
      .rt-tcell.on {
        background: var(--primary, #4f46e5);
        border-color: var(--primary, #4f46e5);
      }
      .rt-tcell.on {
        background: var(--primary);
        border-color: var(--primary);
      }
      .rt-tlabel {
        margin-top: 8px;
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }

      /* Document Tables Formatting */
      .doc-table-block {
        margin: 12px 0;
      }
      .doc-table-wrap {
        overflow-x: auto;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      }
      .doc-table {
        border-collapse: collapse;
        width: 100%;
        min-width: 260px;
        font-size: 0.9em;
        background: #fff;
        border-radius: 10px;
        overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
      }
      .doc-table th,
      .doc-table td {
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        padding: 7px 10px;
        text-align: left;
        vertical-align: top;
        min-width: 56px;
        line-height: 1.5;
      }
      .doc-table th {
        background: #f1f5f9;
        font-weight: 800;
      }
      .doc-table tr:nth-child(even) td {
        background: #fbfcfe;
      }
      .doc-table td:focus,
      .doc-table th:focus {
        outline: 2px solid var(--primary);
        outline-offset: -2px;
        background: var(--primary-soft);
      }
      /* Multi-line table cell wrapping */
      .doc-card-body .doc-table th,
      .doc-card-body .doc-table td {
        white-space: normal;
      }

      /* Document Typography & Preview Styles */
      .ql-editor {
        font-size: 16px;
      }
      .ql-editor h1 {
        font-size: 2em;
        font-weight: 800;
        line-height: 1.25;
        margin: 0.6em 0 0.35em;
      }
      .ql-editor h2 {
        font-size: 1.6em;
        font-weight: 800;
        line-height: 1.3;
        margin: 0.6em 0 0.3em;
      }
      .ql-editor h3 {
        font-size: 1.3em;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin: 0.55em 0 0.3em;
      }
      .ql-editor h4 {
        font-size: 1.12em;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin: 0.5em 0 0.28em;
      }
      .ql-editor h5 {
        font-size: 1em;
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      .ql-editor h6 {
        font-size: 0.9em;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .ql-editor hr,
      .doc-card-body hr {
        border: none;
        border-top: 2px solid var(--border);
        margin: 1.1em 0;
      }
      .ql-editor blockquote,
      .doc-card-body blockquote {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--primary);
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
        padding: 8px 12px !important;
        margin: 0.7em 0 !important;
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .ql-editor sub,
      .doc-card-body sub {
        vertical-align: sub;
        font-size: 0.72em;
      }
      .ql-editor sup,
      .doc-card-body sup {
        vertical-align: super;
        font-size: 0.72em;
      }
      /* Interactive Task Checklist */
      .ql-editor ul[data-checked] > li::before {
        content: "☐";
        margin-right: 6px;
      }
      .ql-editor ul[data-checked="true"] > li::before {
        content: "☑";
        color: var(--success);
      }
      .ql-editor ul[data-checked="true"] > li {
        color: var(--text-sub);
        text-decoration: line-through;
      }
      .ql-editor a,
      .doc-card-body a {
        color: var(--primary);
        text-decoration: underline;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }
      .ql-editor .ql-video {
        width: 100%;
        aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 12px;
      }
      /* Scaled card preview typography */
      .doc-card-body [style*="font-size"] {
        max-font-size: 1.1rem;
      }

      /* Editor Chrome and Containers */
      .editor-container,
      .proj-editor-wrapper {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        min-height: 0;
      }
      .ql-container.ql-snow {
        border: none !important;
      }

      /* Responsive Editor Breakpoints */
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .rt-bar {
          gap: 3px;
          padding: 5px 6px;
        }
        .rt-sel {
          font-size: 0.7rem;
          height: 28px;
        }
        .rt-block {
          min-width: 92px;
        }
        .rt-font {
          min-width: 84px;
        }
        .rt-b {
          min-width: 28px;
          height: 28px;
        }
        .rt-pop {
          position: fixed;
          left: 8px;
          right: 8px;
          top: auto;
          bottom: 12px;
          max-height: 56vh;
          overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .rt-swgrid {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
        }
        .rt-sw {
          width: 100%;
          aspect-ratio: 1;
          height: auto;
        }
        .rt-pop-tbl .rt-tgrid {
          justify-content: center;
        }
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .rt-b,
        .rt-sw,
        .rt-pop {
          transition: none !important;
          animation: none !important;
        }
      }

      /**
 * Section: Document Studio Styles & Writing Modes
 * Responsibilities: In-app modal dialogs, custom listboxes, color pickers, date panels,
 * tooltip bubbles, writing modes (Focus, Typewriter, Reading), stats bar, and find & replace.
 */

      /* In-App Accessible Modal Dialog Shell */
      .ui-modal {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 12000;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        padding: 20px;
        background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.42);
        backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity 0.18s ease;
      }
      .ui-modal.in {
        opacity: 1;
      }
      .ui-modal-card {
        width: min(420px, 100%);
        background: #fff;
        border-radius: 20px;
        padding: 20px;
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1),
          0 30px 60px -20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55);
        transform: translateY(10px) scale(0.98);
        transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.2, 0.4, 1);
      }
      .ui-modal.in .ui-modal-card {
        transform: none;
      }
      .ui-modal-slim {
        width: min(340px, 100%);
        padding: 14px;
      }
      .ui-modal-h {
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-main);
        line-height: 1.35;
      }
      .ui-modal-m {
        margin-top: 7px;
        font-size: 0.84rem;
        line-height: 1.55;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .ui-modal-f {
        margin-top: 14px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 10px;
      }
      .ui-field span {
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        margin-bottom: 4px;
      }
      .ui-input {
        width: 100%;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        padding: 11px 13px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: var(--bg-body);
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .ui-input:focus {
        outline: none;
        background: #fff;
        border-color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .ui-modal-a {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 9px;
        margin-top: 18px;
      }
      .ui-btn {
        flex: 1;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 7px;
        padding: 11px 16px;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.84rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: transform 0.14s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease;
        min-width: 0;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .ui-btn svg.ui-ico {
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        stroke: currentColor;
        fill: none;
        stroke-width: 2;
        stroke-linecap: round;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      .ui-modal-leave .ui-modal-a {
        flex-wrap: nowrap;
      }
      .ui-modal-leave .ui-btn {
        flex: 1 1 0;
        padding: 10px 10px;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
      }
      @media (max-width: 520px) {
        .ui-modal {
          padding: 10px;
          align-items: end;
          place-items: end center;
        }
        .ui-modal-leave .ui-modal-card {
          width: 100%;
          border-radius: 18px 18px 14px 14px;
          padding: 16px 14px calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
        }
        .ui-modal-leave .ui-modal-a {
          flex-direction: column-reverse;
          flex-wrap: nowrap;
          gap: 8px;
        }
        .ui-modal-leave .ui-btn {
          flex: none;
          width: 100%;
          padding: 13px 14px;
          font-size: 0.9rem;
          border-radius: 14px;
        }
      }
      .ui-btn:active {
        transform: scale(0.97);
      }
      .ui-primary {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4f46e5, #4338ca);
        color: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 5px 14px -5px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.75);
      }
      .ui-danger {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f87171, #dc2626);
        color: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 5px 14px -5px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.7);
      }
      .ui-ghost {
        background: #f1f5f9;
        color: var(--text-main);
        border-color: var(--border);
      }

      /* Custom Listbox Component */
      .ui-sel {
        position: relative;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 5px;
        height: 30px;
        padding: 0 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #f6f8fb);
        font-size: 0.74rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
        user-select: none;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .ui-sel:hover {
        border-color: #cbd5e1;
      }
      .ui-sel.open {
        border-color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .ui-sel-v {
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .ui-sel-c {
        width: 11px;
        height: 11px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        transition: transform 0.18s ease;
      }
      .ui-sel.open .ui-sel-c {
        transform: rotate(180deg);
      }
      .ui-sel-list {
        display: none;
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(100% + 5px);
        left: 0;
        min-width: 100%;
        max-height: 240px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        padding: 5px;
        background: #fff;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 12px;
        box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45);
        z-index: 2400;
      }
      .ui-sel-list.up {
        top: auto;
        bottom: calc(100% + 5px);
      }
      .ui-sel.open .ui-sel-list {
        display: block;
      }
      .ui-opt {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 7px 10px;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .ui-opt:hover {
        background: var(--bg-body);
      }
      .ui-opt.on {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        color: var(--primary);
        font-weight: 800;
      }

      /* Color Palette & Custom Color Picker */
      .ui-cp {
        margin-top: 10px;
        padding-top: 10px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        width: 196px;
      }
      .ui-cp-sv {
        position: relative;
        height: 110px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        cursor: crosshair;
        border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
      }
      .ui-cp-dot {
        position: absolute;
        width: 13px;
        height: 13px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        border: 2px solid #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .ui-cp-hue {
        position: relative;
        height: 13px;
        margin-top: 9px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        cursor: pointer;
        background: linear-gradient(
          to right,
          #f00 0%, #ff0 17%, #0f0 33%, #0ff 50%, #00f 67%, #f0f 83%, #f00 100%
        );
      }
      .ui-cp-hdot {
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        width: 15px;
        height: 15px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #fff;
        border: 2px solid #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .ui-cp-foot {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        margin-top: 10px;
      }
      .ui-cp-prev {
        width: 26px;
        height: 26px;
        border-radius: 7px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18);
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .ui-cp-hex {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        height: 26px;
        padding: 0 7px;
        font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 7px;
        background: var(--bg-body);
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .ui-cp-ok {
        height: 26px;
        padding: 0 11px;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: var(--primary);
        color: #fff;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .rt-more {
        flex: 1;
        height: 26px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #fff;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .rt-more:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        border-color: var(--primary);
        color: var(--primary);
      }

      /* Inline Date Picker Panel */
      .ui-dp {
        width: 100%;
        user-select: none;
      }
      .ui-dp-h {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
      }
      .ui-dp-t {
        font-size: 0.84rem;
        font-weight: 800;
      }
      .ui-dp-nav {
        width: 28px;
        height: 28px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: #fff;
        font-size: 1rem;
        line-height: 1;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .ui-dp-nav:hover {
        background: var(--bg-body);
      }
      .ui-dp-w,
      .ui-dp-g {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
        gap: 3px;
      }
      .ui-dp-w span {
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 0.56rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        padding: 3px 0;
      }
      .ui-dp-d {
        aspect-ratio: 1;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 9px;
        background: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .ui-dp-d:hover {
        background: var(--bg-body);
      }
      .ui-dp-d.today {
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--primary);
        color: var(--primary);
