      }
      .ui-dp-d.on {
        background: var(--primary);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .ui-dp-f {
        display: flex;
        gap: 7px;
        margin-top: 10px;
        padding-top: 9px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      .ui-dp-q {
        flex: 1;
        padding: 7px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #fff;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .ui-dp-q:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        border-color: var(--primary);
        color: var(--primary);
      }

      /* Accessible Custom Tooltip Bubble */
      .ui-tip {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 13000;
        padding: 5px 9px;
        border-radius: 7px;
        background: #0f172a;
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        white-space: nowrap;
        pointer-events: none;
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(3px);
        transition: opacity 0.14s ease, transform 0.14s ease;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
      }
      .ui-tip.on {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: none;
      }

      /* Editor Shell & Specialized Writing Modes */
      .rt-shell {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        background: var(--bg-body);
      }
      .rt-surface {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
      }
      .rt-surface > div {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
      }

      /* Standard Writing Mode */
      .rt-shell.mode-standard .rt-surface {
        background: #fff;
      }

      /* Page Simulation Mode (A4 Sheet on Desk) */
      /* The sheet grows with content (height:auto) and the surface scrolls,
         so writing always continues BELOW - no more clipped fixed-height page
         with an inner scrollbar. */
      .rt-shell.mode-page .rt-surface {
        background: #e9edf3;
        padding: 22px 14px 40px;
        display: block;
        position: relative;
        /* Both axes scroll: the paper keeps its real size and the page size
           decides the flow - portrait pages scroll vertically, landscape /
           wide pages scroll horizontally too, large pages scroll both ways. */
        overflow-x: auto;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
        touch-action: pan-x pan-y;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-page .ql-container {
        /* True paper size (never squeezed to fit the screen). Centered when
           narrower than the viewport, panable when wider. */
        width: calc(var(--pg-w, 794px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1));
        max-width: calc(var(--pg-w, 794px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1));
        height: auto !important;
        margin: 0 auto;
        background: #fff;
        border-radius: 4px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12),
          0 20px 45px -20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45);
        overflow: visible !important;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-page .ql-editor {
        height: auto !important;
        overflow: visible !important;
        padding: calc(var(--pg-m, 72px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1)) !important;
        min-height: calc(var(--pg-h, 1123px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1));
        position: relative;
      }

      /* Focus Mode (Active Paragraph Highlight) */
      .rt-shell.mode-focus .rt-surface {
        background: #fff;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-focus .ql-editor > * {
        opacity: 0.28;
        transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-focus .ql-editor > .rt-live {
        opacity: 1;
      }

      /* Reading Mode */
      /* Reading Mode Floating Quick Dock */
      .rt-shell.mode-reading .rt-bar,
      .rt-shell.mode-reading .rt-find {
        display: none !important;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-reading .rt-surface {
        background: #fbf8f1;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-reading .ql-editor {
        max-width: 680px;
        margin: 0 auto;
        font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
        font-size: 1.08rem;
        line-height: 1.9 !important;
        padding: 34px 26px !important;
        color: #2b2b2b;
      }

      /* Typewriter Mode (Vertical Caret Centering) */
      .rt-shell.mode-typewriter .ql-editor {
        padding-top: 38vh !important;
        padding-bottom: 42vh !important;
      }

      /* Dark Theme Writing Surface */
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-surface,
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .ql-container {
        background: #0f172a;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .ql-editor {
        color: #e2e8f0;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .ql-editor.ql-blank::before {
        color: #64748b;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .ql-editor h1,
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .ql-editor h2,
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .ql-editor h3,
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .ql-editor h4 {
        color: #f8fafc;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .doc-table th {
        background: #1e293b;
        color: #e2e8f0;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .doc-table td {
        background: #0f172a;
        color: #e2e8f0;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .doc-table th,
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .doc-table td {
        border-color: #334155;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-stats {
        background: #0b1220;
        color: #64748b;
        border-top-color: #1e293b;
      }

      /* Live Document Statistics Status Bar */
      .rt-stats {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 6px 16px;
        padding: 6px 14px;
        background: #fbfcfe;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        font-size: 0.63rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .rt-stats b {
        color: var(--text-main);
        font-weight: 800;
      }
      .rt-stats span {
        display: inline-flex;
        gap: 4px;
        align-items: baseline;
      }
      .rt-stats span + span::before {
        content: "";
        width: 3px;
        height: 3px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: currentColor;
        opacity: 0.45;
        margin-right: 10px;
        align-self: center;
      }

      /* Find and Replace Drawer Strip */
      .rt-find {
        display: none;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        padding: 7px 10px;
        background: #fff;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        overflow-x: auto;
        scrollbar-width: none;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .rt-find::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
      }
      .rt-find.on {
        display: flex;
      }
      .rt-find-q,
      .rt-find-r {
        flex: 1 1 130px;
        min-width: 96px;
        height: 30px;
        padding: 0 11px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: var(--bg-body);
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .rt-find-q:focus,
      .rt-find-r:focus {
        outline: none;
        background: #fff;
        border-color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .rt-find-n {
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        flex-shrink: 0;
        min-width: 34px;
        text-align: center;
      }
      .rt-fb {
        height: 30px;
        min-width: 30px;
        padding: 0 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #fff;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .rt-fb:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        border-color: var(--primary);
        color: var(--primary);
      }
      .rt-fb.wide {
        padding: 0 12px;
      }

      /* Responsive Editor Breakpoints */
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        /* Single-row status bar constraint */
        .rt-bar {
          flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
        }
        .rt-grp {
          flex: 0 0 auto !important;
          align-items: center;
        }
        .ui-sel {
          flex: 0 0 auto !important;
        }
        .rt-shell.mode-page .rt-surface {
          padding: 10px 6px 24px;
        }
        .rt-shell.mode-page .ql-editor {
          min-height: calc(var(--pg-h, 1123px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1));
        }
        .rt-shell.mode-reading .ql-editor {
          padding: 20px 16px !important;
          font-size: 1rem;
        }
        .rt-stats {
          gap: 10px;
          font-size: 0.58rem;
        }
        .ui-sel-list {
          max-height: 210px;
        }
        .rt-find {
          flex-wrap: nowrap;
        }
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .ui-modal,
        .ui-modal-card,
        .ui-tip,
        .rt-shell.mode-focus .ql-editor > * {
          transition: none !important;
        }
      }

      /**
 * Section: Power Editor Dropdowns & Overlays
 * Responsibilities: Dropdown portal positioning, slash command menu, export format chooser,
 * live outline pane, and revision history viewer.
 */

      /* Dropdown Portal Positioning */
.rt-portal {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 20000 !important;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .rt-portal .ui-sel-list,
      .rt-portal .rt-pop,
      .rt-portal .fd-col-pop {
        position: fixed !important;
        z-index: 20100 !important;
        pointer-events: auto !important;
      }
      .rt-slash {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 20200 !important;
      }
      .rt-ctxmenu {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 20300 !important;
      }
      .rt-imgbar,
      .rt-linkbar {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 20400 !important;
      }
      .ui-modal {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 21000 !important;
      }
      .ui-modal .fd-card,
      .ui-modal-card {
        z-index: 21100 !important;
      }
      .rt-toast {
        z-index: 30000 !important;
      }
      .rt-portal > * {
        pointer-events: auto;
      }
      .rt-ported {
        position: fixed !important;
        display: block !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
        z-index: 11001 !important;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        animation: rtPop 0.14s ease;
      }
      /* Fixed Portal Coordinates */
      .rt-portal .ui-sel-list,
      .rt-portal .rt-pop {
        top: auto;
        left: auto;
        bottom: auto;
        right: auto;
        max-height: none; /* Dynamic Portal Height Calculation */
        min-width: 0; /* Portal Listbox Width Constraint */
        width: max-content;
        max-width: min(320px, calc(100vw - 16px));
      }
      /* Bottom-sheet popovers on phones (positioned inline by docPortal) */
      .rt-portal .rt-pop.rt-pop-sheet {
        width: auto;
        max-width: calc(100vw - 16px);
        border-radius: 20px;
        padding: 14px 14px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
        box-shadow: 0 -6px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.28), 0 20px 50px -20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);
        animation: rtPopSheet 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.2, 0.4, 1);
      }
      @keyframes rtPopSheet {
        from {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(18px);
        }
        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: none;
        }
      }
      /* Grab handle affordance */
      .rt-pop-sheet::before {
        content: "";
        display: block;
        width: 42px;
        height: 4px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #cbd5e1;
        margin: 2px auto 10px;
      }
      /* Larger, thumb-sized options inside sheets */
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .rt-pop-sheet .rt-exp {
          padding: 13px 14px;
          font-size: 0.86rem;
          border-radius: 11px;
        }
        .rt-pop-sheet .rt-pop-h {
          font-size: 0.64rem;
          margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .rt-pop-sheet .rt-sw {
          border-radius: 7px;
        }
      }

      /* Toolbar Height and Flex Stretch */
      .rt-bar {
        overflow-x: auto !important;
        overflow-y: hidden !important;
        flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
        align-items: stretch !important;
        height: 44px;
        min-height: 44px;
      }
      .rt-bar .rt-grp {
        align-items: center !important;
        align-self: center !important;
        height: 100%;
      }
      .rt-bar .rt-b,
      .rt-bar .ui-sel,
      .rt-bar .rt-pop-wrap {
        align-self: center !important;
      }

      /* Slash Command Floating Menu */
      .rt-slash {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 12500;
        display: none;
        width: 232px;
        max-height: 258px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        padding: 6px;
        background: #fff;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 14px;
        box-shadow: 0 20px 44px -16px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);
      }
      .rt-slash.on {
        display: block;
        animation: rtPop 0.13s ease;
      }
      .rt-slash-i {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 10px;
        width: 100%;
        padding: 8px 10px;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 9px;
        background: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.79rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
        text-align: left;
      }
      .rt-slash-i:hover,
      .rt-slash-i.on {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        color: var(--primary);
      }
      .rt-slash-i kbd {
        font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        background: var(--bg-body);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 5px;
        padding: 1px 5px;
      }

      /* Document Export Popover Menu */
      /* Image Quick-Size Bar & Formatting Overlays */
      .rt-b:disabled {
        opacity: 0.32 !important;
        cursor: default !important;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .rt-imgbar {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 12000;
        display: flex;
        gap: 4px;
        padding: 5px;
        background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92);
        border-radius: 999px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.35);
        backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      }
      .rt-imgbar button {
        border: none;
        background: transparent;
        color: #e2e8f0;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        padding: 5px 10px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        cursor: pointer;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .rt-imgbar button:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .rt-linkbar {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 12001;
        display: flex;
        gap: 4px;
        padding: 5px;
        background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92);
        border-radius: 999px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.35);
        backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      }
      .rt-linkbar button {
        border: none;
        background: transparent;
        color: #e2e8f0;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        padding: 5px 10px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        cursor: pointer;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .rt-linkbar button:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .rt-pbgrid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 6px;
        padding: 4px 2px 2px;
      }
      .rt-pbgrid .rt-exp {
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .rt-pbgrid .rt-exp:first-child {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
      }
      .rt-pop-exp {
        min-width: 168px;
      }
      .rt-exp {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 8px 11px;
        margin-top: 3px;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 9px;
        background: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .rt-exp:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        color: var(--primary);
      }
      .rt-pop .rt-exp.on {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--primary);
      }

      /* Context Menu: Custom right-click & long-press action menu */
      .rt-ctxmenu {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 3200;
        min-width: 190px;
        max-width: 260px;
        padding: 6px;
        background: #fff;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 12px;
        box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45);
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(-4px) scale(0.98);
        transition: opacity 0.1s ease, transform 0.1s ease;
      }
      .rt-ctxmenu.in {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: none;
      }
      .rt-ctxitem {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 9px 12px;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
        min-height: 34px;
      }
      .rt-ctxitem:hover:not(:disabled),
      .rt-ctxitem:focus-visible:not(:disabled) {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        color: var(--primary);
        outline: none;
      }
      .rt-ctxitem:disabled {
        color: var(--text-sub);
        opacity: 0.45;
        cursor: default;
      }
      .rt-ctxsep {
        height: 1px;
        margin: 5px 4px;
        background: var(--border);
      }
      @media (pointer: coarse) {
        .rt-ctxitem {
          min-height: 40px;
          padding: 10px 12px;
        }
      }

      /* Live Document Headings Outline Panel */
      .rt-outline {
        margin-top: 12px;
        max-height: 46vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 2px;
      }
      .rt-o {
        text-align: left;
        padding: 7px 10px;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .rt-o:hover {
        background: var(--bg-body);
      }
      .rt-o.l1 { font-weight: 800; }
      .rt-o.l2 { padding-left: 22px; font-weight: 700; }
      .rt-o.l3 { padding-left: 36px; font-size: 0.76rem; }
      .rt-o.l4 { padding-left: 50px; font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--text-sub); }
      .rt-o.l5,
      .rt-o.l6 { padding-left: 62px; font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-sub); }

      /* Version History Snapshot Drawer */
      .rt-vlist {
        margin-top: 12px;
        max-height: 44vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 4px;
      }
      .rt-v {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 9px 12px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: #fff;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .rt-v:hover {
        border-color: var(--primary);
        background: var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .rt-v span {
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }

      /* Dark Mode Document Chrome */
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-bar {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #111c30, #0d1626);
        border-bottom-color: #1e293b;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-b {
        color: #cbd5e1;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-b:hover {
        background: #1e293b;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .ui-sel {
        background: #16233c;
        border-color: #26364f;
        color: #e2e8f0;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-grp {
        border-right-color: #1e293b;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-find {
        background: #0d1626;
        border-bottom-color: #1e293b;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-find-q,
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-find-r {
        background: #16233c;
        border-color: #26364f;
        color: #e2e8f0;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-fb {
        background: #16233c;
        border-color: #26364f;
        color: #e2e8f0;
      }

      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .rt-slash {
          width: calc(100vw - 24px);
          left: 12px !important;
        }
        .rt-ported {
          max-width: calc(100vw - 16px);
        }
      }

      /**
 * Section: Document Studio 3D Shell & Advanced Layouts
 * Responsibilities: Raised 3D toolbar slab, flat writing canvas, floating quick dock,
 * writing mode cards, symbol picker, multi-column flow, and line numbers.
 */

      /* Raised 3D Toolbar Slab */
      .rt-bar {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #eef2f8 100%) !important;
        border-bottom: none !important;
        border-radius: 0 0 16px 16px;
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05),
          0 4px 8px -3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14),
          0 14px 26px -14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) !important;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1200;
      }
      .rt-grp {
        border-right-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3) !important;
      }
      /* Tactile Button Press Treatment */
      .rt-b {
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        transition:
          transform 0.13s ease,
          box-shadow 0.13s ease,
          background 0.13s ease,
          color 0.13s ease;
      }
      .rt-b:hover {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff, #eaeef6);
        border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
        transform: translateY(-1.5px);
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05),
          0 5px 10px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.3),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
      }
      .rt-b:active {
        transform: translateY(0);
        box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.22);
      }
      .rt-b.on {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4f46e5, #4338ca) !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        border-color: transparent !important;
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08),
          0 4px 10px -3px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.6),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) !important;
      }
      .rt-b.on svg use {
        color: #fff;
      }
      .ui-sel {
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04),
          0 2px 5px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
        transition: transform 0.13s ease, box-shadow 0.13s ease;
      }
      .ui-sel:hover {
        transform: translateY(-1.5px);
        box-shadow:
          0 2px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05),
          0 6px 12px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.3),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
      }

      /* Flat Writing Surface with Optimal Line Length (45-75 chars) */
      .rt-surface {
        background: #fff;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-standard .ql-container,
      .rt-shell.mode-focus .ql-container,
      .rt-shell.mode-typewriter .ql-container {
        margin: 0 auto;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: none;
        background: transparent;
        border-radius: 0;
        box-shadow: none;
      }
      /* Comfortable Reading Measure */
      .rt-shell.mode-standard .ql-editor,
      .rt-shell.mode-focus .ql-editor,
      .rt-shell.mode-typewriter .ql-editor {
        max-width: var(--doc-measure, 74ch);
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: 26px 24px 40px !important;
      }
      /* Typewriter caret centering must win over the surface reset above
         (same specificity, so this must come later in the stylesheet). */
      .rt-shell.mode-typewriter .ql-editor {
        padding-top: 38vh !important;
        padding-bottom: 42vh !important;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-wide .ql-editor {
        max-width: none;
      }

      /* Page Mode Paper Elevation Shadow */
      .rt-shell.mode-page .ql-container {
        border-radius: 3px;
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16),
          0 12px 28px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.3);
      }

      /* Writing Surface Zoom Scaling */
      .rt-shell .ql-editor {
        font-size: calc(16px * var(--doc-zoom, 1));
      }

      

      /* Floating Quick Dock */
      .rt-dock {
        position: absolute;
        right: 16px;
        bottom: 54px;
        z-index: 60;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 3px;
        padding: 5px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(180%);
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28);
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08),
          0 8px 18px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.34),
          0 20px 40px -22px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
        opacity: 0.55;
        transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
      }
      .rt-dock:hover,
      .rt-dock:focus-within {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(-2px);
      }
      /* Prominent Reading Mode Controls */
      .rt-shell.mode-reading .rt-dock,
      .rt-shell.mode-typewriter .rt-dock {
        opacity: 1;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-standard .rt-dock [data-dock="exit"] {
        display: none;
      }
      .rt-dock-b {
        display: inline-grid;
        place-items: center;
        min-width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
        padding: 0 8px;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: transparent;
        color: var(--text-main);
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.74rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        cursor: pointer;
        line-height: 1;
        grid-auto-flow: column;
        gap: 1px;
      }
      .rt-dock-b span {
        font-size: 0.62rem;
      }
      .rt-dock-b svg {
        width: 15px;
        height: 15px;
      }
      .rt-dock-b:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        color: var(--primary);
      }
      .rt-dock-b:active {
        box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2);
      }
      .rt-dock-z {
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        min-width: 38px;
        text-align: center;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-dock {
        background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92);
        border-color: #26364f;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-dock-b,
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-dock-z {
        color: #cbd5e1;
      }

      /* Writing Mode Selector Cards */
      .rt-modegrid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));
        gap: 9px;
        margin-top: 14px;
        max-height: 52vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }
      .rt-modecard {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 3px;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 12px 13px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: linear-gradient(160deg, #ffffff, #f5f7fb);
        cursor: pointer;
        font-family: inherit;
        box-shadow:
          0 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04),
          0 4px 10px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.26),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
        transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
      }
      .rt-modecard:hover {
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow:
          0 2px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06),
          0 12px 22px -10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.38),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
      }
      .rt-modecard.on {
        border-color: var(--primary);
        background: linear-gradient(160deg, #eef2ff, #e0e7ff);
      }
      .rt-modecard b {
        font-size: 0.84rem;
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .rt-modecard span {
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        line-height: 1.4;
      }

      /* Special Characters & Symbol Picker Dialog */
      .rt-symtabs {
        display: flex;
        gap: 5px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        margin-top: 12px;
      }
      .rt-symtab {
        padding: 5px 11px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #fff;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .rt-symtab.on {
        background: var(--primary);
        border-color: transparent;
        color: #fff;
      }
      .rt-symgrid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(42px, 1fr));
        gap: 5px;
        margin-top: 11px;
        max-height: 40vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }
      .rt-sym {
        aspect-ratio: 1;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 9px;
        background: #fff;
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: var(--text-main);
        transition: transform 0.12s ease;
      }
      .rt-sym:hover {
        transform: scale(1.12);
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        border-color: var(--primary);
      }

      /* Page Setup & Margin Configuration */
      .rt-pset {
        margin-top: 14px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 11px;
      }
      .rt-pset .mf-label {
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .rt-hint {
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        color: #b45309;
        align-self: center;
      }

      /* Page Geometry Dimensions (scaled together with zoom, Word-style) */
      .rt-shell.mode-page .ql-container {
        max-width: calc(var(--pg-w, 794px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1));
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-page .ql-editor {
        padding:
          calc(var(--pg-mt, 96px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1))
          calc((var(--pg-col-mr, var(--pg-mr, 96px)) + var(--pg-inset-r, 0px)) * var(--doc-zoom, 1))
          calc(var(--pg-mb, 96px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1))
          calc((var(--pg-col-ml, var(--pg-ml, 96px)) + var(--pg-inset-l, 0px)) * var(--doc-zoom, 1)) !important;
        min-height: calc(var(--pg-h, 1123px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1));
        /* Subtle separators at each page boundary on the continuous sheet */
        background-image: linear-gradient(
          to bottom,
          transparent calc(var(--pg-h, 1123px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1) - 2px),
          rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35) calc(var(--pg-h, 1123px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1) - 2px),
          rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35) calc(var(--pg-h, 1123px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1)),
          transparent calc(var(--pg-h, 1123px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1))
        );
        background-repeat: repeat-y;
        background-size: 100% calc(var(--pg-h, 1123px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1));
      }
      /* Multi-Column Document Flow */
      /* Standard vertical paragraph block flow.
         IMPORTANT: never force `column-count` on .ql-editor itself. Quill
         pins the editor to a fixed height (height:100%); once content
         overflows that height, Chromium's multicol fragmenter balloons each
         block box to ~2x the column width, spilling text sideways off the
         page (measured up to 2516px for a 1280px column). Columns are only
         applied in Page mode when the user picks a multi-column layout. */
      .ql-editor {
        display: block !important;
        white-space: pre-wrap !important;
        word-wrap: break-word !important;
        overflow-wrap: break-word !important;
      }
      .ql-editor p,
      .ql-editor h1,
      .ql-editor h2,
      .ql-editor h3,
      .ql-editor h4,
      .ql-editor h5,
      .ql-editor h6,
      .ql-editor ul,
      .ql-editor ol,
      .ql-editor blockquote,
      .ql-editor pre,
      .ql-editor .doc-table-block,
      .ql-editor .doc-callout {
        display: block !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        clear: both;
      }
      /* Multi-column layout explicitly in page mode */
      .rt-shell.mode-page.cols-multi .ql-editor {
        column-count: var(--pg-cols, 1) !important;
        column-gap: var(--pg-col-gap, 34px);
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-page.cols-multi.col-w .ql-editor {
        column-width: calc(var(--pg-col-w, 0px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1));
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-page.cols-multi.cols-line .ql-editor {
        column-rule: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
      }
      .rt-shell .ql-editor h1,
      .rt-shell .ql-editor h2,
      .rt-shell .ql-editor .doc-table-block {
        column-span: all;
      }

      /* Document Line Numbers Gutter */
      .rt-shell .ql-container {
        position: relative;
      }
      .rt-lineno {
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        width: 40px;
        height: 100%;
        pointer-events: none;
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #64748b;
        font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .rt-lineno span {
        position: absolute;
        right: 8px;
        line-height: 1.4;
      }
      .rt-shell.show-lineno .ql-editor {
        padding-left: 46px !important;
        border-left: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28);
      }
      .rt-shell.show-lineno.mode-page .ql-editor {
        padding-left: calc(var(--pg-ml, 96px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1) + 22px) !important;
      }

      /* Word Count Goal Progress Meter */
      .rt-goal {
        position: relative;
        display: inline-flex !important;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 5px;
        padding: 2px 9px 2px 8px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: var(--bg-body);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .rt-goal i {
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        transition: width 0.3s ease;
      }
      .rt-goal.done i {
        background: #dcfce7;
      }
      .rt-goal b,
      .rt-goal {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
      }
      .rt-selinfo {
        color: var(--primary) !important;
      }
      .rt-stats {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fbfcfe, #f1f4f9);
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28);
      }

      /* Responsive Grid Layouts */
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .rt-bar {
          border-radius: 0;
        }
        .rt-shell.mode-standard .ql-container,
        .rt-shell.mode-focus .ql-container {
          margin: 8px auto;
          width: calc(100% - 12px);
          border-radius: 12px;
        }
        .rt-dock {
          right: 10px;
          bottom: 48px;
          padding: 4px;
        }
        .rt-dock-b {
          min-width: 28px;
          height: 28px;
        }
        /* NOTE: no column-count fallback here - forcing columns on the
           fixed-height .ql-editor balloons block widths on overflow. */
        .rt-modegrid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        }
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .rt-b,
        .ui-sel,
        .rt-dock,
        .rt-modecard {
          transition: none !important;
        }
      }

      /**
 * Section: Ribbon Toolbar Interface & Tab Clusters
 * Responsibilities: Ribbon tab strip, tool group panels, labelled action buttons,
 * dark theme ribbon styling, and keyboard shortcut cheat sheet.
 */

      .rt-ribbon {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f7f9fc 100%);
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.34);
        box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1200;
      }

      /* Ribbon Tab Strip Navigation */
      .rt-tabs {
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 2px;
        padding: 0 8px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.24);
        overflow-x: auto;
        scrollbar-width: none;
      }
      .rt-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
      }
      .rt-tab {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 2;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        border: none;
        background: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        padding: 9px 14px;
        cursor: pointer;
        border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
        transition: color 0.18s ease;
      }
      .rt-tab:hover {
        color: var(--text-main);
        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12);
      }
      .rt-tab.on {
        color: var(--primary);
        font-weight: 800;
      }
      .rt-tabs-glide {
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 0;
        left: 0;
        height: 2.5px;
        border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
        background: var(--primary);
        transition:
          transform 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.1, 0.4, 1),
          width 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.1, 0.4, 1);
      }
      .rt-tabs-end {
        margin-left: auto;
        display: flex;
        gap: 2px;
        padding-left: 8px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .rt-quick {
        height: 28px !important;
        min-width: 28px !important;
      }

      /* Ribbon Tool Panels & Groups */
      .rt-bar {
        display: none !important;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 4px;
        padding: 7px 10px !important;
        background: transparent !important;
        border: none !important;
        border-radius: 0 !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        overflow-x: auto;
        overflow-y: visible;
        scrollbar-width: none;
        min-height: 46px;
        height: auto;
        flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
      }
      .rt-bar.on {
        display: flex !important;
      }
      .rt-bar::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
      }
      .rt-grp {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 3px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        padding-right: 8px;
        margin-right: 3px;
        border-right: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
        height: 32px;
      }
      .rt-grp:last-child {
        border-right: none;
      }

      /* Labelled Action Buttons */
      .rt-b.wide {
        grid-auto-flow: column;
        gap: 6px;
        padding: 0 11px;
        min-width: auto;
      }
      .rt-b.wide em {
        font-style: normal;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      .rt-b .sm {
        font-size: 0.62rem;
      }
      .rt-zoomlbl {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        min-width: 40px;
        text-align: center;
      }

      /* Flat Writing Surface Reset */
      .rt-shell.mode-standard .ql-container,
      .rt-shell.mode-focus .ql-container,
      .rt-shell.mode-typewriter .ql-container,
      .rt-shell.mode-reading .ql-container {
        background: transparent !important;
        border-radius: 0 !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        margin: 0 auto !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: none !important;
      }
      .rt-surface {
        background: #fff;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-surface {
        background: #0f172a;
      }

      /* Keyboard Shortcuts Cheat Sheet Modal */
      .rt-keys {
        margin-top: 14px;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 6px 14px;
        max-height: 54vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }
      .rt-key {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 9px;
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .rt-key kbd {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        min-width: 104px;
        font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        padding: 3px 7px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: var(--bg-body);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-bottom-width: 2px;
        color: var(--text-main);
        text-align: center;
      }
      .rt-key span {
        color: var(--text-sub);
        font-size: 0.72rem;
      }

      /* Streamlined Floating Dock */
      .rt-dock [data-dock="zoom-in"],
      .rt-dock [data-dock="zoom-out"],
      .rt-dock .rt-dock-z {
        display: none;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-reading .rt-dock [data-dock="zoom-in"],
      .rt-shell.mode-reading .rt-dock [data-dock="zoom-out"],
      .rt-shell.mode-reading .rt-dock .rt-dock-z,
      .rt-shell.mode-typewriter .rt-dock [data-dock="zoom-in"],
      .rt-shell.mode-typewriter .rt-dock [data-dock="zoom-out"],
      .rt-shell.mode-typewriter .rt-dock .rt-dock-z {
        display: inline-grid;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-reading .rt-dock .rt-dock-z,
      .rt-shell.mode-typewriter .rt-dock .rt-dock-z {
        display: inline-block;
      }

      /* Dark Theme Ribbon Toolbar */
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-ribbon {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #111c30, #0d1626);
        border-bottom-color: #1e293b;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-tabs {
        border-bottom-color: #1e293b;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-tab {
        color: #64748b;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-tab.on {
        color: #a5b4fc;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-tabs-glide {
        background: #a5b4fc;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-grp {
        border-right-color: #1e293b;
      }

      /* Responsive Grid Layouts */
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .rt-tab {
          padding: 9px 11px;
          font-size: 0.72rem;
        }
        /* Mobile Ribbon Scrolling */
        .rt-bar {
          padding: 6px 8px !important;
          flex-wrap: wrap !important;
          row-gap: 4px;
          overflow-x: visible;
        }
        .rt-grp {
          height: 30px;
        }
        .rt-b {
          min-width: 30px;
          height: 30px;
        }
        .ui-sel {
          height: 30px;
        }
        /* Icon-only compact mode */
        .rt-b.wide em {
          display: none;
        }
        .rt-b.wide {
          padding: 0 8px;
        }
        .rt-shell.mode-standard .ql-editor,
        .rt-shell.mode-focus .ql-editor,
        .rt-shell.mode-typewriter .ql-editor {
          padding: 18px 16px 34px !important;
        }
        .rt-keys {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .rt-tabs-glide {
          transition: none !important;
        }
      }

      /**
 * Section: Advanced Typography & Formatting Styles
 * Responsibilities: Underline galleries, bullet libraries, text effect previews,
 * paragraph borders, drop caps, callout boxes, page breaks, watermarks, and format painter.
 */

      /* Single-Line Ribbon Bar Constraint */
      .rt-bar {
        flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
        overflow-x: auto !important;
        overflow-y: visible !important;
        row-gap: 0 !important;
        height: 44px;
        min-height: 44px;
        align-items: center !important;
        scroll-snap-type: x proximity;
      }
      .rt-grp {
        height: 32px;
        flex: 0 0 auto !important;
        scroll-snap-align: start;
      }
      /* Edge Overflow Indicator */
      .rt-ribbon {
        position: relative;
      }
      .rt-ribbon::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 26px;
        height: 44px;
        pointer-events: none;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #f7f9fc 72%);
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-ribbon::after {
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #0d1626 72%);
      }

      /* Split Action Buttons */
      .rt-split {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .rt-split-main {
        border-radius: 8px 0 0 8px !important;
        margin-right: -1px;
      }
      .rt-split-arrow {
        min-width: 16px !important;
        width: 16px;
        padding: 0 !important;
        font-size: 0.56rem !important;
        border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0 !important;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .rt-split:hover .rt-split-arrow {
        background: #e2e8f0;
      }

      /* Underline Style Gallery Popover */
      .rt-uline {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 7px 11px;
        margin-top: 2px;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .rt-uline:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        color: var(--primary);
      }

      /* Custom Bullet & Numbering Library */
      .rt-bulgrid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
        gap: 5px;
      }
      .rt-bul {
        aspect-ratio: 1;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: #fff;
        font-size: 1rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .rt-bul:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        border-color: var(--primary);
      }
      .rt-spgrid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
        gap: 4px;
        margin-top: 5px;
      }
      .rt-sp {
        padding: 5px 0;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 7px;
        background: #fff;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .rt-sp:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        border-color: var(--primary);
        color: var(--primary);
      }

      /* Text Effects (Shadow, Glow, Reflection, Outline) */
      .ql-editor .fx-shadow,
      .doc-card-body .fx-shadow {
        text-shadow: 2px 2px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45);
      }
      .ql-editor .fx-outline,
      .doc-card-body .fx-outline {
        -webkit-text-stroke: 1px currentColor;
        color: transparent;
      }
      .ql-editor .fx-glow,
      .doc-card-body .fx-glow {
        text-shadow: 0 0 8px currentColor, 0 0 16px currentColor;
      }
      .ql-editor .fx-emboss,
      .doc-card-body .fx-emboss {
        text-shadow: -1px -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85), 1px 1px 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
      }
      .ql-editor .fx-gradient,
      .doc-card-body .fx-gradient {
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6366f1, #ec4899, #f59e0b);
        -webkit-background-clip: text;
        background-clip: text;
        color: transparent;
      }
      /* Text Effect Preview Swatches */
      .rt-exp.fx-shadow { text-shadow: 2px 2px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.4); }
      .rt-exp.fx-outline { -webkit-text-stroke: 1px currentColor; }
      .rt-exp.fx-glow { text-shadow: 0 0 7px var(--primary); }

      /* Paragraph Border Styles */
      .ql-editor .pb-all,
      .doc-card-body .pb-all {
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 8px 11px;
      }
      .ql-editor .pb-left,
      .doc-card-body .pb-left {
        border-left: 3px solid var(--primary);
        padding-left: 11px;
      }
      .ql-editor .pb-top { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 7px; }
      .ql-editor .pb-bottom { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom: 7px; }

      /* Drop Cap Typography */
      .ql-editor .doc-dropcap::first-letter,
      .doc-card-body .doc-dropcap::first-letter {
        float: left;
        font-size: 3.4em;
        line-height: 0.84;
        font-weight: 800;
        padding: 4px 8px 0 0;
        color: var(--primary);
      }

      /* Callout Box Embed */
      .doc-callout {
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 12px 14px;
        margin: 12px 0;
        border-left: 4px solid var(--primary);
        background: var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .doc-callout.tip { border-left-color: #16a34a; background: #f0fdf4; }
      .doc-callout.warn { border-left-color: #f59e0b; background: #fffbeb; }
      .doc-callout.quotebox {
        border-left-color: #64748b;
        background: #f8fafc;
        font-style: italic;
      }
      .doc-callout.plain {
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-left-width: 1px;
        background: #fff;
      }
      .doc-callout p:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
      .doc-callout p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

      /* Page Break Visual Marker */
      .doc-pagebreak {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
        margin: 18px 0;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        font-size: 0.6rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        user-select: none;
      }
      .doc-pagebreak::before,
      .doc-pagebreak::after {
        content: "";
        flex: 1;
        border-top: 2px dashed var(--border);
      }
      @media print {
        .doc-pagebreak { page-break-after: always; border: none; }
        .doc-pagebreak span { display: none; }
      }

      /* Formatting Marks (Pilcrow & Whitespace) */
      .rt-shell.show-marks .ql-editor p::after,
      .rt-shell.show-marks .ql-editor h1::after,
      .rt-shell.show-marks .ql-editor h2::after,
      .rt-shell.show-marks .ql-editor h3::after,
      .rt-shell.show-marks .ql-editor li::after {
        content: "¶";
        color: #93c5fd;
        margin-left: 3px;
        font-weight: 400;
      }
      .rt-shell.show-marks .ql-editor {
        --mark: 1;
      }

      /* Custom Bullet Character Styling */
      .ql-editor ul[style*="--bullet"] > li::before {
        content: var(--bullet, "•") !important;
      }

      /* Document Top Ruler Component */
      .rt-ruler {
        position: relative;
        display: block;
        height: 26px;
        background: #fff;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        overflow-x: auto;
        overflow-y: hidden;
        scrollbar-width: none;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .rt-ruler::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
      }
      .rt-ruler-inner {
        position: relative;
        height: 100%;
        min-width: 100%;
      }
      /* Align the ruler with the paper in Page mode: same width as the paper
         (real size), centered the same way, synced horizontally while
         panning. JS keeps the exact left offset (sync in toggleRuler). */
      .rt-shell.mode-page .rt-ruler {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: calc(var(--pg-w, 794px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1));
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: 0;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-page .rt-ruler-inner {
        width: calc(var(--pg-w, 794px) * var(--doc-zoom, 1));
        min-width: 100%;
      }
      /* Real inch-scale ticks: 96px = 1 inch (built by buildRulerTicks) */
      .rt-tick {
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 0;
        border-left: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .rt-tick-mid {
        height: 8px;
        border-left-color: #94a3b8;
      }
      .rt-tick-minor {
        height: 5px;
      }
      .rt-tick-tiny {
        height: 3px;
        border-left-color: #e2e8f0;
      }
      .rt-tick-major {
        height: 13px;
        border-left: 1.5px solid #64748b;
      }
      .rt-tick-num {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        font-size: 9px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #64748b;
        padding-left: 3px;
        line-height: 13px;
        pointer-events: none;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      /* Shaded margin zones on the rulers (width = real margin) */
      .rt-rm {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.18);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .rt-rm-l {
        border-right: 1px solid rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.55);
      }
      .rt-rm-r {
        border-left: 1px solid rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.55);
      }
      /* Vertical (height) ruler pinned to the left edge of the paper */
      .rt-ruler-v {
        position: absolute;
        width: 24px;
        background: #fff;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
        box-shadow: 1px 0 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
        z-index: 6;
        pointer-events: none;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .rt-ruler-v .rt-tick {
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        border-left: none;
        border-top: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      }
      .rt-ruler-v .rt-tick-major {
        width: 13px;
        height: 0;
        border-top: 1.5px solid #64748b;
      }
      .rt-ruler-v .rt-tick-mid {
        width: 8px;
        height: 0;
        border-top-color: #94a3b8;
      }
      .rt-ruler-v .rt-tick-minor {
        width: 5px;
        height: 0;
      }
      .rt-ruler-v .rt-tick-num {
        position: absolute;
        left: 15px;
        top: 0;
        padding: 0;
        line-height: 1;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        font-size: 8px;
      }
      .rt-ruler-v .rt-rm {
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        top: auto;
        bottom: auto;
      }
      .rt-ruler-v .rt-rm-l {
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.55);
      }
      .rt-ruler-v .rt-rm-r {
        border-left: none;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.55);
      }
      /* Extra left space for the vertical (height) ruler - applied only
         while the ruler is visible so the paper stays perfectly centred
         otherwise. */
      .rt-shell.mode-page.show-ruler .rt-surface {
        padding-left: 44px;
      }
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .rt-shell.mode-page.show-ruler .rt-surface {
          padding-left: 34px;
        }
      }

      /* Page info strip (real paper dimensions) */
      .rt-pageinfo {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        padding: 4px 10px;
        background: #f8fafc;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25);
        font-size: 0.62rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        text-align: center;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow-x: auto;
        scrollbar-width: none;
      }
      .rt-pageinfo::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
      }
      .rt-pageinfo b {
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .rt-pset-info {
        margin-top: 10px;
        padding: 8px 10px;
        background: #f1f5f9;
        border-radius: 10px;
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        line-height: 1.5;
      }
      /* Custom margins / size / columns dialog controls */
      .rt-cmgrid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 8px 12px;
        margin-top: 12px;
      }
      .rt-cmgrid label {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .rt-cmgrid .ui-input {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        height: 38px;
        padding: 0 10px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 10px;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-align: center;
      }
      .rt-cmgrid .ui-input:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .rt-cmgrid span {
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-faint);
      }
      .rt-cmpresets {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 6px;
        margin-top: 12px;
      }
      .rt-cmnote {
        margin: 10px 0 0;
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        line-height: 1.45;
      }
      .rt-cminline {
        margin-top: 8px;
        padding: 10px;
        border: 1px dashed var(--border);
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: #f8fafc;
      }
      .rt-cminline .rt-cmgrid {
        margin-top: 6px;
      }
      /* Layout designer dialog panels */
      .rt-lpanel {
        margin-top: 10px;
      }
      .rt-lpanel[hidden] {
        display: none;
      }
      .rt-lbb {
        border: 1px dashed var(--border);
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 8px;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
        background: #fafbfe;
      }
      .rt-lbb-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        gap: 6px;
      }
      .rt-lbb-grid label {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 4px;
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .rt-lbb-grid .ui-input {
        height: 34px;
        padding: 0 6px;
        font-size: 0.8rem;
      }
      .rt-lbb-row {
        display: flex;
        gap: 6px;
        margin-top: 6px;
      }
      .rt-lbb-row .ui-input {
        flex: 1;
        height: 34px;
        padding: 0 8px;
        font-size: 0.76rem;
      }
      .rt-lbb-row .ui-btn {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        height: 34px;
      }
      /* On-paper layout boxes (text boxes / bands / grid cells) */
      .layout-box {
        position: absolute;
        border: 1.5px dashed #94a3b8;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
        border-radius: 3px;
        z-index: 5;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        overflow: hidden;
        cursor: text;
        outline: none;
        font-family: var(--font-stack);
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      .layout-box:focus {
        border-style: solid;
        border-color: var(--primary);
        background: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .layout-box[data-shape="rounded"] {
        border-radius: 14px;
      }
      .layout-box[data-shape="ellipse"],
      .layout-box[data-shape="circle"] {
        border-radius: 50%;
      }
      .layout-box::before {
        content: attr(data-tag);
        position: absolute;
        top: 2px;
        left: 5px;
        font-size: 8px;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #94a3b8;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 2;
      }
      .layout-box:focus::before {
        color: var(--primary);
      }
      .layout-box p {
        margin: 0 0 6px;
      }
      /* Drag bar on top of every box - grab to move */
      .lb-bar {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        height: 18px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 4px;
        padding: 0 6px;
        background: rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.85);
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.45);
        cursor: grab;
        touch-action: none;
        user-select: none;
        -webkit-user-select: none;
        -webkit-touch-callout: none;
        font-size: 8px;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #64748b;
        z-index: 3;
      }
      .lb-bar:hover {
        background: #cbd5e1;
      }
      .lb-bar:active {
        cursor: grabbing;
      }
      .lb-grip {
        font-size: 10px;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .lb-locked .lb-bar {
        cursor: not-allowed;
        background: rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.5);
      }
      .lb-locked {
        border-style: dotted !important;
      }
      /* In-line (in-flow) boxes: block embed inside the document text */
      .docbox {
        position: relative;
        display: block;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        margin: 10px 0 12px;
        max-width: 100%;
        border: 1.5px dashed #94a3b8;
        background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.85);
        border-radius: 3px;
        z-index: 2;
      }
      .docbox[data-shape="rounded"] {
        border-radius: 14px;
      }
      .docbox[data-shape="ellipse"],
      .docbox[data-shape="circle"] {
        border-radius: 50%;
      }
      .docbox .lb-bar {
        position: static;
        height: 18px;
        border-radius: 0;
      }
      .docbox-inner {
        padding: 10px;
        min-height: 40px;
        outline: none;
        overflow: hidden;
        color: var(--text-main);
        font-family: var(--font-stack);
      }
      .docbox-inner p {
        margin: 0 0 6px;
      }
      /* On-box action buttons - fully custom, no native button look */
      .lb-acts {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 3px;
        margin-left: auto;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .lb-act {
        appearance: none;
        -webkit-appearance: none;
        -moz-appearance: none;
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.45);
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--text-main);
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 800;
        line-height: 1;
        min-width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        padding: 0 4px;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: inline-grid;
        place-items: center;
        box-shadow: none;
        font-family: inherit;
      }
      .lb-act:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        border-color: var(--primary);
        color: var(--primary);
      }
      .lb-act-del:hover {
        background: #fee2e2;
        border-color: var(--danger);
        color: var(--danger);
      }
      /* Rows & grid cells live in the document flow (no overlay) */
      .lb-flow {
        position: static !important;
        float: left;
        margin: 6px 0;
        z-index: auto;
        clear: none;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-page .ql-container::after {
        content: "";
        display: block;
        clear: both;
      }
      /* Locked in-line box */
      .docbox-locked .docbox-inner {
        opacity: 0.75;
        background: repeating-linear-gradient(
          45deg,
          rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.08) 0 8px,
          transparent 8px 16px
        );
      }
      /* Body-drag of overlay boxes locks text selection while moving */
      .ov-dragging,
      .ov-dragging * {
        user-select: none !important;
        -webkit-user-select: none !important;
      }
      /* Overlay boxes capture touch gestures (drag/resize) - the paper
         scrolls instead of the box on touch devices */
      .layout-box {
        touch-action: none;
      }
      /* Selected overlay box (click-to-select) */
      .layout-box.ov-selected {
        border-color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 2.5px var(--primary-soft), 0 0 0 1px var(--primary);
      }
      /* Snap alignment guides while dragging */
      .snap-guide {
        position: absolute;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 60;
        display: none;
        background: var(--primary);
      }
      .snap-guide.gv {
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 1px;
        opacity: 0.75;
      }
      .snap-guide.gh {
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        height: 1px;
        opacity: 0.75;
      }
      /* Live mini-page preview */
      .pg-preview {
        margin: 6px auto 10px;
        width: min(190px, 100%);
      }
      .pg-preview.sm {
        width: min(150px, 100%);
      }
      .pp-paper {
        position: relative;
        background: #fff;
        border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
        border-radius: 3px;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18), 0 4px 10px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.25);
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .pp-content {
        position: absolute;
        background: rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.55);
      }
      .pp-col {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        background: #fff;
        border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
        border-radius: 2px;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }
      .pp-row {
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
        border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
        border-radius: 2px;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }
      .pp-box {
        position: absolute;
        border: 1.5px solid var(--primary);
        border-radius: 2px;
        background: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.14);
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }
      /* Subtle column boundary guides (no line-between chosen) */
      .rt-shell.mode-page.cols-multi:not(.cols-line) .ql-editor {
        column-rule: 1px dashed rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25);
      }
      @media (pointer: coarse) {
        .lb-act {
          min-width: 30px;
          height: 30px;
          font-size: 12px;
        }
      }
      /* Handles on hover OR focus (discoverable on touch and mouse) */
      .docbox .lb-handle {
        display: none;
      }
      .docbox:hover .lb-handle,
      .docbox.docbox-active .lb-handle {
        display: block;
      }
      /* Focused in-line box: solid ring, no native focus outline */
      .docbox.docbox-active {
        border-style: solid;
        border-color: var(--primary);
        background: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .docbox.docbox-active .lb-bar {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        color: var(--primary);
      }
      .docbox-resizing {
        border-color: var(--primary) !important;
      }
      .docbox .lb-bar {
        cursor: grab;
      }
      .docbox .lb-bar:active {
        cursor: grabbing;
      }
      /* Drag-to-reorder: ghost, insertion marker, selection lock */
      .ib-ghost {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 30000;
        pointer-events: none;
        opacity: 0.9;
        border: 1.5px solid var(--primary);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);
        transform: rotate(1.2deg);
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .ib-ghost .lb-handle,
      .ib-ghost .lb-convert {
        display: none !important;
      }
      .ib-marker {
        position: fixed;
        height: 3px;
        border-radius: 3px;
        background: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--primary-soft);
        z-index: 30001;
        pointer-events: none;
        display: none;
      }
      .ib-marker.on {
        display: block;
      }
      .ib-dragging,
      .ib-dragging * {
        user-select: none !important;
        -webkit-user-select: none !important;
      }
      .ib-origin {
        opacity: 0.45;
      }
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         Browser-default design sweep: no native controls anywhere
         ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
      select.ui-input {
        appearance: none;
        -webkit-appearance: none;
        -moz-appearance: none;
        background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='10' height='6' viewBox='0 0 10 6'%3E%3Cpath d='M1 1l4 4 4-4' fill='none' stroke='%2364748b' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
        background-position: right 9px center;
        padding-right: 26px;
        text-align: left;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      input[type="number"] {
        -moz-appearance: textfield;
        appearance: textfield;
      }
      input[type="number"]::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
      input[type="number"]::-webkit-inner-spin-button {
        -webkit-appearance: none;
        margin: 0;
      }
      .ui-input:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .ui-input::placeholder {
        color: #94a3b8;
        opacity: 1;
      }
      ::selection {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        color: var(--text-main);
      }
      button:focus-visible,
      select:focus-visible,
      .ui-btn:focus-visible,
      .mf-chip:focus-visible,
      .rt-exp:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--primary);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }
      .ui-modal-card::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 10px;
      }
      .ui-modal-card::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: #cbd5e1;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 3px solid transparent;
        background-clip: content-box;
      }
      .ui-modal-card::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: transparent;
      }
      /* Designer card: always inside the viewport, scrolls internally */
      .ui-modal .ui-modal-card {
        max-height: min(92vh, 880px);
        overflow-y: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      }
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .rt-lbb-grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        }
        .rt-lbb-row {
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .rt-lbb-row .ui-input {
          min-width: 90px;
        }
        .ui-modal-card {
          max-height: min(88vh, 880px);
        }
      }
      @media (max-height: 560px) and (orientation: landscape) {
        .ui-modal-card {
          max-height: 92vh;
          border-radius: 12px;
          padding: 12px;
        }
        .rt-cmgrid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        }
      }
      /* Resize handles */
      .lb-handle {
        position: absolute;
        width: 14px;
        height: 14px;
        z-index: 4;
        touch-action: none;
      }
      /* Larger, thumb-friendly handles on touch devices */
      @media (pointer: coarse) {
        .lb-handle {
          width: 26px;
          height: 26px;
        }
        .lb-handle::after {
          inset: 6px;
          border-width: 2px;
          border-radius: 5px;
        }
        .docbox .lb-bar {
          height: 24px;
          font-size: 9px;
        }
        .layout-box .lb-bar {
          height: 24px;
          font-size: 9px;
        }
      }
      .lb-handle::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: 3px;
        background: #fff;
        border: 1.5px solid var(--primary);
        border-radius: 3px;
      }
      .lb-h-nw { left: -5px; top: -5px; cursor: nwse-resize; }
      .lb-h-n { left: 50%; top: -5px; margin-left: -7px; cursor: ns-resize; }
      .lb-h-ne { right: -5px; top: -5px; cursor: nesw-resize; }
      .lb-h-e { right: -5px; top: 50%; margin-top: -7px; cursor: ew-resize; }
      .lb-h-se { right: -5px; bottom: -5px; cursor: nwse-resize; }
      .lb-h-s { left: 50%; bottom: -5px; margin-left: -7px; cursor: ns-resize; }
      .lb-h-sw { left: -5px; bottom: -5px; cursor: nesw-resize; }
      .lb-h-w { left: -5px; top: 50%; margin-top: -7px; cursor: ew-resize; }
      /* Layers panel inside the designer */
      .rt-layers {
        margin-top: 12px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        padding-top: 10px;
      }
      .rt-layers-h {
        font-size: 0.6rem;
        font-weight: 900;
        letter-spacing: 0.09em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        margin-bottom: 6px;
      }
      .rt-layer {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 4px;
        padding: 4px 6px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
        border-radius: 9px;
        margin-bottom: 5px;
        background: #fafbfe;
      }
      .rt-layer-name {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-main);
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .rt-lb {
        width: 28px;
        height: 28px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
        border-radius: 7px;
        background: #fff;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .rt-lb:active {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .rt-lb-danger {
        color: var(--danger);
      }
      /* Multi-page: page-edge chips */
      .rt-pageedges {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 8;
      }
      .rt-pageedge {
        position: absolute;
        right: 6px;
        background: #eef2f7;
        border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
        color: #64748b;
        font-size: 9px;
        font-weight: 800;
        line-height: 1;
        padding: 2px 7px;
        border-radius: 999px;
      }
      /* Dock page navigator label */
      .rt-dock-p {
        font-size: 0.64rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        min-width: 34px;
        text-align: center;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      /* Designer dialog scrolls on short screens */
      .ui-modal .ui-modal-card {
        max-height: calc(100vh - 24px);
        overflow-y: auto;
      }

      /* Watermark & Page Background Color */
      .rt-shell .rt-surface {
        background: var(--page-bg, #fff) !important;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-surface {
        background: #0f172a !important;
      }
      .rt-shell.dark-page .ql-editor {
        color: #e2e8f0;
      }
      .rt-shell.has-watermark .ql-container::before {
        content: var(--watermark, "");
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        font-size: 5rem;
        font-weight: 900;
        color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
        transform: rotate(-28deg);
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 0;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      }

      /* Format Painter Active Cursor */
      .ql-editor.rt-painting,
      .ql-editor.rt-painting * {
        cursor: crosshair !important;
      }

      /* Responsive Tool Sizing */
      @media (max-width: 900px) {
        .rt-b.wide em {
          display: none;
        }
        .rt-b.wide {
          padding: 0 8px;
        }
      }
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .rt-bar {
          flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
          padding: 5px 8px !important;
        }
        .rt-grp {
          padding-right: 6px;
          margin-right: 2px;
        }
        .rt-b {
          padding: 0 5px;
        }
        .ui-sel {
          font-size: 0.7rem;
        }
        .rt-styles { width: 104px !important; }
        .rt-block { width: 96px !important; }
        .rt-font { width: 86px !important; }
        .rt-size { width: 60px !important; }
        .rt-lh { width: 64px !important; }
        .rt-tab {
          padding: 8px 10px;
          font-size: 0.71rem;
        }
        .rt-bulgrid {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
        }
      }

      /**
 * Section: Structured Document Blocks & Inspector Panes
 * Responsibilities: Table of contents embeds, captions, equations, chart visualization blots,
 * track changes markers, comments sidebar, and navigation panes.
 */

      /* Table of Contents Blot */
      .doc-toc {
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 14px 16px;
        margin: 14px 0;
        background: #fbfcfe;
      }
      .doc-toc-h {
        font-size: 0.66rem;
        font-weight: 900;
        letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        margin-bottom: 8px;
      }
      .doc-toc-i {
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: 6px;
        padding: 3px 0;
        color: var(--text-main);
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .doc-toc-i i {
        flex: 1;
        border-bottom: 1px dotted #cbd5e1;
      }
      .doc-toc-i:hover span { color: var(--primary); text-decoration: underline; }
      .doc-toc-i.l1 { font-weight: 800; }
      .doc-toc-i.l2 { padding-left: 18px; }
      .doc-toc-i.l3 { padding-left: 36px; font-size: 0.82rem; }
      .doc-toc-i.l4, .doc-toc-i.l5, .doc-toc-i.l6 { padding-left: 54px; font-size: 0.78rem; }

      /* Figure and Table Captions */
      .doc-caption {
        font-size: 0.78rem !important;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        text-align: center;
        font-style: italic;
        margin: 4px 0 14px !important;
      }

      /* Lightweight Inline Equations */
      .doc-eq {
        font-family: "Cambria Math", Georgia, serif;
        font-size: 1.06em;
        padding: 1px 6px;
        background: #f8fafc;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 6px;
      }

      /* Embedded Bar Chart Visualization */
      .doc-chart-block,
      .doc-chart {
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 14px;
        margin: 14px 0;
        background: #fff;
      }
      .doc-bar {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 96px 1fr 44px;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 9px;
        margin-bottom: 7px;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
      }
      .doc-bar-l { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
      .doc-bar-t {
        height: 14px;
        background: #eef2f7;
        border-radius: 999px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .doc-bar-t i {
        display: block;
        height: 100%;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4f46e5, #4338ca);
      }
      .doc-bar b { text-align: right; font-size: 0.74rem; }

      /* Track Changes Revision Highlights */
      .tracking-on .ql-editor .trk-ins {
        color: #15803d;
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-decoration-color: #86efac;
      }
      .tracking-on .ql-editor .trk-del {
        color: var(--danger);
        text-decoration: line-through;
      }

      /* Inspector Side Panes (Comments & Outline) */
      .rt-shell.has-pane .rt-surface,
      .rt-shell.has-nav .rt-surface { min-width: 0; }
      .rt-shell.has-pane,
      .rt-shell.has-nav {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
        min-height: 0;
      }
      /* Side Pane Grid Placement */
      .rt-shell.has-pane > .rt-ribbon,
      .rt-shell.has-nav > .rt-ribbon { grid-row: 1; grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .rt-shell.has-pane > .rt-find,
      .rt-shell.has-nav > .rt-find { grid-row: 2; grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .rt-shell.has-nav > .rt-nav { grid-row: 3; grid-column: 1; }
      .rt-shell.has-nav > .rt-surface { grid-row: 3; grid-column: 2; }
      .rt-shell.has-pane:not(.has-nav) > .rt-surface { grid-row: 3; grid-column: 1; }
      .rt-shell.has-pane:not(.has-nav) > .rt-comments { grid-row: 3; grid-column: 2; }
      .rt-shell.has-nav.has-pane > .rt-surface { grid-row: 3; grid-column: 2; }
      .rt-shell.has-nav.has-pane > .rt-comments { grid-row: 3; grid-column: 3; }
      .rt-shell.has-pane > .rt-stats,
      .rt-shell.has-nav > .rt-stats { grid-row: 4; grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      /* Floating dock positioning */
      .rt-shell.has-pane > .rt-dock,
      .rt-shell.has-nav > .rt-dock {
        grid-row: 3;
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        justify-self: end;
        align-self: end;
        position: absolute;
      }
      .rt-shell.has-nav {
