        grid-template-columns: 232px 1fr;
      }
      .rt-shell.has-pane {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 262px;
      }
      .rt-shell.has-nav.has-pane {
        grid-template-columns: 212px 1fr 250px;
      }
      .rt-shell.has-pane .rt-ribbon,
      .rt-shell.has-nav .rt-ribbon,
      .rt-shell.has-pane .rt-find,
      .rt-shell.has-nav .rt-find,
      .rt-shell.has-pane .rt-stats,
      .rt-shell.has-nav .rt-stats {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
      }
      .rt-nav, .rt-comments {
        min-height: 0;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        background: #fbfcfe;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
        padding: 0 0 12px;
        min-height: 0;
      }
      .rt-comments {
        border-right: none;
        border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      .rt-pane-h {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        background: #fbfcfe;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        font-size: 0.64rem;
        font-weight: 900;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        z-index: 2;
      }
      .rt-pane-empty {
        padding: 22px 14px;
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .rt-nav-i {
        display: block;
        width: calc(100% - 16px);
        margin: 2px 8px;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 6px 9px;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.79rem;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .rt-nav-i:hover { background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); }
      .rt-nav-i.l1 { font-weight: 800; }
      .rt-nav-i.l2 { padding-left: 20px; }
      .rt-nav-i.l3 { padding-left: 32px; font-size: 0.75rem; }
      .rt-nav-i.l4, .rt-nav-i.l5, .rt-nav-i.l6 { padding-left: 44px; font-size: 0.73rem; }

      .rt-comment {
        margin: 8px;
        padding: 10px 11px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-left: 3px solid #f59e0b;
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: #fff;
      }
      .rt-comment.done { opacity: 0.55; border-left-color: #86efac; }
      .rt-c-q {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        font-style: italic;
        margin-bottom: 5px;
      }
      .rt-c-t { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-main); line-height: 1.5; }
      .rt-c-a { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; }
      .rt-c-a button {
        flex: 1;
        padding: 4px 6px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #fff;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.64rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .rt-c-a button:hover { background: var(--bg-body); color: var(--text-main); }

      /* Word Count Statistics Dialog */
      .rt-wc { margin-top: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; }
      .rt-wc div {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 8px 11px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
      }
      .rt-wc div:nth-child(odd) { background: var(--bg-body); }
      .rt-wc span { color: var(--text-sub); }
      .rt-wc b { color: var(--text-main); }

      /* Header and Footer Preview */
      .rt-shell.has-hdr.mode-page .ql-editor::before {
        content: var(--hdr, "");
        position: absolute;
        top: 22px;
        left: 0; right: 0;
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .rt-shell.has-ftr.mode-page .ql-editor::after {
        content: var(--ftr, "");
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 22px;
        left: 0; right: 0;
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-page .ql-editor { position: relative; }

      /* Multilevel Numbered Lists */
      /* Custom Numbering Formats (Alpha, Roman, Decimal) */
      .ql-editor ol li.num-alpha:not([class*="ql-indent-"]):before { content: counter(list-0, lower-alpha) ". "; }
      .ql-editor ol li.num-Alpha:not([class*="ql-indent-"]):before { content: counter(list-0, upper-alpha) ". "; }
      .ql-editor ol li.num-roman:not([class*="ql-indent-"]):before { content: counter(list-0, lower-roman) ". "; }
      .ql-editor ol li.num-Roman:not([class*="ql-indent-"]):before { content: counter(list-0, upper-roman) ". "; }
      /* Custom Bullet Library Glyphs */
      .ql-editor ul li[data-bul]:before { content: attr(data-bul) !important; }
      .ql-editor.multilevel ol { counter-reset: l1; }
      .ql-editor.multilevel ol > li { counter-increment: l1; }
      .ql-editor.multilevel ol > li.ql-indent-1 { list-style-type: lower-alpha; }
      .ql-editor.multilevel ol > li.ql-indent-2 { list-style-type: lower-roman; }
      .ql-editor.multilevel ol > li.ql-indent-3 { list-style-type: upper-alpha; }

      /* Collapsible Side Panes on Narrow Screens */
      @media (max-width: 900px) {
        .rt-shell.has-nav,
        .rt-shell.has-pane,
        .rt-shell.has-nav.has-pane {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
        .rt-nav, .rt-comments {
          max-height: 190px;
          border: none;
          border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
      }

      /**
 * Section: Notification Toasts & Visual Feedback
 * Responsibilities: Toast notifications, tool cluster group labels, large touch targets,
 * and active state feedback indicators.
 */

      /* Notification Toast Container */
      .rt-toast {
        position: fixed;
        left: 50%;
        bottom: 78px;
        transform: translate(-50%, 14px);
        z-index: 13500;
        max-width: min(400px, calc(100vw - 32px));
        padding: 10px 16px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #0f172a;
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-align: center;
        box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7);
        opacity: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        transition: opacity 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease;
      }
      .rt-toast.on {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translate(-50%, 0);
      }
      .rt-toast.warn {
        background: #b45309;
      }
      .rt-toast.ok {
        background: #15803d;
      }

      /* Ribbon Tool Cluster Sub-Labels */
      @media (min-width: 900px) {
        .rt-bar {
          height: 58px;
          min-height: 58px;
          align-items: flex-start !important;
          padding-top: 4px !important;
        }
        .rt-grp {
          position: relative;
          height: 50px;
          flex-direction: row;
          align-items: center !important;
          padding-bottom: 12px;
        }
        .rt-grp::after {
          content: attr(data-label);
          position: absolute;
          left: 0;
          right: 8px;
          bottom: 0;
          text-align: center;
          font-size: 0.55rem;
          font-weight: 700;
          letter-spacing: 0.04em;
          color: #64748b;
          text-transform: uppercase;
          pointer-events: none;
        }
        .rt-ribbon::after {
          height: 58px;
        }
      }

      /* Enhanced Touch Targets for Mobile */
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .rt-b {
          min-width: 40px;
          height: 40px;
        }
        .rt-bar {
          height: 50px;
          min-height: 50px;
        }
        .rt-grp {
          height: 40px;
        }
        .ui-sel {
          height: 40px;
        }
        .rt-toast {
          bottom: 96px;
        }
      }

      /* Active & Pressed Button Indicators */
      .rt-b.on::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 50%;
        bottom: 2px;
        width: 12px;
        height: 2px;
        border-radius: 2px;
        background: currentColor;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        opacity: 0.9;
      }
      .rt-b {
        position: relative;
      }

      /**
 * Section: Document Themes, Page Borders & Proofing
 * Responsibilities: Theme color presets, themed document typography, decorative page borders,
 * hyphenation, gridline overlays, thesaurus panel, and column breaks.
 */

      /* Document Theme Preset Picker */
      .rt-themegrid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(112px, 1fr));
        gap: 9px;
        margin-top: 14px;
      }
      .rt-theme {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        padding: 12px 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: var(--tp, #fff);
        cursor: pointer;
        font-family: inherit;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
        transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
      }
      .rt-theme:hover {
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -9px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.35);
      }
      .rt-theme.on {
        border-color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .rt-theme-pv {
        font-size: 1.5rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--th, #1e293b);
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .rt-theme b {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        color: var(--ta, #4f46e5);
      }

      /* Document Aesthetic Themes, Headings & Style Sets */
      .rt-shell {
        --thm-font: inherit;
        --thm-head: var(--text-main, #1e293b);
        --thm-accent: #4f46e5;
        --ss-h1: 2em;
        --ss-weight: 800;
        --ss-caps: none;
        --pgb-color: #94a3b8;
      }
      .rt-shell.themed {
        --primary: var(--thm-accent, #4f46e5);
      }
      .rt-shell .ql-editor {
        font-family: var(--thm-font, inherit);
      }
      .rt-shell .ql-editor h1 {
        color: var(--thm-head, var(--thm-accent, var(--text-main))) !important;
        font-size: var(--ss-h1, 2em) !important;
        font-weight: var(--ss-weight, 800) !important;
        text-transform: var(--ss-caps, none) !important;
        line-height: 1.25 !important;
        margin: 0.6em 0 0.35em !important;
      }
      .rt-shell .ql-editor h2 {
        color: var(--thm-head, var(--thm-accent, var(--text-main))) !important;
        font-size: calc(var(--ss-h1, 2em) * 0.75) !important;
        font-weight: var(--ss-weight, 800) !important;
        text-transform: var(--ss-caps, none) !important;
        line-height: 1.3 !important;
        margin: 0.55em 0 0.3em !important;
      }
      .rt-shell .ql-editor h3 {
        color: var(--thm-head, var(--thm-accent, var(--text-main))) !important;
        font-size: calc(var(--ss-h1, 2em) * 0.6) !important;
        font-weight: var(--ss-weight, 800) !important;
        text-transform: var(--ss-caps, none) !important;
        line-height: 1.35 !important;
        margin: 0.5em 0 0.25em !important;
      }
      .rt-shell .ql-editor h4,
      .rt-shell .ql-editor h5,
      .rt-shell .ql-editor h6 {
        color: var(--thm-head, var(--thm-accent, var(--text-main))) !important;
        font-weight: var(--ss-weight, 800) !important;
      }
      .rt-shell .ql-editor a {
        color: var(--thm-accent, var(--primary, #4f46e5)) !important;
      }
      .rt-shell .ql-editor blockquote {
        border-left-color: var(--thm-accent, var(--primary, #4f46e5)) !important;
      }
      .rt-shell .doc-callout.info {
        border-left-color: var(--thm-accent, var(--primary, #4f46e5)) !important;
      }
      .rt-shell .ql-editor hr {
        border-color: var(--thm-accent, var(--border)) !important;
      }
      .rt-shell.ss-rule .ql-editor h1,
      .rt-shell.ss-rule .ql-editor h2 {
        border-bottom: 2px solid var(--thm-accent, currentColor) !important;
        padding-bottom: 4px !important;
      }

      /* Document Aesthetics & Themed Color Palettes */
      .rt-shell {
        --pgb-color: #94a3b8;
      }
      .rt-shell.themed {
        --primary: var(--thm-accent, #4f46e5);
      }
      .rt-shell.themed .ql-editor h1,
      .rt-shell.themed .ql-editor h2,
      .rt-shell.themed .ql-editor h3,
      .rt-shell.themed .ql-editor h4 {
        color: var(--thm-head, var(--thm-accent, var(--text-main))) !important;
        font-family: var(--thm-font, inherit);
      }
      .rt-shell.themed .ql-editor a {
        color: var(--thm-accent, var(--primary)) !important;
      }
      .rt-shell.themed .ql-editor blockquote {
        border-left-color: var(--thm-accent, var(--primary)) !important;
      }
      .rt-shell.themed .doc-callout.info {
        border-left-color: var(--thm-accent, var(--primary)) !important;
      }
      /* Page Background Color Application */
      .rt-shell .rt-surface,
      .rt-shell .ql-container,
      .rt-shell:not(.mode-dark) .ql-editor {
        background: var(--page-bg, #ffffff) !important;
      }
      /* Decorative Document Page Frame & Borders */
      .rt-shell[class*="pgb-"] .ql-container {
        outline-offset: -16px;
      }
      .rt-shell.pgb-thin .ql-container { outline: 1px solid var(--pgb-color, #94a3b8); }
      .rt-shell.pgb-medium .ql-container { outline: 2px solid var(--pgb-color, #94a3b8); }
      .rt-shell.pgb-thick .ql-container { outline: 3.5px solid var(--pgb-color, #64748b); }
      .rt-shell.pgb-double .ql-container { outline: 4px double var(--pgb-color, #64748b); }
      .rt-shell.pgb-triple .ql-container { outline: 5px double var(--pgb-color, #64748b); }
      .rt-shell.pgb-dashed .ql-container { outline: 2px dashed var(--pgb-color, #94a3b8); }
      .rt-shell.pgb-dotted .ql-container { outline: 2.5px dotted var(--pgb-color, #94a3b8); }
      .rt-shell.pgb-groove .ql-container { outline: 4px groove var(--pgb-color, #94a3b8); }
      .rt-shell.pgb-ridge .ql-container { outline: 4px ridge var(--pgb-color, #94a3b8); }
      .rt-shell.pgb-left .ql-container { border-left: 5px solid var(--pgb-color, var(--primary, #4f46e5)); }

      /* Automated Document Hyphenation */
      .rt-shell.hyphenate .ql-editor {
        hyphens: auto;
        -webkit-hyphens: auto;
        text-align: justify;
      }

      /* Document Canvas Gridline Overlay */
      .rt-shell.show-grid .ql-editor {
        background-image:
          repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.16) 0 1px, transparent 1px 24px),
          repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.16) 0 1px, transparent 1px 24px);
      }

      /* Read-Only Restricted Editing State */
      .rt-shell.locked .ql-editor {
        background: repeating-linear-gradient(
          45deg, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.05) 0 8px, transparent 8px 16px
        );
        cursor: not-allowed;
      }
      .rt-shell.locked .rt-bar .rt-b:not([data-act="protect"]) {
        opacity: 0.45;
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      /* Built-In Thesaurus & Dictionary Panel */
      .rt-syn {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 7px;
        margin-top: 14px;
      }
      .rt-synb {
        padding: 8px 14px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #fff;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: transform 0.13s ease;
      }
      .rt-synb:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        background: var(--primary-soft);
        border-color: var(--primary);
        color: var(--primary);
      }

      /* Multi-Column Break Visual Marker */
      .ql-editor [class*="column-break"] {
        break-after: column;
      }

      /**
 * Section: Font & Paragraph Configuration Dialogs
 * Responsibilities: Advanced typography settings, underline variations, hidden text,
 * dialog launch buttons, and custom form controls.
 */

      /* Extended Underline Style Variations */
      .ql-editor .uex-thick,
      .doc-card-body .uex-thick {
        border-bottom: 3px solid currentColor;
        padding-bottom: 1px;
      }
      .ql-editor .uex-dotdash,
      .doc-card-body .uex-dotdash {
        background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
          90deg, currentColor 0 5px, transparent 5px 7px, currentColor 7px 9px, transparent 9px 13px);
        background-repeat: repeat-x;
        background-position: 0 100%;
        background-size: 13px 1.5px;
        padding-bottom: 2px;
      }
      .ql-editor .uex-dotdotdash,
      .doc-card-body .uex-dotdotdash {
        background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
          90deg, currentColor 0 6px, transparent 6px 8px, currentColor 8px 10px,
          transparent 10px 12px, currentColor 12px 14px, transparent 14px 18px);
        background-repeat: repeat-x;
        background-position: 0 100%;
        background-size: 18px 1.5px;
        padding-bottom: 2px;
      }
      .ql-editor .uex-words,
      .doc-card-body .uex-words {
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-decoration-skip-ink: all;
      }
      /* Hidden Text Indicator (Dotted Underline) */
      .ql-editor .hid-on {
        opacity: 0.32;
      }
      .rt-shell.show-marks .ql-editor .hid-on {
        opacity: 0.6;
        text-decoration: underline dotted;
      }
      .doc-card-body .hid-on {
        display: none;
      }

      /* Gallery Preview Styles */
      .up-none { color: var(--text-sub); }
      .up-solid { text-decoration: underline; }
      .up-double { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-style: double; }
      .up-dotted { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-style: dotted; }
      .up-dashed { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed; }
      .up-wavy { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-style: wavy; }
      .up-thick { border-bottom: 3px solid currentColor; }
      .up-dotdash,
      .up-dotdotdash { border-bottom: 2px dashed currentColor; }
      .up-words { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-skip-ink: all; }

      /* Tool Group Dialog Launcher Trigger */
      .rt-launch {
        min-width: 18px !important;
        width: 18px;
        padding: 0 !important;
        font-size: 0.6rem !important;
        color: var(--text-sub);
        opacity: 0.75;
      }
      .rt-launch:hover {
        opacity: 1;
        color: var(--primary);
      }

      /* Universal Interactive Draggable Slider & Scrubber Component */
      .ui-slider-card {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 8px;
        background: #f8fafc;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 14px;
        padding: 12px 14px;
        transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
        touch-action: pan-y !important;
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }
      .ui-slider-card:hover,
      .ui-slider-card:focus-within,
      .ui-slider-card.is-dragging {
        border-color: #cbd5e1;
        background: #ffffff;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
      }
      .ui-slider-header {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 8px;
      }
      .ui-slider-label-group {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
      }
      .ui-slider-label {
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .ui-slider-ctrls {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 4px;
        background: #ffffff;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 2px 4px;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
      }
      .ui-slider-btn {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
        border: none;
        background: transparent;
        color: var(--text-main);
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        border-radius: 6px;
        cursor: pointer;
        user-select: none;
        -webkit-user-select: none;
        touch-action: manipulation;
        transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease, transform 0.1s ease;
      }
      .ui-slider-btn:hover {
        background: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.1);
        color: var(--primary);
      }
      .ui-slider-btn:active {
        transform: scale(0.9);
        background: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.18);
      }
      .ui-slider-input {
        width: 62px;
        border: none;
        background: transparent;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--primary);
        text-align: center;
        outline: none;
        padding: 0 2px;
      }
      .ui-slider-input:focus {
        background: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.06);
        border-radius: 4px;
      }
      .ui-slider-track-wrap {
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        height: 38px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        cursor: pointer;
        user-select: none;
        -webkit-user-select: none;
        touch-action: none !important;
        outline: none;
      }
      .ui-slider-track {
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        height: 6px;
        background: #e2e8f0;
        border-radius: 999px;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .ui-slider-fill {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        height: 100%;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6366f1, #4f46e5);
        border-radius: 999px;
        pointer-events: none;
        transition: width 0.04s ease-out;
      }
      .ui-slider-thumb {
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #ffffff;
        border: 2.5px solid var(--primary, #4f46e5);
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.38), 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18);
        pointer-events: auto;
        cursor: grab;
        touch-action: none !important;
        z-index: 5;
        transition: transform 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.1s ease;
      }
      .ui-slider-thumb::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: -14px;
        border-radius: 50%;
      }
      .ui-slider-thumb:hover,
      .ui-slider-thumb.dragging,
      .ui-slider-track-wrap:focus-visible .ui-slider-thumb {
        cursor: grabbing;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.22);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.2), 0 4px 14px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.5);
      }
      .ui-slider-tip {
        position: absolute;

      /**
 * Section: Accessibility & Keyboard Navigation
 * Responsibilities: Expanded hit area padding, WAI-ARIA tab navigation,
 * and high-visibility focus indicators.
 */
      .rt-split-arrow,
      .rt-launch {
        position: relative;
        min-width: 24px !important;
        width: 24px !important;
      }
      /* Pseudo-element expanded touch target */
      .rt-split-arrow::before,
      .rt-launch::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: -5px -3px;
      }
      @media (pointer: coarse) {
        /* 44px Minimum Touch Target Sizing */
        .rt-b,
        .rt-split-arrow,
        .rt-launch {
          min-height: 36px !important;
        }
        .rt-split-arrow,
        .rt-launch {
          min-width: 28px !important;
          width: 28px !important;
        }
        .rt-split-arrow::before,
        .rt-launch::before {
          inset: -8px -6px;
        }
        .rt-bar {
          height: 50px;
          min-height: 50px;
        }
        .rt-grp {
          height: 38px;
        }
      }

      /* WAI-ARIA Accessible Ribbon Tab Navigation */
      .rt-tab:focus-visible,
      .rt-b:focus-visible,
      .ui-sel:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--primary);
        outline-offset: 1px;
        z-index: 3;
      }

      /**
 * Section: High-Contrast Contrast Tokens & Ribbon Overflow Affordances
 * Responsibilities: High-contrast color tokens, ribbon overflow navigation arrows,
 * and responsive toolbar masks.
 */

      /* Ribbon Chrome High-Contrast Styling */
      .rt-tab,
      .rt-split-arrow,
      .rt-launch,
      .rt-grp[data-label]::after {
        color: var(--text-faint);
      }

      /* Header Action Buttons Target Sizing */
      .pp-act {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 32px;
        min-width: 44px;
        padding: 6px 10px;
        background: none;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 7px;
        font-weight: 800;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: var(--text-sub);
      }
      .pp-act:hover {
        background: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.08);
      }
      .pp-act-primary {
        color: var(--primary);
      }
      @media (pointer: coarse) {
        .pp-act {
          min-height: 40px;
          min-width: 52px;
        }
      }

      /* Ribbon Overflow Navigation Affordance & Scroll Arrows */
      .rt-barwrap {
        position: relative;
        display: block;
      }
      .rt-barwrap::before,
      .rt-barwrap::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 34px;
        pointer-events: none;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity 0.18s ease;
        /* Ribbon Scroll Arrow Button Stacking & Positioning */
        z-index: 1250;
      }
      .rt-barwrap::before {
        left: 0;
        background: linear-gradient(
          90deg,
          var(--bg-body) 12%,
          rgba(241, 245, 249, 0)
        );
      }
      .rt-barwrap::after {
        right: 0;
        background: linear-gradient(
          270deg,
          var(--bg-body) 12%,
          rgba(241, 245, 249, 0)
        );
      }
      .rt-barwrap.has-l::before,
      .rt-barwrap.has-r::after {
        opacity: 1;
      }
      .rt-scroll {
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        width: 26px;
        min-height: 34px;
        display: none;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--surface);
        color: var(--text-main);
        cursor: pointer;
        z-index: 1300; /* Elevated Arrow Button Layering */
        box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14);
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .rt-scroll:hover {
        background: var(--primary-soft);
      }
      .rt-scroll-l {
        left: 2px;
      }
      .rt-scroll-r {
        right: 2px;
      }
      .rt-barwrap.has-l .rt-scroll-l,
      .rt-barwrap.has-r .rt-scroll-r {
        display: flex;
      }
      /* Toolbar Edge Padding for Scroll Arrows */
      /* Smooth Edge Scroll Padding */
      .rt-bar {
        scroll-padding-inline: 34px;
      }
      @media (pointer: coarse) {
        .rt-scroll {
          width: 32px;
          min-height: 40px;

      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-barwrap::after {

        border-color: #334155;
      }

      /**
 * Section: Fullscreen Sheet Layout & Header Ergonomics
 * Responsibilities: Responsive multi-column document card grids in fullscreen mode,
 * toggle state glyphs, and dedicated distraction-free editor viewport.
 */

      /* Document Cards Responsive Multi-Column Grid in Fullscreen */
      .doc-scroll {
        width: 100%;
        align-self: stretch;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      /* Fullscreen Toggle Visual State Indicators */
      .btn-full .ico-exit {

      .btn-full.is-on .ico-enter {

      }
      .btn-full.is-on .ico-exit {

      /* Sheet Header Date and Weekday Subtitle */
      .sh-date {

      /**
 * Section: Dark Mode High-Contrast Color Palette
 * Responsibilities: Contrast ratios (>= 4.5:1) for inactive tabs, group labels,
 * and micro-copy in dark writing mode.
 */
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-tab {
        color: #9aa7bb; /* High-contrast active tab text on dark ribbon */
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-grp[data-label]::after {

      /**
 * Section: Browser-Default Resets & 3D Interactive Controls
 * Responsibilities: Global selection styling, custom checkboxes, save status pill placement,
 * unified slim scrollbars, and 3D neomorphic project buttons.
 */

      /* Global Selection & Form Control Resets */
      html {
        color-scheme: light;
        -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
        text-size-adjust: 100%;
      }
      ::selection {
        background: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.22);

        background: rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.35);
        color: #f8fafc;
      }
      body {
        caret-color: var(--primary);
      }
      /* Firefox Focus Ring Reset */
      ::-moz-focus-inner {
        border: 0;
        padding: 0;
      }
      /* List Marker Spacing & Color */
      .ql-editor ol > li::marker,
      .ql-editor ul > li::marker {
        color: var(--primary);
      }

      /* Accessible Custom-Styled Checkbox */
      .fd-chk input[type="checkbox"] {
        appearance: none;
        -webkit-appearance: none;
        width: 18px;
        height: 18px;
        min-width: 18px;
        margin: 0;
        border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 5px;
        background: #fff;
        display: inline-grid;
        place-content: center;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition:
          background 0.15s ease,
          border-color 0.15s ease;
      }
      .fd-chk input[type="checkbox"]::before {
        content: "";
        width: 10px;
        height: 10px;
        transform: scale(0);
        transition: transform 0.12s ease-in-out;
        background: #fff;
        /* Vector Checkmark Indicator */
        clip-path: polygon(
          14% 44%,
          0 65%,
          40% 100%,
          100% 16%,
          85% 0,
          38% 70%
        );
      }
      .fd-chk input[type="checkbox"]:checked {
        background: var(--primary);
        border-color: var(--primary);
      }
      .fd-chk input[type="checkbox"]:checked::before {
        transform: scale(1);
      }
      .fd-chk input[type="checkbox"]:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--primary);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }
      /* Expanded Checkbox Click Target */
      .fd-chk {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        min-height: 26px;
        cursor: pointer;
        user-select: none;
      }

      /* Save Status Toast Notification Positioning */
      .save-status {
        /* Top-Centered Save Notification Position */
        top: calc(
          var(--visual-viewport-offset-top, 0px) + var(--safe-area-top) + 62px
        ) !important;
        bottom: auto !important;
        left: 50% !important;
        right: auto !important;
        transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px);
      }
      .save-status.visible {
        transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
      }

      /* Unified Thin Custom Scrollbars */
      .rt-surface,
      .ql-container.ql-snow,
      .ql-editor,
      .ui-modal-a,
      .ui-modal-card {
        scrollbar-width: thin;
        scrollbar-color: #cbd5e1 transparent;
      }
      .rt-surface::-webkit-scrollbar,
      .ql-editor::-webkit-scrollbar,
      .ui-modal-a::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 10px;
        height: 10px;
      }
      .rt-surface::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
      .ql-editor::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
      .ui-modal-a::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: #cbd5e1;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 3px solid transparent;
        background-clip: content-box;
      }
      .rt-surface::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
      .ql-editor::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
      .ui-modal-a::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: transparent;
      }
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .ql-editor,
      .rt-shell.mode-dark .rt-surface {
        scrollbar-color: #475569 transparent;
      }

      /* 3D Neomorphic Interactive Project Cards */
      .proj-3d-card {
        --pb-soft: rgba(163, 177, 198, 0.45);
        --pb-light: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
        position: relative;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) !important;
        border-radius: 16px !important;
        background: linear-gradient(
            150deg,
            #ffffff 0%,
            var(--proj-tint, #f4f7fb) 100%
          ) !important;
        padding: 14px !important;
        overflow: hidden;
        transform: translateZ(0);
        box-shadow:
          5px 5px 12px var(--pb-soft),
          -5px -5px 12px var(--pb-light) !important;
        transition:
          transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
          box-shadow 0.18s ease !important;
      }
      @media (hover: hover) {
        .proj-3d-card:hover {
          transform: translateY(-2px);
          box-shadow:
            6px 6px 14px var(--pb-soft),
            -6px -6px 14px var(--pb-light) !important;
        }
      }
      .proj-3d-card:active,
      .proj-3d-card.is-pressed {
        transform: scale(0.97);
        box-shadow:
          inset 4px 4px 9px var(--pb-soft),
          inset -4px -4px 9px var(--pb-light) !important;
      }
      .proj-3d-card:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--primary);
        outline-offset: 3px;
      }
      /* Pinned Project Accent Highlighting */
      .proj-3d-card.is-pinned {
        background: linear-gradient(
            150deg,
            #fffdf5 0%,
            #fff4da 100%
          ) !important;
      }
      /* Reduced Motion Fallback */
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .proj-3d-card {
          transition: none;
        }
        .proj-3d-card:hover {
          transform: none;
        }
      }

      /* Ribbon Tab Strip Horizontal Overflow Mask */
      .rt-tabs.tovf-r {
        -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(
          90deg,
          #000 calc(100% - 36px),
          transparent
        );
        mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 calc(100% - 36px), transparent);

    <!--
  Module: Application Header and Navigation Landmark.
  Contains view mode switchers (Normal, Compact, Timeline), live clock display,
  month navigation controls, date jumper trigger, and master planner launcher.
-->
    <!--
      Accessibility Navigation:
      Provides a keyboard bypass skip link and a visually hidden h1 landmark
      to establish screen reader heading hierarchy without impacting visual density.
    -->
    <a class="skip-link" href="#mainContent">Skip to calendar</a>
    <h1 class="sr-only">Pro Planner — calendar, daily planner and documents</h1>

    <header>
      <div class="header-left">
        <button
          class="view-toggle"
          id="viewTog"
          type="button"
          aria-label="Change calendar view"
          data-tip="Change calendar view"
          onclick="toggleViewMode()"
        >
          <svg style="width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor">
            <use href="#icon-layer" />
          </svg>
        </button>
        <div
          class="clock-widget centered"
          id="smartClock"
          role="button"
          tabindex="0"
          aria-label="Go to today"
          data-tip="Go to today"
          onclick="goToToday()"
          onkeydown="if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') goToToday()"
        >
          <div class="cw-time" id="headTime">--:--</div>
          <div class="cw-date" id="headDate">-- --</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="center-title" id="centerTitle"></div>

      <div class="nav-group">
        <button
          class="nav-btn"
          type="button"
          aria-label="Previous month"
          data-tip="Previous month"
          onclick="moveMonth(-1)"
        >
          ‹
        </button>
        <button
          class="nav-btn picker-btn"
          type="button"
          aria-label="Jump to a date"
          data-tip="Jump to a date"
          onclick="openDatePicker()"
        >
          <svg style="width: 20px; height: 20px"><use href="#icon-cal" /></svg>
        </button>
        <button
          class="nav-btn"
          type="button"
          aria-label="Next month"
          data-tip="Next month"
          onclick="moveMonth(1)"
        >
          ›
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <!--
  Module: Calendar Workspace and Main Content Landmark.
  Hosts the interactive month grid, compact view, horizontal timeline strip,
  and the collapsible project summary strip.
-->
    <main id="mainContent" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Calendar and projects">
      <!--
        Module: Calendar Switcher Bar.
        3D capsule chips listing "All" plus every user calendar, shown above the
        weekday row. Tap to scope the planner, tap again for options.
      -->
      <div class="cal-bar" id="calBar" role="tablist" aria-label="Calendars"></div>

      <div class="timeline-strip" id="timelineBox"></div>

      <div class="cal-grid" id="grid" role="grid" aria-label="Month calendar"></div>

      <div class="project-section" id="projSection">
        <div
          class="section-title"
          onclick="toggleProjects()"
          style="cursor: pointer"
        >
          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px">
            <div class="proj-toggle-icon">
              <svg
                style="
                  width: 20px;
                  height: 20px;
                  fill: none;
                  stroke: currentColor;
                  stroke-width: 2.5;
                  stroke-linecap: round;
                  stroke-linejoin: round;
                "
              >
                <path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <span>My Projects</span>
          </div>

          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px">
          <!-- Project Strip Action Controls: Expand all projects browser and create a new project -->
          <button
            type="button"
            class="pp-act"
            onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openProjectListPanel()"
            data-tip="Open all projects"
            aria-label="Open all projects panel"
          >
            ☰ ALL
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            class="pp-act pp-act-primary"
            onclick="event.stopPropagation(); createNewProject()"
            data-tip="Create a new project"
            aria-label="Create a new project"
          >
            + NEW
          </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="project-scroll" id="projectList"></div>
      </div>
    </main>

    <!--
  Module: Modal Dialog Overlays.
  Reusable modal dialogs for time selection, month/year jumping,
  and destructive action confirmation prompts.
-->
    <div
      class="picker-overlay"
      id="timePicker"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Select time"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <div class="tp-card">
        <div class="tp-header">Select Time</div>
        <div class="tp-grid">
          <div class="tp-col" id="tpHours"></div>
          <div class="tp-col" id="tpMins"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="tp-actions">
          <button type="button" class="tp-act-btn tp-close" onclick="closeTimePicker()">
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="tp-act-btn tp-save" onclick="saveTimePicker()">
            Save
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div
      class="picker-overlay"
      id="datePicker"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Jump to date"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <div class="tp-card">
        <div class="tp-header">Jump to Date</div>
        <div class="tp-grid">
          <div class="tp-col" id="dpMonths"></div>
          <div class="tp-col" id="dpYears"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="tp-actions">
          <button type="button" class="tp-act-btn tp-close" onclick="closeDatePicker()">
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="tp-act-btn tp-save" onclick="saveDatePicker()">
            Go
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div
      class="picker-overlay"
      id="confirmOverlay"
      role="alertdialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Confirm deletion"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <div class="confirm-card">
        <div class="conf-title">Delete Item?</div>
        <div class="conf-sub">This action cannot be undone.</div>
        <div class="conf-btns">
          <button type="button" class="conf-btn conf-no" onclick="closeConfirm()">No</button>
          <button type="button" class="conf-btn conf-yes" onclick="confirmYes()">Yes</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div
      class="picker-overlay"
      id="dayCustomizerPicker"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Customize day markings"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <div class="tp-card dc-card" style="width: 340px; background: #fff; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);">
        <div class="tp-header dc-head" style="font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-main); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom: 10px; text-align: center;">Day Cell Customizer</div>
        <div class="dc-cal-target" id="dcCalTarget"></div>
        
        <!-- Customizer Tabs Header — pinned; does not scroll with tab pages -->
        <div class="dc-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Day customizer sections">
          <button type="button" role="tab" class="dc-tab active" id="dcTabBorders" aria-selected="true" onclick="switchDcTab('borders')">Borders</button>
          <button type="button" role="tab" class="dc-tab" id="dcTabLines" aria-selected="false" onclick="switchDcTab('lines')">Lines</button>
          <button type="button" role="tab" class="dc-tab" id="dcTabBgGlow" aria-selected="false" onclick="switchDcTab('bgGlow')">Bg & Glow</button>
          <button type="button" role="tab" class="dc-tab" id="dcTabExtras" aria-selected="false" onclick="switchDcTab('extras')">Extras</button>
        </div>

        <div class="dc-body">
        <!-- PANEL 1: BORDERS & PRESETS -->
        <div id="dcPanelBorders" class="dc-panel" style="display: block;">
          <!-- Quick Presets -->
          <div class="customizer-section" style="margin-bottom: 12px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border); padding-bottom: 10px;">
            <div style="font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-sub); margin-bottom: 6px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">Quick Presets</div>
            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 6px;">
              <button type="button" class="tp-btn" style="padding: 5px; font-size: 0.72rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px;" onclick="applyDcPreset('important')">⚠️ Urgent</button>
              <button type="button" class="tp-btn" style="padding: 5px; font-size: 0.72rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px;" onclick="applyDcPreset('holiday')">🎉 Holiday</button>
              <button type="button" class="tp-btn" style="padding: 5px; font-size: 0.72rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px;" onclick="applyDcPreset('work')">💼 Work</button>

        viewMode = (viewMode + 1) % 3;
        safeStore.setItem("viewMode", viewMode);

        renderCal();
        updateViewToggle();
        placeProjectSection();

        const overlay = document.getElementById("overlay");

          document.body.classList.add("mode-split");
          overlay.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
          overlay.inert = false;

          if (!selKey) selKey = todayKey;

          renderSheet();

      function updateHeaderState() {

          viewDate.getMonth() === today.getMonth() &&

        const clock = document.getElementById("smartClock");

        renderCal();

      function getRelTime(isoDate, timeStr) {
        if (!timeStr) return null;
        const target = new Date(`${isoDate}T${timeStr}`);
        if (isNaN(target.getTime())) return null; /* B5 */
        const now = new Date();
        const diff = target - now;
        const mins = Math.ceil(diff / 6e4);
        if (diff < -6e4)
          return {
            txt: "Late",
            class: "late",
          };
        if (diff <= 6e4 && diff > -6e4)
          return {
            txt: "Now",
            class: "",
          };
        if (mins < 60)
          return {
            txt: `in ${mins}m`,
            class: "",
          };
        const h = Math.floor(mins / 60);
        const m = mins % 60;
        return {
          txt: `in ${h}h ${m > 0 ? m + "m" : ""}`,
          class: "",
        };
      }

      let lastTodayKey = toLocalDateKey(new Date());

      function refreshCalTimers() {
        document.querySelectorAll("#grid .pin-chip[data-key]").forEach((chip) => {
          const key = chip.dataset.key;
          const idx = Number(chip.dataset.idx);
          const pin = db[key] && db[key].pins && db[key].pins[idx];
          if (!pin || !pin.time) return;
          const rel = getRelTime(key, pin.time);
          chip.classList.toggle("is-late", !!(rel && rel.class === "late"));
          const b = chip.querySelector("b");
          if (b && rel && rel.txt) b.textContent = rel.txt;
        });
      }

      function renderCal() {
        const y = viewDate.getFullYear(),
          m = viewDate.getMonth();
        updateHeaderState();
        const grid = document.getElementById("grid");
        const timelineBox = document.getElementById("timelineBox");
        if (viewMode === 2) {
          grid.style.display = "none";
          timelineBox.style.display = "flex";
          renderTimeline(y, m);
          return;
        } else {
          grid.style.display = "grid";
          timelineBox.style.display = "none";
        }
        grid.innerHTML = "";
        ["SUN", "MON", "TUE", "WED", "THU", "FRI", "SAT"].forEach((d) => {
          const h = document.createElement("div");
          h.className = "day-head";
          h.innerText = d;
          grid.appendChild(h);
        });
        const firstDay = new Date(y, m, 1).getDay();
        const daysInMonth = new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();
        const todayKey = toLocalDateKey(new Date());
        /* Generates a complete 6x7 (42-cell) grid matrix for consistent viewport fitting */
        const TOTAL_CELLS = 42;
        for (let i = 0; i < firstDay; i++) {
          const blank = document.createElement("div");
          blank.className = "day is-blank";
          grid.appendChild(blank);
        }
        for (let i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
          const dObj = new Date(y, m, i);
          const key = toLocalDateKey(dObj);
          const d = dayBucket(key);
          /* Calendar scope: items and day design resolve through the active calendar */
          const design = resolveDayDesign(key);
          const vPins = calFilterItems(d.pins);
          const vTasks = calFilterItems(d.tasks);
          const vNotes = calFilterItems(d.notes);
          /* Render-time guards: last line of defense before any interpolation */
          const _vHex = (v, fb) => (SAFE_HEX_RE.test(String(v)) ? String(v) : fb);
          const _vEnum = (v, list, fb) => (list.includes(v) ? v : fb);
          const cell = document.createElement("div");
          cell.className = "day";
          cell.dataset.key = key;
          cell.setAttribute("role", "button");
          cell.tabIndex = 0;
          const pretty = dObj.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long" });
          cell.setAttribute("aria-label", (key === todayKey ? "Today, " : "") + pretty);
          if (key === todayKey) cell.classList.add("today");
          
          // Background Color, Gradient or Pattern
          if (design.bgType === 'gradient' && SAFE_GRADIENT_RE.test(String(design.bgGradient))) {
            cell.style.background = design.bgGradient;
          } else if (design.bgType === 'pattern' && design.bgPattern === 'stripes') {
            const baseBg = _vHex(design.bg, "#ffffff");
            cell.style.background = `repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, ${baseBg}, ${baseBg} 6px, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 6px, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 12px)`;
          } else {
            cell.style.background = _vHex(design.bg, "#ffffff") !== "#ffffff" ? _vHex(design.bg, "") : "";
          }
          
          // Border Customization
          if (design.borderStyle && design.borderStyle !== 'none') {
            cell.style.border = `${_vEnum(design.borderWidth, ['1px','2px','4px','6px'], '2px')} ${_vEnum(design.borderStyle, ['solid','dashed','dotted','double','groove'], 'solid')} ${_vHex(design.borderColor, '#cbd5e1')}`;
          }
          if (design.borderRadius) {
            cell.style.borderRadius = RADIUS_RE.test(String(design.borderRadius)) ? design.borderRadius : '0';
            cell.style.overflow = "hidden";
          }
          
          // Neon Glow Effect
          if (design.glowEnabled) {
            const gColor = _vHex(design.glowColor, THEME_PRIMARY_HEX);
            cell.style.boxShadow = `0 0 8px 1px ${gColor}, inset 0 0 4px ${gColor}`;
          }
          
          const openThisDay = (ev) => {
            if (ev.target.closest(".pin-chip")) return;
            openSheet(key, dObj);
          };
          cell.onclick = openThisDay;
          cell.onkeydown = (ev) => {
            if (ev.key === "Enter" || ev.key === " ") {
              ev.preventDefault();
              openThisDay(ev);
            }
          };
          
          let html = "";
          // Day Text Badge
          if (design.badgeText) {
            const bBg = _vHex(design.badgeBg, THEME_PRIMARY_HEX);
            html += `<div class="day-badge" style="position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 4px; font-size: 0.48rem; font-weight: 800; background: ${bBg}; color: #ffffff; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 4px; line-height: 1; pointer-events: none; z-index: 6; text-transform: uppercase;">${escapeHTMLText(design.badgeText)}</div>`;
          }
          
          // Top Mark Line
          if (design.markTopEnabled) {
            const mStyle = _vEnum(design.markTopStyle, ['solid','dashed','dotted','double'], 'solid');
            const mHeight = _vEnum(design.markTopHeight, ['3px','4px','6px','10px'], '4px');
            const mColor = _vHex(design.markTopColor, THEME_PRIMARY_HEX);
            html += `<div class="day-mark-top" style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; border-top: ${mHeight} ${mStyle} ${mColor}; pointer-events: none; z-index: 5;"></div>`;
          }
          
          // Day Top (Emoji + Date Number)
          /* F5: emoji — tag-stripped, 4-grapheme cap, escaped */
          const _emojiVal = design.dayEmoji ? capGraphemes(String(design.dayEmoji).replace(/[<>]/g, ""), 4) : ""; /* audit2: ZWJ-safe */
          const emojiHTML = _emojiVal ? `<div class="day-emoji" style="font-size: 0.85rem; margin-right: auto; pointer-events: none; z-index: 6; line-height: 1;">${escapeHTMLText(_emojiVal)}</div>` : '';
          html += `<div class="day-top" style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; width:100%;">${emojiHTML}<div class="date-num" style="z-index: 6;">${i}</div></div>`;
          if (viewMode === 1) {
            html += `<div class="indicator-row">`;
            if (vPins.length)
              html += `<div class="idx-pill idx-p">${vPins.length}p</div>`;
            const activeT = vTasks.filter(
              (t) => t.status !== "done" && t.status !== "skip",
            ).length;
            if (activeT)
              html += `<div class="idx-pill idx-t">${activeT}t</div>`;
            if (vNotes.length)
              html += `<div class="idx-pill idx-n">${vNotes.length}d</div>`;
            html += `</div>`;
          } else {
            html += `<div class="day-pins" data-key="${key}">`;
            d.pins.forEach((pin, pIdx) => {
              if (!calItemVisible(pin)) return;
              const calDot = isAllView()
                ? `<span class="pin-cal-dot" style="--c:${calColor(calOf(pin))}"></span>`
                : "";
              let chipClass = "";
              let timeHTML = "";
              if (pin.time) {
                const rel = getRelTime(key, pin.time);
                if (rel) timeHTML = `<b>${rel.txt}</b> `;
                if (rel && rel.class === "late") chipClass = "is-late";
              }
              html += `<div class="pin-chip ${chipClass}" draggable="true"
                data-key="${key}" data-idx="${pIdx}"
                data-tip="${escapeHTMLText(pin.txt || "")}">${calDot}${timeHTML}${escapeHTMLText(pin.txt || "")}</div>`;
            });
            html += `</div>`;
            const activeT = vTasks.filter(
              (t) => t.status !== "done" && t.status !== "skip",
            ).length;
            if (activeT || vNotes.length) {
              html += `<div class="mini-dots">`;
              if (activeT)
                html += `<div class="m-dot" style="background:var(--success)"></div>`;
              if (vNotes.length)
                html += `<div class="m-dot" style="background:var(--warn)"></div>`;
              html += `</div>`;
            }
          }
          // Bottom Mark Line
          if (design.markBottomEnabled) {
            const mStyle = _vEnum(design.markBottomStyle, ['solid','dashed','dotted','double'], 'solid');
            const mHeight = _vEnum(design.markBottomHeight, ['3px','4px','6px','10px'], '4px');
            const mColor = _vHex(design.markBottomColor, THEME_PRIMARY_HEX);
            html += `<div class="day-mark-bottom" style="position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; border-bottom: ${mHeight} ${mStyle} ${mColor}; pointer-events: none; z-index: 5;"></div>`;
          }
          html += calDayStripHTML(key);
          cell.innerHTML = html;
          grid.appendChild(cell);
        }
        const filled = firstDay + daysInMonth;
        for (let i = filled; i < TOTAL_CELLS; i++) {
          const blank = document.createElement("div");
          blank.className = "day is-blank";
          grid.appendChild(blank);
        }
        grid.style.setProperty(
          "--cal-rows",
          String(Math.ceil(filled / 7) || 6),
        );
        markPinOverflow();
        initPinDragDrop();
      }

      /* Computes overflow in calendar day cells to display "+N" badge when pins exceed visible height */
      function markPinOverflow() {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          document.querySelectorAll("#grid .day-pins").forEach((box) => {
            const hidden = [...box.children].filter(
              (chip) => chip.offsetTop + chip.offsetHeight > box.clientHeight + 1,
            ).length;
            box.parentElement.classList.toggle("has-overflow", hidden > 0);
            if (hidden > 0)
              box.parentElement.style.setProperty("--more", `"+${hidden}"`);
            else box.parentElement.style.removeProperty("--more");
          });
        });
      }

      /* Drag-and-drop controller for rescheduling pins between calendar days */
      let dragPin = null;

      function initPinDragDrop() {
        const grid = document.getElementById("grid");
        if (!grid || grid.dataset.dndReady === "1") return;
        grid.dataset.dndReady = "1";

        grid.addEventListener("dragstart", (e) => {
          pinDragActive = true; /* B6 */
          const chip = e.target.closest(".pin-chip");
          if (!chip) return;
          dragPin = {
            fromKey: chip.dataset.key,
            idx: Number(chip.dataset.idx),
          };
          chip.classList.add("is-dragging");
          e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
          try {
            e.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", chip.dataset.key);
          } catch (err) {}
        });

        grid.addEventListener("dragend", () => {
          pinDragActive = false; /* B6 */
          dragPin = null;
          grid
            .querySelectorAll(".is-dragging, .drop-target")
            .forEach((el) =>
              el.classList.remove("is-dragging", "drop-target"),
            );
        });

        grid.addEventListener("dragover", (e) => {
          const cell = e.target.closest(".day:not(.is-blank)");
          if (!cell || !dragPin) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "move";
          grid
            .querySelectorAll(".drop-target")
            .forEach((el) => el.classList.remove("drop-target"));
          if (cell.dataset.key !== dragPin.fromKey)
            cell.classList.add("drop-target");
        });

        grid.addEventListener("dragleave", (e) => {
          const cell = e.target.closest(".day");
          if (cell) cell.classList.remove("drop-target");
        });

        grid.addEventListener("drop", (e) => {
          const cell = e.target.closest(".day:not(.is-blank)");
          if (!cell || !dragPin) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          const toKey = cell.dataset.key;
          const { fromKey, idx } = dragPin;
          dragPin = null;
          if (!toKey || toKey === fromKey) {
            renderCal();
            return;
          }
          const src = db[fromKey];
          if (!src || !src.pins || !src.pins[idx]) return;
          if (!db[toKey])
            db[toKey] = { bg: "#ffffff", pins: [], tasks: [], notes: [] };
          const [moved] = src.pins.splice(idx, 1);
          db[toKey].pins.push(moved);
          saveDB();
          renderCal();
          setSaveStatus("Pin moved");
        });
      }

      function renderTimeline(y, m) {
        const box = document.getElementById("timelineBox");
        if (!box) return;
        box.innerHTML = "";
        const daysStr = ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"];
        const daysInMonth = new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();
        const todayKey = toLocalDateKey(new Date());
        if (!selKey) selKey = todayKey;
        for (let i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
          const dObj = new Date(y, m, i);
          const key = toLocalDateKey(dObj);
          const dayData = db[key] || {
            bg: "#ffffff",
            pins: [],
            tasks: [],
            notes: [],
          };
          const el = document.createElement("div");
          el.className = `tl-item ${key === selKey ? "active" : ""}`;
          el.setAttribute("role", "button");
          el.tabIndex = 0;
          el.setAttribute("aria-label", dObj.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long" }));
          if (key !== selKey && dayData.bg && dayData.bg !== "#ffffff") {
            el.style.background = dayData.bg;
            el.style.borderColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.05)";
          }
          const pCount = calFilterItems(dayData.pins).length;
          const tCount = calFilterItems(dayData.tasks).filter(
            (t) => t.status !== "done" && t.status !== "skip",
          ).length;
          const nCount = calFilterItems(dayData.notes).length;
          let indicatorsHTML = `<div class="tl-indicators">`;
          if (pCount > 0)
            indicatorsHTML += `<span class="tl-ind tl-p">${pCount}p</span>`;
          if (tCount > 0)
            indicatorsHTML += `<span class="tl-ind tl-t">${tCount}t</span>`;
          if (nCount > 0)
            indicatorsHTML += `<span class="tl-ind tl-n">${nCount}d</span>`;
          indicatorsHTML += `</div>`;
          el.innerHTML = `
            <div class="tl-day">${daysStr[dObj.getDay()]}</div>
            <div class="tl-date">${i}</div>
            ${indicatorsHTML}
        `;
          const pick = () => {
            selKey = key;
            renderTimeline(y, m);
            renderSheet();
          };
          el.onclick = pick;
          el.onkeydown = (ev) => {
            if (ev.key === "Enter" || ev.key === " ") {
              ev.preventDefault();
              pick();
            }
          };
          box.appendChild(el);
          if (key === selKey) {
            setTimeout(
              () =>
                el.scrollIntoView({
                  behavior: "smooth",
                  inline: "center",
                  block: "nearest",
                }),
              50,
            );
          }
        }
      }

      function setBoxColor(c) {
        /* Day tint belongs to the calendar currently being designed */
        dcTarget().bg = c;
        document.getElementById("sheetCard").style.background = c;
        saveDB();
        renderCal();
        if (viewMode === 2) {
          const d = new Date(selKey);
          renderTimeline(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth());
        }
      }

      function moveMonth(n) {
        viewDate.setDate(1);
        viewDate.setMonth(viewDate.getMonth() + n);
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) {
          // Phase 3: bring the new month (and its neighbours) into RAM and
          // evict months that are no longer adjacent, without blocking the
          // first paint. renderCal() can already read cold days from the
          // mirror via dayBucket(), so we render immediately and hydrate in
          // the background for richer cells.
          try { ChunkedStorage.refreshHotWindow(); } catch (e) {}
        }
        renderCal();
      }

      function saveTimePicker() {
        const value = `${tpSel.h}:${tpSel.m}`;
        if (tpTarget.scope === "master") {
          const { key, collection, index } = tpTarget;
          if (db[key] && db[key][collection] && db[key][collection][index]) {
            db[key][collection][index].time = value;
            db[key][collection][index].updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            saveDB();
            renderMasterContent();
          }
        } else {
          updItem(tpTarget.type, tpTarget.index, "time", value);
          renderSheet();

        closeTimePicker();
        tpTarget = { type: null, index: null };

      function buildDatePicker() {
        const mBox = document.getElementById("dpMonths");
        const yBox = document.getElementById("dpYears");
        if (mBox.dataset.ready === "true" && yBox.dataset.ready === "true")
          return;
        const months = [
          "Jan",
          "Feb",
          "Mar",
          "Apr",
          "May",
          "Jun",
          "Jul",
          "Aug",
          "Sep",
          "Oct",
          "Nov",
          "Dec",
        ];
        mBox.innerHTML = months
          .map(
            (month, index) =>
              `<button type="button" class="tp-btn" onclick="dpSelect('m', ${index}, this)">${month}</button>`,
          )

        }).join("");

      function dpSelect(type, val, el) {
        if (type === "m") dpSel.m = val;
        else dpSel.y = val;
        const parent =
          type === "m"
            ? document.getElementById("dpMonths")
            : document.getElementById("dpYears");
        Array.from(parent.children).forEach((c) =>
          c.classList.remove("active"),
        );

      function openDatePicker() {
        dpSel.m = viewDate.getMonth();
        dpSel.y = viewDate.getFullYear();
        const mBox = document.getElementById("dpMonths");
        const yBox = document.getElementById("dpYears");
        Array.from(mBox.children).forEach((c, i) =>
          c.classList.toggle("active", i === dpSel.m),
        );
        Array.from(yBox.children).forEach((c) => c.classList.remove("active"));
        const yrBtn = document.getElementById(`yr-${dpSel.y}`);
        if (yrBtn) {
          yrBtn.classList.add("active");
          yrBtn.scrollIntoView({
            block: "center",
          });
        }
        const dialog = document.getElementById("datePicker");
        dialog.classList.add("open");
        dialog.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      }

      function closeDatePicker() {
        const dialog = document.getElementById("datePicker");
        dialog.classList.remove("open");
        dialog.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      }

      function saveDatePicker() {
        viewDate = new Date(dpSel.y, dpSel.m, 1);
        renderCal();
        closeDatePicker();
      }

      function delItem(type, index) {
        pendingDelete = { type, index };
        const dialog = document.getElementById("confirmOverlay");
        dialog.classList.add("open");
        dialog.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      }

      function closeConfirm() {
        const dialog = document.getElementById("confirmOverlay");
        dialog.classList.remove("open");
        dialog.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      }

      function confirmYes() {
        const { type, index } = pendingDelete;
        if (window.ChunkedStorage && selKey) ChunkedStorage.hydrateDay(selKey);
        if (type === "note") db[selKey].notes.splice(index, 1);
        else db[selKey][type === "pin" ? "pins" : "tasks"].splice(index, 1);
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.rebuildCatalog();
        saveDB();
        renderSheet();
        renderCal();
        closeConfirm();
      }

      /**
       * Module: Daily Planner Sheet Controller
       * Responsibilities: Manages daily sheet opening/closing, tab switching (Pins, Tasks, Notes),
       * task checklists, pin sticker management, and theme background palettes.
       */
      function openSheet(key, dateObj) {
        selKey = key;
        isEdit = false;
        // Phase 3: pull this day's items back from the mirror if it was evicted.
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.hydrateDay(key);
        if (!db[selKey])
          db[selKey] = {
            bg: "#ffffff",
            pins: [],
            tasks: [],
            notes: [],
          };
        document.getElementById("sheetCard").style.background =
          resolveDayDesign(selKey).bg || "#ffffff";
        /* Formats and populates the date title and day-of-week header */
        {
          const d =
            dateObj instanceof Date && !isNaN(dateObj)
              ? dateObj
              : (() => {
                  const [y, m, dd] = String(key).split("-").map(Number);
                  return new Date(y, (m || 1) - 1, dd || 1);
                })();
          const elD = document.getElementById("shDateNum");
          const elW = document.getElementById("shDateWk");
          if (elD)
            elD.textContent = d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
              day: "numeric",
              month: "short",
            });
          if (elW)
            elW.textContent = d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
              weekday: "long",
            });
        }
        if (viewMode !== 2) {
          setSurfaceOpen("overlay", true);
        }
        setFabMark(document.getElementById("fabBtn"), "plus");
        if (calFilterItems(db[selKey].pins).length) setTab("pin");
        else if (calFilterItems(db[selKey].tasks).length) setTab("task");
        else setTab("pin");
        renderSheet();
      }

      function closeSheet() {
        if (isEdit) {
          cancelEditNote();
          return;
        }
        if (viewMode === 2) return;
        setSurfaceOpen("overlay", false);
        /* Resets fullscreen tracking state on sheet close */
        fsBeforeEdit = null;
        applySheetFullscreen(false);
        document.body.classList.remove("editing-active");
        isEdit = false;
        quill = null;
        editingNoteIdx = null;
        pruneBlankEntries();
        saveDB();
        renderCal();
      }

      function toggleFullSheet() {
        applySheetFullscreen(!isSheetFullscreen);
      }


      function setFabMark(el, kind) {
        if (!el) return;
        const href = kind === "check" ? "#icon-check" : "#icon-plus";
        el.innerHTML = '<svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><use href="' + href + '"/></svg>';
      }

      function toggleEdit() {
        isEdit = !isEdit;
        if (isEdit && curTab === "note") {
          document.body.classList.add("editing-active");
          enterEditorFullscreen(); /* Cleans up fullscreen classes from document body */
        } else {
          document.body.classList.remove("editing-active");
          if (!isEdit) pruneBlankEntries();
          /* Restores previous browsing mode after document editing completes */
          restoreFullscreenAfterEdit();
        }
        setFabMark(document.getElementById("fabBtn"), isEdit ? "check" : "plus");
        renderSheet();
      }

      function setTab(t) {
        if (isEdit) cancelEditNote();

        document

          .forEach((b) =>
            b.classList.toggle(
              "active",
              b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(t.replace("note", "doc")),

        document.getElementById("taskFilters").style.display =
          t === "task" && !isEdit ? "flex" : "none";

      /* Color update helpers for daily notes, master cards, and project cards */
      function setDailyNoteColor(idx, color) {
        if (!db[selKey] || !db[selKey].notes[idx]) return;
        db[selKey].notes[idx].bg = color;
        db[selKey].notes[idx].updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        saveDB();
        renderSheet();
      }

      function setMasterNoteColor(key, idx, color) {
        if (!isValidStoreKey(key)) return console.warn("Blocked invalid store key:", key); /* F11 */
        if (!db[key] || !db[key].notes || !db[key].notes[idx]) return;
        db[key].notes[idx].bg = color;
        db[key].notes[idx].updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

      /* ==================================================================
       * ==================================================================
       *
       *   M O D U L E :   R I C H   D O C U M E N T   E N G I N E   (v13)
       *
       * ==================================================================
       *
       * WHAT THIS IS
       * ------------
       * A single, self-contained word-processor layer shared by all three
       * editors (daily note, Master Planner doc, project doc). Everything the
       * documents can do lives in this one block so it can be reasoned about,
       * extended, or lifted out without touching the rest of the planner.
       *
       *
       * WHY IT EXISTS  (research notes)
       * -------------------------------
       * The previous setup used Quill's stock toolbar. Three problems:
       *
       *  1. COLOUR WAS INVISIBLE. `color` and `background` were configured and
       *     technically worked, but Quill renders them as two tiny 18px grey
       *     glyphs with no colour preview at all. Users could not tell they
       *     were there. They are now explicit, labelled swatch panels with a
       *     live preview bar under the A, plus a custom colour input.
       *
       *  2. NO TABLES. Quill 1.3.6 ships no table format whatsoever - the
       *     bundle registers only: align, background, blockquote, bold, code,
       *     code-block, color, direction, font, header, image, indent, italic,
       *     link, list, script, size, strike, underline, video. Confirmed by
       *     grepping the bundle for `formats/table` (zero hits). Tables are
       *     therefore implemented here as a custom Blot + insert/edit toolbar.
       *
       *  3. NO REAL SIZING. Quill's `size` is four CSS classes
       *     (small/normal/large/huge). Word users expect real point/pixel
       *     values, so an explicit px scale is registered instead.
       *
       *
       * FEATURE MAP  (what a user gets)
       * -------------------------------
       *   Font family ....... 10 families incl. serif / mono / display
       *   Font size ......... true px scale, 8px -> 96px
       *   Headings .......... H1-H6 + Normal
       *   Line height ....... 1.0 / 1.15 / 1.5 / 2.0 / 2.5 / 3.0
       *   Weight/style ...... bold, italic, underline, strike
       *   Script ............ superscript / subscript
       *   Colour ............ text colour + highlight, 40 swatches + custom
       *   Alignment ......... left / centre / right / justify
       *   Indent ............ increase / decrease
       *   Direction ......... LTR / RTL
       *   Lists ............. ordered, bullet, checklist
       *   Blocks ............ blockquote, code block, horizontal rule
       *   Tables ............ insert N x M, add/remove row & column, delete
       *   Insert ............ link, image, video
       *   Utility ........... clear formatting, undo, redo
       *
       * All of it is plain Quill API + a small custom Blot, so documents stay
       * ordinary HTML and keep working with the existing save/search/sanitise
       * pipeline (highlightHTML, docPlainPreview, docTitleOf).
       * ================================================================== */

      /* Custom Parchment Blot and Attributor Registrations */
      let richFormatsReady = false;

      function registerRichFormats() {

        const LineHeight = new Parchment.Attributor.Style("lineheight", "line-height", {

            return n;
          }
          static value(n) {
            return { html: n.innerHTML };

        ChartBlot.blotName = "chart";
        ChartBlot.tagName = "div";
        ChartBlot.className = "doc-chart-block";
        Quill.register(ChartBlot, true);

        /* Advanced Typography Attributors (Scale, Baseline Position, OpenType Features) */

        /* Character effect attributors (Double Strikethrough, All Caps, Small Caps, Hidden Text) */
        /* Extended underline variant class attributors */
        const UnderExtra = new Parchment.Attributor.Class("uextra", "uex", {
          scope: Parchment.Scope.INLINE,
          whitelist: ["thick", "dotdash", "dotdotdash", "words"],

        const UpperAttr = new Parchment.Attributor.Style("allcaps", "text-transform", {

        const PositionAttr = new Parchment.Attributor.Style("vpos", "vertical-align", {

        const KernAttr = new Parchment.Attributor.Style("kern", "font-kerning", {
          scope: Parchment.Scope.INLINE,

        const Tracked = new Parchment.Attributor.Class("tracked", "trk", {

        /* Page break block embed blot */
        class PageBreakBlot extends BlockEmbed {
          static create() {
            const n = super.create();
            n.setAttribute("class", "doc-pagebreak");
            n.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
            n.innerHTML = '<span>Page break</span>';
            return n;
          }
        }
        PageBreakBlot.blotName = "pagebreak";
        PageBreakBlot.tagName = "div";
        Quill.register(PageBreakBlot, true);

        /* In-line text box (block embed): sits IN the document flow, so the
           writing continues below it - the "In line with text" Word mode.
           Overlay boxes (layout-box) float above; inline boxes flow. */
        class DocBoxBlot extends BlockEmbed {
          static create(value) {
            const n = super.create();
            n.setAttribute("class", "docbox");
            n.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
            const v = value || {};
            const w = Math.min(12, Math.max(0.5, Number(v.w) || 3));
            const h = Math.min(12, Math.max(0.4, Number(v.h) || 1.5));
            n.dataset.w = w;
            n.dataset.h = h;
            n.dataset.shape = v.shape || "rect";
            n.dataset.margin = Number(v.margin) || 0.1;
            n.style.width = Math.round(w * 96) + "px";
            n.style.minHeight = Math.round(h * 96) + "px";
            const bar = document.createElement("div");
            bar.className = "lb-bar";
            bar.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
            bar.innerHTML =
              '<span class="lb-tag"></span>' +
              '<span class="lb-acts">' +
                '<button type="button" class="lb-act" data-bact="conv" aria-label="Convert to overlay layer" title="Convert to overlay">⤴</button>' +
                '<button type="button" class="lb-act" data-bact="lock" aria-label="Lock or unlock editing" title="Lock editing">🔓</button>' +
                '<button type="button" class="lb-act lb-act-del" data-bact="del" aria-label="Delete box" title="Delete box">✕</button>' +
                '<span class="lb-grip" aria-hidden="true">⠿</span>' +
              '</span>';
            bar.querySelector(".lb-tag").textContent = "Inline box";
            const inner = document.createElement("div");
            inner.className = "docbox-inner";
            inner.setAttribute("contenteditable", "true");
            inner.setAttribute("spellcheck", "false");
            inner.innerHTML = v.html || "";
            n.appendChild(bar);
            n.appendChild(inner);
            /* Resize handles shown while the box is focused */
            ["nw", "n", "ne", "e", "se", "s", "sw", "w"].forEach((d) => {
              const hd = document.createElement("i");
              hd.className = "lb-handle lb-h-" + d;
              hd.dataset.dir = d;
              hd.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
              hd.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
              n.appendChild(hd);
            });
            return n;
          }
          static value(node) {
            return {
              w: parseFloat(node.dataset.w) || 3,
              h: parseFloat(node.dataset.h) || 1.5,
              shape: node.dataset.shape || "rect",
              margin: parseFloat(node.dataset.margin) || 0.1,
              html: (node.querySelector(".docbox-inner") || node).innerHTML,
            };
          }
        }
        DocBoxBlot.blotName = "docbox";
        DocBoxBlot.tagName = "div";
        Quill.register(DocBoxBlot, true);

              (value && value.html) || "<p>Type inside this box…</p>";
            return n;
          }
          static value(n) {
            return {
              kind: (n.className.split(" ")[1] || "info"),
              html: n.innerHTML,
            };
          }
        }
        CalloutBlot.blotName = "callout";
        CalloutBlot.tagName = "div";
        Quill.register(CalloutBlot, true);

            n.setAttribute("class", "doc-toc");
            n.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
            n.innerHTML =
              (value && value.html) ||
              '<div class="doc-toc-h">Contents</div>';
            return n;
          }
          static value(n) {
            return { html: n.innerHTML };
          }
