        TOCBlot.blotName = "doctoc";
        TOCBlot.tagName = "div";
        Quill.register(TOCBlot, true);

        /* Column break block embed blot */
        class ColBreakBlot extends BlockEmbed {
          static create() {
            const n = super.create();
            n.setAttribute("class", "doc-colbreak");
            n.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
            n.innerHTML = "<span>Column break</span>";
            return n;
          }
        }
        ColBreakBlot.blotName = "colbreak";
        ColBreakBlot.tagName = "div";
        Quill.register(ColBreakBlot, true);

        /* Document table block embed blot */
        class TableBlot extends BlockEmbed {
          static create(value) {
            const node = super.create();
            node.setAttribute("class", "doc-table-wrap");
            node.setAttribute("contenteditable", "true");
            const rows = (value && value.rows) || 2;
            const cols = (value && value.cols) || 2;
            if (value && value.html) {
              node.innerHTML = value.html;
              return node;
            }
            let html = '<table class="doc-table"><tbody>';
            for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
              html += "<tr>";
              for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                html +=
                  r === 0
                    ? "<th><br></th>"
                    : "<td><br></td>";
              }
              html += "</tr>";
            }
            html += "</tbody></table>";
            node.innerHTML = html;
            return node;
          }
          static value(node) {
            return { html: node.innerHTML };
          }
        }
        TableBlot.blotName = "doctable";
        TableBlot.tagName = "div";
        TableBlot.className = "doc-table-block";
        Quill.register(TableBlot, true);
      }

       * ==================================================================
       *
       *   M O D U L E :   D O C U M E N T   S T U D I O   (v14)
       *
       * ==================================================================
       *
       * PURPOSE
       * -------
       * Two things, kept together because they share the same design system:
       *
       *   A. NO BROWSER-DEFAULT UI. Every native control the editor still
       *      leaned on has been replaced with an in-app equivalent:
       *
       *        window.alert / prompt / confirm  ->  custom modal
       *        <select>                         ->  custom listbox
       *        <input type="color">             ->  custom HSV picker
       *        <input type="date">              ->  custom date panel
       *        data-tip="..." tooltips             ->  custom tooltip layer
       *
       *      Native widgets were rejected because they render with the OS
       *      theme (different on iOS / Android / Windows), cannot be styled,
       *      block the JS thread, and on mobile hijack the whole screen.
       *
       *   B. WRITING MODES. A document is not always read the same way, so
       *      the editor now offers several purpose-built modes:
       *
       *        Standard ..... normal editing surface
       *        Page ......... A4-width paper with margins, like a word
       *                       processor page view
       *        Focus ........ dims everything except the paragraph being
       *                       written (typewriter-style)
       *        Reading ...... wider line-height + serif, no toolbar
       *        Dark ......... inverted editing surface for night work
       *        Typewriter ... keeps the caret vertically centred
       *
       *      Plus live document statistics (words, characters, reading time)
       *      and a find-and-replace panel.
       * ================================================================== */

      /* In-App Accessible Modal Dialog Controller */
      function uiIco(name) {
        const p = {
          keep: '<path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z"/>',
          trash: '<polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/><line x1="10" y1="11" x2="10" y2="17"/><line x1="14" y1="11" x2="14" y2="17"/>',
          save: '<path d="M19 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h11l5 5v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z"/><polyline points="17 21 17 13 7 13 7 21"/><polyline points="7 3 7 8 15 8"/>',
        };
        const d = p[name];
        return d ? `<svg class="ui-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${d}</svg>` : "";
      }
      function uiDialog({ title, message, fields, okLabel, cancelLabel, extraLabel, extraDanger, danger, onOk, onExtra, enterSubmits, variant, okIcon, cancelIcon, extraIcon }) {
        const host = document.createElement("div");
        host.className = "ui-modal" + (variant === "leave" ? " ui-modal-leave" : "");
        host.innerHTML = `
          <div class="ui-modal-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${escapeHTMLText(title || "Dialog")}">
            <div class="ui-modal-h">${escapeHTMLText(title || "")}</div>
            ${message ? `<div class="ui-modal-m">${escapeHTMLText(message)}</div>` : ""}
            ${
              fields
                ? `<div class="ui-modal-f">${fields
                    .map(
                      (f, i) =>
                        `<label class="ui-field"><span>${escapeHTMLText(f.label)}</span>
                         <input class="ui-input" data-i="${i}" type="text"
                          value="${escapeHTMLText(f.value || "")}"
                          placeholder="${escapeHTMLText(f.placeholder || "")}"></label>`,
                    )
                    .join("")}</div>`
                : ""
            }
            <div class="ui-modal-a">
              <button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-ghost" data-x>${uiIco(cancelIcon)}<span>${escapeHTMLText(cancelLabel || "Cancel")}</span></button>
              ${extraLabel ? `<button type="button" class="ui-btn ${extraDanger ? "ui-danger" : "ui-ghost"}" data-extra>${uiIco(extraIcon)}<span>${escapeHTMLText(extraLabel)}</span></button>` : ""}
              <button type="button" class="ui-btn ${danger ? "ui-danger" : "ui-primary"}" data-ok>${uiIco(okIcon)}<span>${escapeHTMLText(okLabel || "OK")}</span></button>
            </div>
          </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(host);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => host.classList.add("in"));

        const inputs = [...host.querySelectorAll(".ui-input")];
        if (inputs[0]) setTimeout(() => inputs[0].focus(), 60);

        const close = () => {
          host.classList.remove("in");
          setTimeout(() => host.remove(), 180);
          document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
        };
        const submit = () => {
          const vals = inputs.map((i) => i.value);
          close();
          if (onOk) onOk(fields ? vals : true);
        };
        function onKey(e) {
          if (e.key === "Escape") {
            e.preventDefault();
            close();
          } else if (e.key === "Enter" && enterSubmits !== false && (!fields || fields.length <= 1)) {
            e.preventDefault();
            submit();
          } else if (e.key === "Tab") {
            /* Keyboard focus trap within active modal dialog */
            const f = host.querySelectorAll("input,button");
            const first = f[0];
            const last = f[f.length - 1];
            if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
              e.preventDefault();
              last.focus();
            } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
              e.preventDefault();
              first.focus();
            }
          }
        }
        document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
        host.querySelector("[data-ok]").onclick = submit;
        host.querySelector("[data-x]").onclick = close;
        const extraBtn = host.querySelector("[data-extra]");
        if (extraBtn) {
          extraBtn.onclick = () => {
            close();
            if (onExtra) onExtra();
          };
        }
        host.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
          if (e.target === host) close();
        });
        return close;
      }


      /* Floating Dropdown Portal Manager */
      const docPortal = (() => {
        let layer = null;
        /* Clears all floating elements from the dropdown portal */
        function purge() {
          if (layer) layer.innerHTML = "";
        }
        function host() {
          if (!layer) {
            layer = document.createElement("div");
            layer.className = "rt-portal";
            document.body.appendChild(layer);
          }
          return layer;
        }
        return {
          /* Attaches a floating menu panel to the portal positioned relative to anchor */
          open(panel, anchor, opts = {}) {
            const h = host();
            if (!panel._home) {
              panel._home = panel.parentNode;
              panel._next = panel.nextSibling;
            }
            h.appendChild(panel);
            panel.classList.add("rt-ported");
            this.place(panel, anchor, opts);
          },
          place(panel, anchor, opts = {}) {
            const a = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
            const vw = window.innerWidth;
            const vh = window.visualViewport ? window.visualViewport.height : window.innerHeight;
            const vTop = window.visualViewport ? window.visualViewport.offsetTop : 0;

            /* Phones: render ribbon popovers as bottom sheets - full width,
               thumb-reachable and scrollable, with safe-area padding. */
            const isSheet = vw <= 640 && panel.classList.contains("rt-pop");
            if (isSheet) {
              const safeBottom = 12;
              /* Keep the sheet clear of the editor's Save/Cancel action bar
                 so primary actions stay visible above the menu. */
              const act = document.querySelector(".editor-actions");
              const actH =
                act && getComputedStyle(act).display !== "none"
                  ? act.getBoundingClientRect().height + 6
                  : 0;
              panel.classList.add("rt-pop-sheet");
              panel.style.minWidth = "0";
              panel.style.width = "auto";
              panel.style.left = "8px";
              panel.style.right = "8px";
              panel.style.top = "auto";
              panel.style.bottom = safeBottom + actH + "px";
              panel.style.maxHeight = Math.min(Math.round(vh * 0.56), Math.round(vh - safeBottom - actH - 8)) + "px";
              panel.style.overflowY = "auto";
              panel.style.webkitOverflowScrolling = "touch";
              panel.style.touchAction = "pan-y";
              panel.style.overscrollBehavior = "contain";
              panel.style.visibility = "";
              return;
            }
            panel.classList.remove("rt-pop-sheet");
            if (opts.matchWidth !== false) panel.style.minWidth = a.width + "px";
            panel.style.visibility = "hidden";
            panel.style.display = "block";
            panel.style.maxHeight = "none";
            let p = panel.getBoundingClientRect();

            const gap = 6;
            const spaceBelow = Math.max(0, (vTop + vh) - a.bottom - gap - 8);
            const spaceAbove = Math.max(0, a.top - vTop - gap - 8);
            const fitsBelow = spaceBelow >= Math.min(p.height, 160) || spaceBelow >= spaceAbove;

            let left = opts.alignRight ? a.right - p.width : a.left;
            left = Math.max(8, Math.min(left, vw - p.width - 8));

            let top = fitsBelow ? (a.bottom + gap) : Math.max(vTop + 8, a.top - gap - p.height);
            const maxH = Math.max(140, Math.min(320, fitsBelow ? spaceBelow : spaceAbove));

            panel.style.left = left + "px";
            panel.style.top = top + "px";
            panel.style.maxHeight = maxH + "px";
            panel.style.overflowY = "auto";
            panel.style.webkitOverflowScrolling = "touch";
            panel.style.touchAction = "pan-y";
            panel.style.overscrollBehavior = "contain";
            panel.style.visibility = "";
          },
          purge,
          /* Restores panel to its original DOM parent container */
          close(panel) {
            if (!panel || !panel._home) return;
            panel.classList.remove("rt-ported");
            panel.style.cssText = "";
            if (panel._next && panel._next.parentNode === panel._home)
              panel._home.insertBefore(panel, panel._next);
            else panel._home.appendChild(panel);
          },
        };
      })();

      /* Custom Accessible Listbox Component */
      /* Auto-closes floating popovers and dropdowns during page / sheet / modal scrolling */
      const autoCloseFloatingOnScroll = (e) => {
        if (e && e.target && e.target.closest && (
          e.target.closest(".ui-sel-list") ||
          e.target.closest(".fd-col-pop") ||
          e.target.closest(".rt-pop") ||
          e.target.closest(".fd-card")
        )) {
          return;
        }
        document.querySelectorAll(".ui-sel.open").forEach((sel) => {
          if (typeof sel._closeList === "function") sel._closeList();
          else {
            sel.classList.remove("open");
            const l = sel.querySelector(".ui-sel-list");
            if (l && typeof docPortal !== "undefined") docPortal.close(l);
          }
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-pop-wrap.open").forEach((wrap) => {
          wrap.classList.remove("open");
          const t = wrap.querySelector("[data-pop]");
          if (t) t.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
          const p = wrap.querySelector(".rt-pop");
          if (p && typeof docPortal !== "undefined") docPortal.close(p);
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(".fd-col-pop.open").forEach((p) => {
          p.classList.remove("open");
          if (typeof docPortal !== "undefined") docPortal.close(p);
        });
      };
      window.addEventListener("scroll", autoCloseFloatingOnScroll, { capture: true, passive: true });
      document.addEventListener("scroll", autoCloseFloatingOnScroll, { capture: true, passive: true });

      function uiSelect(cfg) {
        /* Listbox configuration options: { value, options, width, title, onPick } */
        const el = document.createElement("div");
        el.className = "ui-sel";
        if (cfg.width) el.style.width = cfg.width;
        el.tabIndex = 0;
        el.setAttribute("role", "combobox");
        el.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        el.setAttribute("aria-label", cfg.title || "Select");
        el.dataset.tip = cfg.title || "";

        const labelOf = (v) => {
          const hit = cfg.options.find((o) => o[0] === v);
          return hit ? hit[1] : cfg.options[0][1];
        };

        el.innerHTML = `<span class="ui-sel-v">${escapeHTMLText(labelOf(cfg.value))}</span>
          <svg class="ui-sel-c" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-chevron"/></svg>
          <div class="ui-sel-list" role="listbox"></div>`;

        const list = el.querySelector(".ui-sel-list");
        const paint = () => {
          list.innerHTML = cfg.options
            .map(
              ([v, l, st]) =>
                `<button type="button" role="option" class="ui-opt ${v === el.dataset.value ? "on" : ""}"
                   data-v="${escapeHTMLText(v)}" ${st ? `style="${st}"` : ""}>${escapeHTMLText(l)}</button>`,
            )
            .join("");
        };
        el.dataset.value = cfg.value;
        paint();

        let touchStartY = 0;
        let isTouchScroll = false;

        list.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) {
            touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
          }
          isTouchScroll = false;
        }, { passive: true });

        list.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches[0] && Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientY - touchStartY) > 5) {
            isTouchScroll = true;
          }
        }, { passive: true });

        const close = () => {
          el.classList.remove("open");
          el.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
          docPortal.close(list);
        };
        const open = () => {
          document.querySelectorAll(".ui-sel.open").forEach((o) => {
            o.classList.remove("open");
            const l = o.querySelector(".ui-sel-list");
            if (l) docPortal.close(l);
          });
          paint();
          el.classList.add("open");
          el.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
          docPortal.open(list, el);
        };
        el._closeList = close;

        /* Touch movement tracking on the trigger button to distinguish scroll from tap */
        let trigTouchX = 0;
        let trigTouchY = 0;
        let trigMoved = false;

        el.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) {
            trigTouchX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            trigTouchY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            trigMoved = false;
          }
        }, { passive: true });

        el.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) {
            const dx = Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientX - trigTouchX);
            const dy = Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientY - trigTouchY);
            if (dx > 8 || dy > 8) {
              trigMoved = true;
            }
          }
        }, { passive: true });

        el.addEventListener("touchend", () => {
          setTimeout(() => { trigMoved = false; }, 120);
        }, { passive: true });

        el.addEventListener("touchcancel", () => {
          trigMoved = false;
        }, { passive: true });

        const toggleOpen = (e) => {
          if (trigMoved) {
            trigMoved = false;
            return;
          }
          if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".ui-opt")) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          el.classList.contains("open") ? close() : open();
        };

        el.addEventListener("click", toggleOpen);

        list.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          if (isTouchScroll) {
            isTouchScroll = false;
            return;
          }
          const b = e.target.closest(".ui-opt");
          if (!b) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          el.dataset.value = b.dataset.v;
          el.querySelector(".ui-sel-v").textContent = labelOf(b.dataset.v);
          close();
          if (cfg.onPick) cfg.onPick(b.dataset.v);
        });

        el.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
            e.preventDefault();
            el.classList.contains("open") ? close() : open();
          } else if (e.key === "Escape") close();
        });

        const onDocInteract = (e) => {
          if (!el.contains(e.target) && !list.contains(e.target)) {
            close();
          }
        };

        docBind(document, "mousedown", onDocInteract);
        docBind(document, "touchstart", onDocInteract, { passive: true });

        el.setValue = (v) => {
          el.dataset.value = v;
          el.querySelector(".ui-sel-v").textContent = labelOf(v);
        };
        return el;
      }

      /* Custom Color Palette Popover Component */
      function uiColorPicker(initial, onPick) {
        let h = 0, sv = { s: 1, v: 1 };
        const hex2hsv = (hex) => {
          const m = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex || "#000000");
          if (!m) return { h: 0, s: 1, v: 1 };
          let r = parseInt(m[1], 16) / 255,
            g = parseInt(m[2], 16) / 255,
            b = parseInt(m[3], 16) / 255;
          const mx = Math.max(r, g, b), mn = Math.min(r, g, b), d = mx - mn;
          let hh = 0;
          if (d) {
            if (mx === r) hh = ((g - b) / d) % 6;
            else if (mx === g) hh = (b - r) / d + 2;
            else hh = (r - g) / d + 4;
          }
          return { h: (hh * 60 + 360) % 360, s: mx ? d / mx : 0, v: mx };
        };
        const hsv2hex = (H, S, V) => {
          const c = V * S, x = c * (1 - Math.abs(((H / 60) % 2) - 1)), m = V - c;
          let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
          if (H < 60) [r, g, b] = [c, x, 0];
          else if (H < 120) [r, g, b] = [x, c, 0];
          else if (H < 180) [r, g, b] = [0, c, x];
          else if (H < 240) [r, g, b] = [0, x, c];
          else if (H < 300) [r, g, b] = [x, 0, c];
          else [r, g, b] = [c, 0, x];
          const f = (n) =>
            Math.round((n + m) * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
          return `#${f(r)}${f(g)}${f(b)}`;
        };
        const init = hex2hsv(initial);
        h = init.h; sv = { s: init.s, v: init.v };

        const wrap = document.createElement("div");
        wrap.className = "ui-cp";
        wrap.innerHTML = `
          <div class="ui-cp-sv"><span class="ui-cp-dot"></span></div>
          <div class="ui-cp-hue"><span class="ui-cp-hdot"></span></div>
          <div class="ui-cp-foot">
            <span class="ui-cp-prev"></span>
            <input class="ui-cp-hex" maxlength="7" aria-label="Hex colour">
            <button type="button" class="ui-cp-ok">Apply</button>
          </div>`;
        const svBox = wrap.querySelector(".ui-cp-sv");
        const dot = wrap.querySelector(".ui-cp-dot");
        const hueBox = wrap.querySelector(".ui-cp-hue");
        const hdot = wrap.querySelector(".ui-cp-hdot");
        const prev = wrap.querySelector(".ui-cp-prev");
        const hex = wrap.querySelector(".ui-cp-hex");

        const render = () => {
          const c = hsv2hex(h, sv.s, sv.v);
          svBox.style.background =
            `linear-gradient(to top, #000, transparent), linear-gradient(to right, #fff, ${hsv2hex(h, 1, 1)})`;
          dot.style.left = sv.s * 100 + "%";
          dot.style.top = (1 - sv.v) * 100 + "%";
          dot.style.background = c;
          hdot.style.left = (h / 360) * 100 + "%";
          prev.style.background = c;
          if (document.activeElement !== hex) hex.value = c;
        };
        const drag = (box, fn) => {
          const move = (ev) => {
            const r = box.getBoundingClientRect();
            const p = ev.touches ? ev.touches[0] : ev;
            fn(
              Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (p.clientX - r.left) / r.width)),
              Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (p.clientY - r.top) / r.height)),
            );
            render();
          };
          const up = () => {
            document.removeEventListener("mousemove", move);
            document.removeEventListener("mouseup", up);
            document.removeEventListener("touchmove", move);
            document.removeEventListener("touchend", up);
          };
          box.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            move(e);
            document.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
            document.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
          });
          box.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
            move(e);
            document.addEventListener("touchmove", move, { passive: true });
            document.addEventListener("touchend", up);
          }, { passive: true });
        };
        drag(svBox, (x, y) => { sv.s = x; sv.v = 1 - y; });
        drag(hueBox, (x) => { h = x * 360; });
        hex.addEventListener("input", () => {
          if (/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(hex.value)) {
            const k = hex2hsv(hex.value);
            h = k.h; sv = { s: k.s, v: k.v };
            render();
          }
        });
        wrap.querySelector(".ui-cp-ok").addEventListener("click", () =>
          onPick(hsv2hex(h, sv.s, sv.v)),
        );
        render();
        return wrap;
      }

      /* Inline Date Picker Panel Component */
      function uiDatePanel(initial, onPick) {
        let view = initial ? new Date(initial + "T00:00:00") : new Date();
        if (isNaN(view)) view = new Date();
        const sel = initial || "";
        const el = document.createElement("div");
        el.className = "ui-dp";

        const draw = () => {
          const y = view.getFullYear(), m = view.getMonth();
          const first = new Date(y, m, 1).getDay();
          const days = new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();
          const todayK = toLocalDateKey(new Date());
          let cells = "";
          for (let i = 0; i < first; i++) cells += `<span class="ui-dp-x"></span>`;
          for (let d = 1; d <= days; d++) {
            const k = toLocalDateKey(new Date(y, m, d));
            cells += `<button type="button" class="ui-dp-d ${k === sel ? "on" : ""} ${k === todayK ? "today" : ""}" data-k="${k}">${d}</button>`;
          }
          el.innerHTML = `
            <div class="ui-dp-h">
              <button type="button" class="ui-dp-nav" data-mv="-1" aria-label="Previous month">‹</button>
              <span class="ui-dp-t">${view.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "long", year: "numeric" })}</span>
              <button type="button" class="ui-dp-nav" data-mv="1" aria-label="Next month">›</button>
            </div>
            <div class="ui-dp-w">${["S","M","T","W","T","F","S"].map((d) => `<span>${d}</span>`).join("")}</div>
            <div class="ui-dp-g">${cells}</div>
            <div class="ui-dp-f">
              <button type="button" class="ui-dp-q" data-k="${todayK}">Today</button>
              <button type="button" class="ui-dp-q" data-clear>No date</button>
            </div>`;
        };
        draw();
        el.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          const nav = e.target.closest("[data-mv]");
          if (nav) {
            view.setMonth(view.getMonth() + Number(nav.dataset.mv));
            draw();
            return;
          }
          if (e.target.closest("[data-clear]")) return onPick("");
          const d = e.target.closest("[data-k]");
          if (d) onPick(d.dataset.k);
        });
        return el;
      }

      /* Custom Accessible Tooltips Engine */
      (function initTooltips() {
        let tip, timer;
        const show = (target) => {
          const text = target.dataset.tip || target.getAttribute("title");
          if (!text) return;
          if (target.getAttribute("title")) {
            target.dataset.tip = text;
            target.removeAttribute("title"); /* Suppress default browser title bubble */
          }
          if (!tip) {
            tip = document.createElement("div");
            tip.className = "ui-tip";
            document.body.appendChild(tip);
          }
          tip.textContent = text;
          const r = target.getBoundingClientRect();
          tip.style.visibility = "hidden";
          tip.classList.add("on");
          const t = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
          let left = r.left + r.width / 2 - t.width / 2;
          left = Math.max(6, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - t.width - 6));
          const below = r.top < t.height + 12;
          tip.style.left = left + "px";
          tip.style.top = (below ? r.bottom + 7 : r.top - t.height - 7) + "px";
          tip.style.visibility = "";
        };
        const hide = () => {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          if (tip) tip.classList.remove("on");
        };
        document.addEventListener("mouseover", (e) => {
          const t = e.target.closest("[title],[data-tip]");
          if (!t) return;
          clearTimeout(timer);
          timer = setTimeout(() => show(t), 320);
        });
        document.addEventListener("mouseout", hide);
        document.addEventListener("mousedown", hide);
        window.addEventListener("scroll", hide, true);
      })();

      /* Writing Modes Controller (Standard, Focus, Typewriter, Reading) */
      const DOC_MODES = [
        ["standard", "Standard", "Plain editing surface"],
        ["page", "Page", "A4 paper with margins"],
        ["focus", "Focus", "Dim all but the current line"],
        ["reading", "Reading", "Comfortable serif reading view"],
        ["typewriter", "Typewriter", "Keep the caret centred"],
        ["dark", "Dark", "Night-friendly editing"],
      ];

      let docMode = safeStore.getItem("docMode") || "standard";

      function applyDocMode(mode) {
        docMode = mode;
        safeStore.setItem("docMode", mode);
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
          DOC_MODES.forEach(([m]) => sh.classList.remove("mode-" + m));
          sh.classList.add("mode-" + mode);
        });
        /* Typewriter mode: keeps the active editing line vertically centered */
        if (mode === "typewriter") enableTypewriter();
        else disableTypewriter();
        updateDocStats();
        updatePageInfo();
      }

      let twHandler = null;
      function enableTypewriter() {
        disableTypewriter();
        twHandler = () => {
          const ed = document.querySelector(".rt-shell.mode-typewriter .ql-editor");
          if (!ed) return;
          const sel = window.getSelection();
          if (!sel || !sel.rangeCount) return;
          const r = sel.getRangeAt(0).getBoundingClientRect();
          const b = ed.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (!r.height) return;
          const target = r.top - b.top + ed.scrollTop - b.height / 2;
          ed.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, target), behavior: "smooth" });
        };
        document.addEventListener("keyup", twHandler);
        document.addEventListener("click", twHandler);
      }
      function disableTypewriter() {
        if (!twHandler) return;
        document.removeEventListener("keyup", twHandler);
        document.removeEventListener("click", twHandler);
        twHandler = null;
      }

      /* Writing surface zoom scaling controller */
      let docZoom = Number(safeStore.getItem("docZoom") || 100);
      /* Rescue: the old auto-fit saved crushed zooms (40-46%) into storage on
         phones, which made every font tiny. Restore a readable 100% once. */
      if (window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches && docZoom < 60) {
        docZoom = 100;
        safeStore.setItem("docZoom", 100);
      }

      function applyDocZoom(z) {
        /* Smaller floor on touch screens so the manual "Fit page width"
           action can show a whole portrait A4 page on a phone; desktop
           keeps 60%. Nothing ever changes the zoom automatically. */
        const floor = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches ? 40 : 60;
        docZoom = Math.min(200, Math.max(floor, z));
        safeStore.setItem("docZoom", docZoom);
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
          sh.style.setProperty("--doc-zoom", docZoom / 100);
          sh.querySelectorAll(".rt-dock-z, .rt-zoomlbl").forEach(
            (l) => (l.textContent = docZoom + "%"),
          );
        });
        refreshRulerSync();
        renderLayoutBoxes();
        updatePageNav();
      }

      /* NOTE: no automatic zoom-out anywhere. Zooming the paper down to fit
         the phone screen makes the base font unreadable (16px * 0.4 = 6.4px)
         and silently overrides the font size the user picked in Home. The
         paper always keeps its true size; on narrow screens it pans
         horizontally (scroll direction follows the page size). "Fit page
         width" stays available as an explicit, user-chosen action. */

      /* Floating quick dock overlay */
      function bindDock(dock, shell, q) {
        applyDocZoom(docZoom);
        dock.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          const b = e.target.closest("[data-dock]");
          if (!b) return;
          const a = b.dataset.dock;
          if (a === "zoom-in") applyDocZoom(docZoom + 10);
          else if (a === "zoom-out") applyDocZoom(docZoom - 10);
          else if (a === "page-prev") scrollToPage(-1);
          else if (a === "page-next") scrollToPage(1);
          else if (a === "exit") {
            applyDocMode("standard");
            const sel = shell.querySelector(".ui-sel.rt-mode");
            if (sel && sel.setValue) sel.setValue("standard");
          } else if (a === "modes") openModePicker(shell);
        });
      }

      /* Writing mode switcher dialog */
      function openModePicker(shell) {
        const host = document.createElement("div");
        host.className = "ui-modal";
        host.innerHTML = `<div class="ui-modal-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Writing mode">
            <div class="ui-modal-h">Writing mode</div>
            <div class="rt-modegrid">${DOC_MODES.map(
              ([v, l, d]) =>
                `<button type="button" class="rt-modecard ${v === docMode ? "on" : ""}" data-m="${v}">
                   <b>${l}</b><span>${d}</span></button>`,
            ).join("")}</div>
            <div class="ui-modal-a"><button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-ghost" data-x>Close</button></div>
          </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(host);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => host.classList.add("in"));
        const close = wireModal(host);
        host.querySelectorAll(".rt-modecard").forEach((b) =>
          b.addEventListener("click", () => {
            applyDocMode(b.dataset.m);
            const sel = shell.querySelector(".ui-sel.rt-mode");
            if (sel && sel.setValue) sel.setValue(b.dataset.m);
            close();
          }),
        );
      }

      /* Keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet dialog */
      const SHORTCUT_LIST = [
        ["Ctrl / ⌘ + B", "Bold"], ["Ctrl + I", "Italic"], ["Ctrl + U", "Underline"],
        ["Ctrl + Shift + X", "Strikethrough"], ["Alt + 1…6", "Heading 1-6"],
        ["Alt + 0", "Normal text"], ["Ctrl + Shift + 7", "Numbered list"],
        ["Ctrl + Shift + 8", "Bulleted list"], ["Ctrl + Shift + 9", "Quote"],
        ["Ctrl + K", "Insert link"], ["Ctrl + F", "Find and replace"],
        ["Ctrl + Z / Y", "Undo / Redo"], ["Ctrl + Shift + C", "Clear formatting"],
        ["/", "Slash commands"], ["# + space", "Heading"], ["- + space", "Bullet"],
        ["1. + space", "Numbered"], ["[] + space", "Checklist"],
        ["> + space", "Quote"], ["**text**", "Bold as you type"],
      ];

      function openShortcutSheet() {
        const host = document.createElement("div");
        host.className = "ui-modal";
        host.innerHTML = `<div class="ui-modal-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Keyboard shortcuts">
            <div class="ui-modal-h">Keyboard shortcuts & autoformat</div>
            <div class="rt-keys">${SHORTCUT_LIST.map(
              ([k, d]) => `<div class="rt-key"><kbd>${k}</kbd><span>${d}</span></div>`,
            ).join("")}</div>
            <div class="ui-modal-a"><button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-ghost" data-x>Close</button></div>
          </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(host);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => host.classList.add("in"));
        const close = wireModal(host);
      }

      /* Focus mode: highlights paragraph under caret and dims background text */
      function markFocusLine(q) {
        const root = q.root;
        root.querySelectorAll(".rt-live").forEach((n) => n.classList.remove("rt-live"));
        const sel = window.getSelection();
        if (!sel || !sel.anchorNode) return;
        let n = sel.anchorNode;
        if (n.nodeType === 3) n = n.parentElement;
        while (n && n.parentElement !== root) n = n.parentElement;
        if (n && n.classList) n.classList.add("rt-live");
      }

      /* Live Document Statistics Calculator (Words, Characters, Reading Time) */
      let statsRaf = 0;
      function updateDocStats() {
        /* Batches statistics computation within animation frame for smooth typing */
        if (statsRaf) return;
        statsRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          statsRaf = 0;
          doUpdateDocStats();
        });
      }

      function doUpdateDocStats() {
        const bar = document.querySelector(".rt-stats");
        if (!bar || !quill) return;
        const text = quill.getText().replace(/\u200b/g, "");
        const words = (text.match(/[^\s]+/g) || []).length;
        const chars = text.replace(/\n/g, "").length;
        const mins = Math.max(1, Math.round(words / 220));
        const paras = (quill.root.querySelectorAll("p,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,li") || []).length;
        const sel = quill.getSelection();
        const selText = sel && sel.length ? quill.getText(sel.index, sel.length) : "";
        const selWords = selText ? (selText.match(/[^\s]+/g) || []).length : 0;
        const selChars = selText ? selText.replace(/\n/g, "").length : 0;
        let html =
          `<span><b>${words}</b> words</span>` +
          `<span><b>${chars}</b> characters</span>` +
          `<span><b>${paras}</b> blocks</span>` +
          `<span><b>${mins}</b> min read</span>` +
          `<span data-page>Page 1 of 1</span>`;
        if (selWords)
          html += `<span class="rt-selinfo"><b>${selWords}</b> words · <b>${selChars}</b> chars selected</span>`;
        if (docGoal > 0) {
          const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((words / docGoal) * 100));
          html += `<span class="rt-goal ${pct >= 100 ? "done" : ""}">
              <i style="width:${pct}%"></i><b>${pct}%</b> of ${docGoal}
            </span>`;
        }
        bar.innerHTML = html;
        renderLineNumbers();
        updatePageNav();
      }

      /* Find and Replace Search Engine */
      let findState = { q: "", hits: [], at: -1 };

      function toggleFindPanel(shell) {
        const p = shell.querySelector(".rt-find");
        if (!p) return;
        const open = p.classList.toggle("on");
        if (open) {
          const i = p.querySelector(".rt-find-q");
          i.focus();
          i.select();
        } else clearFindMarks();
      }

      function clearFindMarks() {
        if (!quill) return;
        const len = quill.getLength();
        quill.formatText(0, len, "background", false, "silent");
        findState = { q: "", hits: [], at: -1 };
      }

      function runFind(shell, term, jump) {
        if (!quill) return;
        const info = shell.querySelector(".rt-find-n");
        clearFindMarks();
        if (!term) {
          if (info) info.textContent = "0/0";
          return;
        }
        const text = quill.getText();
        const hits = [];
        const low = text.toLowerCase();
        const t = term.toLowerCase();
        let i = low.indexOf(t);
        while (i !== -1) {
          hits.push(i);
          i = low.indexOf(t, i + t.length);
        }
        findState = { q: term, hits, at: hits.length ? 0 : -1 };
        hits.forEach((h) =>
          quill.formatText(h, term.length, "background", "#fde68a", "silent"),
        );
        if (hits.length) {
          const at = jump === undefined ? 0 : jump;
          findState.at = (at + hits.length) % hits.length;
          const pos = hits[findState.at];
          quill.formatText(pos, term.length, "background", "#f59e0b", "silent");
          quill.setSelection(pos, term.length);
        }
        if (info)
          info.textContent = `${hits.length ? findState.at + 1 : 0}/${hits.length}`;
      }

      function runReplace(shell, all) {
        if (!quill || !findState.q) return;
        const rep = shell.querySelector(".rt-find-r").value;
        const term = findState.q;
        if (all) {
          for (let i = findState.hits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            quill.deleteText(findState.hits[i], term.length, "user");
            quill.insertText(findState.hits[i], rep, "user");
          }
        } else if (findState.at >= 0) {
          const pos = findState.hits[findState.at];
          quill.deleteText(pos, term.length, "user");
          quill.insertText(pos, rep, "user");
        }
        clearFindMarks();
        runFind(shell, term, 0);
        updateDocStats();
      }



      /**
       * Module: Power Editor Features
       * Responsibilities: Keyboard shortcuts, live markdown autoformat, smart paste & image optimization,
       * slash commands, autosave version snapshots, crash-proof draft recovery, and document exporter.
       */

      /* Document Keyboard Shortcuts Handler */
      function bindDocShortcuts(q, shell, id) {
        q.root.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
          const mod = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;
          if (!mod) return;
          const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
          const r = q.getSelection() || { index: 0, length: 0 };
          const tog = (fmt) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            q.format(fmt, !q.getFormat(r)[fmt], "user");
          };
          /* Extends standard key bindings with application and ribbon commands */
          if (e.shiftKey && k === "x") tog("strike");
          else if (e.shiftKey && k === "7") {
            e.preventDefault();
            q.format("list", q.getFormat(r).list === "ordered" ? false : "ordered", "user");
          } else if (e.shiftKey && k === "8") {
            e.preventDefault();
            q.format("list", q.getFormat(r).list === "bullet" ? false : "bullet", "user");
          } else if (e.shiftKey && k === "9") {
            e.preventDefault();
            q.format("blockquote", !q.getFormat(r).blockquote, "user");
          } else if (k >= "1" && k <= "6" && e.altKey) {
            e.preventDefault();
            q.format("header", Number(k), "user");
          } else if (k === "0" && e.altKey) {
            e.preventDefault();
            q.format("header", false, "user");
          } else if (k === "y" && !e.shiftKey) {
            /* Redo shortcut binding (Ctrl+Y) */
            e.preventDefault();
            q.history.redo();
          } else if (k === "k") {
            e.preventDefault();
            richAction(q, "link", r, id);
          } else if (k === "f") {
            e.preventDefault();
            toggleFindPanel(shell);
          } else if (e.shiftKey && k === "c") {
            e.preventDefault();
            richAction(q, "clean", r, id);
          } else if (k === "d") {
            /* Font dialog shortcut (Ctrl+D) */
            e.preventDefault();
            openFontDialog(q);
          } else if (e.altKey && k === "p") {
            /* Paragraph dialog shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+P) */
            e.preventDefault();
            openParagraphDialog(q);
          } else if (k === "s") {
            /* Save shortcut (Ctrl+S): saves current draft without closing editor */
            e.preventDefault();
            persistDraft();
          } else if (e.shiftKey && k === "l") {
            e.preventDefault();
            q.format("align", q.getFormat(r).align ? false : "center", "user");
          }
        });
      }

      /* Markdown Autoformat Engine (Headings, Lists, Blockquotes, Inline) */
      const MD_RULES = [
        [/^(#{1,6})\s$/, (m, q, line) => q.formatLine(line, 1, "header", m[1].length)],
        [/^[-*+]\s$/, (m, q, line) => q.formatLine(line, 1, "list", "bullet")],
        [/^\d+\.\s$/, (m, q, line) => q.formatLine(line, 1, "list", "ordered")],
        [/^\[\]\s$/, (m, q, line) => q.formatLine(line, 1, "list", "unchecked")],
        [/^>\s$/, (m, q, line) => q.formatLine(line, 1, "blockquote", true)],
        [/^```$/, (m, q, line) => q.formatLine(line, 1, "code-block", true)],
        [/^(---|\*\*\*)$/, (m, q, line) => {
          q.deleteText(line, m[0].length);
          q.insertEmbed(line, "hr", true, "user");
        }],
      ];

      function bindMarkdown(q) {
        q.on("text-change", (delta, old, source) => {
          if (source !== "user") return;
          const ins = delta.ops && delta.ops.find((o) => o.insert);
          if (!ins || typeof ins.insert !== "string") return;
          const sel = q.getSelection();
          if (!sel) return;
          const [blot] = q.getLine(sel.index);
          if (!blot) return;
          const lineStart = q.getIndex(blot);
          const text = blot.domNode.textContent || "";

          /* Block-level markdown triggers */
          for (const [re, fn] of MD_RULES) {
            const m = text.match(re);
            if (m) {
              /* Defers formatting execution to prevent Quill mutation collision */
              setTimeout(() => {
                q.deleteText(lineStart, m[0].length, "user");
                fn(m, q, lineStart);
                q.setSelection(lineStart, 0, "silent");
                q.focus();
              }, 0);
              return;
            }
          }

          /* Inline markdown formatting replacements */
          const inline = [
            [/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*$/, "bold"],
            [/(?:^|[^*])\*([^*]+)\*$/, "italic"],
            [/`([^`]+)`$/, "code"],
            [/~~([^~]+)~~$/, "strike"],
          ];
          for (const [re, fmt] of inline) {
            const m = text.match(re);
            if (m) {
              const full =
                m[0].startsWith("*") || m[0].startsWith("`") || m[0].startsWith("~")
                  ? m[0]
                  : m[0].slice(1);
              const at = lineStart + text.lastIndexOf(full);
              setTimeout(() => {
                q.deleteText(at, full.length, "user");
                q.insertText(at, m[1], { [fmt]: true }, "user");
                q.setSelection(at + m[1].length, 0, "silent");
                q.format(fmt, false);
                q.focus();
              }, 0);
              return;
            }
          }
        });
      }

      /* Smart Paste & Image Compression Handler */

      /* Compresses and resizes large clipboard images before embedding */
      function insertImageSmart(q, dataUrl, r) {
        const target = r || q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength() };
        const probe = new Image();
        probe.onload = () => {
          const MAX = 1600;
          const heavy = String(dataUrl).length > 500000;
          const big = probe.width > MAX || probe.height > MAX;
          if (!big && !heavy) {
            q.insertEmbed(target.index, "image", dataUrl, "user");
            q.setSelection(target.index + 1, 0);
            return;
          }
          try {
            const scale = Math.min(1, MAX / Math.max(probe.width, probe.height));
            const c = document.createElement("canvas");
            c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(probe.width * scale));
            c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(probe.height * scale));
            const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
            ctx.drawImage(probe, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
            const out = c.toDataURL("image/jpeg", 0.85);
            q.insertEmbed(target.index, "image", out, "user");
          } catch (e) {
            q.insertEmbed(target.index, "image", dataUrl, "user");
          }
          q.setSelection(target.index + 1, 0);
        };
        probe.onerror = () => {
          q.insertEmbed(target.index, "image", dataUrl, "user");
          q.setSelection(target.index + 1, 0);
        };
        probe.src = dataUrl;
      }

      function bindSmartPaste(q) {
        q.root.addEventListener("paste", (e) => {
          const cb = e.clipboardData;
          if (!cb) return;

          /* Embeds optimized clipboard image as data URL */
          const img = [...(cb.items || [])].find((i) => i.type.startsWith("image/"));
          if (img) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const file = img.getAsFile();
            if (!file) return;
            const rd = new FileReader();
            rd.onload = () => {
              /* Canvas-based client-side image downscaling */
              const r = q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength() };
              insertImageSmart(q, rd.result, r);
            };
            rd.readAsDataURL(file);
            return;
          }

          /* Auto-link URLs pasted over an existing text selection */
          const txt = cb.getData("text/plain") || "";
          const r = q.getSelection();
          if (r && r.length > 0 && /^https?:\/\/\S+$/i.test(txt.trim())) {
            e.preventDefault();
            q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "link", txt.trim(), "user");
          }
        });
      }

      /* Slash Commands Menu Controller (/h1, /h2, /table, /callout, etc.) */
      const SLASH = [
        ["Heading 1", "h1", (q, i) => q.formatLine(i, 1, "header", 1)],
        ["Heading 2", "h2", (q, i) => q.formatLine(i, 1, "header", 2)],
        ["Heading 3", "h3", (q, i) => q.formatLine(i, 1, "header", 3)],
        ["Bulleted list", "ul", (q, i) => q.formatLine(i, 1, "list", "bullet")],
        ["Numbered list", "ol", (q, i) => q.formatLine(i, 1, "list", "ordered")],
        ["Checklist", "todo", (q, i) => q.formatLine(i, 1, "list", "unchecked")],
        ["Quote", "quote", (q, i) => q.formatLine(i, 1, "blockquote", true)],
        ["Code block", "code", (q, i) => q.formatLine(i, 1, "code-block", true)],
        ["Divider", "hr", (q, i) => q.insertEmbed(i, "hr", true, "user")],
        ["Table 3x3", "table", (q, i) => insertDocTable(q, { index: i }, 3, 3)],
        ["Date today", "date", (q, i) =>
          q.insertText(i, new Date().toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
            weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" }), "user")],
        ["Time now", "time", (q, i) =>
          q.insertText(i, new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }), "user")],
        /* Extended slash command definitions */
        ["Equation", "eqn", (q) => openEquation(q)],
        ["Callout", "box", (q, i) =>
          q.insertEmbed(i, "callout", { kind: "info", html: "<p>Type here…</p>" }, "user")],
        ["Page break", "page", (q, i) =>
          q.insertEmbed(i, "pagebreak", true, "user")],
      ];

      function bindSlashMenu(q) {
        /* Clears previous slash command menus */
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-slash").forEach((n) => n.remove());
        const menu = document.createElement("div");
        menu.className = "rt-slash";
        document.body.appendChild(menu);
        let open = false, at = 0, filter = "", idx = 0;

        const hide = () => {
          open = false;
          menu.classList.remove("on");
        };
        const paint = () => {
          const list = SLASH.filter(
            ([label, key]) =>
              !filter ||
              label.toLowerCase().includes(filter) ||
              key.startsWith(filter),
          );
          if (!list.length) return hide();
          idx = Math.min(idx, list.length - 1);
          menu.innerHTML = list
            .map(
              ([label, key], i) =>
                `<button type="button" class="rt-slash-i ${i === idx ? "on" : ""}" data-k="${key}">
                   <span>${label}</span><kbd>/${key}</kbd></button>`,
            )
            .join("");
          menu._list = list;
        };
        const run = (key) => {
          try {
            const hit = SLASH.find(([, k]) => k === key);
            if (!hit) return;
            const sel = q.getSelection();
            if (!sel) return;
            const [blot] = q.getLine(sel.index);
            if (!blot) return;
            const start = q.getIndex(blot);
            const text = blot.domNode.textContent || "";
            const slash = text.lastIndexOf("/");
            if (slash >= 0) q.deleteText(start + slash, text.length - slash, "user");
            /* Applies formatting at the line boundary */
            hit[2](q, start);
            hide();
            q.focus();
          } catch (err) {
            hide();
            docToast("Command failed: " + (err && err.message ? err.message : err), "warn");
          }
        };

        menu.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
          const b = e.target.closest(".rt-slash-i");
          if (!b) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          run(b.dataset.k);
        });

        q.on("text-change", (d, o, source) => {
          if (source !== "user") return;
          const sel = q.getSelection();
          if (!sel) return hide();
          const [blot] = q.getLine(sel.index);
          if (!blot) return hide();
          const text = blot.domNode.textContent || "";
          const m = text.match(/\/([a-z0-9]*)$/i);
          if (!m) return hide();
          filter = (m[1] || "").toLowerCase();
          idx = 0;
          at = sel.index;
          paint();
          const b = q.getBounds(sel.index);
          const rr = q.root.getBoundingClientRect();
          menu.style.left = Math.min(rr.left + b.left, window.innerWidth - 240) + "px";
          const top = rr.top + b.bottom + 6;
          menu.style.top =
            (top + 260 > window.innerHeight ? rr.top + b.top - 266 : top) + "px";
          open = true;
          menu.classList.add("on");
        });

        /* Executes highlighted slash command on Enter */
        docBind(document, "keydown", (e) => {
          if (!open || !q.root.contains(e.target)) return;
          const list = menu._list || [];
          if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (list.length) {
              idx = (idx + (e.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1) + list.length) % list.length;
              paint();
            }
          } else if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === "Tab") {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            const item = list[idx];
            if (item) run(item[1]);
            else hide();
          } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            hide();
          }
        }, true);
        q.on("selection-change", (r) => {
          if (!r) hide();
        });
      }

      /* Document Version History & Snapshot Engine */
      const docVersions = [];
      let versionTimer = 0;

      function snapshotDoc(q) {
        markDirty(); /* Marks draft dirty on content change */
        /* Captures target note key for debounced autosave */
        const key = histKeyForActiveNote();
        clearTimeout(versionTimer);
        versionTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
          const html = q.root.innerHTML;
          if (!html) return;
          const snap = { at: Date.now(), html };
          const list = key ? (docHistoryDB[key] || (docHistoryDB[key] = [])) : null;
          if (list) {
            const last = list[list.length - 1];
            if (!last || last.html !== html) {
              list.push(snap);
              if (list.length > 10) list.shift();
              persistHistoryKey(key);
            }
          }
          if (key && key === histKeyForActiveNote()) {
            docVersions.length = 0;
            (docHistoryDB[key] || []).forEach((v) => docVersions.push(v));
            if (docVersions.length > 30) docVersions.length = 30;
          }
        }, 4000);
        scheduleDraftSave(); /* Mirrors active draft to localStorage for recovery */
      }

      /* Draft State Tracking & Unsaved-Changes Guard */
      let draftDirty = false;
      let draftBaseHTML = "";

      function markDirty() {
        draftDirty = true;
      }
      function snapshotBase(html) {
        draftBaseHTML = html || "";
        draftDirty = false;
      }
      function isDirty() {
        if (!draftDirty || !quill) return false;
        const cur = quill.root.innerHTML;
        if (cur === draftBaseHTML) return false;
        if (typeof pkIsBlankHTML === "function" && pkIsBlankHTML(cur) && pkIsBlankHTML(draftBaseHTML))
          return false;
        return true;
      }

      /* Active document key being edited */
      function histKeyForActiveNote() {
        try {
          if (isMasterEditNote)
            return masterEditingKey ? "m:" + masterEditingKey + ":" + masterEditingIdx : null;
          if (isProjEdit) return "p:" + curProjIdx + ":" + editingProjDocIdx;
          if (isEdit) return "d:" + selKey + ":" + editingNoteIdx;
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
      }

      function persistDraft() {
        if (!quill) return;
        const html = quill.root.innerHTML;
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        try {
          if (isMasterEditNote) {
            if (!db[masterEditingKey]) db[masterEditingKey] = { bg: "#ffffff", pins: [], tasks: [], notes: [] };
            if (masterEditingIdx !== null && db[masterEditingKey].notes[masterEditingIdx]) {
              db[masterEditingKey].notes[masterEditingIdx].html = html;
              db[masterEditingKey].notes[masterEditingIdx].updatedAt = now;
            }
          } else if (isProjEdit) {
            const p = currentProj();
            if (p && editingProjDocIdx !== null && p.docs[editingProjDocIdx]) {
              p.docs[editingProjDocIdx].html = html;
              p.docs[editingProjDocIdx].updated = now;
            }
          } else if (isEdit && editingNoteIdx !== null && db[selKey] && db[selKey].notes[editingNoteIdx]) {
            db[selKey].notes[editingNoteIdx].html = html;
            db[selKey].notes[editingNoteIdx].updatedAt = now;
          } else {
            return; /* Standalone editing mode */
          }
        } catch (e) {
          return;
        }
        triggerDBSave();
        snapshotBase(html);
        setSaveStatus("Draft saved");
      }

      /* Prompts for confirmation before discarding modified draft */
      function confirmDiscard(onDiscard) {
        confirmLeaveEditor({ onDiscard });
      }

      /* Leave editor: Save / Discard / Keep editing (Undo is NOT this) */
      function confirmLeaveEditor({ onDiscard, onSave } = {}) {
        uiDialog({
          title: "Unsaved changes",
          message: "Save this document, discard what you typed, or keep editing? Undo in the toolbar only reverses the last keystroke — it does not close the editor.",
          variant: "leave",
          okLabel: "Save",
          okIcon: "save",
          cancelLabel: "Keep editing",
          cancelIcon: "keep",
          extraLabel: "Discard",
          extraIcon: "trash",
          extraDanger: true,
          danger: false,
          enterSubmits: false,
          onOk: () => {
            if (typeof onSave === "function") onSave();
            else if (isMasterEditNote) saveMasterNote();
            else if (isProjEdit) saveProjDoc();
            else saveNote();
          },
          onExtra: onDiscard,
        });
      }

      /* Persists document snapshot history to IndexedDB */
      const docHistoryDB = {};

      function loadHistoryForActiveNote() {
        const key = histKeyForActiveNote();
        docVersions.length = 0;
        if (!key || !idb || !idb.objectStoreNames || !idb.objectStoreNames.contains("history")) return;
        try {
          const tx = idb.transaction(["history"], "readonly");
          const req = tx.objectStore("history").get(key);
          req.onsuccess = () => {
            if (req.result && Array.isArray(req.result)) {
              docHistoryDB[key] = req.result;
              docVersions.length = 0;
              req.result.forEach((v) => docVersions.push(v));
            }
          };
        } catch (e) {
          /* Best-effort snapshot persistence */
        }
      }

      function persistHistoryKey(key) {
        if (!key || !idb || !idb.objectStoreNames || !idb.objectStoreNames.contains("history")) return;
        try {
          const tx = idb.transaction(["history"], "readwrite");
          tx.objectStore("history").put((docHistoryDB[key] || []).slice(-10), key);
        } catch (e) {
          /* Best-effort snapshot persistence */
        }
      }

      function persistHistory() {
        persistHistoryKey(histKeyForActiveNote());
      }

      /* Crash-Proof LocalStorage Draft Recovery */
      const DRAFT_PREFIX = "docDraft:";
      let draftSaveTimer = 0;

      function scheduleDraftSave() {
        clearTimeout(draftSaveTimer);
        draftSaveTimer = window.setTimeout(saveDraftNow, 2500);
      }

      function saveDraftNow() {
        if (!quill) return;
        const key = histKeyForActiveNote();
        if (!key) return;
        const html = quill.root.innerHTML;
        if (!html || html.length > 300000) return; /* Cleans up legacy draft entries from storage */
        try {
          safeStore.setItem(DRAFT_PREFIX + key, JSON.stringify({ html: html, at: Date.now() }));
        } catch (e) {
          /* Draft recovery storage handler */
        }
      }

      function clearDraftForActiveNote() {
        const key = histKeyForActiveNote();
        if (!key) return;
        try {
          safeStore.removeItem(DRAFT_PREFIX + key);
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      function recoverDraft() {
        if (!quill) return;
        const key = histKeyForActiveNote();
        if (!key) return;
        let stored = null;
        try {
          const raw = safeStore.getItem(DRAFT_PREFIX + key);
          if (raw) stored = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch (e) {}
        if (!stored || !stored.html) return;
        if (stored.html === quill.root.innerHTML) return; /* No stored crash recovery draft found */
        const when = stored.at
          ? new Date(stored.at).toLocaleString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })
          : "";
        showAppConfirm(
          "Recover draft?",
          "An unsaved draft from " + when + " was found for this document. Restore it?",
          () => {
            const safe = sanitizeDocHTML(stored.html);
            quill.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(0, safe, "silent");
            snapshotBase(quill.root.innerHTML);
            persistDraft();
            setSaveStatus("Draft restored");
          },
          { okLabel: "Restore", cancelLabel: "Ignore", danger: false },
        );
      }

      function openVersionHistory(q) {
        if (!docVersions.length) {
          showAppAlert("No history yet", "Snapshots are captured a few seconds after you stop typing, and survive reloads for this document.");
          return;
        }
        const host = document.createElement("div");
        host.className = "ui-modal";
        host.innerHTML = `<div class="ui-modal-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Version history">
            <div class="ui-modal-h">Version history</div>
            <div class="ui-modal-m">Restore any autosaved snapshot from this session.</div>
            <div class="rt-vlist">${docVersions
              .slice()
              .reverse()
              .map((v, i) => {
                const words = (v.html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").match(/\S+/g) || []).length;
                return `<button type="button" class="rt-v" data-i="${docVersions.length - 1 - i}">
                  <b>${new Date(v.at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" })}</b>
                  <span>${words} words</span></button>`;
              })
              .join("")}</div>
            <div class="ui-modal-a"><button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-ghost" data-x>Close</button></div>
          </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(host);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => host.classList.add("in"));
        const close = wireModal(host);
        host.querySelectorAll(".rt-v").forEach((b) =>
          b.addEventListener("click", () => {
            const v = docVersions[+b.dataset.i];
            q.setContents([]);
            q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(0, v.html);
            /* Restores snapshot into document note */
            persistDraft();
            snapshotBase(v.html);
            close();
            setSaveStatus("Version restored");
          }),
        );
      }

      /* Document Headings Outline Generator */
      function openDocOutline(q) {
        const heads = [...q.root.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6")];
        const host = document.createElement("div");
        host.className = "ui-modal";
        host.innerHTML = `<div class="ui-modal-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Outline">
            <div class="ui-modal-h">Document outline</div>
            ${
              heads.length
                ? `<div class="rt-outline">${heads
                    .map(
                      (h, i) =>
                        `<button type="button" class="rt-o l${h.tagName[1]}" data-i="${i}">${escapeHTMLText(h.textContent || "Untitled")}</button>`,
                    )
                    .join("")}</div>`
                : `<div class="ui-modal-m">No headings yet. Use Heading 1-6 to build an outline.</div>`
            }
            <div class="ui-modal-a"><button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-ghost" data-x>Close</button></div>
          </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(host);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => host.classList.add("in"));
        const close = wireModal(host);
        host.querySelectorAll(".rt-o").forEach((b) =>
          b.addEventListener("click", () => {
            heads[+b.dataset.i].scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
            close();
          }),
        );
      }

      /* Document Exporter (HTML, Markdown, Plain Text, Printable View) */
      function exportDoc(q, how) {
        const html = sanitizeDocHTML(q.root.innerHTML) + sanitizeDocHTML(layoutBoxesExportHTML()); /* F8 */
        const title = docTitleOf(html) || "document";
        if (how === "print") {
          const w = window.open("", "_blank");
          if (!w) return showAppAlert("Blocked", "Allow pop-ups to print or save as PDF.");
          /* Safely escapes closing tags in exported HTML documents */
          const C = (t) => "<" + "/" + t + ">";
          const doc =
            "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'>" +
            "<title>" + escapeHTMLText(title) + C("title") +
            "<style>" +
            "@page{size:" + (pageSetup.size === "custom" && pageSetup.customSize
              ? pageSetup.customSize.w + "in " + pageSetup.customSize.h + "in"
              : ((PAGE_SIZES[pageSetup.size] || PAGE_SIZES.a4).label) +
                (pageSetup.orient === "landscape" ? " landscape" : "")) +
            ";margin:" + marginExport() + ";" +
            (pageChrome.header ? "@top-center{content:\"" + pageChrome.header.replace(/"/g, "") + "\";font:9pt sans-serif;color:#666}" : "") +
            (pageChrome.footer || pageChrome.numbers ? "@bottom-center{content:\"" +
              (pageChrome.footer || "").replace(/"/g, "") +
              (pageChrome.numbers ? (pageChrome.footer ? "  ·  " : "") + "Page \" counter(page) \" of \" counter(pages) " : "") +
              "\";font:9pt sans-serif;color:#666}" : "") +
            "}" +
            "body{font-family:Georgia,serif;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;line-height:1.7;color:#111" +
            (pageSetup.columns > 1 ? ";column-count:" + pageSetup.columns +
              ";column-gap:" + pageSetup.colGap + "px" +
              (pageSetup.colLine ? ";column-rule:1px solid #999" : "") : "") + "}" +
            "h1,h2,h3{line-height:1.3}img{max-width:100%;page-break-inside:avoid}" +
            "table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;page-break-inside:auto}" +
            "td,th{border:1px solid #999;padding:6px 9px;page-break-inside:avoid}" +
            "tr{page-break-inside:avoid}" +
            "blockquote{border-left:3px solid #999;margin:0;padding-left:14px;color:#444}" +
            "pre{background:#f4f4f4;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;white-space:pre-wrap;page-break-inside:avoid}" +
            ".doc-pagebreak{page-break-after:always;border:0;height:0}" +
            ".doc-pagebreak span{display:none}" +
            ".doc-colbreak{page-break-after:always;border:0;height:0}" +
            ".doc-colbreak span{display:none}" +
            ".doc-toc{page-break-inside:avoid}" +
            ".doc-callout{border:1px solid #999;border-left:4px solid #4f46e5;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;margin:12px 0;page-break-inside:avoid}" +
            ".doc-toc a{display:block;text-decoration:none;color:#111;padding:2px 0}" +
            ".docbox{display:block;border:1px solid #999;border-radius:3px;padding:8px;margin:10px 0;page-break-inside:avoid}" +
            C("style") + C("head") +
            "<body>" + html + C("body") + C("html");
          w.document.write(doc);
          w.document.close();
          setTimeout(() => w.print(), 350);
          return;
        }
        let blob, ext;
        if (how === "md") {
          blob = new Blob([htmlToMarkdown(html)], { type: "text/markdown" });
          ext = "md";
        } else if (how === "txt") {
          blob = new Blob([docPlainPreview(html, 1e9)], { type: "text/plain" });
          ext = "txt";
        } else {
          blob = new Blob(
            [
              '<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><title>' +
                escapeHTMLText(title) +
                "<" + "/title>" +
                html,
            ],
            { type: "text/html" },
          );
          ext = "html";
        }
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = url;
        a.download = `${title.slice(0, 40).replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, "") || "document"}.${ext}`;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        a.remove();
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1500);
        setSaveStatus("Exported");
      }

      function htmlToMarkdown(html) {
        if (!html || typeof html !== "string") return "";
        const d = document.createElement("div");
        d.innerHTML = html;

        const walk = (n) => {
          let out = "";
          n.childNodes.forEach((c) => {
            if (c.nodeType === 3) {
              return (out += c.nodeValue);
            }
            if (c.nodeType !== 1) return;

            const t = c.tagName.toUpperCase();
            const cls = c.className || "";
            const inner = walk(c).trim();

            if (/^H[1-6]$/.test(t)) {
              const level = +t[1];
              out += `\n\n${"#".repeat(level)} ${inner}\n\n`;
            } else if (t === "STRONG" || t === "B") {
              out += inner ? `**${inner}**` : "";
            } else if (t === "EM" || t === "I") {
              out += inner ? `*${inner}*` : "";
            } else if (t === "U") {
              out += inner ? `<u>${inner}</u>` : "";
            } else if (t === "S" || t === "DEL" || t === "STRIKE") {
              out += inner ? `~~${inner}~~` : "";
            } else if (t === "SUP") {
              out += inner ? `<sup>${inner}</sup>` : "";
            } else if (t === "SUB") {
              out += inner ? `<sub>${inner}</sub>` : "";
            } else if (t === "CODE") {
              out += inner ? `\`${inner}\`` : "";
            } else if (t === "PRE" || cls.includes("ql-syntax")) {
              out += `\n\n\`\`\`\n${c.textContent.trim()}\n\`\`\`\n\n`;
            } else if (t === "BLOCKQUOTE" || cls.includes("doc-callout")) {
              const lines = (c.textContent || inner).trim().split("\n").map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
              let prefix = "> ";
              if (cls.includes("warn")) prefix = "> [!WARNING]\n> ";
              else if (cls.includes("tip")) prefix = "> [!TIP]\n> ";
              else if (cls.includes("info")) prefix = "> [!NOTE]\n> ";
              out += `\n\n${prefix}${lines.join("\n> ")}\n\n`;
            } else if (t === "UL" || t === "OL") {
              out += `\n\n${inner}\n\n`;
            } else if (t === "LI") {
              const dataList = c.getAttribute("data-list");
              if (dataList === "checked") {
                out += `\n- [x] ${inner}`;
              } else if (dataList === "unchecked") {
                out += `\n- [ ] ${inner}`;
              } else if (c.parentElement && c.parentElement.tagName === "OL") {
                out += `\n1. ${inner}`;
              } else {
                out += `\n- ${inner}`;
              }
            } else if (t === "A") {
              const href = c.getAttribute("href") || "#";
              out += `[${inner || href}](${href})`;
            } else if (t === "IMG") {
              const src = c.getAttribute("src") || "";
              const alt = c.getAttribute("alt") || "Image";
              out += `\n\n![${alt}](${src})\n\n`;
            } else if (t === "HR") {
              out += `\n\n---\n\n`;
            } else if (t === "BR") {
              out += `\n`;
            } else if (t === "TABLE" || cls.includes("doc-table")) {
              const rows = [...c.querySelectorAll("tr")];
              if (rows.length) {
                out += "\n\n";
                rows.forEach((r, i) => {
                  const cells = [...r.children].map((x) => x.textContent.replace(/\|/g, "\\|").trim());
                  out += `| ${cells.join(" | ")} |\n`;
                  if (i === 0) {
                    out += `| ${cells.map(() => "---").join(" | ")} |\n`;
                  }
                });
                out += "\n";
              }
            } else if (cls.includes("doc-caption")) {
              out += `\n\n*${inner}*\n\n`;
            } else if (cls.includes("doc-eq")) {
              out += ` $${inner}$ `;
            } else if (t === "P" || t === "DIV") {
              if (inner) out += `\n\n${inner}\n\n`;
            } else {
              out += inner;
            }
          });
          return out;
        };

        return walk(d)
          .split("\n")
          .map((line) => line.trimEnd())
          .join("\n")
          .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
          .trim();
      }

      /* Image Quick-Size & Alignment Overlay Bar */
      let imgBarEl = null;

      function hideImageQuickBar() {
        if (imgBarEl) {
          imgBarEl.remove();
          imgBarEl = null;
        }
      }

      function positionImageBar(img) {
        if (!imgBarEl) return;
        const r = img.getBoundingClientRect();
        imgBarEl.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(r.left + r.width / 2 - 110, window.innerWidth - 228)) + "px";
        imgBarEl.style.top = Math.max(8, r.top - 46) + "px";
      }

      function bindImageQuickBar(q) {
        const root = q.root;
        /* Editor change listener for image selection */
        if (root._imgBarBound) return;
        root._imgBarBound = true;
        const onMousedown = (e) => {
          const img = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest("img") : null;
          if (!img || !root.contains(img)) {
            hideImageQuickBar();
            return;
          }
          /* Ignores quick-bar clicks to maintain image focus */
          if (imgBarEl && imgBarEl.contains(e.target)) return;
          if (!imgBarEl) {
            imgBarEl = document.createElement("div");
            imgBarEl.className = "rt-imgbar";
            imgBarEl.setAttribute("role", "toolbar");
            imgBarEl.setAttribute("aria-label", "Image size");
            imgBarEl.innerHTML =
              ["L", "C", "R"]
                .map(
                  (a) =>
                    `<button type="button" data-align="${a}" data-tip="Align ${a === "L" ? "left" : a === "C" ? "centre" : "right"}" aria-label="Align ${a}">${a}</button>`,
                )
                .join("") +
              [
                ["Small", "40%"],
                ["Medium", "65%"],
                ["Large", "85%"],
                ["Full", "100%"],
              ]
                .map(
                  ([l, w]) =>
                    `<button type="button" data-w="${w}">${l}</button>`,
                )
                .join("");
            imgBarEl.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
              const b = ev.target.closest("button");
              if (!b) return;
              /* Applies size preset or alignment to selected image */
              if (b.dataset.align) {
                img.style.float = b.dataset.align === "C" ? "none" : b.dataset.align === "L" ? "left" : "right";
                img.style.display = b.dataset.align === "C" ? "block" : "inline";
                img.style.margin =
                  b.dataset.align === "L" ? "0 12px 8px 0"
                  : b.dataset.align === "R" ? "0 0 8px 12px"
                  : "0 auto";
                hideImageQuickBar();
                q.focus();
                return;
              }
              img.style.width = b.dataset.w;
              img.style.height = "auto";
              hideImageQuickBar();
              q.focus();
            });
            document.body.appendChild(imgBarEl);
          }
          imgBarEl._img = img;
          positionImageBar(img);
        };
        /* Binds lifecycle event listeners to editor root */
        root.addEventListener("mousedown", onMousedown);
        docBind(window, "scroll", () => {
          if (imgBarEl && imgBarEl._img && imgBarEl._img.isConnected) {
            positionImageBar(imgBarEl._img);
          } else hideImageQuickBar();
        }, true);
        docBind(window, "resize", () => hideImageQuickBar());
      }

      /* Hyperlink Quick Action Bar (Open / Edit / Remove) */
      let linkBarEl = null;

      function hideLinkTooltip() {
        if (linkBarEl) {
          linkBarEl.remove();
          linkBarEl = null;
        }
      }

      function positionLinkBar(a) {
        if (!linkBarEl || !a) return;
        const r = a.getBoundingClientRect();
        const bw = linkBarEl.offsetWidth || 180;
        linkBarEl.style.left =
          Math.max(8, Math.min(r.left + r.width / 2 - bw / 2, window.innerWidth - bw - 8)) + "px";
        linkBarEl.style.top = Math.max(8, r.top - 44) + "px";
      }

      /* Context Menu: Custom right-click & long-press action menu */
      let ctxMenuEl = null;
      function closeEditorContextMenu() {
        if (ctxMenuEl) {
          ctxMenuEl.remove();
          ctxMenuEl = null;
        }
      }

      function openEditorContextMenu(q, id, x, y, targetEl) {
        closeEditorContextMenu();
        const range = q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength(), length: 0 };
        const hasSel = range.length > 0;
        const fmt = q.getFormat(range);
        const cell = docActiveCell();
        const linkNode = targetEl && targetEl.closest ? targetEl.closest("a[href]") : null;
        const imgNode = targetEl && targetEl.closest ? targetEl.closest("img") : null;

        const items = [];
        if (imgNode) {
          items.push([
            "Image size & align…",
            () => imgNode.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("mousedown", { bubbles: true, clientX: x, clientY: y })),
          ]);
          items.push(null);
        }
