      function bindEditorContextMenu(q, id) {
        const root = q.root;
        if (root._ctxMenuBound) return;
        root._ctxMenuBound = true;

        root.addEventListener("contextmenu", (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          openEditorContextMenu(q, id, e.clientX, e.clientY, e.target);
        });

        /* Long-press touch gesture trigger for context menu */
        let pressTimer = null;
        let pressPt = null;
        root.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
          if (e.touches.length !== 1) return;
          const t = e.touches[0];
          pressPt = { x: t.clientX, y: t.clientY, target: e.target };
          pressTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            pressTimer = null;
            if (pressPt) openEditorContextMenu(q, id, pressPt.x, pressPt.y, pressPt.target);
          }, 500);
        }, { passive: true });
        const cancelPress = () => {
          if (pressTimer) clearTimeout(pressTimer);
          pressTimer = null;
          pressPt = null;
        };
        root.addEventListener("touchend", cancelPress, { passive: true });
        root.addEventListener("touchcancel", cancelPress, { passive: true });
        root.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
          if (!pressPt) return;
          const t = e.touches[0];
          if (Math.abs(t.clientX - pressPt.x) > 8 || Math.abs(t.clientY - pressPt.y) > 8) cancelPress();
        }, { passive: true });

        docBind(document, "mousedown", (e) => {
          if (ctxMenuEl && !ctxMenuEl.contains(e.target)) closeEditorContextMenu();
        });
        docBind(document, "keydown", (e) => {
          if (e.key === "Escape") closeEditorContextMenu();
        });
        docBind(window, "scroll", closeEditorContextMenu, true);
        docBind(window, "resize", closeEditorContextMenu);
      }

      /* Change Case Controller (Sentence case, lowercase, UPPERCASE, Title Case) */
      function transformCase(q, how) {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r || !r.length) {
          showAppAlert("Select some text", "Highlight the text you want to change first.");
          return;
        }
        const txt = q.getText(r.index, r.length);
        let out = txt;
        if (how === "upper") out = txt.toUpperCase();
        else if (how === "lower") out = txt.toLowerCase();
        else if (how === "title")
          out = txt.replace(/\w\S*/g, (w) => w[0].toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase());
        else if (how === "sentence")
          out = txt.toLowerCase().replace(/(^\s*\w|[.!?]\s+\w)/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
        else if (how === "toggle")
          out = txt.replace(/./g, (c) =>
            c === c.toUpperCase() ? c.toLowerCase() : c.toUpperCase(),
          );
        /* Preserves formatting ranges during case transformation */
        const fmts = q.getFormat(r);
        q.deleteText(r.index, r.length, "user");
        q.insertText(r.index, out, fmts, "user");
        q.setSelection(r.index, out.length);
      }

      /* Page Setup Configuration (Paper Size, Orientation, Margins, Columns) */
      const pageSetup = {
        size: safeStore.getItem("pgSize") || "a4",
        orient: safeStore.getItem("pgOrient") || "portrait",
        margin: safeStore.getItem("pgMargin") || "normal",
        columns: Number(safeStore.getItem("pgCols") || 1),
        lineNumbers: safeStore.getItem("pgLineNo") === "true",
        /* Word-style deep customization */
        marginCustom: (() => {
          try {

          } catch (e) { return { t: 96, b: 96, l: 96, r: 96 }; }
        })(),
        gutter: Number(safeStore.getItem("pgGutter") || 0),
        customSize: (() => {
          try {
            return JSON.parse(safeStore.getItem("pgCustomSize")) || null;
          } catch (e) { return null; }
        })(),
        colGap: Number(safeStore.getItem("pgColGap") || 34),
        colLine: safeStore.getItem("pgColLine") === "true",
        lineMode: safeStore.getItem("pgLineMode") || "page",
        /* Layout designer state (columns / rows / grid / free boxes) */
        layoutMode: safeStore.getItem("pgLayoutMode") || "single",
        rows: Number(safeStore.getItem("pgRows") || 1),
        rowGap: Number(safeStore.getItem("pgRowGap") || 20),
        colWidth: Number(safeStore.getItem("pgColWidth") || 0),
        colSpace: safeStore.getItem("pgColSpace") !== "false",
        colMargin: safeStore.getItem("pgColMargin") !== "false",
        boxes: (() => {
          try {
            return JSON.parse(safeStore.getItem("pgBoxes")) || [];
          } catch (e) { return []; }
        })(),
        /* Per-row / per-column sizes (inches) for rows & grid tracks */
        rowHeights: (() => {
          try {
            return JSON.parse(safeStore.getItem("pgRowHeights")) || [];
          } catch (e) { return []; }
        })(),
        colWidths: (() => {
          try {
            return JSON.parse(safeStore.getItem("pgColWidths")) || [];
          } catch (e) { return []; }
        })(),
      };
      /* Current paper incl. the user's custom size (inches -> px) */
      function currentPaper() {
        if (pageSetup.size === "custom" && pageSetup.customSize) {
          return {
            w: Math.round(pageSetup.customSize.w * 96),
            h: Math.round(pageSetup.customSize.h * 96),
            label: "Custom",
            inch:
              pageSetup.customSize.w.toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") +
              " \u00d7 " + pageSetup.customSize.h.toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, ""),
            mm: Math.round(pageSetup.customSize.w * 25.4) + " \u00d7 " + Math.round(pageSetup.customSize.h * 25.4),
          };
        }
        return PAGE_SIZES[pageSetup.size] || PAGE_SIZES.a4;
      }

      /* Real paper geometry: CSS pixels (96px = 1 inch), plus human-readable
         dimensions in inches and millimetres for the info displays. */
      const PAGE_SIZES = {
        a4: { w: 794, h: 1123, label: "A4", inch: "8.27 × 11.69", mm: "210 × 297" },
        letter: { w: 816, h: 1056, label: "Letter", inch: "8.5 × 11", mm: "216 × 279" },
        legal: { w: 816, h: 1344, label: "Legal", inch: "8.5 × 14", mm: "216 × 356" },
        a5: { w: 559, h: 794, label: "A5", inch: "5.83 × 8.27", mm: "148 × 210" },
      };
      /* Word-standard margins: Narrow 0.5", Normal 1", Wide 1.25" */
      /* Word-standard margins per side (px, 96px = 1 inch):
         Normal 1" all sides | Narrow 0.5" all sides | Moderate 1" top/bottom
         0.75" sides | Wide 1" top/bottom 1.25" sides. */
      const PAGE_MARGINS = {
        narrow: { t: 48, b: 48, l: 48, r: 48 },
        normal: { t: 96, b: 96, l: 96, r: 96 },
        moderate: { t: 96, b: 96, l: 72, r: 72 },
        wide: { t: 96, b: 96, l: 120, r: 120 },
      };
      const PAGE_MARGIN_IN = { narrow: "0.5", moderate: "0.75", normal: "1.0", wide: "1.25" };
      /* Returns the current margin box {t,r,b,l} in px, including the gutter
         (binding space) on the left, exactly like Word's Gutter setting. */
      function marginBox() {
        const base =
          PAGE_MARGINS[pageSetup.margin] || { t: 96, b: 96, l: 96, r: 96 };
        if (pageSetup.margin === "custom" && pageSetup.marginCustom) {
          const c = pageSetup.marginCustom;
          return {
            t: c.t || 96,
            b: c.b || 96,
            l: (c.l || 96) + (pageSetup.gutter || 0),
            r: c.r || 96,
          };
        }
        return {
          t: base.t,
          b: base.b,
          l: base.l + (pageSetup.gutter || 0),
          r: base.r,
        };
      }
      function marginExport() {
        const b = marginBox();
        return (
          (b.t / 96).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") + "in " +
          (b.r / 96).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") + "in " +
          (b.b / 96).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") + "in " +
          (b.l / 96).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") + "in"
        );
      }
      function marginLabel(m) {
        const b = marginBox();
        if (m === "custom")
          return (
            "Custom L " + (b.l / 96).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") +
            " \u00b7 R " + (b.r / 96).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") +
            " \u00b7 T " + (b.t / 96).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") +
            " \u00b7 B " + (b.b / 96).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") + " in" +
            (pageSetup.gutter ? " (+" + (pageSetup.gutter / 96).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") + " gutter)" : "")
          );
        return (PAGE_MARGIN_IN[m] || "1.0") + " in";
      }

      /* Builds accurate inch-scale ticks for the horizontal ruler (width) and
         the vertical ruler (height), with shaded margin zones. 96px = 1 inch,
         so every paper size maps to real inches (A4 = 8.27" wide, etc.). */
      function buildRulerTicks(inner, vR, sh) {
        const zs = getComputedStyle(sh);
        const zoom = parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--doc-zoom")) || 1;
        const pw = (parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--pg-w")) || 794) * zoom;
        const ph = (parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--pg-h")) || 1123) * zoom;
        const mL = (parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--pg-ml")) || 96) * zoom;
        const mR = (parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--pg-mr")) || 96) * zoom;
        const mT = (parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--pg-mt")) || 96) * zoom;
        const mB = (parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--pg-mb")) || 96) * zoom;
        const IN = 96 * zoom; /* one real inch on screen */
        const inches = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(pw / IN));
        let t = "";
        let v = "";
        for (let i = 0; i <= inches; i++) {
          const x = Math.round(i * IN);
          t += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-major" style="left:' + x + 'px"></span>';
          t += '<span class="rt-tick-num" style="left:' + x + 'px">' + i + "</span>";
          if (i < inches) {
            t += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-mid" style="left:' + Math.round(x + IN / 2) + 'px"></span>';
            t += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-minor" style="left:' + Math.round(x + IN / 4) + 'px"></span>';
            t += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-minor" style="left:' + Math.round(x + (3 * IN) / 4) + 'px"></span>';
            if (IN >= 84) {
              t += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-tiny" style="left:' + Math.round(x + IN / 8) + 'px"></span>';
              t += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-tiny" style="left:' + Math.round(x + (3 * IN) / 8) + 'px"></span>';
              t += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-tiny" style="left:' + Math.round(x + (5 * IN) / 8) + 'px"></span>';
              t += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-tiny" style="left:' + Math.round(x + (7 * IN) / 8) + 'px"></span>';
            }
          }
        }
        t += '<div class="rt-rm rt-rm-l" style="left:0;width:' + Math.round(mL) + 'px"></div>';
        t += '<div class="rt-rm rt-rm-r" style="left:' + Math.round(pw - mR) + 'px;width:' + Math.round(mR) + 'px"></div>';
        const vIn = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(ph / IN));
        for (let i = 0; i <= vIn; i++) {
          const y = Math.round(i * IN);
          v += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-major" style="top:' + y + 'px"></span>';
          v += '<span class="rt-tick-num" style="top:' + y + 'px">' + i + "</span>";
          if (i < vIn) {
            v += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-mid" style="top:' + Math.round(y + IN / 2) + 'px"></span>';
            v += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-minor" style="top:' + Math.round(y + IN / 4) + 'px"></span>';
            v += '<span class="rt-tick rt-tick-minor" style="top:' + Math.round(y + (3 * IN) / 4) + 'px"></span>';
          }
        }
        v += '<div class="rt-rm rt-rm-l" style="top:0;height:' + Math.round(mT) + 'px"></div>';
        v += '<div class="rt-rm rt-rm-r" style="top:' + Math.round(ph - mB) + 'px;height:' + Math.round(mB) + 'px"></div>';
        inner.innerHTML = t;
        vR.innerHTML = v;
      }

      function applyPageSetup() {
        const p = currentPaper();
        const w = pageSetup.orient === "landscape" ? p.h : p.w;
        const h = pageSetup.orient === "landscape" ? p.w : p.h;
        const mb = marginBox();
        /* Legacy callers that only set columns>1 (Page Setup chips, columns
           select) behave as a columns layout. */
        const effMode =
          pageSetup.layoutMode === "single" && pageSetup.columns > 1
            ? "columns"
            : pageSetup.layoutMode;
        /* Custom column width (inches): shrink the text flow area so the
           browser lays out exactly N columns of that width, centred. */
        let colW = 0;
        let insetL = 0;
        let insetR = 0;
        if (effMode === "columns" && pageSetup.columns > 1 && pageSetup.colWidth > 0) {
          const gap = pageSetup.colSpace ? pageSetup.colGap : 0;
          const contentW = w - mb.l - mb.r;
          const flowW = pageSetup.columns * pageSetup.colWidth * 96 + (pageSetup.columns - 1) * gap;
          const effW =
            flowW > contentW
              ? Math.max(60, (contentW - (pageSetup.columns - 1) * gap) / pageSetup.columns)
              : pageSetup.colWidth * 96;
          colW = effW;
          const usedW = effW * pageSetup.columns + (pageSetup.columns - 1) * gap;
          insetL = insetR = Math.max(0, (contentW - usedW) / 2);
        }
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-w", w + "px");
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-h", h + "px");
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-mt", mb.t + "px");
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-mr", mb.r + "px");
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-mb", mb.b + "px");
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-ml", mb.l + "px");
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-m", mb.l + "px");
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-m-eff", mb.l + "px");
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-cols", pageSetup.columns);
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-col-gap", (pageSetup.colSpace ? pageSetup.colGap : 0) + "px");
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-col-w", colW + "px");
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-inset-l", insetL + "px");
          sh.style.setProperty("--pg-inset-r", insetR + "px");
          /* "Column margins" off = text spans the full paper width */
          sh.style.setProperty(
            "--pg-col-ml",
            (effMode === "columns" && !pageSetup.colMargin ? 0 : mb.l) + "px",
          );
          sh.style.setProperty(
            "--pg-col-mr",
            (effMode === "columns" && !pageSetup.colMargin ? 0 : mb.r) + "px",
          );
          sh.classList.toggle("cols-multi", effMode === "columns" && pageSetup.columns > 1);
          sh.classList.toggle("cols-line", effMode === "columns" && pageSetup.colLine && pageSetup.columns > 1);
          sh.classList.toggle("col-w", colW > 0);
          sh.classList.toggle("show-lineno", pageSetup.lineNumbers);
        });
        safeStore.setItem("pgSize", pageSetup.size);
        safeStore.setItem("pgOrient", pageSetup.orient);
        safeStore.setItem("pgMargin", pageSetup.margin);
        safeStore.setItem("pgCols", pageSetup.columns);
        safeStore.setItem("pgLineNo", pageSetup.lineNumbers);
        safeStore.setItem("pgMarginCustom", JSON.stringify(pageSetup.marginCustom));
        safeStore.setItem("pgGutter", String(pageSetup.gutter || 0));
        safeStore.setItem("pgCustomSize", JSON.stringify(pageSetup.customSize));
        safeStore.setItem("pgColGap", String(pageSetup.colGap));
        safeStore.setItem("pgColLine", String(!!pageSetup.colLine));
        safeStore.setItem("pgLineMode", pageSetup.lineMode);
        safeStore.setItem("pgLayoutMode", pageSetup.layoutMode);
        safeStore.setItem("pgRows", String(pageSetup.rows));
        safeStore.setItem("pgRowGap", String(pageSetup.rowGap));
        safeStore.setItem("pgColWidth", String(pageSetup.colWidth));
        safeStore.setItem("pgColSpace", String(!!pageSetup.colSpace));
        safeStore.setItem("pgColMargin", String(!!pageSetup.colMargin));
        safeStore.setItem("pgBoxes", JSON.stringify(serializeBoxes()));
        safeStore.setItem("pgRowHeights", JSON.stringify(pageSetup.rowHeights || []));
        safeStore.setItem("pgColWidths", JSON.stringify(pageSetup.colWidths || []));
        renderLineNumbers();
        refreshRulerSync();
        renderLayoutBoxes();
        updatePageNav();
        /* Live previews stay in sync no matter who changed the page setup */
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-preview], [data-psetprev]").forEach((el) => {
          if (typeof renderPagePreview === "function") renderPagePreview(el);
        });

      /* Keeps the effective margin in sync when rotating / resizing across
         the 640px breakpoint (narrow screens clamp the margins). */
      if (!window.__pgSetupResizeBound) {

        window.addEventListener("resize", () => {

      /* Document Line Numbers Gutter Controller */
      let linenoRaf = 0;
      function renderLineNumbers() {
        /* Batches line numbering layout updates inside animation frame */
        if (linenoRaf) return;
        linenoRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          linenoRaf = 0;
          doRenderLineNumbers();
        });
      }

      function doRenderLineNumbers() {
        /* Line numbers visibility check */
        if (pageSetup.columns > 1) {
          document.querySelectorAll(".rt-lineno").forEach((g) => g.remove());
          return;
        }
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell.show-lineno").forEach((sh) => {
          const ed = sh.querySelector(".ql-editor");
          if (!ed) return;
          let g = sh.querySelector(".rt-lineno");
          if (!g) {
            g = document.createElement("div");
            g.className = "rt-lineno";
            ed.parentNode.appendChild(g);
          }
          const zs = getComputedStyle(sh);
          const zoom = parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--doc-zoom")) || 1;
          const ph = (parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--pg-h")) || 1123) * zoom;
          /* In Page mode the numbering restarts on every page (like Word's
             "Restart each page"); elsewhere it is continuous. */
          const perPage = docMode === "page" && pageSetup.lineMode === "page" && ph > 0;
          const edR = ed.getBoundingClientRect();
          const pageCounts = {};
          let lineNo = 0;
          const spans = [];
          [...ed.children].forEach((b) => {
            const r = b.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (r.height <= 0) return;
            /* Measure the block's real line boxes - one number per rendered
               line, not per paragraph. */
            const range = document.createRange();
            range.selectNodeContents(b);
            const rects = [...range.getClientRects()];
            const tops = [...new Set(rects.map((x) => Math.round(x.top)))].sort((a, b2) => a - b2);
            tops.forEach((t) => {
              const lineTop = r.top - edR.top + ed.scrollTop + (t - r.top);
              lineNo++;
              let num = lineNo;
              if (perPage) {
                const pg = Math.max(0, Math.floor(lineTop / ph));
                pageCounts[pg] = (pageCounts[pg] || 0) + 1;
                num = pageCounts[pg];
              }
              spans.push('<span style="top:' + Math.round(lineTop) + 'px">' + num + "</span>");
            });
          });
          g.innerHTML = spans.join("");
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell:not(.show-lineno) .rt-lineno").forEach((g) => g.remove());
      }

      /**

       * Responsibilities: Underline gallery, text effects, style presets, format painter,

      /* Underline Gallery Formatter */
      const UNDERLINE_STYLES = [
        ["solid", "Single", "underline"],
        ["double", "Double", "underline"],
        ["dotted", "Dotted", "underline"],
        ["dashed", "Dashed", "underline"],
        ["wavy", "Wavy", "underline"],
      ];

      function applyUnderline(q, style, colour) {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r) return;
        if (style === "none") {
          q.format("underline", false);
          q.format("deco", false);
          q.format("ustyle", false);
          q.format("ucolor", false);
          return;
        }
        /* Applies custom underline style attributor */
        q.format("underline", true);
        q.format("deco", "underline");
        q.format("ustyle", style);
        if (colour) q.format("ucolor", colour);
      }

      /* Double Strikethrough Formatter */
      function applyDoubleStrike(q) {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r) return;
        const cur = q.getFormat(r);
        /* Applies double line-through formatting */
        const on = cur.deco === "line-through" && cur.ustyle === "double";
        q.format("deco", on ? false : "line-through", "user");
        q.format("ustyle", on ? false : "double", "user");
      }

      /* Text Effects Formatter */
      const TEXT_EFFECTS = [
        ["", "None"],
        ["shadow", "Shadow"],
        ["outline", "Outline"],
        ["glow", "Glow"],
        ["emboss", "Emboss"],
        ["gradient", "Gradient"],
      ];

      /* Document Style Gallery Presets (Title, Subtitle, Heading 1/2, Quote) */
      const DOC_STYLES = [
        ["normal", "Normal", {}],
        ["title", "Title", { header: false, size: "48px", bold: true, align: "center" }],
        ["subtitle", "Subtitle", { header: false, size: "24px", italic: true, color: "#64748b", align: "center" }],
        ["h1", "Heading 1", { header: 1 }],
        ["h2", "Heading 2", { header: 2 }],
        ["h3", "Heading 3", { header: 3 }],
        ["quote", "Quote", { blockquote: true, italic: true }],
        ["intense", "Intense Quote", { blockquote: true, bold: true, color: "#4f46e5", align: "center" }],

        ["strong", "Strong", { bold: true }],
        ["nospace", "No Spacing", { lineheight: "1", spbefore: "0px", spafter: "0px" }],

      function applyDocStyle(q, key) {
        const hit = DOC_STYLES.find((x) => x[0] === key);
        if (!hit) return;
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r) return;
        /* Resets block format before applying style preset */
        ["header", "blockquote", "code-block", "align", "lineheight", "spbefore", "spafter"].forEach(
          (f) => q.format(f, false, "user"),
        );
        if (r.length)
          ["bold", "italic", "underline", "strike", "color", "size", "deco", "ustyle"].forEach((f) =>
            q.formatText(r.index, r.length, f, false, "user"),
          );
        Object.entries(hit[2]).forEach(([k, v]) => q.format(k, v, "user"));
        updateDocStats();
      }

      /* Format Painter Tool (Copies and applies formatting) */
      let paintedFormat = null;
      let painterPersistent = false;
      let painterCleanup = null;
      let painterSelectTimer = null;
      let lastPainterClickTime = 0;

      const INLINE_FORMAT_KEYS = [
        "bold", "italic", "underline", "strike", "color", "background", "size", "font", "script",
        "ustyle", "ucolor", "deco", "uextra", "tracking", "textfx", "caps", "allcaps",
        "hiddentext", "scalex", "vpos", "otf", "kern", "dstrike", "tracked", "equation"
      ];

      const BLOCK_FORMAT_KEYS = [
        "align", "direction", "lineheight", "header", "blockquote", "code-block",
        "list", "shading", "pborder", "spbefore", "spafter", "numfmt", "bulletchar", "caption"
      ];

      function clearFormatPainter() {
        if (typeof painterCleanup === "function") {
          painterCleanup();
          painterCleanup = null;
        }
        clearTimeout(painterSelectTimer);
        paintedFormat = null;
        painterPersistent = false;
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-b[data-act='painter']").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("is-on", "on"));
        document.querySelectorAll(".ql-editor").forEach((el) => el.classList.remove("rt-painting"));
      }

      function applyFormatToRange(q, range) {
        if (!range || !paintedFormat) return false;

        let targetRange = range;
        if (range.length === 0) {
          const text = q.getText();
          let start = range.index;
          let end = range.index;
          while (start > 0 && /\S/.test(text[start - 1]) && text[start - 1] !== String.fromCharCode(10)) {
            start--;
          }
          while (end < text.length && /\S/.test(text[end]) && text[end] !== String.fromCharCode(10)) {
            end++;
          }
          if (end > start) {
            targetRange = { index: start, length: end - start };
          } else {
            return false;
          }
        }

        if (targetRange.length <= 0) return false;

        INLINE_FORMAT_KEYS.forEach((f) => {
          q.formatText(targetRange.index, targetRange.length, f, false, "user");
        });

        Object.entries(paintedFormat).forEach(([k, v]) => {
          if (INLINE_FORMAT_KEYS.includes(k) && v !== undefined && v !== false) {
            q.formatText(targetRange.index, targetRange.length, k, v, "user");
          }
        });

        Object.entries(paintedFormat).forEach(([k, v]) => {
          if (BLOCK_FORMAT_KEYS.includes(k) && v !== undefined && v !== false) {
            q.formatLine(targetRange.index, targetRange.length, k, v, "user");
          }
        });

        if (typeof updateDocStats === "function") updateDocStats();
        return true;
      }

      function toggleFormatPainter(q, btn, forcePersistent = false) {
        if (paintedFormat && !forcePersistent) {
          clearFormatPainter();
          docToast("Format painter off");
          return;
        }

        let r = q.getSelection();
        let fmt = null;

        if (r && r.length > 0) {
          fmt = q.getFormat(r);
        } else if (r) {
          fmt = q.getFormat(r.index, 1);
          if (!fmt || Object.keys(fmt).length === 0) {
            fmt = q.getFormat(Math.max(0, r.index - 1), 1);
          }
        }

        if (!fmt || Object.keys(fmt).length === 0) {
          fmt = q.getFormat();
        }

        if (!fmt || Object.keys(fmt).length === 0) {
          docToast("Select or place cursor on formatted text first", "warn");
          return;
        }

        paintedFormat = Object.assign({}, fmt);
        painterPersistent = forcePersistent;

        if (btn) btn.classList.add("is-on", "on");
        q.root.classList.add("rt-painting");

        if (typeof painterCleanup === "function") painterCleanup();

        const activatedAt = Date.now();

        const tryApply = () => {
          if (!paintedFormat || Date.now() - activatedAt < 200) return;
          setTimeout(() => {
            const sel = q.getSelection();
            if (!sel) return;
            const didApply = applyFormatToRange(q, sel);
            if (didApply) {
              docToast("Formatting applied");
              if (!painterPersistent) {
                clearFormatPainter();
              }
            }
          }, 40);
        };

        const onMouseUp = (e) => {
          if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".rt-ribbon, .rt-dock, .rt-modal")) return;
          tryApply();
        };

        const onTouchEnd = (e) => {
          if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".rt-ribbon, .rt-dock, .rt-modal")) return;
          tryApply();
        };

        const onSelectionChange = (range) => {
          if (range && range.length > 0 && Date.now() - activatedAt >= 200) {
            clearTimeout(painterSelectTimer);
            painterSelectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
              if (!paintedFormat) return;
              const currentSel = q.getSelection();
              if (currentSel && currentSel.length > 0) {
                const didApply = applyFormatToRange(q, currentSel);
                if (didApply) {
                  docToast("Formatting applied");
                  if (!painterPersistent) {
                    clearFormatPainter();
                  }
                }
              }
            }, 180);
          }
        };

        const onKeyUp = (e) => {
          if (e.key === "Escape") {
            clearFormatPainter();
            docToast("Format painter off");
            return;
          }
          if (e.shiftKey && (e.key.startsWith("Arrow") || e.key === "Home" || e.key === "End")) {
            tryApply();
          }
        };

        document.addEventListener("mouseup", onMouseUp);
        document.addEventListener("touchend", onTouchEnd);
        document.addEventListener("keyup", onKeyUp);
        q.on("selection-change", onSelectionChange);

        painterCleanup = () => {
          clearTimeout(painterSelectTimer);
          document.removeEventListener("mouseup", onMouseUp);
          document.removeEventListener("touchend", onTouchEnd);
          document.removeEventListener("keyup", onKeyUp);
          q.off("selection-change", onSelectionChange);
        };

        docToast(
          painterPersistent
            ? "Format painter locked on. Select text or tap words to apply (Esc to exit)"
            : "Format copied. Select text or tap a word to apply"
        );
      }

      /* Bullet & Numbering Format Libraries */
      const BULLET_CHARS = ["•", "◦", "▪", "▸", "–", "✦", "✔", "➔", "★"];
      const NUMBER_FORMATS = [
        ["decimal", "1. 2. 3."],
        ["lower-alpha", "a. b. c."],
        ["upper-alpha", "A. B. C."],
        ["lower-roman", "i. ii. iii."],
        ["upper-roman", "I. II. III."],
      ];

      function applyBulletChar(q, ch) {
        /* Applies custom bullet glyph attribute */
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r) return docToast("Place the cursor in a list first", "warn");
        q.format("list", "bullet", "user");
        setTimeout(() => {
          const sel = q.getSelection();
          if (!sel) return;
          const [blot] = q.getLine(sel.index);
          const ul = blot && blot.domNode ? blot.domNode.closest("ul") : null;
          if (!ul) return;
          ul.querySelectorAll(":scope > li").forEach((li) => {
            const liBlot = Quill.find(li);
            if (!liBlot) return;
            const idx = q.getIndex(liBlot);
            q.formatLine(idx, 1, "bulchar", ch, "user");
          });
        }, 10);
      }

      /* Maps numbering format choice to attributor */
      const NUMFMT_VALUE = {
        decimal: false,
        "lower-alpha": "alpha",
        "upper-alpha": "Alpha",
        "lower-roman": "roman",
        "upper-roman": "Roman",
      };

      function applyNumberFormat(q, fmt) {
        /* Applies custom numbering format attribute */
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r) return docToast("Place the cursor in a list first", "warn");
        q.format("list", "ordered", "user");
        const val = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(NUMFMT_VALUE, fmt)
          ? NUMFMT_VALUE[fmt]
          : fmt;
        setTimeout(() => {
          const sel = q.getSelection();
          if (!sel) return;
          const [blot] = q.getLine(sel.index);
          const ol = blot && blot.domNode ? blot.domNode.closest("ol") : null;
          if (!ol) return;
          /* Applies list format across continuous list blocks */
          ol.querySelectorAll(":scope > li").forEach((li) => {
            const liBlot = Quill.find(li);
            if (!liBlot) return;
            const idx = q.getIndex(liBlot);
            q.formatLine(idx, 1, "numfmt", val, "user");
          });
        }, 10);
      }

      /* Formatting Marks Toggle (Pilcrow & spaces) */
      let showMarks = false;
      function toggleFormattingMarks() {
        showMarks = !showMarks;
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) =>
          sh.classList.toggle("show-marks", showMarks),
        );
      }

      /* Alphabetical Line Sorting Tool */
      function sortSelection(q, dir) {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r || !r.length) {
          showAppAlert("Select some lines", "Highlight the lines or list you want to sort.");
          return;
        }
        const text = q.getText(r.index, r.length);
        const lines = text.split("\n").filter((l) => l.trim() !== "");
        lines.sort((a, b) =>
          dir === "desc" ? b.localeCompare(a) : a.localeCompare(b),
        );
        q.deleteText(r.index, r.length, "user");
        q.insertText(r.index, lines.join("\n") + "\n", "user");
        q.setSelection(r.index, lines.join("\n").length);
      }

      /* Drop Cap Formatter */
      function toggleDropCap(q) {
        const sel = q.getSelection();
        if (!sel) return;
        const [blot] = q.getLine(sel.index);
        if (!blot || !blot.domNode) return;
        blot.domNode.classList.toggle("doc-dropcap");
      }

      /* Text-to-Speech Read Aloud Synthesizer */
      let speaking = false;
      function toggleReadAloud(q) {
        if (!("speechSynthesis" in window)) {
          showAppAlert("Not supported", "This browser cannot read text aloud.");
          return;
        }
        if (speaking) {
          speechSynthesis.cancel();
          speaking = false;
          docToast("Reading stopped");
          return;
        }
        const sel = q.getSelection();
        const text =
          sel && sel.length ? q.getText(sel.index, sel.length) : q.getText();
        if (!text.trim()) return docToast("Nothing to read", "warn");
        docToast("Reading aloud…");
        const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
        u.rate = 1;
        u.onend = () => (speaking = false);
        speaking = true;
        speechSynthesis.speak(u);
        setSaveStatus("Reading aloud…");
      }

      function setWatermark(q) {

      const PAGE_COLOURS = ["#ffffff", "#fffbeb", "#f0fdf4", "#eff6ff", "#fdf2f8", "#f8fafc", "#1e293b"];
      function setPageColour(c) {
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
          sh.style.setProperty("--page-bg", c);
          sh.classList.toggle("dark-page", c === "#1e293b");
        });
      }

      /* Top Ruler Display Toggle */
      let showRuler = false;
      function toggleRuler() {
        showRuler = !showRuler;
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
          sh.classList.toggle("show-ruler", showRuler);
          let r = sh.querySelector(".rt-ruler");
          const surf = sh.querySelector(".rt-surface");
          if (showRuler && !r && surf) {
            r = document.createElement("div");
            r.className = "rt-ruler";
            const inner = document.createElement("div");
            inner.className = "rt-ruler-inner";
            r.appendChild(inner);
            /* Vertical (height) ruler pinned to the left edge of the paper,
               inside the scrolling surface so it pans with the page. */
            const vR = document.createElement("div");
            vR.className = "rt-ruler-v";
            surf.appendChild(vR);
            /* Keeps both rulers glued to the paper: horizontal ticks follow
               the paper's left offset and the surface's horizontal scroll;
               the vertical ruler follows the paper's position in the
               surface's scroll coordinates. */
            const sync = () => {
              const pEl = sh.querySelector(".ql-container");
              if (!pEl || !surf) return;
              const off = Math.max(
                0,
                pEl.getBoundingClientRect().left +
                  surf.scrollLeft -
                  r.getBoundingClientRect().left,
              );
              inner.style.marginLeft = off + "px";
              r.scrollLeft = surf.scrollLeft;
              const pRect = pEl.getBoundingClientRect();
              const sRect = surf.getBoundingClientRect();
              vR.style.left = pRect.left - sRect.left + surf.scrollLeft - 24 + "px";
              vR.style.top = pRect.top - sRect.top + surf.scrollTop + "px";
              vR.style.height = pRect.height + "px";
            };
            const rebuild = () => {
              buildRulerTicks(inner, vR, sh);
              sync();
            };
            r._sync = sync;
            r._rebuild = rebuild;
            r._surf = surf;
            r._vR = vR;
            surf.addEventListener("scroll", sync, { passive: true });
            window.addEventListener("resize", sync);
            sh.querySelector(".rt-surface").before(r);
            requestAnimationFrame(rebuild);
          } else if (!showRuler && r) {
            if (r._sync && r._surf) {
              r._surf.removeEventListener("scroll", r._sync);
              window.removeEventListener("resize", r._sync);
            }
            if (r._vR) r._vR.remove();
            r.remove();
          }
        });
      }

      /* Footnote Inserter */
      let footnoteN = 0;
      function insertFootnote(q) {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r) return docToast("Place the cursor where the footnote goes", "warn");
        footnoteN++;
        q.insertText(r.index, `[${footnoteN}]`, { script: "super", color: "#4f46e5" }, "user");
        const end = q.getLength();
        q.insertText(end - 1, `\n[${footnoteN}] Footnote text…`, { size: "12px", color: "#64748b" }, "user");
        q.setSelection(r.index + 3, 0);
        docToast("Footnote added");
      }


      /**
       * Module: Advanced Document Structures
       * Responsibilities: Table of contents generator, captions, comments sidebar,
       * track changes engine, proofing & readability, navigation pane, equations, and charts.
       */

      /* Table of Contents Generator */
      function insertTOC(q) {
        const heads = [...q.root.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6")];
        if (!heads.length) {
          showAppAlert(
            "No headings found",
            "Apply Heading 1-6 to some lines first; the table of contents is built from them.",
          );
          return;
        }
        let html = '<div class="doc-toc" contenteditable="false"><div class="doc-toc-h">Contents</div>';
        heads.forEach((h, i) => {
          const lvl = +h.tagName[1];
          if (!h.id) h.id = "hd-" + i;
          html += `<a class="doc-toc-i l${lvl}" href="#${h.id}" data-jump="${h.id}">
              <span>${escapeHTMLText(h.textContent || "Untitled")}</span><i></i></a>`;
        });
        html += "</div>";
        /* Inserts Table of Contents block embed */
        const r = q.getSelection() || { index: 0 };
        q.insertEmbed(r.index, "doctoc", { html }, "user");
        q.setSelection(r.index + 1, 0);
        setSaveStatus("Contents inserted");
      }

      /* Table of Contents item navigation click handler */
      document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const jump = e.target.closest("[data-jump]");
        if (!jump) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const t = document.getElementById(jump.dataset.jump);
        if (t) t.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
      });

      /* Captions and Bookmarks Inserters */
      let captionN = { Figure: 0, Table: 0, Equation: 0 };

      function insertCaption(q, kind) {
        captionN[kind] = (captionN[kind] || 0) + 1;
        const r = q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength() - 1 };
        const label = `${kind} ${captionN[kind]}: caption text`;
        q.insertText(r.index, "\n" + label, "user");
        q.formatLine(r.index + 1, 1, "caption", true, "user");
        q.setSelection(r.index + 1 + label.length, 0);
      }

      const bookmarks = [];
      function addBookmark(q) {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r) return;
        uiDialog({
          title: "Add bookmark",
          fields: [{ label: "Name", value: "", placeholder: "Introduction" }],
          okLabel: "Add",
          onOk: (v) => {
            if (!v[0]) return;
            bookmarks.push({ name: v[0], index: r.index });
            setSaveStatus("Bookmark added");
          },
        });
      }

      function openBookmarks(q) {
        if (!bookmarks.length) {
          showAppAlert("No bookmarks", "Place the cursor somewhere and use Bookmark to add one.");
          return;
        }
        const host = document.createElement("div");
        host.className = "ui-modal";
        host.innerHTML = `<div class="ui-modal-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Bookmarks">
            <div class="ui-modal-h">Bookmarks</div>
            <div class="rt-vlist">${bookmarks
              .map((b, i) => `<button type="button" class="rt-v" data-i="${i}"><b>${escapeHTMLText(b.name)}</b><span>position ${b.index}</span></button>`)
              .join("")}</div>
            <div class="ui-modal-a"><button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-ghost" data-x>Close</button></div>
          </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(host);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => host.classList.add("in"));
        const close = wireModal(host);
        host.querySelectorAll(".rt-v").forEach((b) =>
          b.addEventListener("click", () => {
            q.setSelection(bookmarks[+b.dataset.i].index, 0);
            q.focus();
            close();
          }),
        );
      }

      /* Document Comments Sidebar Controller */
      const docComments = [];
      let commentN = 0;

      function addComment(q) {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r || !r.length) {
          showAppAlert("Select some text", "Highlight the words you want to comment on.");
          return;
        }
        uiDialog({
          title: "New comment",
          fields: [{ label: "Comment", value: "", placeholder: "Your note…" }],
          okLabel: "Comment",
          onOk: (v) => {
            if (!v[0]) return;
            commentN++;
            docComments.push({
              id: commentN,
              text: v[0],
              quote: q.getText(r.index, r.length).slice(0, 60),
              at: Date.now(),
              resolved: false,
            });
            q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "background", "#fef3c7", "user");
            renderCommentPane();
            setSaveStatus("Comment added");
          },
        });
      }

      let commentPaneOpen = false;
      function toggleCommentPane() {
        commentPaneOpen = !commentPaneOpen;
        renderCommentPane();
      }

      function renderCommentPane() {
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
          let pane = sh.querySelector(".rt-comments");
          if (!commentPaneOpen) {
            if (pane) pane.remove();
            sh.classList.remove("has-pane");
            return;
          }
          if (!pane) {
            pane = document.createElement("aside");
            pane.className = "rt-comments";
            sh.querySelector(".rt-surface").after(pane);
          }
          sh.classList.add("has-pane");
          pane.innerHTML =
            `<div class="rt-pane-h">Comments<button type="button" class="pk-icon" data-close-pane aria-label="Close">✕</button></div>` +
            (docComments.length
              ? docComments
                  .map(
                    (c) => `<div class="rt-comment ${c.resolved ? "done" : ""}">
                      <div class="rt-c-q">“${escapeHTMLText(c.quote)}”</div>
                      <div class="rt-c-t">${escapeHTMLText(c.text)}</div>
                      <div class="rt-c-a">
                        <button type="button" data-resolve="${c.id}">${c.resolved ? "Reopen" : "Resolve"}</button>
                        <button type="button" data-delc="${c.id}">Delete</button>
                      </div></div>`,
                  )
                  .join("")
              : `<div class="rt-pane-empty">No comments yet.</div>`);
          pane.onclick = (e) => {
            if (e.target.closest("[data-close-pane]")) return toggleCommentPane();
            const res = e.target.closest("[data-resolve]");
            if (res) {
              const c = docComments.find((x) => x.id === +res.dataset.resolve);
              if (c) c.resolved = !c.resolved;
              return renderCommentPane();
            }
            const del = e.target.closest("[data-delc]");
            if (del) {
              const i = docComments.findIndex((x) => x.id === +del.dataset.delc);
              if (i > -1) docComments.splice(i, 1);
              renderCommentPane();
            }
          };
        });
      }

      /* Track Changes Revision Tracking Engine */
      let trackChanges = false;

      function toggleTrackChanges(q, btn) {
        trackChanges = !trackChanges;
        if (btn) btn.classList.toggle("on", trackChanges);
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) =>
          sh.classList.toggle("tracking-on", trackChanges),
        );
        docToast(trackChanges ? "Track changes on" : "Track changes off");
        setSaveStatus(trackChanges ? "Tracking changes" : "Tracking off");
      }

      function bindTrackChanges(q) {
        q.on("text-change", (delta, old, source) => {
          if (!trackChanges || source !== "user") return;
          let idx = 0;
          (delta.ops || []).forEach((op) => {
            if (op.retain) idx += op.retain;
            else if (typeof op.insert === "string" && op.insert.length) {
              /* Marks inserted text in track-changes mode */
              q.formatText(idx, op.insert.length, "tracked", "ins", "silent");
              idx += op.insert.length;
            }
          });
        });

      /* Proofing, Readability, and AutoCorrect Engine */

      function openWordCount(q) {
        const text = q.getText();
        const words = (text.match(/[^\s]+/g) || []).length;
        const chars = text.replace(/\n/g, "").length;
        const charsSp = text.length;
        const paras = q.root.querySelectorAll("p,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,li,blockquote").length;
        const sentences = (text.match(/[^.!?]+[.!?]+/g) || []).length;
        const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(words / 500));
        /* Flesch Reading Ease score calculator */
        const syl = (w) => {
          const groups = (String(w).toLowerCase().match(/[aeiouy]+/g) || []).length;
          return Math.max(1, groups);
        };
        const totalSyl = (text.match(/[^\s]+/g) || []).reduce((n, w) => n + syl(w), 0);
        const flesch = Math.round(
          206.835 - 1.015 * (words / Math.max(1, sentences)) - 84.6 * (totalSyl / Math.max(1, words)),
        );
        const grade =
          flesch >= 90 ? "Very easy" : flesch >= 80 ? "Easy" : flesch >= 70 ? "Fairly easy"
          : flesch >= 60 ? "Standard" : flesch >= 50 ? "Fairly difficult"
          : flesch >= 30 ? "Difficult" : "Very difficult";
        const rows = [
          ["Pages", pages], ["Words", words], ["Characters (no spaces)", chars],
          ["Characters (with spaces)", charsSp], ["Paragraphs", paras],
          ["Sentences", sentences], ["Reading time", Math.max(1, Math.round(words / 220)) + " min"],
          ["Speaking time", Math.max(1, Math.round(words / 130)) + " min"],
          ["Readability (Flesch)", flesch + " — " + grade],
        ];
        const host = document.createElement("div");
        host.className = "ui-modal";
        host.innerHTML = `<div class="ui-modal-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Word count">
            <div class="ui-modal-h">Word count</div>
            <div class="rt-wc">${rows.map(([k, v]) => `<div><span>${k}</span><b>${v}</b></div>`).join("")}</div>
            <div class="ui-modal-a"><button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-primary" data-x>Close</button></div>
          </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(host);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => host.classList.add("in"));
        const close = wireModal(host);
      }

      /* AutoCorrect and smart quote replacement handler */
      let autoCorrect = true;
      const AUTO_REPLACE = [
        [/\bteh\b/g, "the"], [/\brecieve\b/g, "receive"], [/\bseperate\b/g, "separate"],
        [/\bdefinately\b/g, "definitely"], [/\boccured\b/g, "occurred"],
        [/\badn\b/g, "and"], [/\bthier\b/g, "their"], [/\bwierd\b/g, "weird"],
        [/\balot\b/g, "a lot"], [/\bdont\b/g, "don't"], [/\bcant\b/g, "can't"],
        [/\(c\)/g, "©"], [/\(r\)/g, "®"], [/\(tm\)/g, "™"],
        [/->/g, "→"], [/<-/g, "←"], [/\.\.\./g, "…"], [/--/g, "—"],
        [/\b1\/2\b/g, "½"], [/\b1\/4\b/g, "¼"], [/\b3\/4\b/g, "¾"],
      ];

      function bindAutoCorrect(q) {
        q.on("text-change", (delta, old, source) => {
          if (!autoCorrect || source !== "user") return;
          const ins = (delta.ops || []).find((o) => o.insert);
          if (!ins || typeof ins.insert !== "string") return;
          if (!/[\s.,!?]/.test(ins.insert)) return;
          const sel = q.getSelection();
          if (!sel) return;
          const [blot] = q.getLine(sel.index);
          if (!blot || !blot.domNode) return;
          /* Skips AutoCorrect inside code blocks, URLs, and deletions */
          if (blot.domNode.closest("pre, .ql-code-block-container, .trk-del")) return;
          const start = q.getIndex(blot);
          const text = blot.domNode.textContent || "";
          let out = text;
          AUTO_REPLACE.forEach(([re, to]) => (out = out.replace(re, to)));
          /* Typographic smart quote replacements */
          out = out
            .replace(/(^|[\s([{])"/g, "$1“").replace(/"/g, "”")
            .replace(/(^|[\s([{])'/g, "$1‘").replace(/'/g, "’");
          if (out === text) return;
          const off = sel.index - start;
          setTimeout(() => {
            q.deleteText(start, text.length, "silent");
            q.insertText(start, out, "silent");
            q.setSelection(start + off + (out.length - text.length), 0, "silent");
          }, 0);
        });
      }

      /* Select All Text with Similar Formatting Tool */
      function selectSimilar(q) {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r) return;
        const f = q.getFormat(r);
        const keys = Object.keys(f);
        if (!keys.length) return showAppAlert("No formatting", "Put the cursor in formatted text first.");
        const len = q.getLength();
        const matchAt = (i) => keys.every((k) => q.getFormat(i, 1)[k] === f[k]);
        let total = 0;
        let firstStart = -1;
        let lastEnd = -1;
        let i = 0;
        while (i < len) {
          if (!matchAt(i)) { i++; continue; }
          const start = i;
          while (i < len && matchAt(i)) i++;
          total += (i - start);
          if (firstStart < 0) firstStart = start;
          lastEnd = i;
        }
        if (!total) return showAppAlert("Similar formatting", "No other text shares this formatting.");
        /* Highlights and selects all text matching formatting attributes */
        setTimeout(() => {
          q.focus();
          q.setSelection(firstStart, lastEnd - firstStart, "user");
        }, 0);
        docToast(`${total} characters share this formatting - matching text selected.`);
      }

      /**
       * Module: Ribbon Action Handlers
       * Responsibilities: Home, Insert, Design, Layout, References, Review, and View tab actions.
       */

      /* Clipboard Action Handlers (Cut, Copy, Paste, Format Painter) */
      let internalClip = null;

      async function copyTextToClipboard(text) {
        if (!text) return false;
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
          try {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
            return true;
          } catch (e) {}
        }
        try {
          const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
          ta.value = text;
          ta.style.position = "fixed";
          ta.style.top = "-9999px";
          ta.style.left = "-9999px";
          ta.setAttribute("readonly", "");
          document.body.appendChild(ta);
          ta.focus();
          ta.select();
          const ok = document.execCommand("copy");
          ta.remove();
          return ok;
        } catch (err) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      function getSelectedHTML(q, range) {
        const r = (range && range.length) ? range : (q.getSelection() || { index: 0, length: 0 });
        if (!r || r.length === 0) {
          return q.root.innerHTML;
        }
        const sel = window.getSelection();
        if (sel && sel.rangeCount && !sel.getRangeAt(0).collapsed) {
          const div = document.createElement("div");
          div.appendChild(sel.getRangeAt(0).cloneContents());
          if (div.innerHTML && div.innerHTML.trim()) return div.innerHTML;
        }
        const tempDiv = document.createElement("div");
        const tempQ = new Quill(tempDiv);
        tempQ.setContents(q.getContents(r.index, r.length));
        return tempQ.root.innerHTML;
      }

      async function docCut(q, range) {
        const r = (range && range.length) ? range : (q.getSelection() || { index: 0, length: 0 });
        if (!r || !r.length) return docToast("Select something to cut", "warn");
        const text = q.getText(r.index, r.length);
        const delta = q.getContents(r.index, r.length);
        internalClip = { text, delta };
        await copyTextToClipboard(text);
        q.deleteText(r.index, r.length, "user");
        q.setSelection(r.index, 0, "silent");
        docToast("Cut selection");
      }

      async function docCopy(q, range) {
        const r = (range && range.length) ? range : (q.getSelection() || { index: 0, length: 0 });
        let text = "";
        let delta = null;
        if (r && r.length) {
          text = q.getText(r.index, r.length);
          delta = q.getContents(r.index, r.length);
        } else {
          text = q.getText();
          delta = q.getContents();
        }
        if (!text || text === String.fromCharCode(10)) return docToast("Nothing to copy", "warn");
        internalClip = { text, delta };
        await copyTextToClipboard(text);
        docToast(r && r.length ? "Selection copied" : "Document copied");
      }

      async function docCopyMD(q, range) {
        const r = (range && range.length) ? range : q.getSelection();
        const html = getSelectedHTML(q, r);
        const md = htmlToMarkdown(html) || (r && r.length ? q.getText(r.index, r.length) : q.getText());
        if (!md || md === String.fromCharCode(10)) return docToast("Nothing to copy", "warn");
        internalClip = { text: md, delta: null };
        await copyTextToClipboard(md);
        docToast(r && r.length ? "Selection copied as Markdown" : "Document copied as Markdown");
      }

      async function docCopyHTML(q, range) {
        const r = (range && range.length) ? range : q.getSelection();
        const html = getSelectedHTML(q, r);
        if (!html || !html.trim()) return docToast("Nothing to copy", "warn");
        internalClip = { text: html, delta: null };
        await copyTextToClipboard(html);
        docToast(r && r.length ? "Selection copied as HTML" : "Document copied as HTML");
      }

      async function docPaste(q, plain, range) {
        const r = (range && range.index !== undefined) ? range : (q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength() - 1, length: 0 });
        const targetIndex = r.index !== undefined ? r.index : 0;
        const targetLength = r.length || 0;

        /* Rich HTML clipboard paste handler */
        if (!plain && navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.read) {
          try {
            const items = await navigator.clipboard.read();
            const htmlItem = items.find((it) => it.types && it.types.indexOf("text/html") > -1);
            if (htmlItem) {
              const blob = await htmlItem.getType("text/html");
              const html = await blob.text();
              if (html && html.trim()) {
                const safe = sanitizeDocHTML(html);
                if (targetLength > 0) q.deleteText(targetIndex, targetLength, "user");
                const lenBefore = q.getLength();
                q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(targetIndex, safe, "user");
                const insertedLen = q.getLength() - lenBefore;
                q.setSelection(targetIndex + insertedLen, 0, "silent");
                return docToast("Pasted");
              }
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        let text = "";
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.readText) {
          try {
            text = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        if (!text && internalClip) {
          if (!plain && internalClip.delta) {
            if (targetLength > 0) q.deleteText(targetIndex, targetLength, "user");
            const Delta = Quill.import("delta");
            q.updateContents(
              new Delta().retain(targetIndex).concat(internalClip.delta),
              "user"
            );
            q.setSelection(targetIndex + (internalClip.text ? internalClip.text.length : 0), 0, "silent");
            return docToast("Pasted");
          }
          text = internalClip.text;
        }

        if (!text) return docToast("Clipboard is empty (use long-press or Ctrl+V)", "info");
        if (targetLength > 0) q.deleteText(targetIndex, targetLength, "user");
        q.insertText(targetIndex, text, plain ? {} : undefined, "user");
        q.setSelection(targetIndex + text.length, 0, "silent");
        docToast(plain ? "Pasted as plain text" : "Pasted");
      }
