      /* ---------- Layout designer (columns / rows / grid / free boxes) ---------- */

      function layoutDesc() {
        const L = pageSetup;
        if (L.layoutMode === "rows" && L.rows > 1)
          return "Rows " + L.rows + " (gap " + L.rowGap + "px)";
        if (L.layoutMode === "grid")
          return "Grid " + L.columns + " × " + L.rows + " (gap " + L.colGap + "px)";
        if (L.layoutMode === "free")
          return "Freeform · " + (L.boxes || []).length + " box" + ((L.boxes || []).length === 1 ? "" : "es");
        if (L.layoutMode === "columns" && L.columns > 1)
          return (
            "Columns " + L.columns +
            (L.colWidth > 0 ? " · " + L.colWidth + " in" : "") +
            " (gap " + (L.colSpace ? L.colGap : 0) + "px" +
            (L.colLine ? ", line" : "") +
            (L.colMargin ? "" : ", no margins") + ")"
          );
        return "1 column";
      }

      function captureLayout() {
        return {
          mode: pageSetup.layoutMode,
          columns: pageSetup.columns,
          rows: pageSetup.rows,
          rowGap: pageSetup.rowGap,
          colGap: pageSetup.colGap,
          colLine: !!pageSetup.colLine,
          colSpace: pageSetup.colSpace !== false,
          colMargin: pageSetup.colMargin !== false,
          colWidth: Number(pageSetup.colWidth || 0),
          rowHeights: (pageSetup.rowHeights || []).slice(),
          colWidths: (pageSetup.colWidths || []).slice(),
          boxes: serializeBoxes(),
          inline: serializeInlineBoxes(),
        };
      }

      /* Reads live box HTML so saving keeps what was typed inside boxes */
      function serializeBoxes() {
        return [...document.querySelectorAll(".layout-box")].map((el) => ({
          x: parseFloat(el.dataset.x) || 0,
          y: parseFloat(el.dataset.y) || 0,
          w: parseFloat(el.dataset.w) || 2,
          h: parseFloat(el.dataset.h) || 2,
          shape: el.dataset.shape || "rect",
          margin: parseFloat(el.dataset.margin) || 0,
          locked: el.dataset.locked === "1",
          hidden: el.dataset.hidden === "1",
          mode: el.dataset.mode || "overlay",
          html: cleanBoxHTML(el.innerHTML),
        }));
      }

      /* Box specs in inches for the active layout mode */
      function layoutBoxSpecs() {
        const L = pageSetup;
        const specs = [];
        const p = currentPaper();
        const mb = marginBox();
        const pw = L.orient === "landscape" ? p.h : p.w;
        const ph = L.orient === "landscape" ? p.w : p.h;
        const mk = (x, y, w, h, shape, margin, label, flow, gapRight) =>
          specs.push({ x, y, w, h, shape, margin, label, flow, gapRight });
        if (L.layoutMode === "rows" && L.rows > 1) {
          /* Custom row heights (inches) if set by dragging the bottom edge */
          const gap = L.rowGap;
          const avail = ph - mb.t - mb.b - gap * (L.rows - 1);
          const defH = Math.max(0.4, avail / L.rows);
          let y = mb.t;
          for (let i = 0; i < L.rows; i++) {
            const hPx = L.rowHeights && L.rowHeights[i] ? L.rowHeights[i] * 96 : defH;
            mk(mb.l / 96, y / 96, (pw - mb.l - mb.r) / 96, hPx / 96, "rect", 0.15, "Row " + (i + 1), true, 0);
            y += hPx + gap;
          }
        } else if (L.layoutMode === "grid") {
          /* Custom column / row sizes (inches) set by dragging edges */
          const gap = L.colGap;
          const cAvail = pw - mb.l - mb.r - gap * (L.columns - 1);
          const rAvail = ph - mb.t - mb.b - gap * (L.rows - 1);
          const defC = Math.max(0.4, cAvail / L.columns);
          const defR = Math.max(0.4, rAvail / L.rows);
          let y = mb.t;
          for (let r = 0; r < L.rows; r++) {
            const hPx = L.rowHeights && L.rowHeights[r] ? L.rowHeights[r] * 96 : defR;
            let x = mb.l;
            for (let c = 0; c < L.columns; c++) {
              const wPx = L.colWidths && L.colWidths[c] ? L.colWidths[c] * 96 : defC;
              mk(x / 96, y / 96, wPx / 96, hPx / 96, "rect", 0.15, (r + 1) + "·" + (c + 1), true, c < L.columns - 1 ? gap / 96 : 0);
              x += wPx + gap;
            }
            y += hPx + gap;
          }
        } else if (L.layoutMode === "free") {
          (L.boxes || []).forEach((b, i) => {
            if (b.hidden) return;
            /* In-line boxes live inside the document flow, not on the canvas */
            if (b.mode === "inline") return;
            mk(b.x || 0, b.y || 0, b.w || 2, b.h || 2, b.shape || "rect", b.margin || 0, "Box " + (i + 1));
          });
        }
        return specs;
      }

      /* Strips the drag bars / resize handles out of saved box content so
         re-renders and saves never accumulate chrome inside the box HTML. */
      function cleanBoxHTML(html) {
        if (!html) return "";
        const t = document.createElement("div");
        t.innerHTML = html;
        t.querySelectorAll(".lb-bar, .lb-handle").forEach((n) => n.remove());
        return t.innerHTML;
      }

      /* Rebuilds the on-paper layout boxes (preserves typed content) */
      function renderLayoutBoxes() {
        /* Busy-guard: while a drag/resize gesture is in flight, any caller
           (window resize, page nav, page setup) must not rebuild boxes from
           the (possibly mid-gesture) state - that is what snapped boxes back
           to their old position on touch. */
        if (window.__lbBusy) {
          window.__lbRerenderQueued = true;
          return;
        }
        const prev = [...document.querySelectorAll(".layout-box")].map((el) => cleanBoxHTML(el.innerHTML));
        document.querySelectorAll(".layout-box").forEach((el) => el.remove());
        const sh = document.querySelector(".rt-shell");
        if (!sh) return;
        const specs = layoutBoxSpecs();
        if (!specs.length) return;
        const zs = getComputedStyle(sh);
        const zoom = parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--doc-zoom")) || 1;
        const paper = sh.querySelector(".ql-container");
        if (!paper) return;
        specs.forEach((s, i) => {
          let x = s.x * 96 * zoom;
          let y = s.y * 96 * zoom;
          let w = s.w * 96 * zoom;
          let h = s.h * 96 * zoom;
          if (s.shape === "circle") {
            const m = Math.min(w, h);
            x += (w - m) / 2;
            y += (h - m) / 2;
            w = m;
            h = m;
          }
          const el = document.createElement("div");
          el.className = "layout-box";
          el.setAttribute("contenteditable", "true");
          el.setAttribute("spellcheck", "false");
          el.dataset.x = s.x;
          el.dataset.y = s.y;
          el.dataset.w = s.w;
          el.dataset.h = s.h;
          el.dataset.shape = s.shape;
          el.dataset.margin = s.margin;
          el.dataset.tag = s.label;
          /* Layer flags for free boxes */
          const st =
            pageSetup.layoutMode === "free" && pageSetup.boxes && pageSetup.boxes[i]
              ? pageSetup.boxes[i]
              : null;
          el.dataset.locked = st && st.locked ? "1" : "0";
          el.dataset.hidden = st && st.hidden ? "1" : "0";
          el.dataset.mode = st && st.mode ? st.mode : "overlay";
          if (st && st.locked) el.classList.add("lb-locked");
          el.style.left = Math.round(x) + "px";
          el.style.top = Math.round(y) + "px";
          el.style.width = Math.round(w) + "px";
          el.style.height = Math.round(h) + "px";
          if (s.flow) {
            /* Rows & grid cells live IN the document flow (no overlay) */
            el.classList.add("lb-flow");
            if (s.gapRight) el.style.marginRight = Math.round(s.gapRight * 96 * zoom) + "px";
          }
          el.style.paddingTop = Math.round((s.margin || 0) * 96 * zoom + 18) + "px";
          el.style.paddingRight = Math.round((s.margin || 0) * 96 * zoom) + "px";
          el.style.paddingBottom = Math.round((s.margin || 0) * 96 * zoom) + "px";
          el.style.paddingLeft = Math.round((s.margin || 0) * 96 * zoom) + "px";
          /* Rebuild preserves live typing (prev), but a stale EMPTY box must
             not wipe the saved content from pageSetup.boxes on restore. */
          const saved =
            pageSetup.boxes && pageSetup.boxes[i] && pageSetup.boxes[i].html
              ? cleanBoxHTML(pageSetup.boxes[i].html)
              : "";
          el.innerHTML = prev[i] ? prev[i] : saved;
          /* Chrome must be added AFTER innerHTML (innerHTML would wipe it):
             the drag bar (top strip) and the resize handles. */
          const bar = document.createElement("div");
          bar.className = "lb-bar";
          bar.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
          /* Lock / delete / convert live on the box itself - no need to open
             the designer. Only for free-form overlay boxes. */
          const showActs = pageSetup.layoutMode === "free";
          bar.innerHTML =
            '<span class="lb-tag"></span>' +
            (showActs
              ? '<span class="lb-acts">' +
                  '<button type="button" class="lb-act" data-bact="inline" aria-label="Convert to in-line box" title="Convert to in line">⤵</button>' +
                  '<button type="button" class="lb-act" data-bact="lock" aria-label="Lock or unlock" title="' + (st && st.locked ? "Unlock" : "Lock") + '">' + (st && st.locked ? "🔒" : "🔓") + "</button>" +
                  '<button type="button" class="lb-act lb-act-del" data-bact="del" aria-label="Delete box" title="Delete box">✕</button>' +
                  '<span class="lb-grip" aria-hidden="true">⠿</span>' +
                "</span>"
              : '<span class="lb-grip" aria-hidden="true">⠿</span>');
          bar.querySelector(".lb-tag").textContent =
            pageSetup.layoutMode === "free"
              ? s.label + " \u00b7 " + s.w.toFixed(1) + "\u00d7" + s.h.toFixed(1) + "\u2033"
              : s.label;
          el.insertBefore(bar, el.firstChild);
          const dirs =
            pageSetup.layoutMode === "free"
              ? ["nw", "n", "ne", "e", "se", "s", "sw", "w"]
              : pageSetup.layoutMode === "rows"
                ? ["s"]
                : pageSetup.layoutMode === "grid"
                  ? ["e", "s"]
                  : [];
          dirs.forEach((d) => {
            const hd = document.createElement("i");
            hd.className = "lb-handle lb-h-" + d;
            hd.dataset.dir = d;
            hd.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
            hd.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
            el.appendChild(hd);
          });
          paper.appendChild(el);
        });
        /* One-time interaction binding (drag / resize via pointer events) */
        /* Re-apply the selection ring after a rebuild */
        if (paper.__selIdx != null) {
          const selBox = paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box")[paper.__selIdx];
          if (selBox) selBox.classList.add("ov-selected");
        }
        if (!paper.__lbBound) {
          paper.__lbBound = true;
          bindLayoutBoxInteractions(paper);
        }
      }

      /* Paper dimensions in inches for clamping overlay boxes inside it */
      function paperDimsIn() {
        const p = currentPaper();
        const w = pageSetup.orient === "landscape" ? p.h : p.w;
        const h = pageSetup.orient === "landscape" ? p.w : p.h;
        return { pw: w / 96, ph: h / 96 };
      }

      /* ---------- In-line box engine (in-flow boxes via the docbox blot) ---------- */

      /* Inserts an in-line box at the caret (or the end of the document) */
      function insertInlineBox(q, value) {
        if (!q) return;
        const v = value || {};
        const sel = q.getSelection();
        const at =
          sel && sel.index != null
            ? sel.index
            : Math.max(0, q.getLength() - 1);
        q.insertEmbed(at, "docbox", {
          w: v.w || 3,
          h: v.h || 1.5,
          shape: v.shape || "rect",
          margin: v.margin || 0.1,
          html: v.html || "",
        }, "user");
        q.setSelection(at + 1, 0);
      }

      /* Reads every in-line box from the editor with its delta index */
      function serializeInlineBoxes() {
        const q = typeof quill !== "undefined" ? quill : null;
        if (!q) return [];
        return [...q.root.querySelectorAll(".docbox")].map((el) => {
          const blot = Quill.find(el);
          const idx = blot ? q.getIndex(blot) : 0;
          return {
            index: idx,
            w: parseFloat(el.dataset.w) || 3,
            h: parseFloat(el.dataset.h) || 1.5,
            shape: el.dataset.shape || "rect",
            margin: parseFloat(el.dataset.margin) || 0.1,
            html: (el.querySelector(".docbox-inner") || el).innerHTML,
          };
        });
      }

      /* After pasteHTML, Quill strips unknown divs, so in-line boxes are
         re-inserted from the saved design (best-effort positions). */
      function rehydrateInlineBoxes(layout) {
        const q = typeof quill !== "undefined" ? quill : null;
        if (!q || !layout || !Array.isArray(layout.inline)) return;
        const list = layout.inline.slice().sort((a, b) => (a.index || 0) - (b.index || 0));
        list.forEach((b) => {
          const at = Math.max(0, Math.min(q.getLength() - 1, b.index || q.getLength() - 1));
          q.insertEmbed(at, "docbox", {
            w: b.w || 3,
            h: b.h || 1.5,
            shape: b.shape || "rect",
            margin: b.margin || 0.1,
            html: b.html || "",
          }, "silent");
        });
      }

      /* Overlay box (designer list) -> in-line box (document flow) */
      function convertBoxToInline(i) {
        const b = pageSetup.boxes && pageSetup.boxes[i];
        if (!b || !quill) return;
        pageSetup.boxes.splice(i, 1);
        applyPageSetup();
        insertInlineBox(quill, {
          w: b.w || 3,
          h: b.h || 1.5,
          shape: b.shape || "rect",
          margin: b.margin || 0.1,
          html: b.html || "",
        });
        docToast("Converted to in-line box - text flows below it");
      }

      /* In-line box -> overlay layer (canvas). The box is removed from the
         flow and becomes a draggable layer at 1in,1in. */
      function convertInlineToOverlay(el) {
        if (!el || !quill) return;
        const blot = Quill.find(el);
        const idx = blot ? quill.getIndex(blot) : 0;
        const html = (el.querySelector(".docbox-inner") || el).innerHTML;
        quill.deleteText(idx, 1, "user");
        pageSetup.boxes = pageSetup.boxes || [];
        pageSetup.boxes.push({
          x: 1,
          y: 1,
          w: parseFloat(el.dataset.w) || 3,
          h: parseFloat(el.dataset.h) || 1.5,
          shape: el.dataset.shape || "rect",
          margin: parseFloat(el.dataset.margin) || 0.1,
          locked: false,
          hidden: false,
          mode: "overlay",
          html: html,
        });
        pageSetup.layoutMode = "free";
        applyPageSetup();
        renderLayoutBoxes();
        docToast("Converted to overlay layer");
      }

      /* Pointer interaction for in-line boxes (resize handles + convert bar).
         Delegated once on the editor root; guards against Quill's own
         selection by stopping propagation on the chrome. */
      function bindInlineBoxInteractions(root) {
        if (!root || root.__ibBound) return;
        root.__ibBound = true;
        let st = null;   /* resize state */
        let drag = null; /* reorder drag state */
        let resizeRaf = 0;
        let lastMove = null;
        const zoomOf = () => {
          const sh = document.querySelector(".rt-shell");
          return parseFloat(getComputedStyle(sh).getPropertyValue("--doc-zoom")) || 1;
        };
        const blockSel =
          "p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, li, blockquote, pre, .docbox";
        /* Only the drag bar, resize handles and the convert button swallow
           the pointer. Clicks inside the box body must reach Quill so the
           user can place the caret and type inside the box. */
        const guardStart = (e) => {
          const act = e.target.closest(".lb-act");
          if (act) return false; /* action buttons keep their click */
          const bar = e.target.closest(".lb-bar");
          const handle = e.target.closest(".lb-handle");
          const box = e.target.closest(".docbox");
          if (!box) return false;
          if (!bar && !handle) return false;
          if (e.pointerType === "mouse" && e.button !== 0) return false;
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          return true;
        };
        /* Quill v1 tracks selection on mousedown/touchstart - without these
           guards it would hijack drag gestures on the bar and handles. */
        root.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
          guardStart(e);
        }, true);
        root.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
          /* Action buttons (.lb-act) must keep their tap -> click */
          if (e.target.closest(".lb-act")) return;
          if (e.target.closest(".lb-bar, .lb-handle")) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
          }
        }, { capture: true, passive: false });

        root.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
          const bar = e.target.closest(".lb-bar");
          const handle = e.target.closest(".lb-handle");
          const convert = e.target.closest(".lb-convert");
          const box = e.target.closest(".docbox");
          if (!box) return;
          if (!guardStart(e)) return; /* let caret/typing work inside box */
          if (convert) {
            convertInlineToOverlay(box);
            return;
          }
          if (handle) {
            /* ---- smooth resize (rAF-throttled) ---- */
            const idx = [...root.querySelectorAll(".docbox")].indexOf(box);
            const zoom = zoomOf();
            const lim = paperDimsIn();
            st = {
              idx,
              zoom,
              dir: handle.dataset.dir,
              startX: e.clientX,
              startY: e.clientY,
              ow: parseFloat(box.dataset.w) || 3,
              oh: parseFloat(box.dataset.h) || 1.5,
              lim,
            };
            box.classList.add("docbox-resizing");
            try {
              handle.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
            } catch (err) {}
            return;
          }
          if (bar) {
            /* ---- drag to reorder inside the document flow ----
               A ghost follows the pointer, an insertion marker shows where
               the box will land; drop to move it. Tapping the bar also
               reveals the resize handles (touch discoverability). */
            box.classList.add("docbox-active");
            const blot = Quill.find(box);
            const origIdx = blot ? quill.getIndex(blot) : 0;
            const ghost = box.cloneNode(true);
            ghost.classList.add("ib-ghost");
            ghost.querySelectorAll(".lb-handle, .lb-convert").forEach((n) => n.remove());
            document.body.appendChild(ghost);
            const marker = document.createElement("div");
            marker.className = "ib-marker";
            document.body.appendChild(marker);
            root.classList.add("ib-dragging");
            box.classList.add("ib-origin");
            const br = box.getBoundingClientRect();
            ghost.style.width = br.width + "px";
            ghost.style.minHeight = br.height + "px";
            drag = {
              origIdx,
              ghost,
              marker,
              box,
              zoom: zoomOf(),
              target: null,
              lastY: e.clientY,
              scrollRaf: 0,
            };
            const place = (x, y) => {
              ghost.style.left = x + 14 + "px";
              ghost.style.top = y + 14 + "px";
              drag.lastY = y;
            };
            place(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            drag.place = place;
            /* Auto-scroll the surface while dragging near its edges */
            const scrollLoop = () => {
              if (!drag) return;
              const surf = root.closest(".rt-surface");
              if (surf) {
                const sr = surf.getBoundingClientRect();
                let d = 0;
                if (drag.lastY < sr.top + 52) d = -34;
                else if (drag.lastY > sr.bottom - 52) d = 34;
                if (d) surf.scrollTop += d;
              }
              drag.scrollRaf = requestAnimationFrame(scrollLoop);
            };
            drag.scrollRaf = requestAnimationFrame(scrollLoop);
            try {
              bar.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
            } catch (err) {}
          }
        });

        const applyResize = () => {
          resizeRaf = 0;
          if (!st || !lastMove) return;
          const box = root.querySelectorAll(".docbox")[st.idx];
          if (!box) return;
          const e = lastMove;
          const dx = (e.clientX - st.startX) / (96 * st.zoom);
          const dy = (e.clientY - st.startY) / (96 * st.zoom);
          const d = st.dir;
          let w = st.ow;
          let h = st.oh;
          if (d.includes("e")) w = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(st.lim.pw, st.ow + dx));
          if (d.includes("s")) h = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(st.lim.ph, st.oh + dy));
          if (d.includes("w")) w = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(st.lim.pw, st.ow - dx));
          if (d.includes("n")) h = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(st.lim.ph, st.oh - dy));
          w = round2(w);
          h = round2(h);
          box.style.width = Math.round(w * 96 * st.zoom) + "px";
          box.style.minHeight = Math.round(h * 96 * st.zoom) + "px";
          box.dataset.w = w.toFixed(2);
          box.dataset.h = h.toFixed(2);
        };

        const placeMarker = (x, y) => {
          if (!drag) return;
          const el = document.elementFromPoint(x, y);
          const block = el && el.closest ? el.closest(blockSel) : null;
          let target = null;
          if (block && root.contains(block)) {
            const inBox = block.closest(".docbox");
            /* Dropping on the box itself or INSIDE another box = no move */
            if (!inBox || inBox !== drag.box) {
              if (inBox && inBox !== drag.box) {
                /* map to the other box's outer edges instead */
                const r = inBox.getBoundingClientRect();
                const before = y < r.top + r.height / 2;
                target = { block: inBox, before };
                drag.marker.style.top = (before ? r.top : r.bottom) - 1.5 + "px";
                drag.marker.style.left = "0px";
                drag.marker.style.width = "100vw";
                drag.marker.classList.add("on");
                return;
              }
              const r = block.getBoundingClientRect();
              const before = y < r.top + r.height / 2;
              target = { block, before };
              drag.marker.style.top = (before ? r.top : r.bottom) - 1.5 + "px";
              drag.marker.style.left = "0px";
              drag.marker.style.width = "100vw";
              drag.marker.classList.add("on");
            }
          }
          if (!target) drag.marker.classList.remove("on");
          drag.target = target;
        };

        /* Window-level so pointer events are never lost when the finger
           leaves the box / editor during a touch drag or resize. */
        window.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
          if (drag) {
            drag.place(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            placeMarker(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            return;
          }
          if (!st) return;
          lastMove = { clientX: e.clientX, clientY: e.clientY };
          if (!resizeRaf) resizeRaf = requestAnimationFrame(applyResize);
        });

        const round2 = (v) => Math.round(v * 20) / 20;
        const commit = () => {
          if (drag) {
            const d = drag;
            drag = null;
            if (d.scrollRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(d.scrollRaf);
            d.ghost.remove();
            d.marker.remove();
            root.classList.remove("ib-dragging");
            d.box.classList.remove("ib-origin");
            if (d.target && d.target.block) {
              const val = {
                w: parseFloat(d.box.dataset.w) || 3,
                h: parseFloat(d.box.dataset.h) || 1.5,
                shape: d.box.dataset.shape || "rect",
                margin: parseFloat(d.box.dataset.margin) || 0.1,
                html: (d.box.querySelector(".docbox-inner") || d.box).innerHTML,
              };
              const tBlot = Quill.find(d.target.block);
              let tIdx = tBlot ? quill.getIndex(tBlot) : 0;
              if (!d.target.before) tIdx += 1;
              quill.deleteText(d.origIdx, 1, "user");
              if (tIdx > d.origIdx) tIdx -= 1;
              tIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(quill.getLength() - 1, tIdx));
              quill.insertEmbed(tIdx, "docbox", val, "user");
              /* Focus the moved box so its handles stay visible */
              const moved = root.querySelector(".docbox .docbox-inner");
              if (moved) moved.focus();
            }
            return;
          }
          if (st) {
            if (resizeRaf) {
              cancelAnimationFrame(resizeRaf);
              resizeRaf = 0;
              applyResize();
            }
            const box = root.querySelectorAll(".docbox")[st.idx];
            if (box) box.classList.remove("docbox-resizing");
            st = null;
            lastMove = null;
          }
        };
        window.addEventListener("pointerup", commit);
        window.addEventListener("pointercancel", commit);

        /* Handles visible on hover too; focused box gets a clear ring */
        root.addEventListener("focusin", (e) => {
          const box = e.target.closest(".docbox");
          if (box) box.classList.add("docbox-active");
        });
        root.addEventListener("focusout", (e) => {
          const box = e.target.closest(".docbox");
          if (box) box.classList.remove("docbox-active");
        });
        /* Bar action buttons on in-line boxes: convert / lock / delete */
        root.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          const btn = e.target.closest("[data-bact]");
          if (!btn) return;
          const box = btn.closest(".docbox");
          if (!box) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          const a = btn.dataset.bact;
          if (a === "conv") {
            convertInlineToOverlay(box);
            return;
          }
          if (a === "del") {
            const blot = Quill.find(box);
            const idx = blot ? quill.getIndex(blot) : 0;
            quill.deleteText(idx, 1, "user");
            return;
          }
          if (a === "lock") {
            const inner = box.querySelector(".docbox-inner");
            const wasLocked = inner.getAttribute("contenteditable") !== "true";
            /* Toggle: lock -> editable off + hatch + 🔒; unlock -> back */
            inner.setAttribute("contenteditable", wasLocked ? "true" : "false");
            box.classList.toggle("docbox-locked", !wasLocked);
            btn.textContent = wasLocked ? "🔓" : "🔒";
            btn.title = wasLocked ? "Lock editing" : "Unlock editing";
          }
        });
      }

      /* Canvas-like interaction: drag boxes by their bar, resize with the
         handles. Works with mouse and touch (pointer events + capture).
         Overlay boxes are always clamped INSIDE the paper - they can never
         leave the page or the screen (the paper itself scrolls). */
      function bindLayoutBoxInteractions(paper) {
        let st = null;
        let ovRaf = 0;
        let ovLast = null;
        const ovRound = (v) => Math.round(v * 20) / 20;
        const zoomOf = () => {
          const sh = document.querySelector(".rt-shell");
          return parseFloat(getComputedStyle(sh).getPropertyValue("--doc-zoom")) || 1;
        };
        /* rAF-throttled apply: one layout write per frame = smooth drag/resize */
        const ovApply = () => {
          ovRaf = 0;
          if (!st || !ovLast) return;
          const boxes = paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box");
          const box = boxes[st.idx];
          if (!box) return;
          const e = ovLast;
          const dx = (e.clientX - st.startX) / (96 * st.zoom);
          const dy = (e.clientY - st.startY) / (96 * st.zoom);
          /* Clamp inside the paper: overlay boxes never leave the page */
          const lim = paperDimsIn();
          if (st.handle) {
            let x = st.ox, y = st.oy, w = st.ow, h = st.oh;
            const d = st.handle;
            if (st.mode === "rows") {
              h = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(lim.ph, st.oh + dy));
            } else if (st.mode === "grid") {
              if (d === "e") w = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(lim.pw, st.ow + dx));
              if (d === "s") h = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(lim.ph, st.oh + dy));
            } else {
              if (d.includes("e")) w = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(lim.pw - x, st.ow + dx));
              if (d.includes("s")) h = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(lim.ph - y, st.oh + dy));
              if (d.includes("w")) {
                w = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(st.ow + st.ox, st.ow - dx));
                x = st.ox + (st.ow - w);
              }
              if (d.includes("n")) {
                h = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(st.oh + st.oy, st.oh - dy));
                y = st.oy + (st.oh - h);
              }
            }
            x = ovRound(x);
            y = ovRound(y);
            w = ovRound(w);
            h = ovRound(h);
            box.style.left = Math.round(x * 96 * st.zoom) + "px";
            box.style.top = Math.round(y * 96 * st.zoom) + "px";
            box.style.width = Math.round(w * 96 * st.zoom) + "px";
            box.style.height = Math.round(h * 96 * st.zoom) + "px";
            box.dataset.x = x.toFixed(2);
            box.dataset.y = y.toFixed(2);
            box.dataset.w = w.toFixed(2);
            box.dataset.h = h.toFixed(2);
            if (st.mode === "free") {
              const tag = box.querySelector(".lb-tag");
              if (tag)
                tag.textContent = "Box " + (st.idx + 1) + " \u00b7 " + w.toFixed(1) + "\u00d7" + h.toFixed(1) + "\u2033";
            }
          } else {
            /* Free-form drag, clamped to the paper bounds + magnetic snap */
            const maxX = Math.max(0, lim.pw - st.ow);
            const maxY = Math.max(0, lim.ph - st.oh);
            let x = ovRound(Math.max(0, Math.min(maxX, st.ox + dx)));
            let y = ovRound(Math.max(0, Math.min(maxY, st.oy + dy)));
            /* Magnetic snapping (~8px): page margins, horizontal/vertical
               centre, and other boxes' edges. Guide lines show the snap. */
            const snap = 0.09;
            const mb = marginBox();
            const candX = [mb.l / 96, lim.pw - mb.r / 96 - st.ow, (lim.pw - st.ow) / 2];
            const candY = [mb.t / 96, lim.ph - mb.b / 96 - st.oh, (lim.ph - st.oh) / 2];
            paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box").forEach((ob) => {
              if (ob === box) return;
              const ox2 = parseFloat(ob.dataset.x) || 0;
              const oy2 = parseFloat(ob.dataset.y) || 0;
              const ow2 = parseFloat(ob.dataset.w) || 2;
              const oh2 = parseFloat(ob.dataset.h) || 2;
              candX.push(ox2, ox2 + ow2, ox2 + ow2 - st.ow);
              candY.push(oy2, oy2 + oh2, oy2 + oh2 - st.oh);
            });
            let guideX = null;
            let guideY = null;
            for (const c of candX) if (Math.abs(x - c) < snap) { x = ovRound(c); guideX = c; break; }
            for (const c of candY) if (Math.abs(y - c) < snap) { y = ovRound(c); guideY = c; break; }
            x = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxX, x));
            y = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxY, y));
            box.style.left = Math.round(x * 96 * st.zoom) + "px";
            box.style.top = Math.round(y * 96 * st.zoom) + "px";
            box.dataset.x = x.toFixed(2);
            box.dataset.y = y.toFixed(2);
            /* Guide lines while snapped */
            if (!paper.__gv) {
              paper.__gv = document.createElement("div");
              paper.__gv.className = "snap-guide gv";
              paper.appendChild(paper.__gv);
            }
            if (!paper.__gh) {
              paper.__gh = document.createElement("div");
              paper.__gh.className = "snap-guide gh";
              paper.appendChild(paper.__gh);
            }
            if (guideX !== null) {
              paper.__gv.style.display = "block";
              paper.__gv.style.left = Math.round(guideX * 96 * st.zoom) + "px";
            } else paper.__gv.style.display = "none";
            if (guideY !== null) {
              paper.__gh.style.display = "block";
              paper.__gh.style.top = Math.round(guideY * 96 * st.zoom) + "px";
            } else paper.__gh.style.display = "none";
          }
          /* Continuous state write: whatever happens mid-drag (resize events,
             nav updates, anything calling applyPageSetup), the box keeps its
             live position - it can never snap back. */
          if (st.mode === "free") {
            pageSetup.boxes = pageSetup.boxes || [];
            pageSetup.boxes[st.idx] = Object.assign({}, pageSetup.boxes[st.idx] || {}, {
              x: parseFloat(box.dataset.x) || 0,
              y: parseFloat(box.dataset.y) || 0,
              w: parseFloat(box.dataset.w) || 0.4,
              h: parseFloat(box.dataset.h) || 0.4,
            });
          } else if (st.mode === "rows" && st.handle === "s") {
            pageSetup.rowHeights = pageSetup.rowHeights || [];
            pageSetup.rowHeights[st.idx] = parseFloat(box.dataset.h) || 0.4;
          } else if (st.mode === "grid") {
            const rr = Math.floor(st.idx / (pageSetup.columns || 1));
            const cc = st.idx % (pageSetup.columns || 1);
            pageSetup.rowHeights = pageSetup.rowHeights || [];
            pageSetup.colWidths = pageSetup.colWidths || [];
            if (st.handle === "e") pageSetup.colWidths[cc] = parseFloat(box.dataset.w) || 0.4;
            if (st.handle === "s") pageSetup.rowHeights[rr] = parseFloat(box.dataset.h) || 0.4;
          }
        };
        /* Bar action buttons: lock / delete / convert (click, not drag) */
        paper.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          const btn = e.target.closest("[data-bact]");
          if (!btn) return;
          const box = e.target.closest(".layout-box");
          if (!box || pageSetup.layoutMode !== "free") return;
          const idx = [...paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box")].indexOf(box);
          const b = pageSetup.boxes && pageSetup.boxes[idx];
          if (!b) return;
          if (btn.dataset.bact === "lock") {
            b.locked = !b.locked;
            applyPageSetup();
          } else if (btn.dataset.bact === "del") {
            pageSetup.boxes.splice(idx, 1);
            applyPageSetup();
          } else if (btn.dataset.bact === "inline") {
            convertBoxToInline(idx);
          }
        });

        paper.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
          if (e.pointerType === "mouse" && e.button !== 0) return;
          const act = e.target.closest("[data-bact]");
          if (act) return; /* buttons are click-handled */
          const handle = e.target.closest(".lb-handle");
          const bar = e.target.closest(".lb-bar");
          const box = e.target.closest(".layout-box");
          if (!box) {
            /* Click on empty paper clears the selection */
            paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("ov-selected"));
            paper.__selIdx = null;
            if (!paper.hasAttribute("tabindex")) paper.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
            paper.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            return;
          }
          if (box.dataset.locked === "1") return;
          const mode = pageSetup.layoutMode;
          const idx = [...paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box")].indexOf(box);
          const zoom = zoomOf();
          if (!handle && !bar) {
            /* Drag from the BOX BODY: position change starts after a small
               move threshold. A plain single click SELECTS the box (ring,
               no focus); a double-click switches to editing - the standard
               canvas / text-box behaviour. */
            if (mode !== "free") return;
            e.preventDefault();
            window.__lbBusy = true;
            st = {
              idx,
              mode,
              zoom,
              handle: null,
              pending: true,
              startX: e.clientX,
              startY: e.clientY,
              ox: parseFloat(box.dataset.x) || 0,
              oy: parseFloat(box.dataset.y) || 0,
              ow: parseFloat(box.dataset.w) || 2,
              oh: parseFloat(box.dataset.h) || 2,
            };
            try {
              box.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
            } catch (err) {}
            return;
          }
          /* Rows/grid boxes are track-bound: they resize, they do not move */
          if (!handle && mode !== "free") return;
          e.preventDefault();
          window.__lbBusy = true;
          st = {
            idx,
            mode,
            zoom,
            handle: handle ? handle.dataset.dir : null,
            startX: e.clientX,
            startY: e.clientY,
            ox: parseFloat(box.dataset.x) || 0,
            oy: parseFloat(box.dataset.y) || 0,
            ow: parseFloat(box.dataset.w) || 2,
            oh: parseFloat(box.dataset.h) || 2,
          };
          try {
            (handle || bar).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
          } catch (err) {}
        });
        /* Window-level so pointer events are never lost when the finger
           leaves the paper during a touch drag or resize. */
        window.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
          if (!st) return;
          /* Body drag: only start once the pointer moved past the threshold */
          if (st.pending) {
            const dist = Math.hypot(e.clientX - st.startX, e.clientY - st.startY);
            if (dist < 6) return;
            st.pending = false;
            e.preventDefault();
            const box = paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box")[st.idx];
            if (box) box.classList.add("ov-dragging");
            if (window.getSelection) window.getSelection().removeAllRanges();
          }
          ovLast = { clientX: e.clientX, clientY: e.clientY };
          if (!ovRaf) ovRaf = requestAnimationFrame(ovApply);
        });
        /* Click-to-select overlay boxes (ring) + keyboard nudge/delete.
           Registered once globally; runs on EVERY keydown while a free box
           is selected and no text editing is in progress. */
        const bindOverlayKeys = () => {
          if (window.__ovKeysBound) return;
          window.__ovKeysBound = true;
          document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
            const sh = document.querySelector(".rt-shell");
            const paper2 = sh && sh.querySelector(".ql-container");
            if (!paper2) return;
            const act = document.activeElement;
            if (act && (act.isContentEditable || act.tagName === "INPUT" || act.tagName === "TEXTAREA")) return;
            if (docMode !== "page" || pageSetup.layoutMode !== "free") return;
            if (paper2.__selIdx == null) return;
            const boxes = paper2.querySelectorAll(".layout-box");
            const box = boxes[paper2.__selIdx];
            if (!box) return;
            const lim = paperDimsIn();
            let x = parseFloat(box.dataset.x) || 0;
            let y = parseFloat(box.dataset.y) || 0;
            const w = parseFloat(box.dataset.w) || 2;
            const h = parseFloat(box.dataset.h) || 2;
            const step = e.shiftKey ? 1 : 0.1;
            if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") { x = Math.max(0, x - step); e.preventDefault(); }
            else if (e.key === "ArrowRight") { x = Math.min(lim.pw - w, x + step); e.preventDefault(); }
            else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") { y = Math.max(0, y - step); e.preventDefault(); }
            else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") { y = Math.min(lim.ph - h, y + step); e.preventDefault(); }
            else if (e.key === "Delete" || e.key === "Backspace") {
              pageSetup.boxes.splice(paper2.__selIdx, 1);
              paper2.__selIdx = null;
              applyPageSetup();
              e.preventDefault();
              return;
            } else return;
            box.style.left = Math.round(x * 96 * ((parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(".rt-shell")).getPropertyValue("--doc-zoom")) || 1))) + "px";
            box.style.top = Math.round(y * 96 * ((parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(".rt-shell")).getPropertyValue("--doc-zoom")) || 1))) + "px";
            box.dataset.x = x.toFixed(2);
            box.dataset.y = y.toFixed(2);
            pageSetup.boxes[paper2.__selIdx] = Object.assign({}, pageSetup.boxes[paper2.__selIdx] || {}, { x, y, w, h });
          });
        };
        bindOverlayKeys();

        const commit = () => {
          if (!st) return;
          /* Plain click on the body (no move) = select the box (or edit) */
          if (st.pending) {
            const pidx = st.idx;
            const pmode = st.mode;
            st = null;
            /* Gesture is over: unblock re-renders even though nothing moved */
            window.__lbBusy = false;
            window.__lbRerenderQueued = false;
            /* Clicking a free box selects it; clicking empty paper clears */
            const boxes = paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box");
            const box = boxes[pidx];
            paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("ov-selected"));
            if (box && pmode === "free") {
              box.classList.add("ov-selected");
              paper.__selIdx = pidx;
              /* Focus the paper itself so arrow keys nudge the box instead
                 of moving a text caret (double-click switches to editing). */
              if (!paper.hasAttribute("tabindex")) paper.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
              paper.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }
            return;
          }
          if (ovRaf) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(ovRaf);
            ovRaf = 0;
            ovApply();
          }
          ovLast = null;
          if (paper.__gv) paper.__gv.style.display = "none";
          if (paper.__gh) paper.__gh.style.display = "none";
          const boxes = paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box");
          const box = boxes[st.idx];
          if (box) {
            box.classList.remove("ov-dragging");
            const x = parseFloat(box.dataset.x) || 0;
            const y = parseFloat(box.dataset.y) || 0;
            const w = parseFloat(box.dataset.w) || 0.4;
            const h = parseFloat(box.dataset.h) || 0.4;
            if (st.mode === "free") {
              pageSetup.boxes = pageSetup.boxes || [];
              pageSetup.boxes[st.idx] = Object.assign({}, pageSetup.boxes[st.idx] || {}, { x, y, w, h });
            } else if (st.mode === "rows") {
              pageSetup.rowHeights = pageSetup.rowHeights || [];
              pageSetup.rowHeights[st.idx] = h;
            } else if (st.mode === "grid") {
              const r = Math.floor(st.idx / (pageSetup.columns || 1));
              const c = st.idx % (pageSetup.columns || 1);
              pageSetup.rowHeights = pageSetup.rowHeights || [];
              pageSetup.colWidths = pageSetup.colWidths || [];
              if (st.handle === "e") pageSetup.colWidths[c] = w;
              if (st.handle === "s") pageSetup.rowHeights[r] = h;
            }
          }
          st = null;
          window.__lbBusy = false;
          window.__lbRerenderQueued = false;
          applyPageSetup();
        };
        window.addEventListener("pointerup", commit);
        window.addEventListener("pointercancel", commit);

        /* Double-click on a free box = select + focus for editing */
        paper.addEventListener("dblclick", (e) => {
          const box = e.target.closest(".layout-box");
          if (!box || pageSetup.layoutMode !== "free") return;
          const idx = [...paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box")].indexOf(box);
          paper.querySelectorAll(".layout-box").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("ov-selected"));
          box.classList.add("ov-selected");
          paper.__selIdx = idx;
          box.focus();
        });
      }

      /* ---------- Multi-page system (pages, navigation, page edges) ---------- */

      let pageNav = { count: 1, current: 1 };

      function pageHeightPx() {
        const sh = document.querySelector(".rt-shell");
        if (!sh) return 1123;
        const zs = getComputedStyle(sh);
        const ph = parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--pg-h")) || 1123;
        const zoom = parseFloat(zs.getPropertyValue("--doc-zoom")) || 1;
        return ph * zoom;
      }

      function computePageCount() {
        if (docMode !== "page") return 1;
        const sh = document.querySelector(".rt-shell");
        const paper = sh && sh.querySelector(".ql-container");
        if (!paper) return 1;
        return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(paper.scrollHeight / pageHeightPx()));
      }

      function paperTopInSurface(surf, paper) {
        const sRect = surf.getBoundingClientRect();
        const pRect = paper.getBoundingClientRect();
        return pRect.top - sRect.top + surf.scrollTop;
      }

      /* Recomputes the page count, current page, page-edge chips and the
         navigator labels. Cheap - runs on text change / scroll / zoom. */
      function updatePageNav() {
        const sh = document.querySelector(".rt-shell");
        const surf = sh && sh.querySelector(".rt-surface");
        const paper = sh && sh.querySelector(".ql-container");
        if (!sh || !surf || !paper) return;
        pageNav.count = computePageCount();
        const phz = pageHeightPx();
        const top = paperTopInSurface(surf, paper);
        pageNav.current = Math.min(
          pageNav.count,
          Math.max(1, Math.floor((surf.scrollTop - top + 8) / phz) + 1),
        );
        /* Page-edge chips: one per page boundary, labelled with the page no. */
        let edges = paper.querySelector(".rt-pageedges");
        if (!edges) {
          edges = document.createElement("div");
          edges.className = "rt-pageedges";
          paper.appendChild(edges);
        }
        edges.innerHTML = "";
        for (let i = 1; i < pageNav.count; i++) {
          const c = document.createElement("span");
          c.className = "rt-pageedge";
          c.style.top = Math.round(i * phz + 4) + "px";
          c.textContent = i + 1;
          edges.appendChild(c);
        }
        const lbl = document.querySelector(".rt-dock-p");
        if (lbl) lbl.textContent = pageNav.current + "/" + pageNav.count;
        const st = document.querySelector(".rt-stats [data-page]");
        if (st) st.textContent = "Page " + pageNav.current + " of " + pageNav.count;
      }

      /* Scrolls to the previous / next page (dir = -1 / +1) */
      function scrollToPage(dir) {
        const sh = document.querySelector(".rt-shell");
        const surf = sh && sh.querySelector(".rt-surface");
        const paper = sh && sh.querySelector(".ql-container");
        if (!sh || !surf || !paper) return;
        const count = computePageCount();
        const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(count - 1, pageNav.current - 1 + dir));
        const phz = pageHeightPx();
        const top = paperTopInSurface(surf, paper);
        surf.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, top + target * phz - 6), behavior: "smooth" });
      }

      /* Live current-page updates while scrolling (throttled to a frame) */
      if (!window.__pgNavBound) {
        window.__pgNavBound = true;
        let __navRaf = 0;
        document.addEventListener(
          "scroll",
          () => {
            if (docMode !== "page") return;
            if (__navRaf) return;
            __navRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
              __navRaf = 0;
              updatePageNav();
            });
          },
          true,
        );
      }

      /* Boxes exported for print/PDF (absolute, real inches) */
      function layoutBoxesExportHTML() {
        const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll(".layout-box")];
        if (!boxes.length) return "";
        const p = currentPaper();
        const pw = pageSetup.orient === "landscape" ? p.h : p.w;
        const ph = pageSetup.orient === "landscape" ? p.w : p.h;
        return (
          '<div style="position:relative;width:' + pw + 'px;min-height:' + ph + 'px;margin:0 auto">' +
          boxes
            .filter((el) => el.dataset.hidden !== "1")
            .map((el) => {
              const x = parseFloat(el.dataset.x) * 96;
              const y = parseFloat(el.dataset.y) * 96;
              const bw = parseFloat(el.dataset.w) * 96;
              const bh = parseFloat(el.dataset.h) * 96;
              const shp = el.dataset.shape;
              const radius =
                shp === "circle" || shp === "ellipse" ? "50%" : shp === "rounded" ? "14px" : "3px";
              return (
                '<div style="position:absolute;left:' + x + 'px;top:' + y + "px;width:" + bw +
                "px;height:" + bh + "px;border:1px solid #999;border-radius:" + radius +
                ";padding:" + (parseFloat(el.dataset.margin) * 96) +
                'px;box-sizing:border-box;overflow:hidden">' + el.innerHTML + "</div>"
              );
            })
            .join("") +
          "</div>"
        );
      }

      /* Live mini-page preview: a small paper that reflects the current
         size, orientation, margins, columns, rows and free boxes. Used in
         the Layout designer and the Page setup dialog so every change is
         visible at a glance. */
      function renderPagePreview(host) {
        if (!host) return;
        const p = currentPaper();
        const w = pageSetup.orient === "landscape" ? p.h : p.w;
        const h = pageSetup.orient === "landscape" ? p.w : p.h;
        const mb = marginBox();
        const ml = (mb.l / w) * 100;
        const mr = (mb.r / w) * 100;
        const mt = (mb.t / h) * 100;
        const mbB = (mb.b / h) * 100;
        const cw = 100 - ml - mr;
        const ch = 100 - mt - mbB;
        const cols = pageSetup.columns;
        const rows = pageSetup.rows;
        const mode = pageSetup.layoutMode;
        let inner = "";
        /* Content area (inside the margins) */
        inner +=
          '<div class="pp-content" style="left:' + ml + "%;top:" + mt +
          "%;width:" + cw + "%;height:" + ch + '%">';
        if (mode === "columns" || mode === "grid") {
          const gap = pageSetup.colSpace ? (pageSetup.colGap / w) * 100 : 0;
          const colW = (cw - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
          for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++)
            inner +=
              '<i class="pp-col" style="left:' + (i * (colW + gap)) +
              "%;width:" + colW + '%"></i>';
        }
        if (mode === "rows" || mode === "grid") {
          const gap = (pageSetup.rowGap / h) * 100;
          const rowH = (ch - gap * (rows - 1)) / rows;
          for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++)
            inner +=
              '<i class="pp-row" style="top:' + (i * (rowH + gap)) +
              "%;height:" + rowH + '%"></i>';
        }
        if (mode === "free") {
          (pageSetup.boxes || []).forEach((b) => {
            if (b.hidden || b.mode === "inline") return;
            inner +=
              '<i class="pp-box" style="left:' + ((b.x || 0) / (w / 96)) * 100 +
              "%;top:" + ((b.y || 0) / (h / 96)) * 100 +
              "%;width:" + ((b.w || 2) / (w / 96)) * 100 +
              "%;height:" + ((b.h || 2) / (h / 96)) * 100 + '%"></i>';
          });
        }
        inner += "</div>";
        host.innerHTML =
          '<div class="pp-paper" style="aspect-ratio:' + w + "/" + h + '">' + inner + "</div>";
      }

      /* Word-style Layout Designer dialog */
      function openLayoutDesigner() {
        const host = document.createElement("div");
        host.className = "ui-modal";
        host.innerHTML = `<div class="ui-modal-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Layout designer">

              </div></div>
              <div class="rt-cmgrid">
                <label>Column width <input class="ui-input" type="number" min="0" max="12" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal" data-lw placeholder="auto"><span>in · 0 = auto</span></label>
                <label>Gap <input class="ui-input" type="number" min="0" max="120" step="1" inputmode="numeric" data-lg><span>px</span></label>
              </div>
              <div class="rt-cmpresets">
                <button type="button" class="mf-chip" data-tog="colSpace">Space between</button>
                <button type="button" class="mf-chip" data-tog="colLine">Line between</button>
                <button type="button" class="mf-chip" data-tog="colMargin">Column margins</button>
              </div>
              <p class="rt-cmnote">Custom width shrinks the text area so columns are exactly that wide, centred on the page.</p>
            </div>
            <div data-lm-panel="rows" class="rt-lpanel">
              <div class="mf-row"><span class="mf-label">Rows</span><div class="mf-chips">
                ${[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((n) => `<button type="button" class="mf-chip" data-lr="${n}">${n}</button>`).join("")}
              </div></div>
              <div class="rt-cmgrid">
                <label>Row gap <input class="ui-input" type="number" min="0" max="120" step="1" inputmode="numeric" data-lgr><span>px</span></label>
              </div>
              <p class="rt-cmnote">Rows divide the page into horizontal bands. Tap inside a band to write.</p>
            </div>
            <div data-lm-panel="grid" class="rt-lpanel">
              <div class="mf-row"><span class="mf-label">Columns</span><div class="mf-chips">
                ${[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((n) => `<button type="button" class="mf-chip" data-lgc="${n}">${n}</button>`).join("")}
              </div></div>
              <div class="mf-row"><span class="mf-label">Rows</span><div class="mf-chips">
                ${[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((n) => `<button type="button" class="mf-chip" data-lrg="${n}">${n}</button>`).join("")}
              </div></div>
              <div class="rt-cmgrid">
                <label>Gap <input class="ui-input" type="number" min="0" max="120" step="1" inputmode="numeric" data-lgg><span>px</span></label>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div data-lm-panel="free" class="rt-lpanel">
              <div class="rt-lbb-list"></div>
              <button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-primary" data-addbox>+ Add box</button>
              <p class="rt-cmnote">Each box can be an <b>overlay layer</b> (floating canvas box - drag & resize) or an <b>in-line box</b> (inside the text - writing continues below it). In-line boxes appear under "In text" below.</p>
              <div class="rt-inline-list" data-inline></div>
            </div>
            <div class="rt-layers" data-layers></div>
            <div class="ui-modal-a"><button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-primary" data-x>Done</button></div>
          </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(host);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => host.classList.add("in"));
        const close = wireModal(host);

        const applyAll = () => {
          applyPageSetup();
          if (docMode !== "page") applyDocMode("page");
        };
        const renderFreeList = () => {
          const list = host.querySelector(".rt-lbb-list");
          if (!list) return;
          list.innerHTML = (pageSetup.boxes || [])
            .map(
              (b, i) =>
                '<div class="rt-lbb" data-bi="' + i + '">' +
                  '<div class="rt-lbb-grid">' +
                    '<label>X <input class="ui-input" type="number" min="0" max="24" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal" data-bx="' + i + '" value="' + (b.x || 0) + '"></label>' +
                    '<label>Y <input class="ui-input" type="number" min="0" max="24" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal" data-by="' + i + '" value="' + (b.y || 0) + '"></label>' +
                    '<label>W <input class="ui-input" type="number" min="0.2" max="24" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal" data-bw="' + i + '" value="' + (b.w || 2) + '"></label>' +
                    '<label>H <input class="ui-input" type="number" min="0.2" max="24" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal" data-bh="' + i + '" value="' + (b.h || 2) + '"></label>' +
                  '</div>' +
                  '<div class="rt-lbb-row">' +
                    '<select class="ui-input" data-bs="' + i + '">' +
                      '<option value="rect"' + (b.shape === "rect" ? " selected" : "") + '>Rectangle</option>' +
                      '<option value="rounded"' + (b.shape === "rounded" ? " selected" : "") + '>Rounded</option>' +
                      '<option value="ellipse"' + (b.shape === "ellipse" ? " selected" : "") + '>Ellipse</option>' +
                      '<option value="circle"' + (b.shape === "circle" ? " selected" : "") + '>Circle</option>' +
                    '</select>' +
                    '<select class="ui-input" data-bm="' + i + '">' +
                      [0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5].map((m) => '<option value="' + m + '"' + ((b.margin || 0) === m ? " selected" : "") + '>' + (m === 0 ? "No inner margin" : m + ' in margin') + "</option>").join("") +
                    '</select>' +
                    '<select class="ui-input" data-bmd="' + i + '" aria-label="Layout mode">' +
                      '<option value="overlay"' + (b.mode !== "inline" ? " selected" : "") + '>Overlay layer</option>' +
                      '<option value="inline"' + (b.mode === "inline" ? " selected" : "") + '>In line (text flows below)</option>' +
                    '</select>' +
                    '<button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-danger" data-bdel="' + i + '">✕ Remove</button>' +
                  '</div>' +
                '</div>',
            )
            .join("");
        };
        const refreshPanels = () => {
          host.querySelectorAll("[data-lm]").forEach((b) =>
            b.classList.toggle("is-on", b.dataset.lm === pageSetup.layoutMode),
          );
          ["columns", "rows", "grid", "free"].forEach((m) => {
            const pan = host.querySelector('[data-lm-panel="' + m + '"]');
            if (pan) pan.style.display = pageSetup.layoutMode === m ? "block" : "none";
          });
          host.querySelectorAll("[data-lc]").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("is-on", +b.dataset.lc === pageSetup.columns));
          host.querySelectorAll("[data-lr]").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("is-on", +b.dataset.lr === pageSetup.rows));
          host.querySelectorAll("[data-lgc]").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("is-on", +b.dataset.lgc === pageSetup.columns));
          host.querySelectorAll("[data-lrg]").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("is-on", +b.dataset.lrg === pageSetup.rows));
          host.querySelectorAll("[data-tog]").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("is-on", !!pageSetup[b.dataset.tog]));
          const lw = host.querySelector("[data-lw]");
          if (lw) lw.value = pageSetup.colWidth || "";
          const lg = host.querySelector("[data-lg]");
          if (lg) lg.value = pageSetup.colGap;
          const lgr = host.querySelector("[data-lgr]");
          if (lgr) lgr.value = pageSetup.rowGap;
          const lgg = host.querySelector("[data-lgg]");
          if (lgg) lgg.value = pageSetup.colGap;
          renderFreeList();
          renderLayers();
          renderInlineList();
          const pv = host.querySelector("[data-preview]");
          if (pv) renderPagePreview(pv);
        };
        /* In-line boxes already placed in the document flow */
        const renderInlineList = () => {
          const box = host.querySelector("[data-inline]");
          if (!box) return;
          const q = typeof quill !== "undefined" ? quill : null;
          const els = q && q.root ? q.root.querySelectorAll(".docbox") : [];
          if (!els.length) {
            box.innerHTML = "";
            return;
          }
          box.innerHTML =
            '<div class="rt-layers-h">In text (' + els.length + ")</div>" +
            [...els]
              .map((el, i) =>
                '<div class="rt-lbb" data-ib="' + i + '">' +
                  '<div class="rt-lbb-grid">' +
                    '<label>W <input class="ui-input" type="number" min="0.5" max="12" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal" data-iw="' + i + '" value="' + (parseFloat(el.dataset.w) || 3) + '"></label>' +
                    '<label>H <input class="ui-input" type="number" min="0.4" max="12" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal" data-ih="' + i + '" value="' + (parseFloat(el.dataset.h) || 1.5) + '"></label>' +
                  '</div>' +
                  '<div class="rt-lbb-row">' +
                    '<select class="ui-input" data-iss="' + i + '">' +
                      '<option value="rect"' + ((el.dataset.shape || "rect") === "rect" ? " selected" : "") + '>Rectangle</option>' +
                      '<option value="rounded"' + (el.dataset.shape === "rounded" ? " selected" : "") + '>Rounded</option>' +
                      '<option value="ellipse"' + (el.dataset.shape === "ellipse" ? " selected" : "") + '>Ellipse</option>' +
                      '<option value="circle"' + (el.dataset.shape === "circle" ? " selected" : "") + '>Circle</option>' +
                    '</select>' +
                    '<select class="ui-input" data-ism="' + i + '">' +
                      [0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5].map((m) => '<option value="' + m + '"' + ((parseFloat(el.dataset.margin) || 0) === m ? " selected" : "") + '>' + (m === 0 ? "No inner margin" : m + ' in margin') + "</option>").join("") +
                    '</select>' +
                    '<button type="button" class="ui-btn" data-tooverlay="' + i + '">⤴ To overlay</button>' +
                  '</div>' +
                '</div>',
              )
              .join("");
        };
        /* Canvas-like layer list: order (z), visibility, lock, duplicate */
        const renderLayers = () => {
          const box = host.querySelector("[data-layers]");
          if (!box) return;
          if (pageSetup.layoutMode !== "free" || !(pageSetup.boxes || []).length) {
            box.innerHTML = "";
            return;
          }
          box.innerHTML =
            '<div class="rt-layers-h">Layers</div>' +
            pageSetup.boxes
              .map(
                (b, i) =>
                  '<div class="rt-layer" data-li="' + i + '">' +
                    '<button type="button" class="rt-lb" data-lup="' + i + '" aria-label="Bring forward">↑</button>' +
                    '<button type="button" class="rt-lb" data-ldown="' + i + '" aria-label="Send backward">↓</button>' +
                    '<span class="rt-layer-name">' + ((b.html || "").replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "").slice(0, 18) || ("Box " + (i + 1))) + '</span>' +
                    '<button type="button" class="rt-lb" data-lk="' + i + '" aria-label="' + (b.locked ? "Unlock" : "Lock") + '">' + (b.locked ? "🔒" : "🔓") + "</button>" +
                    '<button type="button" class="rt-lb" data-lv="' + i + '" aria-label="' + (b.hidden ? "Show" : "Hide") + '">' + (b.hidden ? "◌" : "●") + "</button>" +
                    '<button type="button" class="rt-lb" data-ldup="' + i + '" aria-label="Duplicate">⧉</button>' +
                    '<button type="button" class="rt-lb rt-lb-danger" data-bdel="' + i + '" aria-label="Delete">✕</button>' +
                  "</div>",
              )
              .join("");
        };

        host.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          const lm = e.target.closest("[data-lm]");
          if (lm) {
            pageSetup.layoutMode = lm.dataset.lm;
            if (lm.dataset.lm === "single") pageSetup.columns = 1;
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
            /* New layout = new beginning: bring the paper top into view */
            const surf = document.querySelector(".rt-surface");
            if (surf) surf.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
            return;
          }
          const lc = e.target.closest("[data-lc]");
          if (lc) {
            pageSetup.columns = +lc.dataset.lc;
            pageSetup.layoutMode = "columns";
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const lr = e.target.closest("[data-lr]");
          if (lr) {
            pageSetup.rows = +lr.dataset.lr;
            pageSetup.layoutMode = "rows";
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const lgc = e.target.closest("[data-lgc]");
          if (lgc) {
            pageSetup.columns = +lgc.dataset.lgc;
            pageSetup.layoutMode = "grid";
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const lrg = e.target.closest("[data-lrg]");
          if (lrg) {
            pageSetup.rows = +lrg.dataset.lrg;
            pageSetup.layoutMode = "grid";
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const tog = e.target.closest("[data-tog]");
          if (tog) {
            pageSetup[tog.dataset.tog] = !pageSetup[tog.dataset.tog];
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const add = e.target.closest("[data-addbox]");
          if (add) {
            /* Default is IN-LINE: the box joins the document flow and text
               continues below it. Use the Layout select (or ⤵/⤴) to float
               a box as an overlay layer. */
            const q = typeof quill !== "undefined" ? quill : null;
            if (q) {
              insertInlineBox(q, { w: 3, h: 1.5, html: "" });
              if (docMode !== "page") applyDocMode("page");
              refreshPanels();
              docToast("In-line box added - text flows below it");
            }
            return;
          }
          const del = e.target.closest("[data-bdel]");
          if (del) {
            pageSetup.boxes.splice(+del.dataset.bdel, 1);
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const lup = e.target.closest("[data-lup]");
          if (lup) {
            const i = +lup.dataset.lup;
            if (i > 0) {
              const arr = pageSetup.boxes;
              [arr[i - 1], arr[i]] = [arr[i], arr[i - 1]];
            }
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const ldown = e.target.closest("[data-ldown]");
          if (ldown) {
            const i = +ldown.dataset.ldown;
            const arr = pageSetup.boxes;
            if (i < arr.length - 1) {
              [arr[i + 1], arr[i]] = [arr[i], arr[i + 1]];
            }
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const lk = e.target.closest("[data-lk]");
          if (lk) {
            const i = +lk.dataset.lk;
            pageSetup.boxes[i].locked = !pageSetup.boxes[i].locked;
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const lv = e.target.closest("[data-lv]");
          if (lv) {
            const i = +lv.dataset.lv;
            pageSetup.boxes[i].hidden = !pageSetup.boxes[i].hidden;
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const ldup = e.target.closest("[data-ldup]");
          if (ldup) {
            const i = +ldup.dataset.ldup;
            const b = pageSetup.boxes[i];
            pageSetup.boxes.push(
              Object.assign({}, b, {
                x: (b.x || 0) + 0.2,
                y: (b.y || 0) + 0.2,
                html: "",
                locked: false,
                hidden: false,
              }),
            );
            refreshPanels();
            applyAll();
          }
        });
        host.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
          const iw = e.target.closest("[data-iw]");
          if (iw) {
            const el = document.querySelectorAll(".docbox")[+iw.dataset.iw];
            if (el) {
              const w = Math.min(12, Math.max(0.5, parseFloat(iw.value) || 3));
              el.style.width = Math.round(w * 96 * ((parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(".rt-shell")).getPropertyValue("--doc-zoom")) || 1))) + "px";
              el.dataset.w = w;
            }
            return;
          }
          const ih = e.target.closest("[data-ih]");
          if (ih) {
            const el = document.querySelectorAll(".docbox")[+ih.dataset.ih];
            if (el) {
              const h = Math.min(12, Math.max(0.4, parseFloat(ih.value) || 1.5));
              el.style.minHeight = Math.round(h * 96 * ((parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(".rt-shell")).getPropertyValue("--doc-zoom")) || 1))) + "px";
              el.dataset.h = h;
            }
            return;
          }
          const box = ["bx", "by", "bw", "bh"].map((k) => e.target.closest("[data-" + k + "]")).find(Boolean);
          if (box) {
            const k = Object.keys(box.dataset)[0];
            const i = +box.dataset[k];
            pageSetup.boxes = pageSetup.boxes || [];
            if (!pageSetup.boxes[i]) pageSetup.boxes[i] = { x: 1, y: 1, w: 2, h: 2, shape: "rect", margin: 0.1, html: "" };
            const key = k === "bx" ? "x" : k === "by" ? "y" : k === "bw" ? "w" : "h";
            pageSetup.boxes[i][key] = Math.max(0, parseFloat(box.value) || 0);
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const lw = e.target.closest("[data-lw]");
          if (lw) {
            pageSetup.colWidth = Math.max(0, parseFloat(lw.value) || 0);
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const lg = e.target.closest("[data-lg]");
          if (lg) {
            pageSetup.colGap = Math.max(0, Math.min(120, parseFloat(lg.value) || 0));
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const lgr = e.target.closest("[data-lgr]");
          if (lgr) {
            pageSetup.rowGap = Math.max(0, Math.min(120, parseFloat(lgr.value) || 0));
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const lgg = e.target.closest("[data-lgg]");
          if (lgg) {
            pageSetup.colGap = Math.max(0, Math.min(120, parseFloat(lgg.value) || 0));
            applyAll();
          }
        });
        host.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
          const bs = e.target.closest("[data-bs]");
          if (bs) {
            const i = +bs.dataset.bs;
            if (pageSetup.boxes[i]) pageSetup.boxes[i].shape = bs.value;
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const bm = e.target.closest("[data-bm]");
          if (bm) {
            const i = +bm.dataset.bm;
            if (pageSetup.boxes[i]) pageSetup.boxes[i].margin = parseFloat(bm.value) || 0;
            applyAll();
            return;
          }
          const bmd = e.target.closest("[data-bmd]");
          if (bmd) {
            if (bmd.value === "inline") convertBoxToInline(+bmd.dataset.bmd);
            else {
              if (pageSetup.boxes[+bmd.dataset.bmd]) pageSetup.boxes[+bmd.dataset.bmd].mode = "overlay";
              applyAll();
            }
            refreshPanels();
            return;
          }
          const tooverlay = e.target.closest("[data-tooverlay]");
          if (tooverlay) {
            const el = document.querySelectorAll(".docbox")[+tooverlay.dataset.tooverlay];
            if (el) convertInlineToOverlay(el);
            refreshPanels();
          }
        });
        host.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
          const iss = e.target.closest("[data-iss]");
          if (iss) {
            const el = document.querySelectorAll(".docbox")[+iss.dataset.iss];
            if (el) el.dataset.shape = iss.value;
            return;
          }
          const ism = e.target.closest("[data-ism]");
          if (ism) {
            const el = document.querySelectorAll(".docbox")[+ism.dataset.ism];
            if (el) el.dataset.margin = parseFloat(ism.value) || 0;
          }
        });
        refreshPanels();
      }

      /* Hyphenation toggle */
      let hyphenOn = false;
      function toggleHyphenation() {
        hyphenOn = !hyphenOn;
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) =>
          sh.classList.toggle("hyphenate", hyphenOn),
        );
        docToast(hyphenOn ? "Hyphenation on" : "Hyphenation off");
      }
      /* Multi-column break inserter */
      function insertColumnBreak(q) {
        /* Inserts column break blot */
        if (pageSetup.columns < 2) {
          uiDialog({
            title: "Single column",
            message: "Column breaks need a multi-column layout. Switch to two columns?",
            okLabel: "2 columns",
            cancelLabel: "Cancel",
            onOk: () => {
              pageSetup.columns = 2;
              applyPageSetup();
              applyDocMode("page");
              const r = q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength() - 1 };
              q.insertEmbed(r.index, "colbreak", true, "user");
              docToast("Column break inserted");
            },
          });
          return;
        }
        const r = q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength() - 1 };
        q.insertEmbed(r.index, "colbreak", true, "user");
        q.setSelection(r.index + 1, 0);
        docToast("Column break inserted");
      }

      /* References Tab Actions (Table of Contents, Captions, Citations) */
      let endnoteN = 0;
      function insertEndnote(q) {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r) return;
        endnoteN++;
        q.insertText(r.index, `[e${endnoteN}]`, { script: "super", color: "#0891b2" }, "user");
        const end = q.getLength();
        q.insertText(end - 1, `\n[e${endnoteN}] Endnote text…`, { size: "12px", color: "#64748b" }, "user");
        docToast("Endnote added");
      }

      const citations = [];
      function addCitation(q) {
        uiDialog({
          title: "Add source",
          fields: [
            { label: "Author", value: "", placeholder: "Surname, First" },
            { label: "Title", value: "", placeholder: "Work title" },
            { label: "Year", value: "", placeholder: "2026" },
          ],
          okLabel: "Insert citation",
          onOk: (v) => {
            if (!v[0] && !v[1]) return;
            citations.push({ author: v[0], title: v[1], year: v[2] });
            const r = q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength() - 1 };
            const tag = `(${v[0].split(",")[0] || "Anon"}${v[2] ? ", " + v[2] : ""})`;
            q.insertText(r.index, tag, "user");
            docToast("Citation inserted");
          },
        });
      }

      function insertBibliography(q) {
        if (!citations.length) return docToast("Add a source first", "warn");
        let html = '<h2>References</h2>';
        citations
          .slice()
          .sort((a, b) => a.author.localeCompare(b.author))
          .forEach((c) => {
            html += `<p>${escapeHTMLText(c.author)}${c.year ? " (" + escapeHTMLText(c.year) + ")" : ""}. <em>${escapeHTMLText(c.title)}</em>.</p>`;
          });
        q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(q.getLength() - 1, html, "user");
        docToast("Bibliography inserted");
      }

      function insertTableOfFigures(q) {
        const caps = [...q.root.querySelectorAll(".doc-caption")];
        if (!caps.length) return docToast("No captions found", "warn");
        let html = '<h2>Table of figures</h2>';
        caps.forEach((c) => (html += `<p>${escapeHTMLText(c.textContent)}</p>`));
        q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(q.getLength() - 1, html, "user");
        docToast("Table of figures inserted");
      }

      const indexEntries = [];
      function markIndexEntry(q) {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r || !r.length) return docToast("Select a word to index", "warn");
        const term = q.getText(r.index, r.length).trim();
        if (term && !indexEntries.includes(term)) indexEntries.push(term);
        q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "background", "#e0e7ff", "user");
        docToast(`"${term}" marked`);
      }
      function insertIndex(q) {
        if (!indexEntries.length) return docToast("Mark some entries first", "warn");
        let html = "<h2>Index</h2>";
        indexEntries.slice().sort().forEach((t) => (html += `<p>${escapeHTMLText(t)}</p>`));
        q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(q.getLength() - 1, html, "user");
        docToast("Index inserted");
      }

      /* Review Tab Actions (Thesaurus, Translation, Track Changes, Word Count) */
      const THESAURUS = {
        good: ["excellent", "fine", "great", "superb", "worthy"],
        bad: ["poor", "inferior", "substandard", "unsatisfactory"],
        big: ["large", "considerable", "substantial", "sizeable"],
        small: ["little", "compact", "minor", "modest"],
        important: ["crucial", "vital", "significant", "essential"],
        show: ["display", "demonstrate", "reveal", "present"],
        make: ["create", "produce", "construct", "build"],
        use: ["employ", "utilise", "apply", "operate"],
        help: ["assist", "aid", "support", "facilitate"],
        fast: ["quick", "rapid", "swift", "speedy"],
      };

      function openThesaurus(q) {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (!r || !r.length) return docToast("Select a word", "warn");
        const word = q.getText(r.index, r.length).trim().toLowerCase();
        const syn = THESAURUS[word];
        const host = document.createElement("div");
        host.className = "ui-modal";
        host.innerHTML = `<div class="ui-modal-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Thesaurus">
            <div class="ui-modal-h">Thesaurus — “${escapeHTMLText(word)}”</div>
            ${
              syn
                ? `<div class="rt-syn">${syn.map((x) => `<button type="button" class="rt-synb" data-w="${x}">${x}</button>`).join("")}</div>`
                : `<div class="ui-modal-m">No synonyms stored for this word. The built-in list covers common words only.</div>`
            }
            <div class="ui-modal-a"><button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-ghost" data-x>Close</button></div>
          </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(host);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => host.classList.add("in"));
        const close = wireModal(host);
        host.querySelectorAll(".rt-synb").forEach((b) =>
          b.addEventListener("click", () => {
