      function rejectAllChanges(q) {
        const marks = q.root.querySelectorAll(".trk-ins");
        if (!marks.length) return docToast("No tracked changes", "warn");
        /* Backward index iteration for tracked revisions */
        const spans = [...marks].reverse();
        spans.forEach((sp) => {
          const blot = Quill.find(sp);
          if (!blot) return;
          const idx = q.getIndex(blot);
          q.deleteText(idx, sp.textContent.length, "user");
        });
        docToast("Changes rejected");
      }

      function gotoChange(q, dir) {
        const marks = [...q.root.querySelectorAll(".trk-ins, .trk-del")];
        if (!marks.length) return docToast("No tracked changes", "warn");
        const sel = q.getSelection() || { index: 0 };
        const positions = marks
          .map((m) => { const b = Quill.find(m); return b ? q.getIndex(b) : -1; })
          .filter((x) => x >= 0)
          .sort((a, b) => a - b);
        const next = dir > 0
          ? positions.find((p) => p > sel.index) ?? positions[0]
          : [...positions].reverse().find((p) => p < sel.index) ?? positions[positions.length - 1];
        q.setSelection(next, 1);
        docToast("Change " + (positions.indexOf(next) + 1) + " of " + positions.length);
      }

      /**
       * Universal Draggable Slider & Scrubber Component.
       * Supports touch drag, pointer capture, stepper auto-repeat, direct number input, and quick presets.
       */
      function uiSlider(opts) {
        const min = typeof opts.min === "number" ? opts.min : 0;
        const max = typeof opts.max === "number" ? opts.max : 100;
        const step = typeof opts.step === "number" ? opts.step : 1;
        const unit = opts.unit || "";
        const formatVal = typeof opts.formatValue === "function" ? opts.formatValue : (v) => v + unit;

        let currentVal = typeof opts.value === "number" ? opts.value : (opts.parseValue ? opts.parseValue(opts.value) : parseFloat(opts.value) || min);
        currentVal = Math.max(min, Math.min(max, currentVal));

        const el = document.createElement("div");
        el.className = "ui-slider-card" + (opts.className ? " " + opts.className : "");

        const presetsHtml = (opts.presets || [])
          .map((p) => `<button type="button" class="ui-slider-chip${p.val === currentVal ? " on" : ""}" data-val="${p.val}">${p.label}</button>`)
          .join("");

        el.innerHTML = `
          <div class="ui-slider-header">
            <div class="ui-slider-label-group">
              <span class="ui-slider-label">${opts.label || "Value"}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="ui-slider-ctrls">
              <button type="button" class="ui-slider-btn ui-slider-dec" aria-label="Decrease ${opts.label || "value"}">−</button>
              <div class="ui-slider-val-badge">
                <input type="text" class="ui-slider-input" value="${formatVal(currentVal)}" aria-label="${opts.label || "value"} input" />
              </div>
              <button type="button" class="ui-slider-btn ui-slider-inc" aria-label="Increase ${opts.label || "value"}">+</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="ui-slider-track-wrap" tabindex="0" role="slider" aria-valuemin="${min}" aria-valuemax="${max}" aria-valuenow="${currentVal}" aria-label="${opts.label || "value"}">
            <div class="ui-slider-track">
              <div class="ui-slider-fill"></div>
              <div class="ui-slider-thumb">
                <div class="ui-slider-tip">${formatVal(currentVal)}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          ${presetsHtml ? `<div class="ui-slider-presets">${presetsHtml}</div>` : ""}
        `;

        const trackWrap = el.querySelector(".ui-slider-track-wrap");
        const track = el.querySelector(".ui-slider-track");
        const fill = el.querySelector(".ui-slider-fill");
        const thumb = el.querySelector(".ui-slider-thumb");
        const tip = el.querySelector(".ui-slider-tip");
        const input = el.querySelector(".ui-slider-input");
        const decBtn = el.querySelector(".ui-slider-dec");
        const incBtn = el.querySelector(".ui-slider-inc");

        const syncUI = (val, emit) => {
          currentVal = Math.max(min, Math.min(max, val));
          const fraction = (max === min) ? 0 : (currentVal - min) / (max - min);
          const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, fraction * 100));
          fill.style.width = pct + "%";
          thumb.style.left = pct + "%";
          const formatted = formatVal(currentVal);
          tip.textContent = formatted;
          if (document.activeElement !== input) {
            input.value = formatted;
          }
          trackWrap.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", String(currentVal));
          el.querySelectorAll(".ui-slider-chip").forEach((chip) => {
            const cv = parseFloat(chip.dataset.val);
            chip.classList.toggle("on", Math.abs(cv - currentVal) < 0.001);
          });
          if (emit && typeof opts.onChange === "function") {
            opts.onChange(currentVal, formatted);
          }
        };

        syncUI(currentVal, false);

        const setFromClientX = (clientX, emit) => {
          const rect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (rect.width <= 0) return;
          const fraction = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width));
          const rawVal = min + fraction * (max - min);
          const stepped = Math.round((rawVal - min) / step) * step + min;
          const precision = step < 0.1 ? 2 : step < 1 ? 1 : 0;
          const finalVal = parseFloat(stepped.toFixed(precision));
          syncUI(finalVal, emit);
        };

        let isDragging = false;
        let activePointerId = null;

        const startDrag = (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          isDragging = true;
          activePointerId = e.pointerId !== undefined ? e.pointerId : null;
          thumb.classList.add("dragging");
          el.classList.add("is-dragging");
          if (e.pointerId !== undefined && trackWrap.setPointerCapture) {
            try {
              trackWrap.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
            } catch (_) {}
          }
          const clientX = e.clientX !== undefined ? e.clientX : (e.touches && e.touches[0] ? e.touches[0].clientX : 0);
          setFromClientX(clientX, true);
        };

        const moveDrag = (e) => {
          if (!isDragging) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          const clientX = e.clientX !== undefined ? e.clientX : (e.touches && e.touches[0] ? e.touches[0].clientX : 0);
          setFromClientX(clientX, true);
        };

        const stopDrag = (e) => {
          if (!isDragging) return;
          isDragging = false;
          thumb.classList.remove("dragging");
          el.classList.remove("is-dragging");
          const pId = (e && e.pointerId !== undefined) ? e.pointerId : activePointerId;
          activePointerId = null;
          if (pId !== null && pId !== undefined && trackWrap.releasePointerCapture) {
            try {
              if (trackWrap.hasPointerCapture && trackWrap.hasPointerCapture(pId)) {
                trackWrap.releasePointerCapture(pId);
              }
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        };

        trackWrap.addEventListener("pointerdown", startDrag);
        trackWrap.addEventListener("pointermove", moveDrag);
        trackWrap.addEventListener("pointerup", stopDrag);
        trackWrap.addEventListener("pointercancel", stopDrag);
        trackWrap.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", stopDrag);

        trackWrap.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
          if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowDown") {
            e.preventDefault();
            syncUI(currentVal - step, true);
          } else if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
            e.preventDefault();
            syncUI(currentVal + step, true);
          } else if (e.key === "Home") {
            e.preventDefault();
            syncUI(min, true);
          } else if (e.key === "End") {
            e.preventDefault();
            syncUI(max, true);
          }
        });

        const bindStepper = (btn, delta) => {
          let timer = null;
          let interval = null;
          const stepOnce = () => {
            const precision = step < 0.1 ? 2 : step < 1 ? 1 : 0;
            const next = parseFloat((currentVal + delta * step).toFixed(precision));
            syncUI(next, true);
          };
          const startStep = (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            stepOnce();
            timer = setTimeout(() => {
              interval = setInterval(stepOnce, 60);
            }, 280);
          };
          const clearStep = () => {
            if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
            if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
            timer = null;
            interval = null;
          };
          btn.addEventListener("pointerdown", startStep);
          btn.addEventListener("pointerup", clearStep);
          btn.addEventListener("pointercancel", clearStep);
          btn.addEventListener("pointerleave", clearStep);
        };

        bindStepper(decBtn, -1);
        bindStepper(incBtn, 1);

        const applyInputVal = () => {
          const raw = input.value.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, "");
          const parsed = parseFloat(raw);
          if (!isNaN(parsed)) {
            syncUI(parsed, true);
          } else {
            input.value = formatVal(currentVal);
          }
        };
        input.addEventListener("change", applyInputVal);
        input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter") {
            e.preventDefault();
            applyInputVal();
            input.blur();
          }
        });
        input.addEventListener("focus", () => input.select());

        el.querySelectorAll(".ui-slider-chip").forEach((chip) => {
          chip.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            const val = parseFloat(chip.dataset.val);
            syncUI(val, true);
          });
        });

        el.setValue = (val) => syncUI(val, false);
        el.getValue = () => currentVal;

        return el;
      }

            pop.classList.add("open");
            docPortal.open(pop, btn, { alignRight: false, matchWidth: false });
          }
        };

        let fBtnTouchX = 0, fBtnTouchY = 0, fBtnMoved = false;
        fontColBtn.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) {
            fBtnTouchX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            fBtnTouchY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            fBtnMoved = false;
          }
        }, { passive: true });
        fontColBtn.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) {
            if (Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientX - fBtnTouchX) > 6 || Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientY - fBtnTouchY) > 6) {
              fBtnMoved = true;
            }
          }
        }, { passive: true });
        fontColBtn.onclick = (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (fBtnMoved) { fBtnMoved = false; return; }
          toggleFdColorPop(fontColPop, fontColBtn);
        };

        let uBtnTouchX = 0, uBtnTouchY = 0, uBtnMoved = false;
        ulineColBtn.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) {
            uBtnTouchX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            uBtnTouchY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            uBtnMoved = false;
          }
        }, { passive: true });
        ulineColBtn.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) {
            if (Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientX - uBtnTouchX) > 6 || Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientY - uBtnTouchY) > 6) {
              uBtnMoved = true;
            }
          }
        }, { passive: true });
        ulineColBtn.onclick = (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (uBtnMoved) { uBtnMoved = false; return; }
          toggleFdColorPop(ulineColPop, ulineColBtn);
        };

        document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          if (!e.target.closest(".fd-color-control") && !e.target.closest(".fd-col-pop")) {
            closeFdColorPops();
          }
        });

        fontColPop.addEventListener("click", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
        ulineColPop.addEventListener("click", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

        [fontColPop, ulineColPop].forEach((pop) => {
          pop.querySelectorAll(".fd-sw-item").forEach((sw) => {
            sw.onclick = (e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              const target = sw.closest(".fd-sw-matrix").dataset.target;
              draft[target] = sw.dataset.c;
              paint();
              closeFdColorPops();
            };
          });

          pop.querySelectorAll(".fd-col-auto").forEach((btn) => {
            btn.onclick = (e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              const target = btn.dataset.auto;
              draft[target] = target === "color" ? "#000000" : "";
              paint();
              closeFdColorPops();
            };
          });

          pop.querySelectorAll(".fd-col-custom").forEach((btn) => {
            btn.onclick = (e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              const target = btn.dataset.cust;
              const slotId = target === "color" ? "#fd-font-custom-slot" : "#fd-uline-custom-slot";
              const slot = pop.querySelector(slotId);
              if (!slot) return;
              if (slot.firstChild) {
                slot.innerHTML = "";
                docPortal.place(pop, target === "color" ? fontColBtn : ulineColBtn, { alignRight: false, matchWidth: false });
                return;
              }
              slot.appendChild(
                uiColorPicker(draft[target] || "#000000", (hex) => {
                  draft[target] = hex;
                  slot.innerHTML = "";
                  paint();
                  closeFdColorPops();
                })
              );
              docPortal.place(pop, target === "color" ? fontColBtn : ulineColBtn, { alignRight: false, matchWidth: false });
            };
          });
        });

        host.querySelectorAll(".fd-tab").forEach((t) =>
          t.addEventListener("click", () => {
            host.querySelectorAll(".fd-tab").forEach((x) => {
              x.classList.toggle("on", x === t);
              x.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(x === t));
            });
            host.querySelectorAll(".fd-panel").forEach((p) =>
              p.classList.toggle("on", p.dataset.fdp === t.dataset.fd)
            );
          })
        );

        mountFontDialogSelects(host, [
          { key: "font", options: DOC_FONTS, value: draft.font },
          {
            key: "style",
            options: [["", "Regular"], ["b", "Bold"], ["i", "Italic"], ["bi", "Bold italic"]],
            value: draft.bold && draft.italic ? "bi" : draft.bold ? "b" : draft.italic ? "i" : "",
            onPick: (v) => { draft.bold = v.includes("b"); draft.italic = v.includes("i"); },
          },
          { key: "uline", options: UNDERLINE_GALLERY, value: draft.uline },
          { key: "otf", options: OTF_SETS, value: draft.otf },
        ], (key, val, onPick) => {
          if (onPick) onPick(val);
          else draft[key] = val;
          paint();
        });

        // 1. Mount Font Size Slider
        const sizeSlot = host.querySelector('[data-slot="size-slider"]');
        if (sizeSlot) {
          const sizeVal = parseInt(draft.size) || 16;
          const sizeSlider = uiSlider({
            label: "Font Size",
            value: sizeVal,
            min: 8,
            max: 96,
            step: 1,
            unit: "px",
            formatValue: (v) => v + "px",
            presets: [
              { label: "12px", val: 12 }, { label: "14px", val: 14 },
              { label: "16px", val: 16 }, { label: "18px", val: 18 },
              { label: "24px", val: 24 }, { label: "32px", val: 32 },
              { label: "48px", val: 48 }, { label: "64px", val: 64 },
            ],
            onChange: (v) => {
              draft.size = v + "px";
              paint();
            },
          });
          sizeSlot.replaceWith(sizeSlider);
        }

        // 2. Mount Character Scale Slider
        const scaleSlot = host.querySelector('[data-slot="scalex-slider"]');
        if (scaleSlot) {
          let scaleNum = 100;
          if (draft.scalex) {
            const m = draft.scalex.match(/scaleX\(([^)]+)\)/);
            if (m) scaleNum = Math.round(parseFloat(m[1]) * 100);
          }
          const scaleSlider = uiSlider({
            label: "Character Scaling",
            value: scaleNum,
            min: 30,
            max: 250,
            step: 1,
            unit: "%",
            formatValue: (v) => v + "%",
            presets: [
              { label: "50%", val: 50 }, { label: "66%", val: 66 },
              { label: "80%", val: 80 }, { label: "100%", val: 100 },
              { label: "120%", val: 120 }, { label: "150%", val: 150 },
              { label: "200%", val: 200 },
            ],
            onChange: (v) => {
              draft.scalex = v === 100 ? "" : `scaleX(${(v / 100).toFixed(2)})`;
              paint();
            },
          });
          scaleSlot.replaceWith(scaleSlider);
        }

        // 3. Mount Spacing / Tracking Slider
        const trackingSlot = host.querySelector('[data-slot="tracking-slider"]');
        if (trackingSlot) {
          let trackNum = 0;
          if (draft.tracking && draft.tracking !== "normal") {
            if (draft.tracking.includes("px")) trackNum = parseFloat(draft.tracking) || 0;
            else if (draft.tracking.includes("em")) trackNum = Math.round((parseFloat(draft.tracking) || 0) * 16);
          }
          const trackSlider = uiSlider({
            label: "Character Spacing (Tracking)",
            value: trackNum,
            min: -4,
            max: 16,
            step: 0.5,
            unit: "px",
            formatValue: (v) => (v === 0 ? "Normal (0px)" : (v > 0 ? `+${v}px` : `${v}px`)),
            presets: [
              { label: "Tight (-2px)", val: -2 }, { label: "Normal (0)", val: 0 },
              { label: "Loose (+2px)", val: 2 }, { label: "Expanded (+5px)", val: 5 },
              { label: "Wide (+10px)", val: 10 },
            ],
            onChange: (v) => {
              draft.tracking = v === 0 ? "normal" : `${v}px`;
              paint();
            },
          });
          trackingSlot.replaceWith(trackSlider);
        }

        // 4. Mount Baseline Position Shift Slider
        const vposSlot = host.querySelector('[data-slot="vpos-slider"]');
        if (vposSlot) {
          let posNum = 0;
          if (draft.vpos) posNum = parseFloat(draft.vpos) || 0;
          const vposSlider = uiSlider({
            label: "Baseline Shift (Position)",
            value: posNum,
            min: -15,
            max: 15,
            step: 1,
            unit: "px",
            formatValue: (v) => (v === 0 ? "Normal (0px)" : (v > 0 ? `Raised +${v}px` : `Lowered ${v}px`)),
            presets: [
              { label: "Lowered (-6px)", val: -6 }, { label: "Lowered (-3px)", val: -3 },
              { label: "Normal (0)", val: 0 }, { label: "Raised (+3px)", val: 3 },
              { label: "Raised (+6px)", val: 6 },
            ],
            onChange: (v) => {
              draft.vpos = v === 0 ? "" : `${v}px`;
              paint();
            },
          });
          vposSlot.replaceWith(vposSlider);
        }

        host.querySelectorAll("[data-e]").forEach((cb) =>
          cb.addEventListener("change", () => {
            const k = cb.dataset.e;
            if (k === "super" || k === "sub") {
              draft.script = cb.checked ? k : "";
              host.querySelectorAll('[data-e="super"],[data-e="sub"]').forEach((o) => {
                if (o !== cb) o.checked = false;
              });
            } else draft[k] = cb.checked;
            paint();
          })
        );

        const close = wireModal(host, () => q.focus());
        host.querySelector("[data-ok]").onclick = () => {
          q.setSelection(range.index, range.length, "silent");
          const F = (k, v) => q.format(k, v, "user");
          F("font", draft.font);
          F("size", draft.size);
          F("bold", draft.bold);
          F("italic", draft.italic);
          F("color", draft.color || false);
          applyUnderlineFull(q, draft.uline, draft.ucolor);
          F("strike", draft.strike);
          if (draft.dstrike) { F("deco", "line-through"); F("ustyle", "double"); }
          F("script", draft.script || false);
          F("caps", draft.smallcaps ? "small-caps" : false);
          F("allcaps", draft.allcaps ? "uppercase" : false);
          F("hiddentext", draft.hidden ? "on" : false);
          F("scalex", draft.scalex || false);
          F("tracking", draft.tracking === "normal" ? false : draft.tracking);
          F("vpos", draft.vpos || false);
          F("otf", draft.otf || false);
          F("kern", draft.kern ? false : "none");
          close();
          docToast("Font applied");
        };
      }

      /**
       * Mounts custom portal-rendered listbox dropdowns inside dialog placeholder slots.
       */
      function mountFontDialogSelects(host, specs, onChange) {
        specs.forEach((spec) => {
          const slot = host.querySelector(`[data-slot="${spec.key}"]`);
          if (!slot) return;
          const widget = uiSelect({
            value: spec.value,
            options: spec.options,
            title: spec.key,
            onPick: (v) => onChange(spec.key, v, spec.onPick),
          });
          widget.style.width = "100%";
          widget.style.flex = "1 1 auto";
          slot.replaceWith(widget);
        });
      }

      /**
       * Shared modal dialog manager with keyboard focus trapping and ARIA attributes.
       */
      function wireModal(host, onClose) {
        const close = () => {
          host.remove();
          document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
          if (onClose) onClose();
        };
        function onKey(e) {
          if (e.key === "Escape") {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            close();
            return;
          }
          if (e.key !== "Tab") return;
          const f = [
            ...host.querySelectorAll(
              "button,select,input,.ui-sel,[tabindex]:not([tabindex='-1'])",
            ),
          ].filter((el) => el.offsetParent !== null);
          if (!f.length) return;
          const first = f[0];
          const last = f[f.length - 1];
          if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
            e.preventDefault();
            last.focus();
          } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
            e.preventDefault();
            first.focus();
          }
        }
        document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
        host.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
          if (e.target === host) close();
        });
        host.querySelectorAll("[data-x]").forEach((x) => {
          x.onclick = close;
        });
        setTimeout(() => {
          const f = host.querySelector("select,input,button,.ui-sel");
          if (f) f.focus();
        }, 60);
        return close;
      }

      /**
       * Opens the Paragraph Formatting Dialog (Alignment, Indentation, Line Spacing, Margins) with Draggable Sliders.
       */
      function openParagraphDialog(q) {
        const range = q.getSelection() || { index: 0, length: 0 };
        const cur = q.getFormat(range);
        const host = document.createElement("div");
        host.className = "ui-modal";
        const slot = (k) => `<span class="fd-slot" data-slot="${k}"></span>`;
        host.innerHTML = `
          <div class="ui-modal-card fd-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Paragraph">
            <div class="fd-header">
              <div class="ui-modal-h">Paragraph & Spacing</div>
              <button type="button" class="fd-close" data-x aria-label="Close">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div class="fd-panel on">
              <div class="fd-row">
                <label class="fd-f"><span>Alignment</span>${slot("align")}</label>
                <label class="fd-f"><span>Outline level</span>${slot("header")}</label>
                <label class="fd-f"><span>Direction</span>${slot("direction")}</label>
              </div>
              <div class="fd-row">

              </div>
              <div class="fd-row">

                <label class="fd-f"><span>Border</span>${slot("pborder")}</label>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="fd-prev-wrap">
              <span class="fd-legend">Preview</span>
              <div class="fd-prev"><p class="fd-prev-p">Paragraph text sample. Professional document layout and typography preview.</p></div>
            </div>
            <div class="ui-modal-a">
              <button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-ghost" data-x>Cancel</button>
              <button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-primary" data-ok>Apply</button>
            </div>
          </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(host);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => host.classList.add("in"));

        const draft = {
          align: cur.align || "",
          header: cur.header ? String(cur.header) : "",
          direction: cur.direction || "",
          indent: cur.indent ? String(cur.indent) : "",
          spbefore: cur.spbefore || "0px",
          spafter: cur.spafter || "0px",
          lineheight: cur.lineheight || "1.5",
          shading: cur.shading || "",
          pborder: cur.pborder || "",
        };

        const pv = host.querySelector(".fd-prev-p");
        const paint = () => {
          pv.style.cssText = "";
          pv.style.textAlign = draft.align || "left";
          pv.style.marginTop = draft.spbefore;
          pv.style.marginBottom = draft.spafter;
          pv.style.lineHeight = draft.lineheight;
          pv.style.paddingLeft = (Number(draft.indent || 0) * 22) + "px";
          if (draft.shading) pv.style.background = draft.shading;
          pv.style.direction = draft.direction === "rtl" ? "rtl" : "ltr";
          pv.className = "fd-prev-p" + (draft.pborder ? " pb-" + draft.pborder : "");
        };
        paint();

        mountFontDialogSelects(host, [
          { key: "align", options: [["", "Left"], ["center", "Centre"], ["right", "Right"], ["justify", "Justified"]], value: draft.align },
          { key: "header", options: [["", "Body text"], ["1", "Level 1"], ["2", "Level 2"], ["3", "Level 3"]], value: draft.header },
          { key: "direction", options: [["", "Left to right"], ["rtl", "Right to left"]], value: draft.direction },
          { key: "shading", options: [["", "None"], ["#f1f5f9", "Light grey"], ["#fef3c7", "Light yellow"], ["#dbeafe", "Light blue"], ["#dcfce7", "Light green"]], value: draft.shading },
          { key: "pborder", options: [["", "None"], ["bottom", "Bottom"], ["top", "Top"], ["left", "Left bar"], ["all", "Box outline"]], value: draft.pborder },
        ], (key, val) => {
          draft[key] = val;
          paint();
        });

        // Mount Line Spacing Slider
        const lhSlot = host.querySelector('[data-slot="lineheight-slider"]');
        if (lhSlot) {
          const lhSlider = uiSlider({
            label: "Line Spacing",
            value: parseFloat(draft.lineheight) || 1.5,

            formatValue: (v) => Number(v).toFixed(2) + "×",
            presets: [
              { label: "1.0", val: 1.0 }, { label: "1.15", val: 1.15 },
              { label: "1.25", val: 1.25 }, { label: "1.5", val: 1.5 },
              { label: "2.0", val: 2.0 }, { label: "2.5", val: 2.5 },
              { label: "3.0", val: 3.0 },

            onChange: (v) => {
              draft.lineheight = String(v);
              paint();

          lhSlot.replaceWith(lhSlider);
        }

        // Mount Indent Slider
        const indentSlot = host.querySelector('[data-slot="indent-slider"]');
        if (indentSlot) {
          const indentSlider = uiSlider({
            label: "Indent Level",
            value: parseInt(draft.indent) || 0,
            min: 0,
            max: 6,
            step: 1,
            unit: "",
            formatValue: (v) => "Level " + v,
            presets: [
              { label: "0", val: 0 }, { label: "1", val: 1 },
              { label: "2", val: 2 }, { label: "3", val: 3 },
              { label: "4", val: 4 }, { label: "5", val: 5 },

            onChange: (v) => {
              draft.indent = v === 0 ? "" : String(v);

        const spBeforeSlot = host.querySelector('[data-slot="spbefore-slider"]');

            label: "Space Before (Top Margin)",
            value: parseFloat(draft.spbefore) || 0,
            min: 0,
            max: 48,
            step: 2,
            unit: " pt",
            formatValue: (v) => v + " pt",
            presets: [
              { label: "0 pt", val: 0 }, { label: "6 pt", val: 6 },
              { label: "12 pt", val: 12 }, { label: "18 pt", val: 18 },
              { label: "24 pt", val: 24 }, { label: "36 pt", val: 36 },
            ],
            onChange: (v) => {
              draft.spbefore = v + "px";
              paint();
            },
          });
          spBeforeSlot.replaceWith(spBeforeSlider);
        }

        // Mount Space After Slider
        const spAfterSlot = host.querySelector('[data-slot="spafter-slider"]');
        if (spAfterSlot) {
          const spAfterSlider = uiSlider({
            label: "Space After (Bottom Margin)",
            value: parseFloat(draft.spafter) || 0,

            max: 48,
            step: 2,
            unit: " pt",
            formatValue: (v) => v + " pt",
            presets: [
              { label: "0 pt", val: 0 }, { label: "6 pt", val: 6 },
              { label: "12 pt", val: 12 }, { label: "18 pt", val: 18 },
              { label: "24 pt", val: 24 }, { label: "36 pt", val: 36 },
            ],
            onChange: (v) => {
              draft.spafter = v + "px";
              paint();
            },
          });
          spAfterSlot.replaceWith(spAfterSlider);
        }

        const close = wireModal(host, () => q.focus());
        host.querySelector("[data-ok]").onclick = () => {
          q.setSelection(range.index, range.length, "silent");
          q.format("align", draft.align || false, "user");
          q.format("header", draft.header ? Number(draft.header) : false, "user");
          q.format("direction", draft.direction || false, "user");
          q.format("indent", draft.indent ? Number(draft.indent) : false, "user");
          q.format("spbefore", draft.spbefore, "user");
          q.format("spafter", draft.spafter, "user");
          q.format("lineheight", draft.lineheight, "user");
          q.format("shading", draft.shading || false, "user");
          q.format("pborder", draft.pborder || false, "user");
          close();
          docToast("Paragraph applied");
        };
      }

      /* ---------------------------------------------------------------

      const DOC_FONTS = [

      /**
       * Generates full HTML markup for the ribbon toolbar and tab panels.
       * @param {string} id Unique editor instance identifier.
       * @returns {string} Toolbar HTML markup string.
       */
      /* Single-row toolbar panel layout */
      const RIBBON_TABS = [
        ["home", "Home"],
        ["insert", "Insert"],
        ["design", "Design"],
        ["layout", "Layout"],
        ["refs", "References"],
        ["review", "Review"],

      function richToolbarHTML(id) {
        const pop = (key, label, body, cls = "") => `
          <div class="rt-pop-wrap">
            <button type="button" class="rt-b ${cls}" data-pop="${key}" data-tip="${label}" aria-label="${label}" aria-expanded="false">${
              cls.includes("wide") ? "" : ""
            }${body.trigger}</button>

              <div class="rt-pop-h">${label}</div>${body.panel}

        return `
        <div class="rt-ribbon" id="${id}-ribbon">

          <div class="rt-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Editor sections">
            ${RIBBON_TABS.map(

      /* Editor Instance Factory */
      function createRichEditor(mountSel, id, placeholder) {
        registerRichFormats();
        const mount = document.querySelector(mountSel);
        if (!mount) return null;

        /* Editor container shell */
        const shell = document.createElement("div");
        shell.className = "rt-shell mode-" + docMode;
        mount.parentNode.insertBefore(shell, mount);

        const holder = document.createElement("div");
        holder.innerHTML = richToolbarHTML(id);
        while (holder.firstElementChild) shell.appendChild(holder.firstElementChild);
        bindRibbonTabs(shell);

        const surface = document.createElement("div");
        surface.className = "rt-surface";
        shell.appendChild(surface);
        surface.appendChild(mount);

        /* Floating dock controls */
        const dock = document.createElement("div");
        dock.className = "rt-dock";
        dock.innerHTML = `
          <button type="button" class="rt-dock-b" data-dock="exit" data-tip="Back to editing" aria-label="Back to editing">
            <svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-pencil"/></svg>
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="rt-dock-b" data-dock="zoom-out" data-tip="Smaller text" aria-label="Smaller text">A<span>-</span></button>
          <span class="rt-dock-z" aria-live="polite">100%</span>
          <button type="button" class="rt-dock-b" data-dock="zoom-in" data-tip="Larger text" aria-label="Larger text">A<span>+</span></button>
          <button type="button" class="rt-dock-b" data-dock="page-prev" data-tip="Previous page" aria-label="Previous page">‹</button>
          <span class="rt-dock-p" aria-live="polite">1/1</span>
          <button type="button" class="rt-dock-b" data-dock="page-next" data-tip="Next page" aria-label="Next page">›</button>
          <button type="button" class="rt-dock-b" data-dock="modes" data-tip="Change writing mode" aria-label="Change writing mode">
            <svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-layer"/></svg>
          </button>`;
        shell.appendChild(dock);

        const stats = document.createElement("div");
        stats.className = "rt-stats";
        shell.appendChild(stats);

        const q = new Quill(mountSel, {
          theme: "snow",
          placeholder: placeholder || "Start writing…",
          modules: {
            toolbar: false,
            history: { delay: 700, maxStack: 200, userOnly: true },
            /* Configures Quill history module for user-initiated actions only */
          },
        });

        bindDock(dock, shell, q);
        bindRichToolbar(shell.querySelector(".rt-ribbon"), q, id, shell);
        bindDocShortcuts(q, shell, id);
        bindAutoCorrect(q);
        bindTrackChanges(q);
        q.root.setAttribute("spellcheck", "true");
        bindMarkdown(q);
        bindSmartPaste(q);
        bindSlashMenu(q);
        bindTableKeys(q); /* Table cell navigation with Tab / Shift+Tab */
        bindLinkTooltip(q); /* Hyperlink interaction handler */
        bindEditorContextMenu(q, id); /* Custom context menu trigger */
        bindChecklistToggle(q); /* Checklist toggle handler */
        q.on("text-change", () => snapshotDoc(q));
        bindInlineBoxInteractions(q.root);
        applyDocMode(docMode);
        applyPageSetup();
        updateDocStats();
        return q;
      }

      /* Ribbon Toolbar Event Dispatch & Formatting State Reflection */

      /**
       * Central action dispatch table for all ribbon buttons and dropdown commands.
       */
      /* Feedback toast helper */
      let toastTimer = 0;
      function docToast(msg, kind) {
        let t = document.querySelector(".rt-toast");
        if (!t) {
          t = document.createElement("div");
          t.className = "rt-toast";
          document.body.appendChild(t);
        }
        t.textContent = msg;
        t.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
        t.className = "rt-toast on" + (kind ? " " + kind : "");
        clearTimeout(toastTimer);
        toastTimer = window.setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove("on"), 2200);
      }

      /* Selection-dependent action wrapper */
      function needsSelection(fn, hint) {
        return (ctx) => {
          const r = ctx.q.getSelection();
          if (!r || !r.length) {
            docToast(hint || "Select some text first", "warn");
            return;
          }
          fn(ctx);
        };
      }

      const DOC_ACTIONS = {
        /* History and basic formatting */
        undo: ({ q }) => q.history.undo(),
        redo: ({ q }) => q.history.redo(),
        clean: ({ q, range }) =>
          range && range.length
            ? q.removeFormat(range.index, range.length)
            : q.removeFormat(0, q.getLength()),
        find: ({ shell }) => toggleFindPanel(shell),

        /* Character formatting */
        dstrike: needsSelection(
          ({ q }) => {
            applyDoubleStrike(q);
            docToast("Double strikethrough applied");
          },
          "Select the text to strike through",
        ),
        painter: ({ q, btn }) => {
          const r = q.getSelection();
          if (!paintedFormat && (!r || !r.length)) {
            docToast("Select formatted text to copy from", "warn");
            return;
          }
          toggleFormatPainter(q, btn);
          docToast(paintedFormat ? "Now select where to apply" : "Format painter off");
        },
        /* Format matching from caret position */
        selectsim: ({ q }) => selectSimilar(q),

        /* Paragraph formatting */
        multilevel: ({ q }) => {
          applyMultilevel(q);
          docToast("Multilevel numbering on - use Tab to demote");
        },
        marks: ({ btn }) => {
          toggleFormattingMarks();
          btn.classList.toggle("on", showMarks);
          docToast(showMarks ? "Formatting marks shown" : "Formatting marks hidden");
        },
        "ind-in": ({ q }) => {
          nudgeIndent(q, 1);
          docToast("Indent " + ((q.getFormat(q.getSelection() || {}).indent) || 0));
        },
        "ind-out": ({ q }) => {
          const cur = (q.getFormat(q.getSelection() || {}).indent) || 0;
          if (!cur) return docToast("Already at the left margin", "warn");
          nudgeIndent(q, -1);
          docToast("Indent " + (cur - 1));
        },
        rtl: ({ q, range, btn }) => {
          const cur = q.getFormat(range || {}).direction;
          const next = cur === "rtl" ? false : "rtl";
          q.format("direction", next);
          q.format("align", next ? "right" : false);
          if (btn) btn.classList.toggle("on", !!next);
          docToast(next ? "Right-to-left text" : "Left-to-right text");
        },

        /* Insert actions */
        link: ({ q, range, id }) => richAction(q, "link", range, id),
        image: ({ q, range, id }) => richAction(q, "image", range, id),
        video: ({ q, range, id }) => richAction(q, "video", range, id),
        hr: ({ q, range }) => {
          const at = range ? range.index : q.getLength();
          q.insertEmbed(at, "hr", true, "user");
          q.setSelection(at + 1, 0);
        },
        pagebreak: ({ q, range }) => {
          const at = range ? range.index : q.getLength();
          q.insertEmbed(at, "pagebreak", true, "user");
          q.setSelection(at + 1, 0);
        },
        symbol: ({ q }) => openSymbolPicker(q),
        equation: ({ q }) => openEquation(q),
        chart: ({ q }) => insertChart(q),
        template: ({ q }) => openTemplatePicker(q),
        cover: ({ q }) => insertCoverPage(q),
        dropcap: ({ q }) => {
          toggleDropCap(q);
          docToast("Drop cap toggled");
        },
        footnote: ({ q }) => insertFootnote(q),
        datetime: ({ q, range }) => {
          const now = new Date();
          const at = range ? range.index : q.getLength() - 1;
          q.insertText(
            at,
            now.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" }) +
              " " + now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
            "user",
          );
        },

        /* Layout actions */
        pagesetup: ({ shell }) => openPageSetup(shell),
        lineno: () => {
          pageSetup.lineNumbers = !pageSetup.lineNumbers;
          applyPageSetup();
          docToast(
            pageSetup.lineNumbers
              ? pageSetup.columns > 1
                ? "Line numbers need a single column"
                : "Line numbers on"
              : "Line numbers off",
            pageSetup.lineNumbers && pageSetup.columns > 1 ? "warn" : "",
          );
        },
        ruler: ({ btn }) => {
          toggleRuler();
          btn.classList.toggle("on", showRuler);
          docToast(showRuler ? "Ruler shown" : "Ruler hidden");
        },
        watermark: ({ q }) => setWatermark(q),
        header: () => editHeaderFooter("header"),
        footer: () => editHeaderFooter("footer"),
        pagenum: ({ btn }) => {
          togglePageNumbers();
          btn.classList.toggle("on", pageChrome.numbers);
          docToast(
            pageChrome.numbers
              ? "Page numbers on - visible in Page mode"
              : "Page numbers off",
          );
        },

        /* References actions */
        toc: ({ q }) => insertTOC(q),
        nav: ({ q, btn }) => {
          toggleNavPane(q);
          btn.classList.toggle("on", navOpen);
        },
        bookmark: ({ q }) => addBookmark(q),
        pagebreakToast: null,
        bookmarks: ({ q }) => openBookmarks(q),
        props: ({ q }) => openDocProperties(q),

        /* Review actions */
        spell: ({ q, btn }) => toggleSpellCheck(q, btn),
        wordcount: ({ q }) => openWordCount(q),
        comment: needsSelection(({ q }) => addComment(q), "Select the text to comment on"),
        comments: ({ btn }) => {
          toggleCommentPane();
          btn.classList.toggle("on", commentPaneOpen);
        },
        track: ({ q, btn }) => toggleTrackChanges(q, btn),
        accept: ({ q }) => {
          if (!q.root.querySelector(".trk-ins, .trk-del"))
            return docToast("No tracked changes to accept", "warn");
          acceptAllChanges(q);
          docToast("All changes accepted", "ok");
        },
        readaloud: ({ q, btn }) => {
          toggleReadAloud(q);
          btn.classList.toggle("on", speaking);
        },
        pastespecial: ({ q }) => pasteSpecial(q),
        outline: ({ q }) => openDocOutline(q),
        history: ({ q }) => openVersionHistory(q),
        goal: () => setDocGoal(),

        /* Clipboard command cluster */
        cut: ({ q }) => docCut(q),
        copy: ({ q }) => docCopy(q),
        /* Copies formatted text as Markdown or HTML */
        copymd: ({ q }) => {
          const s = window.getSelection();
          const div = document.createElement("div");
          if (s && s.rangeCount && !s.getRangeAt(0).collapsed)
            div.appendChild(s.getRangeAt(0).cloneContents());
          const md = htmlToMarkdown(div.innerHTML) || q.getText();
          (navigator.clipboard
            ? navigator.clipboard.writeText(md).then(
                () => docToast(div.innerHTML ? "Selection copied as Markdown" : "Document copied as Markdown"),
                () => docToast("Copy blocked by browser", "warn"),
              )
            : Promise.reject()
          ).catch(() => docToast("Copy blocked by browser", "warn"));
        },
        copyhtml: ({ q }) => {
          const s = window.getSelection();
          if (!s || !s.rangeCount) return docToast("Nothing selected", "warn");
          const r = s.getRangeAt(0);
          const div = document.createElement("div");
          div.appendChild(r.cloneContents());
          if (!div.innerHTML) return docToast("Nothing to copy", "warn");
          (navigator.clipboard
            ? navigator.clipboard.writeText(div.innerHTML).then(
                () => docToast("Selection copied as HTML"),
                () => docToast("Copy blocked by browser", "warn"),
              )
            : Promise.reject()
          ).catch(() => docToast("Copy blocked by browser", "warn"));
        },
        paste: ({ q }) => docPaste(q, false),
        pastetext: ({ q }) => docPaste(q, true),

        /* Editing command cluster */
        replace: ({ shell }) => {
          toggleFindPanel(shell);
          const rr = shell.querySelector(".rt-find-r");
          if (rr) setTimeout(() => rr.focus(), 120);
        },
        selectall: ({ q }) => openSelectMenu(q),

        /* Dialog launcher buttons */
        fontdlg: ({ q }) => openFontDialog(q),
        paradlg: ({ q }) => openParagraphDialog(q),
        smallcaps: ({ q }) => {
          const r = q.getSelection();
          if (!r || !r.length) return docToast("Select some text first", "warn");
          const on = q.getFormat(r).caps === "small-caps";
          q.format("caps", on ? false : "small-caps", "user");
          docToast(on ? "Small caps off" : "Small caps");
        },
        allcaps: ({ q }) => {
          const r = q.getSelection();
          if (!r || !r.length) return docToast("Select some text first", "warn");
          const on = q.getFormat(r).allcaps === "uppercase";
          q.format("allcaps", on ? false : "uppercase", "user");
          docToast(on ? "All caps off" : "ALL CAPS");
        },

        /* Font size adjustments */
        grow: ({ q }) => stepFontSize(q, 1),
        shrink: ({ q }) => stepFontSize(q, -1),

        /* Design tab commands */
        themes: () => openThemePicker(),
        pageborder: ({ q }) => {
          /* Page border application action */
          const host = document.createElement("div");
          host.className = "ui-modal";
          host.innerHTML = `<div class="ui-modal-card ui-modal-slim" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Page borders">
            <div class="ui-modal-h">Page borders</div>
            <div class="rt-pbgrid">${PAGE_BORDERS.map(
              ([k, l]) =>
                `<button type="button" class="rt-exp" data-pb="${k}">${l}</button>`,
            ).join("")}</div>
            <div class="ui-modal-a"><button type="button" class="ui-btn ui-ghost" data-x>Close</button></div>
          </div>`;
          document.body.appendChild(host);
          requestAnimationFrame(() => host.classList.add("in"));
          const close = wireModal(host);
          host.querySelectorAll("[data-pb]").forEach((b) =>
            b.addEventListener("click", () => {
              setPageBorder(b.dataset.pb);
              if (docMode !== "page") applyDocMode("page");
              close();
            }),
          );
        },

        /* Layout tab commands */
        hyphen: ({ btn }) => {
          toggleHyphenation();
          btn.classList.toggle("on", hyphenOn);
        },
        colbreak: ({ q }) => insertColumnBreak(q),
        layoutdesigner: () => {
          openLayoutDesigner();
        },
        inlinebox: ({ q }) => {
          insertInlineBox(q, {});
          applyDocMode("page");
          docToast("In-line box inserted - text flows below it");
        },

        /* References tab commands */
        endnote: ({ q }) => insertEndnote(q),
        citation: ({ q }) => addCitation(q),
        biblio: ({ q }) => insertBibliography(q),
        figures: ({ q }) => insertTableOfFigures(q),
        markindex: ({ q }) => markIndexEntry(q),
        insindex: ({ q }) => insertIndex(q),

        /* Review tab commands */
        thesaurus: ({ q }) => openThesaurus(q),
        translate: ({ q }) => translateHint(q),
        reject: ({ q }) => rejectAllChanges(q),
        nextchange: ({ q }) => gotoChange(q, 1),
        prevchange: ({ q }) => gotoChange(q, -1),
        protect: ({ q, btn }) => toggleProtect(q, btn),

        /* View tab commands */
        gridlines: ({ btn }) => {
          toggleGridlines();
          btn.classList.toggle("on", gridOn);
        },
        "zoom-100": () => zoomPreset(100),
        "zoom-fit": () => zoomPreset("page"),

        /* View mode commands */
        "zoom-in": () => {
          if (docZoom >= 200) return docToast("Maximum zoom", "warn");
          applyDocZoom(docZoom + 10);
          docToast(docZoom + "%");
        },
        "zoom-out": () => {
          const floor = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches ? 40 : 60;
          if (docZoom <= floor) return docToast("Minimum zoom", "warn");
          applyDocZoom(docZoom - 10);
          docToast(docZoom + "%");
        },
        "zoom-reset": () => {
          applyDocZoom(100);
          docToast("Zoom reset to 100%");
        },
        shortcuts: () => openShortcutSheet(),
      };

      /* Highlights the active Margin / Orientation / Size option in the
         Layout tab popovers so the current page setup is always visible. */
      function syncLayoutPops(bar) {
        if (!bar) return;
        const groups = { mrg: pageSetup.margin, ori: pageSetup.orient, sz: pageSetup.size };
        bar.querySelectorAll("[data-mrg],[data-ori],[data-sz]").forEach((b) => {
          const g = b.dataset.mrg !== undefined ? "mrg" : b.dataset.ori !== undefined ? "ori" : "sz";
          b.classList.toggle("on", b.dataset[g] === groups[g]);
        });
      }

      function bindRichToolbar(bar, q, id, shell) {
        let lastRange = { index: 0, length: 0 };
        const remember = () => {
          const r = q.getSelection();
          if (r) lastRange = r;
          return lastRange;
        };
        q.on("selection-change", (r) => {
          if (r) lastRange = r;
          syncRichToolbar(bar, q, lastRange);
          syncHistoryButtons(bar, q);
        });
        q.on("text-change", () => {
          syncRichToolbar(bar, q, q.getSelection() || lastRange);
          syncHistoryButtons(bar, q);
          updateDocStats();
        });
        q.on("editor-change", () => {
          if (docMode === "focus") markFocusLine(q);
          bindImageQuickBar(q); /* Image quick-size presets */
        });

        const focusBack = () => {
          q.focus();
          q.setSelection(lastRange.index, lastRange.length, "silent");
        };

        /* Custom listboxes for ribbon controls */
        const selStyles = uiSelect({
          value: "normal",
          width: "128px",
          title: "Paragraph styles",
          options: DOC_STYLES.map(([v, l]) => [v, l]),
          onPick: (v) => {
            remember();
            applyDocStyle(q, v);
            focusBack();
          },
        });
        selStyles.classList.add("rt-styles");
        const slotStyles = bar.querySelector('[data-slot="styles"]');
        if (slotStyles) slotStyles.append(selStyles);

        const selFont = uiSelect({
          value: "Inter",
          width: "114px",
          title: "Font family",
          options: DOC_FONTS.map(([v, l]) => [v, l, `font-family:'${v}'`]),
          onPick: (v) => { remember(); q.format("font", v || false, "user"); focusBack(); },
        });
        selFont.classList.add("rt-font");
        const slotFont = bar.querySelector('[data-slot="font"]');
        if (slotFont) slotFont.replaceWith(selFont);

        const selSize = uiSelect({
          value: "16px",
          width: "74px",
          title: "Font size",
          options: DOC_SIZES.map((v) => [v, v.replace("px", "")]),
          onPick: (v) => { remember(); q.format("size", v || false, "user"); focusBack(); },
        });
        selSize.classList.add("rt-size");
        const slotSize = bar.querySelector('[data-slot="size"]');
        if (slotSize) slotSize.replaceWith(selSize);

        const selLH = uiSelect({
          value: "1.5",
          width: "78px",
          title: "Line spacing",
          options: [["1", "↕ 1.0"], ["1.15", "↕ 1.15"], ["1.5", "↕ 1.5"],
                    ["2", "↕ 2.0"], ["2.5", "↕ 2.5"], ["3", "↕ 3.0"]],
          onPick: (v) => { remember(); q.format("lineheight", v || false, "user"); focusBack(); },
        });
        selLH.classList.add("rt-lh");
        const slotLH = bar.querySelector('[data-slot="lh"]');
        if (slotLH) slotLH.replaceWith(selLH);

        const selMode = uiSelect({
          value: docMode,
          width: "112px",
          title: "Writing mode",
          options: DOC_MODES.map(([v, l]) => [v, l]),
          onPick: (v) => applyDocMode(v),
        });
        selMode.classList.add("rt-mode");
        const slotMode = bar.querySelector('[data-slot="mode"]');
        if (slotMode) slotMode.replaceWith(selMode);

        /* Layout column listboxes */
        const selCols = uiSelect({
          value: String(pageSetup.columns),
          width: "104px",
          title: "Text columns",
          options: [["1", "1 column"], ["2", "2 columns"], ["3", "3 columns"], ["more", "More…"]],
          onPick: (v) => {
            if (v === "more") {
              openCustomColumns();
              return;
            }
            pageSetup.columns = Number(v);
            applyPageSetup();
          },
        });
        const slotCols = bar.querySelector('[data-slot="cols"]');
        if (slotCols) slotCols.replaceWith(selCols);

        const selMeasure = uiSelect({
          value: safeStore.getItem("docMeasure") || "74ch",
          width: "112px",
          title: "Line width",
          options: [["60ch", "Narrow text"], ["74ch", "Standard text"], ["92ch", "Wide text"], ["none", "Full width"]],
          onPick: (v) => {
            safeStore.setItem("docMeasure", v);
            document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
              sh.style.setProperty("--doc-measure", v === "none" ? "none" : v);
            });
          },
        });
        const slotMeasure = bar.querySelector('[data-slot="measure"]');
        if (slotMeasure) slotMeasure.replaceWith(selMeasure);
        document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
          const mv = safeStore.getItem("docMeasure") || "74ch";
          sh.style.setProperty("--doc-measure", mv === "none" ? "none" : mv);
        });

        bar._sel = { block: selStyles, font: selFont, size: selSize, lh: selLH };

        /* Color popovers custom color picker */
        bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-more").forEach((btn) => {
          btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const kind = btn.dataset.kind;
            /* Portal-rendered color picker query */
            const pop = btn.closest(".rt-pop");
            const slot = (pop && pop.querySelector(`.rt-cpslot[data-kind="${kind}"]`))
              || bar.querySelector(`.rt-cpslot[data-kind="${kind}"]`);
            if (!slot) return;
            if (slot.firstChild) {
              slot.innerHTML = "";
              return;
            }
            slot.appendChild(
              uiColorPicker(kind === "text" ? "#000000" : "#ffff00", (hex) => {
                applyRichColour(q, lastRange, kind, hex, id);
                slot.innerHTML = "";
                closeRichPops(bar);
                focusBack();
              }),
            );
          });
        });

        /* Change case menu triggers */
        /* Delegated Popover Event Handlers */
        const POP_ITEMS = {
          uline: (v) => applyUnderlineFull(q, v),
          ucolor: (v) => applyUnderlineFull(q, "solid", v),
          fx: (v) => q.format("textfx", v || false, "user"),
          track: (v) => q.format("tracking", v === "normal" ? false : v, "user"),
          bul: (v) => applyBulletChar(q, v),
          num: (v) => applyNumberFormat(q, v),
          pb: (v) => q.format("pborder", v === "none" ? false : v, "user"),
          spb: (v) => q.format("spbefore", v, "user"),
          spa: (v) => q.format("spafter", v, "user"),
          shade: (v) => q.format("shading", v, "user"),
          box: (v) => {
            const rr = q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength() - 1 };
            q.insertEmbed(rr.index, "callout", { kind: v }, "user");
          },
          sort: (v) => sortSelection(q, v),
          pgcol: (v) => setPageColour(v),
          cap: (v) => insertCaption(q, v),
          exp: (v) => exportDoc(q, v),
          pasteopt: (v) => docPaste(q, v === "plain"),
          ss: (v) => applyStyleSet(v),
          thmcol: (v) => setAccentColour(v),
          thmfont: (v) => setHeadingFont(v),
          docspacing: (v) => setDocSpacing(v),
          mrg: (v) => setMargins(v),
          ori: (v) => setOrientation(v),
          sz: (v) => setPaperSize(v),
          pgb: (v) => setPageBorder(v),
          pgbcol: (v) => setPageBorderColor(v),
        };

        /* Document-level delegated click listener */
        /* Registered lifecycle cleanup */
        let isPopTouchScrolling = false;
        let popTouchStartY = 0;

        docBind(document, "touchstart", (e) => {
          if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".rt-pop, .ui-sel-list")) {
            if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) popTouchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            isPopTouchScrolling = false;
          }
        }, { passive: true });

        docBind(document, "touchmove", (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches[0] && Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientY - popTouchStartY) > 5) {
            isPopTouchScrolling = true;
          }
        }, { passive: true });

        docBind(document, "click", (e) => {
          if (isPopTouchScrolling) {
            isPopTouchScrolling = false;
            return;
          }
          const el = e.target.closest(
            "[data-uline],[data-ucolor],[data-fx],[data-track],[data-bul],[data-num],[data-pb]," +
            "[data-spb],[data-spa],[data-box],[data-sort],[data-pgcol],[data-cap],[data-exp]," +
            "[data-pasteopt],[data-ss],[data-thmcol],[data-thmfont],[data-docspacing],[data-mrg]," +
            "[data-ori],[data-sz],[data-pgb],[data-pgbcol]"
          );
          if (!el) return;
          /* Editor scoping check */
          const owner = el.closest(".rt-portal") || el.closest(".rt-ribbon");
          if (!owner) return;
          if (owner.classList.contains("rt-ribbon") && owner !== bar) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          for (const key in POP_ITEMS) {
            const v = el.getAttribute("data-" + key);
            if (v !== null) {
              q.setSelection(lastRange.index, lastRange.length, "silent");
              POP_ITEMS[key](v);
              break;
            }
          }
          closeRichPops(bar);
          focusBack();
        });

        /* Color swatch clicks */
        bar.querySelectorAll("[data-case]").forEach((b) => {
          b.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            transformCase(q, b.dataset.case);
            closeRichPops(bar);
          });
        });

        /* Export menu handler */
        /* Validates export action target */
        bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-exp[data-exp]").forEach((b) => {
          b.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            exportDoc(q, b.dataset.exp);
            closeRichPops(bar);
          });
        });

        /* Find and replace handler */
        if (shell) {
          const fp = shell.querySelector(".rt-find");
          if (fp) {
            const qi = fp.querySelector(".rt-find-q");
            qi.addEventListener("input", () => runFind(shell, qi.value, 0));
            qi.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") {
                e.preventDefault();
                runFind(shell, qi.value, findState.at + (e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1));
              } else if (e.key === "Escape") toggleFindPanel(shell);
            });
            fp.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
              const b = e.target.closest("[data-find]");
              if (!b) return;
              const a = b.dataset.find;
              if (a === "next") runFind(shell, qi.value, findState.at + 1);
              else if (a === "prev") runFind(shell, qi.value, findState.at - 1);
              else if (a === "one") runReplace(shell, false);
              else if (a === "all") runReplace(shell, true);
              else if (a === "close") toggleFindPanel(shell);
            });
          }
          /* Intercepts Ctrl+F for in-app search */
          shell.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
            if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "f") {
              e.preventDefault();
              toggleFindPanel(shell);
            }
          });
        }

        /* Table dimension grid selector (8x8) builder with touch scrub support */
        const tgrid = bar.querySelector(".rt-tgrid");
        const tlabel = bar.querySelector(".rt-tlabel");
        if (tgrid) {
          let activeGridRows = 1;
          let activeGridCols = 1;

          const highlightGrid = (r, c) => {
            activeGridRows = r;
            activeGridCols = c;
            tgrid.querySelectorAll(".rt-tcell").forEach((x) => {
              x.classList.toggle("on", +x.dataset.r <= r && +x.dataset.c <= c);
            });
            if (tlabel) tlabel.textContent = `${r} × ${c} Table`;
          };

          for (let r = 1; r <= 8; r++) {
            for (let c = 1; c <= 8; c++) {
              const cell = document.createElement("button");
              cell.type = "button";
              cell.className = "rt-tcell";
              cell.dataset.r = r;
              cell.dataset.c = c;
              cell.setAttribute("aria-label", `${r} by ${c} table`);
              cell.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => highlightGrid(r, c));
              cell.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                insertDocTable(q, remember(), r, c);
                closeRichPops(bar);
              });
              tgrid.appendChild(cell);
            }
          }

          /* Touch dragging / scrubbing support on mobile table grid */
          const handleGridTouch = (e) => {
            if (!e.touches || !e.touches[0]) return;
            const touch = e.touches[0];
            const target = document.elementFromPoint(touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
            const cell = target && target.closest ? target.closest(".rt-tcell") : null;
            if (cell && cell.dataset.r && cell.dataset.c) {
              highlightGrid(+cell.dataset.r, +cell.dataset.c);
            }
          };

          tgrid.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
            handleGridTouch(e);
          }, { passive: true });

          tgrid.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault(); // Prevents vertical modal scroll while picking grid size
            handleGridTouch(e);
          }, { passive: false });

          tgrid.addEventListener("touchend", (e) => {
            if (activeGridRows >= 1 && activeGridCols >= 1) {
              insertDocTable(q, remember(), activeGridRows, activeGridCols);
              closeRichPops(bar);
            }
          });
        }

        /* Popover trigger button handlers with touch scroll guard */
        let ribbonTouchX = 0;
        let ribbonTouchY = 0;
        let ribbonScrolled = false;

        bar.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) {
            ribbonTouchX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            ribbonTouchY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            ribbonScrolled = false;
          }
        }, { capture: true, passive: true });

        bar.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
          if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) {
            const dx = Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientX - ribbonTouchX);
            const dy = Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientY - ribbonTouchY);
            if (dx > 8 || dy > 8) {
              ribbonScrolled = true;
            }
          }
        }, { capture: true, passive: true });

        bar.addEventListener("touchend", () => {
          setTimeout(() => { ribbonScrolled = false; }, 120);
        }, { capture: true, passive: true });

        bar.addEventListener("touchcancel", () => {
          ribbonScrolled = false;
        }, { capture: true, passive: true });

        bar.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          if (ribbonScrolled) {
            ribbonScrolled = false;
            return;
          }
          const trigger = e.target.closest("[data-pop]");
          if (trigger) {
            e.preventDefault();
            remember();
            const wrap = trigger.parentElement;
            const pop = wrap.querySelector(".rt-pop");
            const wasOpen = wrap.classList.contains("open");
            closeRichPops(bar);
            if (!wasOpen) {
              wrap.classList.add("open");
              trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
              syncLayoutPops(bar);
              docPortal.open(pop, trigger, {
                alignRight: pop.classList.contains("rt-pop-tbl"),
              });
            }
            return;
          }
          if (!e.target.closest(".rt-pop")) closeRichPops(bar);
        });
        /* Clears active editor listeners */
        docBind(document, "mousedown", (e) => {
          if (
            !e.target.closest(".rt-pop") &&
            !e.target.closest("[data-pop]")
          )
            closeRichPops(bar);
        });
        /* Escape key handler to close active ribbon popovers */
        docBind(document, "keydown", (e) => {
          if (e.key !== "Escape") return;
          const open = bar.querySelector(".rt-pop-wrap.open")
            || document.querySelector(".rt-portal .rt-pop");
          if (open) {
            e.preventDefault();
            closeRichPops(bar);
            focusBack();
          }
        });

        /* Color swatch selection handler */
        bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-sw").forEach((sw) => {
          sw.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            applyRichColour(q, lastRange, sw.dataset.kind, sw.dataset.color, id);
            closeRichPops(bar);
            focusBack();
          });
        });
        bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-custom").forEach((inp) => {
          inp.addEventListener("input", () =>
            applyRichColour(q, lastRange, inp.dataset.kind, inp.value, id),
          );
        });
        bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-clear").forEach((btn) => {
          btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            applyRichColour(q, lastRange, btn.dataset.kind, false, id);
            closeRichPops(bar);
            focusBack();
          });
        });

        /* Primary ribbon button click dispatcher */
        /* Preserves text selection on button mousedown */
        let pendingRange = { index: 0, length: 0 };
        const captureActiveRange = (e) => {
          if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".rt-b, .rt-sel, .rt-pop")) {
            const pr = q.getSelection();
            if (pr && pr.length > 0) pendingRange = pr;
            else if (pr) pendingRange = pr;
            remember();
          }
        };
        bar.addEventListener("mousedown", captureActiveRange, true);
        bar.addEventListener("touchstart", captureActiveRange, { capture: true, passive: true });

        bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-b").forEach((btn) => {
          if (btn.dataset.pop) return;
          btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            /* FIX (audit): capture the freshest range the toolbar still
               knows. A live selection wins; otherwise fall back to the
               range captured at mousedown (which survives the browser
               moving the caret), then to the last remembered range. */
            const liveR = q.getSelection();
            const r = liveR && liveR.length ? liveR : (pendingRange && pendingRange.length ? pendingRange : lastRange);
            const d = btn.dataset;

            if (d.fmt) {
              const cur = q.getFormat(r);
              q.format(d.fmt, !cur[d.fmt], "user");
            } else if (d.script) {
              const cur = q.getFormat(r);
              q.format("script", cur.script === d.script ? false : d.script, "user");
            } else if (d.align !== undefined) {
              q.format("align", d.align || false, "user");
            } else if (d.indent) {
              const cur = q.getFormat(r).indent || 0;
              const next = d.indent === "+1" ? cur + 1 : cur - 1;
              q.format("indent", next > 0 ? next : false, "user");
            } else if (d.list) {
              /* Quill checklist state conversion */
              const cur = q.getFormat(r);
              const isCheck = d.list === "unchecked";
              const already = isCheck
                ? cur.list === "unchecked" || cur.list === "checked"
                : cur.list === d.list;
              q.format("list", already ? false : d.list, "user");
            } else if (d.tbl) {
              runTableCommand(q, d.tbl);
            } else if (d.act && DOC_ACTIONS[d.act]) {
              /* Action table dispatch lookup */
              DOC_ACTIONS[d.act]({ q, shell, id, btn, range: r, bar });
            } else if (d.act) {
              richAction(q, d.act, r, id);
            }
            syncRichToolbar(bar, q, q.getSelection() || r);
            syncHistoryButtons(bar, q);
            /* Toggle button aria-pressed state sync */
            bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-b.on").forEach((b) => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true"));
            bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-b:not(.on)").forEach((b) => b.removeAttribute("aria-pressed"));
            focusBack();
          });
        });

        /* Accessible names for popover menu buttons */
        bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-pop button").forEach((b) => {
          if (!b.getAttribute("aria-label")) {
            const txt = (b.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
            b.setAttribute("aria-label", txt || (b.className || "option"));
          }
        });
        /* Accessible listbox option buttons */
        bar.querySelectorAll(".ui-sel-list .ui-opt").forEach((b) => {
          if (!b.getAttribute("aria-label")) {
            b.setAttribute("aria-label", (b.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() || b.className);
          }
        });
        syncRichToolbar(bar, q, lastRange);
        /* Syncs undo/redo button enabled state with history stack */
        syncHistoryButtons(bar, q);
        /* Ribbon toggle buttons must reflect the live document state after
           every rebuild (marks / ruler / gridlines / hyphenation / track
           changes / protect) - otherwise toggles look off after switching
           tabs or reopening the editor. */
        const stBtn = (act, on) => {
          const b = bar.querySelector('[data-act="' + act + '"]');
          if (b) b.classList.toggle("on", !!on);
        };
        stBtn("marks", showMarks);
        stBtn("ruler", showRuler);
        stBtn("gridlines", gridOn);
        stBtn("hyphen", hyphenOn);
        stBtn("track", trackChanges);
        stBtn("protect", docLocked);
        stBtn("spell", spellOn);
        bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-b.on").forEach((b) => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true"));
        bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-b:not(.on)").forEach((b) => b.removeAttribute("aria-pressed"));
      }

      /* Ribbon tab switcher with animated gliding indicator */
      function bindRibbonTabs(shell) {
        const tabs = shell.querySelector(".rt-tabs");
        if (!tabs) return;

        /* WAI-ARIA tab navigation (Left/Right/Home/End keyboard support) */
        tabs.querySelectorAll(".rt-tab").forEach((t) => {
          const panel = shell.querySelector(`.rt-bar[data-panel="${t.dataset.tab}"]`);
          if (!panel) return;
          const pid = "rtp-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
          panel.id = panel.id || pid;
          t.setAttribute("aria-controls", panel.id);
          panel.setAttribute("aria-label", t.textContent.trim());
        });
        tabs.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
          const list = [...tabs.querySelectorAll(".rt-tab")];
          const i = list.indexOf(document.activeElement);
          if (i < 0) return;
          let n = -1;
          if (e.key === "ArrowRight") n = (i + 1) % list.length;
          else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") n = (i - 1 + list.length) % list.length;
          else if (e.key === "Home") n = 0;
          else if (e.key === "End") n = list.length - 1;
          if (n < 0) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          list[n].focus();
          list[n].click();
        });
        const glide = tabs.querySelector(".rt-tabs-glide");
        const move = () => {
          const on = tabs.querySelector(".rt-tab.on");
          if (!on || !glide) return;
          const t = tabs.getBoundingClientRect();
          const a = on.getBoundingClientRect();
          glide.style.width = a.width + "px";
          glide.style.transform = `translateX(${a.left - t.left + tabs.scrollLeft}px)`;
        };
        tabs.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          const b = e.target.closest(".rt-tab");
          if (!b) return;
          tabs.querySelectorAll(".rt-tab").forEach((x) => {
            x.classList.toggle("on", x === b);
            x.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(x === b));
          });
          shell.querySelectorAll(".rt-bar").forEach((p) =>
            p.classList.toggle("on", p.dataset.panel === b.dataset.tab),
          );
          safeStore.setItem("docRibbonTab", b.dataset.tab); /* Remembers active tab selection */
          move();
        });
        /* Reopens last active ribbon tab */
        const remembered = safeStore.getItem("docRibbonTab");
        if (remembered) {
          const saved = tabs.querySelector('.rt-tab[data-tab="' + remembered + '"]');
          if (saved) saved.click();
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(move);
        docBind(window, "resize", move); /* Clears active editor listeners */

        /* Ribbon overflow scroll affordance and arrow navigation */
        const wrap = shell.querySelector(".rt-barwrap");
        if (wrap) {
          const activeBar = () => wrap.querySelector(".rt-bar.on");
          const syncOverflow = () => {
            const bar = activeBar();
            if (!bar) return;
            const max = bar.scrollWidth - bar.clientWidth;
            /* Sub-pixel scroll tolerance */
            wrap.classList.toggle("has-l", bar.scrollLeft > 2);
            wrap.classList.toggle("has-r", bar.scrollLeft < max - 2);
          };
          /* Synchronizes tab strip overflow masks */
          const syncTabs = () => {
            const max = tabs.scrollWidth - tabs.clientWidth;
            tabs.classList.toggle("tovf-l", tabs.scrollLeft > 2);
            tabs.classList.toggle("tovf-r", tabs.scrollLeft < max - 2);
          };
          const syncAll = () => {
            syncOverflow();
            syncTabs();
          };
          tabs.addEventListener("scroll", syncTabs);
          wrap.addEventListener("scroll", syncOverflow, true);
          tabs.addEventListener("click", () => {
            const bar = activeBar();
            if (bar) bar.scrollLeft = 0;
            requestAnimationFrame(syncOverflow);
          });
          wrap.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            const b = e.target.closest("[data-scroll]");
            if (!b) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            const bar = activeBar();
            if (!bar) return;
            bar.scrollBy({
              left: +b.dataset.scroll * bar.clientWidth * 0.7,
              behavior: "smooth",
            });
          });
          docBind(window, "resize", syncAll); /* Clears active editor listeners */
          if (window.ResizeObserver) {
            /* Registers ResizeObserver for cleanup */
            const ro = new ResizeObserver(syncAll);
            ro.observe(wrap);
            wrap.querySelectorAll(".rt-bar").forEach((b) => ro.observe(b));
            docListeners.push([
              { removeEventListener: () => ro.disconnect() },
              "resize",
              syncAll,
              undefined,
            ]);
          }
          requestAnimationFrame(syncAll);
        }
      }

      function applyRichColour(q, range, kind, colour, id) {
        if (!range) range = q.getSelection() || { index: 0, length: 0 };
        q.setSelection(range.index, range.length, "silent");
        if (kind === "text") {
          q.format("color", colour === false ? false : colour, "user");
          const bar = document.getElementById(`${id}-cbar`);
          if (bar && colour) bar.style.background = colour;
        } else if (kind === "shade") {
          /* Applies paragraph background shading */
          q.format("shading", colour === false ? false : colour, "user");
        } else if (kind === "ucolor") {
          /* Applies underline color to text-decoration-color */
          q.format("ucolor", colour === false ? false : colour, "user");
        } else {
          q.format("background", colour === false ? false : colour, "user");
          const bar = document.getElementById(`${id}-hbar`);

      function syncHistoryButtons(bar, q) {

        const u = bar.querySelector('.rt-quick[data-act="undo"]');
        const r = bar.querySelector('.rt-quick[data-act="redo"]');

      /* Synchronizes active caret formatting back into ribbon controls */
      function syncRichToolbar(bar, q, range) {
        if (!bar || !q) return;
        const f = q.getFormat(range || { index: 0, length: 0 }) || {};
        const mark = (sel, active) => {
          const el = bar.querySelector(sel);
          if (el) el.classList.toggle("on", !!active);
        };
        mark('[data-fmt="bold"]', f.bold);
        mark('[data-fmt="italic"]', f.italic);
        mark('[data-fmt="underline"]', f.underline);
        mark('[data-fmt="strike"]', f.strike);
        mark('[data-fmt="blockquote"]', f.blockquote);
        mark('[data-fmt="code-block"]', f["code-block"]);
        mark('[data-script="super"]', f.script === "super");
        mark('[data-script="sub"]', f.script === "sub");
        mark('[data-list="bullet"]', f.list === "bullet");
        mark('[data-list="ordered"]', f.list === "ordered");
        mark(
          '[data-list="unchecked"]',
          f.list === "unchecked" || f.list === "checked",
        );
        bar.querySelectorAll("[data-align]").forEach((b) =>
          b.classList.toggle("on", (f.align || "") === b.dataset.align),
        );
        if (bar._sel) {
          if (bar._sel.block && bar._sel.block.setValue) {
            const hVal = f.header ? ("h" + f.header) : (f.blockquote ? "quote" : "normal");
            bar._sel.block.setValue(hVal);

          bar._sel.size.setValue(f.size || "16px");
          bar._sel.lh.setValue(f.lineheight || "1.5");
        }
        const cbar = bar.querySelector(".rt-colbar");
        if (cbar && f.color) cbar.style.background = f.color;
        /* Activates table contextual controls when caret is inside a table */
        const inTable = !!(
          q.getSelection() &&
          q.root.querySelector(".doc-table-block:focus-within")
        );
        bar.querySelectorAll(".rt-tblonly").forEach((b) =>
          b.classList.toggle("dim", !inTable && !docActiveCell()),
        );
