      /* Insert Menu Action Handlers (Image, File, Link, Table) */
      function richAction(q, act, range, id) {
        const at = range ? range.index : q.getLength();
        switch (act) {
          case "undo":
            q.history.undo();
            break;
          case "redo":
            q.history.redo();
            break;
          case "clean":
            if (range && range.length)
              q.removeFormat(range.index, range.length);
            else q.removeFormat(0, q.getLength());
            break;
          case "hr":
            q.insertEmbed(at, "hr", true, "user");
            q.setSelection(at + 1, 0);
            break;
          case "rtl": {
            const cur = q.getFormat(range || {}).direction;
            q.format("direction", cur === "rtl" ? false : "rtl");
            q.format("align", cur === "rtl" ? false : "right");
            break;
          }
          case "link": {
            showAppPrompt("Enter the link URL:", (url) => {
              if (!url) return;
              const safe = /^(https?:|mailto:|tel:)/i.test(url)
                ? url
                : "https://" + url;
              if (range && range.length) {
                q.formatText(range.index, range.length, "link", safe, "user");
              } else {
                q.insertText(at, safe, { link: safe }, "user");
              }
            });
            break;
          }
          case "image": {
            const inp = document.createElement("input");
            inp.type = "file";
            inp.accept = "image/*";
            inp.style.display = "none";
            document.body.appendChild(inp);
            inp.addEventListener("change", () => {
              const file = inp.files && inp.files[0];
              if (!file) return inp.remove();
              const rd = new FileReader();
              rd.onload = () => {
                insertImageSmart(q, rd.result, { index: at, length: 0 });
                inp.remove();
              };
              rd.readAsDataURL(file);
            });
            inp.click();
            break;
          }
          case "video": {
            showAppPrompt("Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link:", (url) => {
              if (!url) return;
              let embed = url;
              const yt = url.match(
                /(?:youtube\.com\/watch\?v=|youtu\.be\/)([\w-]+)/,
              );
              const vm = url.match(/vimeo\.com\/(\d+)/);
              if (yt) embed = `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${yt[1]}`;
              else if (vm) embed = `https://player.vimeo.com/video/${vm[1]}`;
              q.insertEmbed(at, "video", embed, "user");
              q.setSelection(at + 1, 0);
            });
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
       * 6. TABLE COMMANDS
       * The table lives inside a block embed, so rows and columns are
       * manipulated directly on the DOM the caret currently sits in.
       * ------------------------------------------------------------- */
      function insertDocTable(q, range, rows, cols) {
        const at = range ? range.index : q.getLength();
        q.insertEmbed(at, "doctable", { rows, cols }, "user");
        q.insertText(at + 1, "\n", "user");
        q.setSelection(at + 2, 0);
        setTimeout(() => {
          const cell = q.root.querySelector(".doc-table th, .doc-table td");
          if (cell) {
            const sel = window.getSelection();
            const r = document.createRange();
            r.selectNodeContents(cell);
            r.collapse(true);
            sel.removeAllRanges();
            sel.addRange(r);
          }
        }, 30);
      }

      /* Resolves table cell enclosing active caret */
      /* Keyboard navigation between table cells */
      function bindTableKeys(q) {
        q.root.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
          if (e.key !== "Tab") return;
          const cell = docActiveCell();
          if (!cell) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          const cells = [
            ...q.root.querySelectorAll(".doc-table td, .doc-table th"),
          ];
          const i = cells.indexOf(cell);
          if (i < 0) return;
          const next =
            cells[(i + (e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1) + cells.length) % cells.length];
          const sel = window.getSelection();
          const r = document.createRange();
          r.selectNodeContents(next);
          r.collapse(true);
          sel.removeAllRanges();
          sel.addRange(r);
        });
      }

      function docActiveCell() {
        const sel = window.getSelection();
        if (!sel || !sel.anchorNode) return null;
        const el =
          sel.anchorNode.nodeType === 1
            ? sel.anchorNode
            : sel.anchorNode.parentElement;
        return el ? el.closest(".doc-table td, .doc-table th") : null;
      }

      function runTableCommand(q, cmd) {
        const cell = docActiveCell();
        if (!cell) {
          showAppAlert(
            "No table selected",
            "Place the cursor inside a table cell first, then use the row and column buttons.",
          );
          return;
        }
        const row = cell.parentElement;
        const table = cell.closest("table");
        const idx = Array.from(row.children).indexOf(cell);

        if (cmd === "row-after") {
          const nr = document.createElement("tr");
          for (let i = 0; i < row.children.length; i++) {
            const td = document.createElement("td");
            td.innerHTML = "<br>";
            nr.appendChild(td);
          }
          row.parentNode.insertBefore(nr, row.nextSibling);
        } else if (cmd === "row-del") {
          if (table.rows.length <= 1) return;
          row.remove();
        } else if (cmd === "col-after") {
          Array.from(table.rows).forEach((r, i) => {
            const c = document.createElement(i === 0 ? "th" : "td");
            c.innerHTML = "<br>";
            r.insertBefore(c, r.children[idx + 1] || null);
          });
        } else if (cmd === "col-del") {
          if (table.rows[0].children.length <= 1) return;
          Array.from(table.rows).forEach((r) => {
            if (r.children[idx]) r.children[idx].remove();
          });
        }
        saveActiveEditorSoon();
      }

      function saveNote() {
        if (!quill) return;
        const txt = quill.root.innerHTML;
        const plainTxt = quill.getText().trim();
        const boxHas = [...document.querySelectorAll(".layout-box")].some((b) => b.textContent.trim().length > 0);
        const hasContent = plainTxt.length > 0 || boxHas || txt.includes("<img") || txt.includes("<iframe") || txt.includes("<table") || txt.includes("doc-table") || txt.includes("<hr") || txt.includes("katex");
        if (!hasContent) {
          showAppAlert("Empty Note", "Please write something or add media before saving!");
          return;
        }
        const design = captureCurrentDesign();
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        if (editingNoteIdx !== null && db[selKey] && db[selKey].notes[editingNoteIdx]) {
          const existing = db[selKey].notes[editingNoteIdx];
          existing.html = txt;
          existing.design = design;
          existing.updatedAt = now;
          // Phase 2: keep snippet/plain in sync so search and cards work
          // without decompressing the (now dirty) gzip payload.
          delete existing.htmlGz;
          delete existing.htmlEncoding;
          try {
            existing.plain = (typeof docPlainPreview === "function"
              ? docPlainPreview(txt, 4000)
              : txt.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()
            ).slice(0, 4000);
            existing.snippet = existing.plain.slice(0, 240);
          } catch (e) {}
        } else if (db[selKey]) {
          const note = {
            html: txt,
            design: design,
            bg: design.pageBg || getRandomColor(),
            cal: calForNewItem(),
            createdAt: now,
          };
          try {
            note.plain = (typeof docPlainPreview === "function"
              ? docPlainPreview(txt, 4000)
              : txt.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()
            ).slice(0, 4000);
            note.snippet = note.plain.slice(0, 240);
          } catch (e) {}
          db[selKey].notes.push(note);
        }
        snapshotBase(txt);
        clearDraftForActiveNote();
        saveDB();
        commitDBSave();
        setSaveStatus("Saved");
        doCancelEditNote();
        docToast("Note saved");

      /* Date range calculation helper for filters */
      function masterRangeMatch(dateKey) {
        const r = mf().range;
        if (r === "all") return true;
        const undated = dateKey === "general";
        if (r === "undated") return undated;
        if (undated) return false;
        const today = new Date();
        today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        const d = new Date(dateKey + "T00:00:00");
        if (isNaN(d)) return false;
        const dayMS = 86400000;
        const diff = Math.round((d - today) / dayMS);
        switch (r) {
          case "overdue":
            return diff < 0;
          case "today":
            return diff === 0;
          case "tomorrow":
            return diff === 1;
          case "week":
            return diff >= 0 && diff < 7;
          case "month":
            return diff >= 0 && diff < 31;
          case "custom": {
            const from = mf().from ? new Date(mf().from + "T00:00:00") : null;
            const to = mf().to ? new Date(mf().to + "T00:00:00") : null;
            if (from && d < from) return false;
            if (to && d > to) return false;
            return true;
          }
          default:
            return true;
        }
      }

      function handleMasterSearch(query) {
        masterSearchQuery = query.toLowerCase().trim();
        clearTimeout(masterSearchTimer);
        // Cancel any in-flight full-body search.
        if (masterFullCancel) { try { masterFullCancel(); } catch (e) {} masterFullCancel = null; }
        masterFullHits = new Set();
        masterFullProgress = "";
        // For notes, kick off the async full-body (gzip) search immediately.
        // It streams matches in and re-renders as they arrive.
        if (curMasterTab === "note" && masterSearchQuery && window.ChunkedStorage) {
          masterFullCancel = ChunkedStorage.searchNotesStream(masterSearchQuery, {
            cal: mf().cal,
            visible: true,
            onMatch: (n) => {
              masterFullHits.add(n.parentKey + ":" + n.realIdx);
              if (masterSearchQuery) {
                masterRenderLimit = 60;
                renderMasterContent();
              }
            },
            onProgress: (done, total) => {
              masterFullProgress = done < total ? `Searching ${done}/${total}…` : "";
            },
            onDone: () => {
              masterFullProgress = "";
              if (masterSearchQuery) renderMasterContent();

      /**
       * Highlights search matches within text or HTML content safely without breaking markup.
       * @param {string} value Text or HTML string.
       * @param {string} query Search query string.
       * @returns {string} Sanitized HTML with highlighted matches.
       */
function escapeHTMLText(str) {
        return String(str == null ? "" : str)
          .replace(/&/g, "&")
          .replace(/</g, "<")
          .replace(/>/g, ">")
          .replace(/"/g, """) /* F1: quote escaping for attribute contexts */
          .replace(/'/g, "'");
      }

      /* Plain-text search term highlighting */
      function highlight(text, query) {
        const safe = escapeHTMLText(text);
        if (!query || !safe) return safe;
        const regex = new RegExp(`(${escapeRegExp(query)})`, "gi");
        return safe.replace(regex, "<mark>$1</mark>");
      }

      /* HTML DOM text node search highlighting */

      /**
       * HTML Sanitizer: strips script tags, event handlers, and dangerous protocols from document HTML.
       * @param {string} html Raw authored HTML string.
       * @returns {DocumentFragment} Sanitized safe DOM fragment.
       */
      const ALLOWED_IFRAME = /^https?:\/\/(www\.)?(youtube(-nocookie)?\.com|youtu\.be|player\.vimeo\.com)\//i;

      const DOC_ALLOWED_TAGS = new Set(
        "A,P,BR,SPAN,STRONG,B,EM,I,U,S,STRIKE,SUB,SUP,H1,H2,H3,H4,H5,H6,OL,UL,LI,BLOCKQUOTE,PRE,CODE,IMG,IFRAME,TABLE,THEAD,TBODY,TFOOT,TR,TD,TH,HR,DIV,MARK,VIDEO,SOURCE,FIGURE,FIGCAPTION,COLGROUP,COL".split(","),
      );
      const DOC_STYLE_OK = new Set([
        "color","background-color","text-align","font-size","font-family","font-weight",
        "font-style","text-decoration","line-height","letter-spacing","padding","padding-left",
        "padding-right","padding-top","padding-bottom","margin","margin-left","margin-right",
        "width","max-width","height","opacity","border","border-left","border-bottom",
        "border-color","border-width","border-style","list-style-type","white-space",
        "vertical-align","text-indent",
      ]);
      const DOC_CLASS_RE = /^(ql-[\w-]+|doc-[\w-]+|language-[\w-]+|hljs[\w-]*|katex[\w-]*)$/;
      const DOC_SAFE_IMG = /^data:image\/(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|bmp);base64,/i;

      function sanitizeStyleAttr(raw) {
        if (!raw) return "";
        const out = [];
        String(raw).split(";").forEach((part) => {
          const i = part.indexOf(":");
          if (i < 0) return;
          const prop = part.slice(0, i).trim().toLowerCase();
          const val = part.slice(i + 1).trim();
          if (!DOC_STYLE_OK.has(prop)) return;
          if (/url\s*\(|expression|javascript|@import|behavior|binding|<|>|\\/i.test(val)) return;
          out.push(prop + ": " + val);
        });
        return out.join("; ");
      }

      function sanitizeClassAttr(raw) {
        return String(raw || "")
          .split(/\s+/)
          .filter((c) => DOC_CLASS_RE.test(c))
          .join(" ");
      }

      function isSafeHref(v) {
        const t = String(v || "").trim();
        const low = t.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
        if (!t || low.startsWith("javascript:") || low.startsWith("vbscript:") || low.startsWith("data:")) return false;
        return /^(https?:|mailto:|tel:|#|\/|\.\/)/i.test(t);
      }

      function isSafeSrc(v) {
        const t = String(v || "").trim();
        const low = t.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
        if (DOC_SAFE_IMG.test(t)) return true;
        if (low.startsWith("data:") || low.startsWith("javascript:") || low.startsWith("vbscript:")) return false;
        return /^https?:/i.test(t);
      }

      function sanitizeDocFragment(root) {
        if (!root) return root;
        root
          .querySelectorAll(
            "script,style,object,embed,base,meta,link,form,input,button,textarea,select,noscript,foreignObject,animate,animateTransform,animateMotion,set,discard,svg,math,template,applet,frame,frameset,link",
          )
          .forEach((n) => n.remove());

        const nodes = [...root.querySelectorAll("*")].reverse();
        nodes.forEach((el) => {
          if (!el.parentNode) return;
          if (!DOC_ALLOWED_TAGS.has(el.tagName)) {
            const parent = el.parentNode;
            while (el.firstChild) parent.insertBefore(el.firstChild, el);
            parent.removeChild(el);
            return;
          }

          [...el.attributes].forEach((attr) => {
            const name = attr.name.toLowerCase();
            if (name.startsWith("on") || name === "srcdoc" || name === "id" || name === "xmlns:xlink") {
              return el.removeAttribute(attr.name);
            }
            if (name === "style") {
              const cleaned = sanitizeStyleAttr(attr.value);
              if (cleaned) el.setAttribute("style", cleaned);
              else el.removeAttribute("style");
              return;
            }
            if (name === "class") {
              const cleaned = sanitizeClassAttr(attr.value);
              if (cleaned) el.setAttribute("class", cleaned);
              else el.removeAttribute("class");
              return;
            }
            if (["href", "src", "xlink:href", "action", "formaction", "data", "poster"].includes(name)) {
              const ok = name === "href" ? isSafeHref(attr.value) : isSafeSrc(attr.value);
              if (!ok) el.removeAttribute(attr.name);
              return;
            }
          });

          if (el.tagName === "A") {
            const t = (el.getAttribute("target") || "").toLowerCase();
            if (t === "_blank") el.setAttribute("rel", "noopener noreferrer");
            else el.removeAttribute("target");
          }

          if (el.tagName === "IFRAME") {
            const src = el.getAttribute("src") || "";
            if (!ALLOWED_IFRAME.test(src)) el.remove();
            else {
              el.setAttribute("sandbox", "allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-presentation");
              el.removeAttribute("srcdoc");
            }
          }
        });
        return root;
      }

      /**
       * Returns sanitized HTML string representation.
       * @param {string} html Raw HTML string.
       * @returns {string} Safe sanitized HTML string.
       */
function sanitizeDocHTML(html) {
        /* F6: inert parse — no browsing context, no resource fetches, no handler execution */
        const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(
          html == null ? "" : String(html),
          "text/html",
        );
        sanitizeDocFragment(doc.body);
        return doc.body.innerHTML;
      }

      /* ============== Planner Data Sanitizer (schema whitelist) ==============
         Every external data path (boot, sync, import) enters through adoptDB().
         Unknown keys/fields are dropped; known fields are validated against the
         exact enums/limits the UI can produce. New data fields MUST be added here. */
      const DATE_KEY_RE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
      const SAFE_HEX_RE = /^#(?:[0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6}|[0-9a-f]{8})$/i;
      const SAFE_TIME_RE = /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/;
      const SAFE_GRADIENT_RE = /^linear-gradient\(\s*\d{1,3}deg(?:\s*,\s*(?:#[0-9a-f]{3,8}|rgba?\(\s*[\d\s.,%]+\s*\))\d{0,3}%?){2,4}\s*\)$/i;
      const STATUS_ENUM = ["pending", "done", "skip"];
      const RADIUS_RE = /^(?:0|[0-9]{1,2}px|50%)$/;
      const DAY_ENUM_WHITELIST = {
        borderStyle: ["none", "solid", "dashed", "dotted", "double", "groove"],
        borderWidth: ["1px", "2px", "4px", "6px"],
        markTopStyle: ["solid", "dashed", "dotted", "double"],
        markTopHeight: ["3px", "4px", "6px", "10px"],
        markBottomStyle: ["solid", "dashed", "dotted", "double"],
        markBottomHeight: ["3px", "4px", "6px", "10px"],
        bgType: ["color", "gradient", "pattern"],
        bgPattern: ["stripes"],
      };
      const DAY_COLOR_FIELDS = ["borderColor", "markTopColor", "markBottomColor", "glowColor", "badgeBg"];
      const MAX_STORE_KEYS = 5000, MAX_ITEMS_PER_DAY = 500, MAX_TXT_LEN = 500,
            MAX_HTML_LEN = 200000, MAX_PROJECTS = 100, MAX_TITLE_LEN = 120;

      function safeHex(v, fb) { return SAFE_HEX_RE.test(String(v)) ? String(v) : fb; }
      function safeEnum(v, list) { return list.includes(v) ? v : undefined; }

      /* Audit-2 helpers: stamps may be epoch numbers OR ISO strings; Document Studio
         design snapshots must survive the door, but any embedded html inside them is
         user-visible markup and must pass the inert sanitizer. */
      const ISO_STAMP_RE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/;
      function keepStamp(v) {
        if (typeof v === "number" && isFinite(v)) return v;
        if (typeof v === "string" && ISO_STAMP_RE.test(v)) return v.slice(0, 30);
        return undefined;
      }
      function capGraphemes(str, n) {
        const s = String(str);
        try {
          if (typeof Intl !== "undefined" && Intl.Segmenter) {
            const seg = new Intl.Segmenter(undefined, { granularity: "grapheme" });
            const out = [];
            for (const part of seg.segment(s)) {
              out.push(part.segment);
              if (out.length >= n) break;
            }
            return out.join("");
          }
        } catch (e) { /* fallback below */ }
        return Array.from(s).slice(0, n).join("");
      }
      function sanitizeDesign(d) {
        if (!d || typeof d !== "object" || Array.isArray(d)) return undefined;
        let clone;
        try {
          const raw = JSON.stringify(d);
          if (!raw || raw.length > 60000) return undefined;
          clone = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch (e) { return undefined; }
        (function walk(o) {
          if (Array.isArray(o)) { o.forEach(walk); return; }
          if (!o || typeof o !== "object") return;
          Object.keys(o).forEach((k) => {
            const v = o[k];
            if (k === "html" && typeof v === "string") {
              o[k] = sanitizeDocHTML(v.slice(0, 20000)); return;
            }
            if (typeof v === "string") { o[k] = v.slice(0, 500); return; }
            if (typeof v === "number") { if (!isFinite(v)) delete o[k]; return; }
            if (typeof v === "boolean" || v === null) return;
            if (typeof v === "object") { walk(v); return; }
            delete o[k];
          });
        })(clone);
        return clone;
      }

      function sanitizePlannerItem(it) {
        if (!it || typeof it !== "object") return null;
        const out = {
          txt: typeof it.txt === "string" ? it.txt.slice(0, MAX_TXT_LEN) : "",
          time: SAFE_TIME_RE.test(String(it.time || "")) ? it.time : "",
          status: safeEnum(it.status, STATUS_ENUM) || "pending",
        };
        if (typeof it.desc === "string" && it.desc) out.desc = it.desc.slice(0, 2000); /* audit2: project task desc */
        if (it.isPinned === true) out.isPinned = true;
        if (typeof it.cal === "string" && /^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/i.test(it.cal)) out.cal = it.cal;
        const st = keepStamp(it.createdAt);
        if (st !== undefined) out.createdAt = st;
        const up = keepStamp(it.updatedAt);
        if (up !== undefined) out.updatedAt = up;
        return out;
      }

      function sanitizeNote(n) {
        if (!n || typeof n !== "object") return null;
        const out = {
          html: sanitizeDocHTML(String(n.html || "").slice(0, MAX_HTML_LEN)),
          bg: safeHex(n.bg, "#ffffff"),
          isPinned: n.isPinned === true,
        };
        /* audit2: keep every timestamp dialect the app writes (epoch or ISO string) */
        [["createdAt", "createdAt"], ["updatedAt", "updatedAt"], ["created", "created"], ["updated", "updated"]]
          .forEach(([srcKey, dstKey]) => {
            const v = keepStamp(n[srcKey]);
            if (v !== undefined) out[dstKey] = v;
          });
        if (typeof n.cal === "string" && /^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/i.test(n.cal)) out.cal = n.cal;
        const dz = sanitizeDesign(n.design); /* audit2: Document Studio settings survive */
        if (dz) out.design = dz;
        return out;
      }

      /* Day-cell design fields, shared by the bucket root (legacy) and every
         per-calendar design layer stored in bucket.cals */
      function sanitizeDayDesignInto(b, out) {
        Object.entries(DAY_ENUM_WHITELIST).forEach(([field, list]) => {
          const v = safeEnum(b[field], list);
          if (v !== undefined) out[field] = v;
        });
        if (RADIUS_RE.test(String(b.borderRadius))) out.borderRadius = String(b.borderRadius);
        DAY_COLOR_FIELDS.forEach((field) => {
          const v = safeHex(b[field], undefined);
          if (v) out[field] = v;
        });
        if (typeof b.bgGradient === "string" && SAFE_GRADIENT_RE.test(b.bgGradient)) out.bgGradient = b.bgGradient;
        if (b.glowEnabled === true) out.glowEnabled = true;
        if (b.markTopEnabled === true) out.markTopEnabled = true;
        if (b.markBottomEnabled === true) out.markBottomEnabled = true;
        if (typeof b.dayEmoji === "string") {
          const e = capGraphemes(b.dayEmoji.replace(/[<>]/g, "").trim(), 4);
          if (e) out.dayEmoji = e;
        }
        if (typeof b.badgeText === "string") {
          const t = b.badgeText.replace(/[<>"']/g, "").slice(0, 6);
          if (t) out.badgeText = t;
        }
        return out;
      }

      function sanitizeCalendars(list) {
        const seen = new Set();
        return (Array.isArray(list) ? list : [])
          .slice(0, 40)
          .map((c) => {
            if (!c || typeof c !== "object") return null;
            const id = String(c.id || "");
            if (!/^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/i.test(id) || seen.has(id)) return null;
            seen.add(id);
            return {
              id,
              name: String(c.name == null ? "Calendar" : c.name).slice(0, 40),
              color: safeHex(c.color, "#4f46e5"),
              emoji: typeof c.emoji === "string" ? capGraphemes(c.emoji.replace(/[<>]/g, ""), 2) : "📅",
            };
          })
          .filter(Boolean);
      }

      function sanitizeDayBucket(b) {
        if (!b || typeof b !== "object") return null;
        const out = {
          bg: safeHex(b.bg, "#ffffff"),
          pins: (Array.isArray(b.pins) ? b.pins : []).slice(0, MAX_ITEMS_PER_DAY).map(sanitizePlannerItem).filter(Boolean),
          tasks: (Array.isArray(b.tasks) ? b.tasks : []).slice(0, MAX_ITEMS_PER_DAY).map(sanitizePlannerItem).filter(Boolean),
          notes: (Array.isArray(b.notes) ? b.notes : []).slice(0, MAX_ITEMS_PER_DAY).map(sanitizeNote).filter(Boolean),
        };
        Object.entries(DAY_ENUM_WHITELIST).forEach(([field, list]) => {
          const v = safeEnum(b[field], list);
          if (v !== undefined) out[field] = v;
        });
        if (RADIUS_RE.test(String(b.borderRadius))) out.borderRadius = String(b.borderRadius);
        DAY_COLOR_FIELDS.forEach((field) => {
          const v = safeHex(b[field], undefined);
          if (v) out[field] = v;
        });
        if (typeof b.bgGradient === "string" && SAFE_GRADIENT_RE.test(b.bgGradient)) out.bgGradient = b.bgGradient;
        if (b.glowEnabled === true) out.glowEnabled = true;
        if (b.markTopEnabled === true) out.markTopEnabled = true;
        if (b.markBottomEnabled === true) out.markBottomEnabled = true;
        if (typeof b.dayEmoji === "string") {
          const e = capGraphemes(b.dayEmoji.replace(/[<>]/g, "").trim(), 4); /* audit2: ZWJ-safe */
          if (e) out.dayEmoji = e;
        }
        if (typeof b.badgeText === "string") {
          const t = b.badgeText.replace(/[<>"']/g, "").slice(0, 6);
          if (t) out.badgeText = t;
        }
        if (b.design && typeof b.design === "object") out.design = b.design;
        /* Per-calendar day designs */
        if (b.cals && typeof b.cals === "object" && !Array.isArray(b.cals)) {
          const cals = {};
          Object.keys(b.cals)
            .slice(0, 40)
            .forEach((id) => {
              if (!/^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/i.test(id)) return;
              const src = b.cals[id];
              if (!src || typeof src !== "object") return;
              const layer = sanitizeDayDesignInto(src, { bg: safeHex(src.bg, "#ffffff") });
              cals[id] = layer;
            });
          if (Object.keys(cals).length) out.cals = cals;
        }
        return out;
      }

      function sanitizeProject(p) {
        if (!p || typeof p !== "object") return null;
        const out = {
          title: String(p.title == null ? "Untitled" : p.title).slice(0, MAX_TITLE_LEN),
          isPinned: p.isPinned === true,
          tasks: (Array.isArray(p.tasks) ? p.tasks : []).slice(0, MAX_ITEMS_PER_DAY).map(sanitizePlannerItem).filter(Boolean),
          docs: (Array.isArray(p.docs) ? p.docs : []).slice(0, MAX_ITEMS_PER_DAY).map(sanitizeNote).filter(Boolean),
        };
        const col = safeHex(p.color, undefined);
        if (col) out.color = col;
        const pc = keepStamp(p.created); /* audit2: project created stamp */
        if (pc !== undefined) out.created = pc;
        return out;
      }

      function sanitizeDB(raw) {
        const dropped = [];
        const store = raw && typeof raw === "object" ? raw : {};
        const out = {};
        const allKeys = Object.keys(store);
        let extraKeys = 0;
        if (allKeys.length > MAX_STORE_KEYS) extraKeys = allKeys.length - MAX_STORE_KEYS;
        allKeys.slice(0, MAX_STORE_KEYS).forEach((k) => {
          if (k === "projects" || k === "mainStore") return;
          if (k !== "general" && !DATE_KEY_RE.test(k)) { dropped.push(k); return; }
          const b = sanitizeDayBucket(store[k]);
          if (b) out[k] = b;
        });
        out.calendars = sanitizeCalendars(store.calendars);
        const projIn = Array.isArray(store.projects) ? store.projects : [];
        const projCut = Math.max(0, projIn.length - MAX_PROJECTS);
        out.projects = projIn.slice(0, MAX_PROJECTS).map(sanitizeProject).filter(Boolean);
        return { ok: dropped.length === 0 && extraKeys === 0 && projCut === 0, dropped, extraKeys, projCut, db: out };
      }

      /* Single adoption door for every external data load */
      function adoptDB(incoming, source) {
        const res = sanitizeDB(incoming);
        if (!res.ok) console.warn("adoptDB(" + (source || "?") + "): dropped invalid keys:", res.dropped);
        db = res.db;
        ensureCalendars();
        pruneBlankEntries();
        if (typeof renderCalBar === "function" && document.getElementById("calBar")) renderCalBar();
        if (source === "import") {
          const bits = [];
          if (res.dropped && res.dropped.length) bits.push(res.dropped.length + " invalid date keys removed");
          if (res.extraKeys) bits.push(res.extraKeys + " extra store keys ignored (cap " + MAX_STORE_KEYS + ")");
          if (res.projCut) bits.push(res.projCut + " projects beyond the 100-project cap were dropped");
          if (bits.length) {
            showAppAlert("Import trimmed", "Some data was limited for safety: " + bits.join("; ") + ".");
          }
        }
        return res;
      }


      function highlightHTML(html, query) {
        /* F6: inert parse for the preview path as well */
        const host = new DOMParser().parseFromString(
          html == null ? "" : String(html),
          "text/html",
        ).body;
        sanitizeDocFragment(host);
        if (query) {
          const rx = new RegExp(escapeRegExp(query), "gi");
          const walker = document.createTreeWalker(host, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
          const targets = [];
          let node;
          while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
            if (
              node.nodeValue &&
              rx.test(node.nodeValue) &&
              !(node.parentElement && node.parentElement.closest("mark"))
            ) {
              targets.push(node);
            }
            rx.lastIndex = 0;
          }
          targets.forEach((textNode) => {
            const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
            const value = textNode.nodeValue;
            let last = 0;
            let m;
            rx.lastIndex = 0;
            while ((m = rx.exec(value))) {
              if (m.index > last)
                frag.appendChild(
                  document.createTextNode(value.slice(last, m.index)),
                );
              const mark = document.createElement("mark");
              mark.textContent = m[0];
              frag.appendChild(mark);
              last = m.index + m[0].length;
              if (m[0] === "") rx.lastIndex++;
            }
            if (last < value.length)
              frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(value.slice(last)));
            textNode.parentNode.replaceChild(frag, textNode);
          });
        }
        return host.innerHTML;
      }

      /**
       * Generates a plain-text preview snippet from rich HTML content.
       * @param {string} html Rich HTML string.
       * @param {number} maxLen Maximum character length for preview.
       * @returns {string} Truncated plain-text preview string.
       */
      const plainTextCache = new Map();

      function docPlainCached(html) {
        if (!html) return "";
        const hit = plainTextCache.get(html);
        if (hit !== undefined) return hit;
        const val = docPlainPreview(html, 100000).toLowerCase();
        if (plainTextCache.size > 4000) plainTextCache.clear();
        plainTextCache.set(html, val);
        return val;
      }

      /* Phase 2: plain-text of a note that may still have its HTML gzipped in
         RAM. Prefers the stored .plain snippet; falls back to inflating the
         note once and caching its text. Never blocks list rendering. */
      function notePlain(note) {
        if (!note || typeof note !== "object") return "";
        if (note.plain) return String(note.plain).toLowerCase();
        if (typeof note.html === "string" && note.html.length)
          return docPlainCached(note.html);
        if (note.htmlEncoding === "gzip+base64") {
          if (typeof note.snippet === "string" && note.snippet)
            return note.snippet.toLowerCase();
          // trigger async inflation; first paint uses snippet
          if (window.ChunkedStorage && note._d == null) {
            // locate by scanning current day is not possible generically; use
            // the catalog if available.
          }
          return "";
        }
        return "";
      }

      /* Plain-text snippet extractor */
      function docPlainPreview(html, limit = 160) {
        /* Parses inert HTML DOM */
        const host = new DOMParser().parseFromString(
          "<body>" + (html == null ? "" : String(html)) + "<" + "/body>",
          "text/html",
        ).body;
        const txt = (host.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        return txt.length > limit ? txt.slice(0, limit) + "…" : txt;
      }

      function docTitleOf(html) {
        const host = new DOMParser().parseFromString(
          "<body>" + (html == null ? "" : String(html)) + "<" + "/body>",
          "text/html",
        ).body;
        const h = host.querySelector("h1,h2,h3,h4,strong,b");
        const fromHeading = h && (h.textContent || "").trim();
        if (fromHeading) return fromHeading.slice(0, 80);
        const txt = (host.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        return txt ? txt.slice(0, 60) : "Untitled document";
      }


      /**
       * Module: Unified Document Card Component
       * Responsibilities: Renders document cards across Daily Sheet, Master Planner, and Project views
       * with search highlighting, color themes, pin states, and expanding previews.
       */

      /* Map of user-expanded card keys */
      const docExpanded = new Set();

      /* Daily sheet document search & view controls */
      let dailyDocQuery = "";
      let dailyDocListMode = safeStore.getItem("dailyDocListMode") === "true";
      let dailyDocTimer = 0;

      function handleDailyDocSearch(v) {
        dailyDocQuery = (v || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        clearTimeout(dailyDocTimer);
        dailyDocTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
          const box = document.getElementById("sheetBody");
          const top = box ? box.scrollTop : 0;
          renderSheet();
          const inp = box && box.querySelector(".doc-search-inp");
          if (inp) {
            inp.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            inp.setSelectionRange(inp.value.length, inp.value.length);
            box.scrollTop = top;
          }
        }, 90);
      }

      function toggleDailyDocView() {
        dailyDocListMode = !dailyDocListMode;
        safeStore.setItem("dailyDocListMode", dailyDocListMode);
        renderSheet();
      }

      function toggleDocExpand(key, btn) {
        const card = btn.closest(".doc-card");
        if (!card) return;
        const open = card.classList.toggle("is-expanded");
        if (open) docExpanded.add(key);
        else docExpanded.delete(key);
        btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
        btn.title = open ? "Collapse" : "Expand";
        btn.innerHTML = `<svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-chevron"/></svg>`;
      }

      /**
       * Builds an interactive document card element.
       * @param {Object} opts Card options (key, html, bg, isPinned, created, updated, query, onEdit, onDelete, onPin, onColor).
       * @returns {HTMLElement} Document card element.
       */
      function renderDocCard(opts) {
        const {
          key,
          html,
          snippet,
          bg,
          isPinned = false,
          created,
          updated,
          query = "",
          onEdit,
          onDelete,
          onPin,
          onColor,
          meta = "",
        } = opts;
        const kjs = escJS(String(key)); /* F11 */
        /* Phase 2: html may be empty when a note's body is still gzipped in
           RAM. The card shows a stored plain-text snippet until the editor
           (or expand) decompresses the full HTML. */
        const bodyHTML = html || (snippet
          ? "<p>" + escapeHTMLText(snippet) + "</p>"
          : "<p><em>Tap to open…</em></p>");
        const title = docTitleOf(html || snippet || "");
        const when = updated || created;
        const stamp = when
          ? new Date(when).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
              day: "numeric",
              month: "short",
              year: "numeric",
            })
          : "";
        const expanded = docExpanded.has(key);
        const tint = SAFE_HEX_RE.test(String(bg)) ? String(bg) : "#ffffff"; /* F5: note.bg */
        const swatch = docPalette.find(
          (c) => c.bg.toLowerCase() === tint.toLowerCase(),
        );
        const ink = swatch ? swatch.ink : "#334155";
        return `
        <article class="doc-card ${isPinned ? "is-pinned" : ""} ${expanded ? "is-expanded" : ""}"
                 style="--doc-tint:${tint}; --doc-ink:${ink}">
            <span class="doc-tape" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <header class="doc-card-head">
                <h3 class="doc-card-title" data-tip="${escapeHTMLText(title)}">${highlight(title, query)}</h3>
                <div class="doc-card-tools">
                    ${onColor ? `<button type="button" class="pk-icon doc-colour" aria-expanded="false" data-tip="Change colour" aria-label="Change card colour" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleDocPalette('${kjs}', this)"><span class="doc-colour-dot"></span></button>` : ""}
                    ${onPin ? PanelControls.pinIcon(onPin, isPinned, "document") : ""}
                    ${onEdit ? PanelControls.editIcon(onEdit, "document") : ""}
                    ${onDelete ? PanelControls.delIcon(onDelete, "document") : ""}
                </div>
            </header>
            ${onColor ? docPaletteHTML(key, tint, onColor) : ""}
            <div class="doc-card-body ql-editor">${highlightHTML(bodyHTML, query)}</div>
            <footer class="doc-card-foot">
                <span class="doc-stamp">${stamp}</span>
                <div class="doc-foot-right">
                    ${isPinned ? '<span class="doc-pin-tag"><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-pin-fill"/></svg>Pinned</span>' : ""}
                    ${meta}
                    <button type="button" class="doc-expand" aria-expanded="${expanded}" data-tip="${expanded ? "Collapse" : "Expand"}" aria-label="Expand document" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleDocExpand('${kjs}', this)"><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-chevron"/></svg></button>
                </div>
            </footer>
        </article>`;
      }

      /* Shared search input markup generator */
      function renderDocSearch(oninput, value, placeholder, onclear) {
        const v = value || "";
        return `
        <div class="doc-search ${v ? "has-value" : ""}">
            <svg class="doc-search-ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-search"/></svg>
            <input type="search" class="doc-search-inp" placeholder="${placeholder || "Search…"}"
                   value="${escapeHTMLText(v)}" aria-label="${placeholder || "Search"}"
                   oninput="${oninput}">
            ${v ? `<button type="button" class="doc-search-clear" aria-label="Clear search" data-tip="Clear" onclick="${onclear}"><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-close"/></svg></button>` : ""}
        </div>`;
      }

      function toggleMasterDocView() {
        isDocCardView = !isDocCardView;
        safeStore.setItem("isDocCardView", isDocCardView);
        renderMasterContent({ rebuildControls: true });
      }

      function renderMasterContent({ rebuildControls = false } = {}) {
        if (!isMasterEditNote) destroyRichEditor();
        const box = document.getElementById("masterContent");
        const masterFab = document.querySelector("#masterPanel .add-fab");
        if (masterFab) {
          /* Add button visibility for current active tab */
          if (isMasterEditNote) {
            masterFab.style.setProperty("display", "none", "important");
          } else {
            masterFab.style.setProperty("display", "flex", "important");
          }
        }
        if (isMasterEditNote) return;
        box.classList.remove("editor-active");

        const F = mf();
        const activeN = masterActiveFilterCount();
        if (rebuildControls) masterRenderLimit = 60;
        const chip = (label, on, onclick, extra = "") =>
          `<button type="button" class="mf-chip ${on ? "is-on" : ""}" ${extra} onclick="${onclick}">${label}</button>`;
        const drawerOpen =
          document.getElementById("masterDrawer") &&
          document.getElementById("masterDrawer").classList.contains("is-open");

        /* Tab-specific filter and sort controls */
        const rangeRow = `
            <div class="mf-row">
                <span class="mf-label">When</span>
                <div class="mf-chips">
                    ${chip("All", F.range === "all", "setMasterRange('all')")}
                    ${chip("Overdue", F.range === "overdue", "setMasterRange('overdue')")}
                    ${chip("Today", F.range === "today", "setMasterRange('today')")}
                    ${chip("Tomorrow", F.range === "tomorrow", "setMasterRange('tomorrow')")}
                    ${chip("7 days", F.range === "week", "setMasterRange('week')")}
                    ${chip("30 days", F.range === "month", "setMasterRange('month')")}
                    ${chip("No date", F.range === "undated", "setMasterRange('undated')")}
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="mf-row">
                <span class="mf-label">Between</span>
                <div class="mf-chips">
                    <button type="button" class="mf-date" onclick="openRangePicker('from')" aria-label="From date">${F.from || "Start date"}</button>
                    <span class="mf-dash">→</span>
                    <button type="button" class="mf-date" onclick="openRangePicker('to')" aria-label="To date">${F.to || "End date"}</button>
                </div>
            </div>`;

        const sortOptions = {
          pin: [["time", "Time of day"], ["date-desc", "Newest"], ["date-asc", "Oldest"], ["alpha", "A–Z"]],
          task: [["date-desc", "Newest"], ["date-asc", "Oldest"], ["time", "Time of day"], ["alpha", "A–Z"], ["created-desc", "Recently added"]],
          note: [["date-desc", "Newest"], ["date-asc", "Oldest"], ["alpha", "A–Z"], ["created-desc", "Recently added"]],
        }[curMasterTab];

        const statusRow =
          curMasterTab === "task"
            ? `
            <div class="mf-row">
                <span class="mf-label">Status</span>
                <div class="mf-chips">
                    ${chip("All", masterTaskFilter === "all", "setMasterTaskFilter('all')")}
                    ${chip("● Active", masterTaskFilter === "pending", "setMasterTaskFilter('pending')")}
                    ${chip("✓ Done", masterTaskFilter === "done", "setMasterTaskFilter('done')")}
                    ${chip("⏭ Skipped", masterTaskFilter === "skip", "setMasterTaskFilter('skip')")}
                </div>
            </div>`
            : "";

        const colourRow =
          curMasterTab === "note"
            ? `
            <div class="mf-row">
                <span class="mf-label">Colour</span>
                <div class="mf-chips">
                    ${chip("All", F.colour === "all", "setMasterDocColour('all')")}
                    ${docPalette
                      .map(
                        (c) =>
                          `<button type="button" class="mf-sw ${F.colour === c.bg ? "is-on" : ""}" style="--sw:${c.bg}" data-tip="${c.name}" aria-label="Filter by ${c.name}" onclick="setMasterDocColour('${c.bg}')"></button>`,
                      )
                      .join("")}
                </div>
            </div>`
            : "";

        /* Calendar scope row — mirrors the capsule bar inside the planner */
        const calRow = `
            <div class="mf-row">
                <span class="mf-label">Calendar</span>
                <div class="mf-chips">
                    ${chip("All visible", !F.cal || F.cal === "all", "setMasterCal('all')")}
                    ${calendars()
                      .map((c) =>
                        chip(
                          `${escapeHTMLText(c.emoji || "📅")} ${escapeHTMLText(c.name)}`,
                          F.cal === c.id,
                          `setMasterCal('${c.id}')`,
                        ),
                      )
                      .join("")}
                </div>
            </div>`;

        const groupOptions =
          curMasterTab === "task"
            ? [["date", "By date"], ["cal", "By calendar"], ["status", "By status"], ["none", "Flat list"]]
            : [["date", "By date"], ["cal", "By calendar"], ["none", "Flat list"]];

        const controlsHTML = `
        <div class="mp-controls" id="masterControls">
            ${renderDocSearch("handleMasterSearch(this.value)", masterSearchQuery, `Search ${curMasterTab === "note" ? "documents" : curMasterTab + "s"}…`, "handleMasterSearch('')")}
            <div class="mp-controls-row">
                <button type="button" class="mf-trigger ${activeN ? "is-on" : ""}" id="masterFilterBtn"
                        aria-expanded="${drawerOpen ? "true" : "false"}" onclick="toggleMasterFilterDrawer()">
                    <svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-filter"/></svg>
                    <span>Filter</span>
                    ${activeN ? `<span class="mf-badge">${activeN}</span>` : ""}
                </button>
                ${curMasterTab === "note" ? PanelControls.viewMode("toggleMasterDocView()", isDocCardView, "master") : ""}
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="mf-widget ${drawerOpen ? "is-open" : ""}" id="masterDrawer" data-tab="${curMasterTab}">
            <div class="mf-widget-inner">
                <div class="mf-head">
                    <span class="mf-title">${curMasterTab === "pin" ? "Pin" : curMasterTab === "task" ? "Task" : "Document"} filters</span>
                    <div class="mf-head-act">
                        ${activeN ? `<button type="button" class="mf-reset" onclick="resetMasterFilters()">Reset all</button>` : ""}
                        <button type="button" class="pk-icon mf-x" aria-label="Close filters" onclick="toggleMasterFilterDrawer()"><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-close"/></svg></button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                ${rangeRow}
                ${calRow}
                ${statusRow}
                ${colourRow}
                <div class="mf-row">
                    <span class="mf-label">Sort</span>
                    <div class="mf-chips">
                        ${sortOptions.map(([v, l]) => chip(l, F.sort === v, `setMasterSort('${v}')`)).join("")}
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="mf-row">
                    <span class="mf-label">Group</span>
                    <div class="mf-chips">
                        ${groupOptions.map(([v, l]) => chip(l, F.group === v, `setMasterGroup('${v}')`)).join("")}
                        <button type="button" class="mf-chip mf-pin ${F.pinned ? "is-on" : ""}" aria-pressed="${F.pinned}" onclick="toggleMasterPinnedOnly()">${PanelControls._pinSVG(F.pinned)}<span>Pinned only</span></button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>`;

        let results = document.getElementById("masterResults");
        const controlsNeedRefresh =
          rebuildControls ||
          !document.getElementById("masterControls") ||
          box.dataset.renderedTab !== curMasterTab;
        if (controlsNeedRefresh) {
          box.innerHTML = `${controlsHTML}<div class="mp-summary" id="masterSummary"></div><div id="masterResults"></div>`;
          updateMasterCounts();
          box.dataset.renderedTab = curMasterTab;
          results = document.getElementById("masterResults");
        } else {
          results.replaceChildren();
        }

        /* Item collection phase.
           Phase 5: read from the catalog, not Object.keys(db). The catalog
           always spans every month (including cold ones) and carries each
           item's parentKey and realIdx, so Master Planner sees all data
           without hydrating months or scanning the full in-memory db. */
        let pinnedList = [];
        let rows = [];
        const type = curMasterTab === "note" ? "notes" : curMasterTab + "s";
        const srcCatalog =
          curMasterTab === "note" ? __catalog.notes :
          curMasterTab === "pin" ? __catalog.pins : __catalog.tasks;
        srcCatalog.forEach((item) => {
          const key = item.parentKey;
          if (!masterRangeMatch(key)) return;
          /* Calendar scope: explicit picker, else the active capsule group */
          if (F.cal && F.cal !== "all") {
            if (calOf(item) !== F.cal) return;
          } else if (!calItemVisible(item)) return;
          let ok = true;
          if (curMasterTab === "task" && masterTaskFilter !== "all") {
            if ((item.status || "pending") !== masterTaskFilter) ok = false;
          }
          if (masterSearchQuery) {
            const content = item.txt
              ? item.txt.toLowerCase()
              : notePlain(item);
            const timeStr = (item.time || "").toLowerCase();
            const fullHit =
              curMasterTab === "note" &&
              masterFullHits.has(key + ":" + item.realIdx);
            if (
              !fullHit &&
              !content.includes(masterSearchQuery) &&
              !timeStr.includes(masterSearchQuery) &&
              !key.includes(masterSearchQuery)
            )
              ok = false;
          }
          if (F.pinned && !item.isPinned) ok = false;
          if (
            curMasterTab === "note" &&
            F.colour !== "all" &&
            (item.bg || "#ffffff").toLowerCase() !== F.colour.toLowerCase()
          )
            ok = false;
          if (!ok) return;
          const row = { ...item, parentKey: key, realIdx: item.realIdx };
          if (item.isPinned) pinnedList.push(row);
          else rows.push(row);
        });

        /* Item sorting phase */
        const textOf = (r) =>
          r.txt ? r.txt.toLowerCase() : notePlain(r);
        const cmp = {
          "date-desc": (a, b) => b.parentKey.localeCompare(a.parentKey),
          "date-asc": (a, b) => a.parentKey.localeCompare(b.parentKey),
          time: (a, b) => (a.time || "99:99").localeCompare(b.time || "99:99"),
          alpha: (a, b) => textOf(a).localeCompare(textOf(b)),
          "created-desc": (a, b) =>
            new Date(b.createdAt || 0) - new Date(a.createdAt || 0),
          "created-asc": (a, b) =>
            new Date(a.createdAt || 0) - new Date(b.createdAt || 0),
        }[F.sort];
        if (cmp) {
          rows.sort(cmp);
          pinnedList.sort(cmp);
        }

        const containerClass =
          curMasterTab === "note"
            ? isDocCardView
              ? "doc-grid is-list"
              : "doc-grid"
            : "doc-card-mode";

        /* Summary calculation phase */
        const summary = document.getElementById("masterSummary");
        if (summary) {
          const total = rows.length + pinnedList.length;
          const vis = Math.min(masterRenderLimit, total);
          const progress = masterFullProgress
            ? ` <span class="mp-search-progress" style="opacity:.7;font-weight:700">· ${escapeHTMLText(masterFullProgress)}</span>`
            : "";
          summary.innerHTML = `<span>${vis < total ? `${vis} of ${total}` : total} item${total === 1 ? "" : "s"}</span>${progress}${
            activeN
              ? ` <button type="button" class="mp-clear" onclick="resetMasterFilters()">Clear filters</button>`
              : ""
          }`;
        }

        /**
       * Incremental batch renderer for Master Planner sections to ensure responsive rendering.
       */
        const PAGE = 60;
        let budget = masterRenderLimit;

        const makeSection = (labelHTML, list, cls) => {
          if (budget <= 0) return;
          const slice = list.slice(0, budget);
          budget -= slice.length;
          list = slice;
          const section = document.createElement("section");
          section.className = "mp-section" + (cls ? " " + cls : "");
          section.innerHTML = labelHTML;
          const container = document.createElement("div");
          container.className = containerClass;
          list.forEach((item) =>
            container.appendChild(
              createMasterCard(item, item.parentKey, item.realIdx),
            ),
          );
          section.appendChild(container);
          results.appendChild(section);
        };

        if (pinnedList.length) {
          makeSection(
            `<div class="group-label pin-group"><svg style="width:12px;height:12px;color:#f59e0b"><use href="#icon-pin-fill"/></svg>Pinned</div>`,
            pinnedList,
            "pinned-header",
          );
        }

        if (!rows.length && !pinnedList.length) {
          results.innerHTML = `<div class="doc-empty"><div class="doc-empty-ico">🔍</div><div class="doc-empty-title">Nothing matches</div><div class="doc-empty-sub">Adjust the filters or clear them to see more.</div></div>`;
          autoResizeAll(results);
          return;
        }

        if (F.group === "none") {
          if (rows.length) makeSection("", rows);
        } else if (F.group === "cal") {
          const byCal = {};
          rows.forEach((r) => (byCal[calOf(r)] ||= []).push(r));
          calendars().forEach((c) => {
            if (byCal[c.id] && byCal[c.id].length)
              makeSection(
                `<div class="group-label" style="color:${c.color}">${escapeHTMLText(c.emoji || "📅")} ${escapeHTMLText(c.name)} <span class="grp-count">${byCal[c.id].length}</span></div>`,
                byCal[c.id],
              );
          });
        } else if (F.group === "status") {
          const buckets = { pending: [], done: [], skip: [] };
          rows.forEach((r) =>
            (buckets[r.status || "pending"] || buckets.pending).push(r),
          );
          const labels = {
            pending: "● Active",
            done: "✓ Completed",
            skip: "⏭ Skipped",
          };
          ["pending", "done", "skip"].forEach((k) => {
            if (buckets[k].length)
              makeSection(
                `<div class="group-label">${labels[k]} <span class="grp-count">${buckets[k].length}</span></div>`,
                buckets[k],
              );
          });
        } else {
          const groups = {};
          rows.forEach((r) => (groups[r.parentKey] ||= []).push(r));
          const keys = Object.keys(groups).sort((a, b) =>
            F.sort === "date-asc"
              ? a.localeCompare(b)
              : b.localeCompare(a),
          );
          keys.forEach((dateKey) => {
            makeSection(
              `<div class="group-label">${masterGroupTitle(dateKey)} <span class="grp-count">${groups[dateKey].length}</span></div>`,
              groups[dateKey],
            );
          });
        }
        const shown = Math.min(
          masterRenderLimit,
          rows.length + pinnedList.length,
        );
        const totalAll = rows.length + pinnedList.length;
        if (shown < totalAll) {
          const more = document.createElement("button");
          more.type = "button";
          more.className = "mp-more";
          more.textContent = `Show more (${totalAll - shown} left)`;
          more.onclick = showMoreMaster;
          results.appendChild(more);
        }
        autoResizeAll(results);
      }

      /* Formats date group bucket heading */
      /* Positions sliding indicator under active segmented tab */
      function moveSegGlide() {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          const seg = document.querySelector(".mp-seg");
          const glide = document.getElementById("mSegGlide");
          const active = seg && seg.querySelector(".mp-seg-btn.active");
          if (!seg || !glide || !active) return;
          const s = seg.getBoundingClientRect();
          const a = active.getBoundingClientRect();
          glide.style.width = a.width + "px";
          glide.style.transform = `translateX(${a.left - s.left}px)`;
        });
      }

      /* Updates total count badges on tab pills */
      function updateMasterCounts() {
        const totals = { pin: 0, task: 0, note: 0 };
        if (window.__catalog) {
          totals.pin = __catalog.pins.filter(calItemVisible).length;
          totals.note = __catalog.notes.filter(calItemVisible).length;
          totals.task = __catalog.tasks.filter(
            (t) => calItemVisible(t) && t.status !== "done" && t.status !== "skip",
          ).length;
        } else {
          Object.keys(db).forEach((key) => {
            if (key === "mainStore" || key === "projects") return;
            const src = db[key];
            if (!src) return;
            totals.pin += calFilterItems(src.pins).length;
            totals.task += calFilterItems(src.tasks).filter(
              (t) => t.status !== "done" && t.status !== "skip",
            ).length;
            totals.note += calFilterItems(src.notes).length;
          });
        }
        const set = (id, v) => {
          const el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (el) el.textContent = v;
        };
        set("mCountPin", totals.pin);
        set("mCountTask", totals.task);
        set("mCountNote", totals.note);
      }


      /* F11 helpers: JS-string escaping for legacy inline handlers + store-key guard */
      const escJS = (s) =>
        String(s).replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/'/g, "\\'").replace(/\r?\n/g, "\\n");
      const isValidStoreKey = (k) =>
        typeof k === "string" && (k === "general" || DATE_KEY_RE.test(k));

      function masterChipDate(dateKey) {
        const d = new Date(dateKey + "T00:00:00");
        if (isNaN(d)) return escapeHTMLText(dateKey);
        const today = new Date();
        today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        const diff = Math.round((d - today) / 86400000);
        if (diff === 0) return "Today";
        if (diff === 1) return "Tomorrow";
        if (diff === -1) return "Yesterday";
        return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
          day: "numeric",
          month: "short",
        });
      }

      function masterGroupTitle(dateKey) {
        if (dateKey === "general") return "⚡ No date";
        const today = new Date();
        today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        const d = new Date(dateKey + "T00:00:00");
        if (isNaN(d)) return escapeHTMLText(dateKey);
        const diff = Math.round((d - today) / 86400000);
        const pretty = d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
          weekday: "short",
          day: "numeric",
          month: "short",
          year: d.getFullYear() === today.getFullYear() ? undefined : "numeric",
        });
        if (diff === 0) return `Today · ${pretty}`;
        if (diff === 1) return `Tomorrow · ${pretty}`;
        if (diff === -1) return `Yesterday · ${pretty}`;
        if (diff < 0) return `${pretty} · ${Math.abs(diff)}d overdue`;
        return pretty;
      }

      function createMasterCard(item, dateKey, realIdx) {        const dk = escJS(dateKey); /* F11: inert key for every handler string below */
        const el = document.createElement("div");
        const isPinned = item.isPinned || false;
        const type = curMasterTab === "note" ? "notes" : curMasterTab + "s";
        let timerHTML = "";
        if (item.time && dateKey !== "general") {
          const rel = getRelTime(dateKey, item.time);
          timerHTML = `<span class="acc-timer ${rel.class === "late" ? "timer-late" : "timer-active"}" style="margin-left:8px; font-size:0.6rem; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px; color:#fff; background:${rel.class === "late" ? "var(--danger)" : "var(--primary)"}">🕒 ${rel.txt}</span>`;
        }
        const metaHTML = `
        <div class="meta-row" style="margin:0; padding:0; border:none; font-size: 0.55rem; color: #64748b; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px;">
            <span>Added: ${item.createdAt ? new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleDateString() : "N/A"}</span>
            ${
              item.updatedAt
                ? `<span>Updated: ${new Date(item.updatedAt).toLocaleTimeString(
                    [],
                    {
                      hour: "2-digit",
                      minute: "2-digit",
                    },
                  )}</span>`
                : ""
            }
        </div>
    `;
        if (curMasterTab === "note") {
          el.className = "doc-card-slot";
          el.innerHTML = renderDocCard({
            key: `m-${dateKey}-${realIdx}`,
            html: item.html,
            snippet: item.snippet || item.plain || "",
            bg: item.bg,
            isPinned: isPinned,
            created: item.createdAt,
            updated: item.updatedAt,
            query: masterSearchQuery,
            onPin: `toggleMasterPin('${dk}', 'notes', ${realIdx})`,
            onEdit: `openMasterNoteEditor('${dk}', ${realIdx})`,
            onDelete: `deleteMasterItem('${dk}', 'notes', ${realIdx})`,
            onColor: `setMasterNoteColor('${dk}', ${realIdx}, '__C__')`,
            meta: calBadgeHTML(item, `pickMasterItemCal('${dk}', 'notes', ${realIdx}, event)`) +
              `<button type="button" class="mp-chip mp-chip-date" onclick="openMasterDatePicker('${dk}', 'notes', ${realIdx})" data-tip="Change date"><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-calendar"/></svg>${dateKey === "general" ? "No date" : masterChipDate(dateKey)}</button>`,
          });
        } else if (curMasterTab === "pin") {
          el.style.cssText = `background: #fff; border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px; margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-left: 5px solid ${isPinned ? "#f59e0b" : "var(--primary)"}; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);`;
          el.innerHTML = `
            <div style="width: 100%;">

                </button>

            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;">

        } else {

          el.className = `card ${status}`;
          el.style.cssText = `background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 14px 10px 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-left: 4px solid ${isPinned ? "#f59e0b" : status === "done" ? "var(--success)" : "var(--primary)"}; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);`;
          const safeText = escapeHTMLText(typeof item.txt === "string" ? item.txt : "");
          el.innerHTML = `
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; width: 100%;">

"var(--success)" : "#cbd5e1"}; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: ${status === "done" ? "var(--success)" : "transparent"}; margin-top: 2px;">

                <textarea class="inp-flat" rows="1" style="flex: 1; background:transparent; border:none; padding:0; font-weight:700; font-size:1rem; color:var(--text-main); line-height: 1.5; resize: none; overflow: hidden; width: 100%; word-break: break-word;" placeholder="Write a task..." oninput="scheduleTextareaResize(this);" onchange="updateMasterItem('${dk}', 'tasks', ${realIdx}, 'txt', this.value)">${safeText}</textarea>

                        <svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-calendar"/></svg>${dateKey === "general" ? "No date" : masterChipDate(dateKey)}
                    </button>
                    ${calBadgeHTML(item, `pickMasterItemCal('${dk}', 'tasks', ${realIdx}, event)`)}
                    ${dateKey !== "general" ? `<button type="button" class="mp-chip mp-chip-time ${item.time ? "has-val" : ""}" onclick="openMasterTimePicker('${dk}', 'tasks', ${realIdx})" data-tip="Change time">${highlight(item.time || "Set time", masterSearchQuery)}</button>${item.time ? `<button type="button" class="mp-chip mp-chip-x" data-tip="Clear time" aria-label="Clear time" onclick="clearMasterTime('${dk}', 'tasks', ${realIdx})">×</button>` : ""} ${timerHTML}` : ""}

                    <button type="button" class="pk-btn" onclick="skipMasterTask('${dk}', ${realIdx})">${status === "skip" ? "RESET" : "SKIP"}</button>
                    ${PanelControls.pin(`toggleMasterPin('${dk}', 'tasks', ${realIdx})`, isPinned, "task")}
                    ${PanelControls.del(`deleteMasterItem('${dk}', 'tasks', ${realIdx})`, "task")}
