        }
        return el;
      }

      function triggerDBSave() {
        saveDB();
      }

      function updateMasterItem(key, type, idx, field, val) {
        if (!isValidStoreKey(key)) return console.warn("Blocked invalid store key:", key); /* F11 */
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.hydrateDay(key);
        if (!db[key] || !db[key][type] || !db[key][type][idx]) return;
        db[key][type][idx][field] = val;
        db[key][type][idx].updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.rebuildCatalog();
        triggerDBSave();
        /* Do not remount the list while typing — that blinks the caret */
        if (field !== "txt") renderMasterContent();
      }

      function toggleMasterTask(key, idx) {
        if (!isValidStoreKey(key)) return console.warn("Blocked invalid store key:", key); /* F11 */
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.hydrateDay(key);
        const item = db[key].tasks[idx];
        item.status = item.status === "done" ? "pending" : "done";
        item.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.rebuildCatalog();
        triggerDBSave();
        renderMasterContent();
      }

      function skipMasterTask(key, idx) {
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.hydrateDay(key);
        const item = db[key].tasks[idx];
        item.status = item.status === "skip" ? "pending" : "skip";
        item.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.rebuildCatalog();
        triggerDBSave();
        renderMasterContent();
      }

      function toggleMasterPin(key, type, idx) {
        if (!isValidStoreKey(key)) return console.warn("Blocked invalid store key:", key); /* F11 */
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.hydrateDay(key);
        if (!db[key] || !db[key][type] || !db[key][type][idx]) return;
        db[key][type][idx].isPinned = !db[key][type][idx].isPinned;
        db[key][type][idx].updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.rebuildCatalog();
        triggerDBSave();
        renderMasterContent();
      }

      function openMasterTimePicker(key, collection, index) {
        if (!isValidStoreKey(key)) return console.warn("Blocked invalid store key:", key); /* F11 */
        const item =
          db[key] && db[key][collection] && db[key][collection][index];
        if (!item) return;
        tpTarget = { scope: "master", key, collection, index };
        if (item.time) {
          const [h, m] = item.time.split(":");
          tpSel = { h, m };
        }
        document.querySelectorAll("#tpHours .tp-btn").forEach((button) => {
          button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.value === tpSel.h);
        });
        document.querySelectorAll("#tpMins .tp-btn").forEach((button) => {
          button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.value === tpSel.m);
        });
        const dialog = document.getElementById("timePicker");
        dialog.classList.add("open");
        dialog.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      }

      function openMasterNoteEditor(key, idx = null) {
        if (!isValidStoreKey(key)) return console.warn("Blocked invalid store key:", key); /* F11 */
        isMasterEditNote = true;
        masterEditingKey = key;
        masterEditingIdx = idx;
        const masterFab = document.querySelector("#masterPanel .add-fab");
        if (masterFab)
          masterFab.style.setProperty("display", "none", "important");
        const box = document.getElementById("masterContent");
        box.classList.add("editor-active");
        box.style.display = "flex";
        box.style.flexDirection = "column";
        box.style.padding = "0";
        box.style.height = "100%";
        box.innerHTML = `
        
        <div class="editor-container" style="flex: 1; position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 0; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);">
            <div id="masterQuill" style="height: 100%; overflow-y: auto;"></div>
        </div>
        
        
        <div class="editor-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn-save-doc" onclick="saveMasterNote()" style="flex:1; height:46px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary, #4f46e5), #6366f1); color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:12px; font-weight:800; font-size:1rem; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.35);">
                <svg style="width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.5;"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>
                <span>Save</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-cancel-doc" onclick="cancelMasterNoteEdit()" style="min-width:105px; height:46px; background:#f1f5f9; color:var(--text-main, #1e293b); border:1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); border-radius:12px; font-weight:700; font-size:0.95rem; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px;" title="Close editor">
                Close
            </button>
        </div>
    `;
        quill = createRichEditor("#masterQuill", "mq", "Start writing…");
        const editorContent = document.querySelector("#masterQuill .ql-editor");
        if (editorContent) {
          editorContent.style.paddingBottom =
            "calc(96px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))";
        }
        if (idx !== null && db[key].notes[idx]) {
          // Phase 2: decompress the note body if it is still gzipped.
          const mn = db[key].notes[idx];
          let mhtml = mn.html;
          if ((!mhtml || !mhtml.length) && window.ChunkedStorage) {
            mhtml = ChunkedStorage.noteHTML(key, idx);
            if (mn.__inflating) {
              mn.__inflating.then((h) => {
                if (quill) {
                  quill.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(0, sanitizeDocHTML(h || ""), "silent");
                  snapshotBase(quill.root.innerHTML);
                }
              });
            }
          }
          quill.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(0, sanitizeDocHTML(mhtml || ""), "silent");
        }
        loadHistoryForActiveNote(); /* Document edit transition */
        recoverDraft(); /* Document draft check */
        snapshotBase(quill.root.innerHTML);
      }

      function cancelMasterNoteEdit() {
        if (isDirty()) {
          confirmLeaveEditor({ onDiscard: doCancelMasterNoteEdit, onSave: saveMasterNote });
          return;
        }
        doCancelMasterNoteEdit();
      }

      function doCancelMasterNoteEdit() {
        destroyRichEditor();
        isMasterEditNote = false;
        const box = document.getElementById("masterContent");
        box.classList.remove("editor-active");
        box.style.removeProperty("display");
        box.style.removeProperty("padding");
        box.style.removeProperty("height");
        box.style.removeProperty("overflow");
        box.innerHTML = "";
        renderMasterContent({ rebuildControls: true });
      }

      function saveMasterNote() {
        if (!quill) return;
        const html = quill.root.innerHTML;
        const design = captureCurrentDesign();
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        if (!db[masterEditingKey])
          db[masterEditingKey] = {
            bg: "#ffffff",
            pins: [],
            tasks: [],
            notes: [],
          };
        if (masterEditingIdx !== null && db[masterEditingKey].notes[masterEditingIdx]) {
          const existing = db[masterEditingKey].notes[masterEditingIdx];
          existing.html = html;
          existing.design = design;
          existing.updatedAt = now;
          // Phase 2: refresh snippet/plain; next save re-gzips.
          delete existing.htmlGz;
          delete existing.htmlEncoding;
          try {
            existing.plain = (typeof docPlainPreview === "function"
              ? docPlainPreview(html, 4000)
              : html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()
            ).slice(0, 4000);
            existing.snippet = existing.plain.slice(0, 240);
          } catch (e) {}
        } else {
          const note = {
            html: html,
            design: design,
            bg: design.pageBg || getRandomColor(),
            cal: calForNewItem(),
            createdAt: now,
            isPinned: false,
          };
          try {
            note.plain = (typeof docPlainPreview === "function"
              ? docPlainPreview(html, 4000)
              : html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()
            ).slice(0, 4000);
            note.snippet = note.plain.slice(0, 240);
          } catch (e) {}
          db[masterEditingKey].notes.unshift(note);
        }
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.rebuildCatalog();
        snapshotBase(html);
        clearDraftForActiveNote();
        saveDB();
        commitDBSave();
        setSaveStatus("Saved");
        doCancelMasterNoteEdit();
        docToast("Master note saved");
      }

      function addGeneralItem() {
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        if (!db["general"])
          db["general"] = {
            bg: "#ffffff",
            pins: [],
            tasks: [],
            notes: [],
          };
        if (curMasterTab === "task") {
          db["general"].tasks.unshift({
            txt: "",
            status: "pending",
            cal: calForNewItem(),
            createdAt: now,
            isPinned: false,
          });
          triggerDBSave();
          renderMasterContent();
        } else if (curMasterTab === "note") {
          openMasterNoteEditor("general", null);
        } else if (curMasterTab === "pin") {
          /* Creates new pin in undated collection */
          db["general"].pins.unshift({
            txt: "",
            time: "",
            status: "pending",
            cal: calForNewItem(),
            createdAt: now,
            isPinned: false,
          });
          triggerDBSave();
          renderMasterContent();
        }
      }

      /**
       * Module: Project Manager Controller
       * Responsibilities: Initializes project data, renders project summary cards,
       * manages project workspace, handles project tasks and rich-text documents.
       */
      let curProjIdx = null;

      let curProjTab = "task";

      let projTaskFilter = "all";

      let isProjEdit = false;

      let editingProjDocIdx = null;

      let isProjDocCardView = false;

      let projDocSearchQuery = "";

      /* Project workspace pinned-only filter */
      let projPinnedOnly = false;

      function toggleProjPinnedOnly() {
        projPinnedOnly = !projPinnedOnly;
        renderProjectContent();
      }

      let projSearchTimer = 0;

      /* Guard for valid active project reference */
      function currentProj() {
        return Array.isArray(db.projects)
          ? db.projects[curProjIdx] || null
          : null;
      }

      function initProjects() {
        if (!Array.isArray(db.projects)) db.projects = [];
        db.projects.forEach((project) => {
          project.title = project.title || "Untitled Project";
          project.tasks = Array.isArray(project.tasks) ? project.tasks : [];
          project.docs = Array.isArray(project.docs) ? project.docs : [];
          project.tasks.forEach((task) => {
            if (typeof task.desc !== "string") task.desc = "";
            if (!task.status) task.status = "pending";
          });
          project.docs.forEach((doc) => {
            if (doc.isPinned === undefined) doc.isPinned = false;
          });
        });
        renderProjects();
      }

      function renderProjects() {
        const list = document.getElementById("projectList");
        if (!list) return;
        list.innerHTML = "";
        if (!db.projects.length) {
          list.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--text-sub); padding:10px;">No projects. Tap + NEW</div>`;
          return;
        }
        /* Orders pinned projects first on the calendar strip */
        const ordered = db.projects
          .map((p, i) => ({ p, i }))
          .sort((a, b) => (b.p.isPinned ? 1 : 0) - (a.p.isPinned ? 1 : 0));
        ordered.forEach(({ p, i }) => {
          const pending = p.tasks.filter(
            (t) => t.status !== "done" && t.status !== "skip",
          ).length;
          const doneN = p.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "done").length;
          const total = p.tasks.length;
          const percent =
            total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((doneN / total) * 100);
          const card = document.createElement("div");
          const tint = projectTint(p);
          card.className = "proj-3d-card" + (p.isPinned ? " is-pinned" : "");
          card.style.setProperty("--proj-tint", tint.bg);
          card.style.setProperty("--proj-ink", tint.ink);
          card.setAttribute("role", "button");
          card.tabIndex = 0;
          card.setAttribute("aria-label", "Open project " + (p.title || "Untitled"));
          card.onclick = () => openProjectPanel(i);
          card.onkeydown = (ev) => {
            if (ev.key === "Enter" || ev.key === " ") {
              ev.preventDefault();
              openProjectPanel(i);
            }
          };
          card.title = p.title;
          card.innerHTML = `
            <div class="p-card-top">
                ${p.isPinned ? '<svg class="p-card-pin" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-pin-fill"/></svg>' : ""}
                <div class="p-card-title">${escapeHTMLText(p.title)}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="p-card-bar" aria-hidden="true">
                <span style="width:${percent}%; background:${percent === 100 ? "var(--success)" : "var(--primary)"}"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="p-card-foot">
                <span class="p-chip">${pending} active</span>
                <span class="p-chip ${percent === 100 ? "is-done" : ""}">${percent}% done</span>
            </div>
        `;
          list.appendChild(card);
        });
        if (typeof renderProjectListPanel === "function") renderProjectListPanel();
      }

      function openPickerOverlay(id) {
        const dialog = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!dialog) return;
        dialog.classList.add("open");
        dialog.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
        try { dialog.inert = false; } catch (e) {}
        if (!dialog.dataset.dcWired) {
          dialog.dataset.dcWired = "1";
          dialog.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
            if (e.target === dialog) {
              if (id === "newProjectPicker") closeNewProjectOverlay();
              else if (id === "dayCustomizerPicker") closeDayCustomizer();
              else if (id === "calEditPicker") closeCalEditor();
            }
          });
        }
      }

      function closePickerOverlay(id) {
        const dialog = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!dialog) return;
        dialog.classList.remove("open");
        dialog.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        try { dialog.inert = true; } catch (e) {}
      }

      function closeNewProjectOverlay() {
        closePickerOverlay("newProjectPicker");
      }

      function submitNewProject() {
        if (!Array.isArray(db.projects)) db.projects = [];
        if (db.projects.length >= MAX_PROJECTS) {
          showAppAlert("Limit reached", "You can keep at most " + MAX_PROJECTS + " projects.");
          return;
        }
        const inp = document.getElementById("npName");
        const clean = ((inp && inp.value) || "").trim().slice(0, MAX_TITLE_LEN);
        if (!clean) {
          if (inp) {
            inp.focus();
            inp.style.borderColor = "var(--danger)";
          }
          return;
        }
        db.projects.unshift({
          title: clean,
          created: new Date().toISOString(),
          tasks: [],
          docs: [],
        });
        saveDB();
        renderProjects();
        closeNewProjectOverlay();
        openProjectPanel(0);
      }

      function createNewProject() {
        if (!Array.isArray(db.projects)) db.projects = [];
        if (db.projects.length >= MAX_PROJECTS) {
          showAppAlert("Limit reached", "You can keep at most " + MAX_PROJECTS + " projects.");
          return;
        }
        const inp = document.getElementById("npName");
        if (inp) {
          inp.value = "";
          inp.style.borderColor = "";
        }
        openPickerOverlay("newProjectPicker");
        if (inp) setTimeout(() => inp.focus(), 40);
      }

      function openProjectPanel(idx) {
        curProjIdx = idx;
        curProjTab = "task";
        projTaskFilter = "all";
        isProjEdit = false;
        const p = db.projects[idx];
        document.getElementById("ppTitle").value = p.title;
        const panel = document.getElementById("projectPanel");
        panel.classList.add("active");
        panel.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
        document
          .querySelectorAll("#projFilters .f-chip")
          .forEach((c) => c.classList.remove("active"));
        document
          .querySelector("#projFilters .f-chip:first-child")
          .classList.add("active");
        refreshProjectHeader();
        applyProjectTab("task");
      }

      function finishCloseProjectPanel() {
        if (isProjEdit) {
          destroyRichEditor();
          isProjEdit = false;
          editingProjDocIdx = null;
        }
        const panel = document.getElementById("projectPanel");
        panel.classList.remove("active");
        panel.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        curProjIdx = null;
        pruneBlankEntries();
        renderProjects();
        if (typeof renderProjectListPanel === "function") renderProjectListPanel();
      }

      function closeProjectPanel() {
        if (isProjEdit && isDirty()) {
          confirmDiscard(() => finishCloseProjectPanel());
          return;
        }
        finishCloseProjectPanel();
      }

      /* Synchronizes project workspace header title, stats, and pin state */
      function refreshProjectHeader() {
        const p = db.projects[curProjIdx];
        if (!p) return;
        const meta = document.getElementById("ppMeta");
        const pinBtn = document.getElementById("ppPinBtn");
        if (meta) {
          const total = (p.tasks || []).length;
          const active = (p.tasks || []).filter(
            (t) => t.status !== "done" && t.status !== "skip",
          ).length;
          const doneN = (p.tasks || []).filter((t) => t.status === "done").length;
          const pct = total ? Math.round((doneN / total) * 100) : 0;
          meta.textContent = `${active} active • ${total} tasks • ${(p.docs || []).length} docs • ${pct}% done`;
        }
        if (pinBtn) {
          pinBtn.classList.toggle("is-on", !!p.isPinned);
          pinBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!!p.isPinned));
          pinBtn.title = p.isPinned ? "Unpin project" : "Pin project";
          pinBtn.innerHTML = `<svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-pin${p.isPinned ? "-fill" : ""}"/></svg>`;
        }
        const inp = document.getElementById("ppTitle");
        if (inp) inp.title = p.title || "Rename project";
        const tint = projectTint(p);
        const panel = document.getElementById("projectPanel");
        if (panel) {
          panel.style.setProperty("--proj-tint", tint.bg);
          panel.style.setProperty("--proj-ink", tint.ink);
        }
        const dot = document.getElementById("ppColourDot");
        if (dot) dot.style.background = tint.bg;
        const bar = document.getElementById("ppPalette");
        if (bar) {
          bar.innerHTML = projectPalette
            .map(
              (c) =>
                `<button type="button" class="doc-sw ${tint.bg === c.bg ? "is-on" : ""}" style="--sw:${c.bg}" data-tip="${c.name}" aria-label="Set project colour ${c.name}" onclick="setProjectColor('${c.bg}')"></button>`,
            )
            .join("");
        }
      }

      /* Sets and persists project accent theme color */
      const projectPalette = [
        { name: "Indigo", bg: "#eef2ff", ink: "#4338ca" },
        { name: "Sun", bg: "#fffbeb", ink: "#b45309" },
        { name: "Mint", bg: "#f0fdf4", ink: "#15803d" },
        { name: "Sky", bg: "#eff6ff", ink: "#1d4ed8" },
        { name: "Rose", bg: "#fff1f2", ink: "#be123c" },
        { name: "Lilac", bg: "#f5f3ff", ink: "#6d28d9" },
        { name: "Teal", bg: "#ecfeff", ink: "#0e7490" },
        { name: "Slate", bg: "#ffffff", ink: "#334155" },
      ];

      function projectTint(p) {
        const c = projectPalette.find(
          (x) => x.bg.toLowerCase() === (p && p.color ? p.color : "").toLowerCase(),
        );
        return c || projectPalette[projectPalette.length - 1];
      }

      function setProjectColor(color) {
        const p = db.projects[curProjIdx];
        if (!p) return;
        p.color = color;
        saveDB();
        refreshProjectHeader();
        renderProjects();
        if (typeof renderProjectListPanel === "function") renderProjectListPanel();
      }

      function toggleProjectPalette(btn) {
        const bar = document.getElementById("ppPalette");
        if (!bar) return;
        const open = bar.classList.toggle("is-open");
        btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      }

      function toggleCurrentProjectPin() {
        const p = db.projects[curProjIdx];
        if (!p) return;
        p.isPinned = !p.isPinned;
        saveDB();
        refreshProjectHeader();
        renderProjects();
      }

      function updateProjectTitle(val) {
        const p = currentProj();
        if (!p) return; /* Project state validation guard */
        const clean = (val || "").trim().slice(0, MAX_TITLE_LEN);
        if (!clean) {
          /* Validates non-empty project name on rename */
          document.getElementById("ppTitle").value = p.title;
          return;
        }
        p.title = clean;
        const inp = document.getElementById("ppTitle");
        if (inp && inp.value !== clean) inp.value = clean;
        saveDB();
        refreshProjectHeader();
        renderProjects();
        if (typeof renderProjectListPanel === "function") renderProjectListPanel();
      }

      function applyProjectTab(tab) {
        curProjTab = tab;
        document
          .getElementById("ppTabTask")
          .classList.toggle("active", tab === "task");
        document
          .getElementById("ppTabDoc")
          .classList.toggle("active", tab === "doc");
        document.getElementById("projFilters").style.display =
          tab === "task" ? "flex" : "none";
        const fab = document.getElementById("projFab");
        setFabMark(fab, tab === "doc" && isProjEdit ? "check" : "plus");
        renderProjectContent();
      }

      function setProjectTab(tab) {
        if (tab === curProjTab) return;
        if (isProjEdit && isDirty()) {
          confirmDiscard(() => {
            doCancelProjEdit();
            applyProjectTab(tab);
          });
          return;
        }
        if (isProjEdit) doCancelProjEdit();
        applyProjectTab(tab);
      }

      function setProjTaskFilter(filter, el) {
        projTaskFilter = filter;
        document
          .querySelectorAll("#projFilters .f-chip")
          .forEach((c) => c.classList.remove("active"));
        el.classList.add("active");
        renderProjectContent();
      }

      function toggleProjDocView() {
        isProjDocCardView = !isProjDocCardView;
        renderProjectContent();
      }

      function handleProjSearch(value) {
        projDocSearchQuery = value.toLowerCase().trim();
        clearTimeout(projSearchTimer);
        projSearchTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
          const box = document.getElementById("projectBody");
          const scrollTop = box.scrollTop;
          renderProjectContent();
          const input = box.querySelector(".proj-search-inp");
          if (input) {
            input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            input.setSelectionRange(input.value.length, input.value.length);
            box.scrollTop = scrollTop;
          }
        }, 90);
      }

      function renderProjectContent() {
        destroyRichEditor();
        const box = document.getElementById("projectBody");
        const p = db.projects[curProjIdx];
        const projectEditorActive = isProjEdit && curProjTab === "doc";
        /* Restores add button visibility after document editor closes */
        if (!projectEditorActive) {
          const projFab = document.getElementById("projFab");
          if (projFab) projFab.style.setProperty("display", "flex", "important");
          setFabMark(projFab, "plus");
        }
        if (!p) return;
        refreshProjectHeader();
        box.classList.toggle("editor-active", projectEditorActive);
        box.innerHTML = "";
        if (isProjEdit && curProjTab === "doc") {
          {
            const projFab = document.getElementById("projFab");
            if (projFab)
              projFab.style.setProperty("display", "none", "important");
          }
          box.innerHTML = `
        <div class="proj-editor-wrapper">
            <div id="projQuill"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="editor-actions">
            <button type="button" onclick="saveProjDoc()" style="flex:1; background:var(--primary); color:#fff; padding:12px; border:none; border-radius:10px; font-weight:800; font-size:1rem; cursor:pointer;">
                Save
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="cancelProjDocEdit()" style="width:100px; background:#f1f5f9; color:var(--text-main); border:none; border-radius:10px; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer;" title="Close editor">
                Close
            </button>
        </div>`;
          quill = createRichEditor("#projQuill", "pq", "Start writing your document…");
          if (editingProjDocIdx !== null && p.docs[editingProjDocIdx]) {
            quill.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(
              0,
              sanitizeDocHTML(p.docs[editingProjDocIdx].html),
              "silent",
            );
          }
          loadHistoryForActiveNote(); /* Document edit transition */
          recoverDraft(); /* Document draft check */
          snapshotBase(quill.root.innerHTML);
          return;
        }
        if (curProjTab === "task") {
          let tasks = p.tasks.map((t, i) => ({
            ...t,
            oIdx: i,
          }));
          if (projTaskFilter !== "all") {
            if (projTaskFilter === "pending")
              tasks = tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "pending");
            else tasks = tasks.filter((t) => t.status === projTaskFilter);
          }
          if (!tasks.length) {
            box.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center; margin-top:50px; color:var(--text-sub);">No ${projTaskFilter} tasks.</div>`;
            return;
          }
          tasks.forEach((t) => {
            const isDone = t.status === "done";
            const isSkip = t.status === "skip";
            box.innerHTML += `
            <div class="card ${escapeHTMLText(t.status)}" style="border-left: 4px solid ${isDone ? "var(--success)" : isSkip ? "var(--skip)" : "var(--primary)"};">
                <div class="card-check" onclick="toggleProjTask(${t.oIdx})" style="background:${isDone ? "var(--success)" : "transparent"}; border-color:${isDone ? "var(--success)" : "var(--border)"}">
                     ${isDone ? '<svg style="width:14px;fill:white"><use href="#icon-check"/></svg>' : ""}
                </div>
                <div class="card-content">

		    <textarea class="inp-flat" rows="1" maxlength="500" style="background:transparent; border:none; padding:0; font-weight:700; font-size:0.95rem; color:var(--text-main); width:100%; line-height: 1.4;" placeholder="Task Title" oninput="scheduleTextareaResize(this);" onchange="updProjTask(${t.oIdx}, 'txt', this.value)">${escapeHTMLText(t.txt)}</textarea>

		    <textarea class="proj-desc-inp" rows="1" maxlength="2000" placeholder="Add description..." oninput="scheduleTextareaResize(this);" onchange="updProjTask(${t.oIdx}, 'desc', this.value)">${escapeHTMLText(t.desc || "")}</textarea>



                </div>
                <div class="task-actions">
                     <button type="button" class="pk-btn" onclick="skipProjTask(${t.oIdx})">${isSkip ? "RESET" : "SKIP"}</button>
                     ${PanelControls.delIcon(`delProjItem('task', ${t.oIdx})`, "task")}
                </div>
            </div>`;
          });
        } else {
          const controls = `
        <div class="proj-controls">
            ${renderDocSearch("handleProjSearch(this.value)", projDocSearchQuery, "Search documents…", "handleProjSearch('')")}
            ${PanelControls.viewMode("toggleProjDocView()", isProjDocCardView, "documents")}
            <button type="button" class="pk-btn pk-pin ${projPinnedOnly ? "is-on" : ""}" aria-pressed="${projPinnedOnly}" onclick="toggleProjPinnedOnly()">${PanelControls._pinSVG(projPinnedOnly)}<span>Pinned</span></button>
        </div>`;
          box.innerHTML = controls;
          let docs = p.docs.map((d, i) => ({
            ...d,
            oIdx: i,
          }));
          if (projDocSearchQuery) {
            docs = docs.filter((d) =>
              d.html.toLowerCase().includes(projDocSearchQuery),
            );
          }
          if (projPinnedOnly) docs = docs.filter((d) => d.isPinned);
          const pinnedDocs = docs.filter((d) => d.isPinned);
          const otherDocs = docs.filter((d) => !d.isPinned);
          if (!docs.length) {
            box.innerHTML += `<div class="doc-empty"><div class="doc-empty-ico">📂</div><div class="doc-empty-title">${projDocSearchQuery || projPinnedOnly ? "No matching documents" : "No documents yet"}</div><div class="doc-empty-sub">${projDocSearchQuery || projPinnedOnly ? "Try a different search or filter." : "Tap + to write your first document."}</div></div>`;
            return;
          }
          const cardFor = (d) =>
            renderDocCard({
              key: `proj-${curProjIdx}-${d.oIdx}`,
              html: d.html,
              bg: d.bg,
              isPinned: d.isPinned,
              created: d.created,
              updated: d.updated,
              query: projDocSearchQuery,
              onPin: `toggleProjPin(${d.oIdx})`,
              onEdit: `startProjEdit(${d.oIdx})`,
              onDelete: `delProjItem('doc', ${d.oIdx})`,
              onColor: `setProjDocColor(${d.oIdx}, '__C__')`,
            });
          const gridClass = isProjDocCardView ? "doc-grid is-list" : "doc-grid";
          let htmlContent = `<div class="doc-scroll">`;
          if (pinnedDocs.length > 0) {
            htmlContent += `
            <section class="pinned-header">
                <div class="pin-label" style="color:#b45309; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;"><svg style="width:13px;height:13px;color:#f59e0b"><use href="#icon-pin-fill"/></svg>PINNED DOCS</div>
                <div class="${gridClass}">
                    ${pinnedDocs.map(cardFor).join("")}
                </div>
            </section>`;
          }
          if (otherDocs.length > 0) {
            htmlContent += `
            <section style="margin-top:18px;">
                <div class="group-label">All files (${otherDocs.length})</div>
                <div class="${gridClass}">
                    ${otherDocs.map(cardFor).join("")}
                </div>
            </section>`;
          }
          htmlContent += `</div>`;
          box.innerHTML += htmlContent;
        }
        autoResizeAll();
      }

      function startProjEdit(idx) {
        if (!currentProj()) return; /* Project state validation guard */
        isProjEdit = true;
        editingProjDocIdx = idx;
        const fab = document.getElementById("projFab");
        setFabMark(fab, "check");
        document.getElementById("projectBody").scrollTop = 0;
        renderProjectContent();
      }


      /* B1: Cancel uses the shared dirty guard (do not wipe drafts silently) */
      function cancelProjDocEdit() {
        cancelProjEdit();
      }

      function saveProjDoc() {
        if (!quill) return;
        const p = currentProj();
        if (!p) return; /* Project state validation guard */
        const html = quill.root.innerHTML;
        const txt = quill.getText().trim();
        const hasContent =
          txt.length > 0 ||
          html.includes("<img") ||
          html.includes("<iframe") ||
          html.includes("<table") ||
          html.includes("doc-table") ||
          html.includes("<hr") ||
          html.includes("katex");
        if (!hasContent) {
          showAppAlert(
            "Empty Document",
            "Please write something before saving!",
          );
          return;
        }
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        if (editingProjDocIdx !== null) {
          p.docs[editingProjDocIdx].html = html;
          p.docs[editingProjDocIdx].updated = now;
        } else {
          p.docs.unshift({
            html: html,
            bg: getRandomColor(),
            isPinned: false,
            created: now,
            updated: now,
          });
        }
        saveDB();
        snapshotBase(html);
        clearDraftForActiveNote(); /* Document draft check */
        doCancelProjEdit();
      }

      function addProjectItem() {
        const p = currentProj();
        if (!p) return; /* Guard against stale project index reference */
        if (curProjTab === "task") {
          if (p.tasks.length >= MAX_ITEMS_PER_DAY) {
            showAppAlert("Limit reached", "This project already has " + MAX_ITEMS_PER_DAY + " tasks.");
            return;
          }
          p.tasks.push({
            txt: "",
            desc: "",
            status: "pending",
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          });
          saveDB();
          renderProjectContent();
        } else {
          startProjEdit(null);
        }
      }

      function updProjTask(idx, field, val) {
        const p = currentProj();
        if (!p || !p.tasks[idx]) return; /* Project state validation guard */
        if (field === "txt") val = String(val || "").slice(0, MAX_TXT_LEN);
        if (field === "desc") val = String(val || "").slice(0, 2000);
        p.tasks[idx][field] = val;
        p.tasks[idx].updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        saveDB();
      }

      function toggleProjTask(idx) {
        const p = currentProj();
        const t = p && p.tasks[idx];
        if (!t) return; /* Project state validation guard */
        t.status = t.status === "done" ? "pending" : "done";
        saveDB();
        renderProjectContent();
      }

      function skipProjTask(idx) {
        const p = currentProj();
        const t = p && p.tasks[idx];
        if (!t) return; /* Project state validation guard */
        t.status = t.status === "skip" ? "pending" : "skip";
        saveDB();
        renderProjectContent();
      }

      function toggleProjPin(idx) {
        const p = currentProj();
        const d = p && p.docs[idx];
        if (!d) return; /* Project state validation guard */
        d.isPinned = !d.isPinned;
        saveDB();
        renderProjectContent();
      }

      function cancelProjEdit() {
        if (isDirty()) {
          confirmLeaveEditor({ onDiscard: doCancelProjEdit, onSave: saveProjDoc });
          return;
        }
        doCancelProjEdit();
      }

      function doCancelProjEdit() {
        destroyRichEditor();
        isProjEdit = false;
        editingProjDocIdx = null;
        const projFab = document.getElementById("projFab");
        if (projFab) projFab.style.setProperty("display", "flex", "important");
        setFabMark(projFab, "plus");
        renderProjectContent();
      }


      /**
       * Module: All Projects Browser Panel
       * Responsibilities: Full-page responsive project browser with search, sorting,
       * card grid layout, and sidebar preview pane.
       */
      let plQuery = "";
      /* All Projects card list rendering */
      const plListMode = true;
      let plSort = safeStore.getItem("plSort") || "recent";
      let plPinnedOnly = false;
      let plPreviewIdx = null;
      let plSearchTimer = 0;

      function openProjectListPanel() {
        const panel = document.getElementById("projectListPanel");
        panel.classList.add("active");
        panel.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
        renderProjectListPanel();
      }

      function closeProjectListPanel() {
        const panel = document.getElementById("projectListPanel");
        panel.classList.remove("active");
        panel.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        renderProjects();
      }

      function plSearch(v) {
        plQuery = (v || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        clearTimeout(plSearchTimer);
        plSearchTimer = window.setTimeout(() => renderProjectListPanel(true), 90);
      }

      function plSetSort(v) {
        plSort = v;
        safeStore.setItem("plSort", plSort);
        renderProjectListPanel();
      }

      function plTogglePinnedOnly() {
        plPinnedOnly = !plPinnedOnly;
        renderProjectListPanel();
      }

      function plTogglePin(idx) {
        const proj = db.projects[idx];
        if (!proj) return;
        proj.isPinned = !proj.isPinned;
        saveDB();
        renderProjectListPanel();
        renderProjects();
      }

      function plDelete(idx) {
        const proj = db.projects[idx];
        if (!proj) return;
        showAppConfirm(
          "Delete Project?",
          `Delete "${escapeHTMLText(proj.title)}" and everything inside it? This cannot be undone.`,
          () => {
            db.projects.splice(idx, 1);
            if (plPreviewIdx === idx) plPreviewIdx = null;
            saveDB();
            renderProjectListPanel();
            renderProjects();
          },
        );
      }

      function plPreview(idx) {
        plPreviewIdx = idx;
        renderProjectListPanel();
        if (window.matchMedia("(max-width: 759px)").matches) {
          openProjectPanel(idx);
        }
      }

      function plOpen(idx) {
        openProjectPanel(idx);
      }

      function renderProjectListPanel(keepFocus) {
        const panel = document.getElementById("projectListPanel");
        if (!panel || !panel.classList.contains("active")) return;
        const bar = document.getElementById("plControls");
        const grid = document.getElementById("plGrid");
        if (!bar || !grid) return;

        if (!bar.dataset.built || !keepFocus) {
          bar.innerHTML = `
            <input type="text" class="proj-search-inp" id="plSearchInp" placeholder="Search projects..." value="${escapeHTMLText(plQuery)}" oninput="plSearch(this.value)" style="min-width:150px;">
            <button type="button" class="pk-btn pk-pin ${plPinnedOnly ? "is-on" : ""}" aria-pressed="${plPinnedOnly}" onclick="plTogglePinnedOnly()">${PanelControls._pinSVG(plPinnedOnly)}<span>Pinned</span></button>
            <button type="button" class="pk-btn ${plSort === "recent" ? "is-on" : ""}" onclick="plSetSort('recent')">Recent</button>
            <button type="button" class="pk-btn ${plSort === "az" ? "is-on" : ""}" onclick="plSetSort('az')">A–Z</button>
            <button type="button" class="pk-btn ${plSort === "active" ? "is-on" : ""}" onclick="plSetSort('active')">Most active</button>`;
          bar.dataset.built = "1";
        }

        let items = (db.projects || []).map((p, i) => ({ p, i }));
        if (plQuery) {
          items = items.filter(({ p }) =>
            (p.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(plQuery),
          );
        }
        if (plPinnedOnly) items = items.filter(({ p }) => p.isPinned);
        const activeCount = (p) =>
          (p.tasks || []).filter((t) => t.status !== "done" && t.status !== "skip")
            .length;
        if (plSort === "az") {
          items.sort((a, b) => (a.p.title || "").localeCompare(b.p.title || ""));
        } else if (plSort === "active") {
          items.sort((a, b) => activeCount(b.p) - activeCount(a.p));
        } else {
          items.sort(
            (a, b) =>
              new Date(b.p.created || 0) - new Date(a.p.created || 0),
          );
        }
        items.sort((a, b) => (b.p.isPinned ? 1 : 0) - (a.p.isPinned ? 1 : 0));

        grid.className = "pl-grid" + (plListMode ? " pk-list-mode" : "");
        if (!items.length) {
          grid.innerHTML = `<div class="pl-empty">No projects match this view.</div>`;
        } else {
          grid.innerHTML = items
            .map(({ p, i }) => {
              const total = (p.tasks || []).length;
              const pending = activeCount(p);
              const doneN = (p.tasks || []).filter((t) => t.status === "done").length;
              const percent =
                total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((doneN / total) * 100);
              return `
            <div class="pl-card ${p.isPinned ? "is-pinned" : ""}" style="--proj-tint:${projectTint(p).bg}; --proj-ink:${projectTint(p).ink}" onclick="plPreview(${i})" ondblclick="plOpen(${i})">
                <div class="pl-card-title">${escapeHTMLText(p.title)}</div>
                <div class="pl-card-meta">${pending} active • ${total} tasks • ${(p.docs || []).length} docs • ${percent}% done</div>
                <div class="pl-card-actions">
                    ${PanelControls.pinIcon(`plTogglePin(${i})`, p.isPinned, "project")}
                    ${PanelControls.delIcon(`plDelete(${i})`, "project")}
                </div>
            </div>`;
            })
            .join("");
        }

        const prev = document.getElementById("plPreview");
        const proj = plPreviewIdx !== null ? db.projects[plPreviewIdx] : null;
        if (prev) {
          prev.innerHTML = proj
            ? `<div style="font-size:1rem; font-weight:800; margin-bottom:4px; overflow-wrap:anywhere;">${escapeHTMLText(proj.title)}</div>
               <div style="font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--text-sub); margin-bottom:12px;">${(proj.tasks || []).length} tasks • ${(proj.docs || []).length} docs</div>
               <button type="button" class="pk-btn is-on" onclick="plOpen(${plPreviewIdx})">Open workspace</button>
               <div style="margin-top:14px;">${
                 (proj.tasks || [])
                   .slice(0, 12)
                   .map(
                     (t) =>
                       `<div style="padding:8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); font-size:0.82rem; overflow-wrap:anywhere;">${t.status === "done" ? "✅" : t.status === "skip" ? "⏭" : "•"} ${t.txt ? escapeHTMLText(t.txt) : "<i>Untitled task</i>"}</div>`,
                   )
                   .join("") || '<div class="pl-empty">No tasks yet.</div>'
               }</div>`
            : `<div class="pl-empty">Select a project to preview it here.</div>`;
        }

        if (keepFocus) {
          const inp = document.getElementById("plSearchInp");
          if (inp && document.activeElement !== inp) {
            inp.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            inp.setSelectionRange(inp.value.length, inp.value.length);
          }
        }
      }

      function deleteMasterItem(key, type, idx) {
        if (!isValidStoreKey(key)) return console.warn("Blocked invalid store key:", key); /* F11 */
        showAppConfirm(
          "Delete Item?",
          "Are you sure? This will permanently remove the item.",
          () => {
            if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.hydrateDay(key);
            db[key][type].splice(idx, 1);
            if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.rebuildCatalog();
            triggerDBSave();
            renderMasterContent();
          },
        );
      }

      function deleteCurrentProject() {
        showAppConfirm(
          "Delete Project?",
          "Delete this entire project? This action is irreversible!",
          () => {
            db.projects.splice(curProjIdx, 1);
            saveDB();
            closeProjectPanel();
          },
        );
      }

      function delProjItem(type, idx) {
        showAppConfirm(
          "Remove Item?",
          "Are you sure you want to remove this item?",
          () => {
            const p = currentProj();
            if (!p) return; /* Project state validation guard */
            if (type === "task") {
              if (Array.isArray(p.tasks) && p.tasks[idx]) p.tasks.splice(idx, 1);
            } else if (Array.isArray(p.docs) && p.docs[idx]) {
              p.docs.splice(idx, 1);
            }
            saveDB();
            renderProjectContent();
          },
        );
      }

      /**
       * Module: Persistence, Startup, and Synchronization
       * Responsibilities: IndexedDB storage engine, localStorage fallback, cross-tab synchronization,
       * and database schema migrations.
       */
      let dbSaveTimer = 0;
      let saveStatusTimer = 0;
      /* Monotonic database revision counter for change detection */
      let dataRev = 0;
      let pinDragActive = false; /* B6: pin drag lifecycle flag */
      let lastSheetRev = -1;

      /**
       * Module: Backup and Restore Engine
       * Responsibilities: Exports entire database to JSON backup file and restores from JSON
       * with schema validation and sanitization.
       */
      function exportBackup() {
        try {
          // Phase 3: cold days have empty arrays in db (items live in the
          // mirror). Build a merged snapshot so the backup contains every
          // item, not just the hot window.
          let snapshot = db;
          if (window.__itemsMirror) {
            snapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(db));
            Object.keys(window.__itemsMirror).forEach((k) => {
              if (k === "general") {
                snapshot.general = Object.assign(
                  { bg: "#ffffff", pins: [], tasks: [], notes: [] },
                  snapshot.general || {},
                  window.__itemsMirror[k],
                );
                return;
              }
              if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(k)) return;
              if (!snapshot[k]) snapshot[k] = { bg: "#ffffff", pins: [], tasks: [], notes: [], cals: {} };
              const m = window.__itemsMirror[k];
              if (m.pins) snapshot[k].pins = m.pins;
              if (m.tasks) snapshot[k].tasks = m.tasks;
              if (m.notes) snapshot[k].notes = m.notes;
            });
          }
          const payload = {
            app: "Pro Planner",
            version: 8,
            exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            data: snapshot,
          };
          const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], {
            type: "application/json",
          });
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          const a = document.createElement("a");
          a.href = url;
          a.download = `planner-backup-${toLocalDateKey(new Date())}.json`;
          document.body.appendChild(a);
          a.click();
          a.remove();
          setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000);
          setSaveStatus("Backup downloaded");
        } catch (e) {
          showAppAlert("Export failed", e.message || "Could not create backup.");
        }
      }

      // Declared with `let` so the chunked engine (Phase 1) can override the
      // import routine in the same lexical scope.
      let importBackup = function () {
        const input = document.createElement("input");
        input.type = "file";
        input.accept = "application/json,.json";
        input.style.display = "none";
        document.body.appendChild(input);
        input.addEventListener("change", () => {
          const file = input.files && input.files[0];
          if (!file) return input.remove();
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = () => {
            let parsed;
            try {
              parsed = JSON.parse(String(reader.result));
            } catch (e) {
              showAppAlert("Import failed", "That file is not valid JSON.");
              input.remove();
              return;
            }
            const incoming = parsed && parsed.data ? parsed.data : parsed;
            if (!incoming || typeof incoming !== "object") {
              showAppAlert("Import failed", "No planner data found in that file.");
              input.remove();
              return;
            }
            showAppConfirm(
              "Replace all data?",
              "Importing will overwrite everything currently in this planner. Export a backup first if you are unsure.",
              () => {
                adoptDB(incoming, "import");
                saveDB();
                initProjects();
                renderCal();
                setSaveStatus("Backup restored");
                input.remove();
              },
              { okLabel: "Replace", cancelLabel: "Cancel", danger: true },
            );
          };
          reader.readAsText(file);
        });
        input.click();
      }

      let persistMode = "initializing";

      function markPersistFailed(msg) {
        persistMode = "failed";
        setSaveStatus(msg || "Offline — changes not saved", true);
      }

      function setSaveStatus(message, persistent = false) {
        const status = document.getElementById("saveStatus");
        if (!status) return;
        clearTimeout(saveStatusTimer);
        status.textContent = message;
        status.classList.add("visible");
        if (!persistent) {
          saveStatusTimer = window.setTimeout(
            () => status.classList.remove("visible"),
            900,
          );
        }
      }

      // Phase 1+ engine OVERRIDES these at installOverrides() time. They are
      // declared as `let` (not `function`) so the engine can reassign the
      // actual binding in this same scope. Assigning window.x would NOT work
      // because function declarations are lexical in a classic script.
      let commitDBSave = function () {
        clearTimeout(dbSaveTimer);
        dbSaveTimer = 0;
        if (!idb) {
          markPersistFailed("Offline — changes not saved");
          return;
        }
        try {
          const tx = idb.transaction(["data"], "readwrite");
          tx.objectStore("data").put(db, "mainStore");
          tx.oncomplete = () => {
            persistMode = "ready";
            setSaveStatus("Saved");
            broadcastPlannerSync();
          };
          tx.onerror = () => markPersistFailed("Save failed — export a backup");
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Database save failed:", error);
          markPersistFailed("Save failed — export a backup");
        }
      };

      let saveDB = function () {
        dataRev++; /* Increments revision counter on database write */
        if (!idb) {
          markPersistFailed("Offline — changes not saved");
          return;
        }
        setSaveStatus("Saving…", true);
        clearTimeout(dbSaveTimer);
        dbSaveTimer = window.setTimeout(commitDBSave, 80);
      };

      let init = function () {
        /* Safe IndexedDB initialization with private browsing error handling */
        let request;
        try {
          request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 2); /* Creates object stores for planner items and version history */
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn("IndexedDB unavailable; running without persistence.", err);
          markPersistFailed("Offline — changes not saved");
          startApp();
          return;
        }
        request.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
          const database = e.target.result;
          if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains("data")) {
            database.createObjectStore("data");
          }
          /* Version history snapshot store */
          if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains("history")) {
            database.createObjectStore("history");
          }
        };
        request.onsuccess = (e) => {
          /* Database load completion handler */
          idb = e.target.result;
          const tx = idb.transaction(["data"], "readonly");
          const store = tx.objectStore("data");
          const readReq = store.get("mainStore");
          const boot = () => {
            /* Cleans blank records from loaded database collections */
            if (typeof pruneBlankEntries === "function") pruneBlankEntries();
            placeProjectSection();
            initProjectState();
            startApp();
          };
          readReq.onsuccess = (ev) => {
            adoptDB(ev.target.result || {}, "boot"); /* F7: real boot path */
            boot();
          };
          readReq.onerror = () => {
            console.warn("Could not read saved data; starting empty.");
            db = {};
            boot();
          };
          tx.onabort = boot;
        };
        request.onerror = (e) => {
          console.error("DB Error:", e);
          markPersistFailed("Storage blocked — changes will not persist");
          startApp();
        };
      }

      function loadDataAndRender() {
        /* Transaction error handling during database load */
        try {
          const tx = idb.transaction(["data"], "readonly");
          const store = tx.objectStore("data");
          const req = store.get("mainStore");
          req.onsuccess = () => {
            adoptDB(req.result || {}, "boot");
            startApp();
          };
          req.onerror = () => {
            console.warn("Could not read saved data; starting empty.");
            db = {};
            startApp();
          };
          tx.onabort = () => {
            db = db || {};
            startApp();
          };
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn("Read transaction failed; starting empty.", err);
          db = {};
          startApp();
        }
      }

      let appStarted = false;

      function startApp() {
        /* Prevents duplicate startup execution on failed transaction */
        if (appStarted) return;
        appStarted = true;
        ensureCalendars();
        renderCalBar();
        applyViewModeClass();
        updateViewToggle();
        if (typeof initProjects === "function") {
          initProjects();
        }
        if (viewMode === 2) {
          const todayKey = toLocalDateKey(new Date());
          selKey = todayKey;
          renderSheet();
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
          renderCal();
          buildTimePicker();
          buildDatePicker();
          updateClock();
          setInterval(() => {
            updateClock();
            if (pinDragActive) return;
            if (document.hidden) return;
            const today = new Date();
            const tk = toLocalDateKey(today);
            if (tk !== lastTodayKey) {
              lastTodayKey = tk;
              renderCal();
            } else if (
              viewDate.getMonth() === today.getMonth() &&
              viewDate.getFullYear() === today.getFullYear()
            ) {
              refreshCalTimers();
            }
            const ae = document.activeElement;
            const typing =
              ae &&
              typeof ae.matches === "function" &&
              ae.matches("input, textarea, [contenteditable='true'], .ql-editor");
            if (
              selKey &&
              !isEdit &&
              !document.body.classList.contains("keyboard-open") &&
              !typing
            ) {
              if (curTab === "task" && dataRev !== lastSheetRev) {
                renderSheet();
                lastSheetRev = dataRev;
              }
            }
          }, 6e4);
        }, 50);
      }

      const SYNC_TAB_ID = "tab-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);
      const syncChannel =
        "BroadcastChannel" in window ? new BroadcastChannel("app_sync") : null;

      function broadcastPlannerSync(detail) {
        if (!syncChannel) return;
        try {
          syncChannel.postMessage({
            type: "refresh",
            target: "planner",
            source: SYNC_TAB_ID,
            rev: dataRev,
            // Phase 5: fine-grained change list so other tabs reload only the
            // affected month chunks/meta instead of the whole database.
            changedMonths: Array.isArray(detail && detail.changedMonths)
              ? detail.changedMonths
              : null,
            metaChanged: !!(detail && detail.metaChanged),
            deletedAny: !!(detail && detail.deletedAny),
          });
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      if (syncChannel)
        syncChannel.onmessage = (event) => {
          const msg = event.data || {};
          if (msg.source === SYNC_TAB_ID) return;
          if (msg.rev != null && Number(msg.rev) <= dataRev && !dbSaveTimer) return;
          if (
            msg.type === "refresh" &&
            (msg.target === "planner" || msg.target === "all")
          ) {
            if (dbSaveTimer) return; /* keep unsaved local write; last-write-wins */
            setTimeout(async () => {
              if (!window.ChunkedStorage || !ChunkedStorage.engine()) return;
              try {
                const rerender = () => {
                  dataRev++;
                  if (typeof renderCal === "function") renderCal();
                  if (typeof renderCalBar === "function") renderCalBar();
                  if (
                    selKey && !isEdit &&
                    !document.body.classList.contains("keyboard-open") &&
                    document.activeElement &&
                    !document.activeElement.matches("input, textarea, [contenteditable='true']")
                  ) {
                    if (typeof renderSheet === "function") renderSheet();
                    lastSheetRev = dataRev;
                  }
                  if (typeof renderProjects === "function") renderProjects();
                  if (curProjIdx !== null &&
                      document.getElementById("projectPanel").classList.contains("active")) {
                    if (db.projects && db.projects[curProjIdx]) renderProjectContent();
                    else closeProjectPanel();
                  }
                  const mp = document.getElementById("masterPanel");
                  if (mp && mp.classList.contains("active") && !isMasterEditNote &&
                      typeof renderMasterContent === "function") {
                    renderMasterContent();
                  }
                };
                // Phase 5: fine-grained reload. If the other tab sent a change
                // list, reload only those months/meta; otherwise fall back to
                // a full reload for backwards compatibility.
                if (Array.isArray(msg.changedMonths) || msg.metaChanged) {
                  await ChunkedStorage.reloadChanged(
                    Array.isArray(msg.changedMonths) ? msg.changedMonths : [],
                    !!msg.metaChanged
                  );
                  rerender();
                } else {
                  // Legacy/unknown sender: do a full mirror reload.
                  const idb2 = ChunkedStorage.engine().idb;
                  const all = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                    const tx = idb2.transaction(["months"], "readonly");
                    const store = tx.objectStore("months");
                    const map = {};
                    const req = store.openCursor();
                    req.onsuccess = () => {
                      const c = req.result;
                      if (!c) return resolve(map);
                      map[c.key] = c.value;
                      c.continue();
                    };
                    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
                  });
                  // Clear and reload via loadMonthChunk for each key.
                  Object.keys(window.__itemsMirror || {}).forEach((k) => {
                    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(k)) delete window.__itemsMirror[k];
                  });
                  for (const mk of Object.keys(all)) {
                    if (mk === "general") continue;
                    try { await ChunkedStorage.loadMonthChunk(mk); } catch (e) {}
                  }
                  rerender();
                }
              } catch (e) {
                console.warn("Chunked sync apply failed", e);
              }
            }, 100);
          }
        };

      document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
        if (document.visibilityState === "hidden" && dbSaveTimer)
          commitDBSave();
      });
      window.addEventListener("pagehide", () => {
        if (dbSaveTimer) commitDBSave();

      /**
       * Module: Application Bootstrap & Global Keybindings

       * binds global keyboard shortcuts (Escape, Ctrl+S), and mounts viewport coordinator.
       */
      /* Global Escape key handler: closes active overlays and exits fullscreen mode */
      document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {

        const dc = document.getElementById("dayCustomizerPicker");
        if (dc && dc.classList.contains("open")) {

        const pl = document.getElementById("projectListPanel");

          return;

          cancelMasterNoteEdit();
          return;
        }
        if (isEdit) {

          return;
        }
        /* Exits fullscreen mode on Escape */

          applySheetFullscreen(false);
        }
      });

      /* =====================================================================
       * Module: Multi-Calendar Layer
       * Responsibilities: Named calendars (Notice, Work, …) rendered as 3D capsule
       * chips above the weekday row. Every pin / task / document belongs to exactly
       * one calendar, and every day-cell design is stored per calendar, so switching
       * calendars scopes what is shown, created and edited. The "All" capsule is a
       * multi-select group of calendars: it shows everything arranged per calendar
       * and merges the day-cell designs into one common pattern.
       * ===================================================================== */

      const CAL_ID_RE = /^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/i;

      const CAL_PALETTE = [
        "#4f46e5", "#0ea5e9", "#10b981", "#f59e0b", "#ef4444",
        "#ec4899", "#8b5cf6", "#14b8a6", "#f97316", "#64748b",
      ];

      const CAL_EMOJIS = ["📅", "🔔", "💼", "🏡", "🎓", "💪", "✈️", "💰", "❤️", "🎯", "🛠️", "🧠"];

      const DEFAULT_CALENDARS = [
        { id: "personal", name: "Personal", color: "#4f46e5", emoji: "🏡" },
        { id: "work", name: "Work", color: "#0ea5e9", emoji: "💼" },
        { id: "notice", name: "Notice", color: "#f59e0b", emoji: "🔔" },
      ];

      /* Design properties that live per calendar, per day */
      const CAL_DESIGN_KEYS = [
        "bg", "bgType", "bgGradient", "bgPattern",
        "borderStyle", "borderWidth", "borderRadius", "borderColor",
        "markTopEnabled", "markTopStyle", "markTopHeight", "markTopColor",
        "markBottomEnabled", "markBottomStyle", "markBottomHeight", "markBottomColor",
        "glowEnabled", "glowColor", "dayEmoji", "badgeText", "badgeBg",
      ];

      /* Active capsule: "all" or a calendar id */
      let activeCal = safeStore.getItem("activeCal") || "all";

      /* Calendars excluded from the "All" group (filter-style selection) */
      let calHidden = (() => {
        try {
          const raw = JSON.parse(safeStore.getItem("calHidden") || "[]");
          return new Set(Array.isArray(raw) ? raw.filter((v) => CAL_ID_RE.test(v)) : []);
        } catch (e) {
          return new Set();
        }
      })();

      /* Calendar new items land in while browsing "All" */
      let allCreateCal = safeStore.getItem("allCreateCal") || "";

      /* Calendar whose design the Day Customizer edits while browsing "All" */
      let dcDesignCal = "";

      let _calVisCache = null;

      function invalidateCalCache() {
        _calVisCache = null;
      }

      function persistCalPrefs() {
        safeStore.setItem("activeCal", activeCal);
        safeStore.setItem("calHidden", JSON.stringify([...calHidden]));
        safeStore.setItem("allCreateCal", allCreateCal || "");
      }

      function calendars() {
        if (!Array.isArray(db.calendars) || !db.calendars.length) ensureCalendars();
        return db.calendars;
      }

      function defaultCalId() {
        const list = Array.isArray(db.calendars) ? db.calendars : [];
        return (list[0] && list[0].id) || "personal";
      }

      function getCal(id) {
        const list = Array.isArray(db.calendars) ? db.calendars : [];
        return list.find((c) => c && c.id === id) || null;
      }

      function calColor(id) {
        const c = getCal(id);
        return (c && c.color) || "#94a3b8";
      }

      function calName(id) {
        const c = getCal(id);
        return (c && c.name) || "Unknown";
      }

      function calEmoji(id) {
        const c = getCal(id);
        return (c && c.emoji) || "📅";
      }

      /* Which calendar an item belongs to (legacy items fall back to the first one) */
      function calOf(item) {
        const id = item && typeof item.cal === "string" ? item.cal : "";
        return CAL_ID_RE.test(id) && getCal(id) ? id : defaultCalId();
      }

      function calVisSet() {
        if (_calVisCache) return _calVisCache;
        const list = Array.isArray(db.calendars) ? db.calendars : [];
        if (activeCal !== "all" && getCal(activeCal)) {
          _calVisCache = new Set([activeCal]);
        } else {
          const on = list.filter((c) => !calHidden.has(c.id)).map((c) => c.id);
          _calVisCache = new Set(on.length ? on : list.map((c) => c.id));
        }
        return _calVisCache;
      }

      function visibleCalIds() {
        const set = calVisSet();
        return (Array.isArray(db.calendars) ? db.calendars : [])
          .filter((c) => set.has(c.id))
          .map((c) => c.id);
      }

      function isAllView() {
        return activeCal === "all" || !getCal(activeCal);
      }

      function calItemVisible(item) {
        return calVisSet().has(calOf(item));
      }

      function calFilterItems(list) {
        return (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).filter(calItemVisible);
      }

      /* Calendar assigned to anything created right now */
      function calForNewItem() {
        if (!isAllView()) return activeCal;
        if (allCreateCal && getCal(allCreateCal) && calVisSet().has(allCreateCal))
          return allCreateCal;
        const vis = visibleCalIds();
        return vis[0] || defaultCalId();
      }

      function stampCal(item) {
        if (item && typeof item === "object") item.cal = calForNewItem();
        return item;
      }

      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
      /* Bootstrap + migration                                              */
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

      function isDefaultDesign(o) {
        if (!o || typeof o !== "object") return true;
        if (o.borderStyle && o.borderStyle !== "none") return false;
        if (o.markTopEnabled || o.markBottomEnabled || o.glowEnabled) return false;
        if (o.dayEmoji || o.badgeText) return false;
        if (o.bg && String(o.bg).toLowerCase() !== "#ffffff") return false;
        if (o.bgType && o.bgType !== "color") return false;
        if (o.bgGradient || o.bgPattern) return false;
        return true;
      }

      function ensureCalendars() {
        if (!Array.isArray(db.calendars) || !db.calendars.length) {
          db.calendars = DEFAULT_CALENDARS.map((c) => ({ ...c }));
        }
        db.calendars = db.calendars
          .filter((c) => c && typeof c === "object" && CAL_ID_RE.test(String(c.id || "")))
          .slice(0, 40)
          .map((c) => ({
            id: String(c.id),
            name: String(c.name || "Calendar").slice(0, 40),
            color: SAFE_HEX_RE.test(String(c.color)) ? String(c.color) : "#4f46e5",
            emoji: c.emoji ? capGraphemes(String(c.emoji).replace(/[<>]/g, ""), 2) : "📅",
          }));
        if (!db.calendars.length) db.calendars = DEFAULT_CALENDARS.map((c) => ({ ...c }));

        /* Legacy data migration: unlabelled items + root-level day design
           are adopted by the first calendar so nothing disappears. */
        const def = defaultCalId();
        Object.keys(db).forEach((key) => {
          if (key === "projects" || key === "mainStore" || key === "calendars") return;
          const b = db[key];
          if (!b || typeof b !== "object") return;
          ["pins", "tasks", "notes"].forEach((coll) => {
            (Array.isArray(b[coll]) ? b[coll] : []).forEach((it) => {
              if (!it || typeof it !== "object") return;
              if (!CAL_ID_RE.test(String(it.cal || "")) || !getCal(it.cal)) it.cal = def;
            });
          });
          if (!b.cals || typeof b.cals !== "object") b.cals = {};
          if (!isDefaultDesign(b)) {
            const target = (b.cals[def] = b.cals[def] || {});
            CAL_DESIGN_KEYS.forEach((k) => {
              if (b[k] !== undefined && target[k] === undefined) target[k] = b[k];
              if (k !== "bg") delete b[k];
            });
            b.bg = "#ffffff";
          }
        });
        invalidateCalCache();
      }

      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
      /* Per-calendar day design                                            */
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

      function dayDesign(key, calId) {
        const b = db[key];
        if (!b || !b.cals || typeof b.cals !== "object") return {};
        const d = b.cals[calId];
        return d && typeof d === "object" ? d : {};
      }

      /* Design used to paint a day cell: one calendar, or a merged common
         pattern (first visible calendar wins per property) in the All view. */
      function resolveDayDesign(key) {
        if (!isAllView()) return dayDesign(key, activeCal);
        const out = {};
        visibleCalIds().forEach((id) => {
          const src = dayDesign(key, id);
          CAL_DESIGN_KEYS.forEach((k) => {
            const v = src[k];
            if (out[k] === undefined && v !== undefined && v !== "" && v !== false)
              out[k] = v;
          });
        });
        return out;
      }

      /* Calendar the Day Customizer writes to */
      function dcCalId() {
        if (!isAllView()) return activeCal;
        if (dcDesignCal && getCal(dcDesignCal) && calVisSet().has(dcDesignCal))
          return dcDesignCal;
        return calForNewItem();
      }

      function dcTarget() {
        const b = ensureDayBucket(selKey);
        if (!b.cals || typeof b.cals !== "object") b.cals = {};
        const id = dcCalId();
        if (!b.cals[id] || typeof b.cals[id] !== "object") b.cals[id] = {};
        return b.cals[id];
      }

      function setDcDesignCal(id) {
        dcDesignCal = id;
        renderDcCalTarget();
        if (typeof openDayCustomizer === "function") openDayCustomizer();
      }

      function renderDcCalTarget() {
        const host = document.getElementById("dcCalTarget");
        if (!host) return;
        const cur = dcCalId();
        if (!isAllView()) {
          host.innerHTML = `<span>Designing</span><span class="dc-cal-btn is-on" style="--c:${calColor(cur)}">${escapeHTMLText(calEmoji(cur))} ${escapeHTMLText(calName(cur))}</span>`;
          return;
        }
        host.innerHTML =
          `<span>Design for</span>` +
          visibleCalIds()
            .map(
              (id) =>
                `<button type="button" class="dc-cal-btn ${id === cur ? "is-on" : ""}" style="--c:${calColor(id)}" onclick="setDcDesignCal('${id}')">${escapeHTMLText(calEmoji(id))} ${escapeHTMLText(calName(id))}</button>`,
            )
            .join("");
      }

      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
      /* Presentation helpers                                               */
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

      function calBadgeHTML(item, onclick) {
        const id = calOf(item);
        return `<span class="cal-badge" style="--c:${calColor(id)}" ${onclick ? `onclick="event.stopPropagation(); ${onclick}" role="button" data-tip="Move to another calendar" title="${escapeHTMLText(calName(id))}"` : ` title="${escapeHTMLText(calName(id))}"`}><span class="cal-sw"></span><span class="cal-ico">${escapeHTMLText(calEmoji(id))}</span><span class="cal-name">${escapeHTMLText(calName(id))}</span></span>`;
      }

      function calGroupHeadHTML(id, count) {
        return `<div class="cal-group-head" style="--c:${calColor(id)}" title="${escapeHTMLText(calName(id))}${count != null ? ` · ${count}` : ""}"><span class="cal-sw"></span><span class="cal-ico">${escapeHTMLText(calEmoji(id))}</span><span class="cal-name">${escapeHTMLText(calName(id))}</span>${count != null ? ` <span class="cal-grp-n">· ${count}</span>` : ""}<span class="cal-group-line" aria-hidden="true"></span></div>`;
      }

      /* Groups a list of items by calendar, following the calendar bar order */
      function calGroupItems(list) {
        const groups = [];
        visibleCalIds().forEach((id) => {
          const items = list.filter((it) => calOf(it) === id);
          if (items.length) groups.push({ id, items });
        });
        return groups;
      }

      /* Colour ticks under a day cell showing which calendars have content */
      function calDayStripHTML(key) {
        if (!isAllView()) return "";
        const b = db[key];
        if (!b) return "";
        const ids = visibleCalIds().filter((id) => {
          const hit = ["pins", "tasks", "notes"].some((coll) =>
            (Array.isArray(b[coll]) ? b[coll] : []).some((it) => calOf(it) === id),
          );
          return hit || !isDefaultDesign(dayDesign(key, id));
        });
        if (ids.length < 2) return "";
        return `<div class="cal-day-strip">${ids
          .map((id) => `<i style="--c:${calColor(id)}"></i>`)
          .join("")}</div>`;
      }

      function calDayCount(key, id) {
        // Phase 3: prefer the catalog (covers cold months) but fall back to db.
        if (window.__catalog) {
          let n = 0;
          const inKey = (r) => r.parentKey === key && calOf(r) === id;
          n += __catalog.pins.filter(inKey).length;
          n += __catalog.notes.filter(inKey).length;
          n += __catalog.tasks.filter(
            (r) => inKey(r) && r.status !== "done" && r.status !== "skip",
          ).length;
          return n;
        }
        const b = db[key];
        if (!b) return 0;
        let n = 0;
        ["pins", "tasks", "notes"].forEach((coll) => {
          (Array.isArray(b[coll]) ? b[coll] : []).forEach((it) => {
            if (calOf(it) === id) n++;
          });
        });
        return n;
      }

      /* Total live items per calendar (for the capsule counters) */
      function calTotals() {
        const totals = {};
        if (window.__catalog) {
          __catalog.pins.forEach((it) => {
            const id = calOf(it);
            totals[id] = (totals[id] || 0) + 1;
          });
          __catalog.notes.forEach((it) => {
            const id = calOf(it);
            totals[id] = (totals[id] || 0) + 1;
          });
          __catalog.tasks.forEach((it) => {
            if (it.status === "done" || it.status === "skip") return;
            const id = calOf(it);
            totals[id] = (totals[id] || 0) + 1;
          });
          return totals;
        }
        Object.keys(db).forEach((key) => {
          if (key === "projects" || key === "mainStore" || key === "calendars") return;
          const b = db[key];
          if (!b || typeof b !== "object") return;
          ["pins", "tasks", "notes"].forEach((coll) => {
            (Array.isArray(b[coll]) ? b[coll] : []).forEach((it) => {
              if (coll === "tasks" && (it.status === "done" || it.status === "skip")) return;
              const id = calOf(it);
              totals[id] = (totals[id] || 0) + 1;
            });
          });
        });
        return totals;
      }

      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
      /* Calendar bar (3D capsules above the weekday row)                    */
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

      function renderCalBar() {
        const bar = document.getElementById("calBar");
        if (!bar) return;
        ensureCalendars();
        const totals = calTotals();
        const list = calendars();
        const allOn = isAllView();
        const hiddenN = list.filter((c) => calHidden.has(c.id)).length;
        const allTotal = list.reduce(
          (n, c) => n + (calHidden.has(c.id) ? 0 : totals[c.id] || 0),
          0,
        );
        let html = `
          <button type="button" class="cal-chip ${allOn ? "is-active" : ""}" style="--c:#334155"
                  id="calChipAll" role="tab" aria-selected="${allOn}"
                  data-tip="All calendars — tap again to choose which ones are in the group"
                  onclick="onCalChipAll(event)">
            <span class="cal-chip-dot"></span>
            <span class="cal-chip-name">All</span>
            <span class="cal-chip-n">${allTotal}</span>
            ${hiddenN ? `<span class="cal-chip-caret">▾ ${list.length - hiddenN}/${list.length}</span>` : `<span class="cal-chip-caret">▾</span>`}
          </button>`;
        list.forEach((c) => {
          const on = activeCal === c.id;
          const muted = allOn && calHidden.has(c.id);
          html += `
          <button type="button" class="cal-chip ${on ? "is-active" : ""} ${muted ? "is-muted" : ""}"
                  style="--c:${c.color}" role="tab" aria-selected="${on}" data-cal="${c.id}"
                  data-tip="${escapeHTMLText(c.name)} — tap to open, long-press for options"
                  onclick="onCalChipClick(event, '${c.id}')">
            <span class="cal-chip-dot"></span>
            <span class="cal-chip-emo">${escapeHTMLText(c.emoji || "📅")}</span>
            <span class="cal-chip-name" title="${escapeHTMLText(c.name)}">${escapeHTMLText(c.name)}</span>
            <span class="cal-chip-n">${totals[c.id] || 0}</span>
          </button>`;
        });
        html += `
          <button type="button" class="cal-chip cal-chip-add" data-tip="Create a new calendar"
                  aria-label="Create a new calendar" onclick="openCalEditor(null)">+</button>`;
        bar.innerHTML = html;
        bindCalChipLongPress(bar);
      }

      function bindCalChipLongPress(bar) {
        bar.querySelectorAll(".cal-chip[data-cal]").forEach((chip) => {
          let timer = 0;
          const start = () => {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
              chip.dataset.longpress = "1";
              openCalMenu(chip.dataset.cal, chip);
            }, 480);
          };
          const stop = () => clearTimeout(timer);
          chip.addEventListener("touchstart", start, { passive: true });
          chip.addEventListener("touchend", stop);
          chip.addEventListener("touchmove", stop, { passive: true });
          chip.addEventListener("mousedown", start);
          chip.addEventListener("mouseup", stop);
          chip.addEventListener("mouseleave", stop);
          chip.addEventListener("contextmenu", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            openCalMenu(chip.dataset.cal, chip);
          });
        });
      }

      function onCalChipClick(e, id) {
        const chip = e.currentTarget;
