        if (chip && chip.dataset.longpress === "1") {
          delete chip.dataset.longpress;
          return;
        }
        if (activeCal === id) {
          openCalMenu(id, chip);
          return;
        }
        setActiveCal(id);
      }

      function onCalChipAll(e) {
        if (isAllView()) {
          openCalFilterPop(e.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        setActiveCal("all");
      }

      function setActiveCal(id) {
        activeCal = id === "all" || getCal(id) ? id : "all";
        dcDesignCal = "";
        invalidateCalCache();
        persistCalPrefs();
        refreshCalendarViews();
        const label = activeCal === "all" ? "All calendars" : calName(activeCal);
        if (typeof docToast === "function") docToast(label);
      }

      function refreshCalendarViews() {
        invalidateCalCache();
        renderCalBar();
        renderCal();
        if (selKey && document.getElementById("overlay") &&
            (document.getElementById("overlay").classList.contains("active") || viewMode === 2))
          renderSheet();
        const mp = document.getElementById("masterPanel");
        if (mp && mp.classList.contains("active") && !isMasterEditNote)
          renderMasterContent({ rebuildControls: true });
        renderDcCalTarget();
      }

      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
      /* Popovers: group filter + per-calendar menu                          */
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

      function closeCalPop() {
        document.querySelectorAll(".cal-pop").forEach((p) => p.remove());
      }

      function openCalPop(anchor, html) {
        closeCalPop();
        const pop = document.createElement("div");
        pop.className = "cal-pop";
        pop.innerHTML = html;
        document.body.appendChild(pop);
        const a = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
        const r = pop.getBoundingClientRect();
        let left = Math.min(Math.max(8, a.left), window.innerWidth - r.width - 8);
        let top = a.bottom + 8;
        if (top + r.height > window.innerHeight - 8)
          top = Math.max(8, a.top - r.height - 8);
        pop.style.left = left + "px";
        pop.style.top = top + "px";
        setTimeout(() => {
          const away = (ev) => {
            if (!pop.contains(ev.target)) {
              pop.remove();
              document.removeEventListener("mousedown", away);
              document.removeEventListener("touchstart", away);
            }
          };
          document.addEventListener("mousedown", away);
          document.addEventListener("touchstart", away);
        }, 0);
        return pop;
      }

      function openCalFilterPop(anchor) {
        const list = calendars();
        const rows = list
          .map((c) => {
            const on = !calHidden.has(c.id);
            return `<button type="button" class="cal-pop-row ${on ? "" : "is-off"}" onclick="toggleCalInGroup('${c.id}', this)">
              <span class="cal-sw" style="background:${c.color}"></span>
              <span>${escapeHTMLText(c.emoji || "📅")} ${escapeHTMLText(c.name)}</span>
              <span class="cal-tick">${on ? "✓" : ""}</span>
            </button>`;
          })
          .join("");
        const newIn = calForNewItem();
        const newRows = list
          .map(
            (c) =>
              `<button type="button" class="cal-pop-row" onclick="setAllCreateCal('${c.id}')">
                <span class="cal-sw" style="background:${c.color}"></span>
                <span>${escapeHTMLText(c.name)}</span>
                <span class="cal-tick">${newIn === c.id ? "✓" : ""}</span>
              </button>`,
          )
          .join("");
        openCalPop(
          anchor,
          `<div class="cal-pop-title">Calendars in this group</div>${rows}
           <div class="cal-pop-sep"></div>
           <button type="button" class="cal-pop-row" onclick="showAllCalendars()">☑ Select all</button>
           <div class="cal-pop-sep"></div>
           <div class="cal-pop-title">New items go to</div>${newRows}
           <div class="cal-pop-mini">In All view everything stays grouped per calendar. Edits always land in the item's own calendar.</div>`,
        );
      }

      function toggleCalInGroup(id, btn) {
        if (calHidden.has(id)) calHidden.delete(id);
        else calHidden.add(id);
        if (calHidden.size >= calendars().length) calHidden.delete(id);
        invalidateCalCache();
        persistCalPrefs();
        const on = !calHidden.has(id);
        if (btn) {
          btn.classList.toggle("is-off", !on);
          const tick = btn.querySelector(".cal-tick");
          if (tick) tick.textContent = on ? "✓" : "";
        }
        refreshCalendarViews();
      }

      function showAllCalendars() {
        calHidden.clear();
        invalidateCalCache();
        persistCalPrefs();
        closeCalPop();
        refreshCalendarViews();
      }

      function setAllCreateCal(id) {
        allCreateCal = id;
        persistCalPrefs();
        closeCalPop();
        if (typeof docToast === "function") docToast("New items go to " + calName(id));
      }

      function openCalMenu(id, anchor) {
        const c = getCal(id);
        if (!c) return;
        const inGroup = !calHidden.has(id);
        openCalPop(
          anchor,
          `<div class="cal-pop-title">${escapeHTMLText(c.emoji || "📅")} ${escapeHTMLText(c.name)}</div>
           <button type="button" class="cal-pop-row" onclick="closeCalPop(); setActiveCal('${id}')"><span class="cal-sw" style="background:${c.color}"></span>Open this calendar</button>
           <button type="button" class="cal-pop-row" onclick="closeCalPop(); soloCalendar('${id}')">◎ Show only this in All</button>
           <button type="button" class="cal-pop-row" onclick="toggleCalInGroup('${id}'); closeCalPop();">${inGroup ? "🚫 Hide from All" : "✓ Include in All"}</button>
           <div class="cal-pop-sep"></div>
           <button type="button" class="cal-pop-row" onclick="closeCalPop(); openCalEditor('${id}')">✎ Rename / recolour</button>
           <button type="button" class="cal-pop-row" style="color:var(--danger)" onclick="closeCalPop(); deleteCalendar('${id}')">🗑 Delete calendar</button>`,
        );
      }

      function soloCalendar(id) {
        calHidden = new Set(calendars().map((c) => c.id).filter((x) => x !== id));
        activeCal = "all";
        invalidateCalCache();
        persistCalPrefs();
        refreshCalendarViews();
      }

      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
      /* Calendar CRUD                                                       */
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

      let calEditId = null;
      let calEditColor = CAL_PALETTE[0];
      let calEditEmoji = "📅";

      function openCalEditor(id) {
        ensureCalendars();
        const c = id ? getCal(id) : null;
        calEditId = c ? c.id : null;
        calEditColor = c ? c.color : CAL_PALETTE[calendars().length % CAL_PALETTE.length];
        calEditEmoji = c ? c.emoji || "📅" : "📅";
        const title = document.getElementById("calEditTitle");
        if (title) title.textContent = c ? "Edit calendar" : "New calendar";
        const input = document.getElementById("calEditName");
        if (input) input.value = c ? c.name : "";
        const del = document.getElementById("calEditDelete");
        if (del) del.style.display = c ? "block" : "none";
        renderCalEditorSwatches();
        openPickerOverlay("calEditPicker");
        setTimeout(() => input && input.focus(), 60);
      }

      function closeCalEditor() {
        closePickerOverlay("calEditPicker");
      }

      function renderCalEditorSwatches() {
        const sw = document.getElementById("calEditSwatches");
        if (sw)
          sw.innerHTML = CAL_PALETTE.map(
            (c) =>
              `<button type="button" class="${c === calEditColor ? "is-on" : ""}" style="background:${c}" aria-label="Colour ${c}" onclick="pickCalEditColor('${c}')"></button>`,
          ).join("");
        const eg = document.getElementById("calEditEmojis");
        if (eg)
          eg.innerHTML = CAL_EMOJIS.map(
            (e) =>
              `<button type="button" class="${e === calEditEmoji ? "is-on" : ""}" onclick="pickCalEditEmoji('${e}')">${e}</button>`,
          ).join("");
      }

      function pickCalEditColor(c) {
        calEditColor = c;
        renderCalEditorSwatches();
      }

      function pickCalEditEmoji(e) {
        calEditEmoji = e;
        renderCalEditorSwatches();
      }

      function submitCalEditor() {
        const input = document.getElementById("calEditName");
        const name = String((input && input.value) || "").trim().slice(0, 40);
        if (!name) {
          showAppAlert("Name required", "Give this calendar a name first.");
          return;
        }
        ensureCalendars();
        if (calEditId) {
          const c = getCal(calEditId);
          if (c) {
            c.name = name;
            c.color = calEditColor;
            c.emoji = calEditEmoji;
          }
        } else {
          let base = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "").slice(0, 20) || "cal";
          let id = base;
          let n = 2;
          while (getCal(id)) id = base + "-" + n++;
          db.calendars.push({ id, name, color: calEditColor, emoji: calEditEmoji });
          activeCal = id;
        }
        saveDB();
        closeCalEditor();
        invalidateCalCache();
        refreshCalendarViews();
        docToast(calEditId ? "Calendar updated" : "Calendar created");
      }

      function deleteCalendar(id) {
        const c = getCal(id);
        if (!c) return;
        if (calendars().length <= 1) {
          showAppAlert("Cannot delete", "At least one calendar must remain.");
          return;
        }
        const fallback = calendars().find((x) => x.id !== id).id;
        showAppConfirm(
          "Delete " + c.name + "?",
          "Its pins, tasks and documents move to " + calName(fallback) + ". Its day designs are removed.",
          () => {
            Object.keys(db).forEach((key) => {
              if (key === "projects" || key === "mainStore" || key === "calendars") return;
              const b = db[key];
              if (!b || typeof b !== "object") return;
              ["pins", "tasks", "notes"].forEach((coll) => {
                (Array.isArray(b[coll]) ? b[coll] : []).forEach((it) => {
                  if (it && calOf(it) === id) it.cal = fallback;
                });
              });
              if (b.cals && b.cals[id]) delete b.cals[id];
            });
            db.calendars = db.calendars.filter((x) => x.id !== id);
            calHidden.delete(id);
            if (activeCal === id) activeCal = "all";
            if (allCreateCal === id) allCreateCal = "";
            persistCalPrefs();
            saveDB();
            invalidateCalCache();
            refreshCalendarViews();
            docToast("Calendar deleted");
          },
          { danger: true, okLabel: "Delete" },
        );
      }

      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
      /* Moving items between calendars                                      */
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

      function openItemCalPicker(current, onPick, anchor) {
        const rows = calendars()
          .map(
            (c) =>
              `<button type="button" class="cal-pop-row" onclick="closeCalPop(); (${onPick})('${c.id}')">
                <span class="cal-sw" style="background:${c.color}"></span>
                <span>${escapeHTMLText(c.emoji || "📅")} ${escapeHTMLText(c.name)}</span>
                <span class="cal-tick">${current === c.id ? "✓" : ""}</span>
              </button>`,
          )
          .join("");
        const host = anchor && anchor.getBoundingClientRect ? anchor : document.getElementById("calChipAll");
        openCalPop(host || document.body, `<div class="cal-pop-title">Move to calendar</div>${rows}`);
      }

      /* Day sheet item → another calendar */
      function pickDayItemCal(coll, idx, ev) {
        const bkt = db[selKey];
        const item = bkt && bkt[coll] && bkt[coll][idx];
        if (!item) return;
        openItemCalPicker(
          calOf(item),
          `function(id){ setDayItemCal('${coll}', ${idx}, id); }`,
          ev && ev.currentTarget,
        );
      }

      function setDayItemCal(coll, idx, id) {
        const bkt = db[selKey];
        const item = bkt && bkt[coll] && bkt[coll][idx];
        if (!item || !getCal(id)) return;
        item.cal = id;
        item.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        saveDB();
        renderSheet();
        renderCal();
        renderCalBar();
        docToast("Moved to " + calName(id));
      }

      /* Master planner item → another calendar */
      function pickMasterItemCal(key, coll, idx, ev) {
        const item = db[key] && db[key][coll] && db[key][coll][idx];
        if (!item) return;
        openItemCalPicker(
          calOf(item),
          `function(id){ setMasterItemCal('${escJS(key)}', '${coll}', ${idx}, id); }`,
          ev && ev.currentTarget,
        );
      }

      function setMasterItemCal(key, coll, idx, id) {
        if (!isValidStoreKey(key)) return;
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.hydrateDay(key);
        const item = db[key] && db[key][coll] && db[key][coll][idx];
        if (!item || !getCal(id)) return;
        item.cal = id;
        item.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        if (window.ChunkedStorage) ChunkedStorage.rebuildCatalog();
        saveDB();
        renderMasterContent();
        renderCal();
        renderCalBar();
        docToast("Moved to " + calName(id));
      }

      /* Empty-state hint text for a scoped calendar */
      function calScopeLabel() {
        return isAllView()
          ? "All calendars"
          : calEmoji(activeCal) + " " + calName(activeCal);
      }

      function setMasterCal(v) {
        mf().cal = v;
        renderMasterContent({ rebuildControls: true });
      }

      /* =====================================================================
         MODULE: Chunked Storage Engine (Phase 1)
         Replaces the single-blob mainStore persistence with a month-chunked
         IndexedDB v3 layout while keeping the in-memory `db` shape identical,
         so the rest of the synchronous app keeps working.

           meta    — calendars, projects, settings snapshot, manifest
           months  — one record per YYYY-MM: pins/tasks/day designs (plain) +
                     notes whose HTML is gzip-compressed on disk
           docs    — reserved for Phase 2/3 (per-document on-demand records)
           history — edit snapshots

         Notes:
           * Tasks/pins are written uncompressed per the design.
           * Note HTML is gzipped inside its month chunk at write time and
             decompressed at boot, so the UI still reads note.html synchronously.
           * Only changed month chunks are written on save.
           * v2 (mainStore) data is migrated once on upgrade.
         Phase 2 will turn months/docs into truly on-demand (async) loads and
         remove the full in-memory mirror; the synchronous render layer must be
         made async-ready first.
         ===================================================================== */
      (function () {
        "use strict";
        if (window.__chunkedStorageInstalled) return;
        window.__chunkedStorageInstalled = true;

        const NEW_DB_VERSION = 3;
        const gzipSupported =
          typeof window.CompressionStream === "function" &&
          typeof window.DecompressionStream === "function";

        function nowISO() {
          return new Date().toISOString();
        }

        /* ---------- gzip helpers (native, with a JSON fallback) ---------- */

        // Chunked base64 encoder/decoder. btoa(String.fromCharCode(...big))
        // crashes with a call-stack RangeError for large payloads (e.g. notes
        // with embedded images). These process the bytes in 0x8000 chunks.
        function bytesToBase64(buf) {
          const bytes = buf instanceof Uint8Array ? buf : new Uint8Array(buf);
          let bin = "";
          const CHUNK = 0x8000;
          for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += CHUNK) {
            bin += String.fromCharCode.apply(
              null,
              bytes.subarray(i, i + CHUNK),
            );
          }
          return btoa(bin);
        }
        function base64ToBytes(b64) {
          const bin = atob(b64);
          const len = bin.length;
          const bytes = new Uint8Array(len);
          for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
          return bytes;
        }

        async function gzipBytes(str) {
          if (!gzipSupported) return null;
          try {
            const stream = new Blob([str]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream("gzip"));
            return await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer();
          } catch (e) {
            return null;
          }
        }
        async function gunzipBytes(buf) {
          if (!gzipSupported || !buf) return null;
          try {
            const stream = new Blob([buf]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"));
            return await new Response(stream).text();
          } catch (e) {
            return null;
          }
        }

        /* ---------- month key helpers ---------- */
        function monthKeyOf(dateKey) {
          if (dateKey === "general") return "general";
          const m = /^(\d{4}-\d{2})-\d{2}$/.exec(String(dateKey || ""));
          return m ? m[1] : null;
        }
        function isDateKey(k) {
          return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(k));
        }

        /* ---------- encode/decode a month record to disk shape ---------- */
        async function encodeMonth(month, data) {
          const notesIn = (data && Array.isArray(data.notes)) ? data.notes : [];
          const notesOut = [];
          for (const n of notesIn) {
            const copy = { ...n };
            let html = "";
            try {
              html = typeof copy.html === "string" ? copy.html : "";
            } catch (e) {
              html = "";
            }
            delete copy.html;
            if (html.length > 0) {
              const gz = await gzipBytes(html);
              // Store a compact plain-text snippet so search/previews never need
              // to decompress the gzip body just to render a list or match text.
              try {
                const plain = (typeof docPlainPreview === "function"
                  ? docPlainPreview(html, 4000)
                  : html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()
                ).slice(0, 4000);
                copy.plain = plain;
                copy.snippet = plain.slice(0, 240);
              } catch (e) {
                copy.plain = "";
                copy.snippet = "";
              }
              if (gz) {
                copy.htmlGz = bytesToBase64(gz);
                copy.htmlEncoding = "gzip+base64";
              } else {
                copy.html = html;
              }
            } else {
              copy.html = "";
            }
            notesOut.push(copy);
          }
          return {
            v: 1,
            month,
            savedAt: nowISO(),
            pins: (data && Array.isArray(data.pins)) ? data.pins : [],
            tasks: (data && Array.isArray(data.tasks)) ? data.tasks : [],
            notes: notesOut,
            cals: data && data.cals ? data.cals : {},
            bg: data && data.bg ? data.bg : "#ffffff",
            // legacy top-level design fields (if any remain pre-migration)
            bgType: data && data.bgType ? data.bgType : undefined,
            bgGradient: data && data.bgGradient ? data.bgGradient : undefined,
            bgPattern: data && data.bgPattern ? data.bgPattern : undefined,
          };
        }

        async function decodeMonth(rec, opts) {
          if (!rec || typeof rec !== "object") return emptyMonthData();
          const keepGz = !!(opts && opts.keepGz);
          const out = emptyMonthData();
          out.pins = Array.isArray(rec.pins) ? rec.pins : [];
          out.tasks = Array.isArray(rec.tasks) ? rec.tasks : [];
          out.cals = rec.cals && typeof rec.cals === "object" ? rec.cals : {};
          out.bg = rec.bg || "#ffffff";
          if (rec.bgType) out.bgType = rec.bgType;
          if (rec.bgGradient) out.bgGradient = rec.bgGradient;
          if (rec.bgPattern) out.bgPattern = rec.bgPattern;
          const srcNotes = Array.isArray(rec.notes) ? rec.notes : [];
          for (const n of srcNotes) {
            if (!n || typeof n !== "object") continue;
            const copy = { ...n };
            if (copy.htmlEncoding === "gzip+base64" && typeof copy.htmlGz === "string") {
              if (keepGz) {
                // Phase 2: leave HTML compressed in RAM until a card/editor
                // actually needs it. A plain-text snippet is kept for search
                // and previews so the Master Planner stays instant.
                copy.html = "";
                if (!copy.snippet) {
                  try {
                    copy.snippet = (copy.plain || "").slice(0, 240);
                  } catch (e) { copy.snippet = ""; }
                }
              } else {
                let html = "";
                try {
                  const bin = atob(copy.htmlGz);
                  const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
                  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
                  const txt = await gunzipBytes(bytes.buffer);
                  html = txt == null ? "" : txt;
                } catch (e) {
                  html = "";
                }
                copy.html = html;
                delete copy.htmlGz;
                delete copy.htmlEncoding;
              }
            } else if (typeof copy.html !== "string") {
              copy.html = "";
            }
            out.notes.push(copy);
          }
          return out;
        }

        // Synchronously decompress a single note's HTML (used by editors / when
        // a doc card needs full content). Result is cached on the note object.
        function inflateNote(note) {
          if (!note || typeof note !== "object") return "";
          if (typeof note.html === "string" && note.html.length) return note.html;
          if (note.htmlEncoding === "gzip+base64" && typeof note.htmlGz === "string") {
            try {
              const bin = atob(note.htmlGz);
              const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
              for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
              // gunzipBytes is async; Phase 2 keeps a synchronous path because
              // renderDocCard is sync. We decompress via a cached promise and
              // fall back to the snippet on the very first paint.
              if (!note.__inflating) {
                note.__inflating = gunzipBytes(bytes.buffer).then((txt) => {
                  note.html = txt == null ? "" : txt;
                  delete note.__inflating;
                  // Phase 2: once the full HTML is available, refresh the
                  // currently visible list so cards expand beyond snippets.
                  try {
                    const mp = document.getElementById("masterPanel");
                    if (mp && mp.classList.contains("active") && !isMasterEditNote && typeof renderMasterContent === "function") {
                      renderMasterContent();
                    } else if (selKey && typeof renderSheet === "function" && curTab === "note" && !isEdit) {
                      renderSheet();
                    }
                  } catch (e) {}
                  return note.html;
                });
              }
              note.html = note.snippet || ""; // temporary first paint
            } catch (e) {
              note.html = note.snippet || "";
            }
          }
          return note.html || "";
        }

        function emptyMonthData() {
          return { pins: [], tasks: [], notes: [], cals: {}, bg: "#ffffff" };
        }

        function emptyDayBucket() {
          return { bg: "#ffffff", pins: [], tasks: [], notes: [], cals: {} };
        }

        /* ---------- stable signature for coarse dirty tracking ---------- */
        function signatureMonth(month, data) {
          try {
            // notes html is part of the in-memory data; gzip is non-deterministic
            // across runs but identical input here means no write is needed.
            // Each item's updatedAt + a short content digest catches edits,
            // status toggles, time changes and reordering.
            const dig = (x) =>
              x
                ? (x.updatedAt || x.createdAt || "") +
                  "::" +
                  (x.status || "") +
                  "::" +
                  (x.time || "") +
                  "::" +
                  (x.isPinned ? "1" : "0") +
                  "::" +
                  (x.cal || "") +
                  "::" +
                  String(typeof x.txt === "string" ? x.txt : "").length
                : "";
            const noteDig = (x) =>
              x
                ? (x.updatedAt || x.createdAt || "") +
                  "::" +
                  (x.isPinned ? "1" : "0") +
                  "::" +
                  (x.cal || "") +
                  "::" +
                  (x.html ? x.html.length : 0)
                : "";
            return JSON.stringify({
              p: (data.pins || []).map(dig),
              t: (data.tasks || []).map(dig),
              n: (data.notes || []).map(noteDig),
              c: data.cals || {},
              bg: data.bg,
            });
          } catch (e) {
            return Math.random() + "";
          }
        }
        function signatureMeta() {
          try {
            return JSON.stringify({
              calendars: Array.isArray(db.calendars) ? db.calendars : [],
              projects: Array.isArray(db.projects) ? db.projects : [],
              general: db.general || null,
            });
          } catch (e) {
            return Math.random() + "";
          }
        }

        /* ---------- engine state ---------- */
        let engine = null; // { idb, lastMonthSigs:Map, lastMetaSig }
        // Phase 3 storage: itemsMirror and catalog are declared at IIFE scope
        // (NOT inside installOverrides) so that writeAll() and the other
        // module-level helpers can read them. Declaring them inside
        // installOverrides caused "itemsMirror is not defined" on every save,
        // which surfaced as "Offline — changes not saved".
        const itemsMirror = {};
        const catalog = { pins: [], tasks: [], notes: [], byKey: new Map() };

        // All phase 3/4/5 helpers are also at IIFE scope (not nested in
        // installOverrides) because writeAll/reloadChanged etc. reference them
        // and would otherwise throw ReferenceError at save time.
        function isDateBucketKey(k) {
          return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(k));
        }
        function monthKeyOfDate(k) {
          return String(k).slice(0, 7);
        }
        function hotMonthKeys() {
          const y = viewDate.getFullYear();
          const m = viewDate.getMonth();
          const fmt = (yy, mm) =>
            yy + "-" + String(mm + 1).padStart(2, "0");
          const prev = m === 0 ? [y - 1, 11] : [y, m - 1];
          const next = m === 11 ? [y + 1, 0] : [y, m + 1];
          return new Set([
            fmt(y, m),
            fmt(prev[0], prev[1]),
            fmt(next[0], next[1]),
          ]);
        }
        function rebuildCatalog() {
          catalog.pins.length = 0;
          catalog.tasks.length = 0;
          catalog.notes.length = 0;
          catalog.byKey.clear();
          Object.keys(itemsMirror).forEach((key) => {
            const b = itemsMirror[key];
            if (!b || typeof b !== "object") return;
            (Array.isArray(b.pins) ? b.pins : []).forEach((it, i) => {
              if (!it || typeof it !== "object") return;
              const row = Object.assign({}, it, { parentKey: key, realIdx: i });
              catalog.pins.push(row);
              catalog.byKey.set("pin:" + key + ":" + i, row);
            });
            (Array.isArray(b.tasks) ? b.tasks : []).forEach((it, i) => {
              if (!it || typeof it !== "object") return;
              const row = Object.assign({}, it, { parentKey: key, realIdx: i });
              catalog.tasks.push(row);
              catalog.byKey.set("task:" + key + ":" + i, row);
            });
            (Array.isArray(b.notes) ? b.notes : []).forEach((it, i) => {
              if (!it || typeof it !== "object") return;
              const row = Object.assign({}, it, { parentKey: key, realIdx: i });
              catalog.notes.push(row);
              catalog.byKey.set("note:" + key + ":" + i, row);
            });
          });
        }
        function syncMirrorFromDB() {
          Object.keys(db).forEach((key) => {
            if (key === "projects" || key === "mainStore" || key === "calendars") return;
            const b = db[key];
            if (!b || typeof b !== "object") return;
            itemsMirror[key] = {
              pins: Array.isArray(b.pins) ? b.pins : [],
              tasks: Array.isArray(b.tasks) ? b.tasks : [],
              notes: Array.isArray(b.notes) ? b.notes : [],
            };
          });
        }
        function evictColdMonths() {
          if (!db) return;
          const hot = hotMonthKeys();
          Object.keys(db).forEach((key) => {
            if (!isDateBucketKey(key)) return;
            const mk = monthKeyOfDate(key);
            if (hot.has(mk)) return;
            const b = db[key];
            if (!b || typeof b !== "object") return;
            itemsMirror[key] = {
              pins: Array.isArray(b.pins) ? b.pins : [],
              tasks: Array.isArray(b.tasks) ? b.tasks : [],
              notes: Array.isArray(b.notes) ? b.notes : [],
            };
            b.pins = [];
            b.tasks = [];
            b.notes = [];
            b.__cold = true;
          });
        }
        function hydrateDay(key) {
          if (!key) return;
          if (!db[key]) db[key] = { bg: "#ffffff", pins: [], tasks: [], notes: [], cals: {} };
          const m = itemsMirror[key];
          if (m) {
            db[key].pins = m.pins || [];
            db[key].tasks = m.tasks || [];
            db[key].notes = m.notes || [];
            delete db[key].__cold;
          }
          return db[key];
        }
        let bootResolve, bootReject;
        const bootPromise = new Promise((res, rej) => {
          bootResolve = res;
          bootReject = rej;
        });
        let writeQueued = false;
        let writeRunning = false;

        function openEngineDB() {
          return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            let req;
            try {
              req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, NEW_DB_VERSION);
            } catch (e) {
              reject(e);
              return;
            }
            req.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
              const d = e.target.result;
              if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("data")) d.createObjectStore("data");
              if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("history")) d.createObjectStore("history");
              if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("meta")) d.createObjectStore("meta");
              if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("months")) d.createObjectStore("months");
              if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("docs")) d.createObjectStore("docs");
              // Migrate v2 mainStore into v3 months/meta once.
              if (e.oldVersion < 3 && d.objectStoreNames.contains("data")) {
                try {
                  const tx = e.target.transaction;
                  const dataStore = tx.objectStore("data");
                  const getReq = dataStore.get("mainStore");
                  getReq.onsuccess = () => {
                    const raw = getReq.result;
                    if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return;
                    const months = tx.objectStore("months");
                    const meta = tx.objectStore("meta");
                    const byMonth = {};
                    const cal = Array.isArray(raw.calendars) ? raw.calendars : undefined;
                    Object.keys(raw).forEach((k) => {
                      if (k === "projects" || k === "calendars" || k === "mainStore") return;
                      if (k === "general") {
                        meta.put(raw[k], "general");
                        return;
                      }
                      const mk = monthKeyOf(k);
                      if (!mk) return;
                      const day = String(k).slice(8, 10);
                      if (!byMonth[mk]) byMonth[mk] = emptyMonthData();
                      const m = byMonth[mk];
                      (raw[k].pins || []).forEach((p) => m.pins.push({ ...p, _d: day }));
                      (raw[k].tasks || []).forEach((t) => m.tasks.push({ ...t, _d: day }));
                      (raw[k].notes || []).forEach((n) => m.notes.push({ ...n, _d: day }));
                      if (raw[k].cals) m.cals[day] = raw[k].cals;
                      if (raw[k].bg && raw[k].bg !== "#ffffff") m.bg = raw[k].bg;
                    });
                    Object.keys(byMonth).forEach((mk) => {
                      // put synchronously in the upgrade transaction (uncompressed
                      // first boot; first real save compresses note html)
                      months.put(byMonth[mk], mk);
                    });
                    if (raw.projects) meta.put(raw.projects, "projects");
                    if (cal) meta.put(cal, "calendars");
                  };
                } catch (err) {
                  console.warn("v2→v3 migration error:", err);
                }
              }
            };
            req.onsuccess = (e) => {
              const idb = e.target.result;
              idb.onversionchange = () => { try { idb.close(); } catch (_) {} };
              resolve(idb);
            };
            req.onerror = () => reject(req.error || new Error("IDB open failed"));
            req.onblocked = () => console.warn("IndexedDB upgrade blocked by another tab");
          });
        }

        async function loadAllChunks(idb) {
          const mem = {};
          // meta
          const metaRecs = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const tx = idb.transaction(["meta"], "readonly");
            const req = tx.objectStore("meta").getAll();
            req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
            req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
          });
          // getAll returns values without keys; read keys explicitly too.
          const metaMap = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const tx = idb.transaction(["meta"], "readonly");
            const store = tx.objectStore("meta");
            const map = {};
            const req = store.openCursor();
            req.onsuccess = () => {
              const cur = req.result;
              if (!cur) return resolve(map);
              map[cur.key] = cur.value;
              cur.continue();
            };
            req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
          });
          if (metaMap.calendars) mem.calendars = metaMap.calendars;
          if (metaMap.projects) mem.projects = metaMap.projects;
          if (metaMap.general) mem.general = metaMap.general;

          // months
          const monthMap = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const tx = idb.transaction(["months"], "readonly");
            const store = tx.objectStore("months");
            const map = {};
            const req = store.openCursor();
            req.onsuccess = () => {
              const cur = req.result;
              if (!cur) return resolve(map);
              map[cur.key] = cur.value;
              cur.continue();
            };
            req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
          });

          for (const mk of Object.keys(monthMap)) {
            // Phase 2: leave note HTML compressed on disk-in-RAM; only meta and
            // snippets are materialised. Catalog indexes everything for the
            // Master Planner so cross-month lists stay instant.
            const data = await decodeMonth(monthMap[mk], { keepGz: true });
            if (mk === "general") {
              mem.general = Object.assign({}, mem.general || emptyDayBucket(), data);
              continue;
            }
            // Re-expand into day buckets. Legacy records migrated during upgrade
            // tagged items with _d; newer records already split per day below.
            const byDay = {};
            (data.pins || []).forEach((p) => {
              const day = p._d || (p.date && String(p.date).slice(8, 10));
              if (!day) return;
              delete p._d;
              (byDay[day] || (byDay[day] = emptyDayBucket())).pins.push(p);
            });
            (data.tasks || []).forEach((t) => {
              const day = t._d || (t.date && String(t.date).slice(8, 10));
              if (!day) return;
              delete t._d;
              (byDay[day] || (byDay[day] = emptyDayBucket())).tasks.push(t);
            });
            (data.notes || []).forEach((n) => {
              const day = n._d || (n.date && String(n.date).slice(8, 10));
              if (!day) return;
              delete n._d;
              (byDay[day] || (byDay[day] = emptyDayBucket())).notes.push(n);
            });
            if (data.cals) {
              Object.keys(data.cals).forEach((day) => {
                const b = (byDay[day] || (byDay[day] = emptyDayBucket()));
                b.cals = data.cals[day];
              });
            }
            Object.keys(byDay).forEach((day) => {
              mem[`${mk}-${day}`] = byDay[day];
            });
          }
          return mem;
        }

        async function writeAll() {
          if (!engine) return;
          if (writeRunning) {
            writeQueued = true;
            return;
          }
          writeRunning = true;
          try {
            const idb = engine.idb;
            // Push any hot (hydrated) day buckets into the mirror before
            // writing. We must NOT clear the mirror here, or cold-month data
            // would be lost. Each hot day is a superset of the mirror copy.
            try {
              const hot = hotMonthKeys();
              Object.keys(db).forEach((k) => {
                if (k === "general" || (isDateBucketKey(k) && hot.has(monthKeyOfDate(k)))) {
                  const b = db[k];
                  itemsMirror[k] = {
                    pins: Array.isArray(b.pins) ? b.pins : [],
                    tasks: Array.isArray(b.tasks) ? b.tasks : [],
                    notes: Array.isArray(b.notes) ? b.notes : [],
                  };
                }
              });
            } catch (e) {}
            // 1) determine changed months — use the mirror (has every item) and
            //    overlay day designs from db (which are never evicted).
            const monthsNow = {};
            const allDateKeys = new Set([
              ...Object.keys(itemsMirror).filter(isDateBucketKey),
              ...Object.keys(db).filter(isDateBucketKey),
            ]);
            allDateKeys.forEach((k) => {
              const mk = monthKeyOf(k);
              if (!mk) return;
              if (!monthsNow[mk]) monthsNow[mk] = emptyMonthData();
              const day = k.slice(8, 10);
              const m = itemsMirror[k] || { pins: [], tasks: [], notes: [] };
              (m.pins || []).forEach((p) => monthsNow[mk].pins.push({ ...p, _d: day }));
              (m.tasks || []).forEach((t) => monthsNow[mk].tasks.push({ ...t, _d: day }));
              (m.notes || []).forEach((n) => monthsNow[mk].notes.push({ ...n, _d: day }));
              const b = db[k];
              if (b && b.cals && typeof b.cals === "object") {
                monthsNow[mk].cals[day] = b.cals;
              }
            });
            // "general" bucket (undated) is stored in meta.
            const general = db.general || itemsMirror.general || null;

            const seenMonthKeys = new Set(Object.keys(monthsNow));
            // Phase 5: track what actually changed so cross-tab sync can reload
            // only those chunks instead of the whole database.
            const changedMonths = [];
            let deletedAny = false;
            let metaChanged = false;
            // IMPORTANT: encode (and gzip) every changed month BEFORE opening the
            // transaction. IndexedDB transactions auto-commit as soon as the event
            // loop yields with no pending requests, so awaiting the async gzip
            // inside the transaction finished it, and the put() below threw
            // TransactionInactiveError ("The transaction has finished").
            const recordsToPut = [];
            for (const mk of seenMonthKeys) {
              const sig = signatureMonth(mk, monthsNow[mk]);
              if (engine.lastMonthSigs.get(mk) === sig) continue;
              const rec = await encodeMonth(mk, monthsNow[mk]); // safe: no tx open yet
              recordsToPut.push({ rec, mk, sig });
            }

            const tx = idb.transaction(["months", "meta"], "readwrite");
            const mStore = tx.objectStore("months");
            const metaStore = tx.objectStore("meta");

            // put changed months — synchronous only; never await a non-IDB
            // promise between operations inside the transaction.
            for (const { rec, mk, sig } of recordsToPut) {
              mStore.put(rec, mk);
              engine.lastMonthSigs.set(mk, sig);
              changedMonths.push(mk);
            }
            // delete month chunks no longer present
            const existingKeys = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
              const r = mStore.getAllKeys();
              r.onsuccess = () => resolve(r.result || []);
              r.onerror = () => reject(r.error);
            });
            existingKeys.forEach((k) => {
              if (k !== "general" && !seenMonthKeys.has(k)) {
                mStore.delete(k);
                engine.lastMonthSigs.delete(k);
                changedMonths.push(k);
                deletedAny = true;
              }
            });

            // 2) meta (calendars, projects, general)
            const metaSig = signatureMeta();
            if (engine.lastMetaSig !== metaSig) {
              if (Array.isArray(db.calendars)) metaStore.put(db.calendars, "calendars");
              if (Array.isArray(db.projects)) metaStore.put(db.projects, "projects");
              if (db.general) metaStore.put(db.general, "general");
              engine.lastMetaSig = metaSig;
              metaChanged = true;
            }

            await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
              tx.oncomplete = resolve;
              tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
              tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error || new Error("tx aborted"));
            });
            setSaveStatus("Saved");
            persistMode = "ready";
            if (typeof window.__catalog !== "undefined" && window.__catalog) rebuildCatalog();
            if (typeof broadcastPlannerSync === "function") {
              broadcastPlannerSync({ changedMonths, metaChanged, deletedAny });
            }
          } catch (e) {
            console.error("Chunked save failed:", e);
            markPersistFailed("Save failed — export a backup");
          } finally {
            writeRunning = false;
            if (writeQueued) {
              writeQueued = false;
              setTimeout(commitDBSave, 30);
            }
          }
        }

        /* ---------- override app persistence + boot ---------- */
        function installOverrides() {
          // These are the real in-scope bindings (declared with `let` above),
          // not window properties, so the engine must assign them directly.
          saveDB = function () {
            dataRev++;
            if (!engine) {
              markPersistFailed("Offline — changes not saved");
              return;
            }
            setSaveStatus("Saving…", true);
            clearTimeout(dbSaveTimer);
            dbSaveTimer = window.setTimeout(commitDBSave, 120);
          };
          commitDBSave = function () {
            clearTimeout(dbSaveTimer);
            dbSaveTimer = 0;
            if (!engine) {
              markPersistFailed("Offline — changes not saved");
              return;
            }
            writeAll();
          };
          window.commitDBSaveImmediate = commitDBSave;

          // Boot: open v3 engine, mirror chunks into db, then start app.
          init = async function () {
            try {
              let idb;
              try {
                idb = await openEngineDB();
              } catch (e) {
                console.warn("Chunked engine unavailable:", e);
                markPersistFailed("Storage blocked — changes will not persist");
                idb = null;
              }
              if (idb) {
                try {
                  const mem = await loadAllChunks(idb);
                  db = mem && typeof mem === "object" ? mem : {};
                } catch (e) {
                  console.warn("Could not read chunks; starting empty.", e);
                  db = {};
                }
                // Keep the global `idb` handle used by the cross-tab sync channel
                // and the history helpers pointed at the v3 database.
                __setEngineIdb(idb);
                window.idb = idb;
                engine = {
                  idb,
                  lastMonthSigs: new Map(),
                  lastMetaSig: "",
                };
                // Phase 3: mirror everything, then evict non-hot months from db.
                syncMirrorFromDB();
                rebuildCatalog();
                try { evictColdMonths(); } catch (e) { console.warn("evict", e); }
              } else {
                engine = null;
                db = {};
              }

              if (typeof pruneBlankEntries === "function") pruneBlankEntries();
              if (typeof placeProjectSection === "function") placeProjectSection();
              if (typeof initProjectState === "function") initProjectState();
              if (typeof ensureCalendars === "function") ensureCalendars();
              if (typeof renderCalBar === "function") renderCalBar();
              if (typeof applyViewModeClass === "function") applyViewModeClass();
              if (typeof updateViewToggle === "function") updateViewToggle();
              if (typeof initProjects === "function") initProjects();
              if (viewMode === 2) {
                selKey = toLocalDateKey(new Date());
                if (typeof renderSheet === "function") renderSheet();
              }
              setTimeout(() => {
                if (typeof renderCal === "function") renderCal();
                if (typeof buildTimePicker === "function") buildTimePicker();
                if (typeof buildDatePicker === "function") buildDatePicker();
                if (typeof updateClock === "function") updateClock();
                if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.storage && navigator.storage.persist) {
                  navigator.storage.persist().catch(() => {});
                }
                setInterval(() => {
                  if (typeof updateClock === "function") updateClock();
                  if (pinDragActive) return;
                  if (document.hidden) return;
                  const today = new Date();
                  const tk = toLocalDateKey(today);
                  if (tk !== lastTodayKey) {
                    lastTodayKey = tk;
                    if (typeof renderCal === "function") renderCal();
                  } else if (
                    viewDate.getMonth() === today.getMonth() &&
                    viewDate.getFullYear() === today.getFullYear()
                  ) {
                    if (typeof refreshCalTimers === "function") refreshCalTimers();
                  }
                  const ae = document.activeElement;
                  const typing =
                    ae &&
                    typeof ae.matches === "function" &&
                    ae.matches(
                      "input, textarea, [contenteditable='true'], .ql-editor",
                    );
                  if (
                    selKey &&
                    !isEdit &&
                    !document.body.classList.contains("keyboard-open") &&
                    !typing
                  ) {
                    if (curTab === "task" && dataRev !== lastSheetRev) {
                      if (typeof renderSheet === "function") renderSheet();
                      lastSheetRev = dataRev;
                    }
                  }
                }, 6e4);
              }, 50);
              bootResolve();
            } catch (e) {
              console.error("Engine boot failed:", e);
              markPersistFailed("Storage error — export a backup");
              bootReject(e);
            }
          };

          // Import: replace in-memory db, then force a full chunked rewrite.
          importBackup = function () {
            const input = document.createElement("input");
            input.type = "file";
            input.accept = "application/json,.json";
            input.style.display = "none";
            document.body.appendChild(input);
            input.addEventListener("change", () => {
              const file = input.files && input.files[0];
              if (!file) return input.remove();
              const reader = new FileReader();
              reader.onload = () => {
                let parsed;
                try {
                  parsed = JSON.parse(String(reader.result));
                } catch (e) {
                  showAppAlert("Import failed", "That file is not valid JSON.");
                  input.remove();
                  return;
                }
                const incoming =
                  parsed && parsed.data ? parsed.data : parsed;
                if (!incoming || typeof incoming !== "object") {
                  showAppAlert(
                    "Import failed",
                    "No planner data found in that file.",
                  );
                  input.remove();
                  return;
                }
                showAppConfirm(
                  "Replace all data?",
                  "Importing will overwrite everything currently in this planner. Export a backup first if you are unsure.",
                  async () => {
                    adoptDB(incoming, "import");
                    if (engine) {
                      // Force all chunks to rewrite by clearing signatures.
                      engine.lastMonthSigs = new Map();
                      engine.lastMetaSig = "";
                      // Wipe old chunks/meta then write fresh.
                      await new Promise((resolve) => {
                        const tx = engine.idb.transaction(
                          ["months", "meta"],
                          "readwrite",
                        );
                        tx.objectStore("months").clear();
                        tx.objectStore("meta").clear();
                        tx.oncomplete = resolve;
                        tx.onerror = resolve;
                      });
                    }
                    if (window.ChunkedStorage) {
                      ChunkedStorage.syncMirrorFromDB();
                      try { ChunkedStorage.evictColdMonths(); } catch (e) {}
                      ChunkedStorage.rebuildCatalog();
                    }
                    saveDB();
                    if (typeof initProjects === "function") initProjects();
                    if (typeof renderCal === "function") renderCal();
                    setSaveStatus("Backup restored");
                    input.remove();
                  },
                  {
                    okLabel: "Replace",
                    cancelLabel: "Cancel",
                    danger: true,
                  },
                );
              };
              reader.readAsText(file);
            });
            input.click();
          };

          // catalog and itemsMirror are declared at IIFE scope (above) so
          // writeAll and other module-level helpers can access them.

          function isDateBucketKey(k) {
            return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(k));
          }
          function monthKeyOfDate(k) {
            return String(k).slice(0, 7);
          }
          function hotMonthKeys() {
            // current viewed month + previous + next
            const y = viewDate.getFullYear();
            const m = viewDate.getMonth();
            const fmt = (yy, mm) =>
              yy + "-" + String(mm + 1).padStart(2, "0");
            const prev = m === 0 ? [y - 1, 11] : [y, m - 1];
            const next = m === 11 ? [y + 1, 0] : [y, m + 1];
            return new Set([
              fmt(y, m),
              fmt(prev[0], prev[1]),
              fmt(next[0], next[1]),
            ]);
          }

          function rebuildCatalog() {
            catalog.pins.length = 0;
            catalog.tasks.length = 0;
            catalog.notes.length = 0;
            catalog.byKey.clear();
            // Build from the mirror (which always has everything), not db.
            Object.keys(itemsMirror).forEach((key) => {
              const b = itemsMirror[key];
              if (!b || typeof b !== "object") return;
              (Array.isArray(b.pins) ? b.pins : []).forEach((it, i) => {
                if (!it || typeof it !== "object") return;
                const row = Object.assign({}, it, { parentKey: key, realIdx: i });
                catalog.pins.push(row);
                catalog.byKey.set("pin:" + key + ":" + i, row);
              });
              (Array.isArray(b.tasks) ? b.tasks : []).forEach((it, i) => {
                if (!it || typeof it !== "object") return;
                const row = Object.assign({}, it, { parentKey: key, realIdx: i });
                catalog.tasks.push(row);
                catalog.byKey.set("task:" + key + ":" + i, row);
              });
              (Array.isArray(b.notes) ? b.notes : []).forEach((it, i) => {
                if (!it || typeof it !== "object") return;
                const row = Object.assign({}, it, { parentKey: key, realIdx: i });
                catalog.notes.push(row);
                catalog.byKey.set("note:" + key + ":" + i, row);
              });
            });
          }

          // Mirror every day bucket from db (called once at boot before the
          // first eviction, and after import/sync bulk replaces).
          function syncMirrorFromDB() {
            Object.keys(itemsMirror).forEach((k) => delete itemsMirror[k]);
            Object.keys(db).forEach((key) => {
              if (key === "projects" || key === "mainStore" || key === "calendars") return;
              const b = db[key];
              if (!b || typeof b !== "object") return;
              itemsMirror[key] = {
                pins: Array.isArray(b.pins) ? b.pins : [],
                tasks: Array.isArray(b.tasks) ? b.tasks : [],
                notes: Array.isArray(b.notes) ? b.notes : [],
              };
            });
          }

          // Evict cold months from `db` but keep their items in the mirror.
          // Day designs (cals) are *not* evicted because renderCal resolves
          // them synchronously — they are tiny relative to note HTML.
          function evictColdMonths() {
            if (!db) return;
            const hot = hotMonthKeys();
            Object.keys(db).forEach((key) => {
              if (!isDateBucketKey(key)) return; // keep "general", projects, ...
              const mk = monthKeyOfDate(key);
              if (hot.has(mk)) return;
              const b = db[key];
              if (!b || typeof b !== "object") return;
              // Make sure the mirror has the latest copy.
              itemsMirror[key] = {
                pins: Array.isArray(b.pins) ? b.pins : [],
                tasks: Array.isArray(b.tasks) ? b.tasks : [],
                notes: Array.isArray(b.notes) ? b.notes : [],
              };
              // Drop the heavy arrays from db; keep cals/bg for the grid.
              b.pins = [];
              b.tasks = [];
              b.notes = [];
              b.__cold = true;
            });
          }

          // Bring a single day's items back from the mirror into db (sync).
          // Used before opening a sheet or rendering a cell with content.
          function hydrateDay(key) {
            if (!key) return;
            if (!db[key]) {
              db[key] = { bg: "#ffffff", pins: [], tasks: [], notes: [], cals: {} };
            }
            const m = itemsMirror[key];
            if (m) {
              db[key].pins = m.pins || [];
              db[key].tasks = m.tasks || [];
              db[key].notes = m.notes || [];
              delete db[key].__cold;
            }
            return db[key];
          }

          // Async-load a full month chunk from disk and hydrate every day in
          // it. Used when navigating to a cold month.
          async function loadMonthChunk(mk) {
            if (!engine) return;
            const idb = engine.idb;
            const rec = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
              const tx = idb.transaction(["months"], "readonly");
              const req = tx.objectStore("months").get(mk);
              req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
              req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
            });
            if (!rec) return;
            const data = await decodeMonth(rec, { keepGz: true });
            const byDay = {};
            (data.pins || []).forEach((p) => {
              const day = p._d || (p.date && String(p.date).slice(8, 10));
              if (!day) return; delete p._d;
              (byDay[day] || (byDay[day] = [])).push(p);
            });
            (data.tasks || []).forEach((t) => {
              const day = t._d || (t.date && String(t.date).slice(8, 10));
              if (!day) return; delete t._d;
              (byDay[day] || (byDay[day] = [])).push(t);
            });
            (data.notes || []).forEach((n) => {
              const day = n._d || (n.date && String(n.date).slice(8, 10));
              if (!day) return; delete n._d;
              (byDay[day] || (byDay[day] = [])).push(n);
            });
            Object.keys(byDay).forEach((day) => {
              const key = mk + "-" + day;
              itemsMirror[key] = { pins: [], tasks: [], notes: [] };
              byDay[day].forEach((it) => {
                const col = it && it.html !== undefined
                  ? "notes"
                  : it && it.status !== undefined ? "tasks" : "pins";
                itemsMirror[key][col].push(it);
              });
              // Only hydrate if this month is currently hot; otherwise the
              // data is now safely mirrored and the day is still cold in db.
              if (hotMonthKeys().has(mk)) hydrateDay(key);
            });
            rebuildCatalog();
          }

          // Phase 5: selectively reload only the chunks/meta that another tab
          // changed. Accepts a list of month keys; a missing record means the
          // month was deleted and its local mirror/db entries are removed.
          async function reloadChanged(changedMonths, metaChanged) {
            if (!engine) return;
            const idb = engine.idb;
            const months = Array.isArray(changedMonths) ? changedMonths : [];
            for (const mk of months) {
              if (mk === "general") continue;
              // Drop this month's days from mirror and db first.
              Object.keys(itemsMirror).forEach((k) => {
                if (isDateBucketKey(k) && monthKeyOfDate(k) === mk) delete itemsMirror[k];
              });
              Object.keys(db).forEach((k) => {
                if (isDateBucketKey(k) && monthKeyOfDate(k) === mk) delete db[k];
              });
              try { await loadMonthChunk(mk); } catch (e) {}
            }
            if (metaChanged) {
              const metaMap = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const tx = idb.transaction(["meta"], "readonly");
                const store = tx.objectStore("meta");
                const map = {};
                const req = store.openCursor();
                req.onsuccess = () => {
                  const c = req.result;
                  if (!c) return resolve(map);
                  map[c.key] = c.value;
                  c.continue();
                };
                req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
              });
              if (metaMap.calendars) db.calendars = metaMap.calendars;
              if (metaMap.projects) db.projects = metaMap.projects;
              if (metaMap.general) {
                db.general = metaMap.general;
                itemsMirror.general = {
                  pins: metaMap.general.pins || [],
                  tasks: metaMap.general.tasks || [],
                  notes: metaMap.general.notes || [],
                };
              }
              if (typeof ensureCalendars === "function") ensureCalendars();
            }
            rebuildCatalog();
          }

          // Phase 4: per-month statistics for the Storage Manager.
          async function chunkStats() {
            if (!engine) return { months: [], total: 0, quota: null };
            const idb = engine.idb;
            const quota =
              navigator.storage && navigator.storage.estimate
                ? await navigator.storage.estimate()
                : null;
            const months = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
              const tx = idb.transaction(["months"], "readonly");
              const store = tx.objectStore("months");
              const out = [];
              const req = store.openCursor();
              req.onsuccess = () => {
                const c = req.result;
                if (!c) return resolve(out);
                const rec = c.value;
                let items = 0, notes = 0, pins = 0, tasks = 0, gz = 0;
                if (rec) {
                  pins = Array.isArray(rec.pins) ? rec.pins.length : 0;
                  tasks = Array.isArray(rec.tasks) ? rec.tasks.length : 0;
                  notes = Array.isArray(rec.notes) ? rec.notes.length : 0;
                  items = pins + tasks + notes;
                  (rec.notes || []).forEach((n) => {
                    if (n && n.htmlEncoding === "gzip+base64" && n.htmlGz)
                      gz += n.htmlGz.length;
                  });
                }
                let size = 0;
                try { size = JSON.stringify(rec).length; } catch (e) {}
                out.push({
                  month: c.key,
                  size,
                  items,
                  pins,
                  tasks,
                  notes,
                  gzSize: gz,
                  isHot: typeof hotMonthKeys === "function" && c.key !== "general" && hotMonthKeys().has(c.key),
                });
                c.continue();
              };
              req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
            });
            months.sort((a, b) => (a.month < b.month ? 1 : -1));
            const total = months.reduce((s, m) => s + m.size, 0);
            return { months, total, quota };
          }

          // Phase 4: force a month out of RAM (it stays on disk; "Archive"
          // in the UI). The data is already saved; we just drop the arrays.
          function archiveMonth(mk) {
            if (!engine || mk === "general") return;
            Object.keys(db).forEach((k) => {
              if (isDateBucketKey(k) && monthKeyOfDate(k) === mk) {
                const b = db[k];
                if (b) {
                  itemsMirror[k] = {
                    pins: Array.isArray(b.pins) ? b.pins : [],
                    tasks: Array.isArray(b.tasks) ? b.tasks : [],
                    notes: Array.isArray(b.notes) ? b.notes : [],
                  };
                  b.pins = [];
                  b.tasks = [];
                  b.notes = [];
                  b.__cold = true;
                }
              }
            });
            rebuildCatalog();
          }

          // Phase 4: bring a cold month fully back into RAM ("Load").
          async function loadMonth(mk) {
            if (!engine) return;
            if (mk === "general") return;
            await loadMonthChunk(mk);
            Object.keys(itemsMirror).forEach((k) => {
              if (isDateBucketKey(k) && monthKeyOfDate(k) === mk) hydrateDay(k);
            });
            rebuildCatalog();
          }

          // Phase 4: delete every item (and its day designs) for a month.
          async function deleteMonth(mk) {
            if (!engine || mk === "general") return;
            Object.keys(itemsMirror).forEach((k) => {
              if (isDateBucketKey(k) && monthKeyOfDate(k) === mk) delete itemsMirror[k];
            });
            Object.keys(db).forEach((k) => {
              if (isDateBucketKey(k) && monthKeyOfDate(k) === mk) delete db[k];
            });
            const idb = engine.idb;
            await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
              const tx = idb.transaction(["months"], "readwrite");
              tx.objectStore("months").delete(mk);
              tx.oncomplete = resolve;
              tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
            });
            if (engine.lastMonthSigs) engine.lastMonthSigs.delete(mk);
            rebuildCatalog();
          }

          // Phase 4: remove completed/skipped tasks older than N days.
          // Mirrors the change into disk immediately.
          function pruneOldStatus(statuses, olderThanDays) {
            const cutoff = new Date();
            cutoff.setDate(cutoff.getDate() - (olderThanDays || 90));
            const statusSet = new Set(statuses || ["done", "skip"]);
            let removed = 0;
            const touch = new Set();
            Object.keys(itemsMirror).forEach((key) => {
              const m = itemsMirror[key];
              if (!m || !Array.isArray(m.tasks)) return;
              const keep = [];
              m.tasks.forEach((t) => {
                const st = t.status || "pending";
                const when = t.updatedAt || t.createdAt;
                const d = when ? new Date(when) : null;
                if (statusSet.has(st) && d && d < cutoff) {
                  removed++;
                  touch.add(monthKeyOfDate(key));
                  return;
                }
                keep.push(t);
              });
              m.tasks = keep;
              if (db[key] && Array.isArray(db[key].tasks)) db[key].tasks = keep;
            });
            if (removed) {
              rebuildCatalog();
              // Force a save so the disk copies drop the pruned tasks.
              engine.lastMonthSigs && touch.forEach((mk) => engine.lastMonthSigs.delete(mk));
              if (typeof commitDBSaveImmediate === "function") commitDBSaveImmediate();
              else saveDB();
            }
            return removed;
          }

          // Called from moveMonth() / viewDate change.
          async function refreshHotWindow() {
            const hot = hotMonthKeys();
            // Hydrate hot months that are missing from db.
            for (const mk of hot) {
              let hasAny = false;
              Object.keys(db).forEach((k) => {
                if (isDateBucketKey(k) && monthKeyOfDate(k) === mk) hasAny = true;
              });
              if (!hasAny && engine) {
                try { await loadMonthChunk(mk); } catch (e) {}
              } else {
                // Ensure hot days have their items mirrored back into db.
                Object.keys(itemsMirror).forEach((k) => {
                  if (monthKeyOfDate(k) === mk) hydrateDay(k);
                });
              }
            }
            evictColdMonths();
            rebuildCatalog();
          }

          rebuildCatalog();

          window.ChunkedStorage = {
            engine: () => engine,
            ready: bootPromise,
            writeAll,
            catalog,
            itemsMirror,
            rebuildCatalog,
            syncMirrorFromDB,
            evictColdMonths,
            hydrateDay,
            loadMonthChunk,
            refreshHotWindow,
            reloadChanged,
            hotMonthKeys,
            isCold: (key) => !!(db[key] && db[key].__cold),
            // Resolve (decompressing if needed) the HTML of a note in memory.
            noteHTML(key, idx) {
              hydrateDay(key);
              const b = db[key];
              const n = b && b.notes && b.notes[idx];
              if (!n) return "";
              if (typeof n.html === "string" && n.html.length) return n.html;
              return inflateNote(n);
            },
            async noteHTMLAsync(key, idx) {
              hydrateDay(key);
              const b = db[key];
              const n = b && b.notes && b.notes[idx];
              if (!n) return "";
              if (typeof n.html === "string" && n.html.length) return n.html;
              if (n.__inflating) await n.__inflating;
              return n.html || "";
            },
            setNoteHTML(key, idx, html) {
              hydrateDay(key);
              const n = db[key] && db[key].notes && db[key].notes[idx];
              if (!n) return;
              n.html = html;
              delete n.htmlGz;
              delete n.htmlEncoding;
              try {
                n.plain = (typeof docPlainPreview === "function"
                  ? docPlainPreview(html, 4000)
                  : html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()
                ).slice(0, 4000);
                n.snippet = n.plain.slice(0, 240);
              } catch (e) {}
              if (itemsMirror[key]) itemsMirror[key].notes[idx] = n;
              rebuildCatalog();
            },
            estimate: () =>
              navigator.storage && navigator.storage.estimate
                ? navigator.storage.estimate()
                : Promise.resolve(null),
            // Debug helper: returns a snapshot of what is in RAM vs cold.
            // Phase 5: streaming full-body note search. The catalog holds
            // each note's plain/snippet (up to 4000 chars), so most matches
            // are found instantly. For notes whose body is longer than the
            // cached plain text, we inflate gzip one at a time, yielding
            // matches to onMatch and reporting progress to onProgress.
            // Returns a cancel function.
            searchNotesStream(query, opts) {
              const q = String(query || "").toLowerCase().trim();
              if (!q) return () => {};
              const onMatch = (opts && opts.onMatch) || function () {};
              const onProgress = (opts && opts.onProgress) || function () {};
              const onDone = (opts && opts.onDone) || function () {};
              const calFilter = opts && opts.cal;
              const visibleOnly = !opts || opts.visible !== false;
              let cancelled = false;
              const seen = new Set();
              // 1) instant pass over the cached plain/snippet field.
              const notes = catalog.notes.filter((n) => {
                if (!n || typeof n !== "object") return false;
                if (visibleOnly && !calItemVisible(n)) return false;
                if (calFilter && calFilter !== "all" && calOf(n) !== calFilter) return false;
                const body = (n.plain || n.snippet || "").toLowerCase();
                if (body.includes(q)) {
                  seen.add(n.parentKey + ":" + n.realIdx);
                  return true;
                }
                if ((n.parentKey || "").toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
                  seen.add(n.parentKey + ":" + n.realIdx);
                  return true;
                }
                return false;
              });
              notes.forEach((n) => { onMatch(n); });
              // 2) scan remaining gzipped notes that did NOT match via cache.
              const remaining = catalog.notes.filter((n) => {
                if (!n || typeof n !== "object") return false;
                if (visibleOnly && !calItemVisible(n)) return false;
                if (calFilter && calFilter !== "all" && calOf(n) !== calFilter) return false;
                return !seen.has(n.parentKey + ":" + n.realIdx);
              });
              let i = 0;
              const total = remaining.length;
              const step = () => {
                if (cancelled) return;
                const batch = Math.min(8, remaining.length - i);
                for (let b = 0; b < batch; b++) {
                  const n = remaining[i++];
                  if (!n) break;
                  if (n.htmlEncoding === "gzip+base64" && n.htmlGz) {
                    try {
                      const bin = atob(n.htmlGz);
                      const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
                      for (let x = 0; x < bin.length; x++) bytes[x] = bin.charCodeAt(x);
                      // gunzip synchronously would block; schedule via the
                      // async decoder. We return a microtask per chunk.
                      gunzipBytes(bytes.buffer).then((txt) => {
                        if (cancelled) return;
                        const body = (txt || "").toLowerCase();
                        if (body.includes(q)) onMatch(n);
                      });
                    } catch (e) {}
                  } else if (typeof n.html === "string" && n.html) {
                    if (n.html.toLowerCase().includes(q)) onMatch(n);
                  }
                }
                onProgress(i, total);
                if (i < remaining.length) {
                  setTimeout(step, 0);
                } else {
                  // Wait for any in-flight gunzip promises to settle.
                  setTimeout(onDone, 30);
                }
              };
              if (total) setTimeout(step, 0);
              else setTimeout(onDone, 0);
              return () => { cancelled = true; };
            },
            ramStats() {
              const hot = hotMonthKeys();
              let hotDays = 0, coldDays = 0, mirrorDays = 0;
              let totalPins = 0, totalTasks = 0, totalNotes = 0;
              Object.keys(itemsMirror).forEach((k) => {
                mirrorDays++;
                totalPins += (itemsMirror[k].pins || []).length;
                totalTasks += (itemsMirror[k].tasks || []).length;
                totalNotes += (itemsMirror[k].notes || []).length;
              });
              Object.keys(db).forEach((k) => {
                if (!isDateBucketKey(k)) return;
                if (db[k] && db[k].__cold) coldDays++;
                else hotDays++;
              });
              return {
                hotMonths: [...hot],
                hotDays, coldDays, mirrorDays,
                totalPins, totalTasks, totalNotes,
                catalogPins: catalog.pins.length,
                catalogTasks: catalog.tasks.length,
                catalogNotes: catalog.notes.length,
              };
            },
            chunkStats,
            archiveMonth,
            loadMonth,
            deleteMonth,
            pruneOldStatus,
          };
          window.__catalog = catalog;
          window.__itemsMirror = itemsMirror;
        }

        // CRITICAL FIX (boot race): this script lives at the END of <body>,
        // so the DOM is already parsed by the time we run. Install the
        // overrides SYNCHRONOUSLY, before the top-level init() call below.
        // If we waited for DOMContentLoaded, init() would run first using the
        // OLD single-blob persistence (no engine, no idb v3), leaving the app
        // empty and stuck on "Offline — changes not saved".
        installOverrides();
      })();

initViewportManager();
      init();

      /* ===== Storage Manager UI (Phase 4) ===== */
      let storageModalEl = null;
      function fmtBytes(n) {
        if (n == null) return "—";
        if (n < 1024) return n + " B";
        if (n < 1024 * 1024) return (n / 1024).toFixed(1) + " KB";
        return (n / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2) + " MB";
      }
      function closeStorageManager() {
        if (storageModalEl) storageModalEl.classList.remove("in");
        setTimeout(() => { if (storageModalEl) storageModalEl.remove(); storageModalEl = null; }, 200);
      }
      async function openStorageManager() {
        if (!window.ChunkedStorage) {
          showAppAlert("Storage unavailable", "The storage engine is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.");
          return;
        }
        const host = document.createElement("div");
        host.className = "ui-modal";
        host.id = "storageModal";
        host.innerHTML = `
          <div class="ui-modal-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Storage manager">
            <div class="sm-head">

      async function renderStorageManager() {
        const body = document.getElementById("smBody");
        if (!body || !window.ChunkedStorage) return;
        const stats = await ChunkedStorage.chunkStats();
        const q = stats.quota || {};
        const used = q.usage || 0;
        const total = q.quota || 0;
        const pct = total ? Math.min(100, Math.round((used / total) * 100)) : 0;

                <small>${m.items} items · ${m.pins}p · ${m.tasks}t · ${m.notes} docs${m.gzSize ? " · gzip " + fmtBytes(m.gzSize) : ""}</small>
              </div>
              <div class="sm-size">${fmtBytes(m.size)}</div>
              <div class="sm-row-btns">

                <button class="danger" onclick="smDelete('${m.month}')">Delete</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
          }).join("");
        body.innerHTML = `
          <div class="sm-quota">
            <span>Used by this site</span><b>${fmtBytes(used)}</b>
            <span>Browser quota</span><b>${total ? fmtBytes(total) : "unknown"}</b>
            <span>Hot / cold days in RAM</span><b>${ram.hotDays} / ${ram.coldDays}</b>
            <div class="sm-bar"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div>
          </div>
          <div class="sm-actions">
            <button onclick="smPrune(30)">Prune done/skip >30d</button>
            <button onclick="smPrune(90)">Prune done/skip >90d</button>
            <button onclick="smPrune(365)">Prune done/skip >1y</button>
          </div>
          <div class="sm-list">${rows || '<div class="sm-empty">No months yet.</div>'}</div>
        `;
      }
      async function smArchive(mk) {
        ChunkedStorage.archiveMonth(mk);
        await renderStorageManager();
        if (typeof renderCal === "function") renderCal();
        docToast("Archived " + mk);
      }
      async function smLoad(mk) {
        await ChunkedStorage.loadMonth(mk);
        await renderStorageManager();
        if (typeof renderCal === "function") renderCal();
        docToast("Loaded " + mk);
      }
      function smDelete(mk) {
        showAppConfirm(
