          "This permanently removes every task, pin and note in " + mk + " for all calendars. This cannot be undone.",

  padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font: 500 12.5px/1.2 "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1f2430; text-align: left;
}
.studio-cmdk-item:hover, .studio-cmdk-item.on { background: #eef1ff; }
.studio-cmdk-item small { margin-left: auto; color: #98a2b3; font-size: 10.5px; }
.studio-cmdk-empty { padding: 18px; text-align: center; color: #98a2b3; font-size: 12px; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- dark theme */
.rt-shell.studio-dark {
  --st-ink: #e6e9f2;
  --st-ink-sub: #9aa4b8;
  --st-line: #2a3142;
  --st-panel: #1b2130;
  --st-panel-2: #232a3b;
  --st-hover: #232a3b;
  background: #121722;
}
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-titlebar { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #171d2b, #121826); border-color: #2a3142; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-statusbar { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #151b29, #10151f); border-color: #2a3142; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-search input,
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-pill,
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-select { background: #1b2130; border-color: #2a3142; color: #e6e9f2; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-docname input:focus { background: #0e1320; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-pane,
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-cmdk-card { background: #161c29; border-color: #2a3142; color: #e6e9f2; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-navrow { color: #cbd3e3; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-navrow:hover { background: #212939; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-thumb { background: #0e1320; border-color: #2a3142; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-thumb .tp { background: #f7f8fb; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-comment { background: #1b2130; border-color: #2a3142; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-comment b { color: #e6e9f2; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-comment p { color: #b9c2d4; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-viewbtns button.on { background: #2b3350; color: #a5b4fc; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------- ribbon pop additions */
.rt-pop .st-pop-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 6px; }
.rt-pop .st-pop-tile {
  border: 1px solid #e4e7ec; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; padding: 7px 6px;
  font: 600 11px/1.25 inherit; color: #344054; cursor: pointer; text-align: center;
}
.rt-pop .st-pop-tile:hover { border-color: #a5b4fc; background: #f5f6ff; }
.rt-pop .st-pop-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.rt-pop .st-pop-note { font-size: 10.5px; color: #98a2b3; padding: 4px 2px; }
.rt-pop .st-swatches { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 18px); gap: 4px; }
.rt-pop .st-swatches button { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12); cursor: pointer; padding: 0; }
.rt-pop .st-swatches button:hover { transform: scale(1.12); }

/* ----------------------------------------------------------- writing surface */
.rt-shell.studio-viewing .ql-editor { caret-color: transparent; }
.rt-shell.studio-viewing .rt-ribbon .rt-b { opacity: .5; }
.rt-shell.studio-draft .ql-editor {
  max-width: none !important; width: 100% !important; padding: 16px 22px !important;
  min-height: 0 !important; background: #fff; box-shadow: none !important; border-radius: 0 !important;
}
.rt-shell.studio-draft .rt-surface { background: #fff; }
.rt-shell.studio-pages .rt-surface { background: #e9edf3; }
/* Dark chrome with a white page — the paper keeps Word's contrast so text
   is never light-on-light. The surface around it goes dark. */
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-surface { background: #0d121c; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-page-dark .ql-editor { background: #1a2030; color: #e6e9f2; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-page-dark .ql-editor h1,
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-page-dark .ql-editor h2,
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-page-dark .ql-editor h3 { color: #f1f5ff; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark.studio-page-dark .doc-table th { background: #232b3d; color: #e6e9f2; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark.studio-page-dark .doc-table td { border-color: #333c52; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .ql-editor { color: #1f2430; background: #fff; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .doc-table th { background: #f3f5f9; color: #111827; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .doc-table th, .rt-shell.studio-dark .doc-table td { border-color: #cbd5e1; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-watermark { color: rgba(79,70,229,.10); }

.studio-watermark {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; pointer-events: none;
  font: 800 84px/1 "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgba(79, 70, 229, .09);
  transform: rotate(-28deg); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 4px; z-index: 2;
}
.studio-hidden-text .hid { display: none; }
.rt-shell.show-hidden-text .hid { display: inline; background: #fff3bf; border-bottom: 1px dotted #f59e0b; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- responsive */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .studio-titlebar { gap: 5px; padding: 0 6px; }
  .studio-titlebar .st-autosave span:not(.studio-switch), .studio-savestate { display: none; }
  .studio-search { max-width: 180px; flex-basis: 120px; }
  .studio-docname input { width: 34vw; }
  .studio-statusbar { gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; }
  .studio-zoomwrap input[type="range"] { width: 70px; }
  .studio-bs-nav { width: 156px; }
  .studio-bs-main { padding: 18px; }
  .studio-pane { width: min(300px, 86vw); }
}
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .studio-tb-end .studio-pill span { display: none; }
  .studio-pill { padding: 0 8px; }
  .studio-statusbar .st-hide-sm { display: none; }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------- part 2: tabs & context */
.rt-tabs .rt-tab-file { font-weight: 800; color: #4338ca; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-tabs .rt-tab-file { color: #a5b4fc; }
.rt-tabs .rt-tab-table { display: none; }
.rt-shell.in-table .rt-tabs .rt-tab-table { display: inline-flex; }
.rt-tabs .rt-tab-table { color: #0f766e; font-weight: 700; }

/* table context tab shows only while the caret is inside a table */
.rt-bar[data-panel="table"] { border-top: 2px solid #14b8a6; }

/* vertical alignment of the page body */
.rt-shell[data-valign] .rt-surface { display: block; }
.rt-shell[data-valign] .ql-container { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.rt-shell[data-valign="center"] .ql-editor { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; }
.rt-shell[data-valign="bottom"] .ql-editor { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; }
.rt-shell[data-valign="justified"] .ql-editor { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; }

/* doc-level body font set from Design → Fonts */
.rt-shell .ql-editor { font-family: var(--doc-body-font, inherit); }

/* tracked-change display modes */
.rt-shell[data-markup="none"] .tc-del,
.rt-shell[data-markup="none"] .tc-ins::before,
.rt-shell[data-markup="none"] .tc-ins::after { display: none; }
.rt-shell[data-markup="simple"] .tc-del { display: none; }
.rt-shell.markup-original .tc-ins { display: none; }
.rt-shell.markup-original .tc-del { display: inline; }
.rt-shell[data-markup="none"] .tc-ins { text-decoration: none; }

/* file panel tiles */
.rt-bar[data-panel="file"] .rt-b.wide em { font-size: 10.5px; }
.rt-bar[data-panel="file"] .rt-grp { min-width: 116px; }

/* mailings + help panels keep the standard ribbon height */
.rt-bar[data-panel="mailings"] .rt-b.wide,
.rt-bar[data-panel="help"] .rt-b.wide,
.rt-bar[data-panel="table"] .rt-b.wide { min-width: 68px; }

/* popover extras */
.st-pop-note { display: block; font-size: 10px; color: #98a2b3; font-weight: 500; margin-top: 2px; }
.studio-modal .studio-bs-table td:first-child { color: #667085; }
.studio-modal h3 { color: #101828; }

/* avoid duplicating the page chip: the studio status bar owns it */
.rt-shell .rt-stats [data-page] { display: none; }

/* one status bar, like Word: the app's own stats strip is folded into it */
.rt-shell .rt-stats { display: none !important; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------- part 3: finishing */
/* page numbers come from the Studio status bar already — drop the dock chip */
.rt-shell .rt-dock .rt-dock-p { display: none; }
.rt-shell .rt-dock [data-dock="page-prev"],
.rt-shell .rt-dock [data-dock="page-next"] { display: none; }

/* mailings / help / table big buttons must not clip their label */
.rt-bar[data-panel="mailings"] .rt-b.wide em,
.rt-bar[data-panel="help"] .rt-b.wide em,
.rt-bar[data-panel="table"] .rt-b.wide em { font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.15; text-align: center; }
.rt-bar[data-panel="mailings"] .rt-b.wide,
.rt-bar[data-panel="help"] .rt-b.wide,
.rt-bar[data-panel="table"] .rt-b.wide { min-width: 62px; max-width: none; height: 52px; white-space: normal; }

/* the dark chrome needs a dark ribbon bar & popovers too */
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-ribbon { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #171d2b, #131927); }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-tab { color: #9aa4b8; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-tab.on { color: #c7d2fe; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-bar { background: #141a27; border-color: #2a3142; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-grp { border-color: #2a3142; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-grp::after,
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-grp > .rt-glbl { color: #7c8698; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-b { color: #cbd3e3; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-b:hover { background: #232a3b; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-b.on { background: #2b3350; color: #c7d2fe; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .ui-sel { background: #1b2130; border-color: #2a3142; color: #e6e9f2; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-pop { background: #161c29; border-color: #2a3142; color: #e6e9f2; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-pop .rt-exp,
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-pop .rt-more,
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-pop .rt-clear { color: #cbd3e3; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-pop .rt-exp:hover { background: #232a3b; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-pop-h { color: #8f9bb3; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .st-pop-tile { background: #1b2130; border-color: #2a3142; color: #cbd3e3; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .st-pop-tile:hover { background: #232a3b; border-color: #4f5f8a; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-pageinfo { background: #131927; color: #9aa4b8; border-color: #2a3142; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .rt-find { background: #161c29; border-color: #2a3142; }
.rt-shell.studio-dark .studio-thumb .tp { background: #f7f8fb; }

/* Quill's imported lists need the app's list look; keep bullets visible */
.rt-shell .ql-editor ul.ql-list-import,
.rt-shell .ql-editor ol.ql-list-import { padding-left: 1.6em; }

/* ------------------------------------------------- part 4: Word defaults */
/* no indigo focus ring around the sheet — the caret shows focus */
.rt-shell .ql-editor,
.rt-shell .ql-editor:focus,
.rt-shell .ql-editor:focus-visible { outline: none !important; }
.rt-shell .ql-editor:focus-visible { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(79, 70, 229, .18); }

/* header / footer preview in every writing mode, not just Page */
.rt-shell.has-hdr:not(.mode-page) .ql-editor::before {
  content: var(--hdr, "");
  display: block;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #8a94a6;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed #dfe4ec;
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  padding-bottom: 5px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.rt-shell.has-ftr:not(.mode-page) .ql-editor::after {
  content: var(--ftr, "");
  display: block;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #8a94a6;
  border-top: 1px dashed #dfe4ec;
  margin: 18px 0 0;
  padding-top: 5px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* hide tracked-markup switches used by Review → Tracking options */
.rt-shell.hide-ins .tc-ins { display: none; }
.rt-shell.hide-del .tc-del { display: none; }
.rt-comments .rt-comment.cm-active { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 1px; }


/* --------------------------------------------- part 5: icon sizing fixes */
.studio-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; }
.studio-btn svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.studio-bs-tile .bs-ico { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; }
.studio-bs-tile .bs-ico svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.studio-bs-nav button svg { flex: 0 0 auto; }
.studio-file-row svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.studio-qat svg, .studio-pill svg, .studio-icobtn svg { display: block; }
.studio-tb-end .studio-pill svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

/* bookmark / cross-reference affordances */
.rt-shell .ql-editor [data-bm] { border-bottom: 1px dotted #c7d2fe; }
.rt-shell .ql-editor [class*="xref-"] { color: #4f46e5; border-bottom: 1px dashed #a5b4fc; cursor: pointer; }
.rt-shell .ql-editor [class*="xe-"] { display: none; }
.st-bm-flash { background: #fef08a !important; transition: background .3s; }
.rt-comment .rt-c-replies { margin: 6px 0 2px 10px; padding-left: 8px; border-left: 2px solid #e2e8f0; }
.rt-comment .rt-c-reply { font-size: 12px; color: #475569; margin: 3px 0; }
.rt-comment .rt-c-reply b { color: #1e293b; font-weight: 600; }
.rt-comment .rt-c-replybox { display: flex; gap: 5px; margin-top: 5px; }
.rt-comment .rt-c-replybox input { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 12px; padding: 3px 6px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 5px; }
.rt-comment .rt-c-replybox button { font-size: 11px; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #f8fafc; cursor: pointer; }

/* comments pane must not sit under the floating dock */
.rt-shell.has-pane .rt-comments { padding-bottom: 132px; }
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-c-replybox button,
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-c-a button { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
.rt-shell .rt-dock { z-index: 40; }

/* ------------------------------------------------- part 6: comments drawer */
.rt-shell.has-pane > .rt-comments {
  position: fixed;
  top: 108px;
  right: 14px;
  bottom: 74px;
  width: 310px;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 28px);
  z-index: 110600;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(15, 23, 42, .18);
  padding: 10px 12px 16px !important;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}
.studio-dark .rt-shell.has-pane > .rt-comments { background: #111827; border-color: #263143; color: #e6e9f2; }
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-pane-h { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #64748b; padding: 2px 0 8px; }
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-comment { border: 1px solid #e7ecf4; border-left: 3px solid #fbbf24; border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 9px; margin: 0 0 9px; background: #fcfdff; }
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-comment.done { border-left-color: #34d399; opacity: .75; }
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-c-q { font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; font-style: italic; margin-bottom: 3px; }
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-c-t { font-size: 13px; color: #1e293b; line-height: 1.45; }
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-c-a { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; }
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-c-a button { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #dbe3ef; border-radius: 6px; background: #f8fafc; cursor: pointer; }
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-c-a button:hover { background: #eef2ff; border-color: #c7d2fe; }
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-c-replybox { margin-top: 8px; }
.rt-shell .rt-comments .rt-pane-empty { font-size: 13px; color: #64748b; padding: 16px 4px; }

/* ============================ part 7: word-more layer ==================== */
.wm-grid4 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px 14px; }
.wm-cases { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.wm-case { justify-content: flex-start; width: 100%; }
.wm-btnrow { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-left: auto; }
.studio-modal-f { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.wm-envelope { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 2 / 1; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 18px 22px; }
.wm-stamp { position: absolute; top: 14px; right: 16px; width: 74px; height: 88px; border: 2px dashed #cbd5e1; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.wm-from { font-size: 12px; color: #475569; max-width: 45%; }
.wm-to { position: absolute; left: 40%; top: 44%; font-size: 15px; color: #0f172a; line-height: 1.5; }
.wm-diff { margin-top: 10px; max-height: 320px; overflow: auto; }
.wm-diffsum { font-size: 12px; color: #475569; padding: 6px 0; }
.wm-difflist { border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; background: #fcfdff; }
.wm-diffrow { font-size: 12px; padding: 2px 0; color: #334155; }
.wm-tag { display: inline-block; width: 16px; font-weight: 700; }
.wm-tag.add { color: #059669; } .wm-tag.del { color: #dc2626; } .wm-tag.same { color: #94a3b8; }
.wm-issues { display: grid; gap: 7px; max-height: 380px; overflow: auto; }
.wm-issue { border: 1px solid #e7ecf4; border-left: 3px solid #f59e0b; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 10px; background: #fffdf6; }
.wm-issue.high { border-left-color: #ef4444; background: #fff7f7; }
.wm-issue.low { border-left-color: #94a3b8; background: #fbfcfe; }
.wm-issue b { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: #1e293b; }
.wm-issue small { color: #64748b; font-size: 11px; }
.wm-styles .studio-file-row.is-on { background: #eef2ff; border-color: #c7d2fe; }
.wm-qrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 10px; }
.wm-qrow > span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.wm-qrow b { font-size: 13px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.wm-qat-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.wm-qat-body .studio-list { max-height: min(54vh, 460px); gap: 6px; }
.wm-ribbon-list { gap: 2px; }
.wm-ribbon-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; padding: 7px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f4; }
.wm-ribbon-tab:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.wm-ribbon-tab > b { font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #667085; padding: 2px 0; }
.wm-rgrp { font-size: 13px; color: #1f2430; padding: 3px 0 3px 2px; }
.wm-rgrp input { width: 15px; height: 15px; accent-color: var(--st-accent); }
.wm-qrow small { color: #98a2b3; font-size: 11px; }
.wm-qrow input { margin: 0; }

/* mini toolbar */
.wm-mini { position: fixed; z-index: 120200; display: none; gap: 2px; padding: 4px 5px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dbe3ef; border-radius: 9px; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.18); }
.wm-mini.on { display: inline-flex; }
.wm-mini button { width: 28px; height: 26px; border: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; color: #1e293b; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.wm-mini button:hover { background: #eef2ff; color: #4338ca; }
.wm-mini-sep { width: 1px; background: #e2e8f0; margin: 3px 2px; }

/* focus / web layout / marks */
.rt-shell.wm-focus .studio-titlebar, .rt-shell.wm-focus .rt-tabs, .rt-shell.wm-focus .rt-bar { display: none !important; }
.rt-shell.wm-focus .rt-surface { grid-row: 1 / -1; }
.rt-shell.wm-web .ql-editor { max-width: 100% !important; width: 100% !important; box-shadow: none !important; padding: 20px 6vw !important; }
.rt-shell.wm-marks .ql-editor p::after { content: "¶"; color: #c7d2fe; margin-left: 2px; font-size: .8em; }
.rt-shell.wm-marks .ql-editor p:empty::after { content: "¶"; }
.rt-shell.wm-marks .ql-editor .ql-editor br { outline: none; }

/* table header repeat + formula cells */
.rt-shell .doc-table thead th, .rt-shell .doc-table tr[data-repeat="1"] th { background: #eef2ff; }
.wm-sides { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.wm-side.primary { background: #eef2ff; border-color: #a5b4fc; color: #3730a3; }
.wm-preview { margin-top: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #334155; font-size: 13px; }
.studio-qat [data-wm-qat] { width: 26px; height: 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: 6px; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.studio-qat [data-wm-qat] svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.studio-qat [data-wm-qat]:hover { background: rgba(79,70,229,.12); }
.wm-qicon { display: inline-flex; width: 16px; height: 16px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; vertical-align: -3px; }
