<script id="studio-ppzip">
/* ============================================================================
 * Pro Planner — PPZIP : dependency-free ZIP reader/writer
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Uses the platform CompressionStream / DecompressionStream ("deflate-raw")
 * when available (Chrome 80+, Edge 80+, Safari 16.4+, Firefox 113+) and
 * falls back to STORED (method 0) entries elsewhere. A STORED zip is a fully
 * valid OPC/DOCX container — Word opens it — it is simply larger.
 * ==========================================================================*/
(function (global) {
  "use strict";

  const CRC_TABLE = (() => {
    const t = new Uint32Array(256);
    for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
      let c = n;
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1;
      t[n] = c >>> 0;
    }
    return t;
  })();

  function crc32(bytes) {
    let c = 0xffffffff;
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) c = CRC_TABLE[(c ^ bytes[i]) & 0xff] ^ (c >>> 8);
    return (c ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
  }

  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const dec = new TextDecoder("utf-8");
  const hasDeflate = typeof global.CompressionStream === "function";
  const hasInflate = typeof global.DecompressionStream === "function";

  async function deflateRaw(bytes) {
    if (!hasDeflate) return null;
    try {
      const cs = new global.CompressionStream("deflate-raw");
      const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(cs);
      return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  async function inflateRaw(bytes) {
    if (!hasInflate) throw new Error("This browser cannot decompress DOCX files (DecompressionStream missing).");
    const ds = new global.DecompressionStream("deflate-raw");
    const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(ds);
    return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());
  }

  function dosTime(d) {
    const time = ((d.getHours() & 31) << 11) | ((d.getMinutes() & 63) << 5) | ((d.getSeconds() / 2) & 31);
    const date = (((d.getFullYear() - 1980) & 127) << 9) | (((d.getMonth() + 1) & 15) << 5) | (d.getDate() & 31);
    return { time, date };
  }

  function u8(str) {
    return typeof str === "string" ? enc.encode(str) : str;
  }

  /**
   * Build a ZIP archive.
   * @param {Array<{name:string,data:string|Uint8Array,store?:boolean}>} entries
   * @returns {Promise<Uint8Array>}
   */
  async function zip(entries) {
    const now = new Date();
    const { time, date } = dosTime(now);
    const chunks = [];
    const central = [];
    let offset = 0;

    for (const entry of entries) {
      const nameBytes = enc.encode(entry.name);
      const raw = u8(entry.data);
      const crc = crc32(raw);
      let method = 0;
      let body = raw;
      if (!entry.store) {
        const deflated = await deflateRaw(raw);
        if (deflated && deflated.length < raw.length) {
          method = 8;
          body = deflated;
        }
      }

      const local = new Uint8Array(30 + nameBytes.length);
      const lv = new DataView(local.buffer);
      lv.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true);
      lv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      lv.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true); // UTF-8 names
      lv.setUint16(8, method, true);
      lv.setUint16(10, time, true);
      lv.setUint16(12, date, true);
      lv.setUint32(14, crc, true);
      lv.setUint32(18, body.length, true);
      lv.setUint32(22, raw.length, true);
      lv.setUint16(26, nameBytes.length, true);
      lv.setUint16(28, 0, true);
      local.set(nameBytes, 30);

      chunks.push(local, body);

      const cd = new Uint8Array(46 + nameBytes.length);
      const cv = new DataView(cd.buffer);
      cv.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true);
      cv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(6, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);
      cv.setUint16(10, method, true);
      cv.setUint16(12, time, true);
      cv.setUint16(14, date, true);
      cv.setUint32(16, crc, true);
      cv.setUint32(20, body.length, true);
      cv.setUint32(24, raw.length, true);
      cv.setUint16(28, nameBytes.length, true);
      cv.setUint16(30, 0, true);
      cv.setUint16(32, 0, true);
      cv.setUint16(34, 0, true);
      cv.setUint16(36, 0, true);
      cv.setUint32(38, 0, true);
      cv.setUint32(42, offset, true);
      cd.set(nameBytes, 46);
      central.push(cd);

      offset += local.length + body.length;
    }

    const cdSize = central.reduce((n, c) => n + c.length, 0);
    const eocd = new Uint8Array(22);
    const ev = new DataView(eocd.buffer);
    ev.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true);
    ev.setUint16(4, 0, true);
    ev.setUint16(6, 0, true);
    ev.setUint16(8, entries.length, true);
    ev.setUint16(10, entries.length, true);
    ev.setUint32(12, cdSize, true);
    ev.setUint32(16, offset, true);
    ev.setUint16(20, 0, true);

    const total = chunks.reduce((n, c) => n + c.length, 0) + cdSize + eocd.length;
    const out = new Uint8Array(total);
    let p = 0;
    for (const c of chunks) {
      out.set(c, p);
      p += c.length;
    }
    for (const c of central) {
      out.set(c, p);
      p += c.length;
    }
    out.set(eocd, p);
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Read a ZIP archive into a Map of name -> Uint8Array.
   * @param {ArrayBuffer|Uint8Array} buf
   * @returns {Promise<Map<string, Uint8Array>>}
   */
  async function unzip(buf) {
    const bytes = buf instanceof Uint8Array ? buf : new Uint8Array(buf);
    const dv = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);

    // Locate End Of Central Directory (scan last 64k)
    let eocd = -1;
    const min = Math.max(0, bytes.length - 65558);
    for (let i = bytes.length - 22; i >= min; i--) {
      if (dv.getUint32(i, true) === 0x06054b50) {
        eocd = i;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (eocd < 0) throw new Error("Not a valid ZIP/DOCX file (no central directory).");

    const count = dv.getUint16(eocd + 10, true);
    const cdOffset = dv.getUint32(eocd + 16, true);
    let ptr = cdOffset;
    const files = new Map();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      if (dv.getUint32(ptr, true) !== 0x02014b50) break;
      const method = dv.getUint16(ptr + 10, true);
      const compSize = dv.getUint32(ptr + 20, true);
      const nameLen = dv.getUint16(ptr + 28, true);
      const extraLen = dv.getUint16(ptr + 30, true);
      const commentLen = dv.getUint16(ptr + 32, true);
      const localOffset = dv.getUint32(ptr + 42, true);
      const name = dec.decode(bytes.subarray(ptr + 46, ptr + 46 + nameLen));
      ptr += 46 + nameLen + extraLen + commentLen;

      if (dv.getUint32(localOffset, true) !== 0x04034b50) continue;
      const lNameLen = dv.getUint16(localOffset + 26, true);
      const lExtraLen = dv.getUint16(localOffset + 28, true);
      const dataStart = localOffset + 30 + lNameLen + lExtraLen;
      const body = bytes.subarray(dataStart, dataStart + compSize);

      let data;
      if (method === 0) data = body;
      else if (method === 8) data = await inflateRaw(body);
      else continue; // unsupported method (rare)

      files.set(name, data);
    }
    return files;
  }

  function toText(bytes) {
    return dec.decode(bytes);
  }

  global.PPZip = { zip, unzip, crc32, toText, deflateRaw, inflateRaw, hasDeflate };
})(typeof window !== "undefined" ? window : globalThis);

</script>
<script id="studio-ppdocx">
/* ============================================================================
 * Pro Planner — PPDOCX : real Microsoft Word (.docx) read + write
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * READ   : parses word/document.xml, styles, numbering, rels, media,
 *          headers/footers and section properties into editor-ready HTML.
 * WRITE  : rebuilds a complete, valid OPC package (document, styles,
 *          numbering, settings, rels, media, headers/footers, docProps).
 * No third-party code. Works fully offline once the page is loaded.
 * ==========================================================================*/
(function (global) {
  "use strict";

  const W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main";
  const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
  const esc = (s) =>
    String(s == null ? "" : s)
      .replace(/&/g, "&")
      .replace(/</g, "<")
      .replace(/>/g, ">")
      .replace(/"/g, """);

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers */
  function attr(el, ns, name) {
    if (!el) return null;
    return el.getAttributeNS(ns, name) || el.getAttribute("w:" + name) || el.getAttribute(name);
  }
  function kids(el, tag) {
    if (!el) return [];
    return Array.from(el.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, tag));
  }
  function child(el, tag) {
    if (!el) return null;
    for (const c of el.children) {
      if (c.localName === tag && c.namespaceURI === W) return c;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function toggle(el, tag) {
    const c = child(el, tag);
    if (!c) return false;
    const v = attr(c, W, "val");
    return v === null || !/^(0|false|off)$/i.test(v);
  }
  function rgbToHex(v) {
    if (!v) return "";
    v = String(v).trim();
    if (/^[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(v)) return "#" + v.toUpperCase();
    if (/^[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(v)) return "#" + v.split("").map((c) => c + c).join("").toUpperCase();
    const m = v.match(/rgba?\(([^)]+)\)/i);
    if (m) {
      const p = m[1].split(",").map((x) => parseFloat(x));
      return "#" + p.slice(0, 3).map((n) => ("0" + Math.round(n).toString(16)).slice(-2)).join("").toUpperCase();
    }
    return v;
  }

  const HL_NAMED = {
    yellow: "#FFFF00", green: "#00FF00", cyan: "#00FFFF", magenta: "#FF00FF",
    blue: "#0000FF", red: "#FF0000", darkBlue: "#000080", darkCyan: "#008080",
    darkGreen: "#008000", darkMagenta: "#800080", darkRed: "#800000",
    darkYellow: "#808000", darkGray: "#808080", lightGray: "#C0C0C0", black: "#000000",
    white: "#FFFFFF",
  };
  const HL_REVERSE = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(HL_NAMED).map(([k, v]) => [v.toLowerCase(), k]));

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ READ  .docx */
  async function read(buffer) {
    const files = await global.PPZip.unzip(buffer);
    const get = (n) => (files.has(n) ? global.PPZip.toText(files.get(n)) : null);
    const xml = (n) => {
      const t = get(n);
      if (!t) return null;
      const d = new DOMParser().parseFromString(t, "application/xml");
      if (d.querySelector("parsererror")) throw new Error("Corrupt part: " + n);
      return d;
    };

    const docXml = xml("word/document.xml");
    if (!docXml) throw new Error("This file has no word/document.xml — it is not a Word document.");

    /* ---- rels: rId -> {target, mode} */
    const rels = {};
    const relXml = xml("word/_rels/document.xml.rels");
    if (relXml) {
      for (const rel of Array.from(relXml.getElementsByTagName("Relationship"))) {
        rels[rel.getAttribute("Id")] = {
          target: rel.getAttribute("Target"),
          mode: rel.getAttribute("TargetMode") || "",
          type: rel.getAttribute("Type") || "",
        };
      }
    }

    /* ---- styles: id -> {name, based, pPr/ rPr} */
    const styles = {};
    const stXml = xml("word/styles.xml");
    if (stXml) {
      for (const s of Array.from(stXml.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "style"))) {
        const id = attr(s, W, "styleId");
        const nameEl = child(s, "name");
        styles[id] = {
          id,
          name: nameEl ? attr(nameEl, W, "val") : id,
          based: attr(child(s, "basedOn"), W, "val") || null,
          isDefault: attr(s, W, "default") === "1",
          type: attr(s, W, "type") || "paragraph",
        };
      }
    }

    /* ---- numbering: numId -> {format per level, text} */
    const nums = {};
    const numXml = xml("word/numbering.xml");
    if (numXml) {
      const abstracts = {};
      for (const an of Array.from(numXml.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "abstractNum"))) {
        const aid = attr(an, W, "abstractNumId");
        const lvls = [];
        for (const lvl of Array.from(an.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "lvl"))) {
          lvls[+attr(lvl, W, "ilvl")] = {
            fmt: attr(child(lvl, "numFmt"), W, "val") || "decimal",
            text: attr(child(lvl, "lvlText"), W, "val") || "",
          };
        }
        abstracts[aid] = lvls;
      }
      for (const n of Array.from(numXml.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "num"))) {
        const id = attr(n, W, "numId");
        const aid = attr(child(n, "abstractNumId"), W, "val");
        nums[id] = abstracts[aid] || [];
      }
    }

    /* ---- media -> data URI */
    const media = {};
    for (const [name, bytes] of files) {
      if (!/^word\/media\//i.test(name)) continue;
      const ext = (name.split(".").pop() || "png").toLowerCase();
      const mime =
        ext === "png" ? "image/png" : ext === "jpg" || ext === "jpeg" ? "image/jpeg" :
        ext === "gif" ? "image/gif" : ext === "svg" ? "image/svg+xml" :
        ext === "bmp" ? "image/bmp" : ext === "webp" ? "image/webp" : "image/png";
      media["word/" + name.replace(/^word\//, "")] = "data:" + mime + ";base64," + b64(bytes);
    }
    function relTarget(rid) {
      const r = rels[rid];
      if (!r) return null;
      const t = r.target.replace(/^\.\//, "");
      return t.startsWith("word/") ? t : "word/" + t;
    }

    /* ---- run -> inline HTML */
    function runHtml(run, ctx) {
      let text = "";
      let imgHtml = "";
      for (const c of run.children) {
        if (c.namespaceURI !== W) continue;
        if (c.localName === "t") text += c.textContent;
        else if (c.localName === "tab") text += "\t";
        else if (c.localName === "br") text += c.getAttributeNS(W, "type") === "page" ? "\u0000PAGEBREAK\u0000" : "\n";
        else if (c.localName === "cr") text += "\n";
        else if (c.localName === "noBreakHyphen") text += "-";
        else if (c.localName === "sym") text += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(attr(c, W, "char") || "0", 16) || 63);
        else if (c.localName === "drawing" || c.localName === "pict") {
          const blip = c.getElementsByTagNameNS("http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main", "blip")[0];
          const rid = blip && blip.getAttributeNS(R, "embed");
          const src = rid ? media[relTarget(rid)] : null;
          const ext = c.getElementsByTagNameNS("http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing", "extent")[0];
          const cx = ext ? +ext.getAttribute("cx") : 0;
          const cy = ext ? +ext.getAttribute("cy") : 0;
          const wpx = cx ? Math.round(cx / 9525) : null;
          const hpx = cy ? Math.round(cy / 9525) : null;
          if (src) imgHtml += `<img src="${src}"${wpx ? ` width="${wpx}"` : ""}${hpx ? ` height="${hpx}"` : ""} alt="">`;
        }
      }
      const pPr = ctx && ctx.pPr;
      const rPr = child(run, "rPr") || (pPr && child(pPr, "rPr")) || null;
      let out = text;
      if (imgHtml) out += imgHtml;
      if (!out) return "";
      const st = {};
      if (rPr) {
        if (toggle(rPr, "b")) st.b = 1;
        if (toggle(rPr, "i")) st.i = 1;
        const u = child(rPr, "u");
        if (u && attr(u, W, "val") !== "none") st.u = attr(u, W, "val") || "single";
        if (toggle(rPr, "strike")) st.s = 1;
        if (toggle(rPr, "dstrike")) st.ds = 1;
        const va = attr(child(rPr, "vertAlign"), W, "val");
        if (va) st.va = va;
        const color = attr(child(rPr, "color"), W, "val");
        if (color && !/^auto$/i.test(color)) st.color = rgbToHex(color);
        const hl = attr(child(rPr, "highlight"), W, "val");
        const shd = attr(child(rPr, "shd"), W, "fill");
        if (hl && HL_NAMED[hl]) st.hl = HL_NAMED[hl];
        else if (shd && !/^auto$/i.test(shd)) st.hl = rgbToHex(shd);
        const sz = attr(child(rPr, "sz"), W, "val");
        if (sz) st.size = Math.round((+sz / 2) * 1.333); // pt -> px
        const fonts = child(rPr, "rFonts");
        if (fonts) {
          const f = attr(fonts, W, "ascii") || attr(fonts, W, "hAnsi");
          if (f) st.font = f;
        }
        if (toggle(rPr, "caps")) st.caps = 1;
        if (toggle(rPr, "smallCaps")) st.scaps = 1;
        if (toggle(rPr, "vanish")) st.hidden = 1;
        const sp = attr(child(rPr, "spacing"), W, "val");
        if (sp) st.track = (+sp / 20).toFixed(2) + "pt";
      }
      if (st.color) out = `<span style="color:${st.color}">${out}</span>`;
      if (st.hl) out = `<span style="background-color:${st.hl}">${out}</span>`;
      if (st.size) out = `<span style="font-size:${st.size}px">${out}</span>`;
      if (st.font) out = `<span style="font-family:'${esc(st.font)}'">${out}</span>`;
      if (st.track) out = `<span style="letter-spacing:${st.track}">${out}</span>`;
      if (st.u) out = `<u data-ustyle="${esc(st.u)}">${out}</u>`;
      if (st.s) out = `<s>${out}</s>`;
      if (st.ds) out = `<s class="fx-dstrike">${out}</s>`;
      if (st.i) out = `<em>${out}</em>`;
      if (st.b) out = `<strong>${out}</strong>`;
      if (st.va === "superscript") out = `<sup>${out}</sup>`;
      if (st.va === "subscript") out = `<sub>${out}</sub>`;
      return out;
    }

    /* ---- hyperlink wrapper */
    function hyperlinkHtml(el, ctx) {
      const rid = el.getAttributeNS(R, "id");
      const target = rid && rels[rid] ? rels[rid].target : null;
      const inner = paragraphRuns(el, ctx);
      return target ? `<a href="${esc(target)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${inner}</a>` : inner;
    }
    function paragraphRuns(p, ctx) {
      let out = "";
      for (const c of p.children) {
        if (c.namespaceURI === W && c.localName === "r") out += runHtml(c, ctx);
        else if (c.namespaceURI === W && c.localName === "hyperlink") out += hyperlinkHtml(c, ctx);
        else if (c.localName === "ins" || c.localName === "smartTag" || c.localName === "sdtContent") out += paragraphRuns(c, ctx);
        else if (c.localName === "del") continue;
      }
      return out;
    }

    /* ---- paragraph -> block html */
    function paragraphHtml(p) {
      const pPr = child(p, "pPr");
      const styleId = attr(child(pPr, "pStyle"), W, "val");
      const styleName = (styles[styleId] && styles[styleId].name) || "";
      let tag = "p";
      let cls = "";
      const sn = styleName.toLowerCase();
      if (/^heading\s*([1-6])$/.test(sn)) tag = "h" + sn.match(/([1-6])/)[1];
      else if (sn === "title") { tag = "h1"; cls = "doc-title"; }
      else if (sn === "subtitle") { tag = "p"; cls = "doc-subtitle"; }
      else if (sn.indexOf("quote") > -1) { tag = "blockquote"; }
      else if (sn.indexOf("caption") === 0) { tag = "p"; cls = "doc-caption"; }
      else if (sn.indexOf("footnote") === 0 && sn.indexOf("text") > -1) { tag = "p"; cls = "doc-footnote"; }

      const inner = paragraphRuns(p, { pPr }).replace(/\u0000PAGEBREAK\u0000/g, "</p><div class=\"doc-pagebreak\"><span>Page break</span></div><p>");

      /* style-name driven lists (List Bullet / List Number keep numbering in styles.xml) */
      const styleListFmt = /list\s*bullet/i.test(styleName) ? "bullet"
        : /list\s*number/i.test(styleName) ? "decimal" : null;
      if (!child(pPr, "numPr") && styleListFmt) {
        const listTag = styleListFmt === "bullet" ? "ul" : "ol";
        return { tag: listTag, item: `<li data-fmt="${styleListFmt}">${inner || "<br>"}</li>`, list: true };
      }

      /* numbering -> list item */
      const numPr = child(pPr, "numPr");
      if (numPr) {
        const ilvl = +(attr(child(numPr, "ilvl"), W, "val") || 0);
        const numId = attr(child(numPr, "numId"), W, "val");
        const lvl = (nums[numId] || [])[ilvl] || { fmt: "decimal", text: "" };
        const isBullet = /bullet|none/i.test(lvl.fmt);
        const listTag = isBullet ? "ul" : "ol";
        const item = `<li data-ilvl="${ilvl}" data-lvl="${esc(lvl.text)}" data-fmt="${esc(lvl.fmt)}">${inner || "<br>"}</li>`;
        return { tag: listTag, item, list: true };
      }

      /* paragraph properties -> inline style */
      const bits = [];
      const jc = attr(child(pPr, "jc"), W, "val");
      if (jc) bits.push("text-align:" + ({ both: "justify", left: "left", right: "right", center: "center", start: "left", end: "right" }[jc] || jc));
      const ind = child(pPr, "ind");
      if (ind) {
        const left = attr(ind, W, "left") || attr(ind, W, "start");
        if (left) bits.push("margin-left:" + Math.round(+left / 15) + "px");
        const first = attr(ind, W, "firstLine");
        if (first) bits.push("text-indent:" + Math.round(+first / 15) + "px");
      }
      const spacing = child(pPr, "spacing");
      if (spacing) {
        const before = attr(spacing, W, "before");
        const after = attr(spacing, W, "after");
        const line = attr(spacing, W, "line");
        if (before) bits.push("margin-top:" + Math.round(+before / 15) + "px");
        if (after) bits.push("margin-bottom:" + Math.round(+after / 15) + "px");
        if (line && attr(spacing, W, "lineRule") !== "exact") bits.push("line-height:" + (+line / 240).toFixed(2));
      }
      const shd = attr(child(pPr, "shd"), W, "fill");
      if (shd && !/^auto$/i.test(shd)) bits.push("background-color:" + rgbToHex(shd));
      const pBdr = child(pPr, "pBdr");
      if (pBdr) {
        const b = child(pBdr, "bottom") || child(pBdr, "top");
        const sz = b && attr(b, W, "sz");
        if (sz) bits.push("border-bottom:" + Math.max(1, Math.round(+sz / 8)) + "px solid " + rgbToHex(attr(b, W, "color") || "808080"));
      }
      const style = bits.length ? ` style="${esc(bits.join(";"))}"` : "";
      const klass = cls ? ` class="${cls}"` : "";
      return { open: `<${tag}${klass}${style}>`, item: (inner || "<br>") + `</${tag}>`, close: "", list: false };
    }

    /* ---- table */
    function tableHtml(tbl) {
      const gridCols = Array.from(tbl.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "gridCol")).map((g) => +(attr(g, W, "w") || 0));
      const rows = [];
      const trs = Array.from(tbl.children).filter((c) => c.localName === "tr");
      for (const tr of trs) {
        const cells = [];
        for (const tc of Array.from(tr.children).filter((c) => c.localName === "tc")) {
          const span = +(attr(child(child(tc, "tcPr"), "gridSpan"), W, "val") || 1);
          const vmerge = child(child(tc, "tcPr"), "vMerge");
          const paras = Array.from(tc.children).filter((c) => c.localName === "p");
          let html = "";
          paras.forEach((p) => {
            const r = paragraphHtml(p);
            const t = (r.item || "").replace(/^<(p|h[1-6]|blockquote)[^>]*>/, "").replace(/<\/(p|h[1-6]|blockquote)>$/, "");
            html += (html ? "<br>" : "") + t;
          });
          cells.push({ html: html || "<br>", span, vmerge: !!vmerge });
        }
        rows.push(cells);
      }
      const width = gridCols.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) || 9000;
      let out = `<table class="doc-table" style="width:100%"><tbody>`;
      rows.forEach((cells, ri) => {
        out += "<tr>";
        cells.forEach((c) => {
          const tag = ri === 0 ? "th" : "td";
          out += `<${tag}${c.span > 1 ? ` colspan="${c.span}"` : ""}>${c.html}</${tag}>`;
        });
        out += "</tr>";
      });
      out += "</tbody></table>";
      return `<div class="doc-table-block" contenteditable="true">${out}</div>`;
    }

    /* ---- walk body */
    const body = docXml.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "body")[0];
    const blocks = [];
    let listState = { tag: null, html: "" };

    function flushList() {
      if (listState.html && listState.tag) {
        blocks.push({ type: "html", html: `<${listState.tag} class="ql-list-import">${listState.html}</${listState.tag}>` });
      }
      listState = { tag: null, html: "" };
    }

    function walk(node) {
      for (const c of node.children) {
        if (c.namespaceURI !== W) continue;
        if (c.localName === "p") {
          const r = paragraphHtml(c);
          if (r.list) {
            if (listState.tag && listState.tag !== r.tag) flushList();
            if (!listState.tag) listState.tag = r.tag;
            listState.html += r.item;
          } else {
            flushList();
            blocks.push({ type: "html", html: r.open + r.item + r.close });
          }
        } else if (c.localName === "tbl") {
          flushList();
          blocks.push({ type: "table", html: tableHtml(c) });
        } else if (c.localName === "sdt") {
          const content = c.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "sdtContent")[0];
          if (content) walk(content);
        } else if (c.localName === "sectPr") {
          /* handled below */
        }
      }
    }
    walk(body);
    flushList();

    /* ---- section properties */
    let sectPr = child(body, "sectPr");
    if (!sectPr) {
      const all = body.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "sectPr");
      sectPr = all[all.length - 1] || null;
    }
    const page = {};
    if (sectPr) {
      const pgSz = child(sectPr, "pgSz");
      if (pgSz) {
        const w = +attr(pgSz, W, "w") || 11906;
        const h = +attr(pgSz, W, "h") || 16838;
        page.w = Math.round(w / 20); // twips -> pt
        page.h = Math.round(h / 20);
        page.orient = attr(pgSz, W, "orient") === "landscape" ? "landscape" : "portrait";
      }
      const pgMar = child(sectPr, "pgMar");
      if (pgMar) {
        page.margin = {
          t: Math.round((+attr(pgMar, W, "top") || 1440) / 15),
          r: Math.round((+attr(pgMar, W, "right") || 1440) / 15),
          b: Math.round((+attr(pgMar, W, "bottom") || 1440) / 15),
          l: Math.round((+attr(pgMar, W, "left") || 1440) / 15),
        };
        page.gutter = Math.round((+attr(pgMar, W, "gutter") || 0) / 15);
      }
      const cols = child(sectPr, "cols");
      if (cols) page.cols = +attr(cols, W, "num") || 1;
      page.titlePg = !!child(sectPr, "titlePg");
      /* header / footer text */
      const refs = Array.from(sectPr.children).filter((c) => c.localName === "headerReference" || c.localName === "footerReference");
      page.header = "";
      page.footer = "";
      for (const ref of refs) {
        const rid = ref.getAttributeNS(R, "id");
        const path = rid && relTarget(rid);
        if (!path) continue;
        const part = xml(path);
        if (!part) continue;
        const text = Array.from(part.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "t")).map((t) => t.textContent).join(" ").trim();
        const ty = ref.getAttributeNS(W, "type") || "default";
        if (ref.localName === "headerReference" && ty !== "first") page.header = text;
        if (ref.localName === "footerReference" && ty !== "first") page.footer = text;
      }
    }

    /* ---- background / theme colour */
    const bg = docXml.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "background")[0];
    if (bg) page.background = rgbToHex(attr(bg, W, "color") || "");

    /* ---- core properties */
    const core = xml("docProps/core.xml");
    const meta = {};
    if (core) {
      const pick = (tag) => {
        const el = core.getElementsByTagNameNS("*", tag)[0];
        return el ? el.textContent.trim() : "";
      };
      meta.title = pick("title");
      meta.author = pick("creator");
      meta.created = pick("created");
      meta.modified = pick("modified");
      meta.subject = pick("subject");
      meta.keywords = pick("keywords");
    }
    if (!meta.title && blocks.length) {
      const m = /<h1[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h1>/i.exec(blocks[0].html || "");
      if (m) meta.title = m[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").trim();
    }

    return { blocks, page, meta, files, styles, numbering: nums, rels, media };
  }

  /* -------------------------------------------------------------- base64 */
  function b64(bytes) {
    let s = "";
    const chunk = 0x8000;
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += chunk) {
      s += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + chunk));
    }
    return btoa(s);
  }
  function unb64(dataUri) {
    const m = /^data:([^;]+);base64,(.*)$/s.exec(dataUri || "");
    if (!m) return null;
    const bin = atob(m[2]);
    const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    return { mime: m[1], bytes: out, ext: mimeExt(m[1]) };
  }
  function mimeExt(mime) {
    return mime.indexOf("jpeg") > -1 ? "jpg" : mime.indexOf("svg") > -1 ? "svg" :
      mime.indexOf("gif") > -1 ? "gif" : mime.indexOf("webp") > -1 ? "webp" :
      mime.indexOf("bmp") > -1 ? "bmp" : "png";
  }

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------- WRITE .docx */
  const TWIP = 15; // 1px (96dpi) = 15 twips
  const EMU = 9525; // 1px = 9525 EMU

  function styleXml() {
    return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<w:styles xmlns:w="${W}">
<w:docDefaults><w:rPrDefault><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Calibri" w:hAnsi="Calibri" w:eastAsia="Calibri" w:cs="Calibri"/><w:sz w:val="22"/><w:szCs w:val="22"/><w:lang w:val="en-US"/></w:rPr></w:rPrDefault>
<w:pPrDefault><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="160" w:line="259" w:lineRule="auto"/></w:pPr></w:pPrDefault></w:docDefaults>
<w:style w:type="paragraph" w:default="1" w:styleId="Normal"><w:name w:val="Normal"/><w:qFormat/></w:style>
<w:style w:type="paragraph" w:styleId="Title"><w:name w:val="Title"/><w:basedOn w:val="Normal"/><w:next w:val="Normal"/><w:qFormat/><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="0" w:after="120"/></w:pPr><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Calibri Light" w:hAnsi="Calibri Light"/><w:sz w:val="56"/><w:szCs w:val="56"/></w:rPr></w:style>
<w:style w:type="paragraph" w:styleId="Subtitle"><w:name w:val="Subtitle"/><w:basedOn w:val="Normal"/><w:qFormat/><w:rPr><w:color w:val="595959"/><w:sz w:val="24"/></w:rPr></w:style>
${[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((n) => {
  const sizes = { 1: 40, 2: 32, 3: 28, 4: 24, 5: 22, 6: 22 };
  return `<w:style w:type="paragraph" w:styleId="Heading${n}"><w:name w:val="heading ${n}"/><w:basedOn w:val="Normal"/><w:next w:val="Normal"/><w:qFormat/><w:pPr><w:keepNext/><w:spacing w:before="${n === 1 ? 480 : 240}" w:after="${n === 1 ? 200 : 120}"/><w:outlineLvl w:val="${n - 1}"/></w:pPr><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Calibri Light" w:hAnsi="Calibri Light"/><w:b/><w:sz w:val="${sizes[n]}"/><w:color w:val="1F3864"/></w:rPr></w:style>`;
}).join("\n")}
<w:style w:type="paragraph" w:styleId="Quote"><w:name w:val="Quote"/><w:basedOn w:val="Normal"/><w:qFormat/><w:pPr><w:ind w:left="720" w:right="720"/><w:pBdr><w:left w:val="single" w:sz="18" w:space="8" w:color="A6A6A6"/></w:pBdr></w:pPr><w:rPr><w:i/><w:color w:val="404040"/></w:rPr></w:style>
<w:style w:type="paragraph" w:styleId="Caption"><w:name w:val="caption"/><w:basedOn w:val="Normal"/><w:qFormat/><w:rPr><w:i/><w:color w:val="595959"/><w:sz w:val="18"/></w:rPr></w:style>
<w:style w:type="paragraph" w:styleId="ListParagraph"><w:name w:val="List Paragraph"/><w:basedOn w:val="Normal"/><w:pPr><w:ind w:left="720"/></w:pPr></w:style>
<w:style w:type="character" w:styleId="Hyperlink"><w:name w:val="Hyperlink"/><w:rPr><w:color w:val="0563C1"/><w:u w:val="single"/></w:rPr></w:style>
<w:style w:type="character" w:styleId="FootnoteTextChar"><w:name w:val="footnote Text Char"/><w:rPr><w:sz w:val="18"/></w:rPr></w:style>
<w:style w:type="table" w:styleId="TableGrid"><w:name w:val="Table Grid"/><w:tblPr><w:tblBorders><w:top w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/><w:left w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/><w:bottom w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/><w:right w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/><w:insideH w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/><w:insideV w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/></w:tblBorders></w:tblPr></w:style>
</w:styles>`;
  }

  function numberingXml() {
    const bulletLvls = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8].map((i) => {
      const chars = ["\u2022", "\u25E6", "\u25AA", "\u2022", "\u25E6", "\u25AA", "\u2022", "\u25E6", "\u25AA"];
      return `<w:lvl w:ilvl="${i}"><w:start w:val="1"/><w:numFmt w:val="bullet"/><w:lvlText w:val="${chars[i]}"/><w:lvlJc w:val="left"/><w:pPr><w:ind w:left="${720 + i * 360}" w:hanging="360"/></w:pPr><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Calibri" w:hAnsi="Calibri"/></w:rPr></w:lvl>`;
    }).join("");
    const decLvls = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8].map((i) => {
      const fmt = ["decimal", "lowerLetter", "lowerRoman", "decimal", "lowerLetter", "lowerRoman", "decimal", "lowerLetter", "lowerRoman"][i];
      return `<w:lvl w:ilvl="${i}"><w:start w:val="1"/><w:numFmt w:val="${fmt}"/><w:lvlText w:val="%${i + 1}."/><w:lvlJc w:val="left"/><w:pPr><w:ind w:left="${720 + i * 360}" w:hanging="360"/></w:pPr></w:lvl>`;
    }).join("");
    return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<w:numbering xmlns:w="${W}">
<w:abstractNum w:abstractNumId="0"><w:multiLevelType w:val="hybridMultilevel"/>${bulletLvls}</w:abstractNum>
<w:abstractNum w:abstractNumId="1"><w:multiLevelType w:val="hybridMultilevel"/>${decLvls}</w:abstractNum>
<w:num w:numId="1"><w:abstractNumId w:val="0"/></w:num>
<w:num w:numId="2"><w:abstractNumId w:val="1"/></w:num>
</w:numbering>`;
  }

  function settingsXml() {
    return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<w:settings xmlns:w="${W}"><w:zoom w:percent="100"/><w:defaultTabStop w:val="720"/><w:characterSpacingControl w:val="doNotCompress"/><w:compat><w:compatSetting w:name="compatibilityMode" w:uri="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word" w:val="15"/></w:compat></w:settings>`;
  }

  /**
   * Build a .docx from editor HTML.
   * @param {string} html  Quill surface HTML
   * @param {object} opts  {title, author, page:{size,orient,margin,gutter,cols,colGap,colLine,background}, header, footer, pageNumbers}
   * @returns {Promise<Uint8Array>}
   */
  async function write(html, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const page = opts.page || {};
    const host = document.createElement("div");
    host.innerHTML = html || "";

    const media = [];            // {name, bytes}
    const rels = [];             // {id, type, target, mode}
    let ridSeq = 10;
    const nextRid = () => "rId" + ridSeq++;

    /* ---------- inline conversion ---------- */
    function inlineRuns(node, inherit) {
      inherit = inherit || {};
      let out = "";
      for (const child of Array.from(node.childNodes)) {
        if (child.nodeType === 3) {
          const txt = child.nodeValue.replace(/\u200b/g, "");
          if (txt) out += run(txt, inherit);
          continue;
        }
        if (child.nodeType !== 1) continue;
        const el = child;
        const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
        const st = Object.assign({}, inherit);
        if (tag === "strong" || tag === "b") st.b = 1;
        if (tag === "em" || tag === "i") st.i = 1;
        if (tag === "u") st.u = el.dataset.ustyle || "single";
        if (tag === "s" || tag === "strike" || tag === "del") {
          if (/dstrike|double/i.test(el.className)) st.dstrike = 1; else st.strike = 1;
        }
        if (tag === "sup") st.vert = "superscript";
        if (tag === "sub") st.vert = "subscript";
        if (tag === "mark") st.highlight = el.getAttribute("data-color") || "#FFFF00";
        if (tag === "code") { st.font = "Consolas"; st.shade = "F2F2F2"; }
        if (tag === "br") { out += "<w:r><w:br/></w:r>"; continue; }
        if (tag === "img") { out += imageRun(el); continue; }
        if (tag === "a") {
          const href = el.getAttribute("href") || "";
          if (!href) { out += inlineRuns(el, st); continue; }
          const rid = nextRid();
          rels.push({ id: rid, type: "hyperlink", target: href, mode: "External" });
          out += `<w:hyperlink r:id="${rid}" w:history="1">${inlineRuns(el, Object.assign({}, st, { link: 1 }))}</w:hyperlink>`;
          continue;
        }
        /* inline CSS (Quill style attributors) */
        const style = el.getAttribute("style") || "";
        if (/color:/i.test(style)) {
          const m = /(?:^|;)\s*color:\s*([^;]+)/i.exec(style);
          if (m) st.color = rgbToHex(m[1]);
        }
        if (/background-color:/i.test(style)) {
          const m = /background-color:\s*([^;]+)/i.exec(style);
          if (m) st.highlight = rgbToHex(m[1]);
        }
        if (/font-size:/i.test(style)) {
          const m = /font-size:\s*([\d.]+)px/.exec(style);
          if (m) st.size = +m[1];
        }
        if (/font-family:/i.test(style)) {
          const m = /font-family:\s*([^;]+)/.exec(style);
          if (m) st.font = m[1].replace(/['"]/g, "").split(",")[0].trim();
        }
        if (/letter-spacing:/i.test(style)) {
          const m = /letter-spacing:\s*([-\d.]+)(px|em|pt)/.exec(style);
          if (m) st.track = m[2] === "em" ? +m[1] * 20 : m[2] === "px" ? +m[1] : +m[1] * 1.333; // in twips/20
        }
        if (/text-decoration-line/i.test(style) && /line-through/.test(style)) st.strike = 1;
        if (el.classList.contains("ql-size-small")) st.size = 13;
        if (el.classList.contains("ql-size-large")) st.size = 24;
        if (el.classList.contains("ql-size-huge")) st.size = 32;
        if (el.classList.contains("ql-font-serif")) st.font = "Georgia";
        if (el.classList.contains("ql-font-monospace")) st.font = "Consolas";
        out += inlineRuns(el, st);
      }
      return out;
    }

    function run(text, st) {
      let rPr = "";
      if (st.b) rPr += "<w:b/><w:bCs/>";
      if (st.i) rPr += "<w:i/><w:iCs/>";
      if (st.u) rPr += `<w:u w:val="${st.u === "wavy" ? "wave" : st.u === "dotted" ? "dotted" : st.u === "dashed" ? "dashed" : st.u === "double" ? "double" : "single"}"/>`;
      if (st.strike) rPr += "<w:strike/>";
      if (st.dstrike) rPr += "<w:dstrike/>";
      if (st.vert) rPr += `<w:vertAlign w:val="${st.vert}"/>`;
      if (st.color) rPr += `<w:color w:val="${st.color.replace("#", "")}"/>`;
      if (st.highlight) rPr += `<w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="${st.highlight.replace("#", "")}"/>`;
      if (st.shade && !st.highlight) rPr += `<w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="${st.shade}"/>`;
      if (st.size) rPr += `<w:sz w:val="${Math.round(st.size * 1.5)}"/><w:szCs w:val="${Math.round(st.size * 1.5)}"/>`;
      if (st.font) rPr += `<w:rFonts w:ascii="${esc(st.font)}" w:hAnsi="${esc(st.font)}" w:cs="${esc(st.font)}"/>`;
      if (st.track) rPr += `<w:spacing w:val="${Math.round(st.track * 1.5)}"/>`;
      if (st.link) rPr += '<w:rStyle w:val="Hyperlink"/>';
      const textXml = String(text).split("\n").map((t, i) => (i ? "<w:br/>" : "") + `<w:t xml:space="preserve">${esc(t)}</w:t>`).join("");
      return `<w:r>${rPr ? "<w:rPr>" + rPr + "</w:rPr>" : ""}${textXml}</w:r>`;
    }

    function imageRun(img) {
      const src = img.getAttribute("src") || "";
      const data = unb64(src);
      if (!data) {
        const alt = img.getAttribute("alt") || "image";
        return run("[" + alt + "]", {});
      }
      const name = "image" + (media.length + 1) + "." + data.ext;
      media.push({ name, bytes: data.bytes });
      const rid = nextRid();
      rels.push({ id: rid, type: "image", target: "media/" + name });
      const w = +(img.getAttribute("width") || img.naturalWidth || 400);
      const h = +(img.getAttribute("height") || img.naturalHeight || 300);
      const cx = Math.round(w * EMU), cy = Math.round(h * EMU);
      return `<w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline distT="0" distB="0" distL="0" distR="0"><wp:extent cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}"/><wp:docPr id="${media.length}" name="Picture ${media.length}"/><a:graphic xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><pic:pic xmlns:pic="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><pic:nvPicPr><pic:cNvPr id="${media.length}" name="${name}"/><pic:cNvPicPr/></pic:nvPicPr><pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="${rid}"/><a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch></pic:blipFill><pic:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom></pic:spPr></pic:pic></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r>`;
    }

    /* ---------- block conversion ---------- */
    let bodyXml = "";
    let listIds = { ul: 1, ol: 2 };
    let openList = null;

    function closeList() {
      openList = null;
    }

    function blockOf(el) {
      const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
      const style = el.getAttribute("style") || "";
      const cls = el.className || "";

      if (tag === "hr" || el.classList.contains("doc-pagebreak")) {
        return '<w:p><w:r><w:br w:type="page"/></w:r></w:p>';
      }
      if (el.classList.contains("doc-colbreak")) {
        return '<w:p><w:r><w:br w:type="column"/></w:r></w:p>';
      }
      if (el.classList.contains("doc-toc")) {
        /* serialise the TOC block as its own paragraphs */
        const items = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll("a, .doc-toc-i, li")).map((a) => a.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        let out = paragraph('Contents', { pStyle: "Heading1" });
        items.forEach((t) => (out += paragraph(t, {})));
        return out;
      }
      if (el.classList.contains("doc-table-block") || el.classList.contains("doc-table-wrap") || tag === "table") {
        const table = tag === "table" ? el : el.querySelector("table");
        if (table) return tableXml(table);
        return "";
      }
      if (tag === "table") return tableXml(el);
      if (tag === "ul" || tag === "ol") return listXml(el, tag === "ol" ? 2 : 1, 0);
      if (tag === "blockquote") return paragraph(inlineRuns(el, {}), { pStyle: "Quote", isBlock: true, node: el });
      if (tag === "pre") {
        return `<w:p><w:pPr><w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="F5F5F5"/><w:spacing w:line="240" w:lineRule="auto"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Consolas" w:hAnsi="Consolas"/></w:rPr>${String(el.textContent).split("\n").map((t, i) => (i ? "<w:br/>" : "") + `<w:t xml:space="preserve">${esc(t)}</w:t>`).join("")}</w:r></w:p>`;
      }
      if (/^h[1-6]$/.test(tag)) {
        return paragraph(inlineRuns(el, {}), { pStyle: "Heading" + tag[1], node: el, style });
      }
      if (tag === "img") {
        return `<w:p>${imageRun(el)}</w:p>`;
      }
      if (el.classList.contains("doc-caption")) return paragraph(inlineRuns(el, {}), { pStyle: "Caption", node: el, style });
      if (el.classList.contains("doc-subtitle")) return paragraph(inlineRuns(el, {}), { pStyle: "Subtitle", node: el, style });
      if (el.classList.contains("doc-title")) return paragraph(inlineRuns(el, {}), { pStyle: "Title", node: el, style });
      if (el.classList.contains("doc-callout")) {
        return `<w:p><w:pPr><w:pBdr><w:left w:val="single" w:sz="24" w:space="8" w:color="4F46E5"/></w:pBdr><w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="F8FAFC"/><w:ind w:left="180"/></w:pPr>${inlineRuns(el, {})}</w:p>`;
      }
      if (tag === "p" || tag === "div" || tag === "figure" || tag === "section" || tag === "article") {
        /* containers with block children get flattened */
        const hasBlocks = Array.from(el.children).some((c) => /^(P|DIV|UL|OL|TABLE|H[1-6]|BLOCKQUOTE|PRE|FIGURE)$/.test(c.tagName));
        if (hasBlocks && tag !== "p") {
          let out = "";
          for (const c of el.children) out += blockOf(c);
          if (el.textContent.trim() === "" && !out) return "";
          return out;
        }
        return paragraph(inlineRuns(el, {}), { node: el, style, cls });
      }
      if (el.querySelector && el.querySelector("p,div,h1,h2,h3,table,ul,ol")) {
        let out = "";
        for (const c of el.children) out += blockOf(c);
        if (out) return out;
      }
      return paragraph(inlineRuns(el, {}), { node: el, style, cls });
    }

    function listXml(list, numId, level) {
      let out = "";
      for (const li of Array.from(list.children)) {
        if (li.tagName.toLowerCase() !== "li") continue;
        const nested = Array.from(li.children).filter((c) => /^(UL|OL)$/.test(c.tagName));
        const clone = li.cloneNode(true);
        Array.from(clone.children).forEach((c) => { if (/^(UL|OL)$/.test(c.tagName)) c.remove(); });
        out += paragraph(inlineRuns(clone, {}), { numId, ilvl: level, node: li });
        nested.forEach((n) => {
          out += listXml(n, n.tagName.toLowerCase() === "ol" ? 2 : numId === 1 ? 1 : 2, level + 1);
        });
      }
      return out;
    }

    function paragraph(innerXml, o) {
      o = o || {};
      let pPr = "";
      if (o.pStyle) pPr += `<w:pStyle w:val="${o.pStyle}"/>`;
      if (o.numId) pPr += `<w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="${o.ilvl || 0}"/><w:numId w:val="${o.numId}"/></w:numPr><w:ind w:left="${720 + (o.ilvl || 0) * 360}" w:hanging="360"/>`;
      if (o.node) {
        const st = o.node.getAttribute && (o.node.getAttribute("style") || "");
        const cls = (o.node.className || "") + " ";
        const align = /text-align:\s*(left|center|right|justify)/i.exec(st);
        if (align) pPr += `<w:jc w:val="${align[1] === "justify" ? "both" : align[1]}"/>`;
        if (/margin-left:\s*([\d.]+)px/.test(st)) pPr += `<w:ind w:left="${Math.round(parseFloat(RegExp.$1) * TWIP)}"/>`;
        const bg = /background-color:\s*([^;]+)/i.exec(st);
        if (bg) pPr += `<w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="${rgbToHex(bg[1]).replace("#", "")}"/>`;
        if (/line-height:\s*([\d.]+)/.test(st)) pPr += `<w:spacing w:line="${Math.round(parseFloat(RegExp.$1) * 240)}" w:lineRule="auto"/>`;
        const m = /margin-top:\s*([\d.]+)px/.exec(st);
        if (m) pPr += `<w:spacing w:before="${Math.round(parseFloat(m[1]) * TWIP)}"/>`;
        const mb = /margin-bottom:\s*([\d.]+)px/.exec(st);
        if (mb) pPr += `<w:spacing w:after="${Math.round(parseFloat(mb[1]) * TWIP)}"/>`;
        if (cls.indexOf("ql-align-center") > -1) pPr += '<w:jc w:val="center"/>';
        if (cls.indexOf("ql-align-right") > -1) pPr += '<w:jc w:val="right"/>';
        if (cls.indexOf("ql-align-justify") > -1) pPr += '<w:jc w:val="both"/>';
        if (cls.indexOf("ql-direction-rtl") > -1) pPr += '<w:bidi/>';
        const ind = (o.node.getAttribute && o.node.getAttribute("data-indent")) || "";
        if (ind) pPr += `<w:ind w:left="${(+ind) * 720}"/>`;
      }
      return `<w:p>${pPr ? "<w:pPr>" + pPr + "</w:pPr>" : ""}${innerXml || ""}</w:p>`;
    }

    function tableXml(table) {
      const rows = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll("tr"));
      const cols = rows.reduce((n, r) => Math.max(n, r.children.length), 1);
      const colW = Math.floor(9360 / cols);
      let grid = "";
      for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++) grid += `<w:gridCol w:w="${colW}"/>`;
      let rowsXml = "";
      rows.forEach((tr, ri) => {
        let cells = "";
        Array.from(tr.children).forEach((cell) => {
          const span = +(cell.getAttribute("colspan") || 1);
          let inner = "";
          const blocks = Array.from(cell.childNodes).filter((c) => c.nodeType === 1);
          if (blocks.length && blocks.some((b) => /^(P|DIV|UL|OL)$/.test(b.tagName))) {
            blocks.forEach((b) => (inner += blockOf(b)));
          } else {
            inner = paragraph(inlineRuns(cell, {}), {});
          }
          if (!inner) inner = "<w:p/>";
          cells += `<w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="${colW * span}" w:type="dxa"/>${span > 1 ? `<w:gridSpan w:val="${span}"/>` : ""}<w:vAlign w:val="top"/></w:tcPr>${inner}</w:tc>`;
        });
        const header = ri === 0 ? "<w:trPr><w:tblHeader/></w:trPr>" : "";
        rowsXml += `<w:tr>${header}${cells}</w:tr>`;
      });
      return `<w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:val="TableGrid"/><w:tblW w:w="0" w:type="auto"/><w:tblBorders><w:top w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="A6A6A6"/><w:left w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="A6A6A6"/><w:bottom w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="A6A6A6"/><w:right w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="A6A6A6"/><w:insideH w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="A6A6A6"/><w:insideV w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="A6A6A6"/></w:tblBorders><w:tblLook w:val="04A0"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid>${grid}</w:tblGrid>${rowsXml}</w:tbl><w:p/>`;
    }

    for (const el of Array.from(host.children)) {
      bodyXml += blockOf(el);
    }
    if (!bodyXml) bodyXml = "<w:p/>";

    /* ---------- section properties ---------- */
    const size = page.size || { w: 794, h: 1123 };
    let pw = Math.round((size.w / 96) * 1440);
    let ph = Math.round((size.h / 96) * 1440);
    if (page.orient === "landscape") { const t = pw; pw = ph; ph = t; }
    const m = page.margin || { t: 96, r: 96, b: 96, l: 96 };
    const tw = (px) => Math.round((px / 96) * 1440);
    const cols = page.cols || 1;
    const sect = `<w:sectPr>${opts.header || page.header ? '<w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdH"/>' : ""}${opts.footer || page.footer || page.pageNumbers ? '<w:footerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdF"/>' : ""}<w:pgSz w:w="${pw}" w:h="${ph}"${page.orient === "landscape" ? ' w:orient="landscape"' : ""}/><w:pgMar w:top="${tw(m.t)}" w:right="${tw(m.r)}" w:bottom="${tw(m.b)}" w:left="${tw(m.l)}" w:header="720" w:footer="720" w:gutter="${tw(page.gutter || 0)}"/><w:cols w:num="${cols}" w:space="${Math.round(((page.colGap || 34) / 96) * 1440)}"${page.colLine ? ' w:sep="1"' : ""}/>${page.titlePg ? "<w:titlePg/>" : ""}<w:docGrid w:linePitch="360"/></w:sectPr>`;

    const documentXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<w:document xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${R}" xmlns:wp="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing" xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:pic="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture">${
      page.background ? `<w:background w:color="${page.background.replace("#", "")}"/>` : ""
    }<w:body>${bodyXml}${sect}</w:body></w:document>`;

    /* ---------- headers / footers ---------- */
    const parts = [];
    if (opts.header || page.header) {
      const t = esc(opts.header || page.header);
      parts.push({ name: "word/header1.xml", data: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><w:hdr xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${R}"><w:p><w:pPr><w:jc w:val="center"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:rPr><w:sz w:val="18"/><w:color w:val="666666"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">${t}</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:hdr>` });
    }
    if (opts.footer || page.footer || opts.pageNumbers) {
      const t = esc(opts.footer || page.footer || "");
      const num = opts.pageNumbers
        ? `<w:r><w:rPr><w:sz w:val="18"/><w:color w:val="666666"/></w:rPr><w:fldChar w:fldCharType="begin"/></w:r><w:r><w:rPr><w:sz w:val="18"/></w:rPr><w:instrText xml:space="preserve"> PAGE </w:instrText></w:r><w:r><w:rPr><w:sz w:val="18"/></w:rPr><w:fldChar w:fldCharType="separate"/></w:r><w:r><w:rPr><w:sz w:val="18"/></w:rPr><w:t>1</w:t></w:r><w:r><w:rPr><w:sz w:val="18"/></w:rPr><w:fldChar w:fldCharType="end"/></w:r>`
        : "";
      parts.push({ name: "word/footer1.xml", data: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><w:ftr xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${R}"><w:p><w:pPr><w:jc w:val="center"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:rPr><w:sz w:val="18"/><w:color w:val="666666"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">${t}${opts.pageNumbers ? "  ·  Page " : ""}</w:t></w:r>${num}</w:p></w:ftr>` });
    }

    /* ---------- relationships ---------- */
    const relXmlParts = [
      `<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/styles" Target="styles.xml"/>`,
      `<Relationship Id="rId2" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/numbering" Target="numbering.xml"/>`,
      `<Relationship Id="rId3" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/settings" Target="settings.xml"/>`,
    ];
    if (opts.header || page.header) relXmlParts.push(`<Relationship Id="rIdH" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/header" Target="header1.xml"/>`);
    if (opts.footer || page.footer || opts.pageNumbers) relXmlParts.push(`<Relationship Id="rIdF" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/footer" Target="footer1.xml"/>`);
    rels.forEach((r) => {
      const type = r.type === "image"
        ? "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/image"
        : "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/hyperlink";
      relXmlParts.push(`<Relationship Id="${r.id}" Type="${type}" Target="${esc(r.target)}"${r.mode ? ' TargetMode="' + r.mode + '"' : ""}/>`);
    });

    const overrides = [
      `<Override PartName="/word/document.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml"/>`,
      `<Override PartName="/word/styles.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.styles+xml"/>`,
      `<Override PartName="/word/numbering.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.numbering+xml"/>`,
      `<Override PartName="/word/settings.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.settings+xml"/>`,
      `<Override PartName="/docProps/core.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.core-properties+xml"/>`,
      `<Override PartName="/docProps/app.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.extended-properties+xml"/>`,
    ];
    if (opts.header || page.header) overrides.push(`<Override PartName="/word/header1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.header+xml"/>`);
    if (opts.footer || page.footer || opts.pageNumbers) overrides.push(`<Override PartName="/word/footer1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.footer+xml"/>`);
    const extDefaults = new Set(media.map((m) => m.name.split(".").pop()));
    let defaults = `<Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>`;
    extDefaults.forEach((ext) => {
      const ct = ext === "png" ? "image/png" : ext === "jpg" ? "image/jpeg" : ext === "gif" ? "image/gif" : ext === "svg" ? "image/svg+xml" : ext === "webp" ? "image/webp" : "image/" + ext;
      defaults += `<Default Extension="${ext}" ContentType="${ct}"/>`;
    });

    const contentTypes = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types">${defaults}${overrides.join("")}</Types>`;

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString().replace(/\.\d+Z$/, "Z");
    const title = esc(opts.title || "Document");
    const author = esc(opts.author || "Pro Planner");

    const entries = [
      { name: "[Content_Types].xml", data: contentTypes },
      { name: "_rels/.rels", data: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="word/document.xml"/><Relationship Id="rId2" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships/metadata/core-properties" Target="docProps/core.xml"/><Relationship Id="rId3" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/extended-properties" Target="docProps/app.xml"/></Relationships>` },
      { name: "docProps/core.xml", data: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><cp:coreProperties xmlns:cp="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/" xmlns:dcterms="http://purl.org/dc/terms/" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><dc:title>${title}</dc:title><dc:creator>${author}</dc:creator><cp:lastModifiedBy>${author}</cp:lastModifiedBy><dcterms:created xsi:type="dcterms:W3CDTF">${nowIso}</dcterms:created><dcterms:modified xsi:type="dcterms:W3CDTF">${nowIso}</dcterms:modified></cp:coreProperties>` },
      { name: "docProps/app.xml", data: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Properties xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/extended-properties" xmlns:vt="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/docPropsVTypes"><Application>Pro Planner Document Studio</Application><AppVersion>16.0000</AppVersion></Properties>` },
      { name: "word/document.xml", data: documentXml },
      { name: "word/styles.xml", data: styleXml() },
      { name: "word/numbering.xml", data: numberingXml() },
      { name: "word/settings.xml", data: settingsXml() },
      { name: "word/_rels/document.xml.rels", data: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">${relXmlParts.join("")}</Relationships>` },
    ].concat(parts);
    media.forEach((m) => entries.push({ name: "word/media/" + m.name, data: m.bytes, store: false }));

    return global.PPZip.zip(entries);
  }

  /* --------------------------------------------------- import into an editor */
  /**
   * Replace the editor contents with a parsed DOCX result.
   * Tables become real `doctable` embeds so the app's table tools keep working.
   */
  /* markers -> real editable table embeds (last one first keeps indexes valid) */
  function swapTables(quill, tables) {
    for (let i = tables.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const t = tables[i];
      const at = quill.getText().indexOf(t.marker);
      if (at < 0) continue;
      quill.deleteText(at, t.marker.length, "silent");
      quill.insertEmbed(at, "doctable", { html: t.html }, "silent");
      quill.insertText(at + 1, "\n", "silent");
    }
    /* second pass: marker left inside a longer paragraph */
    tables.forEach((t) => {
      const at = quill.getText().indexOf(t.marker);
      if (at < 0) return;
      quill.deleteText(at, t.marker.length, "silent");
      quill.insertEmbed(at, "doctable", { html: t.html }, "silent");
      quill.insertText(at + 1, "\n", "silent");
    });
  }

  /* Paste an HTML fragment (from the clipboard) without losing tables:
     tables are lifted out, pasted as markers, then swapped for doctable embeds. */
  function pasteHtmlInto(quill, html, at) {
    const host = document.createElement("div");
    host.innerHTML = String(html || "");
    /* drop scripts/styles/office junk */
    host.querySelectorAll("script,style,meta,link").forEach((n) => n.remove());
    const tables = Array.from(host.querySelectorAll("table"));
    tables.forEach((tbl, i) => {
      const holder = document.createElement("p");
      holder.textContent = "@@PPTABLE" + i + "@@";
      if (tbl.parentNode) tbl.parentNode.replaceChild(holder, tbl);
    });
    const store = tables.map((tbl, i) => ({ marker: "@@PPTABLE" + i + "@@", html: tbl.outerHTML }));
    const frag = host.innerHTML;
    const sel = quill.getSelection() || { index: quill.getLength() - 1, length: 0 };
    const index = at == null ? sel.index : at;
    if (sel.length) quill.deleteText(index, sel.length, "user");
    try {
      quill.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(index, frag, "user");
    } catch (e) {
      quill.insertText(index, host.textContent || "", "user");
    }
    if (store.length) swapTables(quill, store);
    return store.length;
  }

  function importInto(quill, parsed) {
    /* One paste keeps Quill's block structure intact (paragraphs and lists
       stay separate); tables are swapped in afterwards through a marker so
       they become the app's editable table embeds. */
    quill.setContents([{ insert: "\n" }], "silent");
    const tables = [];
    let html = "";
    parsed.blocks.forEach((block, i) => {
      if (block.type === "table") {
        tables.push({ marker: "@@PPTABLE" + i + "@@", html: block.html });

  /* --------------------------------------------------------------- registry */

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ page helpers */
  function currentPageInfo() {
    const nav = (REF.pageNav || {});
    if (nav && typeof nav.count === "number") return { page: nav.current || 1, count: nav.count || 1 };
    const c = typeof window.computePageCount === "function" ? window.computePageCount() : 1;
    return { page: 1, count: c || 1 };

  function docPageOpts() {
    const ps = (REF.pageSetup || {}) || {};
    const paper = typeof window.currentPaper === "function" ? window.currentPaper() : { w: 794, h: 1123 };
    const mb = typeof window.marginBox === "function" ? window.marginBox() : { t: 96, r: 96, b: 96, l: 96 };
    return {
      size: { w: paper.w, h: paper.h },
      orient: ps.orient || "portrait",
      margin: mb,
      gutter: ps.gutter || 0,
      cols: ps.columns || 1,

      colLine: !!ps.colLine,

  /* ======================================================================
   *  MOUNT
   * ==================================================================== */
  function mountChrome(shell, q, id) {
    if (shell.__studioMounted) return;
    shell.__studioMounted = true;
    shell.dataset.studioId = id || "doc";

    const title = document.createElement("div");
    title.innerHTML = titleBarHTML(id);
    shell.insertBefore(title.firstElementChild, shell.firstElementChild);

    const status = document.createElement("div");
    status.innerHTML = statusBarHTML();
    shell.appendChild(status.firstElementChild);

    /* panes */
    shell.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `
      <div class="studio-cmdk" data-st="cmdk"><div class="studio-cmdk-card">
        <div class="studio-cmdk-list" role="listbox"></div></div></div>
      <aside class="studio-pane left" data-st="navpane">
        <div class="studio-pane-headed">${esc(t("navigation"))}<button type="button" class="st-x" data-st-act="close-nav">✕</button></div>
        <div class="studio-pane-body" data-st="navlist"></div>
      </aside>
      <aside class="studio-pane" data-st="thumbs" style="right:12px;left:auto;width:226px">
        <div class="studio-pane-headed">${esc(t("pages"))}<button type="button" class="st-x" data-st-act="close-thumbs">✕</button></div>
        <div class="studio-pane-body studio-thumbs" data-st="thumblist"></div>
      </aside>`);

    const rec = { shell, q, id, name: "", dirty: false, savedHtml: q.root.innerHTML };
    Editors.add(rec);
    activeEditor = rec;

    const nameInput = shell.querySelector('[data-st-field="name"]');
    const guessName = () => {
      const h = q.root.querySelector("h1,h2");
      const title = (h && h.textContent.trim()) || "";
      return title || t("untitled");
    };
    rec.name = LS.get("studio.docname." + id, "") || guessName();
    nameInput.value = rec.name;
    nameInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
      rec.name = nameInput.value.trim() || t("untitled");
      LS.set("studio.docname." + id, rec.name);
    });
    nameInput.addEventListener("blur", () => { if (!nameInput.value.trim()) nameInput.value = rec.name; });

    /* search / command palette */
    const search = shell.querySelector('[data-st-field="search"]');
    search.addEventListener("focus", () => openCommandPalette(shell, ""));
    search.addEventListener("input", () => openCommandPalette(shell, search.value));
    search.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") { closeCommandPalette(shell); search.blur(); }
      if (e.key === "Enter") {
        const first = shell.querySelector(".studio-cmdk-item.on, .studio-cmdk-item");
        if (first) first.click();
      }
    });

    const zoom = shell.querySelector('[data-st-field="zoom"]');
    zoom.addEventListener("input", () => {
      SET.zoom = +zoom.value;
      LS.set("zoom", SET.zoom);
      if (typeof window.applyDocZoom === "function") window.applyDocZoom(SET.zoom);
      syncZoomLabels();
    });

    /* live updates */
    const normalizeHtml = (h) => String(h || "")
      .replace(/\u200b/g, "")
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      .replace(/class="[^"]*ql-cursor[^"]*"/g, "")
      .trim();
    q.on("text-change", (delta, oldDelta, source) => {
      if (source && source !== "user") { updateStatus(shell, q); return; }
      if (rec.suppressUntil && Date.now() < rec.suppressUntil) {
        rec.savedHtml = q.root.innerHTML;
        rec.dirty = false;
        markSaveState(shell, false);
        updateStatus(shell, q);
        scheduleThumbs(shell, q);
        return;
      }
      /* compare after the DOM settles: pure repaint churn is not a real edit */
      clearTimeout(rec.dirtyT);
      rec.dirtyT = setTimeout(() => {
        rec.dirty = normalizeHtml(q.root.innerHTML) !== normalizeHtml(rec.savedHtml);
        markSaveState(shell, rec.dirty);
      }, 260);
      updateStatus(shell, q);
      scheduleThumbs(shell, q);
    });
    q.on("selection-change", () => {
      const inTable = !!q.root.querySelector(".doc-table") && !!document.activeElement &&
        document.activeElement.closest && document.activeElement.closest(".doc-table");
      shell.classList.toggle("in-table", !!inTable);
    });

    const surface = shell.querySelector(".rt-surface");
    if (surface) surface.addEventListener("scroll", () => updateStatus(shell, q), { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", () => updateStatus(shell, q));

    applyTheme();
    applyLocale();
    applyViewMode(shell);
    /* Word opens documents in Print Layout; only do this once per browser
       (a saved writing mode is respected afterwards). */
    if (!LS.get("mode.init", false)) {
      LS.set("mode.init", true);
      if (!localStorage.getItem("docMode") && typeof window.applyDocMode === "function") window.applyDocMode("page");
    }
    updateStatus(shell, q);
    syncZoomLabels();
    renderNavList(shell, q);
    if (SET.pageThumbs) toggleThumbs(shell, q, true);
    if (SET.navPane) toggleNav(shell, q, true);
    if (typeof window.applyDocZoom === "function") window.applyDocZoom(SET.zoom);
    else (shell.style.setProperty("--doc-zoom", SET.zoom / 100));
  }

  function markSaveState(shell, dirty) {
    const dot = shell.querySelector(".studio-dot");
    const lbl = shell.querySelector(".studio-savestate");
    if (dot) dot.classList.toggle("is-dirty", !!dirty);
    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = dirty ? t("unsaved") : t("saved");
    const save = shell.querySelector('.studio-qat [data-st-act="save"]');
    if (save) save.disabled = false;
  }

  function updateStatus(shell, q) {
    if (!q) return;
    const text = q.getText().replace(/\u200b/g, "");
    const words = (text.match(/[^\s]+/g) || []).length;
    const chars = text.replace(/\n/g, "").length;
    const mins = Math.max(1, Math.round(words / 220));
    const pi = currentPageInfo();
    const pageEl = shell.querySelector('[data-st-slot="page"]');
    if (pageEl) pageEl.innerHTML = `${esc(t("page"))} <b>${pi.page}</b> ${esc(t("of"))} <b>${pi.count}</b>`;
    /* the host stats bar hard-codes "Page 1 of 1" — keep it honest */
    document.querySelectorAll(".rt-stats [data-page]").forEach((el) => {
      el.textContent = "Page " + pi.page + " of " + pi.count;
    });
    const wordEl = shell.querySelector('[data-st-slot="words"]');
    if (wordEl) wordEl.innerHTML = `<b>${words.toLocaleString()}</b> ${esc(t("words"))} · <b>${chars.toLocaleString()}</b> characters · <b>${mins}</b> min read`;
    const langEl = shell.querySelector('[data-st-slot="lang"]');
    if (langEl) langEl.textContent = "English (US)";
  }

  function syncZoomLabels() {
    $$(".studio-zoomlbl").forEach((l) => (l.textContent = SET.zoom + "%"));
    $$('[data-st-field="zoom"]').forEach((i) => (i.value = SET.zoom));
  }

  /* ======================================================================
   *  THEME / LOCALE / VIEW
   * ==================================================================== */
  function applyTheme() {
    $$(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
      sh.classList.toggle("studio-dark", SET.theme === "dark");
      sh.classList.toggle("studio-page-dark", !!LS.get("darkpage", false));
      const b = sh.querySelector('[data-st-act="toggle-theme"]');
      if (b) b.innerHTML = icon(SET.theme === "dark" ? "sun" : "moon");
    });
  }

  function applyLocale() {
    document.documentElement.lang = SET.locale;
    /* chrome strings */
    const map = {
      "newDoc": "newDoc", "open": "open", "save": "save", "saveAs": "saveAs", "print": "print",
      "share": "share", "close": "close", "options": "options", "info": "info", "recent": "recent",
    };
    $$('[data-st-act="share"] span').forEach((s) => (s.textContent = t("share")));
    $$('[data-st-field="search"]').forEach((i) => i.setAttribute("placeholder", t("tellMe")));
    $$(".studio-autosave > span:first-child").forEach((s) => (s.textContent = t("autosave")));
    $$('[data-st-act="editing-mode"] span').forEach((s) => (s.textContent = t(SET.mode)));
    /* ribbon tab labels */
    const tabNames = {
      file: "file", home: "home", insert: "insert", design: "design", layout: "layout",
      refs: "references", mailings: "mailings", review: "review", view: "view", help: "help", table: "table",
    };
    $$(".rt-tab").forEach((b) => {
      const key = tabNames[b.dataset.tab];
      if (key) b.textContent = t(key);
    });
    /* backstage, if open, re-renders */
    const bs = $(".studio-backstage.open");
    if (bs) bs.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("studio:relocalise"));
    updateAllStatus();
  }

  function updateAllStatus() {
    Editors.forEach((rec) => updateStatus(rec.shell, rec.q));
  }

  function applyViewMode(shell) {
    if (!shell) return;
    shell.classList.toggle("studio-draft", SET.view === "draft");
    shell.classList.toggle("studio-pages", SET.view !== "draft");
    shell.classList.toggle("studio-viewing", SET.mode === "viewing");
    shell.classList.toggle("show-hidden-text", !!SET.hiddenText);
    shell.classList.toggle("show-grid", !!SET.gridlines);
    shell.classList.toggle("studio-read", SET.mode === "viewing");
    $$(".studio-viewbtns [data-st-act^='view-']").forEach((b) => {
      const on = (b.dataset.stAct === "view-draft" && SET.view === "draft") ||
        (b.dataset.stAct === "view-print" && SET.view === "print") ||
        (b.dataset.stAct === "view-read" && SET.mode === "viewing");
      b.classList.toggle("on", !!on);
    });
    if (SET.view === "draft" && typeof window.applyDocMode === "function" && window.docMode !== "standard") {
      /* keep the app's own writing mode untouched; draft is a chrome view */
    }
    const q = shell.__studioQ;
    if (q && q.enable) {
      const ro = SET.mode === "viewing";
      if (q.root.getAttribute("contenteditable") !== (ro ? "false" : "true")) q.enable(!ro);
    }
  }

  /* ======================================================================
   *  NAVIGATION + THUMBNAILS
   * ==================================================================== */
  function renderNavList(shell, q) {
    const list = shell.querySelector('[data-st="navlist"]');
    if (!list) return;
    const heads = $$("h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6", q.root);
    if (!heads.length) {
      list.innerHTML = `<div class="studio-hint">Add headings (Home → Styles) to build a navigation pane.</div>`;
      return;
    }
    list.innerHTML = heads.map((h, i) => {
      if (!h.id) h.id = "st-h-" + i;
      const lvl = +h.tagName[1];
      return `<button type="button" class="studio-navrow l${Math.min(6, lvl)}" data-jump="${esc(h.id)}">${esc(h.textContent.trim().slice(0, 70) || "Untitled")}</button>`;
    }).join("");
    list.querySelectorAll("[data-jump]").forEach((b) => {
      b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const target = q.root.querySelector("#" + CSS.escape(b.dataset.jump));
        if (target) target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
      });
    });
  }

  function toggleNav(shell, q, force) {
    const pane = shell.querySelector('[data-st="navpane"]');
    if (!pane) return;
    const open = force === true ? true : !pane.classList.contains("open");
    pane.classList.toggle("open", open);
    SET.navPane = open;
    LS.set("nav", open);
    if (open) renderNavList(shell, q);
  }

  let thumbTimer = 0;
  function scheduleThumbs(shell, q) {
    if (!SET.pageThumbs) return;
    clearTimeout(thumbTimer);
    thumbTimer = setTimeout(() => renderThumbs(shell, q), 700);
  }

  function renderThumbs(shell, q) {
    const box = shell.querySelector('[data-st="thumblist"]');
    if (!box || !SET.pageThumbs) return;
    const pi = currentPageInfo();
    const total = Math.max(1, pi.count);
    const chunks = splitHtmlByPages(q.root.innerHTML, total);
    box.innerHTML = chunks.slice(0, 60).map((html, i) => `
      <button type="button" class="studio-thumb${i + 1 === pi.page ? " on" : ""}" data-page="${i + 1}" aria-label="Page ${i + 1}">
        <span class="tp">${html}</span><small>${i + 1}</small>
      </button>`).join("");
    box.querySelectorAll(".studio-thumb").forEach((b) => {
      b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const surf = shell.querySelector(".rt-surface");
        const paper = shell.querySelector(".ql-container");
        if (!surf || !paper) return;
        const h = typeof window.pageHeightPx === "function" ? window.pageHeightPx() : 1000;
        surf.scrollTo({ top: (+b.dataset.page - 1) * h + paper.offsetTop, behavior: "smooth" });
      });
    });
  }

  function splitHtmlByPages(html, total) {
    const host = document.createElement("div");
    host.innerHTML = html;
    const breaks = $$(".doc-pagebreak, .doc-colbreak", host).length + 1;
    const pages = Math.max(total, breaks);
    if (pages <= 1) return [html];
    const blocks = Array.from(host.children);
    const per = Math.ceil(blocks.length / pages);
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < pages; i++) {
      const slice = blocks.slice(i * per, (i + 1) * per).map((n) => n.outerHTML).join("");
      out.push(slice || "<p> </p>");
    }
    return out;
  }

  function toggleThumbs(shell, q, force) {
    const pane = shell.querySelector('[data-st="thumbs"]');
    if (!pane) return;
    const open = force === true ? true : !pane.classList.contains("open");
    pane.classList.toggle("open", open);
    SET.pageThumbs = open;
    LS.set("thumbs", open);
    if (open) renderThumbs(shell, q);
  }

  /* ======================================================================

    { id: "new", label: "New document", key: "Ctrl+Alt+N", run: () => newDocument() },
    { id: "open", label: "Open a document…", key: "Ctrl+O", run: () => pickFile() },
