  function openCommandPalette(shell, term) {
    const box = shell.querySelector('[data-st="cmdk"]');
    if (!box) return;
    const q = (term || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    const list = COMMANDS.filter((c) => !q || c.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || c.id.includes(q));
    box.querySelector(".studio-cmdk-list").innerHTML = list.length
      ? list.slice(0, 12).map((c, i) =>
          `<button type="button" class="studio-cmdk-item${i === 0 ? " on" : ""}" data-cmd="${c.id}">
             <span>${esc(c.label)}</span><small>${esc(c.key)}</small></button>`).join("")
      : `<div class="studio-cmdk-empty">No matching command</div>`;
    box.classList.add("open");
    box.querySelectorAll("[data-cmd]").forEach((b) => {
      b.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.preventDefault());
      b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const cmd = COMMANDS.find((c) => c.id === b.dataset.cmd);
        closeCommandPalette(shell);
        if (cmd) cmd.run();
      });
    });
  }
  function closeCommandPalette(shell) {
    const box = shell && shell.querySelector('[data-st="cmdk"]');
    if (box) box.classList.remove("open");
  }

  /* ======================================================================
   *  FILE OPERATIONS
   * ==================================================================== */
  function runAction(act) {
    if (!activeEditor) return toast("Open a document first", "warn");
    const { q, shell } = activeEditor;
    const fn = window.DOC_ACTIONS && window.DOC_ACTIONS[act];
    if (fn) {
      try { fn({ q, shell, id: activeEditor.id, btn: null, range: q.getSelection() || { index: 0, length: 0 }, bar: shell.querySelector(".rt-ribbon") }); }
      catch (e) { console.warn(e); toast("That action failed: " + e.message, "warn"); }
      return;
    }
    if (typeof window.richAction === "function") window.richAction(q, act, q.getSelection() || { index: 0, length: 0 }, activeEditor.id);
  }

  function activeQuill() {
    return activeEditor ? activeEditor.q : window.quill || null;
  }

  function saveActive() {
    const rec = activeEditor;
    if (!rec) return;
    if (typeof window.persistDraft === "function") {
      try { window.persistDraft(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    rec.savedHtml = rec.q.root.innerHTML;
    rec.dirty = false;
    markSaveState(rec.shell, false);
    LS.set("studio.savedAt." + rec.id, Date.now());
    if (typeof window.setSaveStatus === "function") window.setSaveStatus("Saved");
    toast("Document saved");
  }

  async function exportDocx() {
    const rec = activeEditor;
    if (!rec) return;
    const q = rec.q;
    const name = safeName(rec.name || t("untitled"));
    toast("Building Word document…");
    try {
      const ps = (REF.pageSetup || {}) || {};
      const bytes = await window.PPDocx.write(q.root.innerHTML, {
        title: rec.name,
        author: SET.author,
        page: docPageOpts(),
        header: ((REF.pageChrome || {}) && (REF.pageChrome || {}).header) || "",
        footer: ((REF.pageChrome || {}) && (REF.pageChrome || {}).footer) || "",
        pageNumbers: !!((REF.pageChrome || {}) && (REF.pageChrome || {}).numbers),
        titlePg: !!ps.diffFirstPage,
      });
      const blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" });
      if (SAVE_FLAGS.showSaveFilePicker && !window.__studioForceDownload) {
        try {
          const handle = await window.showSaveFilePicker({
            suggestedName: name + ".docx",
            types: [{ description: "Word document", accept: { "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": [".docx"] } }],
          });
          const w = await handle.createWritable();
          await w.write(blob);
          await w.close();
          pushRecent({ name: name + ".docx", at: Date.now(), size: bytes.length, kind: "docx" });
          toast("Saved " + name + ".docx");
          return;
        } catch (e) {
          if (e && e.name === "AbortError") return;
        }
      }
      download(blob, name + ".docx");
      pushRecent({ name: name + ".docx", at: Date.now(), size: bytes.length, kind: "docx" });
      toast("Downloaded " + name + ".docx");
      rec.savedHtml = q.root.innerHTML;
      rec.dirty = false;
      markSaveState(rec.shell, false);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      if (typeof window.showAppAlert === "function") window.showAppAlert("Could not create the Word file", e.message);
      else toast("DOCX export failed: " + e.message, "warn");
    }
  }

  function exportAs(kind) {
    const rec = activeEditor;
    if (!rec) return;
    const q = rec.q;
    const name = safeName(rec.name || t("untitled"));
    if (kind === "html") {
      const html = `<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${esc(rec.name)}</title>\n${q.root.innerHTML}`;
      download(new Blob([html], { type: "text/html" }), name + ".html");
    } else if (kind === "md") {
      const md = typeof window.htmlToMarkdown === "function" ? window.htmlToMarkdown(q.root.innerHTML) :
        q.getText();
      download(new Blob([md], { type: "text/markdown" }), name + ".md");
    } else if (kind === "txt") {
      download(new Blob([q.getText()], { type: "text/plain" }), name + ".txt");
    }
    toast("Exported " + kind.toUpperCase());
  }

  function printDoc() {
    if (typeof window.exportDoc === "function" && activeQuill()) window.exportDoc(activeQuill(), "print");
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ open */
  let fileInput = null;
  function pickFile() {
    if (!fileInput) {
      fileInput = document.createElement("input");
      fileInput.type = "file";
      fileInput.accept = ".docx,.doc,.rtf,.html,.htm,.md,.markdown,.txt,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document";
      fileInput.style.display = "none";
      document.body.appendChild(fileInput);
      fileInput.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const f = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
        fileInput.value = "";
        if (f) openFile(f);
      });
    }
    fileInput.click();
  }

  async function openFile(file) {
    if (!activeEditor) return toast("Open the document editor first", "warn");
    const rec = activeEditor;
    const q = rec.q;
    const name = file.name || "document";
    const ext = (name.split(".").pop() || "").toLowerCase();
    try {
      if (rec.dirty) {
        const ok = await confirmDialog("Replace the text in this editor?", "The open document replaces the current text. Save first if you need it.", "Open anyway");
        if (!ok) return;
      }
      if (ext === "docx") {
        toast("Reading " + name + "…");
        const parsed = await window.PPDocx.read(await file.arrayBuffer());
        window.PPDocx.importInto(q, parsed);
        if (parsed.page) applyImportedPageSetup(parsed.page);
        const pc = REF.pageChrome || {};
        if (parsed.page) {
          pc.header = parsed.page.header || "";
          pc.footer = parsed.page.footer || "";
          pc.numbers = /page\s*\d|of\s*\d/i.test(parsed.page.footer || "");
          if (typeof window.applyPageChrome === "function") window.applyPageChrome();
        }
        rec.name = parsed.meta.title || name.replace(/\.docx$/i, "");
        rec.shell.querySelector('[data-st-field="name"]').value = rec.name;
        LS.set("studio.docname." + rec.id, rec.name);
        toast("Opened " + name + (parsed.blocks.length ? "" : " (empty)"));
      } else if (ext === "doc") {
        const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
        const head = new Uint8Array(buf.slice(0, 8));
        const isCfb = head[0] === 0xd0 && head[1] === 0xcf && head[2] === 0x11 && head[3] === 0xe0;
        if (isCfb) {
          const text = extractLegacyDocText(buf);
          q.setContents([{ insert: text ? text.replace(/\r/g, "\n") + "\n" : "This legacy .doc file could not be read.\n" }]);
          toast("Legacy .doc: text-only import", "warn");
          if (typeof window.showAppAlert === "function") {
            window.showAppAlert("Word 97–2003 format",
              "Binary .doc files have no XML inside, so only the readable text was imported. Resave it as .docx in Word (or LibreOffice) for full formatting, then open it here.");
          }
        } else {
          await openFile(new File([buf], name.replace(/\.doc$/i, ".docx")));
        }
      } else if (ext === "rtf") {
        const text = rtfToText(await file.text());
        q.setContents([]);
        q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(0, text.split(/\n{2,}/).map((p) => `<p>${esc(p).replace(/\n/g, "<br>")}</p>`).join(""));
        toast("RTF imported as text");
      } else if (ext === "html" || ext === "htm") {
        const raw = await file.text();
        const body = /<body[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/body>/i.exec(raw);
        q.setContents([]);
        q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(0, body ? body[1] : raw);
        toast("Opened " + name);
      } else if (ext === "md" || ext === "markdown") {
        q.setContents([]);
        q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(0, mdToHtml(await file.text()));
        toast("Opened " + name);
      } else {
        const text = await file.text();
        q.setContents([]);
        q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(0, text.split(/\n{2,}/).map((p) => `<p>${esc(p).replace(/\n/g, "<br>")}</p>`).join(""));
        toast("Opened " + name);
      }
      rec.savedHtml = q.root.innerHTML;
      rec.dirty = false;
      markSaveState(rec.shell, false);
      rec.suppressUntil = Date.now() + 1800;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        rec.savedHtml = q.root.innerHTML;
        rec.dirty = false;
        markSaveState(rec.shell, false);
      });
      setTimeout(() => {
        rec.savedHtml = q.root.innerHTML;
        rec.dirty = false;
        markSaveState(rec.shell, false);
      }, 1800);
      pushRecent({ name, at: Date.now(), size: file.size, kind: ext });
      updateStatus(rec.shell, q);
      renderNavList(rec.shell, q);
      if (setTimeout) scheduleThumbs(rec.shell, q);
      /* keep title bar honest */
      rec.shell.querySelector('[data-st-field="name"]').value = rec.name;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      if (typeof window.showAppAlert === "function") window.showAppAlert("Could not open that file", e.message);
      else toast("Open failed: " + e.message, "warn");
    }
  }

  function applyImportedPageSetup(page) {
    if (typeof (REF.pageSetup || {}) !== "object") return;
    const ps = (REF.pageSetup || {});
    if (page.orient) ps.orient = page.orient;
    if (page.cols) ps.columns = page.cols;
    if (page.gutter) ps.gutter = page.gutter;
    if (page.margin) {
      ps.margin = "custom";
      ps.marginCustom = { t: page.margin.t, r: page.margin.r, b: page.margin.b, l: page.margin.l };
    }
    if (page.w && page.h) {
      const sizes = (REF.PAGE_SIZES || {}) || {};
      const key = Object.keys(sizes).find((k) => {
        const s = sizes[k];
        return Math.abs(s.w - page.w * 1.333) < 12 && Math.abs(s.h - page.h * 1.333) < 12;
      });
      if (key) ps.size = key;
      else {
        ps.size = "custom";
        ps.customSize = { w: page.w / 72, h: page.h / 72 };
      }
    }
    if (typeof window.applyPageSetup === "function") window.applyPageSetup();
    if (typeof window.updatePageInfo === "function") window.updatePageInfo();
  }

  /* legacy .doc text extraction (best effort, honest about it) */
  function extractLegacyDocText(buffer) {
    try {
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
      const dec = new TextDecoder("utf-16le");
      let out = "";
      let run = [];
      for (let i = 0; i + 1 < bytes.length; i += 2) {
        const code = bytes[i] | (bytes[i + 1] << 8);
        const printable = (code >= 32 && code < 127) || code === 13 || code === 10 || code === 9 ||
          (code >= 0x0980 && code <= 0x09ff) || (code >= 0x4e00 && code <= 0x9fff) || code === 0x00a0;
        if (printable) run.push(code);
        else {
          if (run.length > 12) out += dec.decode(new Uint16Array(run)) + "\n";
          run = [];
        }
      }
      if (run.length > 12) out += dec.decode(new Uint16Array(run));
      return out.replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").slice(0, 400000).trim();
    } catch (e) {
      return "";
    }
  }

  function rtfToText(rtf) {
    return rtf
      .replace(/\\'([0-9a-f]{2})/gi, (_, h) => String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h, 16)))
      .replace(/\\u(-?\d+)\??/g, (_, n) => String.fromCharCode((+n + 65536) % 65536))
      .replace(/\\par[d]?/g, "\n")
      .replace(/\{\\\*[^{}]*\}/g, "")
      .replace(/\\[a-z]+-?\d*\s?/gi, "")
      .replace(/[{}]/g, "")
      .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
      .trim();
  }

  function mdToHtml(md) {
    const lines = String(md).replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n").split("\n");
    const out = [];
    let inCode = false, list = null;
    const inline = (s) =>
      esc(s)
        .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, "<code>$1</code>")
        .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "<strong>$1</strong>")
        .replace(/(^|[^*])\*([^*]+)\*/g, "$1<em>$2</em>")
        .replace(/~~([^~]+)~~/g, "<s>$1</s>")
        .replace(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<img alt="$1" src="$2">')
        .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<a href="$2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">$1</a>');
    const closeList = () => { if (list) { out.push(`</${list}>`); list = null; } };
    for (const line of lines) {
      if (/^```/.test(line)) { closeList(); inCode = !inCode; out.push(inCode ? "<pre>" : "</pre>"); continue; }
      if (inCode) { out.push(esc(line)); continue; }
      if (/^\s*$/.test(line)) { closeList(); continue; }
      const h = /^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)$/.exec(line);
      if (h) { closeList(); out.push(`<h${h[1].length}>${inline(h[2])}</h${h[1].length}>`); continue; }
      if (/^\s*[-*+]\s+/.test(line)) {
        if (list !== "ul") { closeList(); out.push("<ul>"); list = "ul"; }
        out.push(`<li>${inline(line.replace(/^\s*[-*+]\s+/, ""))}</li>`);
        continue;
      }
      if (/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+/.test(line)) {
        if (list !== "ol") { closeList(); out.push("<ol>"); list = "ol"; }
        out.push(`<li>${inline(line.replace(/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+/, ""))}</li>`);
        continue;
      }
      if (/^>\s?/.test(line)) { closeList(); out.push(`<blockquote>${inline(line.replace(/^>\s?/, ""))}</blockquote>`); continue; }
      if (/^\|.*\|$/.test(line)) {
        closeList();
        const cells = line.split("|").slice(1, -1).map((c) => c.trim());
        if (cells.every((c) => /^:?-{2,}:?$/.test(c))) continue;
        out.push(`<table class="doc-table"><tbody><tr>${cells.map((c) => `<td>${inline(c)}</td>`).join("")}</tr></tbody></table>`);
        continue;
      }
      closeList();
      out.push(`<p>${inline(line)}</p>`);
    }
    closeList();
    if (inCode) out.push("</pre>");
    return out.join("\n");
  }

  function newDocument() {
    if (!activeEditor) return toast("Open the document editor first", "warn");
    const rec = activeEditor;
    confirmDialog("Start a new document?", "The text in this editor will be replaced. Save first if you need it.", "New document").then((ok) => {
      if (!ok) return;
      rec.q.setContents([{ insert: "\n" }]);
      rec.q.history && rec.q.history.clear && rec.q.history.clear();
      rec.name = t("untitled");
      rec.shell.querySelector('[data-st-field="name"]').value = rec.name;
      rec.savedHtml = rec.q.root.innerHTML;
      rec.dirty = false;
      markSaveState(rec.shell, false);
      updateStatus(rec.shell, rec.q);
      renderNavList(rec.shell, rec.q);
      toast("New document");
    });
  }

  /* ======================================================================
   *  DIALOGS
   * ==================================================================== */
  function modal(title, body, actions, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "studio-modal open";
    wrap.innerHTML = `<div class="studio-modal-card${opts.wide ? " wide" : ""}" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${esc(title)}">
      <div class="studio-modal-h">${esc(title)}<button type="button" class="st-x" data-close aria-label="Close">✕</button></div>
      <div class="studio-modal-b">${body}</div>
      <div class="studio-modal-f">${(actions || []).map((a, i) => `<button type="button" class="studio-btn ${a.kind || ""}" data-a="${i}">${esc(a.label)}</button>`).join("")}</div>
    </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(wrap);
    const close = () => wrap.remove();
    wrap.addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (e.target === wrap || e.target.closest("[data-close]")) close(); });
    (actions || []).forEach((a, i) => {
      wrap.querySelector(`[data-a="${i}"]`).addEventListener("click", async () => {
        const keep = a.run ? await a.run(wrap) : false;
        if (!keep) close();
      });
    });
    wrap.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") close(); });
    setTimeout(() => { const f = wrap.querySelector("input,textarea,select"); if (f) f.focus(); }, 30);
    return { wrap, close };
  }

  function confirmDialog(title, message, okLabel) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const { wrap } = modal(title, `<div class="studio-hint">${esc(message)}</div>`, [
        { label: "Cancel", run: () => { resolve(false); } },
        { label: okLabel || "OK", kind: "primary", run: () => { resolve(true); } },
      ]);
      wrap.addEventListener("remove", () => resolve(false));
    });
  }

      <label class="studio-check"><input type="checkbox" data-opt="hidden"${SET.hiddenText ? " checked" : ""}> Show hidden text (dotted underline)</label>
      <label class="studio-check"><input type="checkbox" data-opt="grid"${SET.gridlines ? " checked" : ""}> Show gridlines</label>
      <label class="studio-check"><input type="checkbox" data-opt="darkpage"${LS.get("darkpage", false) ? " checked" : ""}> Dark page in dark mode (inverts the paper as well as the chrome)</label>
      <label class="studio-check"><input type="checkbox" data-opt="pickers"${LS.get("pickers", false) ? " checked" : ""}> Use the system “Save as” dialog when available (File System Access API)</label>
      <div class="studio-hint">Files are processed entirely in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.</div>`;
    const { wrap } = modal("Studio options", body, [
      { label: "Cancel" },
      { label: "Save options", kind: "primary", run: (host) => {
        const val = (n) => { const e = host.querySelector(`[data-opt="${n}"]`); return e ? (e.type === "checkbox" ? e.checked : e.value) : null; };
        SET.theme = val("theme"); SET.locale = "en"; SET.view = val("view");
        SET.zoom = Math.min(200, Math.max(40, +val("zoom") || 100));
        SET.author = val("author") || "You";
        SET.autosave = val("autosave"); SET.pageThumbs = val("thumbs");
        SET.navPane = val("nav"); SET.hiddenText = val("hidden"); SET.gridlines = val("grid");
        LS.set("pickers", val("pickers"));
        LS.set("darkpage", val("darkpage"));
        $$(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => sh.classList.toggle("studio-page-dark", !!LS.get("darkpage", false)));
        ["theme", "locale", "view", "zoom", "author", "autosave", "thumbs", "nav", "hiddenText", "gridlines"].forEach((k) => LS.set(k, SET[k]));
        LS.set("autosave", SET.autosave);
        LS.set("hiddenText", SET.hiddenText);
        applyTheme(); applyLocale(); applyViewMode(activeEditor && activeEditor.shell); syncZoomLabels();
        if (typeof window.applyDocZoom === "function") window.applyDocZoom(SET.zoom);
        toast("Options saved");
      } },
    ]);
    return wrap;

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------- share */
  function openShare() {
    const rec = activeEditor;
    const url = location.href.split("#")[0];
    const body = `
      <div class="studio-hint">Share this document. Files never leave the device — use a download, the clipboard, or your device's share sheet.</div>

        <button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-share="docx">${icon("download")}  Word (.docx)</button>
        <button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-share="html">${icon("doc")}  Web page (.html)</button>
        <button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-share="md">${icon("doc")}  Markdown (.md)</button>
        <button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-share="txt">${icon("doc")}  Plain text (.txt)</button>
      </div>
      <div class="studio-field"><label>Copy as</label>
        <div class="studio-bs-row">
          <button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-share="copy-html">Rich text</button>
          <button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-share="copy-md">Markdown</button>
          <button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-share="copy-txt">Plain text</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="studio-field"><label>Invite / link</label>
        <div class="studio-bs-row">
          <input type="text" readonly value="${esc(url)}" style="flex:1;height:32px;border:1px solid #d0d5dd;border-radius:8px;padding:0 10px">
          <button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-share="copy-link">Copy link</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    const { wrap } = modal("Share", body, [{ label: "Close" }]);
    wrap.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest("[data-share]");
      if (!b) return;
      const kind = b.dataset.share;
      if (kind === "docx") return exportDocx();
      if (kind === "html" || kind === "md" || kind === "txt") return exportAs(kind);
      if (kind === "copy-html") {
        const html = rec ? rec.q.root.innerHTML : "";
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({
            "text/html": new Blob([html], { type: "text/html" }),
            "text/plain": new Blob([rec ? rec.q.getText() : ""], { type: "text/plain" }),
          })]);
          toast("Rich text copied");
        } catch (err) { toast("Clipboard blocked by the browser", "warn"); }
      }
      if (kind === "copy-md") {
        const md = typeof window.htmlToMarkdown === "function" ? window.htmlToMarkdown(rec.q.root.innerHTML) : rec.q.getText();
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(md).then(() => toast("Markdown copied"), () => toast("Clipboard blocked", "warn"));
      }
      if (kind === "copy-txt") {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(rec ? rec.q.getText() : "").then(() => toast("Text copied"), () => toast("Clipboard blocked", "warn"));
      }
      if (kind === "copy-link") {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(() => toast("Link copied"), () => toast("Clipboard blocked", "warn"));
      }
    });
    if (navigator.share && rec) {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.className = "studio-btn primary";
      btn.textContent = "Use device share sheet…";
      btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        try {
          const bytes = await window.PPDocx.write(rec.q.root.innerHTML, { title: rec.name, page: docPageOpts() });
          const file = new File([bytes], safeName(rec.name) + ".docx", { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" });
          await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: rec.name });
        } catch (err) { if (err.name !== "AbortError") toast("Share cancelled", "warn"); }
      });
      wrap.querySelector(".studio-modal-f").prepend(btn);
    }
  }

      const shell = activeEditor && activeEditor.shell;
      const paper = shell && shell.querySelector(".ql-container");
      const surf = shell && shell.querySelector(".rt-surface");
      if (paper && surf) set(Math.max(40, Math.min(200, Math.round((surf.clientWidth - 40) / paper.offsetWidth * 100))));
    });
    wrap.querySelector("[data-zoom-page]").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const shell = activeEditor && activeEditor.shell;
      const paper = shell && shell.querySelector(".ql-container");
      const surf = shell && shell.querySelector(".rt-surface");
      if (paper && surf) {
        const z = Math.min((surf.clientWidth - 40) / paper.offsetWidth, (surf.clientHeight - 40) / paper.offsetHeight) * 100;
        set(Math.max(40, Math.min(200, Math.round(z))));

    const { wrap } = modal("Mail merge", body, [
      { label: "Close" },

        toast("Merging " + mailMerge.data.length + " documents…");
        for (let i = 0; i < mailMerge.data.length; i++) {
          const html = mergeFor(mailMerge.data[i]);
          const bytes = await window.PPDocx.write(html, { title: (activeEditor.name || "Merge") + " " + (i + 1), page: docPageOpts() });
          download(new Blob([bytes], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" }), safeName(activeEditor.name || "merge") + "-" + (i + 1) + ".docx");
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250));
        }
        toast("Merged " + mailMerge.data.length + " documents");
      } },
    ], { wide: true });

    const mailMerge = (window.__mailMerge = window.__mailMerge || { data: [], fields: [], at: 0 });

    wrap.querySelector('[data-mm="load"]').addEventListener("click", () => {
      const inp = wrap.querySelector("[data-mm-file]");
      inp.addEventListener("change", async () => {
        const f = inp.files[0];
        if (!f) return;
        const rows = parseCSV(await f.text());
        mailMerge.data = rows.slice(1).map((r) => Object.fromEntries(rows[0].map((h, i) => [h.trim(), r[i] || ""])));
        mailMerge.fields = rows[0].map((h) => h.trim());
        mailMerge.at = 0;
        wrap.querySelector("[data-mm-count]").textContent = mailMerge.data.length + " recipients · " + mailMerge.fields.length + " fields";
        wrap.querySelector("[data-mm-fields]").innerHTML = mailMerge.fields.map((f) => `<button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-field="${esc(f)}">«${esc(f)}»</button>`).join("");
        wrap.querySelectorAll("[data-field]").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const q = activeQuill();
          const r = q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength() - 1, length: 0 };
          q.insertText(r.index, "«" + b.dataset.field + "»", "user");
        }));
        toast("Loaded " + mailMerge.data.length + " recipients");
      });
      inp.click();
    });
    wrap.querySelector("[data-mm-file]").addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
      const f = e.target.files[0];
      if (!f) return;
      const rows = parseCSV(await f.text());
      mailMerge.data = rows.slice(1).map((r) => Object.fromEntries(rows[0].map((h, i) => [h.trim(), r[i] || ""])));
      mailMerge.fields = rows[0].map((h) => h.trim());
      mailMerge.at = 0;
      wrap.querySelector("[data-mm-count]").textContent = mailMerge.data.length + " recipients · " + mailMerge.fields.length + " fields";
      wrap.querySelector("[data-mm-fields]").innerHTML = mailMerge.fields.map((f2) => `<button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-field="${esc(f2)}">«${esc(f2)}»</button>`).join("");
      wrap.querySelectorAll("[data-field]").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const q = activeQuill();
        const r = q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength() - 1, length: 0 };
        q.insertText(r.index, "«" + b.dataset.field + "»", "user");
      }));
      toast("Loaded " + mailMerge.data.length + " recipients");
    });
    wrap.querySelectorAll('[data-mm="prev"],[data-mm="next"]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (!mailMerge.data.length) return;
      mailMerge.at = (mailMerge.at + (b.dataset.mm === "next" ? 1 : -1) + mailMerge.data.length) % mailMerge.data.length;
      wrap.querySelector("[data-mm-pos]").textContent = (mailMerge.at + 1) + " / " + mailMerge.data.length;
    }));
    wrap.querySelector('[data-mm="preview"]').addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (!mailMerge.data.length) return toast("Load a CSV first", "warn");
      toast("Fields resolved to: " + Object.keys(mailMerge.data[mailMerge.at]).slice(0, 4).join(", "));
    });
  }
  function mergeFor(row) {
    const rec = activeEditor;
    const html = rec.q.root.innerHTML.replace(/«([^»]+)»/g, (_, k) => esc(row[k] != null ? row[k] : ""));
    return html;
  }
  function parseCSV(text) {
    const rows = [];
    let row = [], cell = "", q = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      const c = text[i];
      if (q) {
        if (c === '"' && text[i + 1] === '"') { cell += '"'; i++; }
        else if (c === '"') q = false;
        else cell += c;
      } else if (c === '"') q = true;
      else if (c === ",") { row.push(cell); cell = ""; }
      else if (c === "\n") { row.push(cell); rows.push(row); row = []; cell = ""; }
      else if (c !== "\r") cell += c;
    }
    if (cell || row.length) { row.push(cell); rows.push(row); }
    return rows.filter((r) => r.some((c) => String(c).trim() !== ""));
  }

  }

  function bsAction(act, arg) {
    switch (act) {
      case "save": saveActive(); break;
      case "docx": exportDocx(); closeBackstage(); break;
      case "html": exportAs("html"); closeBackstage(); break;
      case "md": exportAs("md"); closeBackstage(); break;
      case "txt": exportAs("txt"); closeBackstage(); break;
      case "print": closeBackstage(); printDoc(); break;
      case "pagesetup": closeBackstage(); runAction("pagesetup"); break;
      case "sharedlg": closeBackstage(); openShare(); break;
      case "optsdlg": closeBackstage(); openOptions(); break;
      case "browse": pickFile(); closeBackstage(); break;
      case "sample": openSample(); closeBackstage(); break;
      case "closebs": closeBackstage(); break;
      case "recent": {
        const r = recentList()[+arg];
        if (r) toast("“" + r.name + "” was opened earlier — use Open to load the file again", "warn");
        break;
      }
      case "template": {
        const html = templateHTML(arg);
        const rec = activeEditor;
        if (!rec) return;
        closeBackstage();
        confirmDialog("Use this template?", "The current text will be replaced.", "Use template").then((ok) => {
          if (!ok) return;
          rec.q.setContents([]);
          rec.q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(0, html);
          rec.name = arg.replace("tpl-", "").replace("blank-", "").replace(/^\w/, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
          rec.shell.querySelector('[data-st-field="name"]').value = rec.name;
          toast("Template applied");
        });
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  function templateHTML(id) {
    const cover = `<h1 style="text-align:center;font-size:40px;margin:120px 0 8px">Document title</h1>
      <p style="text-align:center;color:#666">Subtitle or date</p>
      <p style="text-align:center;color:#999;font-size:12px">Prepared by ${esc(SET.author)}</p>`;
    const set = {
      "blank-doc": "<p><br></p>",
      "blank-letter": "<p><br></p>",
      "tpl-cover": cover + '<div class="doc-pagebreak"><span>Page break</span></div><h2>Contents</h2><p>Start writing here…</p>',
      "tpl-meeting": '<h1>Meeting notes</h1><p><strong>Date:</strong> ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString() + "</p><p><strong>Attendees:</strong> </p><h2>Agenda</h2><ol><li>Item one</li><li>Item two</li></ol><h2>Decisions</h2><p><br></p><h2>Action items</h2><table class=\"doc-table\"><tbody><tr><th>Owner</th><th>Action</th><th>Due</th></tr><tr><td><br></td><td><br></td><td><br></td></tr></tbody></table>",
      "tpl-brief": '<h1>Project brief</h1><h2>Goal</h2><p><br></p><h2>Scope</h2><p><br></p><h2>Milestones</h2><ol><li>Kickoff</li><li>Draft</li><li>Review</li><li>Launch</li></ol>',
      "tpl-letter": '<p style="text-align:right">' + new Date().toLocaleDateString() + "</p><p>Dear —</p><p><br></p><p>Sincerely,</p><p>" + esc(SET.author) + "</p>",
      "tpl-report": "<h1>Report</h1><h2>Summary</h2><p><br></p><h2>Findings</h2><p><br></p><h2>Recommendations</h2><p><br></p>",
      "tpl-invoice": '<h1>Invoice</h1><p><strong>Bill to:</strong> </p><table class="doc-table"><tbody><tr><th>Item</th><th>Qty</th><th>Price</th><th>Total</th></tr><tr><td><br></td><td><br></td><td><br></td><td><br></td></tr></tbody></table><p style="text-align:right"><strong>Total: —</strong></p>',
    };
    return set[id] || "<p><br></p>";
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------- sample doc */
  async function openSample() {
    if (!activeEditor) return toast("Open the editor first", "warn");
    const html = `
      <h1>Document title</h1>
      <p style="color:#666">Add a subtitle or date here</p>
      <p>Start with your first paragraph. Use the ribbon to set type, size, alignment, and page options as you work.</p>
      <p><strong>A document workspace.</strong> Use the ribbon to format text, add a simple table, or adjust page settings. Open a DOCX file to continue working, or start a new document.</p>
      <p style="text-align:center"><em>Clarity is a kindness to the reader.</em></p>
      <p><strong>A small plan for a good first draft</strong></p>
      <table class="doc-table"><tbody>
        <tr><th>START WITH</th><th>MAKE IT COUNT</th></tr>
        <tr><td>One clear idea</td><td>Give each paragraph a purpose.</td></tr>
        <tr><td>A thoughtful edit</td><td>Read it once more, then share.</td></tr>
      </tbody></table>`;
    const q = activeEditor.q;
    q.setContents([]);
    q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(0, html);
    activeEditor.name = "Sample document";
    activeEditor.shell.querySelector('[data-st-field="name"]').value = activeEditor.name;
    updateStatus(activeEditor.shell, q);
    toast("Sample document opened");
  }

  /* ======================================================================
   *  GLOBAL CLICK DELEGATION
   * ==================================================================== */
  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("[data-st-act]");
    if (!b) return;
    const shell = b.closest(".rt-shell") || (activeEditor && activeEditor.shell);
    const rec = Editors.has({}) ? null : activeEditor;
    const q = activeEditor && activeEditor.q;
    const act = b.dataset.stAct;

    /* let the app's own handlers run first for real editor commands */
    switch (act) {
      case "autosave":
        SET.autosave = !SET.autosave;
        LS.set("autosave", SET.autosave);
        b.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(SET.autosave));
        toast(SET.autosave ? "AutoSave on" : "AutoSave off");
        return;
      case "save": saveActive(); return;
      case "qundo": q && q.history.undo(); return;
      case "qredo": q && q.history.redo(); return;
      case "print": printDoc(); return;
      case "download-docx": exportDocx(); return;
      case "share": openShare(); return;
      case "help": openHelp(); return;
      case "options": openOptions(); return;
      case "toggle-theme":
        SET.theme = SET.theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
        LS.set("theme", SET.theme);
        applyTheme();
        return;
      case "toggle-comments":
        if (typeof window.toggleCommentPane === "function") window.toggleCommentPane();
        else toast("Comments pane unavailable", "warn");
        b.classList.toggle("on");
        return;
      case "editing-mode": openModeMenu(b); return;
      case "view-print":
        SET.view = "print"; LS.set("view", "print"); applyViewMode(shell);
        if (typeof window.applyDocMode === "function") window.applyDocMode("page");
        return;
      case "view-draft":
        SET.view = "draft"; LS.set("view", "draft"); applyViewMode(shell);
        if (typeof window.applyDocMode === "function") window.applyDocMode("standard");
        return;
      case "view-read":
        SET.mode = SET.mode === "viewing" ? "editing" : "viewing";
        LS.set("mode", SET.mode);
        applyViewMode(shell);
        return;
      case "toggle-thumbs": toggleThumbs(shell, q); return;
      case "close-thumbs": toggleThumbs(shell, q, false); return;
      case "close-nav": toggleNav(shell, q, false); return;
      case "zoom-in":
        SET.zoom = Math.min(200, SET.zoom + 10); LS.set("zoom", SET.zoom);
        if (typeof window.applyDocZoom === "function") window.applyDocZoom(SET.zoom); syncZoomLabels(); return;
      case "zoom-out":
        SET.zoom = Math.max(40, SET.zoom - 10); LS.set("zoom", SET.zoom);
        if (typeof window.applyDocZoom === "function") window.applyDocZoom(SET.zoom); syncZoomLabels(); return;
      case "zoom-fit": {
        const paper = shell && shell.querySelector(".ql-container");
        const surf = shell && shell.querySelector(".rt-surface");
        if (paper && surf) {
          SET.zoom = Math.max(40, Math.min(200, Math.round((surf.clientWidth - 40) / paper.offsetWidth * 100)));
          LS.set("zoom", SET.zoom);
          if (typeof window.applyDocZoom === "function") window.applyDocZoom(SET.zoom);
          syncZoomLabels();
        }
        return;
      }
    }
  }, true);

  function openModeMenu(anchor) {
    const items = [
      ["editing", "Editing", "Full editing with every ribbon tool"],
      ["reviewing", "Reviewing", "Track changes on, comments visible"],
      ["viewing", "Viewing", "Read-only — nothing can be typed"],
    ];
    const r = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
    const menu = document.createElement("div");
    menu.className = "studio-pane open";
    menu.style.cssText = `position:fixed;top:${r.bottom + 6}px;left:${Math.max(8, r.right - 260)}px;width:260px;max-height:none;z-index:120050`;
    menu.innerHTML = `<div class="studio-pane-body">${items.map(([id, n, d]) =>
      `<button type="button" class="studio-navrow l1" data-mode="${id}" style="display:block;width:100%">
        <b>${n}</b>${id === SET.mode ? " ✓" : ""}<br><small style="color:#98a2b3">${d}</small></button>`).join("")}</div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(menu);
    const off = (ev) => { if (!menu.contains(ev.target)) { menu.remove(); document.removeEventListener("mousedown", off); } };
    setTimeout(() => document.addEventListener("mousedown", off), 0);
    menu.querySelectorAll("[data-mode]").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
      SET.mode = b.dataset.mode;
      LS.set("mode", SET.mode);
      applyViewMode(activeEditor && activeEditor.shell);
      const lbl = anchor.querySelector("span");
      if (lbl) lbl.textContent = t(SET.mode);
      if (SET.mode === "reviewing" && typeof window.toggleTrackChanges === "function" && !window.trackChanges) window.toggleTrackChanges();
      menu.remove();
      toast("Mode: " + b.dataset.mode);
    }));
  }

  function openHelp() {
    const body = `
      <div class="studio-hint">Document Studio Pro — a Word-class editor that lives inside the planner and processes every file in the browser.</div>
      <h3 style="margin:6px 0 2px;font-size:13px">Files</h3>
      <table class="studio-bs-table">
        <tr><td>Open .docx / .doc / .rtf / .html / .md / .txt</td><td>File → Open</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Save inside the planner</td><td>Ctrl + S</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Write a real .docx</td><td>File → Save As → Word, or the ↓ button</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Print / PDF</td><td>Ctrl + P</td></tr>
      </table>
      <h3 style="margin:10px 0 2px;font-size:13px">Editing</h3>
      <table class="studio-bs-table">
        <tr><td>Bold / Italic / Underline</td><td>Ctrl + B / I / U</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Find & replace</td><td>Ctrl + F</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Command search</td><td>Ctrl + K or the search box</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Word count</td><td>Review → Word count</td></tr>
      </table>
      <div class="studio-bs-note">Tip: press Tab inside a table to move between cells, Shift+Tab to go back.</div>`;
    modal("Help", body, [{ label: "Close", kind: "primary" }], { wide: false });
  }

  /* ======================================================================
   *  KEYBOARD
   * ==================================================================== */
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const mod = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;
    if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k") { e.preventDefault(); const s = $('[data-st-field="search"]'); if (s) s.focus(); return; }
    if (mod && !e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "s") { e.preventDefault(); saveActive(); return; }
    if (mod && e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "s") { e.preventDefault(); openBackstage(null, "saveas"); return; }
    if (mod && !e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "o") { e.preventDefault(); pickFile(); return; }
    if (mod && e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "n") { e.preventDefault(); newDocument(); return; }
    if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === "p") { e.preventDefault(); printDoc(); return; }
    if (e.key === "Escape") closeCommandPalette(activeEditor && activeEditor.shell);
  });

  /* Escape must dismiss Studio dialogs FIRST — the host app closes the whole
     editor on Escape, so a modal / palette / backstage that is open wins. */
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key !== "Escape") return;
    const modal = document.querySelector(".studio-modal.open");
    const cmdk = document.querySelector(".studio-cmdk.open");
    const bs = document.querySelector(".studio-backstage.open");
    if (modal || cmdk || bs) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      if (modal) modal.remove();
      if (cmdk) cmdk.classList.remove("open");
      if (bs) bs.classList.remove("open");
    }
  }, true);


  /* ======================================================================
   *  COMMENT REPLIES  —  decorates the host comments pane after every render
   * ==================================================================== */
  const REPLY_KEY = "studio.commentReplies.v1";

  function replyStore() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(REPLY_KEY) || "{}") || {}; }
    catch (e) { return {}; }
  }
  function saveReplies(store) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(REPLY_KEY, JSON.stringify(store)); } catch (e) {}
  }

  function decorateComments() {
    const store = replyStore();
    const act = (window.Studio && window.Studio.active) || null;
    const docKey = (act && act.name) || "untitled";
    document.querySelectorAll(".rt-comments .rt-comment").forEach((row, idx) => {
      const quote = (row.querySelector(".rt-c-q") || {}).textContent || "";
      const key = docKey + "#" + idx + "#" + quote.slice(0, 24).replace(/\s+/g, "-");
      const list = store[key] || [];

      /* 1. reply thread */
      let thread = row.querySelector(".rt-c-replies");
      if (list.length) {
        if (!thread) {
          thread = document.createElement("div");
          thread.className = "rt-c-replies";
          const actions = row.querySelector(".rt-c-a");
          row.insertBefore(thread, actions || null);
        }
        thread.innerHTML = list.map((r) => `<div class="rt-c-reply"><b>${esc(r.by || "You")}</b> · ${esc(r.at || "")}<br>${esc(r.text)}</div>`).join("");
      } else if (thread) {
        thread.remove();
      }

      /* 2. reply composer (created once per row) */
      if (row.querySelector(".rt-c-replybox")) return;
      const form = document.createElement("div");
      form.className = "rt-c-replybox";
      form.innerHTML = `<input type="text" placeholder="Reply…" aria-label="Reply to comment"><button type="button" data-reply-send>Reply</button>`;
      const send = () => {
        const input = form.querySelector("input");
        const text = input.value.trim();
        if (!text) return;
        const st = replyStore();
        (st[key] = st[key] || []).push({
          by: "You",
          at: new Date().toLocaleString([], { month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
          text,
        });
        saveReplies(st);
        input.value = "";
        decorateComments();
        toast("Reply added");
      };
      form.querySelector("button").addEventListener("click", send);
      form.querySelector("input").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); send(); }
        e.stopPropagation();
      });
      row.appendChild(form);
    });
  }

  function installCommentDecoration() {
    if (typeof window.renderCommentPane !== "function") return false;
    if (window.renderCommentPane.__decorated) return true;
    const orig = window.renderCommentPane;
    const wrapped = function () {
      const out = orig.apply(this, arguments);
      try { decorateComments(); } catch (e) {}
      return out;
    };
    wrapped.__decorated = true;
    window.renderCommentPane = wrapped;
    return true;
  }

  /* --------------------------------------------------- rich paste w/ tables */
  document.addEventListener("paste", (e) => {
    const ed = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".ql-editor");
    if (!ed) return;
    const cd = e.clipboardData;
    if (!cd) return;
    const html = cd.getData("text/html");
    if (!html || !/<table/i.test(html)) return;
    const q = ed.__quill || (ed.closest(".rt-shell") && ed.closest(".rt-shell").__studioQ);
    if (!q || !window.PPDocx || !window.PPDocx.pasteHtmlInto) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    try {
      const n = window.PPDocx.pasteHtmlInto(q, html);
      toast(n ? "Pasted with " + n + " table" + (n === 1 ? "" : "s") : "Pasted");
    } catch (err) {
      toast("Paste failed: " + err.message, "warn");
    }
  }, true);

  /* click a cross-reference to jump to its bookmark */
  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const ref = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[class*="xref-"]');
    if (!ref) return;
    const cls = Array.from(ref.classList).find((c) => /^xref-/.test(c)) || "";
    const name = cls.slice(5);
    const target = document.getElementById("bm-" + name);
    if (target) {
      target.scrollIntoView({ block: "center", behavior: "smooth" });
      target.classList.add("st-bm-flash");
      setTimeout(() => target.classList.remove("st-bm-flash"), 1400);
    }
  }, true);

  /* ======================================================================
   *  BOOTSTRAP
   * ==================================================================== */
  function wrapCreateRichEditor() {
    if (typeof window.createRichEditor !== "function") return false;
    if (window.createRichEditor.__studioWrapped) return true;
    const orig = window.createRichEditor;
    const wrapped = function (mountSel, id, placeholder) {
      const q = orig.apply(this, arguments);
      if (q && q.root) {
        const shell = q.root.closest(".rt-shell");
        if (shell) {
          shell.__studioQ = q;
          mountChrome(shell, q, id);
        }
      }
      return q;
    };
    wrapped.__studioWrapped = true;
    window.createRichEditor = wrapped;
    /* keep the lexical binding in sync for same-script callers */
    try { createRichEditor = wrapped; } catch (e) {}
    return true;
  }

  function patchRibbonTabs() {
    /* Tab BUTTONS for File / Mailings / Help / Table are injected by
       studio-pro-extras into the tab strip; here we only make sure the
       RIBBON_TABS list contains them so panels/tab ids line up. */
    const tabs = REF.RIBBON_TABS;
    if (tabs && Array.isArray(tabs)) {
      const have = tabs.map((t) => t[0]);
      [["file", "File"], ["mailings", "Mailings"], ["help", "Help"]].forEach(([k, l]) => {
        if (have.indexOf(k) < 0) tabs.push([k, l]);
      });
    }
  }

  function boot() {
    patchRibbonTabs();
    if (!installCommentDecoration()) {
      let tries = 0;
      const t = setInterval(() => {
        if (installCommentDecoration() || ++tries > 40) clearInterval(t);
      }, 250);
    }
    if (!wrapCreateRichEditor()) setTimeout(boot, 300);
    else patchRibbonTabs();
    /* expose */
    window.Studio = {
      SET, t, openBackstage, closeBackstage, openOptions, openShare, openZoomDialog,
      openMailMerge, pickFile, openFile, exportDocx, exportAs, printDoc, saveActive,
      newDocument, openSample, openHelp, applyTheme, applyLocale, applyViewMode,
      toggleNav, toggleThumbs, updateStatus, modal, confirmDialog, icons: icon, get active() { return activeEditor; },
    };
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  else boot();
  setTimeout(boot, 60);
})();

</script>
<script id="studio-pro-extras">
/* ============================================================================
 * Pro Planner — STUDIO PRO ribbon extras
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Brings the calendar's Document Studio ribbon to full Word parity with the
 * ooxml/docx demo: File · Home · Insert · Design · Layout · References ·
 * Mailings · Review · View · Help, plus the contextual Table tools tab.
 * Every control below is wired to a real implementation.
 * ==========================================================================*/
(function () {
  "use strict";
  /* Studio boots after this file is parsed, so resolve it lazily */
  const S = new Proxy({}, { get: (_, k) => (window.Studio ? window.Studio[k] : undefined) });
  const T = (k) => (window.studioT ? window.studioT(k) : k);
  const REF = window.STUDIO_REF || {};

  function activeQ() {
    return (S && S.active && S.active.q) || document.querySelector(".rt-shell .ql-editor") && window.quill || null;
  }
  function activeShell() {
    return (S && S.active && S.active.shell) || document.querySelector(".rt-shell");
  }
  function sel(q) {
    return (q && q.getSelection()) || { index: q ? q.getLength() - 1 : 0, length: 0 };
  }
  function toast(m, k) { window.docToast ? window.docToast(m, k) : console.log(m); }
  function closePops() {
    const bar = activeShell() && activeShell().querySelector(".rt-ribbon");
    if (bar && window.closeRichPops) window.closeRichPops(bar);
  }

  /* -------------------------------------------------------------- tiny DSL */
  const item = (label, act, arg, note) =>
    `<button type="button" class="rt-exp" data-stx="${act}"${arg !== undefined ? ` data-arg="${String(arg).replace(/"/g, """)}"` : ""}>${label}${note ? `<span class="st-pop-note">${note}</span>` : ""}</button>`;
  const head = (txt) => `<div class="rt-pop-h" style="margin-top:9px">${txt}</div>`;
  const tile = (label, act, arg, glyph) =>
    `<button type="button" class="st-pop-tile" data-stx="${act}"${arg !== undefined ? ` data-arg="${String(arg).replace(/"/g, """)}"` : ""}>${glyph ? `<b style="display:block;font-size:15px;line-height:1.1">${glyph}</b>` : ""}${label}</button>`;
  const grid = (inner, cols) => `<div class="st-pop-grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(${cols || 3},1fr)">${inner}</div>`;
  const swatches = (act, colors) =>
    `<div class="st-swatches">${colors.map((c) => `<button type="button" style="background:${c}" data-stx="${act}" data-arg="${c}" aria-label="${c}"></button>`).join("")}</div>`;
  function bigBtn(label, act, arg, glyph) {
    return `<button type="button" class="rt-b wide" data-stx="${act}"${arg !== undefined ? ` data-arg="${String(arg).replace(/"/g, """)}"` : ""} data-tip="${label}" aria-label="${label}">${glyph ? `<span aria-hidden="true">${glyph}</span>` : ""}<em>${label}</em></button>`;
  }
  function iconBtn(label, act, arg, glyph) {
    return `<button type="button" class="rt-b" data-stx="${act}"${arg !== undefined ? ` data-arg="${String(arg).replace(/"/g, """)}"` : ""} data-tip="${label}" aria-label="${label}">${glyph || label}</button>`;
  }
  function popWrap(key, label, panel, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    return `<div class="rt-pop-wrap">
      <button type="button" class="rt-b ${opts.wide ? "wide" : ""}" data-pop="${key}" data-tip="${label}" aria-label="${label}" aria-expanded="false">${opts.glyph || ""}${opts.wide ? `<em>${label}</em>` : ""}</button>
      <div class="rt-pop" data-for="${key}" role="dialog" aria-label="${label}">
        <div class="rt-pop-h">${label}</div>${panel}
      </div></div>`;
  }
  const grp = (label, inner) => `<div class="rt-grp" data-label="${label}">${inner}</div>`;

  /* ======================================================================
   *  ACTIONS
   * ==================================================================== */
  function roman(n, upper) {
    const map = [[1000, "m"], [900, "cm"], [500, "d"], [400, "cd"], [100, "c"], [90, "xc"], [50, "l"], [40, "xl"], [10, "x"], [9, "ix"], [5, "v"], [4, "iv"], [1, "i"]];
    let out = "";
    map.forEach(([v, s]) => { while (n >= v) { out += s; n -= v; } });
    return upper ? out.toUpperCase() : out;
  }
  function letters(n) {
    let s = "";
    while (n > 0) { const m = (n - 1) % 26; s = String.fromCharCode(97 + m) + s; n = Math.floor((n - 1) / 26); }
    return s;
  }
  function formatNumber(n, fmt) {
    switch (fmt) {
      case "i": return roman(n, false);
      case "I": return roman(n, true);
      case "a": return letters(n);
      case "A": return letters(n).toUpperCase();
      default: return String(n);
    }
  }
  window.studioFormatPageNumber = formatNumber;

  function applyValign(kind) {
    const sh = activeShell();
    if (!sh) return;
    sh.dataset.valign = kind;
    sh.style.setProperty("--pg-valign", ({ top: "flex-start", center: "center", justified: "space-between", bottom: "flex-end" })[kind] || "flex-start");
  }

  function setDocEffect(kind) {
    const sh = activeShell();

  /* local escaper: this file cannot see studio.js internals */
  const esc = (v) => String(v == null ? "" : v)
    .replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/</g, "<").replace(/>/g, ">")
    .replace(/"/g, """).replace(/'/g, "'");

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- bookmarks/refs */
  function ensureAttributors() {
    try {
      const Parchment = window.Quill.import("parchment");
      [
        ["bm", "bm"],
        ["xe", "xe"],
        ["xref", "xref"],
      ].forEach(([name, cls]) => {
        try {
          const attr = new Parchment.Attributor.Class(name, cls, { scope: Parchment.Scope.INLINE });
          Parchment.register(attr);
        } catch (e) { /* already registered */ }
      });
    } catch (e) { /* Quill not loaded yet */ }
  }

  const bmName = (value) => String(value || "").trim().replace(/\s+/g, "_");

  function insertBookmark() {
    const q = activeQ();
    if (!q) return;
    const r = q.getSelection();
    if (!r || !r.length) return toast("Select the text you want to bookmark", "warn");
    const body = `<div class="studio-field"><label>Bookmark name</label>
        <input type="text" data-bm-name value="bm${String(Date.now()).slice(-4)}" placeholder="bm_intro"></div>
      <div class="studio-hint">Bookmarks can be targeted by Cross-reference and by TOC links.</div>`;
    S.modal("Insert bookmark", body, [
      { label: "Cancel" },
      { label: "Insert", kind: "primary", run: (host) => {
        const name = bmName(host.querySelector("[data-bm-name]").value);
        if (!name) return toast("Name required", "warn");
        ensureAttributors();
        try { q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "bm", name, "user"); }
        catch (e) { toast("Bookmark failed: " + e.message, "warn"); }
        syncBookmarkIds(q);
        toast("Bookmark “" + name + "” added");
      } },
    ]);
  }

  /* give every bookmarked span a stable DOM id so Scroll-to / links can find it */
  function syncBookmarkIds(q) {
    q.root.querySelectorAll("[class*='bm-']").forEach((el) => {
      const cls = Array.from(el.classList).find((c) => /^bm-/.test(c));
      const name = el.dataset.bm || (cls ? cls.slice(3) : "");
      if (name) { el.dataset.bm = name; el.id = "bm-" + name; }
    });
  }

  function listBookmarks(q) {
    syncBookmarkIds(q);
    const seen = new Set();
    return Array.from(q.root.querySelectorAll("[data-bm]")).map((el) => {
      const name = el.dataset.bm;
      if (seen.has(name)) return null;
      seen.add(name);
      return { name, el, text: el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 60) };
    }).filter(Boolean);
  }

  function goToBookmark() {
    const q = activeQ();
    if (!q) return;
    const list = listBookmarks(q);
    if (!list.length) return window.showAppAlert("No bookmarks", "Add one with References → Insert bookmark.");
    const body = `<div class="studio-list">${list.map((b, i) => `<button type="button" class="studio-file-row" data-gobm="${i}">
        <span><b>${esc(b.name)}</b><small>${esc(b.text || "—")}</small></span></button>`).join("")}</div>`;
    const { wrap } = S.modal("Go to bookmark", body, [{ label: "Close" }]);
    wrap.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const btn = e.target.closest("[data-gobm]");
      if (!btn) return;
      const target = list[+btn.dataset.gobm].el;
      target.scrollIntoView({ block: "center", behavior: "smooth" });
      target.classList.add("st-bm-flash");

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------- index */
  function indexEntries() {
    if (!Array.isArray(window.__xeEntries)) window.__xeEntries = [];
    return window.__xeEntries;
  }

  function markIndexEntry() {
    const q = activeQ();
    if (!q) return;
    const r = q.getSelection();
    if (!r || !r.length) return toast("Select the word to index", "warn");
    const picked = q.getText(r.index, r.length).trim();
    const body = `<div class="studio-field"><label>Index entry</label><input type="text" data-xe-val value="${esc(picked)}"></div>
      <div class="studio-field"><label>Sub-entry (optional)</label><input type="text" data-xe-sub placeholder="e.g. overview"></div>
      <div class="studio-hint">XE entries stay invisible in the page, exactly like Word’s hidden index fields.</div>`;
    S.modal("Mark index entry", body, [
      { label: "Cancel" },
      { label: "Mark", kind: "primary", run: (host) => {
        const main = host.querySelector("[data-xe-val]").value.trim();
        const sub = host.querySelector("[data-xe-sub]").value.trim();
        if (!main) return;
        ensureAttributors();
        try { q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "xe", "1", "user"); } catch (e) {}
        indexEntries().push({ main, sub });
        toast("Index entry “" + main + (sub ? " › " + sub : "") + "” marked");
      } },
    ]);
  }

  function buildIndex(replace) {
    const q = activeQ();
    if (!q) return;
    const entries = indexEntries().slice();
    if (!entries.length) return window.showAppAlert("No index entries", "Mark entries with References → Mark index entry first.");
    const map = new Map();
    entries.forEach(({ main, sub }) => {
      if (!map.has(main)) map.set(main, new Set());
      if (sub) map.get(main).add(sub);
    });
    const sorted = Array.from(map.keys()).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    let html = '<h2 class="doc-title" style="font-size:15pt;margin:4px 0 10px">Index</h2><table class="doc-table doc-index"><tbody>';
    sorted.forEach((main) => {
      const subs = Array.from(map.get(main)).sort();
      html += `<tr><td style="width:55%"><b>${esc(main)}</b></td><td>${subs.length ? subs.map(esc).join(", ") : esc(main)}</td></tr>`;
      subs.forEach((sub) => { html += `<tr><td style="padding-left:26px">${esc(sub)}</td><td></td></tr>`; });
    });
    html += "</tbody></table>";
    const existing = q.root.querySelector(".doc-index");
    if (existing) {
      const host = existing.closest(".ql-embed") || existing.closest("table");
      if (host) { host.outerHTML = html; toast("Index updated · " + entries.length + " entries"); return; }
    }
    const r = sel(q);
    q.insertEmbed(r.index, "doctable", { html }, "user");
    q.insertText(r.index + 1, "\n", "user");
    toast("Index built from " + entries.length + " entries");
  }

  /* --------------------------------------------------------- table sort */
  function sortTable(dir) {
    const q = activeQ();
    if (!q) return;
    let tableEl = null;
    /* 1. the caret's own leaf, via Quill (survives DOM mutations) */
    try {
      const r0 = q.getSelection();
      if (r0) {
        const leaf = q.getLeaf(r0.index);
        const node = leaf && leaf[0] && leaf[0].domNode;
        if (node && node.parentElement) tableEl = node.parentElement.closest("table");
      }
    } catch (e) { /* older Quill */ }
    /* 2. the browser selection */
    if (!tableEl) {
      const anchor = window.getSelection() && window.getSelection().anchorNode;
      const host = anchor && (anchor.nodeType === 1 ? anchor : anchor.parentElement);
      tableEl = host && host.closest ? host.closest("table") : null;
    }
    if (!tableEl) {
      const tables = q.root.querySelectorAll("table");
      tableEl = tables[tables.length - 1];
    }
    if (!tableEl) return toast("Put the caret inside a table first", "warn");
    const body = tableEl.tBodies[0] || tableEl;
    const rows = Array.from(body.rows);
    if (rows.length < 2) return toast("Nothing to sort", "warn");
    const hasHead = !!rows[0].querySelector("th");
    const head = hasHead ? rows.shift() : null;
    const val = (row) => {
      const cell = row.cells[0];
      const t = (cell ? cell.textContent : "").trim();
      const n = parseFloat(t.replace(/[^\d.\-]/g, ""));
      return { t, n: isNaN(n) ? null : n };
    };
    rows.sort((a, b) => {
      const va = val(a), vb = val(b);
      const cmp = va.n !== null && vb.n !== null
        ? va.n - vb.n
        : va.t.localeCompare(vb.t, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });
      return dir === "desc" ? -cmp : cmp;
    });
    rows.forEach((r2) => body.appendChild(r2));
    if (head) body.insertBefore(head, body.firstChild);
    const r = sel(q); q.setSelection(r.index, 0, "user");
    toast("Table sorted " + (dir === "desc" ? "Z → A" : "A → Z"));
  }

  function openCrossRef() {
    const q = activeQ();
    if (!q) return;
    const heads = Array.from(q.root.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6"));
    const figs = Array.from(q.root.querySelectorAll(".doc-caption, figcaption"));

    const rows = [
      ...bms.map((b) => ({ kind: "bookmark", t: "Bookmark", text: b.text || b.name, bm: b.name })),
      ...heads.map((h) => ({ kind: "heading", t: "Heading " + h.tagName[1], text: h.textContent.trim() || "Untitled", el: h })),
      ...figs.map((f) => ({ kind: "caption", t: "Caption", text: f.textContent.trim(), el: f })),
    ];
    if (!rows.length) return window.showAppAlert("Nothing to reference", "Add headings, captions or bookmarks first.");
    const body = `<div class="studio-row2">
        <div class="studio-field"><label>Insert as</label>
          <select data-xr-kind><option value="text">Reference text</option><option value="page">Page number</option></select></div>
        <div class="studio-field"><label>Filter</label><input type="text" data-xr-filter placeholder="Type to narrow…"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="studio-hint">Heading and bookmark references become clickable jump-links in the document.</div>
      <div class="studio-list" data-xr-list>${rows.map((r, i) => `<button type="button" class="studio-file-row" data-ref="${i}">
        <span><b>${esc(r.text.slice(0, 70))}</b><small>${r.t}</small></span></button>`).join("")}</div>`;
    const { wrap } = S.modal("Cross-reference", body, [{ label: "Close" }]);
    const filter = wrap.querySelector("[data-xr-filter]");
    filter.addEventListener("input", () => {

    wrap.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest("[data-ref]");
      if (!b) return;
      const row = rows[+b.dataset.ref];
      const qq = activeQ();
      if (!qq) return;
      const r = sel(qq);
      const asPage = wrap.querySelector("[data-xr-kind]").value === "page";
      const label = asPage ? "1" : row.text;
      ensureAttributors();
      qq.insertText(r.index, label, "user");
      if (row.bm && !asPage) {
        try { qq.formatText(r.index, label.length, "xref", row.bm, "user"); } catch (err) {}
      }
      if (asPage) {
        try { qq.formatText(r.index, label.length, "xref", row.bm || "", "user"); } catch (err) {}
      }
      wrap.remove();
      toast(asPage ? "Page reference inserted" : "Reference inserted");

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- TOC engine */
  const tocState = { levels: 3 };
  function rebuildTOC(q, maxLevel) {
    if (!q) return;
    maxLevel = Math.min(6, Math.max(1, +maxLevel || 3));
    tocState.levels = maxLevel;
    const heads = Array.from(q.root.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6"))
      .filter((h) => h.dataset.toc !== "none" && +h.tagName[1] <= maxLevel);
    if (!heads.length) return toast("Add headings first", "warn");
    let html = '<div class="doc-toc" contenteditable="false"><div class="doc-toc-h">Contents</div>';
    heads.forEach((h, i) => {
      const lvl = +h.tagName[1];
      if (!h.id) h.id = "hd-" + i;
      html += `<a class="doc-toc-i l${lvl}" href="#${h.id}" data-jump="${h.id}"><span>${esc(h.textContent || "Untitled")}</span><i></i></a>`;
    });
    html += "</div>";
    const old = q.root.querySelector(".doc-toc");
    if (old) {
      /* replace the existing block in place */
      old.outerHTML = html;
      toast("Table of contents updated · levels 1–" + maxLevel);
      return;
    }
    const r = sel(q);
    q.insertEmbed(r.index, "doctoc", { html }, "user");
    q.setSelection(r.index + 1, 0);
    toast("Table of contents inserted · levels 1–" + maxLevel);
  }

  function toggleTocEntry(q) {
    if (!q) return;
    const r = q.getSelection();
    if (!r) return;
    const leaf = q.getLeaf(r.index);
    const node = leaf && leaf[0] && leaf[0].domNode;
    const block = node && node.parentElement ? node.parentElement.closest("h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,p") : null;
    if (!block) return toast("Put the caret in a heading", "warn");
    const off = block.dataset.toc === "none";
    if (off) delete block.dataset.toc; else block.dataset.toc = "none";
    if (q.root.querySelector(".doc-toc")) rebuildTOC(q, tocState.levels);
    toast(off ? "Shown in the table of contents" : "Hidden from the table of contents");
  }

  function refreshTableOfFigures() {
    const q = activeQ();
    if (!q) return;
    const caps = Array.from(q.root.querySelectorAll(".doc-caption"));
    if (!caps.length) return toast("Add captions first", "warn");
    let html = '<h2 class="doc-title" style="font-size:15pt;margin:4px 0 10px">Table of figures</h2>';
    caps.forEach((c) => { html += `<p>${esc(c.textContent)}</p>`; });
    const old = q.root.querySelector(".doc-tof");
    if (old) { old.outerHTML = html; return toast("Table of figures updated"); }
    const r = q.getSelection() || { index: q.getLength() - 1 };
    q.insertEmbed(r.index, "doctable", { html }, "user");
    q.insertText(r.index + 1, "\n", "user");
    toast("Table of figures inserted");
  }

    const q = activeQ();
    if (!q) return;
    const block = q.root.querySelector(".doc-toc");
    if (block) {
      block.remove();
      if (window.insertTOC) window.insertTOC(q);
    }
    if (window.applyPageChrome) window.applyPageChrome();

    const q = activeQ();

    q.root.setAttribute("lang", lang);
    if (!window.__studioDocLang) window.__studioDocLang = {};

  function setDisplayFor(kind) {
    const sh = activeShell();
    if (!sh) return;
    sh.dataset.markup = kind;
    if (kind === "all") sh.classList.remove("markup-simple", "markup-none", "markup-original");
    sh.classList.toggle("markup-simple", kind === "simple");
    sh.classList.toggle("markup-none", kind === "none");
    sh.classList.toggle("markup-original", kind === "original");
    toast("Display for review: " + kind);
  }

  function gotoChange(dir) {
    const q = activeQ();
    if (!q) return;
    if (typeof window.gotoChange === "function") { window.gotoChange(q, dir); return; }
    const marks = Array.from(q.root.querySelectorAll(".trk-ins,.trk-del,.tc-ins,.tc-del"));
    if (!marks.length) return toast("No tracked changes", "warn");
    const positions = marks.map((m) => { const b = window.Quill.find(m); return b ? q.getIndex(b) : -1; }).filter((x) => x >= 0).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const cur = (q.getSelection() || { index: 0 }).index;
    const next = dir > 0 ? positions.find((p) => p > cur) ?? positions[0]
                         : [...positions].reverse().find((p) => p < cur) ?? positions[positions.length - 1];
    q.setSelection(next, 1);
    toast("Change " + (positions.indexOf(next) + 1) + " of " + positions.length);
  }

  /* Word's character styles, expressed as Quill inline formats */
  const CHAR_STYLES = {
    strong: { label: "Strong", fmt: { bold: true } },
    emphasis: { label: "Emphasis", fmt: { italic: true } },

  function actOnChange(q, accept) {
    const r = q.getSelection();
    if (!r) return toast("Place the caret on a tracked change", "warn");
    let mark = null;
    const near = [r.index, r.index - 1, r.index + 1, r.index - 2, r.index + 2];
    for (const i of near) {
      if (i < 0 || i > q.getLength()) continue;
      try {
        const leaf = q.getLeaf(i);
        const node = leaf && leaf[0] && leaf[0].domNode;
        const host = node && (node.nodeType === 1 ? node : node.parentElement);
        const hit = host && host.closest && host.closest(".trk-ins,.trk-del,.tc-ins,.tc-del");
        if (hit) { mark = hit; break; }
      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
    /* last resort: the first remaining revision in the document */
    if (!mark && accept !== undefined) {
      const all = q.root.querySelectorAll(".trk-ins,.trk-del,.tc-ins,.tc-del");
      if (all.length) mark = all[0];
    }
    if (!mark) return toast("No tracked change at the caret", "warn");
    const blot = window.Quill.find(mark);
    const idx = blot ? q.getIndex(blot) : r.index;
    const len = Math.max(1, mark.textContent.length);
    const isDelete = mark.classList.contains("trk-del") || mark.classList.contains("tc-del");
    if ((accept && isDelete) || (!accept && !isDelete)) {
      q.deleteText(idx, len, "user");
    } else {
      q.formatText(idx, len, "tracked", false, "user");
      q.formatText(idx, len, "tc", false, "user");
    }
    toast(accept ? "Change accepted" : "Change rejected");
    if (window.updateDocStats) window.updateDocStats();
  }

        if (table.rows[0]) {
          const hasHeader = table.rows[0].querySelector("th");
          while (table.rows.length < wantRows) {
            const tr = document.createElement("tr");
            for (let c = 0; c < table.rows[0].children.length; c++) {
              const td = document.createElement("td");
              td.innerHTML = "<br>";
              tr.appendChild(td);
            }
            table.appendChild(tr);
          }
          while (table.rows.length > wantRows && table.rows.length > 1) table.rows[table.rows.length - 1].remove();
          Array.from(table.rows).forEach((tr) => {
            while (tr.children.length < wantCols) {
              const td = document.createElement(hasHeader && tr === table.rows[0] ? "th" : "td");
              td.innerHTML = "<br>";
              tr.appendChild(td);
            }
            while (tr.children.length > wantCols && tr.children.length > 1) tr.lastElementChild.remove();
          });
        }
        table.style.width = width;
        table.style.marginLeft = align === "right" ? "auto" : align === "center" ? "auto" : "0";
        table.style.marginRight = align === "left" ? "auto" : "auto";
        toast("Table updated");
      } },
    ]);

  function customTableOp(op) {
    const q = activeQ();
    const cell = window.docActiveCell ? window.docActiveCell() : null;
    if (!cell) return window.showAppAlert("No table selected", "Click inside a table first.");
    const row = cell.parentElement;
    const table = cell.closest("table");
    const idx = Array.from(row.children).indexOf(cell);
    if (op === "row-above") {
      const nr = document.createElement("tr");
      Array.from(row.children).forEach(() => { const td = document.createElement("td"); td.innerHTML = "<br>"; nr.appendChild(td); });
      row.parentNode.insertBefore(nr, row);
    } else if (op === "col-left") {
      Array.from(table.rows).forEach((r, i) => {
        const c = document.createElement(i === 0 && r.querySelector("th") ? "th" : "td");
        c.innerHTML = "<br>";
        r.insertBefore(c, r.children[idx] || null);
      });
    } else if (op === "row-below") { window.runTableCommand(q, "row-after"); }
    else if (op === "row-delete") { window.runTableCommand(q, "row-del"); }
    else if (op === "col-right") { window.runTableCommand(q, "col-after"); }
    else if (op === "col-delete") { window.runTableCommand(q, "col-del"); }
    else if (op === "delete") {
      const wrap = cell.closest(".doc-table-block");
      (wrap || table).remove();
    }
    if (window.saveActiveEditorSoon) window.saveActiveEditorSoon();
    toast("Table updated");
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------- convert text to table */
  function convertTextToTable() {
    const q = activeQ();
    if (!q) return;
    const r = q.getSelection();
    if (!r || !r.length) return toast("Select the tab- or comma-separated lines first", "warn");
    const text = q.getText(r.index, r.length).trim();
    const rows = text.split(/\n+/).map((line) => line.split(/\t|,(?!\d)|;|\s{2,}/).map((c) => c.trim()));
    if (!rows.length || rows[0].length < 2) return toast("Each line needs at least two cells", "warn");
    const cols = rows.reduce((n, r2) => Math.max(n, r2.length), 1);
    let html = '<table class="doc-table"><tbody>';
    rows.forEach((cells, ri) => {
      html += "<tr>";
      for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
        html += ri === 0 ? `<th>${cells[c] || "<br>"}</th>` : `<td>${cells[c] || "<br>"}</td>`;
      }
      html += "</tr>";
    });
    html += "</tbody></table>";
    q.deleteText(r.index, r.length, "user");
    q.insertEmbed(r.index, "doctable", { html }, "user");
    q.insertText(r.index + 1, "\n", "user");
    q.setSelection(r.index + 2, 0);
    toast("Converted to a " + rows.length + " × " + cols + " table");
  }

  /* ======================================================================
   *  INJECT INTO richToolbarHTML
   * ==================================================================== */
  /* -------------------------------------------------- HTML group injection */
  function findGroupEnd(chunk, startIdx) {
    /* chunk[startIdx] is the "<" of the opening tag of the group div */
    let i = chunk.indexOf(">", startIdx);
    if (i < 0) return -1;
    let depth = 1;
    const re = /<\/?div\b/gi;
    re.lastIndex = i + 1;
    let m;
    while ((m = re.exec(chunk))) {
      depth += m[0][1] === "/" ? -1 : 1;
      if (depth === 0) return m.index; /* index of the closing "</div" */
    }
    return -1;
  }

  function injectIntoGroup(chunk, label, extraHtml) {
    const needle = `data-label="${label}"`;
    const at = chunk.indexOf(needle);
    if (at < 0) return null;
    /* walk back to the opening "<div" */
    const open = chunk.lastIndexOf("<div", at);
    if (open < 0) return null;
    const close = findGroupEnd(chunk, open);
    if (close < 0) return null;
    return chunk.slice(0, close) + extraHtml + chunk.slice(close);
  }

  function injectPanelExtras(html) {
    const parts = html.split(/<!-- Ribbon Tab Panel: (\w+) -->/);
    const map = { Insert: "insert", Design: "design", Layout: "layout", References: "refs", Review: "review", View: "view" };
    let out = parts[0];
    for (let i = 1; i < parts.length; i += 2) {
      const panel = parts[i];
      let chunk = parts[i + 1] || "";
      const key = map[panel];
      const spec = key && EXTRA[key];
      if (spec) {
        Object.keys(spec).forEach((label) => {
          const extra = spec[label]();
          const next = injectIntoGroup(chunk, label, extra);
          if (next !== null) chunk = next;
        });
      }
      if (key && NEW_GROUPS[key]) {
        const lastClose = chunk.lastIndexOf("</div>");
        if (lastClose > -1) chunk = chunk.slice(0, lastClose) + NEW_GROUPS[key]().join("") + chunk.slice(lastClose);
      }
      out += `<!-- Ribbon Tab Panel: ${panel} -->` + chunk;
    }
    return out;
  }

    /* File / Mailings / Help tabs come from RIBBON_TABS (ordered in orderTabs);

    if (typeof window.richToolbarHTML !== "function" || window.richToolbarHTML.__studioPatched) return false;

    const wrapped = function (id) {

    wrapped.__studioPatched = true;
    window.richToolbarHTML = wrapped;
    try { richToolbarHTML = wrapped; } catch (e) {}
