          const n = formatNumber(((REF.pageNav || {}) && (REF.pageNav || {}).current) || 1, fmt);
          const total = ((REF.pageNav || {}) && (REF.pageNav || {}).count) || 1;
          const txt = (pc.footer ? pc.footer + "   -   " : "") + "Page " + n + " of " + formatNumber(total, fmt);
          sh.style.setProperty("--ftr", `"${txt}"`);
        });
      };
      wrapped.__studioWrapped = true;
      window.applyPageChrome = wrapped;
      try { applyPageChrome = wrapped; } catch (e) {}
    };
    wrapChrome();
    setTimeout(wrapChrome, 800);

    /* contextual Table tab: reveal when the caret is inside a table */
    const watchTables = () => {
      document.querySelectorAll(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
        if (sh.__studioTableWatch) return;
        sh.__studioTableWatch = true;
        const sync = () => {
          const ed = sh.querySelector(".ql-editor");
          const selObj = window.getSelection();
          let inTable = false;
          if (ed && selObj && selObj.anchorNode) {
            const n = selObj.anchorNode.nodeType === 1 ? selObj.anchorNode : selObj.anchorNode.parentElement;
            inTable = !!(n && n.closest && n.closest(".doc-table"));
          }
          sh.classList.toggle("in-table", inTable);
        };
        sh.addEventListener("selectionchange", sync);
        sh.addEventListener("keyup", sync);
        sh.addEventListener("mouseup", sync);
        sh.addEventListener("click", sync);
      });
    };
    setTimeout(watchTables, 1200);
    setInterval(watchTables, 2500);
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  else boot();
  setTimeout(boot, 80);
})();

</script>
<script id="studio-pro-more">
/* ============================================================================
 *  WORD MORE — a second feature layer for the document studio
 *  Adds Word-class dialogs, table tools, review utilities and ribbon widgets
 *  on top of studio.js / extras.js.  No external assets, no build step.
 * ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const LSKEY = "studio.wordmore.v1";
  const store = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LSKEY) || "{}") || {}; } catch (e) { return {}; } };
  const saveStore = (o) => { try { localStorage.setItem(LSKEY, JSON.stringify(o)); } catch (e) {} };

  const $ = (s, r) => (r || document).querySelector(s);
  const $$ = (s, r) => Array.from((r || document).querySelectorAll(s));
  const esc = (v) => String(v == null ? "" : v)
    .replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/</g, "<").replace(/>/g, ">")
    .replace(/"/g, """).replace(/'/g, "'");

  const toast = (m, k) => (window.docToast ? window.docToast(m, k) : console.log("[wm]", m));
  const rec = () => (window.Studio && window.Studio.active) || null;
  const Q = () => { const r = rec(); return r ? r.q : null; };
  const SHELL = () => { const r = rec(); return r ? r.shell : null; };
  const modal = (t, b, btns) => window.Studio.modal(t, b, btns);
  const sel = (q) => q.getSelection() || { index: Math.max(0, q.getLength() - 1), length: 0 };
  const A = window.STUDIO_X_ACT || (window.STUDIO_X_ACT = {});

  const field = (label, inner) => `<div class="studio-field"><label>${label}</label>${inner}</div>`;
  const row2 = (a, b) => `<div class="studio-row2">${a}${b}</div>`;
  const hint = (t) => `<div class="studio-hint">${t}</div>`;
  const check = (label, attr, on) => `<label class="studio-check"><input type="checkbox" ${attr}${on ? " checked" : ""}> ${label}</label>`;

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- formats */
  const INLINE = ["bold", "italic", "underline", "strike", "color", "background", "size", "font",
    "script", "ustyle", "ucolor", "deco", "uextra", "tracking", "textfx", "caps", "allcaps",
    "hiddetext", "hiddentext", "scalex", "vpos", "otf", "kern", "dstrike"];
  const BLOCK = ["align", "direction", "lineheight", "header", "blockquote", "code-block",
    "list", "shading", "pborder", "spbefore", "spafter", "numfmt", "bulletchar", "caption", "indent"];

  function clearInline(q, range) {
    INLINE.forEach((f) => { try { q.formatText(range.index, range.length, f, false, "user"); } catch (e) {} });
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ case change */
  function changeCase(mode) {
    const q = Q();
    if (!q) return;
    const r = q.getSelection();
    if (!r || !r.length) return toast("Select the text first", "warn");
    const text = q.getText(r.index, r.length);
    let out = text;
    if (mode === "upper") out = text.toUpperCase();
    else if (mode === "lower") out = text.toLowerCase();
    else if (mode === "sentence") {
      out = text.toLowerCase().replace(/(^\s*\w|[.!?]\s+\w)/g, (m) => m.toUpperCase());
    } else if (mode === "capitalize") {
      out = text.toLowerCase().replace(/\b\w/g, (m) => m.toUpperCase());
    } else if (mode === "toggle") {
      out = Array.from(text).map((ch) => (ch === ch.toUpperCase() ? ch.toLowerCase() : ch.toUpperCase())).join("");
    }
    const fmt = q.getFormat(r);
    q.deleteText(r.index, r.length, "user");
    q.insertText(r.index, out, fmt, "user");
    q.setSelection(r.index, out.length, "user");
    toast("Case changed");
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- sort paragraphs */
  function sortParagraphs(dir) {
    const q = Q();
    if (!q) return;
    const r = q.getSelection();
    if (!r || !r.length) return toast("Select the paragraphs to sort", "warn");
    const raw = q.getText(r.index, r.length);
    const parts = raw.split("\n").filter((s, i, a) => !(s === "" && (i === 0 || i === a.length - 1)));
    if (parts.length < 2) return toast("Nothing to sort", "warn");
    /* Word sorts text alphabetically; only pure-number paragraphs sort by value */
    const num = (s) => /^\s*[-+]?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?\s*$/.test(s);
    const numeric = parts.every(num);
    const key = (s) => s.replace(/^\s*(?:[-*•]|\d+[.)])\s+/, "").trim(); /* ignore list markers */
    parts.sort((a, b) => {
      const cmp = numeric ? parseFloat(a.replace(",", ".")) - parseFloat(b.replace(",", "."))
        : key(a).localeCompare(key(b), undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });
      return dir === "desc" ? -cmp : cmp;
    });
    q.deleteText(r.index, r.length, "user");
    q.insertText(r.index, parts.join("\n"), "user");
    q.setSelection(r.index, parts.join("\n").length, "user");
    toast("Paragraphs sorted " + (dir === "desc" ? "Z → A" : "A → Z"));
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- borders & shading */
  function bordersShading() {
    const q = Q();
    if (!q) return;
    const r = q.getSelection() || { index: 0, length: 0 };
    const cur = q.getFormat(r) || {};
    const curSide = String(cur.pborder || "none");
    const body = `
      ${hint("Word’s paragraph borders: a box outline, a single edge, or a left bar. Shading fills the paragraph.")}
      <div class="studio-field"><label>Border</label>
        <div class="wm-sides">${[["none", "None"], ["all", "Box"], ["top", "Top"], ["bottom", "Bottom"], ["left", "Left bar"]]
          .map(([v, l]) => `<button type="button" class="studio-btn wm-side${curSide === v ? " primary" : ""}" data-bs-mode="${v}">${l}</button>`).join("")}</div>
      </div>
      ${row2(
        field("Shading", `<input type="color" data-bs-fill value="${cur.shading && /^#/.test(cur.shading) ? cur.shading : "#f1f5f9"}">`),
        `<label class="studio-check" style="align-self:flex-end"><input type="checkbox" data-bs-nofill${cur.shading ? "" : " checked"}> No shading</label>`
      )}
      <div class="wm-preview" data-bs-preview>Sample paragraph</div>`;
    const { wrap } = modal("Borders and shading", body, [
      { label: "Cancel" },
      { label: "Apply", kind: "primary", run: () => {
        const qq = Q(); if (!qq) return;
        const rr = qq.getSelection() || { index: 0, length: qq.getLength() };
        const mode = wrap.querySelector(".wm-side.primary") ? wrap.querySelector(".wm-side.primary").dataset.bsMode : "none";
        const fill = wrap.querySelector("[data-bs-nofill]").checked ? false : wrap.querySelector("[data-bs-fill]").value;
        qq.formatLine(rr.index, Math.max(1, rr.length), "pborder", mode === "none" ? false : mode, "user");
        qq.formatLine(rr.index, Math.max(1, rr.length), "shading", fill, "user");
        toast(mode === "none" ? "Borders removed" : "Borders applied");
      } },
    ]);
    wrap.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest("[data-bs-mode]");
      if (!b) return;
      $$(".wm-side", wrap).forEach((x) => x.classList.toggle("primary", x === b));
      const prev = wrap.querySelector("[data-bs-preview]");
      prev.className = "wm-preview" + (b.dataset.bsMode === "none" ? "" : " pb-" + b.dataset.bsMode);
    });
    const fill = wrap.querySelector("[data-bs-fill]");
    const prev = wrap.querySelector("[data-bs-preview]");
    const paint = () => {
      prev.style.background = wrap.querySelector("[data-bs-nofill]").checked ? "" : fill.value;
    };
    fill.addEventListener("input", paint);
    wrap.querySelector("[data-bs-nofill]").addEventListener("change", paint);
    paint();
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------- table tools */
  function anchorEl() {
    const s = window.getSelection();
    if (!s || !s.anchorNode) return null;
    const n = s.anchorNode;
    return n.nodeType === 1 ? n : n.parentElement;
  }

  function tableAt(q) {
    let node = null;
    const a = anchorEl();
    if (a && a.closest) node = a.closest("table");
    if (!node) {
      try {
        const r = q.getSelection();
        if (r) {
          const leaf = q.getLeaf(r.index);
          const n = leaf && leaf[0] && leaf[0].domNode;
          node = n && n.parentElement && n.parentElement.closest("table");
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (!node) {
      const t = q.root.querySelectorAll("table");
      node = t[t.length - 1] || null;
    }
    return node;
  }

  function cellAt(q) {
    const a = anchorEl();
    if (a && a.closest) {
      const c = a.closest("td,th");
      if (c) return c;
    }
    try {
      const r = q.getSelection();
      if (!r) return null;
      const leaf = q.getLeaf(r.index);
      const n = leaf && leaf[0] && leaf[0].domNode;
      return n && n.parentElement && n.parentElement.closest("td,th");
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  function commitTable(q, table, msg) {
    q.update("user");
    if (msg) toast(msg);
    void table;
  }

  function mergeCells() {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const cell = cellAt(q);
    if (!cell) return toast("Click inside a table first", "warn");
    const table = cell.closest("table");
    const span = window.getSelection();
    let cells = [];
    if (span && span.rangeCount && !span.isCollapsed) {
      const range = span.getRangeAt(0);
      cells = $$("td,th", table).filter((c) => range.intersectsNode(c));
    }
    if (cells.length < 2) {
      /* fall back: merge the cell with the one to its right */
      const row = cell.parentElement;
      const idx = Array.from(row.cells).indexOf(cell);
      if (idx < 0 || idx + 1 >= row.cells.length) return toast("Select at least two cells (or use a cell not at the edge)", "warn");
      cells = [cell, row.cells[idx + 1]];
    }
    const first = cells[0];
    const texts = cells.map((c) => c.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const cols = cells.reduce((n, c) => n + (c.colSpan || 1), 0);
    first.colSpan = cols;
    first.innerHTML = texts.join(" ") || "<br>";
    cells.slice(1).forEach((c) => c.remove());
    commitTable(q, table, "Cells merged");
  }

  function splitCell() {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const cell = cellAt(q);
    if (!cell) return toast("Click inside a table first", "warn");
    const body = `${row2(field("Rows", `<input type="number" data-sp-r value="1" min="1" max="20">`),
      field("Columns", `<input type="number" data-sp-c value="2" min="1" max="20">`))}`;
    modal("Split cell", body, [{ label: "Cancel" }, { label: "Split", kind: "primary", run: (host) => {
      const rows = Math.max(1, +$("[data-sp-r]", host).value || 1);
      const cols = Math.max(1, +$("[data-sp-c]", host).value || 1);
      const text = cell.innerHTML;
      const tr = cell.parentElement;
      const at = Array.from(tr.cells).indexOf(cell);
      if (rows === 1 && cols === 1) return;
      cell.colSpan = cols;
      cell.innerHTML = text;
      for (let i = 1; i < cols; i++) {
        const extra = document.createElement(cell.tagName.toLowerCase());
        extra.innerHTML = "<br>";
        tr.insertBefore(extra, tr.cells[at + i] || null);
      }
      let anchorRow = tr;
      for (let r2 = 1; r2 < rows; r2++) {
        const newRow = tr.cloneNode(false);
        const cellClone = document.createElement(cell.tagName.toLowerCase());
        cellClone.innerHTML = "<br>";
        newRow.appendChild(cellClone);
        anchorRow.parentNode.insertBefore(newRow, anchorRow.nextSibling);
        anchorRow = newRow;
      }
      commitTable(q, cell.closest("table"), "Cell split");
    } }]);
  }

  function splitTable() {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const cell = cellAt(q);
    if (!cell) return toast("Click in the row where the new table should start", "warn");
    const table = cell.closest("table");
    const row = cell.parentElement;
    const body = table.tBodies[0] || table;
    const rows = Array.from(body.rows);
    const at = rows.indexOf(row);
    if (at <= 0) return toast("Put the caret in a row other than the first", "warn");
    const rest = rows.slice(at);
    const clone = table.cloneNode(false);
    const tb = document.createElement("tbody");
    rest.forEach((r2) => tb.appendChild(r2.cloneNode(true)));
    clone.appendChild(tb);
    rows.slice(at).forEach((r2) => r2.remove());
    table.parentNode.insertBefore(clone, table.nextSibling);
    commitTable(q, table, "Table split into two");
  }

  function autoFit() {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const table = tableAt(q);
    if (!table) return toast("No table here", "warn");
    table.style.width = "100%";
    table.style.tableLayout = "fixed";
    commitTable(q, table, "Table fitted to the page width");
  }

  function repeatHeader() {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const table = tableAt(q);
    if (!table) return toast("No table here", "warn");
    const first = table.rows[0];
    if (!first) return;
    const on = first.dataset.repeat !== "1";
    first.dataset.repeat = on ? "1" : "0";
    if (!first.querySelector("th")) {
      first.querySelectorAll("td").forEach((c) => {
        const th = document.createElement("th");
        th.innerHTML = c.innerHTML;
        if (c.colSpan > 1) th.colSpan = c.colSpan;
        c.replaceWith(th);
      });
    }
    commitTable(q, table, on ? "Header row repeats on every page" : "Header row repeat off");
  }

  function tableFormula() {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const cell = cellAt(q);
    if (!cell) return toast("Click in the cell that should hold the result", "warn");
    const body = `${row2(
      field("Function", `<select data-tf-fn>${["SUM", "AVERAGE", "COUNT", "MIN", "MAX"].map((f) => `<option>${f}</option>`).join("")}</select>`),
      field("Direction", `<select data-tf-dir><option value="above">Above</option><option value="left">Left</option></select>`)
    )}${hint("Numbers are read from the cells in the chosen direction, exactly like Word’s =SUM(ABOVE).")}`;
    modal("Formula", body, [{ label: "Cancel" }, { label: "Insert", kind: "primary", run: (host) => {
      const fn = $("[data-tf-fn]", host).value;
      const dir = $("[data-tf-dir]", host).value;
      const row = cell.parentElement;
      const table = cell.closest("table");
      let cells = [];
      if (dir === "above") {
        const col = Array.from(row.cells).indexOf(cell);
        cells = Array.from(table.rows).slice(0, Array.from(table.rows).indexOf(row)).map((r2) => r2.cells[col]).filter(Boolean);
      } else {
        cells = Array.from(row.cells).slice(0, Array.from(row.cells).indexOf(cell));
      }
      const nums = cells.map((c) => parseFloat(String(c.textContent).replace(/[^\d.\-]/g, ""))).filter((n) => !isNaN(n));
      if (!nums.length) return toast("No numbers found in that direction", "warn");
      let out;
      if (fn === "SUM") out = nums.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      else if (fn === "AVERAGE") out = nums.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / nums.length;
      else if (fn === "COUNT") out = nums.length;
      else if (fn === "MIN") out = Math.min.apply(null, nums);
      else out = Math.max.apply(null, nums);
      cell.textContent = String(Math.round(out * 1000) / 1000);
      commitTable(q, table, fn + " = " + cell.textContent);
    } }]);
  }

  function tableToText() {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const table = tableAt(q);
    if (!table) return toast("No table here", "warn");
    const text = Array.from(table.rows).map((r2) => Array.from(r2.cells).map((c) => c.textContent.trim()).join("\t")).join("\n");
    const leaf = q.getLeaf(sel(q).index);
    const blot = leaf && leaf[0];
    let idx = sel(q).index;
    if (blot && blot.domNode) {
      const host = blot.domNode.parentElement ? blot.domNode.parentElement.closest(".doc-table-block,.doc-table-wrap") : null;
      if (host) {
        const b2 = window.Quill.find(host);
        if (b2) idx = q.getIndex(b2);
      }
    }
    q.deleteText(idx, 1, "user");
    q.insertText(idx, text + "\n", "user");
    toast("Table converted to text");
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------- change case UI */
  function caseDialog() {
    const body = `<div class="wm-cases">${[["sentence", "Sentence case"], ["lower", "lowercase"], ["upper", "UPPERCASE"],
      ["capitalize", "Capitalize Each Word"], ["toggle", "tOGGLE cASE"]].map(([k, l]) =>
      `<button type="button" class="studio-btn wm-case" data-case="${k}">${l}</button>`).join("")}</div>`;
    const { wrap } = modal("Change case", body, [{ label: "Close" }]);
    wrap.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest("[data-case]");
      if (!b) return;
      changeCase(b.dataset.case);
      wrap.remove();
    });
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- charts */
  function barChartSvg(labels, values, title) {
    const w = 640, h = 340, pad = 46;
    const max = Math.max.apply(null, values.concat([1]));
    const bw = (w - pad * 2) / Math.max(1, values.length);
    const bars = values.map((v, i) => {
      const bh = Math.round(((h - pad * 2) * v) / max);
      const x = pad + i * bw + bw * 0.18;
      const y = h - pad - bh;
      const col = ["#4f46e5", "#0ea5e9", "#10b981", "#f59e0b", "#ef4444", "#8b5cf6"][i % 6];
      return `<rect x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${y}" width="${(bw * 0.64).toFixed(1)}" height="${bh}" rx="3" fill="${col}"></rect>
        <text x="${(pad + i * bw + bw / 2).toFixed(1)}" y="${y - 7}" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#334155">${v}</text>
        <text x="${(pad + i * bw + bw / 2).toFixed(1)}" y="${h - pad + 18}" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b">${esc(labels[i])}</text>`;
    }).join("");
    const grid = [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map((f) => `<line x1="${pad}" y1="${h - pad - (h - pad * 2) * f}" x2="${w - pad}" y2="${h - pad - (h - pad * 2) * f}" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1"></line>`).join("");
    return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${w}" height="${h}" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}">
      <rect width="${w}" height="${h}" fill="#ffffff"></rect>
      ${title ? `<text x="${w / 2}" y="26" font-size="16" font-family="Segoe UI, Arial" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0f172a">${esc(title)}</text>` : ""}
      ${grid}${bars}
      <line x1="${pad}" y1="${h - pad}" x2="${w - pad}" y2="${h - pad}" stroke="#94a3b8"></line>
    </svg>`;
  }

  function chartDialog() {
    const body = `${field("Chart title", `<input type="text" data-ch-title value="Quarterly revenue" placeholder="Optional">`)}
      ${field("Categories (comma separated)", `<input type="text" data-ch-labels value="Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4">`)}
      ${field("Values (comma separated)", `<input type="text" data-ch-values value="12, 18, 9, 22">`)}
      ${hint("The chart is inserted as a vector image that survives DOCX export.")}`;
    modal("Insert chart", body, [
      { label: "Cancel" },
      { label: "Insert", kind: "primary", run: (host) => {
        const labels = $("[data-ch-labels]", host).value.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        const values = $("[data-ch-values]", host).value.split(",").map((s) => parseFloat(s.trim())).filter((n) => !isNaN(n));
        const title = $("[data-ch-title]", host).value.trim();
        if (!labels.length || !values.length) return toast("Enter at least one label and value", "warn");
        const svg = barChartSvg(labels, values, title);
        svgToPng(svg, 2).then((png) => insertImageUri(png || ("data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(svg)), "Bar chart"));
      } },
    ]);
  }

  /* SVG -> PNG so the picture survives the DOCX writer and Word itself */
  function svgToPng(svg, scale) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const blob = new Blob([svg], { type: "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        const k = scale || 2;
        const c = document.createElement("canvas");
        c.width = Math.round(img.width * k || 1200);
        c.height = Math.round(img.height * k || 600);
        const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
        ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        resolve(c.toDataURL("image/png"));
      };
      img.onerror = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); resolve(null); };
      img.src = url;
    });
  }

  function insertImageUri(uri, alt) {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const r = sel(q);
    q.insertEmbed(r.index, "image", uri, "user");
    q.insertText(r.index + 1, "\n", "user");
    q.setSelection(r.index + 2, 0, "user");
    const img = q.root.querySelectorAll("img");
    const last = img[img.length - 1];
    if (last) { last.setAttribute("alt", alt || "Chart"); last.style.maxWidth = "100%"; }
    toast(alt + " inserted");
  }

  /* -------------------------------------------------------------- smart art */
  function smartArtDialog() {
    const kinds = [["process", "Process (chevrons)"], ["cycle", "Cycle (ring)"], ["list", "Stacked list"], ["hierarchy", "Hierarchy"]];
    const body = `${field("Graphic", `<select data-sa-kind>${kinds.map(([k, l]) => `<option value="${k}">${l}</option>`).join("")}</select>`)}
      ${field("Items (comma separated)", `<input type="text" data-sa-items value="Plan, Build, Test, Ship">`)}`;
    modal("SmartArt graphic", body, [{ label: "Cancel" }, { label: "Insert", kind: "primary", run: (host) => {
      const kind = $("[data-sa-kind]", host).value;
      const items = $("[data-sa-items]", host).value.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);

  function smartArtSvg(kind, items) {
    const n = items.length;
    const w = 720, h = 220;
    const palette = ["#4f46e5", "#0ea5e9", "#10b981", "#f59e0b", "#ef4444", "#8b5cf6"];
    let body = "";
    if (kind === "cycle") {
      const cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2, rad = 78;
      items.forEach((t, i) => {
        const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / n - Math.PI / 2;
        const x = cx + Math.cos(a) * rad, y = cy + Math.sin(a) * rad;
        body += `<circle cx="${x.toFixed(1)}" cy="${y.toFixed(1)}" r="44" fill="${palette[i % 6]}"></circle>
          <text x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${(y + 4).toFixed(1)}" font-size="13" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Segoe UI, Arial">${esc(t)}</text>`;
      });
      body += `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="18" fill="#e2e8f0"></circle>`;
    } else if (kind === "list") {
      const bh = Math.min(44, (h - 24) / n - 8);
      items.forEach((t, i) => {
        const y = 12 + i * (bh + 8);
        body += `<rect x="22" y="${y}" width="${w - 44}" height="${bh}" rx="7" fill="${palette[i % 6]}" opacity="${1 - i * 0.12}"></rect>
          <text x="44" y="${y + bh / 2 + 5}" font-size="14" fill="#fff" font-family="Segoe UI, Arial">${esc(t)}</text>`;
      });
    } else if (kind === "hierarchy") {
      const bw = Math.min(180, (w - 40) / n - 10);
      items.forEach((t, i) => {
        const x = 20 + i * ((w - 40) / n) + ((w - 40) / n - bw) / 2;
        body += `<rect x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="70" width="${bw}" height="70" rx="6" fill="${palette[i % 6]}"></rect>
          <text x="${(x + bw / 2).toFixed(1)}" y="110" font-size="13" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Segoe UI, Arial">${esc(t)}</text>`;
        if (i) body += `<line x1="${(20 + (i - 1) * ((w - 40) / n) + (w - 40) / n / 2).toFixed(1)}" y1="50" x2="${(x + bw / 2).toFixed(1)}" y2="70" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="2"></line>`;
      });
      body += `<rect x="${w / 2 - 70}" y="18" width="140" height="34" rx="6" fill="#0f172a"></rect>
        <text x="${w / 2}" y="40" font-size="13" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Segoe UI, Arial">Overview</text>`;
    } else {
      const cw = (w - 40) / n;
      items.forEach((t, i) => {
        const x = 20 + i * cw;
        body += `<path d="M${x} 60 L${x + cw - 14} 60 L${x + cw} 110 L${x + cw - 14} 160 L${x} 160 L${x + 14} 110 Z" fill="${palette[i % 6]}"></path>
          <text x="${(x + cw / 2).toFixed(1)}" y="114" font-size="13" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Segoe UI, Arial">${esc(t)}</text>`;
      });
    }
    return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${w}" height="${h}" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}"><rect width="${w}" height="${h}" fill="#fff"></rect>${body}</svg>`;
  }

  /* --------------------------------------------------------- find / replace */
  function findReplaceDialog() {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const body = `${field("Find", `<input type="text" data-fr-q placeholder="Text to find…">`)}
      ${field("Replace with", `<input type="text" data-fr-r placeholder="Replacement (leave blank to delete)">`)}
      <div class="studio-row2">
        ${check("Match case", "data-fr-case")}
        ${check("Whole words", "data-fr-word")}
      </div>
      <div class="studio-row2">
        ${check("Regular expression", "data-fr-re")}
        ${check("Search in selection only", "data-fr-sel")}
      </div>
      <div class="studio-hint" data-fr-info>Ready.</div>`;
    const { wrap } = modal("Find and replace", body, [{ label: "Close" }]);
    const info = $("[data-fr-info]", wrap);

    const build = () => {
      const needle = $("[data-fr-q]", wrap).value;
      if (!needle) return null;
      const useRe = $("[data-fr-re]", wrap).checked;
      const caseSensitive = $("[data-fr-case]", wrap).checked;
      const whole = $("[data-fr-word]", wrap).checked;
      let src = useRe ? needle : needle.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
      if (whole) src = "\\b" + src + "\\b";
      return new RegExp(src, caseSensitive ? "g" : "gi");
    };

    const scan = () => {
      const re = build();
      if (!re) return [];
      const qq = Q();
      const base = { index: 0, length: qq.getLength() };
      if ($("[data-fr-sel]", wrap).checked) {
        const s = qq.getSelection();
        if (s && s.length) { base.index = s.index; base.length = s.length; }
      }
      const text = qq.getText(base.index, base.length);
      const out = [];
      let m;
      while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null) {
        out.push({ index: base.index + m.index, length: m[0].length, text: m[0] });
        if (m.index === re.lastIndex) re.lastIndex++;
        if (out.length > 5000) break;
      }
      return out;
    };

    wrap.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest("[data-fr-act]");
      if (!b) return;
      const qq = Q();
      if (b.dataset.frAct === "find") {
        const hits = scan();
        info.textContent = hits.length ? hits.length + " matches" : "No matches";
        if (!hits.length) return;
        const after = hits.find((h) => h.index > (qq.getSelection() || { index: 0 }).index) || hits[0];
        qq.setSelection(after.index, after.length, "user");
        return;
      }
      if (b.dataset.frAct === "replace") {
        const hits = scan();
        const cur = qq.getSelection();
        const hit = hits.find((h) => h.index === cur.index && h.length === cur.length) || hits[0];
        if (!hit) return toast("Nothing to replace", "warn");
        const rep = $("[data-fr-r]", wrap).value;
        qq.deleteText(hit.index, hit.length, "user");
        if (rep) qq.insertText(hit.index, rep, "user");
        info.textContent = "Replaced 1 match";
        return;
      }
      if (b.dataset.frAct === "all") {
        const hits = scan();
        if (!hits.length) return toast("No matches", "warn");
        const rep = $("[data-fr-r]", wrap).value;
        for (let i = hits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          qq.deleteText(hits[i].index, hits[i].length, "user");
          if (rep) qq.insertText(hits[i].index, rep, "user");
        }
        info.textContent = "Replaced " + hits.length + " matches";
        toast("Replaced " + hits.length + " matches");
      }
    });

    /* extra buttons live in the footer */
    const foot = wrap.querySelector(".studio-modal-f, .studio-bs-row") || wrap;
    const bar = document.createElement("div");
    bar.className = "wm-btnrow";
    bar.innerHTML = `<button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-fr-act="find">Find next</button>
      <button type="button" class="studio-btn" data-fr-act="replace">Replace</button>
      <button type="button" class="studio-btn primary" data-fr-act="all">Replace all</button>`;
    foot.appendChild(bar);
  }

  /* --------------------------------------------------------------- compare */
  function compareDialog() {
    const body = `${hint("Pick a .docx / .txt file. The current document is compared against it and only the differences are listed.")}
      <div class="studio-field"><label>Compare with</label><input type="file" data-cmp-file accept=".docx,.txt,.md,.html"></div>
      <div data-cmp-out class="wm-diff"></div>`;
    const { wrap } = modal("Compare documents", body, [{ label: "Close" }]);
    $("[data-cmp-file]", wrap).addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
      const f = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
      if (!f) return;
      let otherText = "";
      try {
        if (/\.docx$/i.test(f.name)) {
          const parsed = await window.PPDocx.read(await f.arrayBuffer());
          otherText = window.PPDocx.toPlainText(parsed);
        } else {
          otherText = await f.text();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        return toast("Could not read the file: " + err.message, "warn");
      }
      const q = Q();
      const mine = q.getText().replace(/\u200b/g, "");
      const diff = wordDiff(mine, otherText);
      $("[data-cmp-out]", wrap).innerHTML = `
        <div class="wm-diffsum">${diff.added} insertions · ${diff.removed} deletions · ${diff.same} unchanged words</div>
        <div class="wm-difflist">${diff.rows.slice(0, 60).map((r) => `<div class="wm-diffrow"><span class="wm-tag ${r.k}">${r.k === "add" ? "+" : r.k === "del" ? "−" : "·"}</span>${esc(r.t)}</div>`).join("")}</div>`;
    });
  }

  function wordDiff(a, b) {
    const A2 = a.split(/(\s+)/).filter((s) => s.trim());
    const B2 = b.split(/(\s+)/).filter((s) => s.trim());
    const counts = new Map();
    A2.forEach((w) => counts.set(w, (counts.get(w) || 0) + 1));
    const rows = [];
    let added = 0, removed = 0, same = 0;
    B2.forEach((w) => {
      const n = counts.get(w) || 0;
      if (n > 0) { counts.set(w, n - 1); same++; rows.push({ k: "same", t: w }); }
      else { added++; rows.push({ k: "add", t: w }); }
    });
    counts.forEach((n, w) => {
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { removed++; rows.push({ k: "del", t: w }); }
    });
    return { added, removed, same, rows };
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------- accessibility */
  function accessibilityCheck() {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const issues = [];
    $$("img", q.root).forEach((img) => {
      if (!img.getAttribute("alt") || !img.getAttribute("alt").trim()) {
        issues.push({ sev: "high", what: "Image without alt text", where: (img.getAttribute("src") || "").slice(0, 40) });
      }
    });
    $$("h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6", q.root).forEach((h) => {
      if (!h.textContent.trim()) issues.push({ sev: "medium", what: "Empty heading", where: h.tagName });
    });
    let prev = 0;
    $$("h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6", q.root).forEach((h) => {
      const lvl = +h.tagName[1];
      if (prev && lvl - prev > 1) issues.push({ sev: "medium", what: "Heading level skipped (" + prev + " → " + lvl + ")", where: h.textContent.trim().slice(0, 40) });
      prev = lvl;
    });
    $$("table", q.root).forEach((t, i) => {
      if (!t.querySelector("th")) issues.push({ sev: "medium", what: "Table without header row", where: "Table " + (i + 1) });
    });
    $$("a", q.root).forEach((a) => {
      if (!a.textContent.trim() && !a.getAttribute("aria-label")) issues.push({ sev: "low", what: "Link without text", where: a.getAttribute("href") || "" });
    });
    const text = q.getText();
    if (/\b(click here|read more)\b/i.test(text)) issues.push({ sev: "low", what: "Vague link text in the document", where: "“click here / read more”" });
    if (!q.root.querySelector("h1")) issues.push({ sev: "low", what: "No Heading 1 (document title)", where: "Whole document" });

    const body = issues.length
      ? `<div class="wm-issues">${issues.map((i) => `<div class="wm-issue ${i.sev}"><b>${esc(i.what)}</b><small>${esc(i.where)}</small></div>`).join("")}</div>`
      : `<div class="studio-hint">No accessibility problems found. Nice.</div>`;
    modal("Accessibility checker", body + hint(issues.length + " issue(s) found · high severity first"), [{ label: "Close" }]);
  }

  function qatList() {
    const s = store();
    return Array.isArray(s.qat) ? s.qat : QAT_DEFAULT.slice();
  }

  function runQatCommand(id) {
    const q = Q();
    switch (id) {
      case "save": return window.Studio.saveActive();
      case "undo": return q && q.history.undo();
      case "redo": return q && q.history.redo();
      case "print": return window.Studio.printDoc();
      case "export": return window.Studio.exportDocx();
      case "new": return window.Studio.newDocument();
      case "open": return window.Studio.pickFile();
      case "fontdlg": return window.openFontDialog ? window.openFontDialog(q) : toast("Font dialog unavailable", "warn");
      case "paradlg": return window.openParagraphDialog ? window.openParagraphDialog(q) : toast("Paragraph dialog unavailable", "warn");
      case "find": return findReplaceDialog();
      case "wordcount": return window.openWordCount ? window.openWordCount(q) : toast("Word count unavailable", "warn");
      case "track": return window.toggleTrackChanges ? window.toggleTrackChanges(q, null) : toast("Track changes unavailable", "warn");
      case "comments": return window.toggleCommentPane ? window.toggleCommentPane() : toast("Comments unavailable", "warn");
      case "zoom": return window.applyDocZoom ? (window.applyDocZoom(100), true) : null;
      default: return null;
    }
  }

  function renderQAT() {
    const bar = $(".studio-qat");

  const TAB_NAMES = { file: "File", home: "Home", insert: "Insert", design: "Design", layout: "Layout",
    refs: "References", mailings: "Mailings", review: "Review", view: "View", help: "Help", table: "Table" };

  function ribbonTabs() {
    const out = [];
    $$(".rt-bar[data-panel]").forEach((bar) => {
      const groups = $$(".rt-grp[data-label]", bar).map((g) => g.dataset.label).filter(Boolean);
      if (groups.length) out.push({ panel: bar.dataset.panel, groups });

    return out;
  }

  function applyRibbonPrefs() {
    const hidden = store().hiddenGrps || [];
    $$(".rt-bar[data-panel] .rt-grp[data-label]").forEach((g) => {
      const panel = g.closest(".rt-bar").dataset.panel;
      const key = panel + ":" + g.dataset.label;
      g.style.display = hidden.indexOf(key) >= 0 ? "none" : "";
    });
  }

  function customizeRibbon() {
    const hidden = store().hiddenGrps || [];
    const tabs = ribbonTabs();
    if (!tabs.length) return toast("Ribbon not ready", "warn");
    const body = `<div class="wm-qat-body"><div class="studio-list wm-ribbon-list">${
      tabs.map((t) => `<div class="wm-ribbon-tab"><b>${esc(TAB_NAMES[t.panel] || t.panel)}</b>${
        t.groups.map((lbl) => {
          const key = t.panel + ":" + lbl;
          return `<label class="studio-check wm-rgrp"><input type="checkbox" data-rgrp="${esc(key)}"${hidden.indexOf(key) < 0 ? " checked" : ""}> ${esc(lbl)}</label>`;
        }).join("")
      }</div>`).join("")
    }</div>${hint("Unchecked groups are hidden on this device. Every tab keeps at least one group.")}</div>`;
    modal("Customize ribbon", body, [
      { label: "Reset", run: () => { const s = store(); delete s.hiddenGrps; saveStore(s); applyRibbonPrefs(); toast("Ribbon restored"); } },
      { label: "Save", kind: "primary", run: (host) => {
        const all = $$("[data-rgrp]", host).map((i) => i.dataset.rgrp);
        const on = $$("[data-rgrp]", host).filter((i) => i.checked).map((i) => i.dataset.rgrp);
        const hiddenKeys = all.filter((k) => on.indexOf(k) < 0);
        /* never leave a tab completely empty */
        tabs.forEach((t) => {
          const keys = t.groups.map((l) => t.panel + ":" + l);
          if (keys.every((k) => hiddenKeys.indexOf(k) >= 0)) {
            const keep = hiddenKeys.indexOf(keys[0]);
            if (keep >= 0) hiddenKeys.splice(keep, 1);
          }
        });
        const s = store();
        s.hiddenGrps = hiddenKeys;
        saveStore(s);
        applyRibbonPrefs();
        toast("Ribbon updated");
      } },
    ]);
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ mini toolbar */
  function installMiniToolbar() {
    if ($(".wm-mini")) return;
    const bar = document.createElement("div");
    bar.className = "wm-mini";
    bar.innerHTML = `
      <button type="button" data-mini="bold" data-tip="Bold"><b>B</b></button>
      <button type="button" data-mini="italic" data-tip="Italic"><i>I</i></button>
      <button type="button" data-mini="underline" data-tip="Underline"><u>U</u></button>
      <span class="wm-mini-sep"></span>
      <button type="button" data-mini="color" data-tip="Text colour">A</button>
      <button type="button" data-mini="highlight" data-tip="Highlight">🖍</button>
      <span class="wm-mini-sep"></span>
      <button type="button" data-mini="grow" data-tip="Grow font">A⁺</button>
      <button type="button" data-mini="shrink" data-tip="Shrink font">A⁻</button>
      <span class="wm-mini-sep"></span>
      <button type="button" data-mini="comment" data-tip="New comment">💬</button>
      <button type="button" data-mini="link" data-tip="Insert link">🔗</button>`;
    document.body.appendChild(bar);

    let hideTimer = null;
    const hide = () => { bar.classList.remove("on"); };
    const show = (x, y) => {
      bar.classList.add("on");
      const w = bar.offsetWidth || 320, h = bar.offsetHeight || 40;
      bar.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerWidth - w - 8, x - w / 2)) + "px";
      bar.style.top = Math.max(8, y - h - 12) + "px";
    };
    document.addEventListener("mouseup", (e) => {
      const ed = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".ql-editor");
      if (!ed) { if (!e.target.closest(".wm-mini")) hide(); return; }
      const q = Q();
      if (!q) return;
      const r = q.getSelection();
      clearTimeout(hideTimer);
      hideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (r && r.length > 1) show(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        else hide();
      }, 120);
    });
    document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") hide(); });

    bar.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.preventDefault());
    bar.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest("[data-mini]");
      if (!b) return;
      const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
      const r = q.getSelection();
      if (!r || !r.length) return;
      const act = b.dataset.mini;
      if (act === "bold" || act === "italic" || act === "underline") {
        const cur = q.getFormat(r)[act];
        q.formatText(r.index, r.length, act, !cur, "user");
      } else if (act === "color") {
        q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "color", "#dc2626", "user");
      } else if (act === "highlight") {
        q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "background", "#fef08a", "user");
      } else if (act === "grow" || act === "shrink") {
        const cur = parseInt(q.getFormat(r).size, 10) || 16;
        q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "size", Math.max(8, Math.min(72, cur + (act === "grow" ? 2 : -2))) + "px", "user");
      } else if (act === "comment") {
        if (window.addComment) window.addComment(q);
      } else if (act === "link") {
        const href = prompt("Link address", "https://");
        if (href) q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "link", href, "user");
      }
      hide();
    });
  }

  /* --------------------------------------------------------- paste special */
  async function pasteSpecial() {
    const body = `<div class="studio-list">
        <button type="button" class="studio-file-row" data-ps="text"><span><b>Unformatted text</b><small>Paste without any styling</small></span></button>
        <button type="button" class="studio-file-row" data-ps="markdown"><span><b>Markdown</b><small># headings, **bold**, - lists</small></span></button>
        <button type="button" class="studio-file-row" data-ps="html"><span><b>Rich text (HTML)</b><small>Keeps bold, links, lists and tables</small></span></button>
      </div>${hint("The clipboard is read with the browser’s clipboard permission; if that is blocked, paste into the dialog instead.")}
      <div class="studio-field"><label>…or paste here</label><textarea data-ps-buffer rows="4" placeholder="Ctrl+V here"></textarea></div>`;
    const { wrap } = modal("Paste special", body, [{ label: "Close" }]);
    wrap.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest("[data-ps]");
      if (!b) return;
      let clip = $("[data-ps-buffer]", wrap).value;
      if (!clip) {
        try { clip = await navigator.clipboard.readText(); } catch (err) { return toast("Clipboard blocked — paste into the box first", "warn"); }
      }
      const q = Q(); const r = sel(q);
      if (!clip) return toast("Nothing to paste", "warn");
      if (b.dataset.ps === "text") {
        q.insertText(r.index, clip, "user");
      } else if (b.dataset.ps === "markdown") {
        const html = clip
          .replace(/^###### (.*)$/gm, "<h6>$1</h6>").replace(/^##### (.*)$/gm, "<h5>$1</h5>")
          .replace(/^#### (.*)$/gm, "<h4>$1</h4>").replace(/^### (.*)$/gm, "<h3>$1</h3>")
          .replace(/^## (.*)$/gm, "<h2>$1</h2>").replace(/^# (.*)$/gm, "<h1>$1</h1>")
          .replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, "<b>$1</b>").replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g, "<i>$1</i>")
          .replace(/(?:^- .*\n?)+/gm, (m) => "<ul>" + m.trim().split("\n").map((l) => "<li>" + l.replace(/^- /, "") + "</li>").join("") + "</ul>")
          .replace(/\n{2,}/g, "</p><p>");
        q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(r.index, "<p>" + html + "</p>", "user");
      } else {
        window.PPDocx.pasteHtmlInto(q, clip, r.index);
      }
      wrap.remove();
      toast("Pasted");
    });
    void pasteSpecial;
  }

"wide" : ""}" data-pop="${key}" data-tip="${esc(label)}" aria-label="${esc(label)}" aria-expanded="false">${opts.glyph || ""}${opts.wide ? `<em>${esc(label)}</em>` : ""}</button><div class="rt-pop" data-for="${key}" role="dialog" aria-label="${esc(label)}"><div class="rt-pop-h">${esc(label)}</div>${panel}</div></div>`;

    `<button type="button" class="rt-exp" data-stx="${act}"${arg !== undefined ? ` data-arg="${esc(arg)}"` : ""}>${esc(label)}${note ? `<span class="st-pop-note">${esc(note)}</span>` : ""}</button>`;

  function addGroup(panel, label, inner) {
    const bar = $(`.rt-bar[data-panel="${panel}"]`);
    if (!bar) return false;
    if ($(`.rt-bar[data-panel="${panel}"] .rt-grp[data-label="${label}"]`)) return true;
    bar.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", grp(label, inner));
    return true;
  }

  function addToGroup(panel, label, inner) {
    const g = $(`.rt-bar[data-panel="${panel}"] .rt-grp[data-label="${label}"]`);
    if (!g) return false;
    if (g.querySelector("[data-wm-item]")) return true;
    const box = document.createElement("span");
    box.setAttribute("data-wm-item", "1");
    box.style.display = "inline-flex";
    box.style.alignItems = "center";
    box.style.gap = "2px";
    box.innerHTML = inner;
    g.appendChild(box);
    return true;
  }
