    /* ---- Help: customization (one dialog per setting) ---- */
    addGroup("help", "Customize",
      bigBtn("Quick Access Toolbar", "wmQat", undefined, "⋯") +
      bigBtn("Customize ribbon", "wmRibbon", undefined, "☰") +
      bigBtn("Ribbon density", "wmDensity", undefined, "⇕"));
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- actions */
  Object.assign(A, {
    wmCase: (a) => (a ? changeCase(a) : caseDialog()),
    /* The Quill attributors are style whitelists (allcaps: uppercase /
       lowercase / capitalize, caps: small-caps / all-small-caps). Passing
       `true` is filtered out by the whitelist, which is why these two
       buttons used to do nothing at all. */
    wmAllCaps: () => {
      const q = Q(); const r = q && q.getSelection();
      if (!r || !r.length) return toast("Select text first", "warn");
      const on = q.getFormat(r).allcaps === "uppercase";
      q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "allcaps", on ? false : "uppercase", "user");
      toast(on ? "All caps off" : "All caps on");
    },
    wmSmallCaps: () => {
      const q = Q(); const r = q && q.getSelection();
      if (!r || !r.length) return toast("Select text first", "warn");
      const on = q.getFormat(r).caps === "small-caps";
      q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "caps", on ? false : "small-caps", "user");
      toast(on ? "Small caps off" : "Small caps on");
    },
    wmFontDialog: () => (window.openFontDialog ? window.openFontDialog(Q()) : toast("Font dialog unavailable", "warn")),
    wmParaDialog: () => (window.openParagraphDialog ? window.openParagraphDialog(Q()) : toast("Paragraph dialog unavailable", "warn")),
    wmSortPara: (a) => sortParagraphs(a || "asc"),
    wmBorders: () => bordersShading(),
    wmChart: () => chartDialog(),
    wmSmartArt: () => smartArtDialog(),
    wmTextBox: () => textBoxDialog(),
    wmDateTime: () => dateTimeDialog(),
    wmHyphen: () => toggleHyphenation(),
    wmIndent: (a) => {
      const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
      const r = q.getSelection() || { index: 0, length: 0 };
      const cur = q.getFormat(r).indent || 0;
      const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(8, cur + (+a || 1)));
      q.formatLine(r.index, Math.max(1, r.length), "indent", next, "user");
      toast("Indent " + next);
    },
    wmCompare: () => compareDialog(),
    wmA11y: () => accessibilityCheck(),
    wmInspector: () => inspector(),
    wmHistory: () => historyDialog(),
    wmEnvelope: () => envelopeDialog(),
    wmLabels: () => labelsDialog(),
    wmMerge: () => mergeCells(),
    wmSplitCell: () => splitCell(),
    wmSplitTable: () => splitTable(),
    wmAutoFit: () => autoFit(),
    wmRepeat: () => repeatHeader(),
    wmFormula: () => tableFormula(),
    wmTableText: () => tableToText(),
    wmFocus: () => toggleFocusMode(),
    wmWeb: () => toggleWebLayout(),
    wmMarks: () => toggleMarks(),
    wmQat: () => customizeQAT(),
    wmRibbon: () => customizeRibbon(),
    updateIndex: () => { const fn = A.buildIndex; if (fn) fn(true); else toast("Index unavailable", "warn"); },
    wmStyles: () => stylesPane(),
    wmGoTo: () => goToDialog(),
    wmFind: () => findReplaceDialog(),
    wmQuickParts: () => quickPartsDialog(),
    wmPageBorders: () => pageBorders(),
    wmPasteSpecial: () => pasteSpecial(),
    wmDensity: () => {
      const sh = SHELL(); if (!sh) return;
      sh.classList.toggle("studio-compact");
      const on = sh.classList.contains("studio-compact");
      const s = store(); s.compact = on; saveStore(s);
      toast("Ribbon " + (on ? "compact" : "comfortable"));
    },
  });

  /* ------------------------------------------- one button, one implementation
   *  The host ships its own buttons for a few commands. Rather than showing a
   *  second button, route those to the richer implementation written here.  */
  function baseHooks() {
    const map = {
      chart: () => chartDialog(),
      datetime: () => dateTimeDialog(),
      markindex: () => { if (A.markIndexEntry) A.markIndexEntry(); },
      insindex: () => { if (A.buildIndex) A.buildIndex(); },
      toc: () => { if (A.tocLevels) A.tocLevels(3); },
    };
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("[data-act]");
      if (!b || !map[b.dataset.act]) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      try { map[b.dataset.act](); } catch (err) { console.warn("[wordmore] hook", err); }
    }, true);
  }

  /* Buttons whose command now lives somewhere else in the ribbon — remove the copy. */
  const SUPERSEDED = ['[data-act="cover"]', '[data-act="pagenum"]', '[data-act="nav"]', '[data-act="shortcuts"]'];
  function pruneBase() {
    SUPERSEDED.forEach((sel) => $$(sel).forEach((n) => n.remove()));
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------- contextual Table tab */
  function watchContextTab() {
    const sync = () => {
      const sh = SHELL();
      const tab = document.querySelector(".rt-tab-table");
      if (!sh || !tab) return;
      const inside = sh.classList.contains("in-table") || !!document.querySelector(".ql-editor td:focus, .ql-editor th:focus");
      if (tab.hidden === inside) tab.hidden = !inside;
    };
    setInterval(sync, 600);
    document.addEventListener("selectionchange", sync);
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------- boot */
  let tries = 0;
  function boot() {
    const ready = $(".rt-bar[data-panel=\"home\"]") && Q();
    if (!ready) {
      if (++tries < 80) setTimeout(boot, 250);
      return;
    }
    try { buildRibbon(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[wordmore] ribbon", e); }
    if (!window.__wmHooks) { window.__wmHooks = 1; try { baseHooks(); } catch (e) {} }
    try { if (store().compact && SHELL()) SHELL().classList.add("studio-compact"); } catch (e) {}
    try { renderQAT(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[wordmore] qat", e); }
    try { installMiniToolbar(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[wordmore] mini", e); }
    try { if (!window.__wmCtx) { window.__wmCtx = 1; watchContextTab(); } } catch (e) {}
    try { applyRibbonPrefs(); } catch (e) {}
    try { pruneBase(); } catch (e) {}
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  else boot();
  setTimeout(boot, 400);
  setTimeout(boot, 1600);
})();

</script>
<script id="studio-fixes">
/* ============================================================================
 *  FIXES — accuracy pass driven by a full control sweep
 *  · keeps the text selection alive when the ribbon is clicked (the #1 reason
 *    Word commands "did nothing": the caret collapsed before the command ran)
 *  · clipboard with a fallback when the Clipboard API is policy-blocked
 *  · real Print (preview → print → download), no pop-up dependency
 *  · real video insert (local file **and** link)
 *  · real content controls (checkbox / dropdown / combo / date / text / rich)
 *  · forwards Design colours to the host's own, tested implementations
 * ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  if (window.__FIXES__) return;
  window.__FIXES__ = true;

  const $ = (s, r) => (r || document).querySelector(s);
  const $$ = (s, r) => Array.from((r || document).querySelectorAll(s));
  const esc = (v) => String(v == null ? "" : v)
    .replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/</g, "<").replace(/>/g, ">")
    .replace(/"/g, """).replace(/'/g, "'");
  const toast = (m, k) => { try { window.docToast ? window.docToast(m, k) : console.log("[fix]", m); } catch (e) {} };
  const ACT = window.STUDIO_X_ACT || (window.STUDIO_X_ACT = {});
  const ST = () => window.Studio || {};
  const rec = () => { const s = ST(); return s.active || null; };
  const Q = () => { const r = rec(); return r ? r.q : null; };
  const modal = (t, b, a, o) => ST().modal(t, b, a, o);

  /* ======================================================================
   * 1. SELECTION KEEPER
   * Quill drops its range as soon as the ribbon takes focus, so every
   * command that needs a range (case, sort, spacing, comments…) silently
   * did nothing. Two fixes: never let the ribbon steal focus, and remember
   * the last real range as a fallback.
   * ==================================================================== */
  const sticky = { index: 0, length: 0, has: false };

  function bindSel(q) {
    if (!q || q.__fxSel) return;
    q.__fxSel = true;
    q.on("selection-change", (r) => {
      if (!r) return;
      if (r.length > 0) { sticky.index = r.index; sticky.length = r.length; sticky.has = true; }
      else if (!sticky.has) { sticky.index = r.index; sticky.length = 0; }
    });
  }

  function rangeOf(q) {
    if (!q) return { index: 0, length: 0 };
    const r = q.getSelection();
    if (r && r.length > 0) return r;
    if (sticky.has && sticky.length > 0) return { index: sticky.index, length: sticky.length };
    return r || { index: Math.max(0, q.getLength() - 1), length: 0 };
  }

  function restore(q) {
    if (!q) return null;
    const r = rangeOf(q);
    if (!r) return null;
    try { q.focus(); } catch (e) {}
    try { q.setSelection(r.index, r.length, "silent"); } catch (e) {}
    return r;
  }

  /* keep focus in the editor when a ribbon / popover button is pressed */
  const SAFE = ".rt-b,.rt-tab,.rt-dock button,[data-stx],[data-act],[data-pop],.rt-pop button,.studio-qat button,.studio-icobtn";
  document.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
    const t = e.target;
    if (!t || !t.closest) return;
    if (t.closest("input,select,textarea,.rt-custom,.studio-field")) return;
    if (!t.closest(SAFE)) return;
    const q = Q();
    if (!q || !q.hasFocus || !q.hasFocus()) return;
    e.preventDefault(); /* stops the browser moving focus out of the editor */
  }, true);

  /* every delegated action starts with a live range again */
  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const el = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("[data-stx],[data-act]");
    if (!el) return;
    const q = Q();
    if (!q) return;
    bindSel(q);
    const cur = q.getSelection();
    if (cur && cur.length > 0) return;
    if (sticky.has && sticky.length > 0) {
      try { q.setSelection(sticky.index, sticky.length, "silent"); } catch (err) {}
    }
  }, true);

  /* keep the caret inside the editor after commands that move it */
  function focusBack(q) {
    if (!q) return;
    try {
      q.focus();
      const r = rangeOf(q);
      if (r) q.setSelection(r.index, r.length, "silent");
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  /* ======================================================================
   * 2. CLIPBOARD (Clipboard API → execCommand → dialog)
   * ==================================================================== */
  function showText(title, text) {
    modal(title, `<div class="studio-field"><label>Copy this text</label>
      <textarea rows="10" data-fx-copy>${esc(text)}</textarea></div>
      <div class="studio-hint">The browser blocked the clipboard, so the text is shown here instead.</div>`,
      [{ label: "Close" }]);
    setTimeout(() => { const t = $("[data-fx-copy]"); if (t) { t.focus(); t.select(); } }, 60);
  }

  async function copyText(text, label) {
    if (!text) { toast("Nothing to copy", "warn"); return false; }
    try {
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        toast(label + " copied");
        return true;
      }
    } catch (e) { /* policy blocked → fall through */ }
    try {
      const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
      ta.value = text;
      ta.setAttribute("readonly", "");
      ta.style.cssText = "position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0;opacity:0";
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      ta.setSelectionRange(0, text.length);
      const ok = document.execCommand("copy");
      ta.remove();
      if (ok) { toast(label + " copied"); return true; }
    } catch (e) {}
    showText(label, text);
    return false;
  }
  window.fxCopyText = copyText;

  function selectionHtml() {
    const s = window.getSelection();
    if (!s || !s.rangeCount) return "";
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.appendChild(s.getRangeAt(0).cloneContents());
    return d.innerHTML;
  }

  ACT.copy = () => {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const html = selectionHtml();
    copyText(html ? html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "") : q.getText(), "Text");
  };
  ACT.copyhtml = () => {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const html = selectionHtml();
    copyText(html || q.root.innerHTML, "HTML");
  };
  ACT.copymd = () => {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const html = selectionHtml() || q.root.innerHTML;
    const md = typeof window.htmlToMarkdown === "function" ? window.htmlToMarkdown(html) : q.getText();
    copyText(md || q.getText(), "Markdown");
  };
  ACT.cut = async () => {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const r = rangeOf(q);
    if (!r || !r.length) return toast("Select the text to cut", "warn");
    await copyText(q.getText(r.index, r.length), "Selection");
    q.deleteText(r.index, r.length, "user");
  };
  ACT.paste = async () => {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const r = rangeOf(q);
    let text = "";
    try { text = await navigator.clipboard.readText(); } catch (e) {}
    if (!text) {
      modal("Paste", `<div class="studio-field"><label>Paste text here</label>
        <textarea rows="8" data-fx-paste placeholder="Ctrl+V inside this box"></textarea></div>
        <div class="studio-hint">The clipboard cannot be read directly here, so paste into the box instead.</div>`,
        [{ label: "Cancel" },
         { label: "Insert", kind: "primary", run: (host) => {
            const v = $("[data-fx-paste]", host).value;
            if (!v) return toast("Nothing pasted", "warn");
            q.insertText(r.index, v, "user");
            toast("Pasted");
         } }]);
      return;
    }
    q.insertText(r.index, text, "user");
    toast("Pasted");
  };

  /* ======================================================================
   * 3. PRINT — preview first, then print, with offline-safe fallbacks
   * ==================================================================== */
  const PAGE = () => (window.REF && window.REF.pageSetup) || {};

  function printDocumentHtml() {
    const r = rec(); if (!r) return "";
    const q = r.q;
    const ps = PAGE();
    const sizes = { a4: "210mm 297mm", letter: "8.5in 11in", legal: "8.5in 14in", a5: "148mm 210mm", a3: "297mm 420mm", tabloid: "11in 17in", executive: "7.25in 10.5in", b5: "176mm 250mm" };
    const size = sizes[ps.size] || sizes.a4;
    const orient = ps.orient === "landscape" ? " landscape" : "";
    const margin = (ps.margin && ps.margin !== "custom") ? "18mm" : "18mm";
    const title = (r.name || "Document").replace(/</g, "<");
    return `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${title}</title>
<style>
  @page { size: ${size}${orient}; margin: ${margin}; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { font-family: "Segoe UI", Inter, Arial, sans-serif; color: #111827; margin: 0; line-height: 1.65; }
  h1,h2,h3,h4 { line-height: 1.25; margin: 18px 0 8px; }
  p { margin: 0 0 10px; }
  table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin: 10px 0; }
  td, th { border: 1px solid #9ca3af; padding: 6px 9px; vertical-align: top; }
  th { background: #f3f4f6; text-align: left; }
  img, video { max-width: 100%; }
  blockquote { margin: 10px 0; padding-left: 14px; border-left: 3px solid #d1d5db; color: #374151; }
  pre { background: #f3f4f6; padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; white-space: pre-wrap; }
  .doc-pagebreak { page-break-after: always; height: 0; border: 0; }
  .doc-pagebreak span { display: none; }
  .docbox { border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; margin: 8px 0; page-break-inside: avoid; }
  .lb-bar { display: none !important; }
  .doc-toc a { text-decoration: none; color: #111827; }
  .trk-ins { text-decoration: underline; }
  .trk-del { text-decoration: line-through; }
  .ql-cursor, .ql-ui { display: none !important; }
</style></head><body>${q.root.innerHTML}</body></html>`;
  }

  function downloadText(name, text, mime) {
    try {
      const blob = new Blob([text], { type: mime || "text/html;charset=utf-8" });
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = name;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); a.remove(); }, 4000);
      return true;
    } catch (e) { return false; }
  }

  function printNow(html) {
    /* 1) hidden iframe — the reliable, pop-up-free path */
    const f = document.createElement("iframe");
    f.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    f.style.cssText = "position:fixed;right:0;bottom:0;width:1px;height:1px;border:0;opacity:0";
    document.body.appendChild(f);
    let printed = false;
    try {
      const d = f.contentWindow.document;
      d.open(); d.write(html); d.close();
      f.contentWindow.focus();
      f.contentWindow.print();
      printed = true;
    } catch (e) {
      /* sandboxed preview: printing is blocked by the embedding page */
    }
    setTimeout(() => f.remove(), 60000);
    return printed;
  }

  function printPreview() {
    const r = rec();
    if (!r) return toast("Open the editor first", "warn");
    const html = printDocumentHtml();
    const embedded = (() => { try { return window.self !== window.top; } catch (e) { return true; } })();
    const body = `<div class="fx-print-shell">
        <div class="fx-print-paper">${r.q.root.innerHTML}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="studio-hint">${embedded
        ? "This editor is running inside an embedded preview, where browsers block printing. Use <b>Download HTML</b> and print that file, or open <code>calendar.html</code> in its own tab."
        : "The print dialog opens with the page setup, headers and footers already applied."}</div>`;
    modal("Print preview", body, [
      { label: "Close" },
      { label: "Copy HTML", run: () => {
          const done = () => toast("Print-ready HTML copied to the clipboard");
          const fail = () => {
            const body2 = `<div class="studio-hint">Downloads and the clipboard are blocked in this embedded preview. Select the HTML below and copy it into a <code>.html</code> file.</div>
              <textarea class="fx-html-out" readonly style="width:100%;height:260px;font:12px/1.5 ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace">${esc(html)}</textarea>`;
            const a = modal("Print-ready HTML", body2, [{ label: "Close" }], { wide: true });
            setTimeout(() => { const t = $(".fx-html-out"); if (t) { t.focus(); t.select(); } }, 60);
            return a;
          };
          try {
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
              navigator.clipboard.writeText(html).then(done).catch(fail);
            } else fail();
          } catch (e) { fail(); }
        } },
      { label: "Download HTML", run: () => { downloadText(((r.name || "document") + ".html").replace(/\s+/g, "-"), html); } },
      { label: "Print", kind: "primary", run: () => {
          const ok = printNow(html);
          if (ok) toast("Print dialog opened");
          else {
            downloadText(((r.name || "document") + ".html").replace(/\s+/g, "-"), html);
            toast("Printing is blocked in this preview — print-ready HTML downloaded instead", "warn");
          }
        } },
    ], { wide: true });
  }
  window.fxPrint = printPreview;
  ACT.print = () => printPreview();

  /* Ctrl/Cmd+P anywhere in the studio */
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (!(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) || e.key.toLowerCase() !== "p") return;
    if (!rec()) return;
    if (e.target.closest("input,textarea,[contenteditable=true]") && e.target.closest(".ql-editor")) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    printPreview();
  }, true);

  /* ======================================================================
   * 4. VIDEO — local file upload + link
   * ==================================================================== */
  function insertBlockHtml(html, w, h) {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const r = rangeOf(q);
    try {
      q.insertEmbed(r.index, "docbox", { html, w: w || 6, h: h || 2, shape: "rect", margin: 0.6 }, "user");
      q.setSelection(r.index + 1, 0, "user");
      q.focus();
    } catch (e) {
      /* no docbox blot? fall back to plain HTML paste */
      q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(r.index, html, "user");
    }
    toast("Inserted");
  }

  function videoEmbed(src, kind, label) {
    if (kind === "link") {
      return `<div class="fx-video"><iframe src="${esc(src)}" title="${esc(label || "Video")}" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen loading="lazy" style="width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border:0;border-radius:8px"></iframe>
        <div class="fx-video-cap">${esc(label || "Embedded video")}</div></div>`;
    }
    return `<div class="fx-video"><video controls preload="metadata" playsinline src="${src}" style="width:100%;max-height:360px;border-radius:8px;background:#000"></video>
      <div class="fx-video-cap">${esc(label || "Video")}</div></div>`;
  }

  function videoDialog() {
    const body = `
      <div class="studio-row2">
        <div class="studio-field"><label>Upload a video file</label>
          <input type="file" accept="video/*" data-vid-file></div>
        <div class="studio-field"><label>Caption (optional)</label>
          <input type="text" data-vid-cap placeholder="e.g. Product demo"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="studio-hint">MP4, WebM or Ogg up to ~20 MB. The video is embedded in the document itself, so no internet is needed.</div>
      <hr class="fx-sep">
      <div class="studio-field"><label>…or embed a link (YouTube / Vimeo)</label>
        <input type="text" data-vid-url placeholder="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=…"></div>
      <div class="studio-hint">Links need an internet connection to play; the player is embedded as a 16:9 frame.</div>`;
    modal("Insert video", body, [
      { label: "Cancel" },
      { label: "Insert", kind: "primary", run: (host) => {
          const file = $("[data-vid-file]", host).files[0];
          const url = ($("[data-vid-url]", host).value || "").trim();
          const cap = ($("[data-vid-cap]", host).value || "").trim();
          if (file) {
            if (file.size > 20 * 1024 * 1024) return toast("That video is larger than 20 MB — use a link instead", "warn");
            const rd = new FileReader();
            rd.onload = () => { insertBlockHtml(videoEmbed(rd.result, "file", cap || file.name), 7, 3); };
            rd.onerror = () => toast("That file could not be read", "warn");
            rd.readAsDataURL(file);
            return;
          }
          if (url) {
            let embed = url;
            const yt = url.match(/(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/)|youtu\.be\/)([\w-]{6,})/);
            const vm = url.match(/vimeo\.com\/(\d+)/);
            if (yt) embed = "https://www.youtube.com/embed/" + yt[1];
            else if (vm) embed = "https://player.vimeo.com/video/" + vm[1];
            insertBlockHtml(videoEmbed(embed, "link", cap), 7, 3);
            return;
          }
          toast("Choose a video file or paste a link", "warn");
        } },
    ]);
  }
  window.fxVideoDialog = videoDialog;
  ACT.video = () => videoDialog();

  /* playing a video must not push the caret around */
  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const t = e.target;
    if (t && t.tagName === "VIDEO") e.stopPropagation();
  }, true);

  /* ======================================================================
   * 5. CONTENT CONTROLS — real, interactive widgets
   * ==================================================================== */
  const CC = {
    richtext: { label: "Rich text", icon: "⊞" },
    plaintext: { label: "Plain text", icon: "⊞" },
    checkbox: { label: "Check box", icon: "☑" },
    dropdown: { label: "Drop-down list", icon: "▾" },
    combo: { label: "Combo box", icon: "⌄" },
    date: { label: "Date picker", icon: "📅" },
  };

  function ccHtml(kind) {
    const id = "cc" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
    if (kind === "checkbox") {
      return `<span class="fx-cc fx-cc-check" data-cc="check" data-on="0" role="checkbox" aria-checked="false" tabindex="0" contenteditable="false">☐ <span class="fx-cc-txt" contenteditable="true">Check box</span></span>`;
    }
    if (kind === "dropdown" || kind === "combo") {
      const items = ["Item 1", "Item 2", "Item 3"];
      const menu = items.map((i) => `<button type="button" data-cc-pick="${esc(i)}">${esc(i)}</button>`).join("");
      return `<span class="fx-cc fx-cc-drop" data-cc="${kind}" data-items="${esc(items.join("|"))}" contenteditable="false">
        <span class="fx-cc-val">${kind === "combo" ? "Pick or type" : "Choose an item"}</span>
        <span class="fx-cc-arrow" role="button" aria-label="Choose an item" tabindex="0">▾</span>
        <span class="fx-cc-menu" role="listbox">${menu}</span>
      </span>`;
    }
    if (kind === "date") {
      return `<span class="fx-cc fx-cc-date" data-cc="date" contenteditable="false"><input type="date" aria-label="Pick a date"></span>`;
    }
    const rich = kind !== "plaintext";
    return `<div class="fx-cc fx-cc-text${rich ? " fx-cc-rich" : " fx-cc-plain"}" data-cc="${rich ? "richtext" : "plaintext"}"
        contenteditable="true" role="textbox" aria-label="${rich ? "Rich text content control" : "Plain text content control"}"
        data-placeholder="${rich ? "Click or tap here to enter text." : "Click or tap here to enter text."}"></div>`;
  }

  function insertCC(kind) {
    const q = Q();
    if (!q) return toast("Open a document first", "warn");
    const r = rangeOf(q);
    const html = ccHtml(kind || "richtext");
    const block = `<div class="fx-cc-wrap" contenteditable="false">${html}</div>`;
    try {
      q.insertEmbed(r.index, "docbox", { html: block, w: 6, h: kind === "richtext" ? 1.2 : 0.5, shape: "rect", margin: 0.6 }, "user");
      q.setSelection(r.index + 1, 0, "user");
    } catch (e) {
      q.clipboard.dangerouslyPasteHTML(r.index, block, "user");
    }
    toast(CC[kind] ? CC[kind].label + " control inserted" : "Content control inserted");
  }
  window.fxInsertContentControl = insertCC;
  ACT.contentControl = (a) => insertCC(a || "richtext");

  /* widget behaviour */
  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const t = e.target;
    if (!t || !t.closest) return;

    const check = t.closest('[data-cc="check"]');
    if (check) {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      const on = check.dataset.on === "1";
      check.dataset.on = on ? "0" : "1";
      check.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(!on));
      const box = check.firstChild;
      if (box && box.nodeType === 3) box.nodeValue = on ? "☐\u00a0" : "☑\u00a0";
      check.classList.toggle("on", !on);
      return;
    }

    const arrow = t.closest(".fx-cc-arrow");
    if (arrow) {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      const host = arrow.closest(".fx-cc-drop");
      $$(".fx-cc-menu", host).forEach((m) => m.classList.toggle("open"));
      return;
    }

    const pick = t.closest("[data-cc-pick]");
    if (pick) {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      const host = pick.closest(".fx-cc-drop");
      const lab = $(".fx-cc-val", host);
      if (lab) lab.textContent = pick.dataset.ccPick;
      $$(".fx-cc-menu", host).forEach((m) => m.classList.remove("open"));
      host.classList.add("chosen");
      return;
    }

    /* close any open dropdown */
    $$(".fx-cc-menu.open").forEach((m) => { if (!m.contains(t)) m.classList.remove("open"); });
  }, true);

  /* combo box: typing replaces the placeholder */
  document.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
    const t = e.target;
    if (!t || !t.closest) return;
    if (t.closest('[data-cc="plaintext"]')) {
      /* strip pasted formatting */
      const html = t.innerHTML;
      if (/<(?!br|\/div|\/span)/i.test(html)) {
        const text = t.textContent;
        t.textContent = text;
      }
    }
  }, true);

  /* ======================================================================
   * 6. FORWARD THE DESIGN COLOURS TO THE HOST'S OWN IMPLEMENTATIONS
   * ==================================================================== */
  /* the host's own Design implementations are reachable as globals — call
     them directly instead of hoping a swatch button exists for the colour */
  ACT.themeColor = (a) => {
    if (typeof window.setAccentColour === "function") return window.setAccentColour(a);
    $$(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
      sh.style.setProperty("--thm-accent", a);
      sh.style.setProperty("--thm-head", a);
      sh.style.setProperty("--primary", a);
      sh.classList.add("themed");
    });
    toast("Theme accent colour: " + a);
  };
  ACT.pageColor = (a) => {
    if (typeof window.setPageColour === "function") return window.setPageColour(a === "none" ? "" : a);
    $$(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => sh.style.setProperty("--page-bg", a === "none" ? "#ffffff" : a));
    toast(a === "none" ? "Page colour cleared" : "Page colour applied");
  };
  /* DOC_THEMES has no "Editorial" entry, so the Design ▸ Themes ▸ Editorial
     button silently did nothing. Add the theme, then use the host renderer. */
  try {
    if (typeof DOC_THEMES !== "undefined" && !DOC_THEMES.some((t) => t[0] === "editorial")) {
      DOC_THEMES.push(["editorial", "Editorial",
        { font: "Georgia", head: "#111827", accent: "#b45309", page: "#fffdf7" }]);
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  ACT.theme = (a) => {
    const btn = document.querySelector('[data-t="' + a + '"]');
    if (btn && !btn.dataset.stx) { btn.click(); return; }
    try {
      if (typeof applyDocTheme === "function") return applyDocTheme(a);
      if (typeof window.applyDocTheme === "function") return window.applyDocTheme(a);
    } catch (e) {}
    toast("Theme: " + a);
  };
  ACT.shapeFill = (a) => {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const sel = q.root.querySelector(".docbox.ov-selected, .layout-box.ov-selected, .docbox:focus-within, .layout-box:focus-within");
    const shapes = sel || q.root.querySelectorAll(".docbox, .layout-box");
    const node = sel || (shapes.length ? shapes[shapes.length - 1] : null);
    if (!node) return toast("Insert a shape or text box first", "warn");
    node.style.background = a;
    node.dataset.fill = a;
    toast("Shape fill applied");
  };
  ACT.paraDir = (a) => {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    const r = restore(q);
    if (!r) return;
    const rtl = a === "rtl";
    try { q.format("direction", rtl ? "rtl" : false, "user"); } catch (e) {}
    try { q.format("align", rtl ? "right" : false, "user"); } catch (e) {}
    /* also mark the block itself so the direction survives a re-render */
    try {
      const leaf = q.getLeaf(r.index);
      const node = leaf && leaf[0] && leaf[0].domNode;
      const block = node && node.parentElement && node.parentElement.closest("p,div,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,li");
      if (block) { block.setAttribute("dir", rtl ? "rtl" : "ltr"); block.style.direction = rtl ? "rtl" : "ltr"; block.style.textAlign = rtl ? "right" : ""; }
    } catch (e) {}
    toast(rtl ? "Right-to-left paragraph" : "Left-to-right paragraph");
  };
  ACT.pageNoFormat = (a) => {
    window.studioPnFormat = a;
    const ref = window.STUDIO_REF || {};
    const pc = ref.pageChrome || {};
    pc.numbers = true;
    if (!pc.numPos) pc.numPos = "bottom-center";
    if (typeof window.applyPageChrome === "function") window.applyPageChrome();
    const sh = document.querySelector(".rt-shell");
    if (sh) {
      const one = { "1": "1", i: "i", I: "I", a: "a", A: "A" }[a] || "1";
      sh.setAttribute("data-pn-format", one);
      sh.style.setProperty("--ftr", `"${pc.footer ? pc.footer + "   -   " : ""}Page \\${one} of \\${one}"`);
    }
    toast("Page number format: " + a);
  };

  /* commands that need a range: give them one before they run */
  ["wmCase", "wmAllCaps", "wmSmallCaps", "wmSortPara", "wmBorders", "characterStyle",
   "clearFormat", "spacingBA", "addText", "wmIndent"].forEach((k) => {
    const orig = ACT[k];
    if (typeof orig !== "function") return;
    ACT[k] = function (a, el) { restore(Q()); const out = orig.call(this, a, el); return out; };
  });

  /* commands that had nothing to act on: say so instead of doing nothing */
  const explain = {
    tocLevels: "Add headings first — the table of contents is built from them",
    tof: "Add captions first (References ▸ Insert caption)",
    tofUpdate: "Add captions first (References ▸ Insert caption)",
    prevChange: "No tracked changes in this document",
    nextChange: "No tracked changes in this document",
    rejectOne: "Put the caret on a tracked change first",
    nextComment: "Add a comment first (Review ▸ New comment)",
    prevComment: "Add a comment first (Review ▸ New comment)",
    deleteCommentAt: "Add a comment first (Review ▸ New comment)",
    "zoom-100": "",
  };
  Object.keys(explain).forEach((k) => {
    const orig = ACT[k];
    if (typeof orig !== "function") return;
    ACT[k] = function (a, el) {
      const before = document.body.innerHTML.length + (Q() ? Q().root.innerHTML.length : 0);
      const out = orig.call(this, a, el);
      if (!explain[k]) return out;
      setTimeout(() => {
        const after = document.body.innerHTML.length + (Q() ? Q().root.innerHTML.length : 0);
        const grew = Math.abs(after - before) > 4;
        if (!grew && !document.querySelector(".studio-modal, .ui-modal:not(.ui-modal-leave)")) toast(explain[k], "warn");
      }, 120);
      return out;
    };
  });

  /* ======================================================================
   * 7. COMMENTS — never fail because the caret collapsed
   * ==================================================================== */
  ACT.comment = () => {
    const q = Q(); if (!q) return;
    let r = q.getSelection();
    if (!r || !r.length) {
      const base = rangeOf(q);
      if (base && base.length) r = base;
    }
    if (!r || !r.length) {
      /* comment on the word under the caret, Word-style */
      const cur = baseCaret(q);
      if (cur) r = cur;
    }
    if (!r || !r.length) return toast("Put the caret in the text you want to comment on, or select it", "warn");
    q.setSelection(r.index, r.length, "silent");
    openCommentComposer(q, r);
  };

  function baseCaret(q) {
    const s = q.getSelection() || rangeOf(q);
    if (!s) return null;
    const text = q.getText(Math.max(0, s.index - 40), 80);
    const at = Math.min(40, Math.max(0, s.index - Math.max(0, s.index - 40)));
    let start = at, end = at;
    while (start > 0 && /[^\s.,;:!?]/.test(text[start - 1])) start--;
    while (end < text.length && /[^\s.,;:!?]/.test(text[end])) end++;
    if (end <= start) return { index: Math.max(0, s.index), length: 1 };
    const base = Math.max(0, s.index - 40);
    return { index: base + start, length: end - start };
  }

  function openCommentComposer(q, r) {
    const quote = q.getText(r.index, r.length).slice(0, 80);
    const body = `<div class="studio-hint">Commenting on: <b>“${esc(quote)}”</b></div>
      <div class="studio-field"><label>Comment</label>
        <textarea rows="4" data-fx-cmt placeholder="Your note…"></textarea></div>
      <label class="studio-check"><input type="checkbox" data-fx-cmt-author checked> Include my name</label>`;
    modal("New comment", body, [
      { label: "Cancel" },
      { label: "Comment", kind: "primary", run: (host) => {
          const text = ($("[data-fx-cmt]", host).value || "").trim();
          if (!text) return toast("Write the comment first", "warn");
          if (typeof window.addCommentWith === "function") { window.addCommentWith(q, r, text); return; }
          /* fall back to the host's own comment store */
          try {
            if (typeof window.docComments !== "undefined" && Array.isArray(window.docComments)) {
              window.docComments.push({ id: Date.now(), text, quote, at: Date.now(), resolved: false });
              q.formatText(r.index, r.length, "background", "#fef3c7", "user");
              toast("Comment added");
            } else { toast("Comment support is unavailable", "warn"); }
          } catch (e) { toast("Comment could not be added", "warn"); }
        } },
    ]);
  }

  /* ======================================================================
   * 7b. PAGE CHROME (header / footer / page numbers)
   * The host renders the footer through `--ftr` + `.has-ftr`, but its
   * applyPageChrome always prints the literal word "Page 1" and never
   * honours a number format, and the chrome wrappers in the extras layer
   * only fire if that global exists. This replaces it with a renderer that
   * understands the format (1 / i / I / a / A), the live page number and
   * the header/footer classes.
   * ==================================================================== */
  const ROMAN = [[1000, "m"], [900, "cm"], [500, "d"], [400, "cd"], [100, "c"], [90, "xc"],
    [50, "l"], [40, "xl"], [10, "x"], [9, "ix"], [5, "v"], [4, "iv"], [1, "i"]];
  function fmtNum(n, kind) {
    n = Math.max(1, Math.round(+n || 1));
    if (kind === "i" || kind === "I") {
      let x = n, out = "";
      ROMAN.forEach(([v, s2]) => { while (x >= v) { out += s2; x -= v; } });
      return kind === "I" ? out.toUpperCase() : out;
    }
    if (kind === "a" || kind === "A") {
      let out = "", x = n;
      while (x > 0) { const m = (x - 1) % 26; out = String.fromCharCode(97 + m) + out; x = Math.floor((x - 1) / 26); }
      return kind === "A" ? out.toUpperCase() : out;
    }
    return String(n);
  }
  window.__fxFmtNum = fmtNum;

  function chromeData() {
    const pc = (window.STUDIO_REF && window.STUDIO_REF.pageChrome) || {};
    const nav = (window.STUDIO_REF && window.STUDIO_REF.pageNav) || {};
    return {
      header: pc.header || "",
      footer: pc.footer || "",
      numbers: !!pc.numbers,
      first: nav.current || 1,
      total: nav.count || 1,
      fmt: window.studioPnFormat || pc.numFormat || "1",
    };
  }

  function renderChrome() {
    const d = chromeData();
    $$(".rt-shell").forEach((sh) => {
      sh.style.setProperty("--hdr", d.header ? '"' + d.header.replace(/"/g, '\\"') + '"' : '""');
      const num = d.numbers ? "Page " + fmtNum(d.first, d.fmt) + (d.total > 1 ? " of " + fmtNum(d.total, d.fmt) : "") : "";
      const ftr = [d.footer, num].filter(Boolean).join("   -   ");
      sh.style.setProperty("--ftr", ftr ? '"' + ftr.replace(/"/g, '\\"') + '"' : '""');
      sh.style.setProperty("--pn-format", d.fmt);
      sh.classList.toggle("has-hdr", !!d.header);
      sh.classList.toggle("has-ftr", !!(d.footer || d.numbers));
    });
  }
  window.__fxChrome = renderChrome;

  /* keep the host's own callers on the accurate renderer */
  try {
    const hostChrome = window.applyPageChrome;
    if (typeof hostChrome === "function" && !hostChrome.__fxWrapped) {
      const wrapped = function () {
        try { hostChrome.apply(this, arguments); } catch (e) {}
        renderChrome();
      };
      wrapped.__fxWrapped = true;
      window.applyPageChrome = wrapped;
      try { applyPageChrome = wrapped; } catch (e) {}
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  /* header/footer/page-number commands must render even when the host's
     function was never exposed as a global */
  ["headerPreset", "footerPreset", "pageNumber", "pageNoFormat"].forEach((k) => {
    const orig = ACT[k];
    ACT[k] = function (a, el) {
      let out;
      try { out = typeof orig === "function" ? orig.call(this, a, el) : undefined; } catch (e) {}
      renderChrome();
      return out;
    };
  });

  /* ======================================================================
   * 8. HOST `data-act` OVERRIDES
   * The host's own ribbon buttons are dispatched by its internal action
   * table, which this layer cannot see. Rather than duplicating behaviour,
   * the click is intercepted here and either handed to our safer version or
   * re-dispatched to the host with the selection restored.
   * ==================================================================== */
  let passthru = false;
  function runHost(el) {
    passthru = true;
    try { el.click(); } finally { setTimeout(() => { passthru = false; }, 0); }
  }

  const HOST = {
    print: () => printPreview(),
    video: () => videoDialog(),
    /* Call the host's addComment() directly instead of re-clicking the
       button: the click focuses the ribbon, which blurs the editor and
       blanks the live range, so the host's needsSelection() wrapper bailed
       out and "New comment" did nothing. */
    comment: (el) => {
      const q = Q();
      if (!q) return;
      let r = q.getSelection();
      if (!r || !r.length) r = rangeOf(q);
      if (!r || !r.length) r = baseCaret(q);
      if (!r || !r.length) return toast("Put the caret in the text you want to comment on, or select it", "warn");
      try { q.focus(); q.setSelection(r.index, r.length, "silent"); } catch (e) {}
      try {
        if (typeof addComment === "function") {
          addComment(q);
          try { if (!commentPaneOpen && typeof toggleCommentPane === "function") toggleCommentPane(); } catch (e2) {}
          return;
        }
      } catch (e3) { console.warn("[fixes] addComment", e3); }
      runHost(el);
    },
    copy: () => ACT.copy(),
    cut: () => ACT.cut(),
    paste: () => ACT.paste(),
    copyhtml: () => ACT.copyhtml(),
    copymd: () => ACT.copymd(),
    translate: (el) => {
      const q = Q();
      const s = q ? q.getSelection() : null;
      const text = q && s && s.length ? q.getText(s.index, s.length) : "";
      if (!text) return toast("Select the text to translate first", "warn");
      try {
        const w = window.open("https://translate.google.com/?sl=auto&text=" + encodeURIComponent(text), "_blank");
        if (w) return;
      } catch (e) {}
      copyText(text, "Selected text");
      toast("New tabs are blocked in this preview — the text is on your clipboard");
    },
  };

  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    if (passthru) return;
    const el = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("[data-act]");
    if (!el) return;
    const fn = HOST[el.dataset.act];
    if (!fn) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    try { fn(el); } catch (err) { console.warn("[fixes] host override", err); }
  }, true);

  /* ======================================================================
   * 8. Small robustness fixes
   * ==================================================================== */
  /* focus mode: requestFullscreen is blocked in embedded previews */
  const origFocus = ACT.wmFocus;
  if (typeof origFocus === "function") {
    ACT.wmFocus = function (a, el) {
      try { return origFocus.call(this, a, el); }
      catch (e) { const sh = document.querySelector(".rt-shell"); if (sh) sh.classList.toggle("wm-focus"); toast("Focus mode toggled"); }
    };
  }
  /* translate: window.open is blocked → keep the text in a dialog */
  const origTranslate = ACT.translate;
  if (typeof origTranslate === "function") {
    ACT.translate = async function (a, el) {
      const q = Q();
      const sel = q ? (q.getSelection() && q.getSelection().length ? q.getText(q.getSelection().index, q.getSelection().length) : "") : "";
      try {
        const w = window.open("https://translate.google.com/?text=" + encodeURIComponent(sel), "_blank");
        if (w) return;
      } catch (e) {}
      if (sel) copyText(sel, "Selected text");
      toast(sel ? "Translation needs a new tab (blocked here) — the text is on your clipboard" : "Select the text to translate first", sel ? "" : "warn");
    };
  }

  /* keep the sticky range in sync with the active editor */
  let tries = 0;
  (function boot() {
    const r = rec();
    if (!r || !r.q) { if (++tries < 80) setTimeout(boot, 250); return; }
    bindSel(r.q);
  })();
  setInterval(() => { const r = rec(); if (r && r.q) bindSel(r.q); }, 1500);
})();

</script>
<style id="studio-mobile-styles">
/* ============================================================================
 *  MOBILE LAYER — phone / tablet responsiveness & visual polish
 *  Loaded after every other stylesheet, so it wins ties.
 *  Two tiers:  ≤760px  (phones)   ·   761–1100px (tablets, light touch)
 * ========================================================================== */

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- 0. touch */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  html {
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
    text-size-adjust: 100%;
  }
  .rt-b,
  .rt-tab,
  .rt-exp,
  .rt-sw,
  .rt-dock-b,
  .studio-btn,
  .studio-icobtn,
  .studio-pill,
  .ui-btn,
  .btn-save-doc,
  .cal-chip,
  .cp-dot {
    touch-action: manipulation;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  /* the desktop tooltip bubble gets stuck over the status bar on touch */
  .ui-tip {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
 *  1. CALENDAR (phone)
 * ======================================================================== */
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  body {
    overscroll-behavior-y: contain;
  }
  header {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .header-left {
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .view-toggle {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
  }
  .view-toggle span,
  .view-toggle .mode-label {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
  }

  /* month strip */
  .cal-bar {
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 0 10px 2px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    scroll-snap-type: x proximity;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0, #000 94%, transparent 100%);
    mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0, #000 94%, transparent 100%);
  }
  .cal-bar::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
  .cal-chip {
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    height: 30px;
    padding: 0 11px;
    font-size: 0.74rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
  }

  /* grid — keep it reading as a calendar: flat tiles, hairline gutters */
  .cal-grid {
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 0 5px 6px;
    background: rgba(203, 213, 225, 0.45);
    grid-auto-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .day-head {
    height: 20px;
    font-size: 0.56rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    opacity: 0.62;
  }
  .day {
    border-radius: 7px;
    background: #fff;
    transition: background 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease;
  }
  .day:active {
    background: #eef2ff;
  }
  .day.today,
  .day.is-today {
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--primary, #4f46e5);
  }
  .day.today .date-num {
    font-weight: 800;
  }
  .day .date-num {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
  }

  /* floating buttons: keep them clear of the sheet and the home indicator */
  .add-fab {
    right: 12px;
    bottom: calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    width: 50px;
    height: 50px;
  }
  /* the sheet and the floating button must never overlap */
  #overlay.active ~ .master-btn,
  body.sheet-open .master-btn {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: translateY(8px);
  }
  .master-btn {
    transition: opacity 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease;
  }

  /* iOS Safari: 100vh includes the URL bar, so the action bar fell off-screen */
  @supports (height: 100dvh) {
    .sheet.full-mode {
      height: 100dvh;
      max-height: 100dvh;
    }
    .sheet.full-mode .sh-body {

/* ==========================================================================
 *  5. STUDIO — status bar, action bar, floating dock

  .studio-statusbar .studio-zoomwrap,

/* ==========================================================================
 *  6. STUDIO — popovers as bottom sheets (polish)
 * ======================================================================== */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .rt-portal .rt-pop,
  .rt-pop.rt-pop-sheet {
    position: fixed !important;
    left: 0 !important;
    right: 0 !important;
    bottom: 0 !important;
    top: auto !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    max-height: min(70vh, 560px) !important;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0 !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
    border-bottom: 0;
    padding: 6px 14px calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 -10px 48px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45) !important;
    animation: fxSheetUp 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.9, 0.24, 1);
    z-index: 14000 !important;
  }
  @keyframes fxSheetUp {
    from {
      opacity: 0.4;
      transform: translateY(26px);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: none;
    }
  }
  .rt-pop.rt-pop-sheet::before {
    width: 44px;
    height: 4px;
    margin: 4px auto 12px;
    background: #cbd5e1;
  }
  .rt-pop .rt-pop-h {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    background: inherit;
    padding: 4px 0 6px;
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.09em;
    color: #64748b;
  }
  .rt-pop .rt-exp,
  .rt-pop .rt-row,
  .rt-pop button[data-stx] {
    min-height: 44px;
    border-radius: 11px;
  }
  .rt-pop .rt-symgrid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(44px, 1fr));
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .rt-pop .rt-sym {
    min-height: 44px !important;
  }
  /* scrim behind the sheet */
  body.fx-sheet-open::after {
    content: "";
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.38);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(1px);
    backdrop-filter: blur(1px);
    z-index: 13000;
    animation: fxFade 0.18s ease;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  @keyframes fxFade {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
 *  7. STUDIO — dialogs become full-width bottom sheets
 * ======================================================================== */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .studio-modal,
  .ui-modal {
    align-items: flex-end !important;

 *  9b. Tablets (761–1024) get more air than phones
 * ======================================================================== */
@media (min-width: 761px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
  .rt-shell .ql-editor {
    padding: 32px 40px 80px !important;
    font-size: 17px;

  .studio-search {

/* ==========================================================================
 * 10. Reduced motion
 * ======================================================================== */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

<script id="studio-mobile">
/* ============================================================================
 *  MOBILE LAYER — behaviour that CSS alone cannot do
 *  · tags <html> with fx-phone / fx-tablet
 *  · scrim + body lock while a ribbon sheet or a dialog is open
 *  · keeps the active ribbon tab in view
 *  · keeps the caret visible above the on-screen keyboard
 * ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  if (window.__FX_MOBILE__) return;
  window.__FX_MOBILE__ = true;

  var PHONE = "(max-width: 760px)";
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var mq = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia(PHONE) : null;

  function tag() {
    var phone = mq ? mq.matches : window.innerWidth <= 760;
    var tablet = !phone && window.innerWidth <= 1100;
    root.classList.toggle("fx-phone", !!phone);
    root.classList.toggle("fx-tablet", !!tablet);
  }
  tag();
  if (mq) {
    if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener("change", tag);
    else if (mq.addListener) mq.addListener(tag);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", tag, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener("orientationchange", function () { setTimeout(tag, 120); }, { passive: true });

  var isPhone = function () { return root.classList.contains("fx-phone"); };

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- sheets */
  function syncSheets() {
    var open = document.querySelector(".rt-portal .rt-pop");
    document.body.classList.toggle("fx-sheet-open", !!open && isPhone());
  }
  try {
    new MutationObserver(syncSheets).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } catch (e) {}
  document.addEventListener("click", function () { setTimeout(syncSheets, 40); }, true);

  /* ------------------------------------------------- modal body lock */
  function syncModal() {
    var open = document.querySelector(".studio-modal, .ui-modal");
    document.body.classList.toggle("fx-modal-open", !!open);
  }
  try {
    new MutationObserver(syncModal).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } catch (e) {}

  /* ------------------------------------------- active tab stays reachable */
  document.addEventListener(
    "click",
    function (e) {
      var tab = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".rt-tab");
      if (!tab || !isPhone()) return;
      setTimeout(function () {
        try {
          tab.scrollIntoView({ inline: "center", block: "nearest", behavior: "smooth" });
        } catch (err) {
          tab.scrollIntoView(false);
        }
      }, 60);
    },
    true
  );

  /* ------------------------------- search expands over the title bar */
  function bindSearch() {
    var box = document.querySelector(".studio-search");
    if (!box || box.__fx) return;
    box.__fx = true;
    var input = box.querySelector("input");
    if (!input) return;
    box.addEventListener(
      "click",
      function (e) {
        if (!isPhone() || box.classList.contains("fx-open")) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        box.classList.add("fx-open");
        setTimeout(function () {
          try { input.focus(); } catch (err) {}
        }, 20);
      },
      true
    );
    input.addEventListener("blur", function () {
      box.classList.remove("fx-open");
    });
    input.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
      if (e.key === "Escape") { box.classList.remove("fx-open"); input.blur(); }
    });
  }
  setTimeout(bindSearch, 400);
  setTimeout(bindSearch, 1800);

  /* -------------------------------- keep the caret clear of the keyboard */
  var vv = window.visualViewport;
  if (vv) {
    var onResize = function () {
      if (!isPhone()) return;
      document.body.classList.toggle("fx-kb-open", vv.height < window.innerHeight - 140);
      var ed = document.querySelector(".ql-editor");
      var sel = window.getSelection();
      if (!ed || !sel || !sel.rangeCount) return;
      var node = sel.getRangeAt(0).endContainer;
      if (!node || !ed.contains(node)) return;
      var r = sel.getRangeAt(0).getClientRects()[0];
      if (!r) return;
      var bottomLimit = vv.offsetTop + vv.height - 64;
      if (r.bottom > bottomLimit) {
        window.scrollBy({ top: r.bottom - bottomLimit, behavior: "smooth" });
      }
    };
    vv.addEventListener("resize", onResize, { passive: true });
    vv.addEventListener("scroll", onResize, { passive: true });
  }

  /* --------------------------------------- avoid iOS double-tap zoom lag */
  var lastTouch = 0;
  document.addEventListener(
    "touchend",
    function (e) {
      var now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastTouch <= 320 && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".rt-b,.rt-tab,.cal-chip,.study-btn")) {
        e.preventDefault();
      }
      lastTouch = now;
    },
    { passive: false }
  );
})();

</script>
